devanagari: यस्य प्रसादादज्ञोऽपि सद्यः सर्व - ज्ञतां व्रजेत् ।
स श्री - चैतन्य - देवो में भगवान्सम्प्रसीदतु ॥1॥
cc-madhya-1.1.translation: Even a person with no knowledge can immediately acquire all knowledge simply by the benediction of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore I am praying to the Lord for His causeless mercy upon me.

lines: prabhura aśeṣa līlā nā yāya varṇana
devanagari: एबे कहि शेष - लीलार मुख्य सूत्र - गण ।
प्रभुर अशेष लीला ना याय वर्णन ॥10॥
cc-madhya-1.10.translation: To describe the unlimited pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is not possible, but I now wish to relate the chief incidents and give a synopsis of those pastimes occurring at the end.

lines: pāche āsi' mili' sabe pāila ānanda
devanagari: नित्यानन्द, जगदा नन्द, दामोदर, मुकुन्द ।
पाछे आ सि’ मिलि’ सबे पाइल आनन्द ॥100॥
cc-madhya-1.100.translation: The Lord had left Nityānanda's company and had gone alone to the Jagannātha temple, but later Nityānanda, Jagadānanda, Dāmodara and Mukunda came to see Him, and after seeing Him they were very pleased.

devanagari: तबे सार्वभौमे प्रभु प्रसाद करिल ।
आपन - ईश्वर - मूर्ति ताँरे देखाइल ॥101॥
cc-madhya-1.101.translation: After this incident, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu bestowed His mercy upon Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya by showing him His original form as the Lord.

lines: tabe ta' karilā prabhu dakṣiṇa gamana
devanagari: तबे त’ करिला प्रभु दक्षिण गमन ।
कूर्म - क्षेत्रे कैल वासुदेव विमोचन ॥102॥
cc-madhya-1.102.translation: After bestowing mercy upon Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, the Lord started for southern India. When He came to Kūrma-kṣetra, He delivered a person named Vāsudeva.

devanagari: जियड़ - नृसिंहे कैल नृसिंह - स्तवन ।
पथे - पथे ग्रामे - ग्रामे नाम - प्रवर्तन ॥103॥
cc-madhya-1.103.translation: After visiting Kūrma-kṣetra, the Lord visited the South Indian temple of Jiyaḍa-nṛsiṁha and offered His prayers to Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva. On His way, He introduced the chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra in every village.

devanagari: गोदावरी - तीर - वने वृन्दावन - भ्रम ।
रामानन्द राय सह ताहाञि मिलन ॥104॥
cc-madhya-1.104.translation: Once the Lord mistook the forest on the bank of the river Godāvarī to be Vṛndāvana. In that place He happened to meet Rāmānanda Rāya.

devanagari: त्रिमल्ल - त्रिपदी - स्थान कैल दरशन ।
सर्वत्र करिल कृष्ण - नाम प्रचारण ॥105॥
cc-madhya-1.105.translation: He visited the place known as Trimalla, or Tirupati, and there He extensively preached the chanting of the Lord's holy name.

devanagari: तबे त’ पाषण्डि - गणे करिल दलन ।
अहोवल - नृसिंहादि कैल दरशन ॥106॥
cc-madhya-1.106.translation: After visiting the temple of Trimalla, or Tripadī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had to subdue some atheists. He then visited the temple of Ahovala-nṛsiṁha.

devanagari: श्री - रङ्ग - क्षेत्र आइला कावेरीर तीर ।
श्री - रङ्ग देखिया प्रेमे हइला अस्थिर ॥107॥
cc-madhya-1.107.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came to the land of Śrī Raṅga-kṣetra, on the bank of the Kāverī, He visited the temple of Śrī Raṅganātha and was there overwhelmed in the ecstasy of love of Godhead.

lines: trimalla bhaṭṭera ghare kaila prabhu vāsa
tāhāñi rahilā prabhu varṣā cāri māsa
devanagari: त्रिमल्ल भट्टेर घरे कैल प्रभु वास ।
ताहाञि रहिला प्रभु वर्षा चारि मास ॥108॥
cc-madhya-1.108.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lived at the house of Trimalla Bhaṭṭa for the four months of the rainy season.

devanagari: श्री - वैष्णव त्रिमल्ल - भट्ट - परम पण्डित ।
गोसाञि र पाण्डित्य - प्रेमे हइला विस्मित ॥109॥
cc-madhya-1.109.translation: Śrī Trimalla Bhaṭṭa was both a member of the Śrī Vaiṣṇava community and a learned scholar; therefore when he saw Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who was both a great scholar and a great devotee of the Lord, he was very much astonished.

devanagari: तार मध्ये येइ भाग दास - वृन्दावन ।
‘चैतन्य - मङ्गले विस्तारि’ करिला वर्णन ॥11॥
cc-madhya-1.11-12.translation: I shall describe only in synopsis that portion which Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has described very elaborately in his book Caitanya-maṅgala. Whatever incidents are outstanding, however, I shall later elaborate.

devanagari: चातुर्मास्य ताँहा प्रभु श्री - वैष्णवेर सने ।
गोङाइल नृत्य - गीत - कृष्ण - सङ्कीर्तने ॥110॥
cc-madhya-1.110.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed the Cāturmāsya months with the Śrī Vaiṣṇavas, dancing, singing and chanting the holy name of the Lord.

devanagari: चातुर्मास्य - अन्ते पुनः दक्षिण गमन ।
परमानन्द - पुरी सह ताहाञि मिलन ॥111॥
cc-madhya-1.111.translation: After the end of Cāturmāsya, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued traveling throughout southern India. At that time He met Paramānanda Purī.

devanagari: तबे भट्टथारि हैते कृष्ण - दासेर उद्धार ।
राम - जपी विप्र - मुखे कृष्ण - नाम प्रचार ॥112॥
cc-madhya-1.112.translation: After this, Kṛṣṇadāsa, the servant of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, was delivered from the clutches of a Bhaṭṭathāri. Caitanya Mahāprabhu then preached that Lord Kṛṣṇa's name should also be chanted by brāhmaṇas who were accustomed to chanting Lord Rāma's name.

devanagari: श्री - रङ्ग - पुरी सह ताहाञि मिलन ।
रामदास विप्रेर कैल दुःख - विमोचन ॥113॥
cc-madhya-1.113.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then met Śrī Raṅgapurī and mitigated all the sufferings of a brāhmaṇa named Rāmadāsa.

devanagari: तत्त्व - वादी सह कैल तत्त्वेर विचार ।
आपनाके हीन - बुद्धि हैल ताँ - सबार ॥114॥
cc-madhya-1.114.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu also had a discussion with the Tattvavādī community, and the Tattvavādīs felt themselves to be inferior Vaiṣṇavas.

devanagari: अनन्त, पुरुषोत्तम, श्री जनार्दन ।
पद्मनाभ, वासुदेव कैल दरशन ॥115॥
cc-madhya-1.115.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then visited the Viṣṇu temples of Anantadeva, Puruṣottama, Śrī Janārdana, Padmanābha and Vāsudeva.

devanagari: तबे प्रभु कैल सप्त - ताल विमोचन ।
सेतु - बन्धे स्नान, रामेश्वर दरशन ॥116॥
cc-madhya-1.116.translation: After that, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered the celebrated Saptatāla tree, took His bath at Setubandha Rāmeśvara and visited the temple of Lord Śiva known as Rāmeśvara.

devanagari: ताहाञि करिल कूर्म - पुराण श्रवण ।
माया - सीता निलेक रावण, ताहाते लिखन ॥117॥
cc-madhya-1.117.translation: At Rāmeśvara, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had a chance to read the Kūrma Purāṇa, in which He discovered that the form of Sītā kidnapped by Rāvaṇa was not that of the real Sītā but a mere shadow representation.

devanagari: शुनिया प्रभुर आनन्दित हैल मन ।
रामदास विप्रेर कथा हइल स्मरण ॥118॥
cc-madhya-1.118.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very glad to read about the false Sītā, and He remembered His meeting with Rāmadāsa Vipra, who was very sorry that mother Sītā had been kidnapped by Rāvaṇa.

lines: sei purātana patra āgraha kari' nila
devanagari: सेइ पुरातन पत्र आग्रह क रि’ निल ।
रामदासे देखाइया दुःख खण्डाइल ॥119॥
cc-madhya-1.119.translation: Indeed, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu eagerly tore this page from the Kūrma Purāṇa, although the book was very old, and He later showed it to Rāmadāsa Vipra, whose unhappiness was mitigated.

lines: dui pustaka lañā āilā uttama jāniñā
devanagari: ब्रह्म - संहिता, कर्णामृत, दुइ पुँथि पाञा ।
दुइ पुस्तक लञा आइला उत्तम जानिञा ॥120॥
cc-madhya-1.120.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also found two other books-namely, Brahma-saṁhitā and Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta. Knowing these books to be excellent, He took them to present to His devotees.

devanagari: पुनरपि नीलाचले गमन करिल ।
भक्त - गणे मेलिया स्नान - यात्रा देखिल ॥121॥
cc-madhya-1.121.translation: After collecting these books, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to Jagannātha Purī. At that time, the bathing ceremony of Jagannātha was taking place, and He saw it.

devanagari: अनवसरे जगन्नाथेर ना पाञा दरशन ।
विरहे आलालनाथ करिला गमन ॥122॥
cc-madhya-1.122.translation: When Jagannātha was absent from the temple, Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who could not see Him, felt separation and left Jagannātha Purī to go to a place known as Ālālanātha.

devanagari: भक्त - सने दिन कत ताहाञि रहिला ।
गौड़ेर भक्त आइसे, समाचार पाइला ॥123॥
cc-madhya-1.123.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained for some days at Ālālanātha. In the meantime, Caitanya Mahāprabhu received news that all the devotees from Bengal were coming to Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - सार्वभौम आग्रह करिञा ।
नीलाचले आइला महाप्रभुके लइञा ॥124॥
cc-madhya-1.124.translation: When the devotees from Bengal arrived at Jagannātha Purī, both Nityānanda Prabhu and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya greatly endeavored to take Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu back to Jagannātha Purī.

lines: virahe vihvala prabhu nā jāne rātri-dine
devanagari: विरहे विह्वल प्रभु ना जाने रात्रि - दिने ।
हेन - काले आइला गौड़ेर भक्त - गणे ॥125॥
cc-madhya-1.125.translation: When Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu finally left Ālālanātha to return to Jagannātha Purī, He was overwhelmed both day and night due to separation from Jagannātha. His lamentation knew no bounds. During this time, all the devotees from different parts of Bengal, and especially from Navadvīpa, arrived in Jagannātha Purī.

lines: sabe mili' yukti kari' kīrtana ārambhila
devanagari: सबे मिलि ‘युक्ति करि’ कीर्तन आरम्भिल ।
कीर्तन - आवेशे प्रभुर मन स्थिर हैल ॥126॥
cc-madhya-1.126.translation: After due consideration, all the devotees began chanting the holy name congregationally. Lord Caitanya's mind was thus pacified by the ecstasy of the chanting.

devanagari: पूर्वे यबे प्रभु रामानन्देरे मिलिला ।
नीलाचले आसिबारे ताँरे आज्ञा दिला ॥127॥
cc-madhya-1.127.translation: Previously, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had been touring South India, He had met Rāmānanda Rāya on the banks of the Godāvarī. At that time it had been decided that Rāmānanda Rāya would resign from his post as governor and return to Jagannātha Purī to live with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: rāja-ājñā lañā teṅho āilā kata dine
devanagari: राज - आज्ञा लञा तेंहो आइला कत दिने ।
रात्रि - दिने कृष्ण - कथा रामानन्द - सने ॥128॥
cc-madhya-1.128.translation: Upon the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya took leave of the King and returned to Jagannātha Purī. After he arrived, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu very much enjoyed talking with him both day and night about Lord Kṛṣṇa and His pastimes.

devanagari: काशी - मिश्रे कृपा, प्रद्युम्न मिश्रादि - मिलन ।
परमानन्द - पुरी - गोविन्द - काशीश्वरागमन ॥129॥
cc-madhya-1.129.translation: After Rāmānanda Rāya's arrival, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bestowed His mercy upon Kāśī Miśra and met Pradyumna Miśra. At that time three personalities-Paramānanda Purī, Govinda and Kāśīśvara-came to see Lord Caitanya at Jagannātha Purī.

lines: tāṅra ājñāya karoṅ tāṅra ucchiṣṭa carvaṇa
devanagari: चैतन्य - लीलार व्यास - दास वृन्दावन ।
ताँर आज्ञाय करों ताँर उच्छिष्ट चर्वण ॥13॥
cc-madhya-1.13.translation: Actually the authorized compiler of the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is Śrīla dāsa Vṛndāvana, the incarnation of Vyāsadeva. Only upon his orders am I trying to chew the remnants of food that he has left.

devanagari: दामोदर - स्वरूप - मिलने परम आनन्द ।
शिखि - माहिति - मिलन, राय भवानन्द ॥130॥
cc-madhya-1.130.translation: Eventually there was a meeting with Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, and the Lord became very greatly pleased. Then there was a meeting with Śikhi Māhiti and with Bhavānanda Rāya, the father of Rāmānanda Rāya.

devanagari: गौड़ हइते सर्व वैष्णवेर आगमन ।
कुलीन - ग्राम - वासि - सङ्गे प्रथम मिलन ॥131॥
cc-madhya-1.131.translation: All the devotees from Bengal gradually began arriving at Jagannātha Purī. At this time, the residents of Kulīna-grāma also came to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for the first time.

devanagari: नरहरि दास आदि यत खण्ड - वासी ।
शिवानन्द - सेन - सङ्गे मिलिला सबे आसि’ ॥132॥
cc-madhya-1.132.translation: Eventually Narahari dāsa and other inhabitants of Khaṇḍa, along with Śivānanda Sena, all arrived, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu met them.

lines: sabā lañā kailā prabhu guṇḍicā mārjana
devanagari: स्नान - यात्रा देखि’ प्रभु सङ्गे भक्त - गण ।
सबा लञा कैला प्रभु गुण्डिचा मार्जन ॥133॥
cc-madhya-1.133.translation: After seeing the bathing ceremony of Lord Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu washed and cleaned Śrī Guṇḍicā temple with the assistance of many devotees.

devanagari: सबा - सङ्गे रथ - यात्रा कैल दरशन ।
रथ - अग्रे नृत्य करि’ उद्याने गमन ॥134॥
cc-madhya-1.134.translation: After this, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and all the devotees saw the Ratha-yātrā, the car festival ceremony. Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself danced in front of the car, and after dancing He entered a garden.

devanagari: प्रतापरुद्रेरे कृपा कैल सेइ स्थाने ।
गौड़ीया - भक्ते आज्ञा दिल विदायेर दिने ॥135॥
cc-madhya-1.135.translation: In that garden, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu bestowed His mercy upon King Pratāparudra. Afterwards, when the Bengali devotees were about to return home, the Lord gave separate orders to almost every one of them.

devanagari: प्रत्यब्द आसिबे रथ - यात्रा - दरशने ।
एइ छले चाहे भक्त - गणेर मिलने ॥136॥
cc-madhya-1.136.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu desired to meet all the devotees of Bengal every year. Therefore He ordered them to come to see the Ratha-yātrā festival every year.

lines: ṣāṭhīra mātā kahe, yāte rāṇḍī ha-uk ṣāṭhī
devanagari: सार्वभौम - घरे प्रभुर भिक्षा - परिपाटी ।
षाठीर माता कहे, य़ाते राण्डी हउक् षाठी ॥137॥
cc-madhya-1.137.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was invited to dine at the house of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya. While He was eating sumptuously, the son-in-law of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya [the husband of his daughter Ṣāṭhī] criticized Him. Because of this, Ṣāṭhī's mother cursed him by praying that Ṣāṭhī would become a widow. In other words, she cursed her son-in-law to die.

devanagari: वर्षान्तरे अद्वैतादि भक्तेर आगमन ।
प्रभुरे देखिते सबे करिला गमन ॥138॥
cc-madhya-1.138.translation: At the end of the year, all the devotees from Bengal, headed by Advaita Ācārya, again came to see the Lord. Indeed, there was a great rush of devotees to Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: आनन्दे सबारे निया देन वास - स्थान ।
शिवानन्द सेन करे सबार पालन ॥139॥
cc-madhya-1.139.translation: When all the devotees from Bengal arrived, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu allotted them residential quarters, and Śivānanda Sena was put in charge of their maintenance.

lines: bhakti kari' śire dhari tāṅhāra caraṇa
devanagari: भक्ति क रि’ शिरे धरि ताँहार चरण ।
शेष - लीलार सूत्र - गण करिये वर्णन ॥14॥
cc-madhya-1.14.translation: Placing his lotus feet upon my head in great devotion, I shall now describe in summary the Lord's final pastimes.

devanagari: शिवानन्देर सङ्गे आइला कुक्कुर भाग्यवान् ।
प्रभुर चरण देखि’ कैल अन्तर्धान ॥140॥
cc-madhya-1.140.translation: A dog accompanied Śivānanda Sena and the devotees, and that dog was so fortunate that after seeing the lotus feet of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, it was liberated and went back home, back to Godhead.

devanagari: पथे सार्वभौम सह सबार मिलन ।
सार्वभौम भट्टाचा र्येर काशीते गमन ॥141॥
cc-madhya-1.141.translation: Everyone met Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya on his way to Vārāṇasī.

devanagari: प्रभुरे मिलिला सर्व वैष्णव आसिया ।
जल - क्रीड़ा कैल प्रभु सबारे लइया ॥142॥
cc-madhya-1.142.translation: After arriving at Jagannātha Purī, all the Vaiṣṇavas met with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Later, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sported in the water, taking all the devotees with Him.

devanagari: सबा लञा कैल गुण्डिचा - गृह - सम्मार्जन ।
रथ - यात्रा - दरशने प्रभुर नर्तन ॥143॥
cc-madhya-1.143.translation: First the Lord washed the temple of Guṇḍicā very thoroughly. Then everyone saw the Ratha-yātrā festival and the Lord's dancing before the car.

devanagari: उपवने कैल प्रभु विविध विलास ।
प्रभुर अभिषेक कैल विप्र कृष्णदास ॥144॥
cc-madhya-1.144.translation: In the forest along the road from the Jagannātha temple to Guṇḍicā, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed various pastimes. A brāhmaṇa named Kṛṣṇadāsa performed the bathing ceremony of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: गुण्डिचाते नृत्य - अन्ते कैल जल - केलि ।
हेरा - पञ्चमीते देखिल लक्ष्मी - देवीर केली ॥145॥
cc-madhya-1.145.translation: After dancing in the Guṇḍicā temple, the Lord sported in the water with His devotees, and on Herā-pañcamī day they all saw the activities of the goddess of fortune, Lakṣmīdevī.

devanagari: कृष्ण - जन्म - यात्राते प्रभु गोप - वेश हैला ।
दधि - भार व हि’ तबे लगुड़ फिराइला ॥146॥
cc-madhya-1.146.translation: On Janmāṣṭamī, Lord Kṛṣṇa's birthday, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dressed Himself as a cowherd boy and, carrying a balance with pots of yogurt, encircled a log.

lines: saṅgera bhakta lañā kare kīrtana sadāya
devanagari: गौड़ेर भक्त - गणे तबे करिल विदाय ।
सङ्गेर भक्त लञा करे कीर्तन सदाय ॥147॥
cc-madhya-1.147.translation: After this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bade farewell to all the devotees from Gauḍa-deśa [Bengal] and continued chanting with His intimate devotees who constantly remained with Him.

devanagari: वृन्दावन याइते कैल गौड़ेरे गमन ।
प्रतापरुद्र कैल पथे विविध सेवन ॥148॥
cc-madhya-1.148.translation: To visit Vṛndāvana, the Lord went to Gauḍa-deśa [Bengal]. On the way, King Pratāparudra performed a variety of service to please the Lord.

devanagari: पुरी - गोसाञि - सङ्गे वस्त्र - प्रदान - प्रसङ्ग ।
रामानन्द राय आइला भद्रक पर्यन्त ॥149॥
cc-madhya-1.149.translation: On the way to Vṛndāvana via Bengal, there was an incident wherein some cloth was exchanged with Purī Gosāñi. Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya accompanied the Lord as far as the city of Bhadraka.

devanagari: चब्बि श वत्सर प्रभुर गृहे अवस्थान ।
ताहाँ ये करिला लीला - ‘आदिलीला’ नाम ॥15॥
cc-madhya-1.15.translation: For twenty-four years, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained at home, and whatever pastimes He performed during that time are called the ādi-līlā.

devanagari: आसि’ विद्या - वाचस्पतिर गृहेते रहिला ।
प्रभुरे देखिते लोक - सङ्घट्ट हइला ॥150॥
cc-madhya-1.150.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu reached Vidyānagara, Bengal, on the way to Vṛndāvana, He stopped at the house of Vidyā-vācaspati, who was the brother of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya. When Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu suddenly arrived at his house, great crowds of people gathered.

devanagari: पञ्च - दिन देखे लोक नाहिक विश्राम ।
लोक - भये रात्रे प्रभु आइला कुलिया - ग्राम ॥151॥
cc-madhya-1.151.translation: For five consecutive days all the people gathered to see the Lord, and still there was no rest. Out of fear of the crowd, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu left at night and went to the town of Kuliyā [present-day Navadvīpa].

lines: koṭi koṭi loka āsi' kaila daraśana
devanagari: कुलिया - ग्रामेते प्रभुर शुनिया आगमन ।
कोटि कोटि लोक आ सि’ कैल दरशन ॥152॥
cc-madhya-1.152.translation: Hearing of the Lord's arrival in Kuliyā-grāma, many hundreds and thousands of people came to see Him.

devanagari: कुलिया - ग्रामे कैल देवानन्देरे प्रसाद ।
गोपाल - विप्रेरे क्षमाइल श्रीवासापराध ॥153॥
cc-madhya-1.153.translation: The specific acts performed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at this time were His showing favor upon Devānanda Paṇḍita and excusing the brāhmaṇa known as Gopāla Cāpala from the offense he had committed at the lotus feet of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: पाषण्डी निन्दक आ सि’ पड़िला चरणे ।
अपराध क्षमि’ तारे दिल कृष्ण - प्रेमे ॥154॥
cc-madhya-1.154.translation: Many atheists and blasphemers came and fell at the lotus feet of the Lord, and the Lord in return excused them and gave them love of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: वृन्दावन याबेन प्रभु शुनि’ नृसिंहानन्द ।
पथ साजाइल मने पाइया आनन्द ॥155॥
cc-madhya-1.155.translation: When Śrī Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī heard that Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go to Vṛndāvana, he became very pleased and mentally began decorating the way there.

lines: kuliyā nagara haite patha ratne bāndhāila
devanagari: कुलिया नगर हैते पथ रत्ने बान्धाइल ।
निवृन्त पुष्प - शय्या उपरे पातिल ॥156॥
cc-madhya-1.156.translation: First Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī contemplated a broad road starting from the city of Kuliyā. He bedecked the road with jewels, upon which he then laid a bed of stemless flowers.

devanagari: पथे दुइ दिके पुष्प - बकुलेर श्रेणी ।
मध्ये मध्ये दुइ - पाशे दिव्य पुष्करिणी ॥157॥
cc-madhya-1.157.translation: He mentally decorated both sides of the road with bakula flower trees, and at intervals on both sides he placed lakes of a transcendental nature.

devanagari: रत्न - बाँधा घाट, ताहे प्रफुल्ल कमल ।
नाना पक्षि - कोलाहल, सुधा - सम जल ॥158॥
cc-madhya-1.158.translation: These lakes had bathing places constructed with jewels, and they were filled with blossoming lotus flowers. There were various birds chirping, and the water was exactly like nectar.

lines: śītala samīra vahe nānā gandha lañā
devanagari: शीतल समीर वहे नाना गन्ध लञा ।
‘कानाइर नाटशाला’ पर्यन्त लइल बान्धिञा ॥159॥
cc-madhya-1.159.translation: The entire road was surcharged with many cool breezes, which carried the fragrances from various flowers. He carried the construction of this road as far as Kānāi Nāṭaśālā.

devanagari: चब्बिश वत्सर शेषे येइ माघ - मास ।
तार शुक्ल - पक्षे प्रभु करिला सन्न्यास ॥16॥
cc-madhya-1.16.translation: At the end of His twenty-fourth year, in the month of Māgha, during the fortnight of the waxing moon, the Lord accepted the renounced order of life, sannyāsa.

lines: āge mana nāhi cale, nā pāre bāndhite
patha-bāndhā nā yāya, nṛsiṁha hailā vismite
devanagari: आगे मन नाहि चले, ना पारे बान्धिते ।
पथ - बान्धा ना याय, नृसिंह हैला विस्मिते ॥160॥
cc-madhya-1.160.translation: Within the mind of Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī, the road could not be constructed beyond Kānāi Nāṭaśālā. He could not understand why the road's construction could not be completed, and thus he was astonished.

devanagari: निश्चय करिया कहि, शुन, भक्त - गण ।
एबार ना याबेन प्रभु श्री - वृन्दावन ॥161॥
cc-madhya-1.161.translation: With great assurance he then told the devotees that Lord Caitanya would not go to Vṛndāvana at that time.

devanagari: ‘काना ञिर नाटशाला’ हैते आसिब फिरि ञा ।
जानिबे पश्चात्, कहिलु निश्चय करि ञा ॥162॥
cc-madhya-1.162.translation: Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī said, "The Lord will go to Kānāi Nāṭaśālā and then will return. All of you will come to know of this later, but I now say this with great assurance."

devanagari: गोसाञि कुलिया हैते चलिला वृन्दावन ।
सङ्गे सहस्त्रेक लोक यत भक्त - गण ॥163॥
cc-madhya-1.163.translation: When Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to proceed from Kuliyā toward Vṛndāvana, thousands of men were with Him, and all of them were devotees.

lines: yāhāṅ yāya prabhu, tāhāṅ koṭi-saṅkhya loka
devanagari: याहाँ याय प्रभु, ताहाँ कोटि - संख्य लोक ।
देखिते आइसे, देखि’ खण्डे दुःख - शोक ॥164॥
cc-madhya-1.164.translation: Wherever the Lord visited, crowds of innumerable people came to see Him. When they saw Him, all their unhappiness and lamentation disappeared.

lines: yāhāṅ yāhāṅ prabhura caraṇa paḍaye calite
se mṛttikā laya loka, garta haya pathe
devanagari: याहाँ याहाँ प्रभुर चरण पड़ये चलिते ।
से मृत्तिका लय लोक, गर्त हय पथे ॥165॥
cc-madhya-1.165.translation: Wherever the Lord touched the ground with His lotus feet, people immediately came and gathered the dirt. Indeed, they gathered so much that many holes were created in the road.

devanagari: ऐछे चलि, आइला प्रभु ‘रामकेलि’ ग्राम ।
गौड़ेर निकट ग्राम अति अनुपाम ॥166॥
cc-madhya-1.166.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu eventually arrived at a village named Rāmakeli. This village is situated on the border of Bengal and is very exquisite.

lines: tāhāṅ nṛtya kare prabhu preme acetana
koṭi koṭi loka āise dekhite caraṇa
devanagari: ताहाँ नृत्य करे प्रभु प्रेमे अचेतन ।
कोटि कोटि लोक आइसे देखते चरण ॥167॥
cc-madhya-1.167.translation: While performing saṅkīrtana in Rāmakeli-grāma, the Lord danced and sometimes lost consciousness due to love of God. While at Rāmakeli-grāma, an unlimited number of people came to see His lotus feet.

devanagari: गौड़ेश्वर यवन - राजा प्रभाव शुनिञा ।
कहिते लागिल किछु विस्मित हञा ॥168॥
cc-madhya-1.168.translation: When the Mohammedan King of Bengal heard of Caitanya Mahāprabhu's influence in attracting innumerable people, he became very astonished and began to speak as follows.

lines: vinā dāne eta loka yāṅra pāche haya
sei ta' gosāñā, ihā jāniha niścaya
devanagari: विना दाने एत लोक याँर पाछे हय ।
सेइ त’ गोसाञा, इहा जानिह निश्चय ॥169॥
cc-madhya-1.169.translation: "Such a person, who is followed by so many people without giving them charity, must be a prophet. I can surely understand this fact."

devanagari: सन्न्यास करिया चब्बिश वत्सर अवस्थान ।
ताहाँ येइ लीला, तार ‘शेष - लीला’ नाम ॥17॥
cc-madhya-1.17.translation: After accepting sannyāsa, Lord Caitanya remained within this material world for another twenty-four years. Within this period, whatever pastimes He enacted are called the śeṣa-līlā, or pastimes occurring at the end.

lines: kājī, yavana ihāra nā kariha hiṁsana
devanagari: काजी, यवन इहार ना करिह हिंसन ।
आपन - इच्छाय बुलुन, याहाँ उँहार मन ॥170॥
cc-madhya-1.170.translation: The Mohammedan King ordered the magistrate, "Do not disturb this Hindu prophet out of jealousy. Let Him do His own will wherever He likes."

devanagari: केशव - छत्रीरे राजा वार्ता पुछिल ।
प्रभुर महिमा छत्री उड़ाइया दिल ॥171॥
cc-madhya-1.171.translation: When the Mohammedan King asked his assistant, Keśava Chatrī, for news of the influence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Keśava Chatrī, although knowing everything about Caitanya Mahāprabhu, tried to avoid the conversation by not giving any importance to Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities.

lines: tāṅre dekhibāre āise dui cāri jana
devanagari: भिखारी सन्न्यासी करे तीर्थ पर्यटन ।
ताँरे देखिबारे आइसे दुइ चारि जन ॥172॥
cc-madhya-1.172.translation: Keśava Chatrī informed the Mohammedan King that Caitanya Mahāprabhu was a mendicant touring different places of pilgrimage and that, as such, only a few people came to see Him.

lines: tāṅra hiṁsāya lābha nāhi, haya āra hāni
devanagari: यवने तोमार ठाञि करये लागानि ।
ताँर हिंसाय लाभ नाहि, हय आर हानि ॥173॥
cc-madhya-1.173.translation: Keśava Chatrī said, "Out of jealousy your Mohammedan servant plots against Him. I think that you should not be very interested in Him, for there is no profit in it. Rather, there is simply loss."

devanagari: राजारे प्रबो धि’ केशव ब्राह्मण पाठाञा ।
चलिबार तरे प्रभुरे पाठाइल कहिञा ॥174॥
cc-madhya-1.174.translation: After pacifying the King in this way, Keśava Chatrī sent a brāhmaṇa messenger to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, requesting Him to leave without delay.

devanagari: दबिर खासेरे राजा पुछिल निभृते ।
गोसाञि र महिमा तेंहो लागिल कहते ॥175॥
cc-madhya-1.175.translation: In private, the King inquired from Dabira Khāsa [Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī], who began to speak about the glories of the Lord.

lines: ye tomāre rājya dila, ye tomāra gosāñā
tomāra deśe tomāra bhāgye janmilā āsiñā
devanagari: ये तोमारे राज्य दिल, ये तोमार गोसाञा ।
तोमार देशे तोमार भाग्ये जन्मिला आसिञा ॥176॥
cc-madhya-1.176.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī said, "The Supreme Personality of Godhead, who gave you this kingdom and whom you accept as a prophet, has taken birth in your country due to your good fortune.

devanagari: तोमार मङ्गल वाञ्छे, कार्य - सिद्धि हय ।
इहार आशीर्वादे तोमार सर्वत्र - इ जय ॥177॥
cc-madhya-1.177.translation: "This prophet always desires your good fortune. By His grace, all your business is successful. By His blessings, you will attain victory everywhere.

lines: more kena pucha, tumi pucha āpana-mana
devanagari: मोरे केन पुछ, तुमि पुछ आपन - मन ।
तुमि नराधिप हओ विष्णु - अंश सम ॥178॥
cc-madhya-1.178.translation: "Why are you questioning me? Better that you question your own mind. Because you are the King of the people, you are the representative of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Therefore you can understand this better than I."

lines: tomāra citte caitanyere kaiche haya jñāna
tomāra citte yei laya, sei ta' pramāṇa
devanagari: तोमार चित्ते चैतन्येरे कैछे हय ज्ञान ।
तोमार चित्ते येइ लय, सेइ त’ प्रमाण ॥179॥
cc-madhya-1.179.translation: Thus Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī informed the King about his mind as a way of knowing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He assured the King that whatever occurred in his mind could be considered evidence.

devanagari: शेष - लीलार ‘मध्य’ ‘अन्त्य’, - दुइ नाम हय ।
लीला - भेदे वैष्णव सब नाम - भेद कय ॥18॥
cc-madhya-1.18.translation: The final pastimes of the Lord, occurring in His last twenty-four years, are called madhya [middle] and antya [final]. All the devotees of the Lord refer to His pastimes according to these divisions.

lines: rājā kahe, śuna, mora mane yei laya
devanagari: राजा कहे, शुन, मोर मने येइ लय ।
साक्षातीश्वर इहँ नाहिक संशय ॥180॥
cc-madhya-1.180.translation: The King replied, "I consider Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to be the Supreme Personality of Godhead. There is no doubt about it."

lines: eta kahi' rājā gelā nija abhyantare
tabe dabira khāsa āilā āpanāra ghare
devanagari: एत क हि’ राजा गेला निज अभ्यन्तरे ।
तबे दबिर खास आइला आपनार घरे ॥181॥
cc-madhya-1.181.translation: After having this conversation with Rūpa Gosvāmī, the King entered his private house. Rūpa Gosvāmī, then known as Dabira Khāsa, also returned to his residence.

lines: ghare āsi' dui bhāi yukati kariñā
devanagari: घरे आ सि’ दुइ भाइ युकति करिञा ।
प्रभु देखिबारे चले वेश लुकाञा ॥182॥
cc-madhya-1.182.translation: After returning to his residence, Dabira Khāsa and his brother decided after much consideration to go see the Lord incognito.

devanagari: अर्ध - रात्रे दुइ भाइ आइला प्रभु - स्थाने ।
प्रथमे मिलिला नित्यानन्द - हरिदास सने ॥183॥
cc-madhya-1.183.translation: Thus in the dead of night the two brothers, Dabira Khāsa and Sākara Mallika, went to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu incognito. First they met Nityānanda Prabhu and Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: ताँरा दुइ - जन जानाइला प्रभुर गोचरे ।
रूप, साकर - मल्लिक आइला तोमा’ देखिबारे ॥184॥
cc-madhya-1.184.translation: Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu and Haridāsa Ṭhākura told Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu that two personalities-Śrī Rūpa and Sanātana-had come to see Him.

lines: dui guccha tṛṇa duṅhe daśane dhariñā
gale vastra bāndhi' paḍe daṇḍavat hañā
devanagari: दुइ गुच्छ तृण दुँहे दशने धरिञा ।
गले वस्त्र बा न्धि’ पड़े दण्डवत् हञा ॥185॥
cc-madhya-1.185.translation: In great humility, both brothers took bunches of straw between their teeth and, each binding a cloth around his neck, fell down like rods before the Lord.

devanagari: दैन्य रोदन करे, आनन्दे विह्वल ।
प्रभु कहे, - उठ, उठ, हइल मङ्गल ॥186॥
cc-madhya-1.186.translation: Upon seeing Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the two brothers were overwhelmed with joy, and out of humility they began to cry. Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked them to get up and assured them of all good fortune.

lines: uṭhi' dui bhāi tabe dante tṛṇa dhari'
dainya kari' stuti kare karayoḍa kari
devanagari: उठि’ दुइ भाइ तबे दन्ते तृण धरि’ ।
दैन्य क रि’ स्तुति करे करयोड़ करि ॥187॥
cc-madhya-1.187.translation: The two brothers got up, and again taking straw between their teeth, they humbly offered their prayers with folded hands.

devanagari: जय जय श्री कृष्ण - चैतन्य दयामय ।
पतित - पावन जय, जय महाशय ॥188॥
cc-madhya-1.188.translation: "All glories to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the most merciful savior of the fallen souls! All glories to the Supreme Personality!

lines: tomāra agrete prabhu kahite vāsi lāja
devanagari: नीच - जाति, नीच - सङ्गी, करि नीच काज ।
तोमार अग्रेते प्रभु कहिते वासि लाज ॥189॥
cc-madhya-1.189.translation: "Sir, we belong to the lowest class of men, and our associates and employment are also of the lowest type. Therefore we cannot introduce ourselves to You. We feel very much ashamed, standing here before You.

devanagari: तार मध्ये छय वत्सर - गमनागमन ।
नीलाचल - गौड़ - सेतुबन्ध - वृन्दावन ॥19॥
cc-madhya-1.19.translation: For six years of the last twenty-four, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu traveled all over India from Jagannātha Purī to Bengal and from Cape Comorin to Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: मत्तुल्यो नास्ति पापात्मा नापराधी च कश्चन ।
परिहा रेऽपि लज्जा मे किं ब्रुवे पुरुषोत्तम ॥190॥
cc-madhya-1.190.translation: "Dear Lord, let us inform you that no one is more sinful than us, nor is there any offender like us. Even if we wanted to mention our sinful activities, we would immediately become ashamed. And what to speak of giving them up!"

devanagari: पतित - पावन हेतु तोमार अवतार ।
आमा - बइ जगते, पतित नाहि आर ॥191॥
cc-madhya-1.191.translation: Both brothers submitted, "Dear Lord, You have incarnated to deliver the fallen souls. You should consider that in this world there is none so fallen as us.

devanagari: जगाइ - माधाइ दुइ करिले उद्धार ।
ताहाँ उद्घारिते श्रम नहिल तोमार ॥192॥
cc-madhya-1.192.translation: "You have delivered the two brothers Jagāi and Mādhāi, but to deliver them You did not have to exert Yourself very much.

lines: nīca-sevā nāhi kare, nahe nīcera kūrpara
devanagari: ब्राह्मण - जाति तारा, नवद्वीपे घर ।
नीच - सेवा नाहि करे, नहे नीचेर कूर्पर ॥193॥
cc-madhya-1.193.translation: "The brothers Jagāi and Mādhāi belonged to the brāhmaṇa caste, and their residence was in the holy place of Navadvīpa. They never served low-class persons, nor were they instruments to abominable activities.

lines: sabe eka doṣa tāra, haya pāpācāra
devanagari: सबे एक दोष तार, हय पापाचार ।
पाप - राशि दहे नामाभासेइ तोमार ॥194॥
cc-madhya-1.194.translation: "Jagāi and Mādhāi had but one fault—they were addicted to sinful activity. However, volumes of sinful activity can be burned to ashes simply by a dim reflection of the chanting of Your holy name.

lines: tomāra nāma lañā tomāra karila nindana
sei nāma ha-ila tāra muktira kāraṇa
devanagari: तोमार नाम लञा तोमार करिल निन्दन ।
सेइ नाम हइल तार मुक्तिर कारण ॥195॥
cc-madhya-1.195.translation: "Jagāi and Mādhāi uttered Your holy name by way of blaspheming You. Fortunately, that holy name became the cause of their deliverance.

lines: adhama patita pāpī āmi dui jana
devanagari: जगाइ - माधाइ हैते कोटी कोटी गुण ।
अधम पतित पापी आमि दुइ जन ॥196॥
cc-madhya-1.196.translation: "We two are millions and millions of times inferior to Jagāi and Mādhāi. We are more degraded, fallen and sinful than they.

devanagari: म्लेच्छ - जाति, म्लेच्छ - सेवी, करि म्लेच्छ - कर्म ।
गो - ब्राह्मण - द्रोहि - सङ्गे आमार सङ्गम ॥197॥
cc-madhya-1.197.translation: "Actually we belong to the caste of meat-eaters because we are servants of meat-eaters. Indeed, our activities are exactly like those of the meat-eaters. Because we always associate with such people, we are inimical toward the cows and brāhmaṇas."

devanagari: मोर कर्म, मोर हाते - गलाय बान्धिया ।
कु - विषय - विष्ठा - गर्ते दियाछे फेलाइया ॥198॥
cc-madhya-1.198.translation: The two brothers, Sākara Mallika and Dabira Khāsa, very humbly submitted that due to their abominable activities they were now bound by the neck and hands and had been thrown into a ditch filled with abominable stoollike objects of material sense enjoyment.

devanagari: आमा उद्धारिते बली नाहि त्रि - भुवने ।
पतित - पावन तुमि - सबे तोमा विने ॥199॥
cc-madhya-1.199.translation: "No one within the three worlds is sufficiently powerful to deliver us. You are the only savior of the fallen souls; therefore there is no one but You.

devanagari: वन्दे श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य - नित्यानन्दौ सहोदितौ ।
गौड़ोदये पुष्पवन्तौ चित्रौ शन्दौ तमो - नुदौ ॥2॥
cc-madhya-1.2.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances unto Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya and Lord Nityānanda, who are like the sun and moon. They have arisen simultaneously on the horizon of Gauḍa to dissipate the darkness of ignorance and thus wonderfully bestow benediction upon all.

devanagari: ताहाँ येइ लीला, तार ‘मध्य - लीला’ नाम ।
तार पाछे लीला - ‘अन्त्य - लीला’ अभिधान ॥20॥
cc-madhya-1.20.translation: All the pastimes performed by the Lord in those places are known as the madhya-līlā, and whatever pastimes were performed after that are called the antya-līlā.

devanagari: आमा उद्वारिया यदि देखाओ निज - बल ।
‘पतित - पावन’ नाम तबे से सफल ॥200॥
cc-madhya-1.200.translation: "If You simply deliver us by Your transcendental strength, then certainly Your name will be known as Patita-pāvana, the savior of the fallen souls.

lines: satya eka bāta kahoṅ, śuna, dayā-maya
mo-vinu dayāra pātra jagate nā haya
devanagari: सत्य एक बात कहों, शुन, दयामय ।
मो - विनु दयार पात्र जगते ना हय ॥201॥
cc-madhya-1.201.translation: "Let us speak one word that is very true. Plainly hear us, O merciful one. There is no other object of mercy within the three worlds but us.

lines: more dayā kari' kara sva-dayā saphala
devanagari: मोरे दया क रि’ कर स्व - दया सफल ।
अखिल ब्रह्माण्ड दे खुक तोमार दया - बल ॥202॥
cc-madhya-1.202.translation: "We are the most fallen; therefore by showing us Your mercy, Your mercy is most successful. Let the power of Your mercy be exhibited throughout the entire universe!

devanagari: न मृषा परमार्थमेव मे शृणु विज्ञापनमेकमग्रतः ।
यदि मे न दयिष्यसे तदा दयनीयस्तव नाथ दुर्लभः ॥203॥
cc-madhya-1.203.translation: “ 'Let us submit one piece of information before You, dear Lord. It is not at all false but is full of meaning. It is this: If You are not merciful upon us, then it will be very, very difficult to find more suitable candidates for Your mercy.'

lines: āpane ayogya dekhi' mane pāṅ kṣobha
devanagari: आपने अयोग्य देखि’ मने पाँ क्षोभ ।
तथापि तोमार गुणे उपजय लोभ ॥204॥
cc-madhya-1.204.translation: "We are very depressed at being unfit candidates for Your mercy. Yet since we have heard of Your transcendental qualities, we are very much attracted to You.

lines: vāmana yaiche cāṅda dharite cāhe kare
taiche ei vāñchā mora uṭhaye antare
devanagari: वामन यैछे चाँद धरिते चाहे करे ।
तैछे एइ वाञ्छा मोर उठये अन्तरे ॥205॥
cc-madhya-1.205.translation: "Indeed, we are like a dwarf who wants to capture the moon. Although we are completely unfit, a desire to receive Your mercy is awakening within our minds.

devanagari: भवन्तमेवानुचरन्निरन्तरः प्रशान्त - नि:शेष - मनो - रथान्तरः ।
कदाहमैकान्तिक - नित्य - किङ्करः प्रहर्षयिष्यामि सनाथ - जीवितम् ॥206॥
cc-madhya-1.206.translation: “ 'By serving You constantly, one is freed from all material desires and is completely pacified. When shall I engage as Your permanent eternal servant and always feel joyful to have such a fitting master?' "

devanagari: शुनि’ महाप्रभु कहे, - शुन, दबिर - खास ।
तुमि दुइ भाइ - मोर पुरातन दास ॥207॥
cc-madhya-1.207.translation: After hearing the prayer of Dabira Khāsa and Sākara Mallika, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "My dear Dabira Khāsa, you two brothers are My old servants.

lines: dainya chāḍa, tomāra dainye phāṭe mora mana
devanagari: आजि हैते दुँहार नाम ‘रूप’ ‘सनातन’ ।
दैन्य छाड़, तोमार दैन्ये फाटे मोर मन ॥208॥
cc-madhya-1.208.translation: "My dear Sākara Mallika, from this day your names will be changed to Śrīla Rūpa and Śrīla Sanātana. Now please abandon your humility, for My heart is breaking to see you so humble.

lines: dainya-patrī likhi' more pāṭhāle bāra bāra
devanagari: दैन्य - पत्री लि खि’ मोरे पाठाले बार बार ।
सेइ पत्री - द्वारा जानि तोमार व्यवहार ॥209॥
cc-madhya-1.209.translation: "You have written several letters showing your humility. I can understand your behavior from those letters.

devanagari: ‘आदि - लीला’, ‘मध्य - लीला’, ‘अन्त्य - लीला’ आर ।
एबे ‘मध्य - लीला र’ किछु करिये विस्तार ॥21॥
cc-madhya-1.21.translation: The pastimes of the Lord are therefore divided into three periods—the ādi-līlā, madhya-līlā and antya-līlā. Now I shall very elaborately describe the madhya-līlā.

devanagari: तोमार हृदय आमि जानि पत्री - द्वारे ।
तोमा शिखाइते श्लोक पाठाइल तोमारे ॥210॥
cc-madhya-1.210.translation: "By your letters, I could understand your heart. Therefore, in order to teach you, I sent you one verse, which reads as follows.

devanagari: पर - व्यसनिनी नारी व्यग्रापि गृह - कर्मसु ।
तदेवास्वादयत्यन्तर्नव - सङ्ग - रसायनम् ॥211॥
cc-madhya-1.211.translation: “ 'If a woman is attached to a man other than her husband, she will appear very busy in carrying out her household affairs, but within her heart she is always relishing feelings of association with her paramour.'

devanagari: गौड़ - निकट आसिते नाहि मोर प्रयोजन ।
तोमा - दुँहा देखिते मोर इहाँ आगमन ॥212॥
cc-madhya-1.212.translation: "I really had no business in coming to Bengal, but I have come just to see you two brothers.

lines: ei mora manera kathā keha nāhi jāne
devanagari: एइ मोर मनेर कथा केह नाहि जाने ।
सबे बले, केने आइला रामकेलि - ग्रामे ॥213॥
cc-madhya-1.213.translation: "Everyone is asking why I have come to this village of Rāmakeli. No one knows My intentions.

lines: bhāla haila, dui bhāi āilā mora sthāne
ghare yāha, bhaya kichu nā kariha mane
devanagari: भाल हैल, दुइ भाइ आइला मोर स्थाने ।
घरे याह, भय किछु ना करिह मने ॥214॥
cc-madhya-1.214.translation: "It is very good that you two brothers have come to see Me. Now you can go home. Do not fear anything.

devanagari: जन्मे जन्मे तुमि दुइ - किङ्कर आमार ।
अचिराते कृष्ण तोमाय करिबे उद्धार ॥215॥
cc-madhya-1.215.translation: "Birth after birth you have been My eternal servants. I am sure that Kṛṣṇa will deliver you very soon."

lines: eta bali duṅhāra śire dharila dui hāte
dui bhāi prabhu-pada nila nija māthe
devanagari: एत बलि दुँहार शिरे धरिल दुइ हाते ।
दुइ भाइ प्रभु - पद निल निज माथे ॥216॥
cc-madhya-1.216.translation: The Lord then placed His two hands on the heads of both of them, and in return they immediately placed the lotus feet of the Lord on their heads.

lines: sabe kṛpā kari' uddhāraha dui jane
devanagari: दोंहा आलिङ्गिया प्रभु बलिल भक्त - गणे ।
सबे कृपा करि’ उद्धारह दुइ जने ॥217॥
cc-madhya-1.217.translation: After this, the Lord embraced both of them and requested all of the devotees present to be merciful upon them and deliver them.

lines: dui jane prabhura kṛpā dekhi' bhakta-gaṇe
devanagari: दुइ जने प्रभुर कृपा देखि’ भक्त - गणे ।
‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ बले सबै आनन्दित - मने ॥218॥
cc-madhya-1.218.translation: When all of the devotees saw the mercy of the Lord upon the two brothers, they were very gladdened, and they began to chant the holy name of the Lord, "Hari! Hari!"

devanagari: नित्यानन्द, हरिदास, श्रीवास, गदाधर ।
मुकुन्द, जगदानन्द, मुरारि, वक्रेश्वर ॥219॥
cc-madhya-1.219.translation: All the Vaiṣṇava associates of the Lord were present, including Nityānanda, Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Mukunda, Jagadānanda, Murāri and Vakreśvara.

devanagari: अष्टादश - वर्ष केवल नीलाचले स्थिति ।
आपनि आच रि’ जीवे शिखाइला भक्ति ॥22॥
cc-madhya-1.22.translation: For eighteen continuous years, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained at Jagannātha Purī and, through His personal behavior, instructed all living entities in the mode of devotional service.

lines: sabāra caraṇe dhari, paḍe dui bhāi
devanagari: सबार चरणे धरि, पड़े दुइ भाइ ।
सबे बले, - धन्य तुमि, पाइले गोसाञि ॥220॥
cc-madhya-1.220.translation: In accordance with the instructions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the two brothers, Rūpa and Sanātana, immediately touched the lotus feet of these Vaiṣṇavas, who all became very happy and congratulated the two brothers for having received the mercy of the Lord.

devanagari: इहाँ हैते काज - और करता है ; गौड़ उन्होंने आपका अ काम नहीं तथापि सबा - पाश आज्ञा मा गि’ चलन - समय ।
प्रभु - पदे कहे किछु करिया विनय ॥221॥
cc-madhya-1.221.translation: After begging the permission of all the Vaiṣṇavas present, the two brothers, at the time of their departure, humbly submitted something at the lotus feet of the Lord.

lines: ihāṅ haite cala, prabhu, ihāṅ nāhi kāya
devanagari: इहाँ हैते चल, प्रभु, इहाँ नाहि काज ।
यद्यपि तोमारे भक्ति करे गौड़ - राज ॥222॥
cc-madhya-1.222.translation: They said, "Dear Lord, although the King of Bengal, Nawab Husena Sāhā, is very respectful toward You, You have no other business here. Kindly depart from this place.

lines: tathāpi yavana jāti, nā kari pratīti
tīrtha-yātrāya eta saṅghaṭṭa bhāla nahe rīti
devanagari: तथापि यवन जाति, ना करि प्रतीति ।
तीर्थ - यात्राय एत संघट्ट भाल नहे रीति ॥223॥
cc-madhya-1.223.translation: "Although the King is respectful toward You, he still belongs to the yavana class and should not be believed. We think that there is no need for such a great crowd to accompany You on Your pilgrimage to Vṛndāvana.

lines: yāra saṅge cale ei loka lakṣa-koṭi
devanagari: यार सङ्गे चले एइ लोक लक्ष - कोटि ।
वृन्दावन - यात्रार ए नहे परिपाटी ॥224॥
cc-madhya-1.224.translation: "Dear Lord, You are going to Vṛndāvana with hundreds and thousands of people following You, and this is not a fitting way to go on a pilgrimage."

lines: yadyapi vastutaḥ prabhura kichu nāhi bhaya
devanagari: यद्यपि वस्तुतः प्रभुर किछु नाहि भय ।
तथापि लौकिक - लीला, लोक - चेष्टा - मय ॥225॥
cc-madhya-1.225.translation: Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself, the Supreme Lord, and was therefore not at all fearful, He still acted like a human being to teach neophytes how to act.

lines: eta bali' caraṇa vandi' gelā dui-jana
prabhura sei grāma haite calite haila mana
devanagari: एत ब लि’ चरण व न्दि’ गेला दुइ - जन ।
प्रभुर सेइ ग्राम हैते चलिते हैल मन ॥226॥
cc-madhya-1.226.translation: Having spoken thus, the two brothers offered prayers to the lotus feet of the Lord and returned to their homes. Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu then desired to leave that village.

devanagari: प्राते च लि’ आइला प्रभु ‘कानाइर नाटशाला’ ।
देखिल सकल ताहाँ कृष्ण - चरित्र - लीला ॥227॥
cc-madhya-1.227.translation: In the morning, the Lord left and went to a place known as Kānāi Nāṭaśālā. While there, He saw many pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

lines: sei rātre prabhu tāhāṅ cinte mane mana
saṅge saṅghaṭṭa bhāla nahe, kaila sanātana
devanagari: सेड़ रात्रे प्रभु ताहाँ चिन्ते मने मन ।
सङ्गे संघट्ट भाल नहे, कैल सनातन ॥228॥
cc-madhya-1.228.translation: That night the Lord considered Sanātana Gosvāmī's proposal that He should not go to Vṛndāvana followed by so many people.

lines: mathurā yāiba āmi eta loka saṅge
kichu sukha nā pāiba, habe rasa-bhaṅge
devanagari: मथुरा याइब आमि एत लोक सङ्गे ।
किछु सुख ना पाइब, हबे रस - भङ्गे ॥229॥
cc-madhya-1.229.translation: The Lord thought, "If I go to Mathurā with such crowds behind Me, it would not be a very happy situation, for the atmosphere would be disturbed."

devanagari: तार मध्ये छय वत्सर भक्त - गण - सङ्गे ।
प्रेम - भक्ति प्रवर्ताइला नृत्य - गीत - रङ्गे ॥23॥
cc-madhya-1.23.translation: Of these eighteen years at Jagannātha Purī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spent six years with His many devotees. By chanting and dancing, He introduced the loving service of the Lord.

lines: ekākī yāiba, kimvā saṅge eka jana
devanagari: एकाकी याइब, किम्वा सङ्गे एक जन ।
तबे से शोभये वृन्दावनेरे गमन ॥230॥
cc-madhya-1.230.translation: The Lord concluded that He would go alone to Vṛndāvana or, at most, would take only one person as His companion. In that way, going to Vṛndāvana would be very pleasant.

devanagari: एत चिन्ति प्रातः काले गङ्गा - स्नान क रि’ ।
‘नीलाचले या ब’ बलि’ चलिला गौरहरि ॥231॥
cc-madhya-1.231.translation: Thinking like this, the Lord took His morning bath in the Ganges and started for Nīlācala, saying "I shall go there."

lines: ei mata cali' cali' āilā śāntipure
devanagari: एइ मत च लि’ चलि’ आइला शान्तिपुरे ।
दिन पाँच - सात रहिला आचा र्येर घरे ॥232॥
cc-madhya-1.232.translation: Walking and walking, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at Śāntipura and remained at the house of Advaita Ācārya for five to seven days.

devanagari: शची - देवी आ नि’ ताँरे कैल नमस्कार ।
सात दिन ताँर ठाञि भिक्षा - व्यवहार ॥233॥
cc-madhya-1.233.translation: Taking this opportunity, Śrī Advaita Ācārya Prabhu sent for mother Śacīdevī, and she remained at His house for seven days to prepare the meals for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: tāṅra ājñā lañā punaḥ karilā gamane
devanagari: ताँर आज्ञा लञा पुनः करिला गमने ।
विनय करिया विदाय दिल भक्त - गणे ॥234॥
cc-madhya-1.234.translation: Taking permission from His mother, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu started for Jagannātha Purī. When the devotees followed Him, He humbly begged them to remain and bade them all farewell.

lines: janā dui saṅge āmi yāba nīlācale
devanagari: जना दुई सङ्गे आमि याब नीलाचले ।
आमारे मिलिबा आ सि’ रथ - यात्रा - काले ॥235॥
cc-madhya-1.235.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, although requesting all the devotees to go back, allowed two people to follow Him. He requested all the devotees to come to Jagannātha Purī and meet Him during the car festival.

devanagari: बलभद्र भट्टाचार्य, आर पण्डित दामोदर ।
दुइ - जन - सङ्गे प्रभु आइला नीलाचल ॥236॥
cc-madhya-1.236.translation: Two persons named Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya and Dāmodara Paṇḍita accompanied Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to Jagannātha Purī [Nīlācala].

lines: dina kata tāhāṅ rahi' calilā vṛndāvana
lukāñā calilā rātre, nā jāne kona jana
devanagari: दिन कत ताहाँ र हि’ चलिला वृन्दावन ।
लुकाञा चलिला रात्रे, ना जाने कोन जन ॥237॥
cc-madhya-1.237.translation: After remaining at Jagannātha Purī for a few days, the Lord secretly started for Vṛndāvana at night. He did this without anyone's knowledge.

devanagari: बलभ द्र भट्टाचार्य रहे मात्र सङ्गे ।
झारिखण्ड - पथे काशी आइला महा - रङ्गे ॥238॥
cc-madhya-1.238.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left Jagannātha Purī for Vṛndāvana, only Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya was with Him. Thus He traveled on the path through Jhārikhaṇḍa and arrived in Benares with great delight.

lines: dina cāra kāśīte rahi' gelā vṛndāvana
devanagari: दिन चार काशीते र हि’ गेला वृन्दावन ।
मथुरा देखियो देखे द्वादश कानन ॥239॥
cc-madhya-1.239.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed at Benares only four days and then left for Vṛndāvana. After seeing the town of Mathurā, He visited the twelve forests.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द - गोसाञिरे पाठाइल गौड़ - देशे ।
तेंहो गौड़ - देश भासाइल प्रेम - रसे ॥24॥
cc-madhya-1.24.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sent Nityānanda Prabhu from Jagannātha Purī to Bengal, which was known as Gauḍa-deśa, and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu overflooded this country with the transcendental loving service of the Lord.

devanagari: लीला - स्थल देखि’ प्रेमे हइला अस्थिर ।
बलभद्र कैल ताँरे मथुरार बाहिर ॥240॥
cc-madhya-1.240.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited all twelve places of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, He became very agitated because of ecstasy. Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya somehow or other got Him out of Mathurā.

devanagari: गङ्गा - तीर - पथे लञा प्रयागे आइला ।
श्री - रूप आ सि’ प्रभुके तथाइ मिलिला ॥241॥
cc-madhya-1.241.translation: After leaving Mathurā, the Lord began to walk along a path on the bank of the Ganges, and finally He reached the holy place named Prayāga [Allahabad]. It was there that Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī came and met the Lord.

devanagari: दण्डवत्क रि’ रूप भूमिते पड़िला ।
परम आनन्दे प्रभु आलिङ्गन दिला ॥242॥
cc-madhya-1.242.translation: At Prayāga, Rūpa Gosvāmī fell down on the ground to offer obeisances to the Lord, and the Lord embraced him with great delight.

devanagari: श्री - रूपे शिक्षा कराइ’ पाठाइला वृन्दावन ।
आपने करिला वाराणसी आगमन ॥243॥
cc-madhya-1.243.translation: After instructing Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī at Prayāga at the Daśāśvamedha-ghāṭa, Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered him to go to Vṛndāvana. The Lord then returned to Vārāṇasī.

lines: dui māsa rahi' tāṅre karāilā śikṣaṇa
devanagari: काशीते प्रभुके आसि’ मिलिला सनातन ।
दुइ मास रहि’ ताँरे कराइला शिक्षण ॥244॥
cc-madhya-1.244.translation: When Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at Vārāṇasī, Sanātana Gosvāmī met Him there. The Lord remained there for two months and instructed Sanātana Gosvāmī perfectly.

devanagari: मथुरा पाठाइला ताँरे दिया भक्ति - बल ।
सन्न्यासी रे कृपा करि’ गेला नीलाचल ॥245॥
cc-madhya-1.245.translation: After fully instructing Sanātana Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sent him to Mathurā with empowered devotional service. In Benares He also bestowed His mercy upon the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs. He then returned to Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī].

lines: chaya vatsara aiche prabhu karilā vilāsa
devanagari: छय वत्स र ऐछे प्रभु करिला विलास ।
कभु इति - उति, कभु क्षेत्र - वास ॥246॥
cc-madhya-1.246.translation: The Lord traveled all over India for six years. He was sometimes here and sometimes there performing His transcendental pastimes, and sometimes He remained at Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: आनन्दे भक्त - सङ्गे सदा कीर्तन - विलास ।
जगन्नाथ - दरशन, प्रेमेर विलास ॥247॥
cc-madhya-1.247.translation: While at Jagannātha Purī, the Lord passed His time in great joy by performing saṅkīrtana and visiting the temple of Jagannātha in great ecstasy.

devanagari: मध्य - लीलार कैलुँ एइ सूत्र - विवरण ।
अन्त्य - लीलार सूत्र एबे शुन, भक्त - गण ॥248॥
cc-madhya-1.248.translation: Thus I have given a synopsis of the madhya-līlā, the middle pastimes of the Lord. Now, O devotees, kindly hear the synopsis of the final pastimes of the Lord, known as antya-līlā.

lines: āṭhāra varṣa tāhāṅ vāsa, kāhāṅ nāhi gelā
devanagari: वृन्दावन हैते यदि नीलाचले आइला ।
आठार वर्ष ताहाँ वास, काहाँ नाहि गेला ॥249॥
cc-madhya-1.249.translation: When the Lord returned to Jagannātha Purī from Vṛndāvana, He remained there and did not go anywhere else for eighteen years.

devanagari: सहजेइ नित्यानन्द - कृष्ण - प्रेमोद्दाम ।
प्रभु - आज्ञाय कैल याहाँ ताहाँ प्रेम - दान ॥25॥
cc-madhya-1.25.translation: Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu is by nature very much inspired in rendering transcendental loving service to Lord Kṛṣṇa. Now, being ordered by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, He distributed this loving service anywhere and everywhere.

lines: cāri māsa rahe prabhura saṅge sammilana
devanagari: प्रतिवर्ष आइसेन ताहाँ गौड़ेर भक्त - गण ।
चारि मास रहे प्रभुर सङ्गे सम्मिलन ॥250॥
cc-madhya-1.250.translation: During those eighteen years, all the devotees of Bengal used to visit Him at Jagannātha Purī every year. They would remain there for four continuous months and enjoy the company of the Lord.

devanagari: निरन्तर नृत्य - गीत कीर्तन - विलास ।
आचण्डाले प्रेम - भक्ति करिला प्रकाश ॥251॥
cc-madhya-1.251.translation: At Jagannātha Purī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed chanting and dancing unceasingly. Thus He enjoyed the pastime of saṅkīrtana. He manifested His causeless mercy, pure love of God, to everyone, including the lowest man.

devanagari: पण्डित - गोसाञि कैल नीलाचले वास ।
वक्रेश्वर, दामोदर, शङ्कर, हरिदास ॥252॥
cc-madhya-1.252.translation: Residing with the Lord at Jagannātha Purī were Paṇḍita Gosāñi and other devotees, such as Vakreśvara, Dāmodara, Śaṅkara and Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: जगदानन्द, भगवान्, गोविन्द, काशीश्वर ।
परमानन्द - पुरी, आर स्वरूप - दामोदर ॥253॥
cc-madhya-1.253.translation: Jagadānanda, Bhagavān, Govinda, Kāśīśvara, Paramānanda Purī and Svarūpa Dāmodara were other devotees who also lived with the Lord.

devanagari: क्षेत्र - वासी रामानन्द राय प्रभृति ।
प्रभु - सङ्गे एइ सब कैल नित्य - स्थिति ॥254॥
cc-madhya-1.254.translation: Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya and other devotees who were residents of Jagannātha Purī also remained permanently with the Lord.

devanagari: अद्वैत, नित्यानन्द, मुकुन्द, श्रीवास ।
विद्यानिधि, वासुदेव, मुरारि, - यत दास ॥255॥
cc-madhya-1.255-256.translation: Other devotees of the Lord-headed by Advaita Ācārya, Nityānanda Prabhu, Mukunda, Śrīvāsa, Vidyānidhi, Vāsudeva and Murāri-used to visit Jagannātha Purī and remain with the Lord for four continuous months. The Lord enjoyed various pastimes in their company.

devanagari: हरिदासेर सिद्धि - प्राप्ति, - अद्भुत से सब ।
आपनि महाप्रभु याँर कैल महोत्सव ॥257॥
cc-madhya-1.257.translation: At Jagannātha Purī, Haridāsa Ṭhākura passed away. The incident was very wonderful because the Lord Himself performed the festival of Ṭhākura Haridāsa's departure.

devanagari: तबे रूप - गोसाञि र पुनरागमन ।
ताँहार हृदये कैल प्रभु शक्ति - सञ्चारण ॥258॥
cc-madhya-1.258.translation: At Jagannātha Purī Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī met the Lord again, and the Lord invested his heart with all transcendental power.

lines: tabe choṭa haridāse prabhu kaila daṇḍa
devanagari: तबे छोट हरिदासे प्रभु कैल दण्ड ।
दामोदर - पण्डित कैल प्रभुके वाक्य - दण्ड ॥259॥
cc-madhya-1.259.translation: After this, the Lord punished Junior Haridāsa, and Dāmodara Paṇḍita gave some warning to the Lord.

devanagari: ताँहार चरणे मोर कोटि नमस्कार ।
चैतन्येर भक्ति येहो लओयाइल संसार ॥26॥
cc-madhya-1.26.translation: I offer innumerable obeisances unto the lotus feet of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, who is so kind that He spread the service of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu all over the world.

devanagari: तबे सनातन - गोसाञि र पुनरागमन ।
ज्यैष्ठ - मासे प्रभु ताँरे कैल परीक्षण ॥260॥
cc-madhya-1.260.translation: Thereafter Sanātana Gosvāmī met the Lord again, and the Lord tested him in scorching heat during the month of Jyaiṣṭha.

lines: tuṣṭa hañā prabhu tāṅre pāṭhāilā vṛndāvana
devanagari: तुष्ट हञा प्रभु ताँरे पाठाइला वृन्दावन ।
अद्वैतेर हस्ते प्रभुर अद्भुत भोजन ॥261॥
cc-madhya-1.261.translation: Being pleased, the Lord sent Sanātana Gosvāmī back to Vṛndāvana. After that, He was fed wonderfully by the hands of Śrī Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: नित्यान न्द - सङ्गे युक्ति करिया निभृते ।
ताँरे पाठाइला गौड़े प्रेम प्रचारिते ॥262॥
cc-madhya-1.262.translation: After sending Sanātana Gosvāmī back to Vṛndāvana, the Lord privately consulted with Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu. He then sent Him to Bengal to preach love of Godhead.

lines: tabe ta' vallabha bhaṭṭa prabhure mililā
devanagari: तबे त’ वल्लभ भट्ट प्रभुरे मिलिला ।
कृष्ण - नामेर अर्थ प्रभु ताँहारे कहिला ॥263॥
cc-madhya-1.263.translation: Soon afterward, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa met the Lord at Jagannātha Purī, and the Lord explained to him the import of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: प्रद्युम्न मिश्रेरे प्रभु रामानन्द - स्थाने ।
कृष्ण - कथा शुनाइल कहि’ ताँर गुणे ॥264॥
cc-madhya-1.264.translation: After explaining the transcendental qualities of Rāmānanda Rāya, the Lord sent Pradyumna Miśra to the residence of Rāmānanda Rāya, and Pradyumna Miśra learned kṛṣṇa-kathā from him.

devanagari: गोपीनाथ पट्टनायक - रामानन्द - भ्राता ।
राजा मारितेछिल, प्रभु हैल त्राता ॥265॥
cc-madhya-1.265.translation: After this, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu saved Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the younger brother of Rāmānanda Rāya, from being condemned to death by the King.

devanagari: रामचन्द्र - पुरी - भये भिक्षा घाटाइला ।
वैष्णवेर दुःख देखि’ अर्धक राखिला ॥266॥
cc-madhya-1.266.translation: Rāmacandra Purī criticized Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu's eating; therefore the Lord reduced His eating to a minimum. However, when all the Vaiṣṇavas became very sorry, the Lord increased His portion to half as much as usual.

devanagari: ब्रह्माण्ड - भितरे हय चौद्द भुवन ।
चौद्द - भुवने वैसे यत जीव - गण ॥267॥
cc-madhya-1.267.translation: There are fourteen planetary systems within the universe, and all living entities reside in those planetary systems.

devanagari: मनुष्येर वेश धरि’ यात्रिकेर छले ।
प्रभुर दर्शन करे आसि’ नीलाचले ॥268॥
cc-madhya-1.268.translation: Dressing like human beings on pilgrimage, they all used to come to Jagannātha Purī to visit Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: एक - दिन श्रीवासादि यत भक्त - गण ।
महाप्रभुर गुण गाञा करेन कीर्तन ॥269॥
cc-madhya-1.269.translation: One day all the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, were chanting the transcendental qualities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: चैतन्य गोसाञि याँरे बले ‘बड़ भाइ’ ।
तेंहो कहे, मोर प्रभु - चैतन्य - गोसाञि ॥27॥
cc-madhya-1.27.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to address Nityānanda Prabhu as His elder brother, whereas Nityānanda Prabhu addressed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as His Lord.

devanagari: शुनि’ भक्त - गणे कहे स - क्रोध वचने ।
कृष्ण - नाम - गुण छाड़ि, कि कर कीर्तने ॥270॥
cc-madhya-1.270.translation: Not liking the chanting of His transcendental qualities, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chastised them as if He were angry. "What kind of chanting is this?" He asked. "Are you leaving aside the chanting of the holy name of the Lord?"

devanagari: औद्धत्य करते हैल सबाकार मन ।
स्वतन्त्र हइया सबे नाशा’बे भुवन ॥271॥
cc-madhya-1.271.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chastised all the devotees, telling them not to show impudence and spoil the entire world by becoming independent.

lines: daśa-dike koṭī koṭī loka hena kāle
devanagari: दश - दिके कोटी कोटी लोक हेन काले ।
जय कृष्ण - चैतन्य’ बलि’ करे कोलाहले ॥272॥
cc-madhya-1.272.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was apparently in a angry mood and chastising His devotees, many thousands of people outside loudly cried in a tumultuous voice, "All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!"

devanagari: जय जय महाप्रभु - व्रजेन्द्र कुमार ।
जगत्तारिते प्रभु, तोमार अवतार ॥273॥
cc-madhya-1.273.translation: All the people began to call very loudly, "All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is the son of Mahārāja Nanda! Now You have appeared to deliver the whole world!

lines: bahu-dūra haite āinu hañā baḍa ārta
devanagari: बहु - दूर हैते आइनु हञा बड़ आर्त ।
दरशन दिया प्रभु करह कृतार्थ ॥274॥
cc-madhya-1.274.translation: "O Lord, we are very unhappy. We have come a long distance to see You. Please be merciful and show us Your favor."

devanagari: शुनिया लोकेर दैन्य द्रविला हृदय ।
बाहिरे आ सि’ दरशन दिला दयामय ॥275॥
cc-madhya-1.275.translation: When the Lord heard the humble petition made by the people, his heart softened. Being very merciful, He immediately came out and gave audience to all of them.

devanagari: बाहु तुलि’ बले प्रभु बल’ ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ।
उठिल - श्री - हरि - ध्वनि चतुर्दिक्भरि’ ॥276॥
cc-madhya-1.276.translation: Raising His arms, the Lord asked everyone to chant loudly the vibration of the holy name of Lord Hari. There immediately arose a great stir, and the vibration of "Hari!" filled all directions.

lines: prabhu dekhi' preme loka ānandita mana
devanagari: प्रभु देखि’ प्रेमे लोक आनन्दित मन ।
प्रभुके ईश्वर बलि’ करये स्तवन ॥277॥
cc-madhya-1.277.translation: Seeing the Lord, everyone became joyful out of love. Everyone accepted the Lord as the Supreme, and thus they offered their prayers.

lines: ghare gupta hao, kene bāhire prakāśa
devanagari: स्तव शुनि’ प्रभुके कहेन श्रीनिवास ।
घरे गुप्त हओ, केने बाहिरे प्रकाश ॥278॥
cc-madhya-1.278.translation: While the people were offering their prayers unto the Lord, Śrīnivāsa Ācārya sarcastically said to the Lord, "At home, You wanted to be covered. Why have You exposed Yourself outside?"

lines: ke śikhāla ei loke, kahe kon bāta
ihā-sabāra mukha ḍhāka diyā nija hāta
devanagari: के शिखाल एइ लोके, कहे कोन्बात ।
इहा - सबार मुख ढाक दिया निज हात ॥279॥
cc-madhya-1.279.translation: Śrīnivāsa Ācārya continued, "Who has taught these people? What are they saying? Now You can cover their mouths with Your own hand.

devanagari: यद्यपि आपनि हये प्रभु बलराम ।
तथापि चैतन्येर करे दास - अभिमान ॥28॥
cc-madhya-1.28.translation: Although Nityānanda Prabhu is none other than Balarāma Himself, He nonetheless always thinks of Himself as the eternal servant of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: sūrya yaiche udaya kari' cāhe lukāite
bujhite nā pāri taiche tomāra carite
devanagari: सूर्य यैछे उदय क रि’ चाहे लुकाइते ।
बुझिते ना पारि तैछे तोमार चरिते ॥280॥
cc-madhya-1.280.translation: "It is as if the sun, after rising, wanted to hide itself. We cannot understand such characteristics in Your behavior."

lines: sabe meli' kara mora kateka lāñcanā
devanagari: प्रभु कहेन, - श्रीनिवास, छाड़ विड़म्बना ।
सबे मे लि’ कर मोर कतेक लाञ्चना ॥281॥
cc-madhya-1.281.translation: The Lord replied, "My dear Śrīnivāsa, please stop joking. You have all combined together to humiliate Me in this way."

lines: eta bali' loke kari' śubha-dṛṣṭi dāna
abhyantare gelā, lokera pūrṇa haila kāma
devanagari: एत ब लि’ लोके क रि’ शुभ - दृष्टि दान ।
अभ्यन्तरे गेला, लोकेर पूर्ण हैल काम ॥282॥
cc-madhya-1.282.translation: Thus speaking, the Lord entered His room after glancing auspiciously upon the people out of charity. In this way the desires of the people were completely fulfilled.

devanagari: रघुनाथ - दास नित्यानन्द - पाशे गेला ।
चिड़ा - दधि - महोत्सव ताहाङिकरिला ॥283॥
cc-madhya-1.283.translation: At this time, Raghunātha dāsa approached Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu and, according to His order, prepared a feast and distributed prasāda composed of chipped rice and curd.

lines: tāṅra ājñā lañā gelā prabhura caraṇe
tāṅra prabhu tāṅre samarpilā svarūpera sthāne
devanagari: ताँर आज्ञा ल ञा गेला प्रभुर चरणे ।
प्रभु ताँरे समर्पिला स्वरूपेर स्थाने ॥284॥
cc-madhya-1.284.translation: Later, Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī left home and took shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī. At that time, the Lord received him and placed him under the care of Svarūpa Dāmodara for spiritual enlightenment.

lines: ei mata līlā kaila chaya vatsara
devanagari: ब्रह्मानन्द - भारतीर घुचाइल चर्माम्बर ।
एइ मत लीला कैल छय वत्सर ॥285॥
cc-madhya-1.285.translation: Later, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped Brahmānanda Bhāratī's habit of wearing deerskin. The Lord thus enjoyed His pastimes continuously for six years, experiencing varieties of transcendental bliss.

devanagari: एइ त’ कहिल मध्य - लीलार सूत्र - गण ।
शेष द्वादश व त्सरेर शुन विवरण ॥286॥
cc-madhya-1.286.translation: I have thus given the codes of the madhya-līlā. Now please hear the pastimes the Lord performed during the last twelve years.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥287॥
cc-madhya-1.287.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: 'caitanye' ye bhakti kare, sei mora prāṇa
devanagari: ‘चैतन्य’ सेव, ‘चैतन्य’ गाओ, लओ ‘चैतन्य’ - नाम ।
‘चैतन्ये’ ये भक्ति करे, सेइ मोर प्राण ॥29॥
cc-madhya-1.29.translation: Nityānanda Prabhu requested everyone to serve Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, chant His glories and utter His name. Nityānanda Prabhu claimed that person to be His life and soul who rendered devotional service unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: जयतां सुरतौ पोङ्गोर्मम मन्द - मतेर्गती ।
मत्सर्वस्व - पदाम्भोजौ राधा - मदन - मोहनौ ॥3॥
cc-madhya-1.3.translation: Glory to the all-merciful Rādhā and Madana-mohana! I am lame and ill-advised, yet They are my directors, and Their lotus feet are everything to me.

devanagari: एइ मत लोके चैतन्य - भक्ति लओयाइल ।
दीन - हीन, निन्दक, सबारे निस्तारिल ॥30॥
cc-madhya-1.30.translation: In this way, Śrīla Nityānanda Prabhu introduced the cult of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to everyone without discrimination. Even though the people were fallen souls and blasphemers, they were delivered by this process.

devanagari: तबे प्रभु व्रजे पाठाइल रूप - सनातन ।
प्रभु - आज्ञाय दुइ भाइ आइला वृन्दावन ॥31॥
cc-madhya-1.31.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then sent the two brothers Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī to Vraja. By His order, they went to Śrī Vṛndāvana-dhāma.

devanagari: भक्ति प्रचारिया सर्व - तीर्थ प्रकाशिल ।
मदन - गोपाल - गोविन्देर सेवा प्रचारिल ॥32॥
cc-madhya-1.32.translation: After going to Vṛndāvana, the brothers preached devotional service and discovered many places of pilgrimage. They specifically initiated the service of Madana-mohana and Govindajī.

lines: nānā śāstra āni' kailā bhakti-grantha sāra
devanagari: नाना शास्त्र आ नि’ कैला भक्ति - ग्रन्थ सार ।
मूढ़ अधम - जनेरे तेंहो करिला निस्तार ॥33॥
cc-madhya-1.33.translation: Both Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī brought various scriptures to Vṛndāvana and collected the essence of these by compiling many scriptures on devotional service. In this way they delivered all rascals and fallen souls.

lines: prabhu ājñāya kaila saba śāstrera vicāra
devanagari: प्रभु आज्ञाय कैल सब शास्त्रेर विचार ।
व्रजेर निगूढ़ भक्ति करिल प्रचार ॥34॥
cc-madhya-1.34.translation: The Gosvāmīs carried out the preaching work of devotional service on the basis of an analytical study of all confidential Vedic literatures. This was in compliance with the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Thus one can understand the most confidential devotional service of Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: हरि - भक्ति - विलास, आर भागवतामृत ।
दशम - टिप्पनी, आर दशम - चरित ॥35॥
cc-madhya-1.35.translation: Some of the books compiled by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī were Hari-bhakti-vilāsa, Bhāgavatāmṛta, Daśama-ṭippanī and Daśama-carita.

lines: ei saba grantha kaila gosāñi sanātana
rūpa-gosāñi kaila yata, ke karu gaṇana
devanagari: एइ सब ग्रन्थ कैल गोसाञि सनातन ।
रूप - गोसाञि कैल यत, के करु गणन ॥36॥
cc-madhya-1.36.translation: We have already given the names of four books compiled by Sanātana Gosvāmī. Similarly, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī has also compiled many books, which no one can even count.

devanagari: प्रधान प्रधान किछु करिये गणन ।
लक्ष ग्रन्थे कैल व्रज - विलास वर्णन ॥37॥
cc-madhya-1.37.translation: I shall therefore enumerate the chief books compiled by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. He has described the pastimes of Vṛndāvana in thousands of verses.

devanagari: रसामृत - सिन्धु, आर विदग्ध - माधव ।
उज्ज्वल - नीलमणि, आर ललित - माधव ॥38॥
cc-madhya-1.38.translation: The books compiled by Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī include Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu, Vidagdha-mādhava, Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi and Lalita-mādhava.

devanagari: दान - केलि - कौमुदी, आर बहु स्तवावली ।
अष्टादश लीला - च्छन्द, आर पद्यावली ॥39॥
cc-madhya-1.39-40.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also compiled Dāna-keli-kaumudī, Stavāvalī, Līlā-cchanda, Padyāvalī, Govinda-virudāvalī, Mathurā-māhātmya and Nāṭaka-varṇana.

devanagari: दीव्यद्वन्दारण्य - कल्प - द्रुमाधः - श्रीमद्रत्नागार - सिंहासन - स्थौ ।
श्रीमद्राधा - श्रील - गोविन्द - देवौ प्रेष्ठालीभिः सेव्यमानौ स्मरामि ॥4॥
cc-madhya-1.4.translation: In a temple of jewels in Vṛndāvana, underneath a desire tree, Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Govinda, served by Their most confidential associates, sit upon an effulgent throne. I offer my humble obeisances unto Them.

devanagari: लघु - भागवतामृतादि के करु गणन ।
सर्वत्र करिल व्रज - विलास वर्णन ॥41॥
cc-madhya-1.41.translation: Who can count the rest of the books (headed by Laghu-bhāgavatāmṛta) written by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī? He has described the pastimes of Vṛndāvana in all of them.

lines: yata bhakti-grantha kaila, tāra anta nāi
devanagari: ताँर भ्रातुष्पुत्र नाम - श्री - जीव - गोसाञि ।
यत भक्ति - ग्रन्थ कैल, तार अन्त नाइ ॥42॥
cc-madhya-1.42.translation: Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī's nephew, Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī, has compiled so many books on devotional service that there is no counting them.

devanagari: श्री - भागवत - सन्दर्भ - नाम ग्रन्थ - विस्तार ।
भक्ति - सिद्धान्तेर ताते देखाइयाछेन पार ॥43॥
cc-madhya-1.43.translation: In Śrī Bhāgavata-sandarbha, Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī has written conclusively about the ultimate end of devotional service.

devanagari: गोपाल - चम्पू - नामे ग्रन्थ - महाशूर ।
नित्य - लीला स्थापन याहे व्रज - रस - पूर ॥44॥
cc-madhya-1.44.translation: The most famous and formidable transcendental literature is the book named Gopāla-campū. In this book the eternal pastimes of the Lord are established, and the transcendental mellows enjoyed in Vṛndāvana are completely described.

lines: ei mata nānā grantha kariyā prakāśa
devanagari: एइ मत नाना ग्रन्थ करिया प्रकाश ।
गोष्ठी सहिते कैला वृन्दावने वास ॥45॥
cc-madhya-1.45.translation: Thus Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, Sanātana Gosvāmī and their nephew Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī, as well as practically all of their family members, lived in Vṛndāvana and published important books on devotional service.

devanagari: प्रथम वत्सरे अद्वैतादि भक्त - गण ।
प्रभुरे देखिते कैल, नीलाद्रि गमन ॥46॥
cc-madhya-1.46.translation: The first year after Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted the renounced order of life, all the devotees, headed by Śrī Advaita Prabhu, went to see the Lord at Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: रथ - यात्रा देखि ताहाँ रहिला चारि - मास ।
प्रभु - सङ्गे नृत्य - गीत परम उल्लास ॥47॥
cc-madhya-1.47.translation: After attending the Ratha-yātrā ceremony at Jagannātha Purī, all the devotees remained there for four months, greatly enjoying the company of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu by performing kīrtana [chanting and dancing].

devanagari: विदाय समय प्रभु कहिला सबारे ।
प्रत्यब्द आसिबे सबे गुण्डिचा देखिबारे ॥48॥
cc-madhya-1.48.translation: At the time of departure, the Lord requested all the devotees, "Please come here every year to see the Ratha-yātrā festival of Lord Jagannātha's journey to the Guṇḍicā temple."

devanagari: प्रभु - आज्ञाय भक्तगण प्रत्यब्द आसिया ।
गुण्डिचा देखिया ग्रान प्रभुरे मिलिया ॥49॥
cc-madhya-1.49.translation: Following the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the devotees used to visit Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu every year. They would see the Guṇḍicā festival at Jagannātha Purī and then return home after four months.

devanagari: श्रीमान्नास - रसारम्भी वंशी - वट - तट - स्थितः ।
कर्षन्वेणु - स्वनैर्गोपीर्गोपीनाथः श्रियेऽस्तु नः ॥5॥
cc-madhya-1.5.translation: May Gopīnāthajī, who attracts all the gopīs with the song of His flute and who has begun the most melodious rāsa dance on the bank of the Yamunā in Vaṁśīvaṭa, be merciful upon us.

lines: anyonye duṅhāra duṅhā vinā nāhi sthiti
devanagari: विंशति वत्सर ऐछे कैला गतागति ।
अन्योन्ये दुँहार दुँहा विना नाहि स्थिति ॥50॥
cc-madhya-1.50.translation: For twenty consecutive years this meeting took place, and the situation became so intense that the Lord and the devotees could not be happy without meeting one another.

lines: śeṣa āra yei rahe dvādaśa vatsara
devanagari: शेष आर येइ रहे द्वादश वत्सर ।
कृष्णेर विरह - लीला प्रभुर अन्तर ॥51॥
cc-madhya-1.51.translation: The last twelve years were simply devoted to relishing the pastimes of Kṛṣṇa in separation within the heart of the Lord.

lines: hāse, kānde, nāce, gāya parama viṣāde
devanagari: निरन्तर रात्रि - दिन विरह उन्मादे ।
हासे, कान्दे, नाचे, गाय परम विषादे ॥52॥
cc-madhya-1.52.translation: In the attitude of separation, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu appeared mad both day and night. Sometimes He laughed, and sometimes He cried; sometimes He danced, and sometimes He chanted in great sorrow.

devanagari: ये काले करेन जगन्नाथ दरशन ।
मने भावे, कुरुक्षेत्रे पाञाछि मिलन ॥53॥
cc-madhya-1.53.translation: At those times, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would visit Lord Jagannātha. Then His feelings exactly corresponded to those of the gopīs when they saw Kṛṣṇa at Kurukṣetra after long separation. Kṛṣṇa had come to Kurukṣetra with His brother and sister to visit.

lines: tāhāṅ ei pada mātra karaye gāyana
devanagari: रथ - यात्राय आगे यबे करेन नर्तन ।
ताहाँ एइ पद मात्र करये गायन ॥54॥
cc-madhya-1.54.translation: When Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to dance before the cart during the festival, He always sang the following two lines.

devanagari: सेइत पराण - नाथ पाइनु ।
याहा लागी’ मदन - दहने झुरि गेनु ॥55॥
cc-madhya-1.55.translation: "I have gotten that Lord of My life for whom I was burning in the fire of lusty desires."

devanagari: एइ धुया - गाने नाचेन द्वितीय प्रहर ।
कृष्ण लञा व्रजे याइ - ए - भाव अन्तर ॥56॥
cc-madhya-1.56.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to sing this song [seita parāṇa-nātha] especially during the latter part of the day, and He would think, "Let Me take Kṛṣṇa and go back to Vṛndāvana." This ecstasy was always filling His heart.

lines: ei bhāve nṛtya-madhye paḍe eka śloka
sei ślokera artha keha nāhi bujhe loka
devanagari: एइ भा वे नृत्य - मध्ये पड़े एक श्लोक ।
सेइ श्लोकेर अर्थ केह नाहि बुझे लोक ॥57॥
cc-madhya-1.57.translation: In that ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited one verse when dancing in front of Lord Jagannātha. Almost no one could understand the meaning of that verse.

lines: yaḥ kaumāra-haraḥ sa eva hi varas tā eva caitra-kṣapās
devanagari: यः कौमार - हरः स एव हि वरस्ता एव चैत्र - क्षपास् ते चोन्मीलित - मालती - सुरभयः प्रौढ़ाः कदम्बानिलाः ।
सा चैवास्मि तथापि तत्र सुरत - व्यापार - लीला - विधौ रेवा - रोधसि वेतसी - तरु - तले चेतः समुत्कण्ठते ॥58॥
cc-madhya-1.58.translation: "That very personality who stole away my heart during my youth is now again my master. These are the same moonlit nights of the month of Caitra. The same fragrance of mālatī flowers is there, and the same sweet breezes are blowing from the kadamba forest. In our intimate relationship, I am also the same lover, yet still my mind is not happy here. I am eager to go back to that place on the bank of the Revā under the Vetasī tree. That is my desire."

lines: ei ślokera artha jāne ekale svarūpa
daive se vatsara tāhāṅ giyāchena rūpa
devanagari: एइ श्लोकेर अर्थ जाने एकले स्वरूप ।
दैवे से वत्सर ताहाँ गियाछेन रूप ॥59॥
cc-madhya-1.59.translation: This verse appears to be the hankering between some ordinary boy and girl, but its actual deep meaning was known only to Svarūpa Dāmodara. By chance, one year Rūpa Gosvāmī was also present there.

devanagari: जय जय गौरचन्द्र जय कृपा - सिन्धु ।
जय जय शची - सुत जय दीन - बन्धु ॥6॥
cc-madhya-1.6.translation: All glories unto Śrī Gaurahari, who is an ocean of mercy! All glories unto You, the son of Śacīdevī, for You are the only friend of all fallen souls!

devanagari: प्रभु - मुखे श्लोक शुनि’ श्री - रूप - गोसाञि ।
सेइ श्लोकेर अर्थ - श्लोक करिला तथा इ ॥60॥
cc-madhya-1.60.translation: Although the meaning of the verse was known only to Svarūpa Dāmodara, Rūpa Gosvāmī, after hearing it from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, immediately composed another verse, describing the meaning of the original verse.

devanagari: श्लोक क रि’ एक ताल - पत्रेते लिखिया ।
आपन वासार चाले राखिल गुञ्जिया ॥61॥
cc-madhya-1.61.translation: After composing this verse, Rūpa Gosvāmī wrote it on a palm leaf and put it on the roof of the thatched house in which he was living.

devanagari: श्लोक रा खि’ गेला समुद्र - स्नान करिते ।
हेन - काले आइला प्रभु ताँहारे मिलिते ॥62॥
cc-madhya-1.62.translation: After composing this verse and putting it on the roof of his house, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī went to bathe in the sea. In the meantime, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to his hut to meet him.

devanagari: हरिदास ठाकुर आर रूप - सनातन ।
जगन्नाथ - मन्दिरे ना या’न तिन जन ॥63॥
cc-madhya-1.63.translation: To avoid turmoil, three great personalities-Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī-did not enter the temple of Jagannātha.

devanagari: महाप्रभु जगन्नाथेर उपल - भोग देखिया ।
निज - गृहे या’न एइ तिनेरे मिलिया ॥64॥
cc-madhya-1.64.translation: Every day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to see the upala-bhoga ceremony at the temple of Jagannātha, and after seeing this He used to go visit these three great personalities on His way to His own residence.

lines: ei tina madhye yabe thāke yei jana
devanagari: एइ तिन मध्ये यबे थाके येइ जन ।
ताँरे आसि’ आपने मिले , - प्रभुर नियम ॥65॥
cc-madhya-1.65.translation: If one of these three was not present, He would meet the others. That was His regular practice.

lines: daive āsi' prabhu yabe ūrdhvete cāhilā
cāle goṅjā tāla-patre sei śloka pāilā
devanagari: दैवे आ सि’ प्रभु यबे ऊध्र्वेते चाहिला ।
चाले गोंजा ताल - पत्रे सेइ श्लोक पाइञा ॥66॥
cc-madhya-1.66.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the residence of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, He accidentally saw the palm leaf on the roof, and thus He read the verse composed by him.

lines: śloka paḍi' āche prabhu āviṣṭa ha-iyā
devanagari: श्लोक प ड़ि’ आछे प्रभु आविष्ट हइया ।
रूप - गोसाञि आसि’ पड़े दण्डवत् हञा ॥67॥
cc-madhya-1.67.translation: After reading the verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went into a ecstatic mood. While He was in that state, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī came and immediately fell down on the floor like a rod.

devanagari: उठि’ महाप्रभु ताँरे चापड़ मारिया ।
कहिते लागिला किछु कोलेते करिया ॥68॥
cc-madhya-1.68.translation: When Rūpa Gosvāmī fell down like a rod, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up and gave him a slap. Then, taking him on His lap, He began to speak to him.

lines: mora ślokera abhiprāya nā jāne kona jane
mora manera kathā tumi jānile kemane?
devanagari: मोर श्लोकेर अभिप्राय ना जाने कोन जने ।
मोर मनेर कथा तुमि जानिले केमने? ॥69॥
cc-madhya-1.69.translation: "No one knows the purport of My verse," Caitanya Mahāprabhu said. "How could you understand My intention?"

devanagari: जय जय नित्यानन्द जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र ।
जय श्रीवासादि जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥7॥
cc-madhya-1.7.translation: All glories unto Lord Nityānanda and Advaita Prabhu, and all glories unto all the devotees of Lord Caitanya, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura!

lines: eta bali' tāṇre bahu prasāda kariyā
devanagari: एत ब लि’ तरि बह प्रसाद करिया ।
स्वरूप - गोसाञिरे श्लोक देखाइल ल ञा ॥70॥
cc-madhya-1.70.translation: Saying this, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu bestowed various benedictions upon Rūpa Gosvāmī, and taking the verse, He later showed it to Svarūpa Gosvāmī.

lines: mora manera kathā rūpa jānila kemate
devanagari: स्वरूपे पुछेन प्रभु हइया विस्मिते ।
मोर मनेर कथा रूप जानिल केमते ॥71॥
cc-madhya-1.71.translation: Having shown the verse to Svarūpa Dāmodara with great wonder, Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked him how Rūpa Gosvāmī could understand the intentions of His mind.

devanagari: स्वरूप कहे , - याते जानिल तोमार मन ।
ताते जानि, हय तोमार कृपार भाजन ॥72॥
cc-madhya-1.72.translation: Śrīla Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī replied to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "If Rūpa Gosvāmī can understand Your mind and intentions, he must have Your Lordship's special benediction."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - तारे आमि सन्तुष्ट हञा ।
आलिङ्गन कैलु सर्व - शक्ति सञ्चारिया ॥73॥
cc-madhya-1.73.translation: The Lord said, "I was so pleased with Rūpa Gosvāmī that I embraced him and bestowed upon him all necessary potencies for preaching the bhakti cult.

devanagari: योग्य पात्र हय गूढ़ - रस - विवेचने ।
