तुमिओ कहिओ तारे गूढ़ - रसाख्याने ॥74॥
cc-madhya-1.74.translation: "I accept Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī as quite fit to understand the confidential mellows of devotional service, and I recommend that you explain devotional service to him further."

devanagari: ए - सब कहिब आगे विस्तार करिञा ।
संक्षेपे उद्देश कैल प्रस्ताव पाइञा ॥75॥
cc-madhya-1.75.translation: I shall describe all these incidents elaborately later on. Now I have given only a brief reference.

lines: tathāhaṁ sā rādhā tad idam ubhayoḥ saṅgama-sukham
devanagari: प्रियः सोऽयं कृष्णः सहचरि कुरुक्षेत्र - मिलितस् तथाहं सा राधा तदिदमुभयोः सङ्गम - सुखम् ।
तथाप्यन्तः - खेलन्मधुर - मुरली - पञ्चम - जुषे मनो मे कालिन्दी - पुलिन - विपिनाय स्पृहयति ॥76॥
cc-madhya-1.76.translation: [This is a verse spoken by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.] "My dear friend, now I have met My very old and dear friend Kṛṣṇa on this field of Kurukṣetra. I am the same Rādhārāṇī, and now We are meeting together. It is very pleasant, but still I would like to go to the bank of the Yamunā beneath the trees of the forest there. I wish to hear the vibration of His sweet flute playing the fifth note within that forest of Vṛndāvana."

devanagari: एइ श्लोकेर संक्षेपार्थ शुन, भक्त - गण ।
जगन्नाथ देखि’ यैछे प्रभुर भावन ॥77॥
cc-madhya-1.77.translation: Now, O devotees, please hear a brief explanation of this verse. Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu was thinking in this way after having seen the Jagannātha Deity.

devanagari: श्री - राधिका कुरुक्षेत्रे कृष्णेर दरशन ।
यद्यपि पाये न, तबु भावेन ऐछन ॥78॥
cc-madhya-1.78.translation: The subject of His thoughts was Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, who met Kṛṣṇa in the field of Kurukṣetra. Although She met Kṛṣṇa there, She was nonetheless thinking of Him in the following way.

devanagari: राज - वेश, हाती, घोड़ा, मनुष्य गहन ।
काहाँ गोप - वेश, काहाँ निर्जन वृन्दावन ॥79॥
cc-madhya-1.79.translation: She thought of Him in the calm and quiet atmosphere of Vṛndāvana, dressed as a cowherd boy. But at Kurukṣetra He was in a royal dress and was accompanied by elephants, horses and crowds of men. Thus the atmosphere was not congenial for Their meeting.

devanagari: पूर्वे कहिलुँ आदि - लीलार सूत्र - गण ।
याहा विस्तारियाछेन दास - वृन्दावन ॥8॥
cc-madhya-1.8.translation: I have previously described in synopsis the ādi-līlā [initial pastimes], which have already been fully described by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura.

lines: sei bhāva, sei kṛṣṇa, sei vṛndāvana
yabe pāi, tabe haya vāñchita pūraṇa
devanagari: सेइ भाव, सेइ कृष्ण, सेइ वृन्दावन ।
यबे पाई, तबे हय वाञ्छित पूरण ॥80॥
cc-madhya-1.80.translation: Thus meeting with Kṛṣṇa and thinking of the Vṛndāvana atmosphere, Rādhārāṇī longed for Kṛṣṇa to take Her to Vṛndāvana again to fulfill Her desire in that calm atmosphere.

lines: gehaṁ juṣām api manasy udiyāt sadā naḥ
devanagari: आहुश्च ते नलिन - नाभ पदारवि न्दं योगेश्वरैर्हदि विचिन्त्यमगाध - बोधैः ।
संसार - कूप - पतितोत्तरणावल म्बं गेहं जुषामपि मनस्युदियात्सदा नः ॥81॥
cc-madhya-1.81.translation: The gopīs spoke thus, "Dear Lord, whose navel is just like a lotus flower, Your lotus feet are the only shelter for those who have fallen into the deep well of material existence. Your feet are worshiped and meditated upon by great mystic yogīs and highly learned philosophers. We wish that these lotus feet may also be awakened within our hearts, although we are only ordinary persons engaged in household affairs."

lines: udaya karaye yadi, tabe vāñchā pūre
devanagari: तोमार चरण मोर व्रज - पुर - घरे ।
उदय करये यदि, तबे वाञ्छा पूरे ॥82॥
cc-madhya-1.82.translation: The gopīs thought, "Dear Lord, if Your lotus feet again come to our home in Vṛndāvana, our desires will be fulfilled."

devanagari: भागवतेर श्लोक - गूढार्थ विशद करिञा ।
रूप - गोसाञि श्लोक कैल लोक बुझाइञा ॥83॥
cc-madhya-1.83.translation: In one verse, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī has explained the confidential meaning of the verse of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam for the understanding of the general populace.

lines: dhanyā kṣauṇī vilasati vṛtā māthurī mādhurībhiḥ
devanagari: या ते लीला - रस - परिमलोद्गारि - वन्यापरीता धन्या क्षौणी विलसति वृता माथुरी माधुरीभिः ।
तत्रास्माभिश्च टुल - पशुपी - भाव - मुग्धान्तराभिः संवीतस्त्वं कलय वदनोल्लासि - वेणुर्विहारम् ॥84॥
cc-madhya-1.84.translation: The gopīs continued, "Dear Kṛṣṇa, the fragrance of the mellows of Your pastimes is spread throughout the forests of the glorious land of Vṛndāvana, which is surrounded by the sweetness of the district of Mathurā. In the congenial atmosphere of that wonderful land, You may enjoy Your pastimes, with Your flute dancing on Your lips, and surrounded by us, the gopīs, whose hearts are always enchanted by unpredictable ecstatic emotions."

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभु देखि’ जगन्नाथे ।
सुभद्रा - सहित देखे, वंशी नाहि हाते ॥85॥
cc-madhya-1.85.translation: In this way, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Jagannātha, He saw that the Lord was with His sister Subhadrā and was not holding a flute in His hand.

lines: kāhāṅ pāba, ei vāñchā bāḍe anukṣaṇa
devanagari: त्रिभङ्ग सुन्दर व्रजे व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन ।
काहाँ पाब, एइ वाञ्छा बाड़े अनुक्षण ॥86॥
cc-madhya-1.86.translation: Absorbed in the ecstasy of the gopīs, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu wished to see Lord Jagannātha in His original form as Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja, standing in Vṛndāvana and appearing very beautiful, His body curved in three places. His desire to see that form was always increasing.

devanagari: राधिका - उन्माद यैछे उद्धव - दर्शने ।
उद्भूर्णा - प्रलाप तैछे प्रभुर रात्रि - दिने ॥87॥
cc-madhya-1.87.translation: Just as Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī talked inconsistently with a bumblebee in the presence of Uddhava, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in His ecstasy talked crazily and inconsistently day and night.

devanagari: द्वादश वत्सर शेष ऐछे गोङाइल ।
एइ मत शेष - लीला त्रि - विधाने कैल ॥88॥
cc-madhya-1.88.translation: The last twelve years of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were passed in this transcendental craziness. Thus He executed His last pastimes in three ways.

lines: sannyāsa kari' cabbiśa vatsara kailā ye ye karma
devanagari: सन्न्यास करि’ चब्बिश वत्सर कैला ये ये कर्म ।
अनन्त, अपार - तार के जानिबे मर्म ॥89॥
cc-madhya-1.89.translation: For the twenty-four years after Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted the renounced order, whatever pastimes He executed were unlimited and unfathomable. Who can understand the purport of such pastimes ?

devanagari: अतएव तार आमि सूत्र - मात्र कैलुँ।
ये किछु विशेष, सूत्र - मध्येइ कहि लुँ ॥9॥
cc-madhya-1.9.translation: I have therefore given only a synopsis of those incidents, and whatever specifics were to be related have already been given in that synopsis.

lines: mukhya mukhya līlāra kari sūtra gaṇana
devanagari: उद्देश करिते करि दिग्दरशन ।
मुख्य मुख्य लीलार करि सूत्र गणन ॥90॥
cc-madhya-1.90.translation: Just to indicate those pastimes, I am presenting a general survey of the chief pastimes in the form of a synopsis.

devanagari: प्रथम सूत्र प्रभुर सन्न्यास - करण ।
सन्न्यास करि’ चलिला प्रभु श्री - वृन्दावन ॥91॥
cc-madhya-1.91.translation: This is the first synopsis: After accepting the sannyāsa order, Caitanya Mahāprabhu proceeded toward Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: प्रेमेते विह्वल बाह्य नाहिक स्मरण ।
राढ़ - देशे तिन दिन करिला भ्रमण ॥92॥
cc-madhya-1.92.translation: When proceeding toward Vṛndāvana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was overwhelmed with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa, and He lost all remembrance of the external world. In this way He traveled continuously for three days in Rāḍha-deśa, the country where the Ganges River does not flow.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द प्रभु महाप्रभु भुलाइया ।
गङ्गा - तीरे लञा आइला ‘यमुना’ बलिया ॥93॥
cc-madhya-1.93.translation: First of all, Lord Nityānanda bewildered Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu by bringing Him along the banks of the Ganges, saying that it was the river Yamunā.

lines: prathama bhikṣā kaila tāhāṅ, rātre saṅkīrtana
devanagari: शान्तिपुरे आचार्येर गृहे आगमन ।
प्रथम भिक्षा कैल ताहाँ, रात्रे सङ्कीर्तन ॥94॥
cc-madhya-1.94.translation: After three days, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu came to the house of Advaita Ācārya at Śāntipura and accepted alms there. This was His first acceptance of alms. At night He performed congregational chanting there.

devanagari: माता भक्त - गणेर ताहाँ करिल मिलन ।
सर्व समाधान क रि’ कैल नीलाद्रि - गमन ॥95॥
cc-madhya-1.95.translation: At the house of Advaita Prabhu, He met His mother as well as all the devotees from Māyāpura. He adjusted everything and then went to Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: पथे नाना लीला - रस, देव - दरशन ।
माधव - पुरीर कथा, गोपाल - स्थापन ॥96॥
cc-madhya-1.96.translation: On the way toward Jagannātha Purī, Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed many other pastimes. He visited various temples and heard the story about Mādhavendra Purī and the installation of Gopāla.

devanagari: क्षीर - चुरि - कथा, साक्षि - गोपाल - विवरण ।
नित्यानन्द कैल प्रभुर दण्ड - भञ्जन ॥97॥
cc-madhya-1.97.translation: From Nityānanda Prabhu, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard the story of Kṣīra-curī Gopinātha and of the witness Gopāla. Then Nityānanda Prabhu broke the sannyāsa rod belonging to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: kruddha hañā ekā gelā jagannātha dekhite
devanagari: क्रुद्ध हञा एका गेला जगन्नाथ देखिते ।
देखिया मूच्छित हञा पड़िला भूमिते ॥98॥
cc-madhya-1.98.translation: After His sannyāsa rod was broken by Nityānanda Prabhu, Caitanya Mahāprabhu apparently became very angry and left His company to travel alone to the Jagannātha temple. When Caitanya Mahāprabhu entered the Jagannātha temple and saw Lord Jagannātha, He immediately lost His senses and fell down on the ground.

devanagari: सार्वभौम ल ञा गेला आपन - भवन ।
तृतीय प्रहरे प्रभुर हइल चेतन ॥99॥
cc-madhya-1.99.translation: After Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Lord Jagannātha in the temple and fell down unconscious, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya took Him to his home. The Lord remained unconscious until the afternoon, when He finally regained His consciousness.

devanagari: विच्छेदेऽस्मिन्प्रभोरन्त्य - लीला - सूत्रानुवर्णने ।
गौरस्य कृष्ण - विच्छेद - प्रलापाद्यनुवर्यते ॥1॥
cc-madhya-2.1.translation: While relating in synopsis form the last division of the pastimes of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, in this chapter I shall describe the Lord's transcendental ecstasy, which appears like madness due to His separation from Kṛṣṇa.

lines: tāhāṅ yāi' nāce, gāya, kṣaṇe mūrcchā yā'na
devanagari: उपवनोद्यान देखि’ वृन्दावन - ज्ञान ।
ताहाँ याइ’ नाचे, गाय, क्षणे मूर्च्छा या’न ॥10॥
cc-madhya-2.10.translation: Sometimes Caitanya Mahāprabhu mistook the small parks of the city for Vṛndāvana. Sometimes He would go there, dance and chant and sometimes fall unconscious in spiritual ecstasy.

lines: kāhāṅ nāhi śuni yei bhāvera vikāra
sei bhāva haya prabhura śarīre pracāra
devanagari: काहाँ नाहि शुनि येइ भावेर विकार ।
सेइ भाव हय प्रभुर शरीरे प्रचार ॥11॥
cc-madhya-2.11.translation: The extraordinary transformations of the body due to transcendental feelings would never have been possible for anyone but the Lord, in whose body all transformations were manifest.

lines: sandhi chāḍi' bhinna haye, carma rahe sthāne
devanagari: हस्त - पदेर सन्धि सब वितस्ति - प्रमाणे ।
सन्धि छा ड़ि’ भिन्न हये, चर्म रहे स्थाने ॥12॥
cc-madhya-2.12.translation: The joints of His hands and legs would sometimes become separated by eight inches, and they remained connected only by the skin.

devanagari: हस्त, पद, शिर सब शरीर - भितरे ।
प्रविष्ट हय - कूर्म - रूप देखिये प्रभुरे ॥13॥
cc-madhya-2.13.translation: Sometimes Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's hands, legs and head would all enter within His body, just like the withdrawn limbs of a tortoise.

devanagari: एइ मत अद्भुत - भाव शरीरे प्रकाश ।
मनेते शून्यता, वाक्ये हा - हा - हुताश ॥14॥
cc-madhya-2.14.translation: In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to manifest wonderful ecstatic symptoms. His mind appeared vacant, and there were only hopelessness and disappointment in His words.

devanagari: काहाँ मोर प्राण - नाथ मुरली - वदन ।
काहाँ करों काहाँ पाँ व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन ॥15॥
cc-madhya-2.15.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to express His mind in this way, "Where is the Lord of My life, who is playing His flute? What shall I do now? Where should I go to find the son of Mahārāja Nanda?

lines: kāhāre kahiba, kebā jāne mora duḥkha
devanagari: काहारे कहिब, केबा जाने मोर दुःख ।
व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन विनु फाटे मोर बुक ॥16॥
cc-madhya-2.16.translation: "To whom should I speak? Who can understand My disappointment? Without the son of Nanda Mahārāja, My heart is broken."

devanagari: एइ - मत विलाप करे विह्वल अन्तर ।
रायेर नाटक - श्लोक पड़े निरन्तर ॥17॥
cc-madhya-2.17.translation: In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu always expressed bewilderment and lamented in separation from Kṛṣṇa. At such times He used to read the ślokas from Rāmānanda Rāya's drama known as Jagannātha-vallabha-nāṭaka.

lines: prema-ccheda-rujo 'vagacchati harir nāyaṁ na ca prema vā
sthānāsthānam avaiti nāpi madano jānāti no durbalāḥ
anyo veda na cānya-duḥkham akhilaṁ no jīvanaṁ vāśravaṁ
dvi-trāṇy eva dināni yauvanam idaṁ hā-hā vidhe kā gatiḥ
devanagari: प्रेम - च्छेद - रुजोऽवगच्छति हरिर्नायं न च प्रेम वा स्थानास्थानमवैति नापि मदनो जानाति नो दुर्बलाः ।
अन्यो वेद न चान्य - दुःखमखिलं नो जीवनं वाश्रवं द्वि - त्राण्येव दिनानि यौवनमिदं हा - हा विधे का गतिः ॥18॥
cc-madhya-2.18.translation: "[Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī used to lament:] 'Our Kṛṣṇa does not realize what we have suffered from injuries inflicted in the course of loving affairs. We are actually misused by love because love does not know where to strike and where not to strike. Even Cupid does not know of our very weakened condition. What should I tell anyone? No one can understand another's difficulties. Our life is actually not under our control, for youth will remain for two or three days and soon be finished. In this condition, O creator, what will be our destination?'

devanagari: उपजिल प्रेमाङ कुर, भाङ्गिल ये दुःख - पूर
कृष्ण ताहा नाहि करे पान ।
बाहिरे नागर - राज, भितरे शठेर काज
पर - नारी वधे सावधान ॥19॥
cc-madhya-2.19.translation: [Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī spoke thus, in distress due to separation from Kṛṣṇa:] "Oh, what shall I say of My distress? After I met Kṛṣṇa My loving propensities sprouted, but upon separating from Him I sustained a great shock, which is now continuing like the sufferings of a disease. The only physician for this disease is Kṛṣṇa Himself, but He is not taking care of this sprouting plant of devotional service. What can I say about the behavior of Kṛṣṇa? Outwardly He is a very attractive young lover, but at heart He is a great cheat, very expert in killing others' wives."

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैतचन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-madhya-2.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! All glories to all the devotees of the Lord!

lines: sakhī he, nā bujhiye vidhira vidhāna
sukha lāgi' kailuṅ prīta, haila duḥkha viparīta,
devanagari: सखि हे, ना बुझिये विधिर विधान
सुख लागि’ कैलुँ प्रीत, हैल दुःख विपरीत, ।
एबे याय, ना रहे पराण ॥20॥
cc-madhya-2.20.translation: [Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī continued lamenting about the consequences of loving Kṛṣṇa:] "My dear friend, I do not understand the regulative principles given by the Creator. I loved Kṛṣṇa for happiness, but the result was just the opposite. I am now in an ocean of distress. It must be that now I am going to die, for My vital force no longer remains. This is My state of mind.

lines: kuṭila premā ageyāna, nāhi jāne sthānāsthāna,
krūra śaṭhera guṇa-ḍore, hāte-gale bāndhi' more,
devanagari: कुटिल प्रेमा अगेयान, नाहि जाने स्थानास्थान ,
भाल - मन्द नारे विचारिते ।
क्रूर शठेर गुण - डोरे, हाते - गले बा न्धि’ मोरे,
राखियाछे, नारि’ उकाशिते ॥21॥
cc-madhya-2.21.translation: "By nature loving affairs are very crooked. They are not entered with sufficient knowledge, nor do they consider whether a place is suitable or not, nor do they look forward to the results. By the ropes of His good qualities, Kṛṣṇa, who is so unkind, has bound My neck and hands, and I am unable to get relief.

devanagari: ये मदन तनु - हीन, पर - द्रोहे परवीण ,
पाँच बाण सन्धे अनुक्षण ।
अबलार शरीरे, विन्धि’ कैल जरजरे ,
दुःख देय, ना लय जीवन ॥22॥
cc-madhya-2.22.translation: "In My loving affairs there is a person named Madana. His qualities are thus: Personally He possesses no gross body, yet He is very expert in giving pains to others. He has five arrows, and fixing them on His bow, He shoots them into the bodies of innocent women. Thus these women become invalids. It would be better if He took My life without hesitation, but He does not do so. He simply gives Me pain.

lines: anyera ye duḥkha mane, anye tāhā nāhi jāne,
anya jana kāhāṅ likhi, nā jānaye prāṇa-sakhī,
devanagari: अन्येर ये दुःख मने, अन्ये ताहा नाहि जाने
सत्य एइ शास्त्रेर विचारे ।
अन्य जन काहाँ लिखि, ना जानये प्राण - सखी
याते कहे धैर्य धरिबारे ॥23॥
cc-madhya-2.23.translation: "In the scriptures it is said that one person can never know the unhappiness in the mind of another. Therefore what can I say of My dear friends, Lalitā and the others? Nor can they understand the unhappiness within Me. They simply try to console Me repeatedly, saying, 'Dear friend, be patient.'

lines: jīvera jīvana cañcala, yena padma-patrera jala,
devanagari: ‘कृष्ण - कृपा - पारावार, कभु करिबेन अङीकार’
सखि, तोर ए व्यर्थ वचन ।
जीवेर जीवन चञ्चल, येन पद्म - पत्रेर जल ,
तत दिन जीवे कोन्जन ॥24॥
cc-madhya-2.24.translation: "I say, 'My dear friends, you are asking Me to be patient, saying that Kṛṣṇa is an ocean of mercy and that some time in the future He will accept Me. However, I must say that this will not console Me. A living entity's life is very flickering. It is like water on the leaf of a lotus flower. Who will live long enough to expect Kṛṣṇa's mercy?

lines: śata vatsara paryanta, jīvera jīvana anta,
nārīra yauvana-dhana, yāre kṛṣṇa kare mana,
devanagari: शत वत्सर पर्यन्त, जीवेर जीवन अन्त
एइ वाक्य कह ना विचा रि’ ।
नारीर यौवन - धन, यारे कृष्ण करे मन
से यौवन - दिन दुइ - चारि ॥25॥
cc-madhya-2.25.translation: “ 'A human being does not live more than a hundred years. You should also consider that the youthfulness of a woman, which is the only attraction for Kṛṣṇa, remains for only a few days.

lines: kṛṣṇa aiche nija-guṇa, dekhāiyā hare mana,
devanagari: अग्नि यैछे निज - धाम, देखाइया अभिराम
पतङ्गीरे आकर्षिया मारे।
कृष्ण ऐछे निज - गुण, देखाइया हरे मन
पाछे दुःख - समुद्रेते डारे ॥26॥
cc-madhya-2.26.translation: “ 'If you say that Kṛṣṇa is an ocean of transcendental qualities and therefore must be merciful some day, I can only say that He is like fire, which attracts flies by its dazzling brightness and kills them. Such are the qualities of Kṛṣṇa. By showing us His transcendental qualities, He attracts our minds, and then later, by separating from us, He drowns us in an ocean of unhappiness.' "

devanagari: एतेक विलाप क रि’, विषादे श्री - गौरहरि
उघाड़िया दुःखेर कपाट ।
भावेर तरङ्ग - बले, नाना - रूपे मन चले
आर एक श्लोक कैल पाठ ॥27॥
cc-madhya-2.27.translation: In this way, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lamented in a great ocean of sadness, and thus He opened the doors of His unhappiness. Forced by the waves of ecstasy, His mind wandered over transcendental mellows, and in this way He would read another verse [as follows].

devanagari: श्री - कृष्ण - रूपादि - निषेवणं विना व्यर्थानि मेऽहान्यखिलेन्द्रियाण्यलम् ।
पाषाण - शुष्केन्धन - भारकाण्यहो बिभर्मि वा तानि कथं हत - त्रपः ॥28॥
cc-madhya-2.28.translation: “ 'My dear friends, unless I serve the transcendental form, qualities and pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, all My days and all My senses will become entirely useless. Now I am uselessly bearing the burden of My senses, which are like stone blocks and dried wood. I do not know how long I will be able to continue without shame.'

lines: ye nā dekhe se cāṅda vadana
se nayane kibā kāja, paḍuka tāra muṇḍe vāja,
devanagari: वंशी - गानामृत - धाम, लावण्यामृत - जन्म - स्थान
ये ना देखे से चाँद वदन ।
से नयने किबा काज, पडुक तार मुण्डे वाज
से नयन रहे कि कारण ॥29॥
cc-madhya-2.29.translation: "Of what use are eyes if one does not see the face of Kṛṣṇa, which resembles the moon and is the birthplace of all beauty and the reservoir of the nectarean songs of His flute? Oh, let a thunderbolt strike his head! Why does he keep such eyes?

lines: śeṣa ye rahila prabhura dvādaśa vatsara
devanagari: शेष ये रहिल प्रभुर द्वादश वत्सर ।
कृष्णेर वियोग - स्फूर्ति हय निरन्तर ॥3॥
cc-madhya-2.3.translation: During His last twelve years, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu always manifested all the symptoms of ecstasy in separation from Kṛṣṇa.

lines: sakhī he, śuna, mora hata vidhi-bala
devanagari: सखि हे, शुन, मोर हत विधि - बल
मोर वपु - चित्त - मन, सकल इन्द्रिय - गण, ।
कृष्ण विनु सकल विफल ॥30॥
cc-madhya-2.30.translation: "My dear friends, please hear Me. I have lost all providential strength. Without Kṛṣṇa, My body, consciousness and mind, as well as all My senses, are useless.

devanagari: कृष्णेर मधुर वाणी, अमृतेर तरङ्गिणी
तार प्रवेश नाहि ये श्रवणे ।
काणाकड़ि - छिद्र सम, जानिह से श्रवण
तार जन्म हैल अकारणे ॥31॥
cc-madhya-2.31.translation: "Topics about Kṛṣṇa are like waves of nectar. If such nectar does not enter one's ear, the ear is no better than the hole of a damaged conchshell. Such an ear is created for no purpose.

lines: tāra svāda ye nā jāne, janmiyā nā maila kene,
devanagari: कृष्णेर अधरामृत, कृष्ण - गुण - चरित
सुधा - सार - स्वाद - विनिन्दन ।
तार स्वाद ये ना जाने, जन्मिया ना मैल केने
से रसना भेक जिह्वा सम ॥32॥
cc-madhya-2.32.translation: "The nectar from the lips of Lord Kṛṣṇa and His transcendental qualities and characteristics surpass the taste of the essence of all nectar, and there is no fault in tasting such nectar. If one does not taste it, he should die immediately after birth, and his tongue is to be considered no better than the tongue of a frog.

lines: hena kṛṣṇa-aṅga-gandha, yāra nāhi se sambandha,
devanagari: मृग - मद नीलोत्पल, मिलने ये परिमल
येइ हरे तार गर्व - मान ।
हेन कृष्ण - अङ्ग - गन्ध, यार नाहि से सम्बन्ध
सेइ नासा भस्त्रार समान ॥33॥
cc-madhya-2.33.translation: "One's nostrils are no better than the bellows of a blacksmith if he has not smelled the fragrance of Kṛṣṇa's body, which is like the aroma of musk combined with that of the bluish lotus flower. Indeed, such combinations are actually defeated by the aroma of Kṛṣṇa's body.

lines: tāra sparśa nāhi yāra, se yāuk chārakhāra,
devanagari: कृष्ण - कर - पद - तल, कोटि - चन्द्र - सुशीतल
तार स्पर्श येन स्पर्श - मणि ।
तार स्पर्श नाहि यार, से याउक्छारखार
सेइ वपु लौह - सम जानि ॥34॥
cc-madhya-2.34.translation: "The palms of Kṛṣṇa's hands and the soles of His feet are so cool and pleasant that they can be compared only to the light of millions of moons. One who has touched such hands and feet has indeed tasted the effects of touchstone. If one has not touched them, his life is spoiled, and his body is like iron."

devanagari: करि’ एत विलपन, प्रभु शची - नन्दन
उघाड़िया हृदयेर शोक ।
दैन्य - निर्वेद - विषादे, हृदयेर अवसादे
पुनरपि पड़े एक श्लोक ॥35॥
cc-madhya-2.35.translation: Lamenting in this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu opened the doors of grief within His heart. Morose, humble and disappointed, He read a verse again and again with a despondent heart.

lines: yadā yāto daivān madhu-ripur asau locana-pathaṁ
punar yasminn eṣa kṣaṇam api dṛśor eti padavīṁ
devanagari: यदा यातो दैवान्मधु - रिपुरसौ लोचन - पथं तदास्माकं चेतो मदन - हतकेनाहृतमभूत् ।
पुनर्यस्मिन्नेष क्षणमपि दृशोरेति पदवीं विधास्यामस्तस्मिन्नखिल - घटिका रत्न - खचिताः ॥36॥
cc-madhya-2.36.translation: “ 'If by chance the transcendental form of Kṛṣṇa comes before My path of vision, My heart, injured from being beaten, will be stolen away by Cupid, happiness personified. Because I could not see the beautiful form of Kṛṣṇa to My heart's content, when I again see His form I shall decorate the phases of time with many jewels.' "

lines: ye kāle vā svapane, dekhinu vaṁśī-vadane,
devanagari: ये काले वा स्वपने, देखिनु वंशी - वदने
सेइ काले आइला दुइ वैरि ।
‘आनन्द’ आर ‘मदन’, हरि’ निल मोर मन
देखिते ना पाइनु नेत्र भरि’ ॥37॥
cc-madhya-2.37.translation: "Whenever I had the chance to see Lord Kṛṣṇa's face and His flute, even in a dream, two enemies would appear before Me. They were pleasure and Cupid, and since they took away My mind, I was not able to see the face of Kṛṣṇa to the full satisfaction of My eyes.

lines: punaḥ yadi kona kṣaṇa, kayāya kṛṣṇa daraśana
devanagari: पुनः यदि कोन क्षण, कराय कृष्ण दरशन
तबे सेइ घटी - क्षण - पल ।
दिया माल्य - चन्दन, नाना रन - आभरण,
अलङ्कृत करिमु सकल ॥38॥
cc-madhya-2.38.translation: "If by chance such a moment comes when I can once again see Kṛṣṇa, then I shall worship those seconds, moments and hours with flower garlands and pulp of sandalwood and decorate them with all kinds of jewels and ornaments."

lines: kṣaṇe bāhya haila mana, āge dekhe dui jana,
svapna-prāya ki dekhinu, kibā āmi pralāpinu,
devanagari: क्षणे बाह्य हैल मन, आगे देखे दुइ जन,
ताँरे पुछे, - आमि ना चैतन्य ? ।
स्वप्न - प्राय कि देखिनु, किबा आमि प्रलापिनु,
तोमरा किछु शुनियाछ दैन्य? ॥39॥
cc-madhya-2.39.translation: In an instant, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu regained external consciousness and saw two persons before Him. Questioning them, He asked, "Am I conscious? What dreams have I been seeing? What craziness have I spoken? Have you heard some expressions of humility?''

devanagari: श्री - राधिकार चेष्टा येन उद्धव - दर्शने ।
एइ - मत दशा प्रभुर हय रात्रि - दिने ॥4॥
cc-madhya-2.4.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's state of mind, day and night, was practically identical to Rādhārāṇī's state of mind when Uddhava came to Vṛndāvana to see the gopīs.

devanagari: शुन मोर प्राणेर बान्धव
नाहि कृष्ण - प्रेम - धन, दरिद्र मोर जीवन, ।
देहेन्द्रिय वृथा मोर सब ॥40॥
cc-madhya-2.40.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "My dear friends, you are all My life and soul; therefore I tell you that I possess no wealth of love for Kṛṣṇa. Consequently My life is poverty-stricken. My limbs and senses are useless."

lines: śuni karaha vicāra, haya, naya—kaha sāra,
devanagari: पुनः कहे, - हाय हाय, शुन, स्वरूप - रामराय ,
एइ मोर हृदय - निश्चय ।
शुनि करह विचार, हय, नय - कह सार ,
एत ब लि’ श्लोक उच्चारय ॥41॥
cc-madhya-2.41.translation: Again He addressed both Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāya Rāmānanda, speaking despondently, "Alas! My friends, you can now know the certainty within My heart, and after knowing My heart you should judge whether I am correct or not. You can speak of this properly." Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then began to chant another verse.

lines: ka-i-avarahi-aṁ pemmaṁ ṇa hi hoi māṇuse loe
ja-i hoi kassa virahe hontammi ko jīa-i
devanagari: क - इ - अवरहि - अं पेम्मं ण हि होइ माणुसे लोए ।
ज - इ होइ कस्स विरहे होन्तम्मि को जीअ - इ ॥42॥
cc-madhya-2.42.translation: “ 'Love of Godhead, devoid of cheating propensities, is not possible within this material world. If there is such a love, there cannot be separation, for if there is separation, how can one live?'

lines: yadi haya tāra yoga, nā haya tabe viyoga,
devanagari: अकैतव कृष्ण - प्रेम, येन जाम्बूनद - हेम
सेइ प्रेमा नृलोके ना हय ।
यदि हय तार योग, ना हय तबे वियोग
वियोग हैले केह ना जीयय ॥43॥
cc-madhya-2.43.translation: "Pure love for Kṛṣṇa, just like gold from the Jāmbū River, does not exist in human society. If it existed, there could not be separation. If separation were there, one could not live."

lines: eta kahi' śacī-suta, śloka paḍe adbhuta,
devanagari: एत क हि’ शची - सुत, श्लोक पड़े अद्भुत
शुने दुँहे एक - मन ह ञा ।
आपन - हृदय - काज, कहिते वासिये लाज
तबु कहि लाज - बीज खा ञा ॥44॥
cc-madhya-2.44.translation: Thus speaking, the son of Śrīmatī Śacīmātā recited another wonderful verse, and Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara heard this verse with rapt attention. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "I feel shameful to disclose the activities of My heart. Nonetheless, I shall be done with all formalities and speak from the heart. Please hear."

devanagari: न प्रेम - गन्धोऽस्ति दरापि मे हरौ क्रन्दामि सौभाग्य - भरं प्रकाशितुम् ।
वंशी - विलास्यानन - लोकनं विना बिभर्मि यत्प्राण - पतङ्गकान्वृथा ॥45॥
cc-madhya-2.45.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, " 'My dear friends, I have not the slightest tinge of love of Godhead within My heart. When you see Me crying in separation, I am just falsely exhibiting a demonstration of My great fortune. Indeed, not seeing the beautiful face of Kṛṣṇa playing His flute, I continue to live My life like an insect, without purpose.'

lines: tabe ye kari krandana, sva-saubhāgya prakhyāpana,
devanagari: दूरे शुद्ध - प्रेम - गन्ध, कपट प्रेमेर बन्ध ,
सेह मोर नाहि कृष्ण - पाय ।
तबे ये करि क्रन्दन, स्व - सौभाग्य प्रख्यापन ,
करि, इहा जानिह निश्चय ॥46॥
cc-madhya-2.46.translation: "Actually, My love for Kṛṣṇa is far, far away. Whatever I do is actually false. When you see Me cry, I am simply exhibiting My great fortune. Please try to understand this beyond a doubt.

lines: yāte vaṁśī-dhvani-sukha, nā dekhi' se cāṅda mukha,
nija-dehe kari prīti, kevala kāmera rīti,
devanagari: याते वंशी - ध्वनि - सुख, ना देखि’ से चाँद मुख
यद्यपि नाहिक ‘आलम्ब न’ ।
निज - देहे करि प्रीति, केवल कामेर रीति
प्राण - कीटेर करिये धारण ॥47॥
cc-madhya-2.47.translation: "Even though I do not see the moonlike face of Kṛṣṇa playing on His flute and although there is no possibility of My meeting Him, still I take care of My own body. That is the way of lust. In this way, I maintain My flylike life.

lines: nirmala se anurāge, nā lukāya anya dāge,
devanagari: कृष्ण - प्रेमा सुनिर्मल, येन शुद्ध - गङ्गा - जल
सेइ प्रेमा - अमृतेर सिन्धु ।
निर्मल से अनुरागे, ना लुकाय अन्य दागे
शुक्ल - वस्त्रे यैछे मसी - बिन्दु ॥48॥
cc-madhya-2.48.translation: "Love for Lord Kṛṣṇa is very pure, just like the waters of the Ganges. That love is an ocean of nectar. That pure attachment to Kṛṣṇa does not conceal any spot, which would appear just like a spot of ink on a white cloth.

lines: kahibāra yogya naya, tathāpi bāule kaya,
devanagari: शुद्ध - प्रेम - सुख - सिन्धु, पाइ तार एक बिन्दु
सेइ बिन्दु जगत्डुबाय ।
कहिबार योग्य नय, तथापि बाउले कय
कहिले वा केला पातियाय ॥49॥
cc-madhya-2.49.translation: "Unalloyed love of Kṛṣṇa is like the ocean of happiness. If someone gets one drop of it, the whole world can drown in that drop. It is not befitting to express such love of Godhead, yet a madman must speak. However, even though he speaks, no one believes him."

devanagari: निरन्तर हय प्रभुर विरह - उन्माद ।
भ्रम - मय चेष्टा सदा, प्रलाप - मय वाद ॥5॥
cc-madhya-2.5.translation: The Lord constantly exhibited a state of mind reflecting the madness of separation. All His activities were based on forgetfulness, and His talks were always based on madness.

devanagari: एइ मत दिने दिने, स्वरूप - रामानन्द - सने
निज - भाव करेन विदित ।
बाह्ये विष - ज्वाला हय, भितरे आनन्द - मय
कृष्ण - प्रेमार अद्भुत चरित ॥50॥
cc-madhya-2.50.translation: In this way, Lord Caitanya used to revel in ecstasy day after day and exhibit these ecstasies before Svarūpa and Rāmānanda Rāya. Externally there appeared severe tribulation, as if He were suffering from poisonous effects, but internally He was experiencing bliss. This is characteristic of transcendental love of Kṛṣṇa.

lines: sei premā yāṅra mane, tāra vikrama sei jāne,
devanagari: एइ प्रेमा - आस्वादन, तप्त - इक्षु - चर्वण ,
मुख ज्वले, ना याय त्यजन ।
सेइ प्रेमा याँर मने, तार विक्रम सेइ जाने ,
विषामृते एकत्र मिलन ॥51॥
cc-madhya-2.51.translation: If one tastes such love of Godhead, he can compare it to hot sugarcane. When one chews hot sugarcane, his mouth burns, yet he cannot give it up. Similarly, if one has but a little love of Godhead, he can perceive its powerful effects. It can only be compared to poison and nectar mixed together.

lines: jñāyante sphuṭam asya vakra-madhurās tenaiva vikrāntayaḥ
devanagari: पीड़ाभिर्नव - काल - कूट - कटुता - गर्वस्य निर्वासनो निस्यन्देन मुदां सुधा - मधुरिमाहङ्कार - सङ्कोचनः ।
प्रेमा सुन्दरि नन्द - नन्दन - परो जागर्ति यस्यान्तरे ज्ञायन्ते स्फुटमस्य वक़ - मधुरास्तेनैव विक्रान्तयः ॥52॥
cc-madhya-2.52.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke, " 'My dear beautiful friend, if one develops love of Godhead, love of Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja, all the bitter and sweet influences of this love will manifest in one's heart. Such love of Godhead acts in two ways. The poisonous effects of love of Godhead defeat the severe and fresh poison of the serpent. Yet there is simultaneously transcendental bliss, which pours down and defeats the pride of nectar and diminishes its value. In other words, love of Kṛṣṇa is so powerful that it simultaneously defeats the poisonous effects of a snake, as well as the happiness derived from pouring nectar on one's head. It is perceived as doubly effective, simultaneously poisonous and nectarean.' "

devanagari: ये काले देखे जगन्नाथ - श्रीराम - सुभद्रा - साथ, तबे जाने - आइलाम कुरुक्षेत्र ।
सफल हैल जीवन, देखिलुँ पद्म - लोचन, जुड़ाइल तनु - मन - नेत्र ॥53॥
cc-madhya-2.53.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would see Jagannātha along with Balarāma and Subhadrā, He would immediately think that He had reached Kurukṣetra, where all of them had come. He would think that His life was successful because He had seen the lotus-eyed one, whom, if seen, pacifies the body, mind and eyes.

lines: garuḍa-stambhera tale, āche eka nimna khāle,
devanagari: गरुड़ेर सन्निधाने, रहि’ करे दरशने
से आनन्देर कि कहिब ब’ले ।
गरुड़ - स्तम्भेर तले, आछे एक निम्न खाले
से खाल भरिल अश्रु - जले ॥54॥
cc-madhya-2.54.translation: Staying near the Garuḍa-stambha, the Lord would look upon Lord Jagannātha. What can be said about the strength of that love? On the ground beneath the column of the Garuḍa-stambha was a deep ditch, and that ditch was filled with the water of His tears.

lines: tāhāṅ haite ghare āsi', māṭīra upare vasi',
devanagari: ताहाँ हैते घरे आ सि’, माटीर उपरे व सि’
नखे करे पृथिवी लिखन ।
हा - हा काहाँ वृन्दावन, काहाँ गोपेन्द्र - नन्दन
काहाँ सेइ वंशी - वदन ॥55॥
cc-madhya-2.55.translation: When coming from the Jagannātha temple to return to His house, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to sit on the ground and mark it with His nails. At such times He would be greatly morose and would cry, "Alas, where is Vṛndāvana? Where is Kṛṣṇa, the son of the King of the cowherd men? Where is that person who plays the flute?"

lines: kāhāṅ se tri-bhaṅga-ṭhāma, kāhāṅ sei veṇu-gāna,
devanagari: काहाँ से त्रि - भङ्ग - ठाम, काहाँ सेइ वेणु - गान
काहाँ सेइ यमुना - पुलिन ।
काहाँ से रास - विलास, काहाँ नृत्य - गीत - हास
काहाँ प्रभु मदन मोहन ॥56॥
cc-madhya-2.56.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to lament by saying, "Where is Śrī Kṛṣṇa, whose form is curved in three places? Where is the sweet song of His flute, and where is the bank of the Yamunā? Where is the rāsa dance? Where is that dancing, singing, and laughing? Where is My Lord, Madana-mohana, the enchanter of Cupid?"

lines: uṭhila nānā bhāvāvega, mane haila udvega,
devanagari: उठिल नाना भावावेग, मने हैल उद्वेग
क्षण - मात्र नारे गोङाइते ।
प्रबल विरहानले, धैर्य हैल टलमले
नाना श्लोक लागिला पड़िते ॥57॥
cc-madhya-2.57.translation: In this way various ecstatic emotions evolved, and the Lord's mind filled with anxiety. He could not escape even for a moment. In this way, because of fierce feelings of separation, His patience began to totter, and He began to recite various verses.

lines: hā hanta hā hanta kathaṁ nayāmi
devanagari: अमून्यधन्यानि दिनान्तराणि हरे त्वदालोकनमन्तरेण ।
अनाथ - बन्धो करुणैक - सिन्धो हा हन्त हा हन्त कथं नयामि ॥58॥
cc-madhya-2.58.translation: “ 'O My Lord, O Supreme Personality of Godhead, O friend of the helpless! You are the only ocean of mercy! Because I have not met You, My inauspicious days and nights have become unbearable. I do not know how I shall pass the time.'

devanagari: तोमार दर्शन - विने, अधन्य ए रात्रि - दिने
एइ काल ना याय काटन ।
तुमि अनाथेर बन्धु, अपार करुणा - सिन्धु
कृपा करि’ देह दरशन ॥59॥
cc-madhya-2.59.translation: "All these inauspicious days and nights are not passing, for I have not met You. It is difficult to know how to pass all this time. But You are the friend of the helpless and an ocean of mercy. Kindly give Me Your audience, for I am in a precarious position."

lines: kṣaṇe aṅga kṣīṇa haya, kṣaṇe aṅga phule
devanagari: रोम - कूपे रक्तोद्गम, दन्त सब हाले ।
क्षणे अङ्ग क्षीण हय, क्षणे अङ्ग फुले ॥6॥
cc-madhya-2.6.translation: Blood flowed from all the pores of His body, and all His teeth were loosened. At one moment His whole body became slender, and at another moment His whole body became fat.

lines: adarśane poḍe mana, kemane pāba daraśana,
devanagari: उठिल भाव - चापल, मन हइल चञ्चल
भावेर गति बुझन ना याय ।
अदर्शने पोड़े मन, केमने पाब दरशन
कृष्ण - ठाञि पुछेन उपाय ॥60॥
cc-madhya-2.60.translation: In this way, the Lord's restlessness was awakened by ecstatic feelings, and His mind became agitated. No one could understand what course such ecstasy would take. Not being able to meet the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, Lord Caitanya's mind burned. He began to ask Kṛṣṇa of the means by which He could reach Him.

lines: mac-cāpalaṁ ca tava vā mama vādhigamyam
devanagari: त्वच्छैशवं त्रि - भुवनाद्भुतमित्यवेहि मच्चापलं च तव वा मम वाधिगम्यम् ।
तत्किं करोमि विरलं मुरली - विलासि मुग्धं मुखाम्बुजमुदीक्षितुमीक्षणाभ्याम् ॥61॥
cc-madhya-2.61.translation: “ 'O Kṛṣṇa, O flute-player, the sweetness of Your early age is wonderful within these three worlds. You know My unsteadiness, and I know Yours. No one else knows about this. I want to see Your beautiful attractive face somewhere in a solitary place, but how can this be accomplished?'

lines: kāhāṅ karoṅ kāhāṅ yāṅ, kāhāṅ gele tomā pāṅ,
devanagari: तोमार माधुरी - बल, ताते मोर चापल ,
एइ दुइ, तुमि आमि जानि ।
काहाँ करों काहाँ याँ, काहाँ गेले तोमा पाँ ,
ताहा मोरे कह त’ आपनि ॥62॥
cc-madhya-2.62.translation: "My dear Kṛṣṇa, only You and I know the strength of Your beautiful features and, because of them, My unsteadiness. Now, this is My position; I do not know what to do or where to go. Where can I find You? I am asking You to give directions."

lines: autsukya, cāpalya, dainya, roṣāmarṣa ādi sainya,
devanagari: नाना - भावेर प्राबल्य, हैल सन्धि - शाबल्य ,
भावे - भावे हैल महा - रण ।
औत्सुक्य, चापल्य, दैन्य, रोषामर्ष आदि सैन्य ,
प्रेमोन्माद - सबार कारण ॥63॥
cc-madhya-2.63.translation: Because of the various kinds of ecstasy, contradictory states of mind occurred, and this resulted in a great fight between different types of ecstasy. Anxiety, impotence, humility, anger and impatience were all like soldiers fighting, and the madness of love of Godhead was the cause.

devanagari: मत्त - गज भाव - गण, प्रभुर देह - इक्षु - वन
गज - युद्धे वनेर दलन ।
प्रभुर हैल दिव्योन्माद, तनु - मनेर अवसाद
भावावेशे करे सम्बोधन ॥64॥
cc-madhya-2.64.translation: The body of the Lord was just like a field of sugarcane into which the mad elephants of ecstasy entered. There was a fight amongst the elephants, and in the process the entire field of sugarcane was destroyed. Thus transcendental madness was awakened in the body of the Lord, and He experienced despondency in mind and body. In this ecstatic condition, He began to speak as follows.

lines: he deva he dayita he bhuvanaika-bandho
he kṛṣṇa he capala he karuṇaika-sindho
he nātha he ramaṇa he nayanābhirāma
hā hā kadā nu bhavitāsi padaṁ dṛśor me
devanagari: हे देव हे दयित हे भुवनैक - बन्धो हे कृष्ण हे चपल हे करुणैक - सिन्धो ।
हे नाथ हे रमण हे नयनाभिराम हा हा कदा नु भवितासि पदं दृशोर्मे ॥65॥
cc-madhya-2.65.translation: “ 'O My Lord! O dearest one! O only friend of the universe! O Kṛṣṇa, O restless one, O ocean of mercy! O My Lord, O My enjoyer, O beloved to My eyes! Alas, when will You again be visible to Me?' "

devanagari: उन्मादेर लक्षण, कराय कृष्ण - स्फुरण,
भावावेशे उठे प्रणय मान ।
सोल्लुण्ठ - वचन - रीति, मान, गर्व, व्याज - स्तुति,
कभु निन्दा, कभु वा सम्मान ॥66॥
cc-madhya-2.66.translation: The symptoms of madness served as an impetus for remembering Kṛṣṇa. The mood of ecstasy awoke love, disdain, defamation by words, pride, honor and indirect prayer. Thus Śrī Kṛṣṇa was sometimes blasphemed and sometimes honored.

lines: tumi mora dayita, mote vaise tomāra cita,
devanagari: तुमि देव क्रीड़ा - रत, भुवनेर नारी यत
ताहे कर अभीष्ट क्रीड़न ।
तुमि मोर दयित, मोते वैसे तोमार चित
मोर भाग्ये कैले आगमन ॥67॥
cc-madhya-2.67.translation: "My dear Lord, You are engaged in Your pastimes, and You utilize all the women in the universe according to Your desire. You are so kind to Me. Please divert Your attention to Me, for by fortune You have appeared before Me.

devanagari: भुवनेर नारी - गण, सबा’ कर आकर्षण
ताहाँ कर सब समाधान ।
तुमि कृष्ण - चित्त - हर, ऐछे कोन पामर
तोमारे वा केबा करे मान ॥68॥
cc-madhya-2.68.translation: "My dear Lord, You attract all the women of the universe, and You make adjustments for all of them when they appear. You are Lord Kṛṣṇa, and You can enchant everyone, but on the whole, You are nothing but a debauchee. Who can honor You?

lines: tomāra capala-mati, ekatra nā haya sthiti,
devanagari: तोमार चपल - मति, एकत्र ना हय स्थिति
ता’ ते तोमार नाहि किछु दोष ।
तुमि त’ करुणा - सिन्धु, आमार पराण - बन्धु
तोमाय नाहि मोर कभु रोष ॥69॥
cc-madhya-2.69.translation: "My dear Kṛṣṇa, Your mind is always restless. You cannot remain in one place, but You are not at fault for this. You are actually the ocean of mercy, the friend of My heart. Therefore I have no reason to be angry with You.

lines: bhitte mukha-śira ghaṣe, kṣata haya saba
devanagari: गम्भीरा - भितरे रात्रे नाहि निद्रा - लव ।
भित्ते मुख - शिर घषे, क्षत हय सब ॥7॥
cc-madhya-2.7.translation: The small room beyond the corridor is called the Gambhīrā. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to stay in that room, but He did not sleep for a moment. All night He used to grind His mouth and head on the ground, and His face sustained injuries all over.

lines: tumi āmāra ramaṇa, sukha dite āgamana,
devanagari: तुमि नाथ - व्रज - प्राण, व्रजेर कर परित्राण
बहु कार्ये नाहि अवकाश ।
तुमि आमार रमण, सुख दिते आगमन
ए तोमार वैदग्ध्य - विलास ॥70॥
cc-madhya-2.70.translation: "My dear Lord, You are the master and the life and soul of Vṛndāvana. Kindly arrange for the deliverance of Vṛndāvana. We have no leisure hours away from our many activities. Actually, You are My enjoyer. You have appeared just to give Me happiness, and this is one of Your expert activities.

lines: mora vākya nindā māni, kṛṣṇa chāḍi' gelā jāni,
devanagari: मोर वाक्य निन्दा मानि, कृष्ण छाड़ि’ गेला जानि ,
शुन, मोर ए स्तुति - वचन ।
नयनेर अभिराम, तुमि मोर धन - प्राण,
हा - हा पुनः देह दरशन ॥71॥
cc-madhya-2.71.translation: "Taking My words as defamation, Lord Kṛṣṇa has left Me. I know that He is gone, but kindly hear My prayers in praise. You are the satisfaction of My eyes. You are My wealth and My life. Alas, please give Me your audience once again."

lines: stambha, kampa, prasveda, vaivarṇya, aśru, svara-bheda,
hāse, kānde, nāce, gāya, uṭhi' iti uti dhāya,
devanagari: स्तम्भ, कम्प, प्रस्वेद, वैवर्ण्य, अश्रु, स्वर - भेद,
देह हैल पुलके व्यापित ।
हासे, कान्दे, नाचे, गाय, उठि’ इति उति धाय ,
क्षणे भूमे पड़िया मूर्च्छित ॥72॥
cc-madhya-2.72.translation: There were different transformations of the body of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu: being stunned, trembling, perspiring, fading away of color, weeping and choking. In this way His whole body was pervaded by transcendental joy. As a result, sometimes Caitanya Mahāprabhu would laugh, sometimes cry, sometimes dance and sometimes sing. Sometimes He would get up and run here and there, and sometimes fall on the ground and lose consciousness.

lines: mūrcchāya haila sākṣātkāra, uṭhi' kare huhuṅkāra,
kṛṣṇera mādhurī-guṇe, nānā bhrama haya mane,
devanagari: मूर्च्छाय हैल साक्षात्कार, उठि’ करे हुहुङ्कार
कहे - एइ आइला महाशय ।
कृष्णेर माधुरी - गुणे, नाना भ्रम हय मने
श्लोक प ड़ि’ करये निश्चय ॥73॥
cc-madhya-2.73.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was thus unconscious, He happened to meet the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Consequently He got up and immediately made a tumultuous sound, very loudly declaring, "Now Kṛṣṇa, the great personality, is present." In this way, because of Kṛṣṇa's sweet qualities, Caitanya Mahāprabhu made different types of mistakes in His mind. Thus by reading the following verse, He ascertained the presence of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: मारः स्वयं नु मधुर - द्युति - मण्डलं नु माधुर्यमेव नु मनो - नयनामृतं नु ।
वेणी - मृजो नु मम जीवित - वल्लभो नु कृष्णोऽयमभ्युदयते मम लोचनाय ॥74॥
cc-madhya-2.74.translation: In the attitude of Rādhārāṇī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu addressed the gopīs, " 'My dear friends, where is that Kṛṣṇa, Cupid personified, who has the effulgence of a kadamba flower, who is sweetness itself, the nectar of My eyes and mind, He who loosens the hair of the gopīs, who is the supreme source of transcendental bliss and My life and soul? Has He come before My eyes again?' "

lines: kibā ei sākṣāt kāma, dyuti-bimba mūrtimān,
devanagari: किबा एइ साक्षात्काम, द्युति - बिम्ब मूर्तिमान्
कि माधुर्य स्वयं मूर्तिमन्त ।
किबा मनो - नेत्रोत्सव, किबा प्राण - वल्लभ
सत्य कृष्ण आइला नेत्रानन्द ॥75॥
cc-madhya-2.75.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then would begin to talk like this: "Is Cupid personified present with the effulgence and reflection of the kadamba tree? Is He the same person, personified sweetness, who is the pleasure of My eyes and mind, who is My life and soul? Has Kṛṣṇa actually come before My eyes ?"

lines: nirveda, viṣāda, dainya, cāpalya, harṣa, dhairya, manyu,
devanagari: गुरु - नाना भाव - गण, शिष्य - प्रभुर तनु - मन,
नाना रीते सतत नाचाय ।
निर्वेद, विषाद, दैन्य, चापल्य, हर्ष, धैर्य, मन्यु,
एइ नृत्ये प्रभुर काल याय ॥76॥
cc-madhya-2.76.translation: As the spiritual master chastises the disciple and teaches him the art of devotional service, so all the ecstatic symptoms of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu-including despondency, moroseness, humility, restlessness, joy, endurance and anger-all instructed His body and mind. In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed His time.

devanagari: चण्डीदास, विद्यापति, रायेर नाटक - गीति,
कर्णामृत, श्री - गीत - गोविन्द ।
स्वरूप - रामानन्द - सने, महाप्रभु रात्रि - दिने,
गाय, शुने परम आनन्द ॥77॥
cc-madhya-2.77.translation: He also passed His time reading the books and singing the songs of Caṇḍīdāsa and Vidyāpati, and listening to quotations from the Jagannātha-vallabha-nāṭaka, Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta and Gīta-govinda. Thus in the association of Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāya Rāmānanda, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed His days and nights chanting and hearing with great pleasure.

devanagari: पुरीर वात्सल्य मुख्य, रामानन्देर शुद्ध - सख्य ,
गोविन्दाद्येर शुद्ध - दास्य - रस ।
गदाधर, जगदानन्द, स्वरूपेर मुख्य रसानन्द,
एइ चारि भावे प्रभु वश ॥78॥
cc-madhya-2.78.translation: Among His associates, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu enjoyed paternal loving affection with Paramānanda Purī, friendly affection with Rāmānanda Rāya, unalloyed service from Govinda and others, and humors of conjugal love with Gadādhara, Jagadānanda and Svarūpa Dāmodara. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu enjoyed all these four mellows, and thus He remained obliged to His devotees.

devanagari: लीला शुक - मर्त्य - जन, ताँर हय भावोद्गम
ईश्वरे से - कि इहा विस्मय ।
ताहे मुख्य - रसाश्रय, हइयाछेन महाशय
ताते हय सर्व - भावोदय ॥79॥
cc-madhya-2.79.translation: Līlāśuka [Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura] was an ordinary human being, yet he developed many ecstatic symptoms in his body. What, then, is so astonishing about these symptoms' being manifest in the body of the Supreme Personality of Godhead? In the ecstatic mood of conjugal love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was on the highest platform; therefore, all the exuberant ecstasies were naturally visible in His body.

lines: tina dvāre kapāṭa, prabhu yāyena bāhire
devanagari: तिन द्वारे कपाट, प्रभु यायेन बाहिरे ।
कभु सिंह - द्वारे पड़े, कभु सिन्धु - नीरे ॥8॥
cc-madhya-2.8.translation: Although the three doors of the house were always closed, the Lord would nonetheless go out and sometimes would be found at Jagannātha Temple, before the gate known as Siṁha-dvāra. And sometimes the Lord would fall flat into the sea.

devanagari: पूर्वे व्रज - विलासे, येइ तिन अभिलाषे
यत्नेह आस्वाद ना हैल ।
श्री - राधार भाव - सार, आपने क रि’ अङ्गीकार
सेइ तिन वस्तु आस्वादिल ॥80॥
cc-madhya-2.80.translation: During His previous pastimes in Vṛndāvana, Lord Kṛṣṇa desired to enjoy the three different types of ecstasy, but despite great endeavor, He could not taste them. Such ecstasies are the monopoly of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. Therefore, in order to taste them, Śrī Kṛṣṇa accepted the position of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī in the form of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: nāhi jāne sthānāsthāna, yāre tāre kaila dāna,
devanagari: आपने क रि’ आस्वादने, शिखाइल भक्त - गणे
प्रेम - चिन्तामणिर प्रभु धनी ।
नाहि जाने स्थानास्थान, यारे तारे कैल दान
महाप्रभु - दाता - शिरोमणि ॥81॥
cc-madhya-2.81.translation: By personally tasting the mellows of love of Godhead, Caitanya Mahāprabhu taught His direct disciples the process. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the most munificent incarnation of the touchstone of love of God. He does not consider whether one is a proper or improper recipient, but gives His treasure to anyone and everyone. Thus He is the most munificent.

lines: ei gupta bhāva-sindhu, brahmā nā pāya eka bindu,
aiche dayālu avatāra, aiche dātā nāhi āra,
devanagari: एइ गुप्त भाव - सिन्धु, ब्रह्मा ना पाय एक बिन्दु
हेन धन विलाइल संसारे ।
ऐछे दयालु अवतार, ऐछे दाता नाहि आर
गुण केह नारे वर्णिबारे ॥82॥
cc-madhya-2.82.translation: No one, not even Lord Brahmā, can ascertain or even taste a drop of this confidential ocean of ecstasy, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, out of His causeless mercy, has distributed this love of Godhead all over the world. Thus there cannot be any incarnation more munificent than Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. There is no greater donor. Who can describe His transcendental qualities?

lines: kahibāra kathā nahe, kahile keha nā bujhaye,
sei se bujhite pāre, caitanyera kṛpā yāṅre,
devanagari: कहिबार कथा नहे, कहिले केह ना बुझये
ऐछे चित्र चैतन्येर रङ्ग ।
सेइ से बुझिते पारे, चैतन्येर कृपा याँरे
हय ताँर दासानुदास - सङ्ग ॥83॥
cc-madhya-2.83.translation: Such topics are not to be discussed freely because if they are, no one will understand them. Such are the wonderful pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Unto one who is able to understand, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has shown mercy by giving him the association of the servant of His own servant.

lines: tāhāṅ kichu ye śuniluṅ, tāhā ihāṅ vistāriluṅ,
devanagari: चैतन्य - लीला - रत्न - सार, स्वरूपेर भाण्डार
तेंहो थुइला रघुनाथेर कण्ठे ।
ताहाँ किछु ये शुनिलुँ, ताहा इहाँ विस्तारि लुँ
भक्त - गणे दि लुँ एइ भेटे ॥84॥
cc-madhya-2.84.translation: The pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are the topmost of jewels. They have been kept in the storehouse of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, who has explained them to Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, who has repeated them to me. Whatever little I have heard from Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī I have described in this book, which is presented to all devotees.

lines: yadi keha hena kaya, grantha kaila śloka-maya,
prabhura yei ācaraṇa, sei kari varṇana,
devanagari: यदि केह हेन कय, ग्रन्थ कैल श्लोक - मय
इतर जने नारिबे बुझिते ।
प्रभुर येइ आचरण, सेइ करि वर्णन
सर्व - चित्त नारि आराधिते ॥85॥
cc-madhya-2.85.translation: If one says that Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta is full of Sanskrit verses and therefore not understandable by a common man, I reply that what I have described are the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and that for me to satisfy everyone is not possible.

lines: nāhi kāhāṅ savirodha, nāhi kāhāṅ anurodha,
yadi haya rāgoddeśa, tāhāṅ haye āveśa,
devanagari: नाहि काहाँ सविरोध, नाहि काहाँ अनुरोध
सहज वस्तु करि विवरण ।
यदि हय रागोद्देश, ताहाँ हये आवेश
सहज वस्तु ना याय लिखन ॥86॥
cc-madhya-2.86.translation: In this Caitanya-caritāmṛta there is no contradictory conclusion, nor is anyone else's opinion accepted. I have written this book to describe the simple substance as I have heard it from superiors. If I become involved in someone's likes and dislikes, I cannot possibly write the simple truth.

lines: yebā nāhi bujhe keha, śunite śunite seha,
kṛṣṇe upajibe prīti, jānibe rasera rīti,
devanagari: येबा नाहि बुझे केह, शुनिते शुनिते सेह
कि अद्भुत चैतन्य - चरित ।
कृष्णे उपजिबे प्रीति, जानिबे रसेर रीति
शुनिलेइ बड़ हय हित ॥87॥
cc-madhya-2.87.translation: If one does not understand in the beginning but continues to hear again and again, the wonderful effects of Lord Caitanya's pastimes will bring love for Kṛṣṇa. Gradually one will come to understand the loving affairs between Kṛṣṇa and the gopīs and other associates of Vṛndāvana. Everyone is advised to continue to hear over and over again in order to greatly benefit.

lines: ihāṅ śloka dui cāri, tāra vyākhyā bhāṣā kari,
devanagari: भागवत - श्लोक - मय, टीका तार संस्कृत हय
तबु कैछे बुझे त्रि - भुवन ।
इहाँ श्लोक दुइ चारि, तार व्याख्या भाषा करि
केने ना बुझिबे सर्व - जन ॥88॥
cc-madhya-2.88.translation: In reply to those critics who say that Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta is full of Sanskrit verses, it can be said that Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam is also full of Sanskrit verses, as are the commentaries on Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam. Nonetheless, Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam can be understood by everyone, as well as by advanced devotees who study the Sanskrit commentaries. Why, then, will people not understand Caitanya-caritāmṛta? There are only a few Sanskrit verses, and these have been explained in the Bengali vernacular. What is the difficulty in understanding?

devanagari: शेष - लीलार सूत्र - गण, कैलुँ किछु विवरण
इहाँ विस्तारि ते चित्त हय ।
थाके यदि आयुः - शेष, विस्तारिब लीला - शेष
यदि महाप्रभुर कृपा हय ॥89॥
cc-madhya-2.89.translation: I have already given in codes all the facts and figures of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's last pastimes, and I have a desire to describe them elaborately. If I remain longer and am fortunate enough to receive the mercy of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, I shall try to describe them again more elaborately.

devanagari: चटक पर्वत देखि’ ‘गोवर्ध न’ भ्रमे ।
धाञा चले आर्तनाद करिया क्रन्दने ॥9॥
cc-madhya-2.9.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would also run very fast across the sand hills, mistaking them to be Govardhana. As He ran, He would wail and cry loudly.

lines: āmi vṛddha jarātura, likhite kāṅpaye kara,
nā dekhiye nayane, nā śuniye śravaṇe,
devanagari: आमि वृद्ध जरातुर, लिखिते काँपये कर
मने किछु स्मरण ना हय ।
ना देखिये नयने, ना शुनिये श्रवणे
तबु लिखि’ - ए बड़ विस्मय ॥90॥
cc-madhya-2.90.translation: I have now become too old and disturbed by invalidity. While writing, my hands tremble. I cannot remember anything, nor can I see or hear properly. Still I write, and this is a great wonder.

lines: ihā-madhye mari yabe, varṇite nā pāri tabe,
devanagari: एइ अन्त्य - लीला - सार, सूत्र - मध्ये विस्तार
करि’ किछु करिलुँ वर्णन ।
इहा - मध्ये मरि यबे, वर्णिते ना पारि तबे
एइ लीला भक्त - गण - धन ॥91॥
cc-madhya-2.91.translation: In this chapter I have to some extent described the essence of the pastimes of Lord Caitanya at the end. If I die in the meantime and cannot describe them in detail, at least the devotees will have this transcendental treasure.

lines: saṅkṣepe ei sūtra kaila, yei ihāṅ nā likhila,
yadi tata dina jiye, mahāprabhura kṛpā haye,
devanagari: सङ्क्षेपे एइ सूत्र कैल, येइ इहाँ ना लिखिल
आगे ताहा करिब विस्तार ।
यदि तत दिन जिये, महाप्रभुर कृपा हये
इच्छा भ रि’ करिब विचार ॥92॥
cc-madhya-2.92.translation: In this chapter I have briefly described the codes. Whatever I have not described I shall describe extensively in the future. If by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mercy I live for so many days that I can fulfill my desires, I will give full consideration to these pastimes.

lines: choṭa baḍa bhakta-gaṇa, vandoṅ sabāra śrī-caraṇa,
devanagari: छोट बड़े भक्त - गण, वन्दों सबार श्री - चरण
सबे मोरे करह सन्तोष ।
स्वरूप - गोसाञि र मत, रूप - रघुनाथ जाने व्रत
ताइ लि खि’ नाहि मोर दोष ॥93॥
cc-madhya-2.93.translation: I worship herewith the lotus feet of all kinds of devotees, both advanced and neophyte. I request all of them to be satisfied with me. I am faultless because I have written herein whatever I have understood from Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rūpa and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmīs. I have neither added to nor subtracted from their version.

devanagari: श्री - चैतन्य, नित्यानन्द, अद्वैतादि भक्त - वृन्द,
शिरे धरि सबार चरण ।
स्वरूप, रूप, सनातन, रघुनाथेर श्री - चरण,
धूलि करों मस्तके भूषण ॥94॥
cc-madhya-2.94.translation: According to the paramparā system, I wish to take the dust from the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Nityānanda Prabhu, Advaita Prabhu, and all the associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu like Svarūpa Dāmodara, Rūpa Gosvāmī, Sanātana Gosvāmī and Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī. I wish to take the dust of their lotus feet upon my head. In this way I wish to be blessed with their mercy.

devanagari: पाञा याँर आज्ञा - धन, व्रजेर वैष्णव - गण,
वन्दों ताँर मुख्य हरिदास ।
चैतन्य - विलास - सिन्धु - कल्लोलेर एक बिन्दु, तार कणा कहे कृष्णदास ॥95॥
cc-madhya-2.95.translation: Receiving orders from the above authorities and the Vaiṣṇavas of Vṛndāvana, especially from Haridāsa, the priest of Govindajī, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī, have tried to describe one small particle of one drop of one wave of the ocean of the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: न्यासं विधायोत्प्रणयोऽथ गौरो वृन्दावनं गन्तु - मना भ्रमाद् यः ।
राढ़े भ्रमन्शान्ति - पुरीमयित्वा ललास भक्तैरिह तं नतोऽस्मि ॥1॥
cc-madhya-3.1.translation: After accepting the sannyāsa order of life, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, out of intense love for Kṛṣṇa, wanted to go to Vṛndāvana, but apparently by mistake He wandered in the Rāḍha-deśa. Later He arrived at Śāntipura and enjoyed Himself there with His devotees. I offer my respectful obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: eta bali' cale prabhu, premonmādera cihna
devanagari: एत ब लि’ चले प्रभु, प्रेमोन्मादेर चिह्न ।
दिक्विदिक्ज्ञान नाहि, किबा रात्रि - दिन ॥10॥
cc-madhya-3.10.translation: As Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was enroute to Vṛndāvana, all the ecstatic symptoms became manifest, and He did not know in which direction He was going, nor did He know whether it was day or night.

devanagari: शतेक सन्न्यासी यदि कराह भोजन ।
तबे एइ अपराध ह इबे खण्डन ॥100॥
cc-madhya-3.100.translation: Śrīla Nityānanda Prabhu continued, "If you invite at least one hundred sannyāsīs to Your home and feed them sumptuously, Your offense will be nullified."

devanagari: आचार्य कहे - ना करिब सन्न्यासि - निमन्त्रण ।
सन्न्यासी नाशिल मोर सब स्मृति - धर्म ॥101॥
cc-madhya-3.101.translation: Advaita Ācārya replied, "I shall never again invite another sannyāsī, for it is a sannyāsī who has spoiled all My brahminical smṛti regulations."

lines: eta bali' dui jane karāila ācamana
devanagari: एत ब लि’ दुइ जने कराइल आचमन ।
उत्तम शय्याते लइया कराइल शयन ॥102॥
cc-madhya-3.102.translation: After this, Advaita Ācārya made the Lords wash Their hands and mouths. He then took Them to a nice bed and made Them lie down to take rest.

devanagari: लवङ्ग एलाची - बीज - उत्तम रस - वास ।
तुलसी - मञ्जरी सह दिल मुख - वास ॥103॥
cc-madhya-3.103.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya fed the two Lords cloves and cardamom mixed with tulasī flowers. Thus there was a good flavor within Their mouths.

devanagari: सुगन्धि चन्दने लिप्त कैल कलेवर ।
सुगन्धि पुष्प - माला आ नि’ दिल हृदय - उपर ॥104॥
cc-madhya-3.104.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya then smeared the bodies of the Lords with sandalwood pulp and then placed very fragrant flower garlands on Their chests.

devanagari: आचार्य करिते चाहे पाद - संवाहन ।
सङ्कुचित ह ञा प्रभु बलेन वचन ॥105॥
cc-madhya-3.105.translation: When the Lord lay down on the bed, Advaita Ācārya wanted to massage His legs, but the Lord was very hesitant and spoke as follows to Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: बहुत नाचाइले तुमि, छाड़ नाचान ।
मुकुन्द - हरिदास लइया करह भोजन ॥106॥
cc-madhya-3.106.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Advaita Ācārya, You have made Me dance in various ways. Now give up this practice. Go with Mukunda and Haridāsa and accept Your lunch."

lines: tabe ta' ācārya saṅge lañā dui jane
karila icchāya bhojana, ye āchila mane
devanagari: तबे त’ आचार्य सङ्गे लञा दुइ जने ।
करिल इच्छाय भोजन, ये आछिल मने ॥107॥
cc-madhya-3.107.translation: Thereupon Advaita Ācārya took prasāda with Mukunda and Haridāsa, and they all wholeheartedly ate as much as they desired.

devanagari: शान्तिपुरेर लोक शुनि’ प्रभुर आगमन ।
देखिते आइला लोक प्रभुर चरण ॥108॥
cc-madhya-3.108.translation: When the people of Śāntipura heard that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was staying there, they all immediately came to see His lotus feet.

devanagari: ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ बले लोक आनन्दित ह ञा ।
चमत्कार पाइल प्रभुर सौन्दर्य देखिञा ॥109॥
cc-madhya-3.109.translation: Being very pleased, all the people loudly began to shout the holy name of the Lord, "Hari! Hari!" Indeed, they became struck with wonder upon seeing the beauty of the Lord.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द, आचार्यरत्न, मुकुन्द, तिन जन ।
प्रभु - पाछे - पाछे तिने करेन गमन ॥11॥
cc-madhya-3.11.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went toward Vṛndāvana, Nityānanda Prabhu, Candraśekhara and Prabhu Mukunda followed Him.

devanagari: गौर - देह - कान्ति सूर्य जिनिया उज्ज्वल ।
अरुण - वस्त्र - कान्ति ताहे करे झल - मल ॥110॥
cc-madhya-3.110.translation: They saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's very fair-complexioned body and its bright luster, which conquered the brilliance of the sun. Over and above this was the beauty of the saffron garments that glittered upon His body.

lines: āise yāya loka harṣe, nāhi samādhāna
devanagari: आइसे याय लोक हर्षे, नाहि समाधान ।
लोकेर सङ्घट्टे दिन हैल अवसान ॥111॥
cc-madhya-3.111.translation: People came and went with great pleasure. There was no calculating how many people assembled there before the day was over.

devanagari: सन्ध्याते आचार्य आरम्भिल सङ्कीर्तन ।
आचार्य नाचेन, प्रभु करेन दर्शन ॥112॥
cc-madhya-3.112.translation: As soon as it was evening, Advaita Ācārya began the congregational chanting. He even began to dance Himself, and the Lord saw the performance.

devanagari: नित्यानन्द गोसाञि बुले आचार्य धरिञा ।
हरिदास पाछे नाचे हरषित हञा ॥113॥
cc-madhya-3.113.translation: When Advaita Ācārya began to dance, Nityānanda Prabhu began dancing behind Him. Haridāsa Ṭhākura, being very pleased, also began dancing behind Him.

lines: ki kahiba re sakhī ājuka ānanda ora
devanagari: कि कहिब रे सखि आजुक आनन्द ओर ।
चिर - दिने माधव मन्दिरे मोर ॥114॥
cc-madhya-3.114.translation: Advaita Ācārya said, " 'My dear friends, what shall I say? Today I have received the highest transcendental pleasure. After many, many days, Lord Kṛṣṇa is in My house.' "

lines: ei pada gāoyāiyā harṣe karena nartana
devanagari: एइ पद गाओयाइया हर्षे करेन नर्तन ।
स्वेद - कम्प - पुलकाश्रु - हुङ्कार - गर्जन ॥115॥
cc-madhya-3.115.translation: Advaita Ācārya led the saṅkīrtana party, and with great pleasure He sang this verse. There was a manifestation of ecstatic perspiration, shivering, raised hairs, tears in the eyes and sometimes thundering and bellowing.

lines: phiri' phiri' kabhu prabhura dharena caraṇa
devanagari: फिरि’ फिरि’ कभु प्रभुर धरेन चरण ।
चरणे धरिया प्रभुरे बलेन वचन ॥116॥
cc-madhya-3.116.translation: While dancing, Advaita Ācārya would sometimes turn around and around and catch the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He then speak to Him as follows.

lines: aneka dina tumi more beḍāile bhāṇḍiyā
devanagari: अनेक दिन तुमि मोरे बेड़ाइले भाण्डिया ।
घरेते पा ञाछि, एबे राखिब बान्धिया ॥117॥
cc-madhya-3.117.translation: Śrī Advaita Ācārya would say, "Many days You escaped Me by bluffing. Now I have You in My home, and I will keep You bound up."

lines: eta bali' ācārya ānande karena nartana
devanagari: एत ब लि’ आचार्य आनन्दे करेन नर्तन ।
प्रहरेक - रात्रि आचार्य कैल सङ्कीर्तन ॥118॥
cc-madhya-3.118.translation: So speaking, Advaita Ācārya performed congregational chanting with great pleasure for three hours that night and danced all the time.

devanagari: प्रेमेर उत्कण्ठा , - प्रभुर नाहि कृष्ण - सङ्ग ।
विरहे बाड़िल प्रेम - ज्वालार तरङ्ग ॥119॥
cc-madhya-3.119.translation: When Advaita Ācārya danced in that way, Lord Caitanya felt ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa, and because of His separation, the waves and flames of love increased.

lines: yei yei prabhu dekhe, sei sei loka
devanagari: येइ येइ प्रभु देखे, सेइ सेइ लोक ।
प्रेमावेशे ‘हरि’ बले, खण्डे दुःख - शोक ॥12॥
cc-madhya-3.12.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed through Rāḍha-deśa, whoever saw Him in ecstasy exclaimed, "Hari! Hari!" As they chanted this with the Lord, all the unhappiness of material existence diminished.

devanagari: व्याकुल हञा प्रभु भूमिते पड़िला ।
गोसाञि देखिया आचार्य नृत्य सम्बरिला ॥120॥
cc-madhya-3.120.translation: Being agitated by the ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu suddenly fell on the ground. Seeing this, Advaita Ācārya stopped dancing.

devanagari: प्रभुर अन्तर मुकुन्द जाने भाल - मते ।
भावेर सदृश पद लागला गाइते ॥121॥
cc-madhya-3.121.translation: When Mukunda saw the ecstasy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he understood the feelings of the Lord and began to sing many stanzas augmenting the force of the Lord's ecstasy.

lines: pada śuni' prabhura aṅga nā yāya dhāraṇa
devanagari: आचार्य उठाइल प्रभुके करिते नर्तन ।
पद शुनि’ प्रभुर अङ्ग ना याय धारण ॥122॥
cc-madhya-3.122.translation: Advaita Ācārya raised the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to help Him dance, but the Lord, after hearing the stanzas sung by Mukunda, could not be held due to His bodily symptoms.

lines: aśru, kampa, pulaka, sveda, gadgada vacana
kṣaṇe uṭhe, kṣaṇe paḍe, kṣaṇeka rodana
devanagari: अश्रु, कम्प, पुलक, स्वेद, गद्गद वचन ।
क्षणे उठे, क्षणे पड़े, क्षणेक रोदन ॥123॥
cc-madhya-3.123.translation: Tears fell from His eyes, and His whole body trembled. His hair stood on end, He perspired heavily, and His words faltered. Sometimes He stood, and sometimes He fell. And sometimes He cried.

lines: hā hā prāṇa-priya-sakhī, ki nā haila more
devanagari: हा हा प्राण - प्रिय - सखि, कि ना हैल मोरे ।
कानु - प्रेम - विषे मोर तनु - मन जरे ॥124॥
cc-madhya-3.124.translation: Mukunda sang, " 'My dear intimate friend! What has not happened to me! Due to the effects of the poison of love for Kṛṣṇa, my body and mind have been severely afflicted.

lines: rātri-dine poḍe mana soyāsti nā pāṅ
yāhāṅ gele kānu pāṅ, tāhāṅ uḍi' yāṅ
devanagari: रात्रि - दिने पोड़े मन सोयास्ति ना पाँ ।
cc-madhya-3.125.translation: “ 'My feeling is like this: My mind burns day and night, and I can get no rest. If there were someplace I could go to meet Kṛṣṇa, I would immediately fly there.' "

lines: ei pada gāya mukunda madhura susvare
devanagari: एइ पद गाय मुकुन्द मधुर सुस्वरे ।
शुनिया प्रभुर चित्त अन्तरे विदरे ॥126॥
cc-madhya-3.126.translation: This stanza was sung by Mukunda in a very sweet voice, but as soon as Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this stanza, His mind went to pieces.

lines: nirveda, viṣāda, harṣa, cāpalya, garva, dainya
devanagari: निर्वेद, विषाद, हर्ष, चापल्य, गर्व, दैन्य ।
प्रभुर सहित युद्ध करे भाव - सैन्य ॥127॥
cc-madhya-3.127.translation: The transcendental ecstatic symptoms of disappointment, moroseness, pleasure, restlessness, pride and humility all began to fight like soldiers within the Lord.

devanagari: जर - जर हैल प्र भु भावेर प्रहारे ।
भूमिते पड़िल, श्वास नाहिक शरीरे ॥128॥
cc-madhya-3.128.translation: The entire body of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to totter due to the onslaught of various ecstatic symptoms. As a result, He immediately fell on the ground, and His breathing almost stopped.

devanagari: देखिया चिन्तित हैला यत भक्त - गण ।
आचम्बिते उठे प्रभु करिया गर्जन ॥129॥
cc-madhya-3.129.translation: Upon seeing the condition of the Lord, all the devotees became very anxious. Then, suddenly, the Lord got up and began to make thundering sounds.

devanagari: गोप - बालक सब प्रभुके देखियो ।
‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ बलि’ डाके उच्च करिया ॥13॥
cc-madhya-3.13.translation: All the cowherd boys who saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passing joined with Him and began to shout loudly, "Hari! Hari!"

devanagari: ‘बल्’ ‘बल्’ बले, नाचे, आनन्दे विह्वल ।
बुझन ना याय भाव - तरङ्ग प्रबल ॥130॥
cc-madhya-3.130.translation: Upon standing up, the Lord said, "Go on speaking! Go on speaking!" Thus He began to dance, overwhelmed with pleasure. No one could understand the strong waves of this ecstasy.

lines: ācārya, haridāsa bule pāche ta', nāciñā
devanagari: नित्यानन्द सङ्गे बुले प्रभुके धरिञा ।
आचार्य, हरिदास बुले पाछे त’ नाचिञा ॥131॥
cc-madhya-3.131.translation: Lord Nityānanda began to walk with Caitanya Mahāprabhu to see that He would not fall, and Advaita Ācārya and Haridāsa Ṭhākura followed Them, dancing.

lines: ei mata prahareka nāce prabhu raṅge
kabhu harṣa, kabhu viṣāda, bhāvera taraṅge
devanagari: एइ मत प्रहरेक नाचे प्रभु रङ्गे ।
कभु हर्ष, कभु विषाद, भावेर तरङ्गे ॥132॥
cc-madhya-3.132.translation: In this way the Lord danced for at least three hours. Sometimes the symptoms of ecstasy were visible, including pleasure, moroseness and many other waves of ecstatic emotional love.

devanagari: तिन दिन उपवासे करिया भोजन ।
उद्दण्ड - नृत्येते प्रभुर हैल परिश्रम ॥133॥
cc-madhya-3.133.translation: The Lord had been fasting for three days, and after that period He took eatables sumptuously. Thus when He danced and jumped high, He became a little fatigued.

lines: tabu ta' nā jāne śrama premāviṣṭa hañā
devanagari: तबु त’ ना जाने श्रम प्रेमाविष्ट हञा ।
नित्यानन्द महाप्रभुके राखिल धरिञा ॥134॥
cc-madhya-3.134.translation: Being fully absorbed in love of Godhead, He would not understand His fatigue. But Nityānanda Prabhu, catching Him, stopped His dancing.

lines: nānā sevā kari' prabhuke karāila śayana
devanagari: आचार्य - गोसाञि तबे राखिल कीर्तन ।
नाना सेवा क रि’ प्रभुके कराइल शयन ॥135॥
cc-madhya-3.135.translation: Although the Lord was fatigued, Nityānanda Prabhu kept Him steady by holding Him. At that time Advaita Ācārya suspended the chanting and, by rendering various services to the Lord, made Him lie down to take rest.

devanagari: एइ - मत दश - दिन भोजन - कीर्तन ।
एक - रूपे क रि’ करे प्रभुर सेवन ॥136॥
cc-madhya-3.136.translation: For ten continuous days Advaita Ācārya held feasting and chanting in the evening. He served the Lord in this way without any change.

devanagari: प्रभाते आचार्यरत्न दोलाय चड़ाञा ।
भक्त - गण - सङ्गे आइला शचीमाता लञा ॥137॥
cc-madhya-3.137.translation: In the morning Candraśekhara brought Śacīmātā from her house with many devotees, and he seated her in a palanquin.

lines: saba loka āilā, haila saṅghaṭṭa samṛddha
devanagari: नदीया - नगरेर लोक - स्त्री - बालक - वृद्ध ।
सब लोक आइला, हैल सङ्घट्ट समृद्ध ॥138॥
cc-madhya-3.138.translation: In this way, all the people of the town of Nadia-including all women, boys and old men-came there. Thus the crowd increased.

devanagari: प्रातः - कृत्य करि’ करे नाम - सङ्कीर्तन ।
शचीमाता लञा आइला अद्वैत - भवन ॥139॥
cc-madhya-3.139.translation: In the morning, after regular duties were completed and the Lord was chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, the people accompanied Śacīmātā to the house of Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: शुनि’ ता - सबार निकट गेला गौरहरि ।
‘बल’ ‘बल’ बले सबार शिरे हस्त ध रि’ ॥14॥
cc-madhya-3.14.translation: When He heard all the cowherd boys also chanting "Hari! Hari!" Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very pleased. He approached them, put His hand on their heads and said, "Go on chanting like that."

devanagari: शची - आगे पड़िला प्रभु दण्डवत् हञा ।
कान्दिते लागिला शची कोले उठाइञा ॥140॥
cc-madhya-3.140.translation: As soon as mother Śacī appeared on the scene, Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell before her like a stick. Mother Śacī began to cry, taking the Lord on her lap.

lines: keśa nā dekhiyā śacī ha-ilā vikala
devanagari: दोंहार दर्शने दुँहे हइला विह्वल ।
केश ना देखिया शची हइला विकल ॥141॥
cc-madhya-3.141.translation: Upon seeing one another, they both became overwhelmed. Seeing the Lord's head without hair, mother Śacī became greatly agitated.

lines: aṅga muche, mukha cumbe, kare nirīkṣaṇa
devanagari: अङ्ग मुछे, मुख चुम्बे, करे निरीक्षण ।
देखिते ना पाय, - अश्रु भरिल नयन ॥142॥
cc-madhya-3.142.translation: She began to smear the body of the Lord with kisses. Sometimes she kissed His face and tried to observe Him carefully, but because her eyes were filled with tears, she could not see.

devanagari: कान्दिया कहेन शची, बाछारे निमाञि ।
विश्वरूप - सम ना करिह निठुराइ ॥143॥
cc-madhya-3.143.translation: Understanding that Lord Caitanya had accepted the renounced order of life, Śacīmātā, crying, said to the Lord, "My darling Nimāi, do not be cruel like Viśvarūpa, Your elder brother."

lines: sannyāsī ha-iyā punaḥ nā dila daraśana
tumi taiche kaile mora ha-ibe maraṇa
devanagari: सन्न्यासी हइया पुनः ना दिल दरशन ।
तुमि तैछे कैले मोर हइबे मरण ॥144॥
cc-madhya-3.144.translation: Mother Śacī continued, "After accepting the renounced order, Viśvarūpa never again gave me audience. If You do like Him, that will certainly be the death of me."

lines: tomāra śarīra ei, mora kichu nāi
devanagari: कान्दिया बलेन प्रभु - शुन, मोर आइ ।
तोमार शरीर एइ, मोर किछु नाइ ॥145॥
cc-madhya-3.145.translation: The Lord replied, "My dear mother, please hear. This body belongs to you. I do not possess anything.

lines: tomāra pālita deha, janma tomā haite
koṭi janme tomāra ṛṇa nā pāri śodhite
devanagari: तोमार पालित देह, जन्म तोमा हैते ।
कोटि जन्मे तोमार ऋण ना पारि शोधिते ॥146॥
cc-madhya-3.146.translation: "This body was raised by you, and it comes from you. I cannot repay this debt even in millions of births.

lines: jāni' vā nā jāni' kaila yadyapi sannyāsa
devanagari: जानि’ वा ना जा नि’ कैल यद्यपि सन्न्यास ।
तथापि तोमारे कभु नहिब उदास ॥147॥
cc-madhya-3.147.translation: "Knowingly or unknowingly I have accepted this renounced order. Still, I shall never be indifferent to you.

lines: tumi yāhāṅ kaha, āmi tāhāṅi rahiba
tumi yei ājñā kara, sei ta' kariba
devanagari: तुमि याहाँ कह, आमि ताहाङिरहिब ।
तुमि येइ आज्ञा कर, सेइ त’ करिब ॥148॥
cc-madhya-3.148.translation: "My dear mother, wherever you ask Me to stay I shall stay, and whatever you order I shall execute."

lines: eta bali' punaḥ punaḥ kare namaskāra
tuṣṭa hañā āi kole kare bāra bāra
devanagari: एत ब लि’ पुनः पुनः करे नमस्कार ।
तुष्ट हञा आइ कोले करे बार बार ॥149॥
cc-madhya-3.149.translation: Saying this, the Lord offered obeisances to His mother again and again, and mother Śacī, being pleased, took Him again and again on her lap.

devanagari: ता’ - सबार स्तुति करे, - तोमरा भा ग्यवान् ।
कृतार्थ करिले मोरे शुनाञा हरि - नाम ॥15॥
cc-madhya-3.15.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus blessed them all, saying that they were all fortunate. In this way He praised them, and He felt very successful because they chanted the holy name of Lord Hari.

lines: tabe āi lañā ācārya gelā abhyantara
devanagari: तबे आइ लञा आचार्य गेला अभ्यन्तर ।
भक्त - गण मिलिते प्रभु हइला सत्वर ॥150॥
cc-madhya-3.150.translation: Then Advaita Ācārya took mother Śacī within the house. The Lord was immediately ready to meet all the devotees.

lines: eke eke milila prabhu saba bhakta-gaṇa
sabāra mukha dekhi' kare dṛḍha āliṅgana
devanagari: एके एके मिलिल प्रभु सब भक्त - गण ।
सबार मुख देखि’ करे दृढ़ आलिङ्गन ॥151॥
cc-madhya-3.151.translation: The Lord met all the devotees one after the other, and looking at everyone's face individually, He embraced them tightly.

lines: keśa nā dekhiyā bhakta yadyapi pāya duḥkha
devanagari: केश ना देखिया भक्त यद्यपि पाय दुःख ।
सौन्दर्य देखिते तबु पाय महा - सुख ॥152॥
cc-madhya-3.152.translation: Although the devotees were unhappy at not seeing the Lord's hair, they nonetheless derived great happiness from seeing His beauty.

devanagari: श्रीवास, रामाइ, विद्यानिधि, गदाधर ।
गङ्गादास, वक्रेश्वर, मुरारि, शुक्लाम्बर ॥153॥
cc-madhya-3.153-155.translation: Śrīvāsa, Rāmāi, Vidyānidhi, Gadādhara, Gaṅgādāsa, Vakreśvara, Murāri, Śuklāmbara, Buddhimanta Khāṅ, Nandana, Śrīdhara, Vijaya, Vāsudeva, Dāmodara, Mukunda, Sañjaya and all the others, however many I can mention-indeed, all the inhabitants of Navadvīpa-arrived there, and the Lord met them with smiles and glances of mercy.

devanagari: आनन्दे नाचये सबे ब लि’ ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ।
आचार्य - मन्दिर हैल श्री - वैकुण्ठ - पुरी ॥156॥
cc-madhya-3.156.translation: Everyone was dancing and chanting the holy names of Hari. In this way the domicile of Advaita Ācārya was converted into Śrī Vaikuṇṭha Purī.

devanagari: यत लोक आइल महाप्रभुके देखिते ।
नाना - ग्राम हैते, आर नवद्वीप हैते ॥157॥
cc-madhya-3.157.translation: People came to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu from various other villages nearby, as well as Navadvīpa.

devanagari: सबाकारे वासा दिल - भक्ष्य, अन्न - पान ।
बहु - दिन आचार्य - गोसा ञि कैल समाधान ॥158॥
cc-madhya-3.158.translation: To everyone who came to see the Lord from villages nearby, especially from Navadvīpa, Advaita Ācārya gave residential quarters, as well as all kinds of eatables, for many days. Indeed, He properly adjusted everything.

lines: yata dravya vyaya kare tata dravya haya
devanagari: आचार्य - गोसाञि र भाण्डार - अक्षय, अव्यय ।
यत द्रव्य व्यय करे तत द्रव्य हय ॥159॥
cc-madhya-3.159.translation: The supplies of Advaita Ācārya were inexhaustible and indestructible. As many goods and commodities as He used, just as many again appeared.

devanagari: गुप्ते ता - सबाके आ नि’ ठाकुर नित्यानन्द ।
शिखाइला सबाकारे करिया प्रबन्ध ॥16॥
cc-madhya-3.16.translation: Calling all the boys in confidence and telling a reasonable story, Nityānanda Prabhu instructed them as follows.

lines: sei dina haite śacī karena randhana
devanagari: सेइ दिन हैते शची करेन रन्धन ।
भक्त - गण लञा प्रभु करेन भोजन ॥160॥
cc-madhya-3.160.translation: From the day Śacīmātā arrived at the house of Advaita Ācārya, she took charge of the cooking, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dined in the company of all the devotees.

devanagari: दिने आचार्येर प्रीति - प्रभुर दर्शन ।
रात्रे लोक देखे प्रभुर नर्तन - कीर्तन ॥161॥
cc-madhya-3.161.translation: All the people who came there during the day saw Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the friendly behavior of Advaita Ācārya. At night they had the opportunity to see the Lord's dancing and hear His chanting.

devanagari: कीर्तन करिते प्रभुर सर्व - भावोदय ।
स्तम्भ, कम्प, पुलकाश्रु, गद्गद, प्रलय ॥162॥
cc-madhya-3.162.translation: When the Lord performed kīrtana, He manifested all kinds of transcendental symptoms. He appeared stunned and trembling, His hair stood on end, and His voice faltered. There were tears and devastation.

lines: kṣaṇe kṣaṇe paḍe prabhu āchāḍa khāñā
devanagari: क्षणे क्षणे पड़े प्रभु आछाड़ खाञा ।
देखि’ शचीमाता कहे रोदन करिया ॥163॥
cc-madhya-3.163.translation: Frequently the Lord would tumble to the ground. Seeing this, mother Śacī would cry.

lines: hā-hā kari' viṣṇu-pāśe māge ei vara
devanagari: चूर्ण हैल, हेन वासों निमाञि - कलेवर ।
हा - हा क रि’ विष्णु - पाशे मागे एइ वर ॥164॥
cc-madhya-3.164.translation: Śrīmatī Śacīmātā thought that the body of Nimāi was being smashed when He fell down so. She cried, "Alas!" and petitioned Lord Viṣṇu.

lines: bālya-kāla haite tomāra ye kailuṅ sevana
tāra ei phala more deha nārāyaṇa
devanagari: बाल्यकाल हैते तोमार ये कैलुँ सेवन ।
तार एइ फल मोरे देह नारायण ॥165॥
cc-madhya-3.165.translation: "My dear Lord, kindly bestow this benediction as a result of whatever service I have rendered unto You from my childhood.

devanagari: ये काले निमाञि पड़े धरणी - उपरे ।
व्यथा येन नाहि लागे निमाञि - शरीरे ॥166॥
cc-madhya-3.166.translation: "Whenever Nimāi falls to the surface of the earth, please do not let Him feel any pain."

devanagari: एइ - मत शचीदेवी वात्सल्ये विह्वल ।
हर्ष - भय - दैन्य - भावे हइल विकल ॥167॥
cc-madhya-3.167.translation: When mother Śacī was thus overwhelmed in paternal love for Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, she became transformed with happiness, fear and humility, as well as bodily symptoms.

lines: prabhuke bhikṣā dite haila sabākāra mana
devanagari: श्रीवासादि यत प्रभुर विप्र भक्त - गण ।
प्रभुके भिक्षा दिते हैल सबाकार मन ॥168॥
cc-madhya-3.168.translation: Since Advaita Ācārya was giving alms and food to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the other devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, also desired to give Him alms and invite Him for lunch.

lines: nimāñira daraśana āra muñi pāba kati
devanagari: शुनि’ शची सबाकारे करिल मिनति ।
निमाञि र दरशन आर मुञि पाब कति ॥169॥
cc-madhya-3.169.translation: Hearing these proposals made by other devotees of the Lord, mother Śacī said to the devotees, "How many times shall I get the chance to see Nimāi again?"

devanagari: वृन्दावन - पथ प्रभु पुछेन तोमारे ।
गङ्गा - तीर - पथ तबे देखाइह ताँरे ॥17॥
cc-madhya-3.17.translation: "If Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asks you about the path to Vṛndāvana, please show Him the path on the bank of the Ganges instead."

devanagari: तोमा - सबा - सने हबे अन्यत्र मिलन ।
मुञि अभागिनीर मात्र एइ दरशन ॥170॥
