cc-madhya-8.84.translation: “ 'Increasing love is experienced in various tastes, one above another. But that love which has the highest taste in the gradual succession of desires manifests itself in the form of conjugal love.'

devanagari: पूर्व - पूर्व - रसेर गुण - परे परे हय ।
दुइ - तिन गणने पञ्च पर्यन्त बाड़य ॥85॥
cc-madhya-8.85.translation: "There is a gradual order of improvement in transcendental mellows from the initial ones to the later ones. In each subsequent mellow the qualities of the previous mellows are manifest, counting from two, then three, and up to the point of five complete qualities.

devanagari: गुणाधिक्ये स्वादाधिक्य बाड़े प्रति - रसे ।
शान्त - दास्य - सख्य - वात्सल्येर गुण मधुरेते वैसे ॥86॥
cc-madhya-8.86.translation: "As the qualities increase, so the taste also increases in each and every mellow. Therefore the qualities found in śānta-rasa, dāsya-rasa, sakhya-rasa and vātsalya-rasa are all manifest in conjugal love [mādhurya-rasa].

devanagari: आकाशादिर गुण येन पर - पर भूते ।
दुइ - तिन क्रमे बाड़े पञ्च पृथिवीते ॥87॥
cc-madhya-8.87.translation: "The qualities in the material elements-sky, air, fire, water and earth-increase one after another by a gradual process of one, two and three, and at the last stage, in the element earth, all five qualities are completely visible.

devanagari: परिपूर्ण - कृष्ण - प्राप्ति एइ ‘प्रेमा’ हैते ।
एइ प्रेमार वश कृष्ण - कहे भागवते ॥88॥
cc-madhya-8.88.translation: "Complete attainment of the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa is made possible by love of Godhead, specifically mādhurya-rasa, or conjugal love. Lord Kṛṣṇa is indeed captivated by this standard of love. This is stated in Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

devanagari: मयि भक्तिर्हि भूतानाममृतत्वाय कल्पते ।
दिष्ट्या यदासीन्मत्स्नेहो भवतीनां मदापनः ॥89॥
cc-madhya-8.89.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa told the gopīs, 'The means of attaining My favor is loving service unto Me, and fortunately you are all thus engaged. Those living beings who render service unto Me are eligible to be transferred to the spiritual world and attain eternal life with knowledge and bliss.'

devanagari: प्रभाते उठिया प्रभु चलिला प्रेमावेशे ।
दिग्विदिक्नाहि ज्ञान रात्रि - दिवसे ॥9॥
cc-madhya-8.9.translation: The next morning, in the great ecstasy of love, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu started on His tour with no knowledge of the proper direction, and He continued the whole day and night.

lines: ye yaiche bhaje, kṛṣṇa tāre bhaje taiche
devanagari: कृष्णेर प्रतिज्ञा दृढ़ सर्व - काले आछे ।
ये यैछे भजे, कृष्ण तारे भजे तैछे ॥90॥
cc-madhya-8.90.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa has made a firm promise for all time. If one renders service unto Him, Kṛṣṇa correspondingly gives him an equal amount of success in devotional service to the Lord.

devanagari: ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम् ।
मम वर्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः ॥91॥
cc-madhya-8.91.translation: "According to Lord Kṛṣṇa in Bhagavad-gītā [4.11],'All of them-as they surrender unto Me-I reward accordingly. Everyone follows My path in all respects, O son of Pṛthā.'

devanagari: एइ ‘प्रेमे’र अनुरूप ना पारे भजिते ।
अतएव ‘ऋणी’ हय - कहे भागवते ॥92॥
cc-madhya-8.92.translation: "In Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam [10.32.22] it is said that Lord Kṛṣṇa cannot proportionately reciprocate devotional service in the mādhurya-rasa; therefore He always remains a debtor to such devotees.

devanagari: न पारयेऽहं निरवद्य - संयुजां स्व - साधु - कृत्यं विबुधायुषापि वः ।
या माभजन्दुर्जय - गेह - शृङ्खलाः संवृश्च्य तद्वः प्रतियातु साधुना ॥93॥
cc-madhya-8.93.translation: "When the gopīs were overwhelmed with dissatisfaction due to Lord Kṛṣṇa's absence from the rāsa-līlā, Kṛṣṇa returned to them and told them, 'My dear gopīs, our meeting is certainly free from all material contamination. I must admit that in many lives it would be impossible for Me to repay My debt to you because you have cut off the bondage of family life just to search for Me. Consequently I am unable to repay you. Therefore please be satisfied with your honest activities in this regard.'

devanagari: यद्यपि कृष्ण - सौन्दर्य - माधुर धुर्य ।
व्रज - देवीर सङ्गे ताँर बाड़ये माधुर्य ॥94॥
cc-madhya-8.94.translation: "Although Kṛṣṇa's unparalleled beauty is the topmost sweetness of love of Godhead, His sweetness increases unlimitedly when He is in the company of the gopīs. Consequently Kṛṣṇa's exchange of love with the gopīs is the topmost perfection of love of Godhead.

devanagari: तत्रातिशुशुभे ताभिर्भगवान्देवकी - सुतः ।
मध्ये मणीनां हैमानां महा - मरकतो यथा ॥95॥
cc-madhya-8.95.translation: “ 'Although the son of Devakī, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is also the reservoir of all kinds of beauty, when He is among the gopīs He nonetheless becomes more beautiful, for He resembles a mārakata jewel surrounded by gold and other jewels.' "

lines: kṛpā kari' kaha, yadi āge kichu haya
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - एइ ‘साध्याव धि’ सुनिश्चय ।
कृपा करि’ कह, यदि आगे किछु हय ॥96॥
cc-madhya-8.96.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "This is certainly the limit of perfection, but please be merciful to Me and speak more if there is more."

lines: rāya kahe,—īhāra āge puche hena jane
devanagari: राय कहे , - इहार आगे पुछे हेन जने ।
एत - दिन नाहि जानि, आछये भुवने ॥97॥
cc-madhya-8.97.translation: Rāya Rāmānanda replied, "Until this day I did not know anyone within this material world who could inquire beyond this perfectional stage of devotional service.

devanagari: इँहार मध्ये राधार प्रेम - ‘साध्य - शिरोम णि’ ।
याँहार महिमा सर्व - शास्त्रेते वाखानि ॥98॥
cc-madhya-8.98.translation: "Among the loving affairs of the gopīs," Rāmānanda Rāya continued, " the love for Śrī Kṛṣṇa is topmost. Indeed, the glories of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī are highly estimated in all revealed scriptures.

devanagari: यथा राधा प्रिया विष्णो स्तस्याः कुण्डं प्रियं तथा ।
सर्व - गोपीषु सैवैका विष्णोरत्यन्त - वल्लभा ॥99॥
cc-madhya-8.99.translation: “ 'Just as Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is most dear to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, Her bathing place known [Rādhā-kuṇḍa] is also dear to Him. Among all the gopīs, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is supermost and very dear to Lord Kṛṣṇa.'

devanagari: नाना - मत - ग्राह - ग्रस्तान्दाक्षिणात्य - जन - द्विपान् ।
कृपारिणा विमुच्यैतागौरश्चक्रे स वैष्णवान् ॥1॥
cc-madhya-9.1.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu converted the inhabitants of South India. These people were as strong as elephants, but they were under the clutches of the crocodiles of various philosophies, such as the Buddhist, Jaina and Māyāvāda philosophies. By His disc of mercy the Lord converted all of them into Vaiṣṇavas, devotees of the Lord.

devanagari: सेइ सब लोक प्रभुर दर्शन - प्रभावे ।
निज - निज - मत छा ड़ि’ हइल वैष्णवे ॥10॥
cc-madhya-9.10.translation: By the influence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all these people abandoned their own opinions and became Vaiṣṇavas, devotees of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: अर्जुनेरे कहितेछेन हित - उपदेश ।
ताँरे देखि’ हय मोर आनन्द - आवेश ॥100॥
cc-madhya-9.100.translation: "When I see the picture of Lord Kṛṣṇa sitting in a chariot and instructing Arjuna, I am filled with ecstatic happiness.

lines: yāvat paḍoṅ, tāvat pāṅa tāṅra daraśana
ei lāgi' gītā-pāṭha nā chāḍe mora mana
devanagari: यावत्पड़ों, तावत्पाङ ताँर दरशन ।
एइ ला गि’ गीता - पाठ ना छाड़े मोर मन ॥101॥
cc-madhya-9.101.translation: "As long as I read Bhagavad-gītā, I simply see the Lord's beautiful features. It is for this reason that I am reading Bhagavad-gītā, and my mind cannot be distracted from this."

lines: tumi se jānaha ei gītāra artha-sāra
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - गीता - पाठे तोमाराइ अधिकार ।
तुमि से जानह एइ गीतार अर्थ - सार ॥102॥
cc-madhya-9.102.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told the brāhmaṇa, "Indeed, you are an authority in the reading of Bhagavad-gītā. Whatever you know constitutes the real purport of Bhagavad-gītā."

lines: eta bali' sei vipre kaila āliṅgana
devanagari: एत ब लि’ सेइ विप्रे कैल आलिङ्गन ।
प्रभु - पद ध रि’ विप्र करेन रोदन ॥103॥
cc-madhya-9.103.translation: After saying this, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced the brāhmaṇa, and the brāhmaṇa, catching the lotus feet of the Lord, began to cry.

lines: tomā dekhi' tāhā haite dvi-guṇa sukha haya
sei kṛṣṇa tumi,—hena mora mane laya
devanagari: तोमा दे खि’ ताहा हैते द्वि - गुण सुख हय ।
सेइ कृष्ण तुमि, - हेन मोर मने लय ॥104॥
cc-madhya-9.104.translation: The brāhmaṇa said, "Upon seeing You, my happiness is doubled. I take it that You are the same Lord Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: कृष्ण - स्फूर्ये ताँर मन हाञाछे निर्मल ।
अतएव प्रभुर तत्त्व जानिल सकल ॥105॥
cc-madhya-9.105.translation: The brāhmaṇa's mind was purified by the revelation of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and therefore he could understand the truth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in all details.

lines: ei bāt kāhāṅ nā kariha prakāśana
devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु ताँरे कराइल शिक्षण ।
एइ बात्काहाँ ना करिह प्रकाशन ॥106॥
cc-madhya-9.106.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then taught the brāhmaṇa very thoroughly and requested him not to disclose the fact that He was Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself.

lines: sei vipra mahāprabhura baḍa bhakta haila
cāri māsa prabhu-saṅga kabhu nā chāḍila
devanagari: सेइ विप्र महाप्रभुर बड़ भक्त हैल ।
चारि मास प्रभु - सङ्ग कभु ना छाड़िल ॥107॥
cc-madhya-9.107.translation: That brāhmaṇa became a great devotee of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and for four continuous months he did not give up the Lord's company.

devanagari: एइ - मत भट्ट - गृहे रहे गौरचन्द्र ।
निरन्तर भट्ट - सङ्गे कृष्ण - कथानन्द ॥108॥
cc-madhya-9.108.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained at the house of Vyeṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa and constantly talked with him about Lord Kṛṣṇa. In this way He was very happy.

lines: tāṅra bhakti dekhi' prabhura tuṣṭa haila mana
devanagari: श्री - वैष्णव’ भट्ट सेवे लक्ष्मी - नारायण ।
ताँर भक्ति दे खि’ प्रभुर तुष्ट हैल मन ॥109॥
cc-madhya-9.109.translation: Being a Vaiṣṇava in the Rāmānuja-sampradāya, Vyeṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa worshiped the Deity of Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa. Seeing his pure devotion, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very much satisfied.

devanagari: वैष्णवेर मध्ये राम - उपासक सब ।
केह ‘तत्त्ववा दी’, केह हय ‘श्री - वैष्णव’ ॥11॥
cc-madhya-9.11.translation: At the time, all the South Indian Vaiṣṇavas were worshipers of Lord Rāmacandra. Some were Tattvavādīs, and some were followers of Rāmānujācārya.

devanagari: निरन्तर ताँर सङ्गे हैल सख्य - भाव ।
हास्य - परिहासे दुँहे सख्येर स्वभाव ॥110॥
cc-madhya-9.110.translation: Constantly associating with one another, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa gradually developed a friendly relationship. Indeed, sometimes they laughed and joked together.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - भट्ट, तोमार लक्ष्मी - ठाकुराणी ।
कान्त - वक्षः - स्थिता, पतिव्रता - शिरोमणि ॥111॥
cc-madhya-9.111.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Bhaṭṭācārya, "Your worshipable goddess of fortune, Lakṣmī, always remains on the chest of Nārāyaṇa, and she is certainly the most chaste woman in the creation.

lines: sādhvī hañā kene cāhe tāṅhāra saṅgama
devanagari: आमार ठाकुर कृष्ण - गोप, गो - चारक ।
साध्वी ह ञा केने चाहे ताँहार सङ्गम ॥112॥
cc-madhya-9.112.translation: "However, my Lord is Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, a cowherd boy who is engaged in tending cows. Why is it that Lakṣmī, being such a chaste wife, wants to associate with My Lord?

devanagari: एइ ला गि’ सुख - भोग छा ड़ि’ चिर - काल ।
व्रत - नियम क रि’ तप करिल अपार ॥113॥
cc-madhya-9.113.translation: "Just to associate with Kṛṣṇa, Lakṣmī abandoned all transcendental happiness in Vaikuṇṭha and for a long time accepted vows and regulative principles and performed unlimited austerities."

devanagari: कस्यानुभावोऽस्य न देव विद्महे तवाङ्घ्रि - रेणु - स्परशाधिकारः ।
यद्वाञ्छया श्रीर्ललनाचरत्तपो विहाय कामान्सु - चिरं धृत - व्रता ॥114॥
cc-madhya-9.114.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, " 'O Lord, we do not know how the serpent Kāliya attained such an opportunity to be touched by the dust of Your lotus feet. Even the goddess of fortune, for this end, performed austerities for centuries, giving up all other desires and taking austere vows. Indeed, we do not know how the serpent Kāliya got such an opportunity."'

devanagari: भट्ट कहे, कृष्ण - नारायण - एकइ स्वरूप ।
कृष्णेते अधिक लीला - वैदग्ध्यादि - रूप ॥115॥
cc-madhya-9.115.translation: Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa then said, "Lord Kṛṣṇa and Lord Nārāyaṇa are one and the same, but the pastimes of Kṛṣṇa are more relishable due to their sportive nature.

devanagari: तार स्पर्शे नाहि याय पतिव्रता - धर्म ।
कौतुके लक्ष्मी चाहेन कृष्णेर सङ्गम ॥116॥
cc-madhya-9.116.translation: "Since Kṛṣṇa and Nārāyaṇa are the same personality, Lakṣmī's association with Kṛṣṇa does not break her vow of chastity. Rather, it was in great fun that the goddess of fortune wanted to associate with Lord Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: सिद्धान्ततस्त्वभेदेऽपि श्रीश - कृष्ण - स्वरूपयोः ।
रसेनोत्कृष्यते कृष्ण - रूपमेषा रस - स्थितिः ॥117॥
cc-madhya-9.117.translation: Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa continued, " 'According to transcendental realization, there is no difference between the forms of Nārāyaṇa and Kṛṣṇa. Yet in Kṛṣṇa there is a special transcendental attraction due to the conjugal mellow, and consequently He surpasses Nārāyaṇa. This is the conclusion of transcendental mellows.'

devanagari: कृष्ण - सङ्गे पतिव्रता - धर्म नहे नाश ।
अधिक लाभ पाइये, आर रास - विलास ॥118॥
cc-madhya-9.118.translation: "The goddess of fortune considered that her vow of chastity would not be damaged by her relationship with Kṛṣṇa. Rather, by associating with Kṛṣṇa she could enjoy the benefit of the rāsa dance."

lines: ihāte ki doṣa, kene kara parihāsa
devanagari: विनोदिनी लक्ष्मीर हय कृष्णे अभिलाष ।
इहाते कि दोष, केने कर परिहास ॥119॥
cc-madhya-9.119.translation: Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa further explained, "Mother Lakṣmī, the goddess of fortune, is also an enjoyer of transcendental bliss; therefore if she wanted to enjoy herself with Kṛṣṇa, what fault is there? Why are You joking so about this?"

devanagari: सेइ सब वैष्णव महाप्रभुर दर्शने ।
कृष्ण - उपासक हैल, लय कृष्ण - नामे ॥12॥
cc-madhya-9.12.translation: After meeting Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all those different Vaiṣṇavas became devotees of Kṛṣṇa and began chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra.

lines: prabhu kahe,—doṣa nāhi, ihā āmi jāni
rāsa nā pāila lakṣmī, śāstre ihā śuni
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - दोष नाहि, इहा आमि जानि ।
रास ना पाइल लक्ष्मी, शास्त्रे इहा शुनि ॥120॥
cc-madhya-9.120.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "I know that there is no fault on the part of the goddess of fortune, but still she could not enter into the rāsa dance. We hear this from revealed scriptures.

devanagari: नायं श्रियोऽङ्ग उ नितान्त - रतेः प्रसादः स्वर्योषितां नलिन - गन्ध - रुचां कुतोऽन्याः ।
रासोत्सवेऽस्य भुज - दण्ड - गृहीत - कण्ठ - लब्धाशिषां य उदगा व्रज - सुन्दरीणाम् ॥121॥
cc-madhya-9.121.translation: “ 'When Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa was dancing with the gopīs in the rāsa-līlā, He put His arms around their necks and embraced them. This transcendental favor was never granted to the goddess of fortune or other consorts in the spiritual world. Nor was such a thing ever imagined by the most beautiful girls in the heavenly planets, girls whose bodily luster and aroma exactly resemble lotus flowers. And what to speak of worldly women, who may be very, very beautiful by material estimation?'

lines: lakṣmī kene nā pāila, ihāra ki kāraṇa
tapa kari' kaiche kṛṣṇa pāila śruti-gaṇa
devanagari: लक्ष्मी केने ना पाइल, इहार कि कारण ।
तप क रि’ कैछे कृष्ण पाइल श्रुति - गण ॥122॥
cc-madhya-9.122.translation: "But can you tell Me why the goddess of fortune, Lakṣmī, could not enter the rāsa dance? The authorities of Vedic knowledge could enter the dance and associate with Kṛṣṇa.

lines: munaya upāsate tad arayo 'pi yayuḥ smaraṇāt
devanagari: निभृत - मरुन्मनोऽक्ष - दृढ़ - योग - युजो हृदि यन् मुनय उपासते तदरयोऽपि ययुः स्मरणात् ।
स्त्रिय उरगेन्द्र - भोग - भुज - दण्ड - विषक्त - धियो वयमपि ते समाः समदृशोऽङ्घ्रि - सरोज - सुधाः ॥123॥
cc-madhya-9.123.translation: “ 'Great sages, by practicing the mystic yoga system and controlling the breath, conquer the mind and senses. Thus engaging in mystic yoga and seeing the Supersoul within their hearts, they ultimately enter into impersonal Brahman, along with the enemies of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. However, the damsels of Vraja, the gopīs, want to embrace Kṛṣṇa and His arms, which are like serpents. Being attracted by the beauty of Kṛṣṇa, the gopīs ultimately tasted the nectar of the lotus feet of the Lord. The Upaniṣads have also tasted the nectar of His lotus feet by following in the footsteps of the gopīs.' "

lines: śruti pāya, lakṣmī nā pāya, ithe ki kāraṇa
bhaṭṭa kahe,—ihā praveśite nāre mora mana
devanagari: श्रुति पाय, लक्ष्मी ना पाय, इथे कि कारण ।
भट्ट कहे , - इहा प्रवेशिते नारे मोर मन ॥124॥
cc-madhya-9.124.translation: Having been asked by Caitanya Mahāprabhu why the goddess of fortune could not enter into the rāsa dance whereas the authorities on Vedic knowledge could, Vyeṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa replied, "I cannot enter into the mysteries of this behavior."

devanagari: आमि जीव , - क्षुद्र - बुद्धि, सहजे अस्थिर ।
ईश्वरेर लीला - कोटि - समुद्र - गम्भीर ॥125॥
cc-madhya-9.125.translation: Vyeṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa then admitted, "I am an ordinary human being. Since my intelligence is very limited and I am easily agitated, my mind cannot enter within the deep ocean of the pastimes of the Lord.

lines: tumi sākṣāt sei kṛṣṇa, jāna nija-karma
yāre jānāha, sei jāne tomāra līlā-marma
devanagari: तुमि साक्षात्सेइ कृष्ण, जान निज - कर्म ।
यारे जानाह, सेइ जाने तोमार लीला - मर्म ॥126॥
cc-madhya-9.126.translation: "You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa Himself. You know the purpose of Your activities, and the person whom You enlighten can also understand Your pastimes."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - कृष्णेर एक स्वभाव विलक्षण ।
स्व - माधुर्ये सर्व चित्त करे आकर्षण ॥127॥
cc-madhya-9.127.translation: The Lord replied, "Lord Kṛṣṇa has a specific characteristic: He attracts everyone's heart by the mellow of His personal conjugal love.

lines: tāṅre īśvara kari' nāhi jāne vraja-jana
devanagari: व्रज - लोकेर भावे पाइये ताँहार चरण ।
ताँरे ईश्वर क रि’ नाहि जाने व्रज - जन ॥128॥
cc-madhya-9.128.translation: "By following in the footsteps of the inhabitants of the planet known as Vrajaloka or Goloka Vṛndāvana one can attain the shelter of the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. However, in that planet the inhabitants do not know that Lord Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

lines: keha sakhā-jñāne jini' caḍe tāṅra kāndhe
devanagari: केह ताँरे पुत्र - ज्ञाने उदुखले बान्धे ।
केह सखा - ज्ञाने जि नि’ चड़े ताँर कान्धे ॥129॥
cc-madhya-9.129.translation: "There someone may accept Him as a son and sometimes bind Him to a grinding mortar. Someone else may accept Him as an intimate friend and, attaining victory over Him, playfully mount His shoulders.

lines: rāma! rāghava! rāma! rāghava! rāma! rāghava! pāhi mām
kṛṣṇa! keśava! kṛṣṇa! keśava! kṛṣṇa! keśava! rakṣa mām
devanagari: राम! राघव! रा म! राघव! राम! राघव! पाहि माम् ।
कृष्ण! केशव! कृष्ण! केशव! कृष्ण! केशव! रक्ष माम् ॥13॥
cc-madhya-9.13.translation: “ 'O Lord Rāmacandra, descendant of Mahārāja Raghu, kindly protect me! O Lord Kṛṣṇa, killer of the Keśī demon, kindly protect me!' "

devanagari: ‘व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन’ बलि’ ताँरे जाने व्रज - जन ।
ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञाने नाहि कोन सम्बन्ध - मानन ॥130॥
cc-madhya-9.130.translation: "The inhabitants of Vrajabhūmi know Kṛṣṇa as the son of Mahārāja Nanda, the King of Vrajabhūmi, and they consider that there can be no relationship with the Lord in the rasa of opulence.

devanagari: व्रज - लोकेर भावे येइ करये भजन ।
सेइ जन पाय व्रजे व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन ॥131॥
cc-madhya-9.131.translation: "One who worships the Lord by following in the footsteps of the inhabitants of Vrajabhūmi attains the Lord and gets to know Him as He is known in the transcendental planet of Vraja. There He is known as the son of Mahārāja Nanda."

devanagari: नायं सुखापो भगवान्देहिनां गोपिका - सुतः ।
ज्ञानिनां चात्म - भूतानां यथा भक्ति - मतामिह ॥132॥
cc-madhya-9.132.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu then quoted, " 'The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, the son of mother Yaśodā, is accessible to those devotees engaged in spontaneous loving service, but He is not as easily accessible to mental speculators, to those striving for self-realization by severe austerities and penances, or to those who consider the body the same as the self.'

devanagari: श्रुति - गण गोपी - गणेर अनुगत हञा ।
व्रजेश्वरी - सुत भजे गोपी - भाव ल ञा ॥133॥
cc-madhya-9.133.translation: "The authorities in vedic literatures known as śruti-gaṇa worshiped Lord Kṛṣṇa in the ecstasy of the gopīs and followed in their footsteps.

devanagari: बाह्यान्तरे गोपी - देह व्रजे यबे पाइल ।
सेइ देहे कृष्ण - सङ्गे रास - क्रीड़ा कैल ॥134॥
cc-madhya-9.134.translation: "The personified authorities on the Vedic hymns acquired bodies like those of the gopīs and took birth in Vrajabhūmi. In those bodies they were allowed to enter into the Lord's rāsa-līlā dance.

lines: devī vā anya strī kṛṣṇa nā kare aṅgīkāra
devanagari: गोप - जाति कृष्ण, गोपी - प्रेयसी ताँहार ।
देवी वा अन्य स्त्री कृष्ण ना करे अङ्गीकार ॥135॥
cc-madhya-9.135.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa belongs to the cowherd community, and the gopīs are the dearmost lovers of Kṛṣṇa. Although the wives of the denizens of the heavenly planets are most opulent within the material world, neither they nor any other women in the material universe can acquire Kṛṣṇa's association.

lines: lakṣmī cāhe sei dehe kṛṣṇera saṅgama
devanagari: लक्ष्मी चाहे सेइ देहे कृष्णेर सङ्गम ।
गोपिका - अनुगा हञा ना कैल भजन ॥136॥
cc-madhya-9.136.translation: "The goddess of fortune, Lakṣmī, wanted to enjoy Kṛṣṇa and at the same time retain her spiritual body in the form of Lakṣmī. However, she did not follow in the footsteps of the gopīs in her worship of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: अन्य देहे ना पाइये रास - विलास ।
अतएव ‘नायं’ श्लोक कहे वेद - व्यास ॥137॥
cc-madhya-9.137.translation: "Vyāsadeva, the supreme authority on Vedic literature, composed a verse beginning 'nāyaṁ sukhāpo bhagavān' because no one can enter into the rāsa-līlā dance in any body other than the bodies of the gopīs."

lines: pūrve bhaṭṭera mane eka chila abhimāna
devanagari: पूर्वे भट्टर मने एक छिल अभिमान ।
‘श्री - नाराय ण’ हयेन स्वयं - भगवान् ॥138॥
cc-madhya-9.138.translation: Before this explanation was given by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Vyeṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa thought that Śrī Nārāyaṇa was the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

devanagari: ताँहार भजन सर्वोपरि - कक्षा हय ।
श्री - वैष्णवे’र भजन एइ सर्वोपरि हय ॥139॥
cc-madhya-9.139.translation: Thinking in this way, Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa believed that worship of Nārāyaṇa was the supreme form of worship, superior to all other processes of devotional service, for it was followed by the Śrī Vaiṣṇava disciples of Rāmānujācārya.

lines: ei śloka pathe paḍi' karilā prayāṇa
devanagari: एइ श्लोक पथे प ड़ि’ करिला प्रयाण ।
गौतमी - गङ्गाय याइ’ कैल गङ्गा - स्नान ॥14॥
cc-madhya-9.14.translation: While walking on the road, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to chant this Rāma Rāghava mantra. Chanting in this way, He arrived at the banks of the Gautamī-gaṅgā and took His bath there.

lines: ei tāṅra garva prabhu karite khaṇḍana
devanagari: एइ ताँर गर्व प्रभु करिते खण्डन ।
परिहास - द्वारे उठाय एतेक वचन ॥140॥
cc-madhya-9.140.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had understood this misconception of Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa's, and to correct it the Lord talked so much in a joking way.

lines: prabhu kahe,—bhaṭṭa, tumi nā kariha saṁśaya
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - भट्ट, तुमि ना करिह संशय ।
‘स्वयं - भगवान् कृष्ण एइ त निश्चय ॥141॥
cc-madhya-9.141.translation: The Lord then continued, "My dear Vyeṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa, please do not continue doubting. Lord Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, and this is the conclusion of Vedic literatures.

devanagari: कृष्णेर विलास - मूर्ति - श्री - नारायण ।
अतएव लक्ष्मी - आद्येर हरे तेंह मन ॥142॥
cc-madhya-9.142.translation: "Lord Nārāyaṇa, the opulent form of Kṛṣṇa, attracts the mind of the goddess of fortune and her followers.

devanagari: एते चांश - कलाः पुंसः कृष्णस्तु भगवान्स्वयम् ।
इन्द्रारि - व्याकुलं लोकं मृड़यन्ति युगे युगे ॥143॥
cc-madhya-9.143.translation: “ 'All these incarnations of Godhead are either plenary portions or parts of the plenary portions of the puruṣa-avatāras. But Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself. In every age He protects the world through His different features when the world is disturbed by the enemies of Indra.'

devanagari: नारायण हैते कृष्णेर असाधारण गुण ।
अतएव लक्ष्मीर कृष्णे तृष्णा अनुक्षण ॥144॥
cc-madhya-9.144.translation: "Because Kṛṣṇa has four extraordinary qualities not possessed by Lord Nārāyaṇa, the goddess of fortune, Lakṣmī, always desires His company.

lines: tumi ye paḍilā śloka, se haya pramāṇa
devanagari: तुमि ये पड़िला श्लोक, से हय प्रमाण ।
सेइ श्लोके आइसे ‘कृष्ण - स्वयं भगवान्’ ॥145॥
cc-madhya-9.145.translation: "You have recited the śloka beginning with 'siddhāntatas tv abhede 'pi.' That very verse is evidence that Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

devanagari: सिद्धान्ततस्त्वभेदेऽपि श्रीश - कृष्ण - स्वरूपयोः ।
रसेनोत्कृष्यते कृष्ण - रूपमेषा रस - स्थितिः ॥146॥
cc-madhya-9.146.translation: “ 'According to transcendental realization, there is no difference between the forms of Kṛṣṇa and Nārāyaṇa. Yet in Kṛṣṇa there is a special transcendental attraction due to the conjugal mellow, and consequently He surpasses Nārāyaṇa. This is the conclusion of transcendental mellows.'

devanagari: स्वयं भगवान् कृष्ण हरे लक्ष्मीर मन ।
गोपिकार मन हरिते नारे ‘नाराय ण’ ॥147॥
cc-madhya-9.147.translation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, attracts the mind of the goddess of fortune, but Lord Nārāyaṇa cannot attract the minds of the gopīs. This proves the superexcellence of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: नारायणेर का कथा, श्री कृष्ण आपने ।
गोपिकारे हास्य कराइते हय ‘नारायणे’ ॥148॥
cc-madhya-9.148.translation: "To say nothing of Lord Nārāyaṇa personally, Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself appeared as Nārāyaṇa just to play a joke on the gopīs.

devanagari: ‘चतुर्भुज - मूर्ति’ देखाय गोपी - गणेर आगे ।
सेइ ‘कृष्णे’ गोपिकार नहे अनुरागे ॥149॥
cc-madhya-9.149.translation: "Although Kṛṣṇa assumed the four-armed form of Nārāyaṇa, He could not attract the serious attention of the gopīs in ecstatic love.

devanagari: मल्लिकार्जुन - तीर्थे याइ’ महेश देखिल ।
ताहाँ सब लोके कृष्ण - नाम लओयाइल ॥15॥
cc-madhya-9.15.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then went to Mallikārjuna-tīrtha and saw the deity of Lord Śiva there. He also induced all the people to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra.

lines: gopīnāṁ paśupendra-nandana-juṣo bhāvasya kas tāṁ kṛtī
āviṣkurvati vaiṣṇavīm api tanuṁ tasmin bhujair jiṣṇubhir
yāsāṁ hanta caturbhir adbhuta-ruciṁ rāgodayaḥ kuñcati
devanagari: गोपीनां पशुपेन्द्र - नन्दन - जुषो भावस्य कस्तां कृती विज्ञातुं क्षमते दुरूह - पदवी - सञ्चारिणः प्रक्रियाम् ।
आविष्कुर्वति वैष्णवीमपि तनुं तस्मिन्भुजैर्जीष्णुभिर् यासां हन्त चतुर्भिरद्भुत - रुचिं रागोदयः कुञ्चति ॥150॥
cc-madhya-9.150.translation: “ 'Once Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa playfully manifested Himself as Nārāyaṇa, with four victorious hands and a very beautiful form. When the gopīs saw this exalted form, however, their ecstatic feelings abated. A learned scholar, therefore, cannot understand the gopīs' ecstatic feelings, which are firmly centered upon the original form of Lord Kṛṣṇa as the son of Nanda Mahārāja. The wonderful feelings of the gopīs in ecstatic parama-rasa with Kṛṣṇa constitute the greatest mystery of spiritual life.' "

lines: eta kahi' prabhu tāṅra garva cūrṇa kariyā
tāṅre sukha dite kahe siddhānta phirāiyā
devanagari: एत क हि’ प्रभु ताँर गर्व चूर्ण करिया ।
ताँरे सुख दिते कहे सिद्धान्त फिराइया ॥151॥
cc-madhya-9.151.translation: In this way Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu deflated the pride of Vyeṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa, but just to make him happy again, He spoke as follows.

lines: duḥkha nā bhāviha, bhaṭṭa, kailuṅ parihāsa
devanagari: दुःख ना भाविह, भट्ट, कैलुँ परिहास ।
शास्त्र - सिद्धान्त शुन, याते वैष्णव - विश्वास ॥152॥
cc-madhya-9.152.translation: The Lord pacified Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa by saying, "Actually whatever I have said is by way of jest. Now you can hear from Me the conclusion of the śāstras, in which every Vaiṣṇava devotee has firm faith.

devanagari: कृष्ण - नारायण, यैछे एकइ स्वरूप ।
गोपी - लक्ष्मी - भेद नाहि हय एक - रूप ॥153॥
cc-madhya-9.153.translation: "There is no difference between Lord Kṛṣṇa and Lord Nārāyaṇa, for They are of the same form. Similarly, there is no difference between the gopīs and the goddess of fortune, for they also are of the same form.

devanagari: गोपी - द्वारे लक्ष्मी करे कृष्ण - सङ्गास्वाद ।
ईश्वरत्वे भेद मानिले हय अपराध ॥154॥
cc-madhya-9.154.translation: "The goddess of fortune enjoys the association of Kṛṣṇa through the gopīs. One should not make distinctions between the forms of the Lord, for such conceptualizing is offensive.

devanagari: एक ईश्वर - भक्तेर ध्यान - अनुरूप ।
एकइ विग्रहे करे नानाकार रूप ॥155॥
cc-madhya-9.155.translation: "There is no difference between the transcendental forms of the Lord. Different forms are manifest due to different attachments of different devotees. Actually the Lord is one, but He appears in different forms just to satisfy His devotees.

devanagari: मणिर्यथा विभागेन नील - पीतादिभिर्युतः ।
रूप - भेदमवाप्नोति ध्यान - भेदात्तथाच्युतः ॥156॥
cc-madhya-9.156.translation: “ 'When the jewel known as vaidūrya touches other materials, it appears to be separated into different colors. consequently the forms also appear different. Similarly, according to the meditational ecstasy of the devotee, the Lord, who is known as Acyuta [infallible], appears in different forms, although He is essentially one.' "

devanagari: भट्ट कहे , - काहाँ आमि जीव पामर ।
काहाँ तुमि सेइ कृष्ण, - साक्षातीश्वर ॥157॥
cc-madhya-9.157.translation: Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa then said, "I am an ordinary fallen living entity, but You are Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself.

lines: tumi yei kaha, sei satya kari' māni
devanagari: अगाध ईश्वर - लीला किछुइ ना जानि ।
तुमि येइ कह, सेइ सत्य क रि’ मानि ॥158॥
cc-madhya-9.158.translation: "The transcendental pastimes of the Lord are unfathomable, and I do not know anything about them. Whatever You say I accept as the truth.

devanagari: मोरे पूर्ण कृपा कैल लक्ष्मी - नारायण ।
ताँर कृपाय पाइनु तोमार चरण - दरशन ॥159॥
cc-madhya-9.159.translation: "I have been engaged in the service of Lakṣmī-Nārāyaṇa, and it is due to Their mercy that I have been able to see Your lotus feet.

devanagari: रामदास महादेवे करिल दरशन ।
अहोवल - नृसिंहेरे करिला गमन ॥16॥
cc-madhya-9.16.translation: There he saw Lord Mahādeva [Śiva], the servant of Lord Rāma. He then went to Ahovala-nṛsiṁha.

lines: kṛpā kari' kahile more kṛṣṇera mahimā
yāṅra rūpa-guṇaiśvaryera keha nā pāya sīmā
devanagari: कृपा करि’ कहिले मोरे कृष्णेर महिमा ।
याँर रूप - गुणैश्वर्येर केह ना पाय सीमा ॥160॥
cc-madhya-9.160.translation: "Out of Your causeless mercy You have told me of the glories of Lord Kṛṣṇa. No one can reach the end of the opulence, qualities and forms of the Lord.

lines: kṛtārtha karile, more kahile kṛpā kari'
devanagari: एबे से जानिनु कृष्ण - भक्ति सर्वोपरि ।
कृतार्थ करिले, मोरे कहिले कृपा करि’ ॥161॥
cc-madhya-9.161.translation: "I can now understand that devotional service unto Kṛṣṇa is the supreme form of worship. Out of Your causeless mercy You have made my life successful simply by explaining the facts."

lines: eta bali' bhaṭṭa paḍilā prabhura caraṇe
kṛpā kari' prabhu tāṅre kailā āliṅgane
devanagari: एत बलि’ भट्ट पड़िला प्रभुर चरणे ।
कृपा करि’ प्रभु ताँरे कैला आलिङ्गने ॥162॥
cc-madhya-9.162.translation: After saying this, Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa fell down before the lotus feet of the Lord, and the Lord, out of His causeless mercy, embraced him.

devanagari: चातुर्मास्य पूर्ण हैल, भट्ट - आज्ञा लञा ।
दक्षिण चलिला प्रभु श्री - रङ्ग देखिया ॥163॥
cc-madhya-9.163.translation: When the period of Cāturmāsya was completed, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took permission to leave Vyeṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa, and after visiting Śrī Raṅga He proceeded further toward southern India.

lines: saṅgete calilā bhaṭṭa, nā yāya bhavane
tāṅre vidāya dilā prabhu aneka yatane
devanagari: सङ्क्ते चलिला भट्ट, ना याय भवने ।
ताँरे विदाय दिला प्रभु अनेक यतने ॥164॥
cc-madhya-9.164.translation: Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa did not want to return home but also wanted to go with the Lord. It was with great endeavor that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bade him farewell.

devanagari: प्रभुर वियोगे भट्ट हैल अचेतन ।
एइ रङ्ग - लीला करे शचीर नन्दन ॥165॥
cc-madhya-9.165.translation: When He did so, Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa fell down unconscious. Such are the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of mother Śacī, at Śrī Raṅga-kṣetra.

devanagari: ऋषभ - पर्वते च लि’ आइला गौरहरि ।
नारायण देखिला ताँहा नति - स्तुति करि’ ॥166॥
cc-madhya-9.166.translation: When the Lord arrived at Ṛṣabha Hill, He saw the temple of Lord Nārāyaṇa and offered obeisances and various prayers.

devanagari: परमानन्द - पुरी ताहाँ रहे चतुर्मास ।
शुनि’ महाप्रभु गेला पुरी - गोसाञि र पाश ॥167॥
cc-madhya-9.167.translation: Paramānanda Purī was staying at Ṛṣabha Hill, and when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this, He immediately went to see him.

lines: preme purī gosāñi tāṅre kaila āliṅgana
devanagari: पुरी - गोसाञि र प्रभु कैल चरण वन्दन ।
प्रेमे पुरी गोसाञि ताँरे कैल आलिङ्गन ॥168॥
cc-madhya-9.168.translation: Upon meeting Paramānanda Purī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered him all respects, touching his lotus feet, and Paramānanda Purī embraced the Lord in ecstasy.

devanagari: तिन - दिन प्रेमे दोंहे कृष्ण - कथा - रङ्गे ।
सेइ विप्र - घरे दोंहे रहे एक - सङ्गे ॥169॥
cc-madhya-9.169.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed with Paramānanda Purī in a brāhmaṇa's house where he was residing. Both of them passed three days there discussing topics of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: नृसिंह देखिया ताँरे कैल नति - स्तुति ।
सिद्धवट गेला याहाँ मूर्ति सीतापति ॥17॥
cc-madhya-9.17.translation: After seeing the Ahovala-nṛsiṁha Deity, Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered many prayers unto the Lord. He then went to Siddhavaṭa, where He saw the Deity of Rāmacandra, the Lord of Sītādevī.

devanagari: पुरी - गोसाञि बले, - आमि याब पुरुषोत्तमे ।
पुरुषोत्तम देखि’ गौड़े याब गङ्गा - स्नाने ॥170॥
cc-madhya-9.170.translation: Paramānanda Purī informed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that he was going to see Puruṣottama at Jagannātha Purī. After seeing Lord Jagannātha there, he would go to Bengal to bathe in the Ganges.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - तुमि पुनः आइस नीलाचले ।
आमि सेतुबन्ध हैते आसिब अल्प - काले ॥171॥
cc-madhya-9.171.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then told him, "Please return to Jagannātha Purī, for I will return there very soon from Rāmeśvara [Setubandha].

devanagari: तोमार निकटे रहि , - हेन वाञ्छा हय ।
नीलाचले आसिबे मोरे हञा सदयं ॥172॥
cc-madhya-9.172.translation: "It is My desire to stay with you, and therefore if you would return to Jagannātha Purī, you would show great mercy to Me."

lines: eta bali' tāṅra ṭhāñi ei ājñā lañā
devanagari: एत ब लि’ ताँर ठाञि एइ आज्ञा लञा ।
दक्षिणे चलिला प्रभु हरषित हञा ॥173॥
cc-madhya-9.173.translation: After talking in this way with Paramānanda Purī, the Lord took his permission to leave and departed for southern India. The Lord Himself was very pleased.

devanagari: परमानन्द पुरी तबे चलिला नीलाचले ।
महाप्रभु चलि चलि आइला श्री - शैले ॥174॥
cc-madhya-9.174.translation: Thus Paramānanda Purī started for Jagannātha Purī, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began walking toward Śrī Śaila.

devanagari: शिव - दुर्गा रहे ताहाँ ब्राह्मणेर वेशे ।
महाप्रभु देखि’ दोंहार हइल उल्ला से ॥175॥
cc-madhya-9.175.translation: It was in Śrī Śaila that Lord Śiva and his wife Durgā lived in the dress of brāhmaṇas, and when they saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they became very much pleased.

lines: tina dina bhikṣā dila kari' nimantraṇa
nibhṛte vasi' gupta-vārtā kahe dui jana
devanagari: तिन दिन भिक्षा दिल क रि’ निमन्त्रण ।
निभृते वसि’ गुप्त - वार्ता कहे दुइ जन ॥176॥
cc-madhya-9.176.translation: Lord Śiva, dressed like a brāhmaṇa, gave alms to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and invited Him to spend three days in a solitary place. Sitting there together, they talked very confidentially.

lines: tāṅra ājñā lañā āilā purī kāmakoṣṭhī
devanagari: ताँर सङ्गे महाप्रभु करि इष्टगोष्ठी ।
ताँर आज्ञा लञा आइला पुरी कामकोष्ठी ॥177॥
cc-madhya-9.177.translation: After talking with Lord Śiva, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took his permission to leave and went to Kāmakoṣṭhī-purī.

devanagari: दक्षिण - मथुरा आइला कामकोष्ठी हैते ।
ताहाँ देखा हैल एक ब्राह्मण - सहिते ॥178॥
cc-madhya-9.178.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at southern Mathurā from Kāmakoṣṭhī, He met a brāhmaṇa.

devanagari: सेइ विप्र महाप्रभुके कैल निमन्त्रण ।
राम - भक्त सेइ विप्र - विरक्त महाजन ॥179॥
cc-madhya-9.179.translation: The brāhmaṇa who met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu invited the Lord to his home. This brāhmaṇa was a great devotee and an authority on Lord Śrī Rāmacandra. He was always detached from material activities.

lines: tāhāṅ eka vipra prabhura kaila nimantraṇa
devanagari: रघुनाथ देखि’ कैल प्रणति स्तवन ।
ताहाँ एक विप्र प्रभुर कैल निमन्त्रण ॥18॥
cc-madhya-9.18.translation: After seeing the Deity of Lord Rāmacandra, the descendant of King Raghu, the Lord offered His prayers and obeisances. Then a brāhmaṇa invited the Lord to take lunch.

lines: kṛtamālāya snāna kari' āilā tāṅra ghare
bhikṣā ki dibena vipra,—pāka nāhi kare
devanagari: कृतमालाय स्नान करि’ आइला ताँर घरे ।
भिक्षा कि दिबेन विप्र , - पाक नाहि करे ॥180॥
cc-madhya-9.180.translation: After bathing in the river Kṛtamālā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the brāhmaṇa's house, but before taking lunch, He saw that the food was unprepared because the brāhmaṇa had not cooked it.

lines: madhyāhna haila, kene pāka nāhi haya
devanagari: महाप्रभु कहे ताँरे, - शुन महाशय ।
मध्याह्न हैल, केने पाक नाहि हय ॥181॥
cc-madhya-9.181.translation: Seeing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "My dear sir, please tell Me why you have not cooked. It is already noon."

lines: pākera sāmagrī vane nā mile samprati
devanagari: विप्र कहे , - प्रभु, मोर अरण्ये वसति ।
पाकेर सामग्री वने ना मिले सम्प्रति ॥182॥
cc-madhya-9.182.translation: The brāhmaṇa replied, "My dear Lord, we are living in the forest. For the time being we cannot get all the ingredients for cooking.

devanagari: वन्य शाक - फल - मूल आनिबे लक्ष्मण ।
तबे सीता करिबेन पाक - प्रयोजन ॥183॥
cc-madhya-9.183.translation: "When Lakṣmaṇa brings all the vegetables, fruits and roots from the forest, Sītā will arrange the necessary cooking."

lines: tāṅra upāsanā śuni' prabhu tuṣṭa hailā
devanagari: ताँर उपासना शुनि’ प्रभु तुष्ट हैला ।
आस्ते - व्यस्ते सेइ विप्र रन्धन करिला ॥184॥
cc-madhya-9.184.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very satisfied to hear about the brāhmaṇa's method of worship. Finally the brāhmaṇa hastily made arrangements for cooking.

devanagari: प्रभु भिक्षा कैल दिनेर तृतीय - प्रहरे ।
निर्विण्ण सेइ विप्र उपवास करे ॥185॥
cc-madhya-9.185.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took His lunch at about three o'clock, but the brāhmaṇa, being very sorrowful, fasted.

lines: kene eta duḥkha, kene karaha hutāśa
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - विप्र काँहे कर उपवास ।
केने एत दुःख, केने करह हुताश ॥186॥
cc-madhya-9.186.translation: While the brāhmaṇa was fasting, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked him, "Why are you fasting? Why are you so unhappy? Why are you so worried?"

devanagari: विप्र कहे , - जीवने मोर नाहि प्रयोजन ।
अग्नि - जले प्रवेशिया छाड़िब जीवन ॥187॥
cc-madhya-9.187.translation: The brāhmaṇa replied, "I have no reason to live. I shall give up my life by entering either fire or water.

devanagari: जगन्माता महा - लक्ष्मी सीता - ठाकुराणी ।
राक्षसे स्पर्शिल ताँरे , - इहा काने शुनि ॥188॥
cc-madhya-9.188.translation: "My dear Sir, mother Sītā is the mother of the universe and the supreme goddess of fortune. She has been touched by the demon Rāvaṇa, and I am troubled upon hearing this news.

lines: e śarīra dharibāre kabhu nā yuyāya
ei duḥkhe jvale deha, prāṇa nāhi yāya
devanagari: ए शरीर धरिबारे कभु ना युयाय ।
एइ दुःखे ज्वले देह, प्राण नाहि याय ॥189॥
cc-madhya-9.189.translation: "Sir, due to my unhappiness I cannot continue living. Although my body is burning, my life is not leaving."

devanagari: सेइ विप्र राम - नाम निरन्तर लय ।
‘राम’ ‘राम’ विना अन्य वाणी ना कहय ॥19॥
cc-madhya-9.19.translation: That brāhmaṇa constantly chanted the holy name of Rāmacandra. Indeed, but for chanting Lord Rāmacandra's holy name, that brāhmaṇa did not speak a word.

lines: prabhu kahe,—e bhāvanā nā kariha āra
paṇḍita hañā kene nā karaha vicāra
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - ए भावना ना करिह आर ।
पण्डित हञा केने ना करह विचार ॥190॥
cc-madhya-9.190.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Please do not think this way any longer. You are a learned paṇḍita. Why don't you consider the case?"

devanagari: ईश्वर - प्रेयसी सीता - चिदानन्द - मूर्ति ।
प्राकृत - इन्द्रियेर ताँरे देखिते नाहि शक्ति ॥191॥
cc-madhya-9.191.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "Sītādevī, the dearmost wife of the Supreme Lord Rāmacandra, certainly has a spiritual form full of bliss. No one can see her with material eyes, for no one material has such power.

lines: sparśibāra kārya āchuka, nā pāya darśana
devanagari: स्पर्शिबार कार्य आछुक, ना पाय दर्शन ।
सीतार आकृति - माया हरिल रावण ॥192॥
cc-madhya-9.192.translation: "To say nothing of touching mother Sītā, a person with material senses cannot even see her. When Rāvaṇa kidnapped her, he kidnapped only her material, illusory form.

devanagari: रावण आसितेइ सीता अन्तर्धान कैल ।
रावणेर आगे माया - सीता पाठाइल ॥193॥
cc-madhya-9.193.translation: "As soon as Rāvaṇa arrived before Sītā, she disappeared. It was just to cheat Rāvaṇa she sent an illusory, material form.

devanagari: अप्राकत वस्तु नहे प्राकत - गोचर ।
वेद - पुराणेते एइ कहे निरन्तर ॥194॥
cc-madhya-9.194.translation: "Spiritual substance is never within the jurisdiction of the material conception. This is always the verdict of the Vedas and Purāṇas."

devanagari: विश्वास करह तुमि आमार वचने ।
पुनरपि कु - भावना ना करिह मने ॥195॥
cc-madhya-9.195.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then assured the brāhmaṇa, "Have faith in My words and do not burden your mind any longer with this misconception."

devanagari: प्रभुर वचने विप्रेर हइल विश्वास ।
भोजन करिल, हैल जीवनेर आश ॥196॥
cc-madhya-9.196.translation: Although the brāhmaṇa was fasting, he had faith in the words of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and accepted food. In this way his life was saved.

devanagari: ताँरे आश्वासिया प्रभु करिला गमन ।
कृतमालाय स्नान करि आइला दुर्वशन ॥197॥
cc-madhya-9.197.translation: After thus assuring the brāhmaṇa, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu proceeded further into southern India and finally arrived at Durvaśana, where He bathed in the river Kṛtamālā.

devanagari: दुर्वशने रघुनाथे कैल दरशन ।
महेन्द्र - शैले परशुरामेर कैल वन्दन ॥198॥
cc-madhya-9.198.translation: At Durvaśana Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the temple of Lord Rāmacandra, and on the hill known as Mahendra-śaila He saw Lord Paraśurāma.

devanagari: सेतुबन्धे आसि’ कैल धनुस्तीर्थे स्नान ।
रामेश्वर देखि ताहाँ करिल विश्राम ॥199॥
cc-madhya-9.199.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then went to Setubandha [Rāmeśvara], where He took His bath at a place called Dhanustīrtha. From there He visited the Rāmeśvara temple and then took rest.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-madhya-9.2.translation: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Śrī Advaita Prabhu! And all glories to the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

lines: sei dina tāṅra ghare rahi' bhikṣā kari'
tāṅre kṛpā kari' āge calilā gaurahari
devanagari: सेइ दिन ताँर घरे र हि’ भिक्षा क रि’ ।
ताँरे कृपा करि’ आगे चलिला गौरहरि ॥20॥
cc-madhya-9.20.translation: That day, Lord Caitanya remained there and accepted prasāda at his house. After bestowing mercy upon him in this way, the Lord proceeded ahead.

devanagari: विप्र - सभाय शुने ताँहा कूर्म - पुराण ।
तार मध्ये आइला पतिव्रता - उपाख्यान ॥200॥
cc-madhya-9.200.translation: There, among the brāhmaṇas, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard the Kūrma Purāṇa, wherein was mentioned the chaste woman's narration.

devanagari: पतिव्रता - शिरोमणि जनक - नन्दिनी ।
जगतेर माता सीता - रामेर गृहिणी ॥201॥
cc-madhya-9.201.translation: Śrīmatī Sītādevī is the mother of the three worlds and the wife of Lord Rāmacandra. Among chaste women she is supreme, and she is the daughter of King Janaka.

lines: rāvaṇa dekhiyā sītā laila agnira śaraṇa
rāvaṇa haite agni kaila sītāke āvaraṇa
devanagari: रावण देखिया सीता लैल अग्निर शरण ।
रावण हैते अग्नि कैल सीताके आवरण ॥202॥
cc-madhya-9.202.translation: When Rāvaṇa came to kidnap mother Sītā and she saw him, she took shelter of the fire-god, Agni. The fire-god covered the body of mother Sītā, and in this way she was protected from the hands of Rāvaṇa.

devanagari: ‘माया - सीता’ रावण निल, शुनिला आख्याने ।
शुनि’ महाप्रभु हैल आनन्दित मने ॥203॥
cc-madhya-9.203.translation: Upon hearing from the Kūrma Purāṇa how Rāvaṇa had kidnapped the false form of mother Sītā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became very much satisfied.

devanagari: सीता ल ञा राखिलेन पार्वतीर स्थाने ।
‘माया - सीता’ दिया अग्नि वञ्चिला रावणे ॥204॥
cc-madhya-9.204.translation: The fire-god, Agni, took away the real Sītā and brought her to the place of Pārvatī, goddess Durgā. An illusory form of mother Sītā was then delivered to Rāvaṇa, and in this way Rāvaṇa was cheated.

devanagari: रघुनाथ आसि’ यबे रावणे मारिल ।
अग्नि - परीक्षा दिते यबे सीतारे आनिल ॥205॥
cc-madhya-9.205.translation: After Rāvaṇa was killed by Lord Rāmacandra, Sītādevī was brought before the fire.

devanagari: तबे माया - सीता अग्नि करि अन्तर्धान ।
सत्य - सीता आ नि’ दिल राम - विद्यमान ॥206॥
cc-madhya-9.206.translation: When the illusory Sītā was brought before the fire by Lord Rāmacandra, the fire-god made the illusory form disappear and delivered the real Sītā to Lord Rāmacandra.

devanagari: शुनिञा प्रभुर आनन्दित हैल मन ।
रामदास - विप्रेर कथा हइल स्मरण ॥207॥
cc-madhya-9.207.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this story, He was very pleased, and He remembered the words of Rāmadāsa Vipra.

lines: e-saba siddhānta śuni' prabhura ānanda haila
brāhmaṇera sthāne māgi' sei patra nila
devanagari: ए - सब सिद्धान्त शुनि’ प्रभुर आनन्द हैल ।
ब्राह्मणेर स्थाने मा गि’ सेइ पत्र निल ॥208॥
cc-madhya-9.208.translation: Indeed, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these conclusive statements from Kūrma Purāṇa, He felt great happiness. After asking the brāhmaṇas' permission, He took possession of those manuscript leaves.

lines: pratīti lāgi' purātana patra māgi' nila
devanagari: नूतन पत्र लेखाञा पुस्तके देओयाइल ।
प्रतीति ला गि’ पुरातन पत्र मागि’ निल ॥209॥
cc-madhya-9.209.translation: Since the Kūrma Purāṇa was very old, the manuscript was also very old. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took possession of the original leaves in order to have direct evidence. The text was copied on to a new scroll in order that the Purāṇa be replaced.

devanagari: स्कन्द - क्षेत्र - तीर्थे कैल स्कन्द दरशन ।
त्रिमठ आइला, ताहाँ दे खि’ त्रिविक्रम ॥21॥
cc-madhya-9.21.translation: At the holy place known as Skanda-kṣetra, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the temple of Skanda. From there He went to Trimaṭha, where He saw the Viṣṇu Deity Trivikrama.

lines: rāmadāsa vipre sei patra āni dilā
devanagari: पत्र लञा पुनः दक्षिण - मथुरा आइला ।
रामदास विप्रे सेइ पत्र आनि दिला ॥210॥
cc-madhya-9.210.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to southern Mathurā [Madura] and delivered the original manuscript of the Kūrma Purāṇa to Rāmadāsa Vipra.

devanagari: सीतयाराधितो वह्निश्छाया - सीतामजीजनत् ।
तां जहार दश - ग्रीवः सीता वह्नि - पुरं गता ॥211॥
cc-madhya-9.211-212.translation: "When he was petitioned by mother Sītā, the fire-god, Agni, brought forth an illusory form of Sītā, and Rāvaṇa, who had ten heads, kidnapped the false Sītā. The original Sītā then went to the abode of the fire-god. When Lord Rāmacandra tested the body of Sītā, it was the false, illusory Sītā that entered the fire. At that time the fire-god brought the original Sītā from his abode and delivered her to Lord Rāmacandra."

lines: patra pāñā viprera haila ānandita mana
devanagari: पत्र पाञा विप्रेर हैल आनन्दित मन ।
प्रभुर चरणे धरि’ करये क्रन्दन ॥213॥
cc-madhya-9.213.translation: Rāmadāsa Vipra was very pleased to receive the original scrolls of the Kūrma Purāṇa, and he immediately fell down before the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and began to cry.

devanagari: विप्र कहे, - तुमि साक्षात्श्री - रघुनन्दन ।
सन्न्यासी र वेषे मोरे दिला दरशन ॥214॥
cc-madhya-9.214.translation: After receiving the manuscript, the brāhmaṇa, being very pleased, said, "Sir, You are Lord Rāmacandra Himself and have come in the dress of a sannyāsī to give me audience.

lines: āji mora ghare bhikṣā kara aṅgīkāra
devanagari: महा - दुःख हइते मोरे करिला निस्तार ।
आजि मोर घरे भिक्षा कर अङ्गीकार ॥215॥
cc-madhya-9.215.translation: "My dear Sir, You have delivered me from a very unhappy condition. I request that You take Your lunch at my place. Please accept this invitation.

lines: mano-duḥkhe bhāla bhikṣā nā dila sei dine
devanagari: मनो - दुःखे भाल भिक्षा ना दिल सेइ दिने ।
मोर भाग्ये पुनरपि पाइलुँ दरशने ॥216॥
cc-madhya-9.216.translation: "Due to my mental distress I could not give You a very nice lunch the other day. Now, by good fortune, You have come again to my home."

lines: eta bali' sei vipra sukhe pāka kaila
devanagari: एत ब लि’ सेइ विप्र सुखे पाक कैल ।
उत्तम प्रकारे प्रभुके भिक्षा कराइल ॥217॥
cc-madhya-9.217.translation: Saying this, the brāhmaṇa very happily cooked food, and a first-class dinner was offered to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: sei rātri tāhāṅ rahi' tāṅre kṛpā kari'
devanagari: सेइ रात्रि ताहाँ र हि’ ताँरे कृपा करि’ ।
पाण्ड्य - देशे ताम्रपर्णी गेला गौरहरि ॥218॥
cc-madhya-9.218.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed that night in the house of the brāhmaṇa. Then, after showing him mercy, the Lord started toward Tāmraparṇī in Pāṇḍya-deśa.

devanagari: ताम्रपर्णी स्नान क रि’ ताम्रपर्णी - तीरे ।
नय त्रिपति दे खि’ बुले कुतूहले ॥219॥
cc-madhya-9.219.translation: There was also a temple of Lord Viṣṇu at Naya-tripati on the bank of the river Tāmraparṇī, and after bathing in the river, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the Deity with great curiosity and wandered on.

devanagari: पुनः सिद्धवट आइला सेइ विप्र - घरे ।
सेइ विप्र कृष्ण - नाम लय निरन्तरे ॥22॥
cc-madhya-9.22.translation: After visiting the temple of Trivikrama, the Lord returned to Siddhavaṭa, where He again visited the house of the brāhmaṇa, who was now constantly chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra.

devanagari: चियड़तला तीर्थे दे खि’ श्री - राम - लक्ष्मण ।
तिल - काञ्ची आ सि’ कैल शिव दरशन ॥220॥
cc-madhya-9.220.translation: After this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to a holy place known as Ciyaḍatalā, where He saw the Deities of the two brothers Lord Rāmacandra and Lakṣmaṇa. He then proceeded to Tila-kāñcī, where He saw the temple of Lord Śiva.

devanagari: गजेन्द्र - मोक्षण - तीर्थे देखि विष्णु - मूर्ति ।
पानागड़ि - तीर्थे आ सि’ देखिल सीतापति ॥221॥
cc-madhya-9.221.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then visited the holy place named Gajendra-mokṣaṇa, where He went to a temple of Lord Viṣṇu. He then came to Pānāgaḍi, a holy place where He saw the Deities of Lord Rāmacandra and Sītā.

devanagari: चाम्ता पुरे आसि’ देखि’ श्री - राम - लक्ष्मण ।
श्री - वैकुण्ठे आसि’ कैल विष्णु दरशन ॥222॥
cc-madhya-9.222.translation: Later the Lord went to Cāmtāpura, where He saw the Deities of Lord Rāmacandra and Lakṣmaṇa. He then went to Śrī Vaikuṇṭha and saw the temple of Lord Viṣṇu there.

devanagari: मलय - पर्वते कैल अगस्त्य - वन्दन ।
कन्या - कुमारी ताहाँ कैल दरशन ॥223॥
cc-madhya-9.223.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then went to Malaya-parvata and offered prayers to Agastya Muni. He then visited a place known as Kanyākumārī [presently Cape Comorin].

devanagari: आम्लितलाय दे खि’ श्री - राम गौरहरि ।
मल्लार - देशेते आइला यथा भट्टथारि ॥224॥
cc-madhya-9.224.translation: After visiting Kanyā-kumārī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came to Āmlitalā, where He saw the Deity of Śrī Rāmacandra. Thereafter He went to a place known as Mallāra-deśa, where a community of Bhaṭṭathāris lived.

devanagari: तमाल - कार्तिक दे खि’ आइल वेतापनि ।
रघुनाथ देखि’ ताहाँ वञ्चि ला रजनी ॥225॥
cc-madhya-9.225.translation: After visiting Mallāra-deśa, Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Tamāla-kārtika and then to Vetāpani. There He saw the temple of Raghunātha, Lord Rāmacandra, and passed the night.

devanagari: गोसाञि र सङ्गे रहे कृष्णदास ब्राह्मण ।
भट्टथारि - सह ताहाँ हैल दरशन ॥226॥
cc-madhya-9.226.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was accompanied by His servant, Kṛṣṇadāsa. He was a brāhmaṇa, but he met with the Bhaṭṭathāris there.

devanagari: स्त्री - धन देखा ञा ताँर लोभ जन्माइल ।
आर्य सरल विप्रेर बुद्धि - नाश कैल ॥227॥
cc-madhya-9.227.translation: The Bhaṭṭathāris allured the brāhmaṇa Kṛṣṇadāsa, who was simple and gentle. By virtue of their bad association, they polluted his intelligence.

devanagari: प्राते उ ठि’ आइला विप्र भट्टथारि - घरे ।
ताहार उद्देशे प्रभु आइला सत्वरे ॥228॥
cc-madhya-9.228.translation: The allured Kṛṣṇadāsa went to their place early in the morning. Just to find him out, the Lord also went there very quickly.

lines: āmāra brāhmaṇa tumi rākha ki kāraṇe
devanagari: आसिया कहेन सब भट्टथारि - गणे ।
आमार ब्राह्मण तुमि राख कि कारणे ॥229॥
cc-madhya-9.229.translation: Upon reaching their community, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked the Bhaṭṭathāris, "Why are you keeping My brāhmaṇa assistant?

lines: bhikṣā kari' mahāprabhu tāṅre praśna kaila
''kaha vipra, ei tomāra kon daśā haila
devanagari: भिक्षा क रि’ महाप्रभु ताँरे प्रश्न कैल ।
“कह विप्र, एइ तोमार कोन्दशा हैल” ॥23॥
cc-madhya-9.23.translation: After finishing His lunch there, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked the brāhmaṇa, "My dear friend, kindly tell Me what your position is now.

devanagari: आमिह सन्न्यासी देख, तुमिह सन्न्यासी ।
मोरे दुःख देह, - तोमार ‘न्याय’ नाहि वासि ॥230॥
cc-madhya-9.230.translation: "I am in the renounced order of life, and so are you. Yet you are purposefully giving Me pain, and I do not see any good logic in this."

lines: suna' saba bhaṭṭathāri uṭhe astra lañā
devanagari: शुनि’ सब भट्टथारि उठे अस्त्र लञा ।
मारिबारे आइल सबे चारि - दिके धा ञा ॥231॥
cc-madhya-9.231.translation: Upon hearing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the Bhaṭṭathāris came running, with weapons in their hands, desiring to hurt the Lord.

lines: tāra astra tāra aṅge paḍe hāta haite
khaṇḍa khaṇḍa haila bhaṭṭathāri palāya cāri bhite
devanagari: तार अत्र तार अङ्गे पड़े हात हैते ।
खण्ड खण्ड हैल भट्टथारि पलाय चारि भिते ॥232॥
cc-madhya-9.232.translation: However, their weapons fell from their hands and struck their own bodies. When some of the Bhaṭṭathāris were thus cut to pieces, the others ran away in the four directions.

lines: keśe dhari' vipre lañā karila gamana
devanagari: भट्टथारि - घरे महा उठिल क्रन्दन ।
केशे ध रि’ विप्रे लञा करिल गमन ॥233॥
cc-madhya-9.233.translation: While there was much roaring and crying at the Bhaṭṭathāri community, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu grabbed Kṛṣṇadāsa by the hair and took him away.

devanagari: सेइ दिन च लि’ आइला पयस्विनी - तीरे ।
स्नान क रि’ गेला आदि - केशव - मन्दिरे ॥234॥
cc-madhya-9.234.translation: That very night, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His assistant Kṛṣṇadāsa arrived at the bank of the Payasvinī River. They took their bath and then went to see the temple of Ādi-keśava.

lines: nati, stuti, nṛtya, gīta, bahuta karilā
devanagari: केशव देखिया प्रेमे आविष्ट हैला ।
नति, स्तुति, नृत्य, गीत, बहुत करिला ॥235॥
cc-madhya-9.235.translation: When the Lord saw the Ādi-keśava temple, He was immediately overwhelmed with ecstasy. Offering various obeisances and prayers, He chanted and danced.

devanagari: प्रेम दे खि’ लोके हैल महा - चमत्कार ।
सर्व - लोक कैल प्रभुर परम सत्कार ॥236॥
cc-madhya-9.236.translation: All the people there were greatly astonished to see the ecstatic pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. They all received the Lord very well.

devanagari: महा - भक्त - गण - सह ताहाँ गोष्ठी कैल ।
‘ब्रह्म - संहिताध्याय’ - पुँथि ताहाँ पाइल ॥237॥
cc-madhya-9.237.translation: In the temple of Ādi-keśava, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu discussed spiritual matters among highly advanced devotees. While there, He found a chapter of the Brahma-saṁhitā.

lines: puṅthi pāñā prabhura haila ānanda apāra
devanagari: पुँथि पाञा प्रभुर हैल आनन्द अपार ।
कम्पाश्रु - स्वेद - स्तम्भ - पुलक विकार ॥238॥
cc-madhya-9.238.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was greatly happy to find a chapter of that scripture, and symptoms of ecstatic transformation-trembling, tears, perspiration, trance and jubilation-were manifest in His body.

devanagari: सिद्धान्त - शास्त्र नाहि ‘ब्रह्म - संहिता’र सम ।
गोविन्द - महिमा ज्ञानेर परम कारण ॥239॥
cc-madhya-9.239-240.translation: There is no scripture equal to the Brahma-saṁhitā as far as the final spiritual conclusion is concerned. Indeed, that scripture is the supreme revelation of the glories of Lord Govinda, for it reveals the topmost knowledge about Him. Since all conclusions are briefly presented in Brahma-saṁhitā, it is essential among all the Vaiṣṇava scriptures.

devanagari: मध्य लीला 9.24 पूर्वे तुमि निरन्तर लैते राम - नाम ।
एबे केने निरन्तर लओ कृष्ण - नाम ॥24॥
cc-madhya-9.24.translation: "Formerly you were constantly chanting the holy name of Lord Rāma. Why are you now constantly chanting the holy name of Kṛṣṇa?"

lines: bahu yatne sei puṅthi nila lekhāiyā
devanagari: बहु यत्ने सेइ पुँथि निल लेखाइया ।
‘अनन्त पद्मनाभ’ आइला हरषित ह ञा ॥241॥
cc-madhya-9.241.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu copied the Brahma-saṁhitā and afterwards, with great pleasure, went to a place known as Ananta Padmanābha.

devanagari: दिन - दुइ पद्मनाभेर कैल दरशन ।
आनन्दे देखिते आइला श्री - जनार्दन ॥242॥
cc-madhya-9.242.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained for two or three days at Ananta Padmanābha and visited the temple there. Then, with great ecstasy, He went to see the temple of Śrī Janārdana.

devanagari: दिन - दुइ ताहाँ करि’ कीर्तन - नर्तन ।
पयस्विनी आसिया देखे शङ्कर नारायण ॥243॥
cc-madhya-9.243.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chanted and danced at Śrī Janārdana for two days. He then went to the bank of the Payasvinī and visited the temple of Śaṅkara-nārāyaṇa.

devanagari: शृङ्गेरि - मठे आइला शङ्कराचार्य - स्थाने ।
मत्स्य - तीर्थ दे खि’ कैल तुङ्गभद्राय स्नाने ॥244॥
cc-madhya-9.244.translation: There He saw the monastery known as Śṛṅgeri-maṭha, the abode of Ācārya Śaṅkara. He then visited Matsya-tīrtha, a place of pilgrimage, and took a bath in the river Tuṅgabhadrā.

devanagari: मध्वाचार्य - स्थाने आइला याँहा ‘तत्त्ववा दी’ ।
उडुपीते ‘कृष्ण’ देखि, ताहाँ हैल प्रेमोन्मादी ॥245॥
cc-madhya-9.245.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu next arrived at the place of Madhvācārya, where the philosophers known as Tattvavādīs resided. He stayed there at a place known as Uḍupī, where he saw the Deity of Lord Kṛṣṇa and became mad with ecstasy.

lines: madhvācārye svapna diyā āilā tāṅra sthāne
devanagari: नर्तक गोपाल देखे परम - मोहने ।
मध्वाचार्ये स्व प्न दिया आइला ताँर स्थाने ॥246॥
cc-madhya-9.246.translation: While at the Uḍupī monastery, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw "dancing Gopāla," a most beautiful Deity. This Deity appeared to Madhvācārya in a dream.

devanagari: गोपी - चन्दन - तले आछिल डिङ्गाते ।
मध्वाचार्य सेइ कृष्ण पाइला कोन - मते ॥247॥
cc-madhya-9.247.translation: Madhvācārya had somehow or other acquired the Deity of Kṛṣṇa from a heap of gopī-candana that had been transported in a boat.

devanagari: मध्वाचार्य आ नि’ ताँरे करिला स्थापन ।
अद्यावधि सेवा करे तत्त्ववादि - गण ॥248॥
cc-madhya-9.248.translation: Madhvācārya brought this dancing Gopāla Deity to Uḍupī and installed Him in the temple. To date, the followers of Madhvācārya, known as Tattvavādīs, worship this Deity.

devanagari: कृष्ण - मूर्ति देखि’ प्रभु महा - सुख पाइल ।
प्रेमावेशे बहु - क्षण नृत्य - गीत कैल ॥249॥
cc-madhya-9.249.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu received great pleasure in seeing this beautiful form of Gopāla. For a long time He danced and chanted in ecstatic love.

lines: tomā dekhi' gela mora ājanma svabhāve
devanagari: विप्र बले , - एइ तोमार दर्शन - प्रभावे ।
तोमा दे खि’ गेल मोर आजन्म स्वभावे ॥25॥
cc-madhya-9.25.translation: The brāhmaṇa replied, "This is all due to Your influence, sir. After seeing You, I have lost the long practice of my life.

lines: prathama darśane prabhuke nā kaila sambhāṣaṇe
devanagari: तत्त्ववादि - गण प्रभुके ‘मायावा दी’ ज्ञाने ।
प्रथम दर्शने प्रभुके ना कैल सम्भाषणे ॥250॥
cc-madhya-9.250.translation: At first sight, the Tattvavādī Vaiṣṇavas considered Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu a Māyāvādī sannyāsī. Therefore they did not talk to Him.

devanagari: पाछे प्रेमावेश दे खि’ हैल चमत्कार ।
वैष्णव - ज्ञाने बहुत करिल सत्कार ॥251॥
cc-madhya-9.251.translation: Later, after seeing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in ecstatic love, they were struck with wonder. Then, considering Him a Vaiṣṇava, they gave Him a nice reception.

devanagari: ‘वैष्णवता’ सबार अन्तरे गर्व जा नि’ ।
ईषत् हासिया किछु कहे गौरमणि ॥252॥
cc-madhya-9.252.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could understand that the Tattvavādīs were very proud of their Vaiṣṇavism. He therefore smiled and began to speak to them.

devanagari: ताँ - सबार अन्तरे गर्व जानि गौरचन्द्र ।
ताँ - सबा - सङ्गे गोष्ठी करिला आरम्भ ॥253॥
cc-madhya-9.253.translation: Considering them very proud, Caitanya Mahāprabhu began His discussion.

lines: tāṅre praśna kaila prabhu hañā yena dīna
devanagari: तत्त्ववादी आचार्य - सब शास्त्रेते प्रवीण ।
ताँरे प्रश्न कैल प्रभु हञा येन दीन ॥254॥
cc-madhya-9.254.translation: The chief ācārya of the Tattvavāda community was very learned in the revealed scriptures. Out of humility, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu questioned him.

devanagari: साध्य - साधन आमि ना जानि भाल - मते ।
साध्य - साधन - श्रेष्ठ जानाह आमाते ॥255॥
cc-madhya-9.255.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "I do not know very well the aim of life and how to achieve it. Please tell Me of the best ideal for humanity and how to attain it."

devanagari: आचार्य कहे , - ‘वर्णाश्रम - धर्म, कृष्ण समर्पण’ ।
एइ हय कृष्ण - भक्तेर श्रेष्ठ ‘साधन’ ॥256॥
cc-madhya-9.256.translation: The ācārya replied, "When the activities of the four castes and the four āśramas are dedicated to Kṛṣṇa, they constitute the best means whereby one can attain the highest goal of life.

devanagari: ‘पञ्च - विध मुक्ति’ पाञा वैकुण्ठे गमन ।
‘साध्य - श्रेष्ठ’ हय, - एइ शास्त्र - निरूपण ॥257॥
cc-madhya-9.257.translation: "When one dedicates the duties of varṇāśrama-dharma to Kṛṣṇa, he is eligible for five kinds of liberation. Thus he is transferred to the spiritual world in Vaikuṇṭha. This is the highest goal of life and the verdict of all revealed scriptures."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - शास्त्रे कहे श्रवण - कीर्तन ।
कृष्ण - प्रेम - सेवा - फलेर ‘परम - साधन’ ॥258॥
cc-madhya-9.258.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "According to the verdict of the śāstras, the process of hearing and chanting is the best means to attain loving service to Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: श्रवणं कीर्तनं विष्णोः स्मरणं पाद - सेवनम् ।
अर्चनं वन्दनं दास्यं सख्यमात्म - निवेदनम् ॥259॥
cc-madhya-9.259-260.translation: “ 'This process entails hearing, chanting and remembering the holy name, form, pastimes, qualities and entourage of the Lord, offering service according to the time, place and performer, worshiping the Deity, offering prayers, always considering oneself the eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa, making friends with Him and dedicating everything unto Him. These nine items of devotional service, when directly offered to Kṛṣṇa, constitute the highest attainment of life. This is the verdict of revealed scriptures.'

devanagari: बाल्यावधि राम - नाम - ग्रहण आमार ।
तोमा दे खि’ कृष्ण - नाम आइल एक - बार ॥26॥
cc-madhya-9.26.translation: "From my childhood I have been chanting the holy name of Lord Rāmacandra, but after seeing You I began to chant the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa just once.

devanagari: श्रवण - कीर्तन हइते कृष्णे हय ‘प्रेमा’ ।
सेइ पञ्चम पुरुषार्थ - पुरुषार्थेर सीमा ॥261॥
cc-madhya-9.261.translation: "When one comes to the platform of loving service to Lord Kṛṣṇa by executing these nine processes, he has attained the fifth platform of success and the limit of life's goals.

devanagari: एवं - व्रतः स्व - प्रिय - नाम - कीर्यो जातानुरागो द्रुत - चित्त उच्चैः ।
हसत्यथो रोदिति रौति गायत्य् उन्माद - वन्नृत्यति लोक - बाह्यः ॥262॥
cc-madhya-9.262.translation: “ 'When a person is actually advanced and takes pleasure in chanting the holy name of the Lord, who is very dear to him, he is agitated and loudly chants the holy name. He also laughs, cries, becomes agitated and chants just like a madman, not caring for outsiders.'

lines: karma haite prema-bhakti kṛṣṇe kabhu nahe
devanagari: कर्म - निन्दा, कर्म - त्याग, सर्व - शास्त्रे कहे ।
कर्म हैते प्रेम - भक्ति कृष्णे कभु नहे ॥263॥
cc-madhya-9.263.translation: "In every revealed scripture there is condemnation of fruitive activities. It is advised everywhere to give up engagement in fruitive activity, for by it no one can attain the highest goal of life, love of Godhead.

devanagari: आज्ञायैवं गुणान्दोषान्मयादिष्टानपि स्वकान् ।
धर्मान्सन्त्यज्य यः सर्वान्मां भजेत्स च सत्तमः ॥264॥
cc-madhya-9.264.translation: “ 'Occupational duties are described in the religious scriptures. If one analyzes them, he can fully understand their qualities and faults and then give them up completely to render service unto the Supreme Personality of Godhead. A person who does so is considered a first-class man.'

devanagari: सर्व - धर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज ।
अहं त्वां सर्व - पापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥265॥
cc-madhya-9.265.translation: “ 'Abandon all varieties of religion and just surrender unto Me. I shall deliver you from all sinful reactions. Do not fear.'

devanagari: तावत्कर्माणि कुर्वीत न निर्विद्येत यावता ।
मत्कथा - श्रवणादौ वा श्रद्धा यावन्न जायते ॥266॥
cc-madhya-9.266.translation: “ 'As long as one is not satiated by fruitive activity and has not awakened his taste for devotional service by śravaṇaṁ kīrtanaṁ viṣṇoḥ, one has to act according to the regulative principles of the Vedic injunctions.'

devanagari: पञ्च - विध मुक्ति त्याग करे भक्त - गण ।
फल्गु करि’ ‘मुक्ति’ देखे नरकेर सम ॥267॥
cc-madhya-9.267.translation: "Pure devotees reject the five kinds of liberation; indeed, liberation for them is very insignificant because they see it as hellish.

devanagari: सालोक्य - साष्ट्रि - सामीप्य - सारूप्यैकत्वमप्युत ।
दीयमानं न गृह्णन्ति विना मत्सेवनं जनाः ॥268॥
cc-madhya-9.268.translation: “ 'Pure devotees always reject the five kinds of liberation, which include living in the spiritual Vaikuṇṭha planets, possessing the same opulences possessed by the Supreme Lord, having the same bodily features as the Lord's, associating with the Lord and merging into the body of the Lord. The pure devotees do not accept these benedictions without the service of the Lord.'

lines: naicchan nṛpas tad ucitaṁ mahatāṁ madhu-dviṭ-
devanagari: यो दुस्त्यजान्क्षिति - सुत - स्वजनार्थ - दारान् प्रार्थ्यां श्रियं सुर - वरैः सदयावलोकाम् ।
नैच्छन्नृपस्तदुचितं महतां मधु - द्विद् सेवानुरक्त - मनसामभवोऽपि फल्गुः ॥269॥
cc-madhya-9.269.translation: “ 'It is very difficult to give up material opulence, land, children, society, friends, riches, wife or the blessings of the goddess of fortune, which are desired even by great demigods. But King Bharata did not desire such things, and this was quite befitting his position, because for a pure devotee whose mind is always engaged in service of the Lord, even liberation or merging into the existence of the Lord is insignificant. And what to speak of material opportunity?'

devanagari: सेइ हैते कृष्ण - नाम जिह्वाते वसिला ।
कृष्ण - नाम स्फुरे, राम - नाम दूरे गेला ॥27॥
cc-madhya-9.27.translation: "Since then, the holy name of Kṛṣṇa has been tied to my tongue. Indeed, when I chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, the holy name of Lord Rāmacandra goes far away.

devanagari: नारायण - पराः सर्वे न कुतश्चन बिभ्यति ।
स्वर्गापवर्ग - नरकेष्वपि तुल्यार्थ - दर्शिनः ॥270॥
cc-madhya-9.270.translation: “ 'A person who is a devotee of Lord Nārāyaṇa is not afraid of a hellish condition because he considers it the same as elevation to heavenly planets or liberation. The devotees of Lord Nārāyaṇa are accustomed to seeing all these things on the same level.'

devanagari: मुक्ति, कर्म - दुइ वस्तु त्यजे भक्त - गण ।
सेइ दुइ स्थाप’ तुमि ‘साध्य’, ‘साधन’ ॥271॥
cc-madhya-9.271.translation: "Both liberation and fruitive activity are rejected by devotees. You are trying to establish these things as life's goal and the process to attain it."

devanagari: सन्न्यासी देखिया मोरे करह वञ्चन ।
ना कहिला ते ञि साध्य - साधन - लक्षण ॥272॥
cc-madhya-9.272.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued speaking to the Tattvavādī ācārya: "Seeing that I am a mendicant in the renounced order of life, you have been playing with Me in a duplicitous way. You have not actually described the process and ultimate objective."

devanagari: शुनि’ तत्त्वाचार्य हैला अन्तरे लज्जित ।
प्रभुर वैष्णवता देखि, हइला विस्मित ॥273॥
cc-madhya-9.273.translation: After hearing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the ācārya of the Tattvavāda-sampradāya became very ashamed. Upon observing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's rigid faith in Vaiṣṇavism, he was struck with wonder.

lines: ācārya kahe,—tumi yei kaha, sei satya haya
devanagari: आचार्य कहे , - तुमि येइ कह, सेइ सत्य हय ।
सर्व - शास्त्रे वैष्णवेर एइ सुनिश्चय ॥274॥
cc-madhya-9.274.translation: The Tattvavādī ācārya replied, "What You have said is certainly factual. It is the conclusion of all the revealed scriptures of the Vaiṣṇavas.

devanagari: तथापि मध्वाचार्य ये करियाछे निर्बन्ध ।
सेइ आचरिये सबे सम्प्रदाय - सम्बन्ध ॥275॥
cc-madhya-9.275.translation: "Still, whatever Madhvācārya has ascertained to be the formula for our party, we practice as a party policy."

lines: tomāra sampradāye dekhi sei dui cihna
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - कर्मी, ज्ञानी, - दुइ भक्ति - हीन ।
तोमार सम्प्रदाये देखि सेइ दुइ चिह्न ॥276॥
cc-madhya-9.276.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Both the fruitive worker and the speculative philosopher are considered nondevotees. We see both elements present in your sampradāya.

lines: sabe, eka guṇa dekhi tomāra sampradāye
devanagari: सबे, एक गुण देखि तोमार सम्प्रदाये ।
सत्य - विग्रह क रि’ ईश्वरे करह निश्चये ॥277॥
cc-madhya-9.277.translation: "The only qualification that I see in your sampradāya is that you accept the form of the Lord as truth."

lines: ei-mata tāṅra ghare garva cūrṇa kari'
devanagari: एइ - मत ताँर घरे गर्व चूर्ण करि’ ।
फल्गु - तीर्थे तबे चलि आइला गौरहरि ॥278॥
cc-madhya-9.278.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu broke the pride of the Tattvavādīs to pieces. He then went to the holy place known as Phalgu-tīrtha.

devanagari: त्रितकूपे विशालार करि’ दरशन ।
पञ्चाप्सरा - तीर्थे आइला शचीर नन्दन ॥279॥
cc-madhya-9.279.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of mother Śacī, went to Tritakūpa, and after seeing the Viśālā Deity there, He went to the holy place known as Pañcāpsarā-tīrtha.

lines: bālya-kāla haite mora svabhāva eka haya
devanagari: बाल्यकाल हैते मोर स्वभाव एक हय ।
नामेर महिमा - शास्त्र करिये सञ्चय ॥28॥
cc-madhya-9.28.translation: "From my childhood I have been practicing this chanting and have been collecting the glories of the holy name from revealed scriptures.

devanagari: गोकर्णे शिव दे खि’ आइला द्वैपायनि ।
सूर्पारक - तीर्थे आइला न्यासि - शिरोमणि ॥280॥
cc-madhya-9.280.translation: After seeing Pañcāpsarā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Gokarṇa. While there, He visited the temple of Lord Śiva, and then He went to Dvaipāyani. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the crown jewel of all sannyāsīs, then went to Sūrpāraka-tīrtha.

devanagari: कोलापुरे लक्ष्मी देखि’ देखेन क्षीर - भगवती ।
लाङ्ग - गणेश दे खि’ देखेन चोर - पार्वती ॥281॥
cc-madhya-9.281.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then visited the town of Kolāpura, where He saw the goddess of fortune in the temple of Kṣīra-bhagavatī and Lāṅga-gaṇeśa in another temple, known as Cora-pārvatī.

devanagari: तथा हैते पाण्डरपुरे आइला गौरचन्द्र ।
विठ्ठल - ठाकुर देखि’ पाइला आनन्द ॥282॥
cc-madhya-9.282.translation: From there Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Pāṇḍarapura, where He happily saw the temple of Viṭhṭhala Ṭhākura.

lines: tāhāṅ eka vipra tāṅre kaila nimantraṇa
devanagari: प्रेमावेशे कैल बहुत कीर्तन - नर्तन ।
ताहाँ एक विप्र ताँरे कैल निमन्त्रण ॥283॥
cc-madhya-9.283.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chanted and danced in various ways as usual, and one brāhmaṇa, seeing Him in ecstatic love, was very pleased. He even invited the Lord to his home for lunch.

lines: bhikṣā kari' tathā eka śubha-vārtā pāila
devanagari: बहुत आदरे प्रभुके भिक्षा कराइल ।
भिक्षा क रि’ तथा एक शुभ - वार्ता पाइल ॥284॥
cc-madhya-9.284.translation: This brāhmaṇa offered Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu food with great respect and love. After finishing His lunch, the Lord received auspicious news.

devanagari: माधव - पुरीर शिष्य ‘श्री - रङ्ग - पुरी’ नाम ।
सेइ ग्रामे विप्र - गृहे करेन विश्राम ॥285॥
cc-madhya-9.285.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu received word that Śrī Raṅga Purī, one of the disciples of Śrī Mādhavendra Purī, was present in that village at the home of a brāhmaṇa.

devanagari: शुनिया चलिला प्रभु ताँरे देखिबारे ।
विप्र - गृहे वसि’ आछेन, देखिला ताँहारे ॥286॥
cc-madhya-9.286.translation: Hearing this news, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately went to see Śrī Raṅga Purī at the brāhmaṇa's home. Upon entering, the Lord saw him sitting there.

lines: aśru, pulaka, kampa, sarvāṅge paḍe ghāma
devanagari: प्रेमावेशे करे ताँरे दण्ड - परणाम ।
अश्रु, पुलक, कम्प, सर्वाङ्गे पड़े घाम ॥287॥
cc-madhya-9.287.translation: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the brāhmaṇa, He immediately began to offer him obeisances in ecstatic love, falling flat to the ground. The symptoms of transcendental transformation were visible-namely, tears, jubilation, trembling and perspiration.

devanagari: देखिया विस्मित हैल श्री - रङ्ग - पुरीर मन ।
‘उठह श्रीपा द’ बलि’ बलिला वचन ॥288॥
cc-madhya-9.288.translation: Upon seeing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in such an ecstatic mood, Śrī Raṅga Purī said, "Your Holiness, please get up.

lines: tāhā vinā anyatra nāhi ei premāra gandha
devanagari: श्रीपाद, धर मोर गोसाञि र सम्बन्ध ।
ताहा विना अन्यत्र नाहि एइ प्रेमार गन्ध ॥289॥
cc-madhya-9.289.translation: "Your Holiness is certainly related to Śrī Mādhavendra Purī, without whom there is no flavor of ecstatic love."

devanagari: रमन्ते य़ोगिनोऽनन्ते सत्यानन्दे चिदात्मनि ।
इति राम - पदेनासौ परं ब्रह्माभिधीयते ॥29॥
cc-madhya-9.29.translation: “ 'The Supreme Absolute Truth is called Rāma because the transcendentalists take pleasure in the unlimited true pleasure of spiritual existence.'

lines: eta bali' prabhuke uthāñā kaila āliṅgana
devanagari: एत ब लि’ प्रभुके उथामा कैल आलिङ्गन ।
गलागलि क रि’ दुँहे करेन क्रन्दन ॥290॥
cc-madhya-9.290.translation: After saying this, Śrī Raṅga Purī lifted Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and embraced Him. When they both embraced, they began to cry in ecstasy.

lines: kṣaṇeke āveśa chāḍi' duṅhāra dhairya haila
devanagari: क्षणेके आवेश छा ड़ि’ दुँहार धैर्य हैल ।
ईश्वर - पुरीर सम्बन्ध गोसाञि जानाइल ॥291॥
cc-madhya-9.291.translation: After some moments, they came to their senses and became patient. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then informed Śrī Raṅga Purī about His relationship with Īśvara Purī.

lines: duṅhe mānya kari' duṅhe ānande vasila
devanagari: अद्भुत प्रेमेर वन्या दुँहार उथलिल ।
दुँहे मान्य क रि’ दुँहे आनन्दे वसिल ॥292॥
cc-madhya-9.292.translation: They were both inundated by the wonderful ecstasy of love, which was aroused in both of them. They finally sat down and respectfully began to converse.

devanagari: दुइ जने कृष्ण - कथा कहे रात्रि - दिने ।
एइ - मते गोङाइल पाँच - सात दिने ॥293॥
cc-madhya-9.293.translation: In this way they discussed topics about Lord Kṛṣṇa continuously for five to seven days.

devanagari: कौतुके पुरी ताँरे पुछिल जन्म - स्थान ।
गोसाञि कौतुके कहेन ‘नवद्वीप’ नाम ॥294॥
cc-madhya-9.294.translation: Out of curiosity, Śrī Raṅga Purī asked Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu about His birthplace, and the Lord informed him that it was Navadvīpa-dhāma.

devanagari: श्री - माधव - पुरीर सङ्गे श्री - रङ्ग - पुरी ।
पूर्वे आसियाछिला तेंहो नदीया - नगरी ॥295॥
cc-madhya-9.295.translation: Śrī Raṅga Purī had formerly gone to Navadvīpa with Śrī Mādhavendra Purī, and he therefore remembered the incidents that took place there.

lines: apūrva mocāra ghaṇṭa tāhāṅ ye khāila
devanagari: जगन्नाथ मिश्र - घरे भिक्षा ये करिल ।
अपूर्व मोचार घण्ट ताहाँ ये खाइल ॥296॥
cc-madhya-9.296.translation: As soon as Śrī Raṅga Purī recalled Navadvīpa, he also recalled accompanying Śrī Mādhavendra Purī to the house of Jagannātha Miśra, where he took lunch. He even remembered the taste of an unprecedented curry made of banana flowers.

devanagari: जगन्नाथेर ब्राह्मणी, तेंह - महा - पतिव्रता ।
वात्सल्ये हयेन तेंह येन जगन्माता ॥297॥
cc-madhya-9.297.translation: Śrī Raṅga Purī also remembered the wife of Jagannātha Miśra. She was very much devoted and chaste. As for her affection, she was exactly like the mother of the universe.

devanagari: रन्धने निपुणा ताँ - सम नाहि त्रिभुवने ।
पुत्र - सम स्नेह करेन सन्न्यासि - भोजने ॥298॥
cc-madhya-9.298.translation: He also remembered how Śrī Jagannātha Miśra's wife, Śacīmātā, was expert in cooking. He recalled that she was very affectionate toward the sannyāsīs and fed them exactly like her own sons.

lines: tāṅra eka yogya putra kariyāche sannyāsa
devanagari: ताँर एक योग्य पुत्र करियाछे सन्न्यास ।
‘शङ्करारण्य’ नाम ताँर अल्प वयस ॥299॥
cc-madhya-9.299.translation: Śrī Raṅga Purī also understood that one of her deserving sons accepted the renounced order at a very young age. His name was Śaṅkarāraṇya.

devanagari: दक्षिण - गमन प्रभुर अति विलक्षण ।
सहस्र सहस्त्र तीर्थ कैल दरशन ॥3॥
cc-madhya-9.3.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's tour of South India was certainly very extraordinary because He visited many thousands of places of pilgrimage there.

devanagari: कृषिर्भु - वाचकः शब्दो णश्च निर्वृति - वाचकः ।
तयोरैक्यं परं ब्रह्म कृष्ण इत्यभिधीयते ॥30॥
cc-madhya-9.30.translation: “ 'The word "kṛṣ" is the attractive feature of the Lord's existence, and "ṇa" means spiritual pleasure. When the verb "kṛṣ" is added to the affix "ṇa," it becomes "Kṛṣṇa," which indicates the Absolute Truth.'

devanagari: एइ तीर्थे शङ्करारण्येर सिद्धि - प्राप्ति हैल ।
प्रस्तावे श्री - रङ्ग - पुरी एतेक कहिल ॥300॥
cc-madhya-9.300.translation: Śrī Raṅga Purī informed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that in this holy place, Pāṇḍarapura, the sannyāsī named Śaṅkarāraṇya attained perfection.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - पूर्वाश्रमे तेंह मोर भ्राता ।
जगन्नाथ मिश्र - पूर्वाश्रमे मोर पिता ॥301॥
cc-madhya-9.301.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "In My previous āśrama, Śaṅkarāraṇya was My brother and Jagannātha Miśra was My father."

devanagari: एइ - मत दुइ - जने इष्ट - गोष्ठी क रि’ ।
द्वारका देखिते चलिला श्री - रङ्ग - पुरी ॥302॥
cc-madhya-9.302.translation: After finishing his talks with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Śrī Raṅga Purī started for Dvārakā-dhāma.

lines: dina cāri tathā prabhuke rākhila brāhmaṇa
bhīmā-nadī snāna kari' karena viṭhṭhala darśana
devanagari: दिन चारि तथा प्रभुके राखिल ब्राह्मण ।
भीमा - नदी स्नान क रि’ करेन विठ्ठल दर्शन ॥303॥
cc-madhya-9.303.translation: After Śrī Raṅga Purī departed for Dvārakā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained with the brāhmaṇa at Pāṇḍarapura for four more days. He took His bath in the Bhīmā River and visited the temple of Viṭhṭhala.

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु आइला कृष्ण - वेण्वा - तीरे ।
नाना तीर्थ दे खि’ ताहाँ देवता - मन्दिरे ॥304॥
cc-madhya-9.304.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu next went to the bank of the Kṛṣṇa-veṇvā River, where He visited many holy places and the temples of various gods.

devanagari: ब्राह्मण - समाज सब - वैष्णव - चरित ।
वैष्णव सकल पड़े ‘कृष्ण - कर्णामृत’ ॥305॥
cc-madhya-9.305.translation: The brāhmaṇa community there was composed of pure devotees, who regularly studied a book entitled Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta, which was composed by Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura.

devanagari: कृष्ण - कर्णामृत शुनि’ प्रभुर आनन्द हैल ।
आग्रह करिया पुँथि लेखाञा लैल ॥306॥
cc-madhya-9.306.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very pleased to hear the book Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta, and with great eagerness He had it copied and took it with Him.

devanagari: ‘कर्णामृत’ - सम वस्तु नाहि त्रिभुवने ।
याहा हैते हय कृष्णे शुद्ध - प्रेम - ज्ञाने ॥307॥
