cc-madhya-9.307.translation: There is no comparison to Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta within the three worlds. By studying this book, one is elevated to the knowledge of pure devotional service to Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: सौन्दर्य - माधुर्घ - कृष्ण - लीलार अवधि ।
सेइ जाने, ये ‘कर्णामृत’ पड़े निरवधि ॥308॥
cc-madhya-9.308.translation: One who constantly reads Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta can fully understand the beauty and melodious taste of the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: ‘ब्रह्म - संहिता’, ‘कर्णामृत’ दुइ पुँथि पाञा ।
महा - रत्न - प्राय पाइ आइला सङ्गे लञा ॥309॥
cc-madhya-9.309.translation: The Brahma-saṁhitā and Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta were two books that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu considered to be most valuable jewels. Therefore He took them with Him on His return trip.

lines: punaḥ āra śāstre kichu viśeṣa pāila
devanagari: परं ब्रह्म दुइ - नाम समान हइल ।
पुनः आर शास्त्रे किछु विशेष पाइल ॥31॥
cc-madhya-9.31.translation: "As far as the holy names of Rāma and Kṛṣṇa are concerned, they are on an equal level, but for further advancement we receive some specific information from revealed scriptures.

lines: nānā tīrtha dekhi tāhāṅ narmadāra tīre
devanagari: तापी स्नान क रि’ आइला माहिष्मती - पुरे ।
नाना तीर्थ देखि ताहाँ नर्मदार तीरे ॥310॥
cc-madhya-9.310.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu next arrived at the banks of the river Tāpī. After bathing there, He went to Māhiṣmatī-pura. While there, He saw many holy places on the banks of the river Narmadā.

devanagari: धनुस्तीर्थ देखि’ करिला निर्विन्ध्याते स्नाने ।
ऋष्यमूक - गिरि आइला दण्डकारण्ये ॥311॥
cc-madhya-9.311.translation: The Lord next arrived at Dhanus-tīrtha, where He took His bath in the river Nirvindhyā. He then arrived at Ṛṣyamūka Mountain and then went to Daṇḍakāraṇya.

lines: ati vṛddha, ati sthūla, ati uccatara
devanagari: ‘सप्तताल - वृक्ष’ देखे कानन - भितर ।
अति वृद्ध, अति स्थूल, अति उच्चतर ॥312॥
cc-madhya-9.312.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then visited a place within the forest called Saptatāla. All the trees there were very old, very bulky and very high.

devanagari: सप्तताल देखि प्रभ आलिङन कैल ।
सशरीरे सप्तताल वैकुण्ठे चलिल ॥313॥
cc-madhya-9.313.translation: After seeing the seven palm trees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them. As a result, they all returned to Vaikuṇṭhaloka, the spiritual world.

devanagari: शून्य - स्थल देखि लोकेर हैल चमत्कार ।
लोके कहे, ए सन्न्यासी - राम - अवतार ॥314॥
cc-madhya-9.314.translation: After the seven palm trees had departed for Vaikuṇṭha, everyone was astonished to see them gone. The people then began to say, "This sannyāsī called Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu must be an incarnation of Lord Rāmacandra.

lines: aiche śakti kāra haya, vinā eka rāma
devanagari: सशरीरे ताल गेल श्री - वैकुण्ठ - धाम ।
ऐछे शक्ति कार हय, विना एक राम ॥315॥
cc-madhya-9.315.translation: "Only Lord Rāmacandra has the power to send seven palm trees to the spiritual Vaikuṇṭha planets."

devanagari: प्रभु आसि’ कैल पम्पा - सरोवरे स्नान ।
पञ्चवटी आसि, ताहाँ करिल विश्राम ॥316॥
cc-madhya-9.316.translation: Eventually Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at a lake known as Pampā, where He took His bath. He then went to a place called Pañcavaṭī, where He rested.

devanagari: नासिके त्र्यम्बक दे खि’ गेला ब्रह्मगिरि ।
कुशावर्ते आइला याहाँ जन्मिला गोदावरी ॥317॥
cc-madhya-9.317.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then visited Nāsika, where He saw the deity Tryambaka. He then went to Brahma-giri and then to Kuśāvarta, the source of the river Godāvarī.

lines: sapta godāvarī āilā kari' tīrtha bahutara
devanagari: सप्त गोदावरी आइला क रि’ तीर्थ बहुतर ।
पुनरपि आइला प्रभु विद्यानगर ॥318॥
cc-madhya-9.318.translation: After visiting many other holy places, the Lord went to Sapta-godāvari. At last He returned to Vidyānagara.

devanagari: रामानन्द राय शुनि’ प्रभुर आगमन ।
आनन्दे आसिया कैल प्रभु - सह मिलन ॥319॥
cc-madhya-9.319.translation: When Rāmānanda Rāya heard of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's arrival, he was very pleased, and he immediately went to see Him.

devanagari: राम रामेति रामेति रमे रामे मनोरमे ।
सहस्त्र - नामभिस्तुल्यं राम - नाम वरानने ॥32॥
cc-madhya-9.32.translation: “ 'Lord Śiva addressed his wife Durgā as Varānanā and explained, "I chant the holy name of Rāma, Rāma, Rāma and thus enjoy this beautiful sound. This holy name of Rāmacandra is equal to one thousand holy names of Lord Viṣṇu."'

devanagari: दण्डवत् हञा पड़े चरणे धरिया ।
आलिङ्गन कैल प्रभु ताँरे उठाञा ॥320॥
cc-madhya-9.320.translation: When Rāmānanda Rāya fell flat, touching the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord immediately raised him to his feet and embraced him.

devanagari: दुइ जने प्रेमावेशे करेन क्रन्दन ।
प्रेमानन्दे शिथिल हैल दुँहाकार मन ॥321॥
cc-madhya-9.321.translation: In great ecstatic love they both began to cry, and thus their minds were slackened.

devanagari: कत - क्षणे दुइ जना सुस्थिर हञा ।
नाना इष्ट - गोष्ठी करे एकत्र वसिया ॥322॥
cc-madhya-9.322.translation: After some time they regained their senses and sat together to discuss various subjects.

devanagari: तीर्थ - यात्रा - कथा प्रभु सकल कहिला ।
कर्णामृत, ब्रह्म - संहिता, - दुइ पुँथि दिला ॥323॥
cc-madhya-9.323.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave Rāmānanda Rāya a vivid description of His travels to the holy places and told him how He had acquired the two books named Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta and Brahma-saṁhitā. The Lord delivered the books to Rāmānanda Rāya.

lines: ei dui puṅthi sei saba sākṣī dile
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - तुमि येइ सिद्धान्त कहिले ।
एइ दुइ पुँथि सेइ सब साक्षी दिले ॥324॥
cc-madhya-9.324.translation: The Lord said, "Whatever you have told Me about devotional service is all supported by these two books."

devanagari: रायेर आनन्द हैल पुस्तक पाइया ।
प्रभु - सह आस्वादिल, राखिल लिखिया ॥325॥
cc-madhya-9.325.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya was very happy to receive these books. He tasted their contents along with the Lord and made a copy of each of them.

devanagari: ‘गोसाञि आइला’ ग्रामे हैल कोलाहल ।
प्रभुके देखिते लोक आइल सकल ॥326॥
cc-madhya-9.326.translation: News spread in the village of Vidyānagara about Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's arrival, and everyone came to see Him once again.

devanagari: लोक देखि’ रामानन्द गेला निज - घरे ।
मध्याह्न उठिला प्रभु भिक्षा करिबारे ॥327॥
cc-madhya-9.327.translation: After seeing the people who gathered there, Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya returned to his own home. At noon, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up to take His lunch.

devanagari: रात्रि - काले राय पुनः कैल आगमन ।
दुइ जने कृष्ण - कथाय कैल जागरण ॥328॥
cc-madhya-9.328.translation: Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya returned at night, and he and the Lord discussed topics concerning Kṛṣṇa. Thus they passed the night.

devanagari: दुइ जने कृष्ण - कथा कहे रात्रि - दिने ।
परम - आनन्दे गेल पाँच - सात दिने ॥329॥
cc-madhya-9.329.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu discussed Kṛṣṇa day and night, and thus they passed from five to seven days in great happiness.

devanagari: मध्य लीला 9.33 सहस्त्र - नाम्नां पुण्यानां त्रिरावृत्त्या तु यत्फलम् ।
एकावृत्त्या तु कृष्णस्य नामैकं तत्प्रयच्छति ॥33॥
cc-madhya-9.33.translation: “ 'The pious results derived from chanting the thousand holy names of Viṣṇu three times can be attained by only one repetition of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.'

devanagari: रामानन्द कहे , - प्रभु, तोमार आज्ञा पा ञा ।
राजाके लिखि लुँ आमि विनय करिया ॥330॥
cc-madhya-9.330.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya said, "My dear Lord, with Your permission I have already written a letter to the King with great humility.

lines: rājā more ājñā dila nīlācale yāite
devanagari: राजा मोरे आज्ञा दिल नीलाचले याइते ।
चलिबार उद्योग आमि लागियाछि करिते ॥331॥
cc-madhya-9.331.translation: "The King has already given me an order to return to Jagannātha Purī, and I am making arrangements to do this."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - एथा मोर ए - निमित्ते आगमन ।
तोमा लञा नीलाचले करिब गमन ॥332॥
cc-madhya-9.332.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "It is for this purpose alone that I have returned. I want to take you with Me to Jagannātha Purī."

devanagari: राय कहे , - प्रभु, आगे चल नीलाचले ।
मोर सङ्गे हाती - घोड़ा, सैन्य - कोलाहले ॥333॥
cc-madhya-9.333.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya said, "My dear Lord, it is better that You proceed to Jagannātha Purī alone because with me there will be many horses, elephants and soldiers, all roaring tumultuously.

lines: tomāra pāche pāche āmi kariba prayāṇa
devanagari: दिन - दशे इहा - सबार क रि’ समाधान ।
तोमार पाछे पाछे आमि करिब प्रयाण ॥334॥
cc-madhya-9.334.translation: "I shall make arrangements within ten days. Following You, I shall go to Nīlācala without delay."

lines: tabe mahāprabhu tāṅre āsite ājñā diyā
devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु ताँरे आसिते आज्ञा दिया ।
नीलाचले चलिला प्रभु आनन्दित हञा ॥335॥
cc-madhya-9.335.translation: Giving orders to Rāmānanda Rāya to come to Nīlācala, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu departed for Jagannātha Purī with great pleasure.

lines: yei pathe pūrve prabhu kailā āgamana
sei pathe calilā dekhi, sarva vaiṣṇava-gaṇa
devanagari: येइ पथे पूर्वे प्रभु कैला आगमन ।
सेइ पथे चलिला देखि, सर्व वैष्णव - गण ॥336॥
cc-madhya-9.336.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned by the same road He formerly took to Vidyānagara, and all the Vaiṣṇavas along the way saw Him again.

lines: yāhāṅ yāya, loka uṭhe hari-dhvani kari'
devanagari: याहाँ याय, लोक उठे हरि - ध्वनि क रि’ ।
देखि’ आनन्दित - मन हैला गौरहरि ॥337॥
cc-madhya-9.337.translation: Wherever Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went, the holy name of Śrī Hari was vibrated. Seeing this, the Lord became very happy.

devanagari: आलालनाथे आ सि’ कृष्णदासे पाठाइल ।
नित्यानन्द - आदि निज - गणे बोलाइल ॥338॥
cc-madhya-9.338.translation: When the Lord reached Ālālanātha, He sent His assistant Kṛṣṇadāsa ahead to call for Nityānanda and other personal associates.

lines: uṭhiyā calilā, preme theha nāhi pāya
devanagari: प्रभुर आगमन शुनि’ नित्यानन्द राय ।
उठिया चलिला, प्रेमे थेह नाहि पाय ॥339॥
cc-madhya-9.339.translation: As soon as Nityānanda received news of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's arrival, He immediately got up and started out to see Him. Indeed, He was very impatient in His great ecstasy.

lines: tathāpi la-ite nāri, śuna hetu tāra
devanagari: एइ वाक्ये कृष्ण - नामेर महिमा अपार ।
तथापि लइते नारि, शुन हेतु तार ॥34॥
cc-madhya-9.34.translation: "According to this statement of the śāstras, the glories of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa are unlimited. Still I could not chant His holy name. Please hear the reason for this.

lines: nāciyā calilā, dehe nā dhare ānanda
devanagari: जगदानन्द, दामोदर - पण्डित, मुकुन्द ।
नाचिया चलिला, देहे ना धरे आनन्द ॥340॥
cc-madhya-9.340.translation: Śrī Nityānanda Rāya, Jagadānanda, Dāmodara Paṇḍita and Mukunda all became ecstatic in their happiness, and dancing along the way, they went to meet the Lord.

lines: prabhure mililā sabe pathe lāg pāñā
devanagari: गोपीनाथाचार्य चलिला आनन्दित ह ञा ।
प्रभुरे मिलिला सबे पथे लाग्पा ञा ॥341॥
cc-madhya-9.341.translation: Gopīnātha Ācārya also went in a very happy mood. They all went to meet the Lord, and they finally contacted Him on the way.

devanagari: प्रभु प्रेमावेशे सबाय कैल आलिङ्गन ।
प्रेमावेशे सबे करे आनन्द - क्रन्दन ॥342॥
cc-madhya-9.342.translation: The Lord was also filled with ecstatic love, and He embraced them all. Out of their love, they began to cry with pleasure.

devanagari: सार्वभौम भट्टाचार्य आनन्दे चलिला ।
समुद्रेर तीरे आसि’ प्रभुरे मिलिला ॥343॥
cc-madhya-9.343.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya also went to see the Lord with great pleasure, and he met Him on the beach by the sea.

devanagari: सार्वभौम महाप्रभुर पड़िला चरणे ।
प्रभु ताँरे उठाञा कैल आलिङ्गने ॥344॥
cc-madhya-9.344.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya fell down at the lotus feet of the Lord, and the Lord pulled him up and embraced him.

devanagari: प्रेमावेशे सार्वभौम करिला रोदने ।
सबा - सङ्गे आइला प्रभु ईश्वर - दरशने ॥345॥
cc-madhya-9.345.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya cried in great ecstatic love. Then, accompanied by them all, the Lord went to the temple of Jagannātha.

devanagari: जगन्नाथ - दरशन प्रेमावेशे कैल ।
कम्प - स्वेद - पुलकाश्रुते शरीर भासिल ॥346॥
cc-madhya-9.346.translation: Due to ecstatic love experienced upon visiting Lord Jagannātha, inundations of trembling, perspiration, tears and jubilation swept the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: बहु नृत्य - गीत कैल प्रेमाविष्ट ह ञा ।
पाण्डा - पाल आइल सबे माला - प्रसाद ल ञा ॥347॥
cc-madhya-9.347.translation: In ecstatic love Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced and chanted. At that time all the attendants and priests came to offer Him a garland and the remnants of Lord Jagannātha's food.

devanagari: माला - प्रसाद पाञा प्रभु सुस्थिर हइला ।
जगन्नाथेर सेवक सब आनन्दे मिलिला ॥348॥
cc-madhya-9.348.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became patient after receiving the garland and prasāda of Lord Jagannātha. All the servants of Lord Jagannātha met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with great pleasure.

lines: mānya kari' prabhu tāṅre kaila āliṅgane
devanagari: काशी - मिश्र आसि’ प्रभुर पड़िला चरणे ।
मान्य क रि’ प्रभु ताँरे कैल आलिङ्गने ॥349॥
cc-madhya-9.349.translation: Afterward, Kāśī Miśra came and fell down at the lotus feet of the Lord, and the Lord respectfully embraced him.

lines: iṣṭa-deva rāma, tāṅra nāme sukha pāi
devanagari: इष्ट - देव राम, ताँर नामे सुख पाइ ।
सुख पाञा राम - नाम रात्रि - दिन गाइ ॥35॥
cc-madhya-9.35.translation: "My worshipable Lord has been Lord Rāmacandra, and by chanting His holy name I received happiness. Because I received such happiness, I chanted the holy name of Lord Rāma day and night.

lines: mora ghare bhikṣā bali' nimantraṇa kailā
devanagari: प्रभु लञा सार्वभौम निज - घरे गेला ।
मोर घरे भिक्षा ब लि’ निमन्त्रण कैला ॥350॥
cc-madhya-9.350.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya then took the Lord with him to his home, saying, "Today's luncheon will be at my home." In this way he invited the Lord.

devanagari: दिव्य महाप्रसाद अनेक आनाइल ।
पीठा - पाना आदि जगन्नाथ ये खाइल ॥351॥
cc-madhya-9.351.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya brought various types of food remnants that had been left by Lord Jagannātha. He brought all kinds of cakes and condensed-milk preparations.

devanagari: मध्याह्न करिला प्रभु निज - गण लञा ।
सार्वभौम - घरे भिक्षा करिला आसिया ॥352॥
cc-madhya-9.352.translation: Accompanied by all His associates, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya's house and took His noon lunch there.

devanagari: भिक्षा करा ञा ताँरे कराइल शयन ।
आपने सार्वभौम करे पाद - संवाहन ॥353॥
cc-madhya-9.353.translation: After offering food to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya made Him lie down to rest, and he personally began to massage the legs of the Lord.

lines: sei rātri tāṅra ghare rahilā tāṅra prīte
devanagari: प्रभु ताँरे पाठाइल भोजन करते ।
सेइ रात्रि तर घरे रहिला ताँर प्रीते ॥354॥
cc-madhya-9.354.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then sent Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya to take his lunch, and the Lord remained that night in his home just to please him.

devanagari: सार्वभौम - सङ्गे आर लञा निज - गण ।
तीर्थ - यात्रा - कथा क हि’ कैल जागरण ॥355॥
cc-madhya-9.355.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His personal associates remained with Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya. They all stayed awake the entire night as the Lord spoke of His pilgrimage.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - एत तीर्थ कैलुँ पर्यटन ।
तोमा - सम वैष्णव ना देखिलुँ एक - जन ॥356॥
cc-madhya-9.356.translation: The Lord told Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, "I have traveled to many holy places, but I could not find a Vaiṣṇava as good as you anywhere."

lines: eka rāmānanda rāya bahu sukha dila
devanagari: एक रामानन्द राय बहु सुख दिल ।
भट्ट कहे , - एइ ला गि’ मिलिते कहिल ॥357॥
cc-madhya-9.357.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "I received much pleasure from the talks of Rāmānanda Rāya."

lines: saṅkṣepe kahiluṅ, vistāra nā yāya varṇana
devanagari: तीर्थ - यात्रा - कथा एइ कैलुँ समापन ।
सङ्क्षेपे कहिलुँ, विस्तार ना याय वर्णन ॥358॥
cc-madhya-9.358.translation: Thus I have ended my narration about Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pilgrimage, describing it in brief. It cannot be described very broadly.

lines: lobhe lajjā khāñā tāra kari ṭānāṭāni
devanagari: अनन्त चैतन्य - लीला कहिते ना जानि ।
लोभे लज्जा खाञा तार करि टानाटानि ॥359॥
cc-madhya-9.359.translation: The pastimes of Lord Caitanya are unlimited. No one can properly describe His activities, yet I make the attempt out of greed. This but reveals my shamelessness.

devanagari: तोमार दर्शने यबे कृष्ण - नाम आइल।
ताहार महिमा तबे हृदये लागिल ॥36॥
cc-madhya-9.36.translation: "By Your appearance, Lord Kṛṣṇa's holy name also appeared, and at that time the glories of Kṛṣṇa's name awoke in my heart."

devanagari: प्रभुर तीर्थ यात्रा - कथा शुने येइ जन ।
चैतन्य - चरणे पाय गाढ़ प्रेम - धन ॥360॥
cc-madhya-9.360.translation: Whoever hears of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pilgrimage to various holy places attains the riches of very deep ecstatic love.

devanagari: चैतन्य - चरित शुन श्रद्धा - भक्ति क रि’ ।
मात्सर्य छाड़िया मुखे बल ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ॥361॥
cc-madhya-9.361.translation: Please hear the transcendental pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with faith and devotion. Giving up envy of the Lord, everyone chant the Lord's holy name, Hari.

lines: ei kali-kāle āra nāhi kona dharma
devanagari: एइ कलि - काले आर नाहि कोन धर्म ।
वैष्णव, वैष्णव - शास्त्र, एइ कहे मर्म ॥362॥
cc-madhya-9.362.translation: In this Age of Kali there are no genuine religious principles. There are only the Vaiṣṇava devotees and the Vaiṣṇava devotional scriptures. This is the sum and substance of everything.

devanagari: चैतन्य - चन्द्रेर लीला - अगाध, गम्भीर ।
प्रवेश करते नारि , - स्पर्शि र हि’ तीर ॥363॥
cc-madhya-9.363.translation: The pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are just like an unfathomable ocean. It is not possible for me to enter into them. Simply standing on the shore, I am but touching the water.

devanagari: चैतन्य - चरित श्रद्धाय शुने येइ जन ।
यतेक विचारे, तत पाय प्रेम - धन ॥364॥
cc-madhya-9.364.translation: Whoever hears the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with faith, analytically studying them, attains the ecstatic riches of love of Godhead.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥365॥
cc-madhya-9.365.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: eta kahi' vipra prabhura caraṇe paḍila
devanagari: सेइ कृष्ण तुमि साक्षात् - इहा निर्धारिल ।
एत क हि’ विप्र प्रभुर चरणे पड़िल ॥37॥
cc-madhya-9.37.translation: The brāhmaṇa concluded, "Sir, You are that Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself. This is my ascertainment." Saying this, the brāhmaṇa fell down at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: tāṅre kṛpā kari' prabhu calilā āra dine
devanagari: ताँरे कृपा करि’ प्रभु चलिला आर दिने ।
वृद्धकाशी आसि’ कैल शिव - दरशने ॥38॥
cc-madhya-9.38.translation: After showing mercy to the brāhmaṇa, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left the next day and arrived at Vṛddhakāśī, where He visited the temple of Lord Śiva.

lines: tāhāṅ haite cali' āge gelā eka grāme
devanagari: ताहाँ हैते च लि’ आगे गेला एक ग्रामे ।
ब्राह्मण - समाज ताहाँ, करिल विश्रामे ॥39॥
cc-madhya-9.39.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then left Vṛddhakāśī and proceeded further ahead. In one village He saw that most of the residents were brāhmaṇas, and He took His rest there.

lines: sei saba tīrtha sparśi' mahā-tīrtha kaila
sei chale sei deśera loka nistārila
devanagari: सेइ सब तीर्थ स्प र्शि’ महा - तीर्थ कैल ।
सेइ छले सेइ देशेर लोक निस्तारिल ॥4॥
cc-madhya-9.4.translation: When the Lord visited all those holy places, He converted many thousands of residents. Thus many people were delivered. Simply by touching the holy places, He made them into great places of pilgrimage.

lines: lakṣārbuda loka āise nā yāya gaṇane
devanagari: प्रभुर प्रभावे लोक आइल दरशने ।
लक्षार्बुद लोक आइसे ना याय गणने ॥40॥
cc-madhya-9.40.translation: Due to the influence of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, many millions of men came just to see Him. Indeed, the assembly was so unlimited that its members could not be counted.

devanagari: गोसाञि र सौन्दर्य दे खि’ ताते प्रेमावेश ।
सबे ‘कृष्ण’ कहे, ‘वैष्णव’ हैल सर्व - देश ॥41॥
cc-madhya-9.41.translation: The Lord's bodily features were very beautiful, and in addition He was always in the ecstasy of love of Godhead. Simply by seeing Him, everyone began chanting the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, and thus everyone became a Vaiṣṇava devotee.

devanagari: ताकिर् क - मीमांसक, व्रत मायावादि - गण ।
साङ्ख्य, पातञ्जल, स्मृति, पुराण, आगम ॥42॥
cc-madhya-9.42.translation: There are many kinds of philosophers. Some are logicians who follow Gautama or Kaṇāda. Some follow the Mīmāṁsā philosophy of Jaimini. Some follow the Māyāvāda philosophy of Śaṅkarācārya, and others follow Kapila's Sāṅkhya philosophy or the mystic yoga system of Patañjali. Some follow the smṛti-śāstra composed of twenty religious scriptures, and others follow the Purāṇas and the tantra-śāstra. In this way there are many different types of philosophers.

lines: sarva mata duṣi' prabhu kare khaṇḍa khaṇḍa
devanagari: निज - निज - शास्त्रो द्ग्राहे सबाइ प्रचण्ड ।
सर्व मत दुषि’ प्रभु करे खण्ड खण्ड ॥43॥
cc-madhya-9.43.translation: All of these adherents of various scriptures were ready to present the conclusions of their respective scriptures, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu broke all their opinions to pieces and established His own cult of bhakti based on the Vedas, Vedānta, the Brahma-sūtra and the philosophy of acintya-bhedābheda-tattva.

lines: prabhura siddhānta keha nā pāre khaṇḍite
devanagari: सर्वत्र स्थापय प्रभु वैष्णव - सिद्धान्ते ।
प्रभुर सिद्धान्त केह ना पारे खण्डिते ॥44॥
cc-madhya-9.44.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu established the devotional cult everywhere. No one could defeat Him.

devanagari: हारि’ हारि’ प्रभु - मते करेन प्रवेश ।
एइ - मते ‘वैष्णव’ प्रभु कैल दक्षिण देश ॥45॥
cc-madhya-9.45.translation: Being thus defeated by Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all these philosophers and their followers entered into His cult. In this way Lord Caitanya made South India into a country of Vaiṣṇavas.

lines: garva kari' āila saṅge śiṣya-gaṇa lañā
devanagari: पाषण्डी आइल यत पाण्डित्य शुनिया ।
गर्व क रि’ आइल सड़े शिष्य - गण लञा ॥46॥
cc-madhya-9.46.translation: When the nonbelievers heard of the erudition of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they came to Him with great pride, bringing their disciples with them.

lines: prabhura āge udgrāha kari' lāgilā balite
devanagari: बौद्धाचार्य महा - पण्डित निज नव - मते ।
प्रभुर आगे उद्ग्राह करि’ लागिला बलिते ॥47॥
cc-madhya-9.47.translation: One of them was the leader of a Buddhist cult and was a very learned scholar. To establish their nine philosophical conclusions, he came before the Lord and began to speak.

devanagari: सद्यपि असम्भाष्य बौद्ध अयुक्त देखिते ।
तथापि बलिला प्रभु गर्व खण्डाइते ॥48॥
cc-madhya-9.48.translation: Although the Buddhists are unfit for discussion and should not be seen by Vaiṣṇavas, Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke to them just to decrease their false pride.

lines: tarkei khaṇḍila prabhu, nā pāre sthāpite
devanagari: तकर् - प्रधान बौद्ध - शास्त्र ‘नव म ते’ ।
तर्केइ खण्डिल प्रभु, ना पारे स्थापिते ॥49॥
cc-madhya-9.49.translation: The scriptures of the Buddhist cult are chiefly based on argument and logic, and they contain nine chief principles. Because Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu defeated them in their argument, they could not establish their cult.

lines: sei saba tīrthera krama kahite nā pāri
devanagari: सेइ सब तीर्थेर क़म कहिते ना पारि ।
दक्षिण - वामे तीर्थ - गमन हय फेराफेरि ॥5॥
cc-madhya-9.5.translation: I cannot chronologically record all the places of pilgrimage visited by Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. I can only summarize everything by saying that the Lord visited all holy places right and left, coming and going.

lines: dṛḍha yukti-tarke prabhu khaṇḍa khaṇḍa kaila
devanagari: बौद्धाचार्य ‘नव प्र श्न’ सब उठाइल ।
दृढ़ युक्ति - तर्के प्रभु खण्ड खण्ड कैल ॥50॥
cc-madhya-9.50.translation: The teacher of the Buddhist cult set forth nine principles, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu broke them to pieces with His strong logic.

lines: loke hāsya kare, bauddha pāila lajjā-bhaya
devanagari: दार्शनिक पण्डित सबाइ पाइल पराजय ।
लोके हास्य करे, बौद्ध पाइल लज्जा - भय ॥51॥
cc-madhya-9.51.translation: All mental speculators and learned scholars were defeated by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and when the people began to laugh, the Buddhist philosophers felt both shame and fear.

lines: prabhuke vaiṣṇava jāni' bauddha ghare gela
sakala bauddha mili' tabe kumantraṇā kaila
devanagari: प्रभुके वैष्णव जानि’ बौद्ध घरे गेल ।
सकल बौद्ध मि लि’ तबे कुमन्त्रणा कैल ॥52॥
cc-madhya-9.52.translation: The Buddhists could understand that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was a Vaiṣṇava, and they returned home very unhappy. Later, however, they began to plot against the Lord.

devanagari: अपवित्र अन्न एक था लिते भरिया ।
प्रभु - आगे निल ‘महा - प्रसाद’ बलिया ॥53॥
cc-madhya-9.53.translation: Having made their plot, the Buddhists brought a plate of untouchable food before Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and called it mahā-prasāda.

lines: ṭhoṅṭe kari' anna-saha thāli lañā gela
devanagari: हेन - काले महाकाय एक पक्षी आइल ।
ठोंटे क रि’ अन्न - सह थालि लञा गेल ॥54॥
cc-madhya-9.54.translation: When the contaminated food was offered to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, a very large bird appeared on the spot, picked up the plate in its beak and flew away.

lines: bauddha-gaṇera upare anna paḍe amedhya haiyā
devanagari: बौद्ध - गणेर उपरे अन्न पड़े अमेध्य हैया ।
बौद्धाचा र्येर माथाय थालि पड़िल बाजिया ॥55॥
cc-madhya-9.55.translation: Indeed, the untouchable food fell upon the Buddhists, and the large bird dropped the plate on the head of the chief Buddhist teacher. When it fell on his head, it made a big sound.

devanagari: तेरछे पड़िल थालि , - माथा का टि’ गेल ।
मूर्च्छित हञा आचार्य भूमिते पड़िल ॥56॥
cc-madhya-9.56.translation: The plate was made of metal, and when its edge hit the head of the teacher, it cut him, and the teacher immediately fell to the ground unconscious.

devanagari: हाहाकार क रि’ कान्दे सब शिष्य - गण ।
सबे आ सि’ प्रभु - पदे लइल शरण ॥57॥
cc-madhya-9.57.translation: When the teacher fell unconscious, his Buddhist disciples cried aloud and ran to the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for shelter.

lines: tumi ta' īśvara sākṣāt, kṣama aparādha
devanagari: तुमि त’ ईश्वर साक्षात्, क्षम अपराध ।
जीयाओ आमार गुरु, करह प्रसाद ॥58॥
cc-madhya-9.58.translation: They all prayed to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, addressing Him as the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself and saying, "Sir, please excuse our offense. Please have mercy upon us and bring our spiritual master back to life."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - सबे कह ‘कृष्ण’ ‘कृष्ण’ ‘हरि’ ।
गुरु - कर्णे कह कृष्ण - नाम उच्च क रि’ ॥59॥
cc-madhya-9.59.translation: The Lord then replied to the Buddhist disciples, "You should all chant the names of Kṛṣṇa and Hari very loudly near the ear of your spiritual master.

lines: kahite nā pāri tāra yathā anukrama
devanagari: अतएव नाम - मात्र करिये गणन् ।
कहिते ना पारि तार यथा अनुक्रम ॥6॥
cc-madhya-9.6.translation: Because it is impossible for me to record all these places in chronological order, I simply make a token gesture of recording them.

devanagari: तोमा - सबार ‘गुरु’ तबे पाइबे चेतन ।
सब बौद्ध मि लि’ करे कृष्ण - सङ्कीर्तन ॥60॥
cc-madhya-9.60.translation: "By this method your spiritual master will regain his consciousness." Following Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's advice, all the Buddhist disciples began to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa congregationally.

devanagari: गुरु - कर्णे कहे सबे ‘कृष्ण’ ‘राम’ ‘हरि’ ।
चेतन पाञा आचार्य बले ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ॥61॥
cc-madhya-9.61.translation: When all the disciples chanted the holy names Kṛṣṇa, Rāma and Hari, the Buddhist teacher regained consciousness and immediately began to chant the holy name of Lord Hari.

lines: kṛṣṇa bali' ācārya prabhure karena vinaya
devanagari: कृष्ण बलि’ आचार्य प्रभुरे करेन विनय ।
देखिया सकल लोक हइल विस्मय ॥62॥
cc-madhya-9.62.translation: When the spiritual master of the Buddhists began to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa and submitted to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the people who were gathered there were astonished.

lines: antardhāna kaila, keha nā pāya darśana
devanagari: एइ - रूपे कौतुक करि’ शचीर नन्दन ।
अन्तर्धान कैल, केह ना पाय दर्शन ॥63॥
cc-madhya-9.63.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of Śacīdevī, then suddenly and strangely disappeared from everyone's sight, and it was impossible for anyone to find Him.

devanagari: महाप्रभु चलि’ आइला त्रिपति - त्रिमल्ले ।
चतुर्भुज मूर्ति देखि’ व्येङ्कटाद्र्ये चले ॥64॥
cc-madhya-9.64.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu next arrived at Tirupati and Trimalla, where He saw a four-handed Deity. Then He next proceeded toward Vyeṅkaṭa Hill.

devanagari: त्रिपति आसिया कैल श्री - राम दरशन ।
रघुनाथ - आगे कैल प्रणाम स्तवन ॥65॥
cc-madhya-9.65.translation: After arriving at Tripati, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the temple of Lord Rāmacandra. He offered His prayers and obeisances before Rāmacandra, the descendant of King Raghu.

devanagari: स्व - प्रभावे लोक - सबार करा ञा विस्मय ।
पाना - नृसिंहे आइला प्रभु दया - मय ॥66॥
cc-madhya-9.66.translation: Everywhere Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went, His influence astonished everyone. He next arrived at the temple of Pānā-nṛsiṁha. The Lord is so merciful.

devanagari: नृसिंहे प्रणति - स्तुति प्रेमावेशे कैल ।
प्रभुर प्रभावे लोक चमत्कार हैल ॥67॥
cc-madhya-9.67.translation: In great ecstatic love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered obeisances and prayers unto Lord Nṛsiṁha. The people were astonished to see Lord Caitanya's influence.

devanagari: शिव - काञ्ची आसिया कैल शिव दरशन ।
प्रभावे ‘वैष्णव’ कैल सब शैव - गण ॥68॥
cc-madhya-9.68.translation: Arriving at Śiva-kāñcī, Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the deity of Lord Śiva. By His influence, He converted all the devotees of Lord Śiva into Vaiṣṇavas.

devanagari: विष्णु - काञ्ची आ सि’ देखिल लक्ष्मी - नारायण ।
प्रणाम करिया कैल बहुत स्तवन ॥69॥
cc-madhya-9.69.translation: The Lord then visited a holy place known as Viṣṇu-kāñcī. He saw there Lakṣmī-Nārāyaṇa Deities, and He offered His respects and many prayers to please Them.

lines: pūrvavat pathe yāite ye pāya daraśana
yei grāme yāya, se grāmera yata jana
devanagari: पूर्ववत्पथे याइते ये पाय दरशन ।
येइ ग्रामे याय, से ग्रामेर यत जन ॥7॥
cc-madhya-9.7-8.translation: As previously stated, all the residents of the villages visited by Lord Caitanya became Vaiṣṇavas and began to chant "Hari" and "Kṛṣṇa." In this way, in all the villages visited by the Lord, everyone became a Vaiṣṇava, a devotee.

devanagari: प्रेमावेशे नृत्य - गीत बहुत करिल ।
दिन - दुइ रहि’ लोके ‘कृष्ण - भक्त’ कैल ॥70॥
cc-madhya-9.70.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed at Viṣṇu-kāñcī for two days, He danced and performed kīrtana in ecstasy. When all the people saw Him, they were converted into devotees of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: त्रिमलय दे खि’ गेला त्रिकाल - हस्ति - स्थाने ।
महादेव दे खि’ ताँरे करिल प्रणामे ॥71॥
cc-madhya-9.71.translation: After visiting Trimalaya, Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see Trikāla-hasti. there He saw Lord Śiva and offered him all respects and obeisances.

devanagari: पक्षि - तीर्थ दे खि’ कैल शिव दरशन ।
वृद्धकोल - तीर्थे तबे करिला गमन ॥72॥
cc-madhya-9.72.translation: At Pakṣi-tīrtha, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the temple of Lord Śiva. Then He went to the Vṛddhakola place of pilgrimage.

devanagari: श्वेत - वराह देखि, ताँरे नमस्क रि’ ।
पीताम्बर - शिव - स्थाने गेला गौरहरि ॥73॥
cc-madhya-9.73.translation: At Vṛddhakola, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the temple of Śveta-varāha, the white boar. After offering Him respects, the Lord visited the temple of Lord Śiva, wherein the deity is dressed with yellow garments.

devanagari: शियाली भैरवी देवी क रि’ दरशन ।
कावेरीर तीरे आइला शचीर नन्दन ॥74॥
cc-madhya-9.74.translation: After visiting the temple of Śiyālī-bhairavī [another form of the goddess Durgā], Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of mother Śacī, went to the bank of the river Kāverī.

devanagari: गो - समाजे शिव दे खि’ आइला वेदावन ।
महादेव दे खि’ ताँरे करिला वन्दन ॥75॥
cc-madhya-9.75.translation: The Lord then visited a place known as Go-samāja, where He saw Lord Śiva's temple. He then arrived at Vedāvana, where He saw another deity of Lord Śiva and offered him prayers.

devanagari: अमृतलिङ्ग - शिव दे खि’ वन्दन करिल ।
सब शिवालये शैव वैष्ण व’ हइल ॥76॥
cc-madhya-9.76.translation: Seeing the Śiva deity named Amṛta-liṅga, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered His obeisances. Thus He visited all the temples of Lord Śiva and converted the devotees of Lord Śiva into Vaiṣṇavas.

devanagari: देव - स्थाने आ सि’ कैल विष्णु दरशन ।
श्री - वैष्णवेर सङ्गे ताहाँ गोष्ठी अनुक्षण ॥77॥
cc-madhya-9.77.translation: At Devasthāna, Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the temple of Lord Viṣṇu, and there He talked with the Vaiṣṇavas in the disciplic succession of Rāmānujācārya. These Vaiṣṇavas are known as Śrī Vaiṣṇavas.

devanagari: कुम्भकर्ण - कपाले दे खि’ सरोवर ।
शिव - क्षेत्रे शिव देखे गौराङ्ग - सुन्दर ॥78॥
cc-madhya-9.78.translation: At Kumbhakarṇa-kapāla, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw a great lake and then the holy place named Śiva-kṣetra, where a temple of Lord Śiva is located.

devanagari: पाप - नाशने विष्णु कैल दरशन ।
श्री - रङ्ग - क्षेत्रे तबे करिला गमन ॥79॥
cc-madhya-9.79.translation: After visiting the holy place named Śiva-kṣetra, Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at Pāpanāśana and there saw the temple of Lord Viṣṇu. Then He finally reached Śrī Raṅga-kṣetra.

devanagari: कावेरीते स्नान क रि’ देखि’ रङ्गनाथ ।
स्तुति - प्रणति क रि’ मानिला कृतार्थ ॥80॥
cc-madhya-9.80.translation: After bathing in the river Kāverī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the temple of Raṅganātha and offered His ardent prayers and obeisances. Thus He felt Himself successful.

lines: dekhi' camatkāra haila saba lokera mana
devanagari: प्रेमावेशे कैल बहुत गान नर्तन ।
देखि’ चमत्कार हैल सब लोकेर मन ॥81॥
cc-madhya-9.81.translation: In the temple of Raṅganātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chanted and danced in ecstatic love of Godhead. Seeing His performance, everyone was struck with wonder.

devanagari: श्री - वैष्णव एक , - ‘व्येङ्कट भट्ट’ नाम ।
प्रभुरे निमन्त्रण कैल करिया सम्मान ॥82॥
cc-madhya-9.82.translation: One Vaiṣṇava known as Vyeṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa then invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to his home with great respect.

lines: sei jala lañā kaila sa-vaṁśe bhakṣaṇa
devanagari: निज - घरे ल ञा कैल पाद - प्रक्षालन ।
सेइ जल लञा कैल सवंशे भक्षण ॥83॥
cc-madhya-9.83.translation: Śrī Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa took Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to his home. After he washed the Lord's feet, all the members of his family drank the water.

devanagari: भिक्षा करा ञा किछु कैल निवेदन ।
चातुर्मास्य आसि’ प्रभु, हैल उपसन्न ॥84॥
cc-madhya-9.84.translation: After offering lunch to the Lord, Vyeṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa submitted that the period of Cāturmāsya had already arrived.

lines: cāturmāsye kṛpā kari' raha mora ghare
devanagari: चातुर्मास्ये कृपा करि’ रह मोर घरे ।
कृष्ण - कथा क हि’ कृपाय उद्धार’ आमारे ॥85॥
cc-madhya-9.85.translation: Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa said, "Please be merciful to me and stay at my house during Cāturmāsya. Speak about Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes and kindly deliver me by Your mercy."

devanagari: ताँर घरे रहिला प्रभु कृष्ण - कथा - रसे ।
भट्ट - सङ्गे गोङाइल सुखे चारि मासे ॥86॥
cc-madhya-9.86.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained at the house of Vyeṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa for four continuous months. The Lord passed His days in great happiness, enjoying the transcendental mellow of discussing Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes.

devanagari: कावेरीते स्नान क रि’ श्री - रङ्ग दर्शन ।
प्रतिदिन प्रेमावेशे करेन नर्तन ॥87॥
cc-madhya-9.87.translation: While there, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took His bath in the river Kāverī and visited the temple of Śrī Raṅga. Every day the Lord also danced in ecstasy.

devanagari: सौन्दर्यादि प्रेमावेश देखि, सर्व - लोक ।
देखिबारे आइसे, देखे, खण्डे दुःख - शोक ॥88॥
cc-madhya-9.88.translation: The beauty of Lord Caitanya's body and His ecstatic love of God were witnessed by everyone. Many people used to come see Him, and as soon as they saw Him, all their unhappiness and distress vanished.

lines: lakṣa lakṣa loka āila nānā-deśa haite
devanagari: लक्ष लक्ष लोक आइल नाना - देश हैते ।
सबे कृष्ण - नाम कहे प्रभुके देखिते ॥89॥
cc-madhya-9.89.translation: Many hundreds of thousands of people from various countries came to see the Lord, and after seeing Him they all chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra.

lines: keha jñānī, keha karmī, pāṣaṇḍī apāra
devanagari: दक्षिण देशेर लोक अनेक प्रकार ।
केह ज्ञानी, केह कर्मी, पाषण्डी अपार ॥9॥
cc-madhya-9.9.translation: In South India there were many types of people. Some were philosophical speculators, and some were fruitive workers, but in any case there were innumerable nondevotees.

lines: kṛṣṇa-nāma vinā keha nāhi kahe āra
devanagari: कृष्ण - नाम विना केह नाहि कहे आर ।
सबे कृष्ण - भक्त हैल , - लोके चमत्कार ॥90॥
cc-madhya-9.90.translation: Indeed, they did not chant anything but the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, and all of them became Lord Kṛṣṇa's devotees. Thus the general populace was astonished.

lines: eka eka dina sabe kaila nimantraṇa
devanagari: श्री - रङ्ग - क्षेत्रे वैसे यत वैष्णव - ब्राह्मण ।
एक एक दिन सबे कैल निमन्त्रण ॥91॥
cc-madhya-9.91.translation: All the Vaiṣṇava brāhmaṇas residing in Śrī Raṅga-kṣetra invited the Lord to their homes every day.

lines: eka eka dine cāturmāsya pūrṇa haila
kataka brāhmaṇa bhikṣā dite nā pāila
devanagari: एक एक दिने चातुर्मास्य पूर्ण हैल ।
कतक ब्राह्मण भिक्षा दिते ना पाइल ॥92॥
cc-madhya-9.92.translation: Each day the Lord was invited by a different brāhmaṇa, but some of them did not get the opportunity to offer Him lunch because the period of Cāturmāsya came to an end.

devanagari: सेइ क्षेत्रे रहे एक वैष्णव - ब्राह्मण ।
देवालये आ सि’ करे गीता आवर्तन ॥93॥
cc-madhya-9.93.translation: In the holy place of Śrī Raṅga-kṣetra, a brāhmaṇa Vaiṣṇava used to visit the temple daily and recite the entire text of Bhagavad-gītā.

devanagari: अष्टादशाध्याय पड़े आनन्द - आवेशे ।
अशुद्ध पड़ेन, लोक करे उपहासे ॥94॥
cc-madhya-9.94.translation: The brāhmaṇa regularly read the eighteen chapters of Bhagavad-gītā in great transcendental ecstasy, but because he could not pronounce the words correctly, people used to joke about him.

lines: keha hāse, keha ninde, tāhā nāhi māne
devanagari: केह हासे, केह निन्दे, ताहा नाहि माने ।
आविष्ट ह ञा गीता पड़े आनन्दित - मने ॥95॥
cc-madhya-9.95.translation: Due to his incorrect pronunciation, people sometimes criticized him and laughed at him, but he did not care. He was full of ecstasy due to reading Bhagavad-gītā and was personally very happy.

devanagari: पुलकाश्रु, कम्प, स्वेद, - यावत्पठन ।
देखि’ आनन्दित हैल महाप्रभुर मन ॥96॥
cc-madhya-9.96.translation: While reading the book, the brāhmaṇa experienced transcendental bodily transformations. His hair stood on end, tears welled in his eyes, and his body trembled and perspired as he read. Seeing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became very happy.

lines: kon artha jāni' tomāra eta sukha haya
devanagari: महाप्रभु पुछिल ताँरे, शुन, महाशय ।
कोनर्थ जा नि’ तोमार एत सुख हय ॥97॥
cc-madhya-9.97.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked the brāhmaṇa, "My dear sir, why are you in such ecstatic love? Which portion of Bhagavad-gītā gives you such transcendental pleasure?"

lines: vipra kahe,—mūrkha āmi, śabdārtha nā jāni
devanagari: विप्र कहे, - मूर्ख आमि, शब्दार्थ ना जानि ।
शुद्धाशुद्ध गीता पड़ि, गुरु - आज्ञा मा नि’ ॥98॥
cc-madhya-9.98.translation: The brāhmaṇa replied, "I am illiterate and therefore do not know the meaning of the words. Sometimes I read Bhagavad-gītā correctly and sometimes incorrectly, but in any case I am doing this in compliance with the orders of my spiritual master."

devanagari: अर्जुनेर रथे कृष्ण हय रज्जु - धर ।
वसियाछे हाते तोत्र श्यामल सुन्दर ॥99॥
cc-madhya-9.99.translation: The brāhmaṇa continued, "Actually I only see Lord Kṛṣṇa sitting on a chariot as Arjuna's charioteer. Taking the reins in His hands, He appears very beautiful and blackish.

devanagari: तं वन्दे गौर - जलदं स्वस्य यो दर्शनामृतैः ।
विच्छेदावग्रह - म्लान - भक्त - शस्यान्यजीवयत् ॥1॥
cc-madhya-10.1.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances unto Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is compared to a cloud that pours water on fields of grain, which are like devotees suffering due to a shortage of rain. Separation from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is like a drought, but when the Lord returns, His presence is like a nectarean rain that falls on all the grains and saves them from perishing.

devanagari: राजा कहे , - जगन्नाथ छा ड़ि’ केने गेला ।
भट्ट कहे , - महान्तेर एइ एक लीला ॥10॥
cc-madhya-10.10.translation: The King asked, "Why has He left Jagannātha Purī?"

devanagari: सबे आसितेछेन तोमारे देखिते ।
ताँ - सबार विलम्ब दे खि’ आइलाङ त्वरिते ॥100॥
cc-madhya-10.100.translation: "They are all coming here to see You, but seeing that they were delayed, I came alone very quickly."

lines: prabhu tāṅre dila, āra sevāra kiṅkara
devanagari: काशी - मिश्रेर आवासे निभृते एक घर ।
प्रभु ताँरे दिल, आर सेवार किङ्कर ॥101॥
cc-madhya-10.101.translation: There was a solitary room at Kāśī Miśra's house, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave it to Paramānanda Purī. He also gave him one servant.

devanagari: आर दिने आइला स्वरूप दामोदर ।
प्रभुर अत्यन्त मर्मी, रसेर सागर ॥102॥
cc-madhya-10.102.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara also arrived the next day. He was a very intimate friend of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and he was an ocean of transcendental mellows.

devanagari: ‘पुरुषोत्तम आचार्य’ ताँर नाम पूर्वाश्रमे ।
नवद्वीपे छिला तेंह प्रभुर चरणे ॥103॥
cc-madhya-10.103.translation: When Svarūpa Dāmodara was residing at Navadvīpa under the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, his name was Puruṣottama Ācārya.

devanagari: प्रभुर सन्न्यास देखि’ उन्मत्त ह ञा ।
सन्न्यास ग्रहण कैल वाराणसी गिया ॥104॥
cc-madhya-10.104.translation: After seeing that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted the renounced order, Puruṣottama Ācārya became like a madman and immediately went to Vārāṇasī to take sannyāsa.

devanagari: ‘चैतन्यानन्द’ गुरु ताँर आज्ञा दिलेन ताँरे ।
वेदान्त पड़िया पड़ाओ समस्त लोकेरे ॥105॥
cc-madhya-10.105.translation: At the conclusion of his sannyāsa, his spiritual master, Caitanyānanda Bhāratī, ordered him, "Read Vedānta-sūtra and teach it to all others."

devanagari: परम विरक्त तेंह परम पण्डित ।
काय - मने आश्रियाछे श्री - कृष्ण - चरित ॥106॥
cc-madhya-10.106.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara was a great renunciate as well as a great learned scholar. With heart and soul he took shelter of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: ‘निश्चिन्ते कृष्ण भजिब’ एइ त’ कारणे ।
उन्मादे करिल तेंह सन्न्यास ग्रहणे ॥107॥
cc-madhya-10.107.translation: He was very enthusiastic to worship Śrī Kṛṣṇa without disturbance; therefore it was almost in madness that he accepted the sannyāsa order.

devanagari: सन्न्यास करिला शिखा - सूत्र - त्याग - रूप ।
योग - पट्ट ना निल, नाम हैल ‘स्वरूप’ ॥108॥
cc-madhya-10.108.translation: Upon accepting sannyāsa, Puruṣottama Ācārya followed the regulative principles by giving up his tuft of hair and sacred thread, but he did not accept the saffron-colored dress. Also, he did not accept a sannyāsī title but remained as a naiṣṭhika-brahmacārī.

devanagari: गुरु - ठाञि आज्ञा मा गि’ आइला नीलाचले ।
रात्रि - दिने कृष्ण - प्रेम - आनन्द - विह्वले ॥109॥
cc-madhya-10.109.translation: After taking permission from his sannyāsa-guru, Svarūpa Dāmodara went to Nīlācala and accepted the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Then all day and night, in ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa, he enjoyed transcendental mellows in the loving service of the Lord.

devanagari: तीर्थ पवित्र करिते करे तीर्थ - भ्रमण ।
सेइ छले निस्तारये सांसारिक जन ॥11॥
cc-madhya-10.11.translation: "Great saints go to holy places of pilgrimage in order to purify them. For that reason Caitanya Mahāprabhu is visiting many tīrthas and delivering many, many conditioned souls.

lines: pāṇḍityera avadhi, vākya nāhi kāro sane
nirjane rahaye, loka saba nāhi jāne
devanagari: पाण्डित्येर अवधि, वाक्य नाहि कारो सने ।
निर्जने रहये, लोक सब नाहि जाने ॥110॥
cc-madhya-10.110.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara was the limit of all learned scholarship, but he did not exchange words with anyone. He simply remained in a solitary place, and no one could understand where he was.

devanagari: कृष्ण - रस - तत्त्व - वेत्ता, देह - प्रेम - रूप ।
साक्षात्महाप्रभुर द्वितीय स्वरूप ॥111॥
cc-madhya-10.111.translation: Śrī Svarūpa Dāmodara was the personification of ecstatic love, fully cognizant of the transcendental mellows in relationship with Kṛṣṇa. He directly represented Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as His second expansion.

lines: grantha, śloka, gīta keha prabhu-pāśe āne
svarūpa parīkṣā kaile, pāche prabhu śune
devanagari: ग्रन्थ, श्लोक, गीत केह प्रभु - पाशे आने ।
स्वरूप परीक्षा कैले, पाछे प्रभु शुने ॥112॥
cc-madhya-10.112.translation: If someone wrote a book or composed verses and songs and wanted to recite them before Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Svarūpa Dāmodara would first examine them and then correctly present them. Only then would Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu agree to listen.

lines: śunite nā haya prabhura cittera ullāsa
devanagari: भक्ति - सिद्धान्त - विरुद्ध, आर रसाभास ।
शुनिते ना हय प्रभुर चित्तेर उल्लास ॥113॥
cc-madhya-10.113.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was never pleased to hear books or verses opposed to the conclusive statements of devotional service. The Lord did not like hearing rasābhāsa, the overlapping of transcendental mellows.

lines: śuddha haya yadi, prabhure karā'na śravaṇa
devanagari: अतएव स्वरूप आगे करे परीक्षण ।
शुद्ध हय यदि, प्रभुरे करा’न श्रवण ॥114॥
cc-madhya-10.114.translation: It was the practice of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī to examine all works of literature to find out whether their conclusions were correct. Only then would he allow them to be heard by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: ei tina gīte karā'na prabhura ānanda
devanagari: विद्यापति, चण्डीदास, श्री - गीत - गोविन्द ।
एइ तिन गीते करा’न प्रभुर आनन्द ॥115॥
cc-madhya-10.115.translation: Śrī Svarūpa Dāmodara used to read the poems of Vidyāpati and Caṇḍīdāsa and Jayadeva Gosvāmī's Śrī Gīta-govinda. He used to make Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu very happy by singing these songs.

devanagari: सङ्गीते - गन्धर्व - सम, शास्त्रे बृहस्पति ।
दामोदर - सम आर नाहिं महा - मति ॥116॥
cc-madhya-10.116.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara was as expert a musician as the Gandharvas, and in scriptural discussion he was just like Bṛhaspati, the priest of the heavenly gods. Therefore it is to be concluded that there was no great personality quite like Svarūpa Dāmodara.

devanagari: अद्वैत - नित्यानन्देर परम प्रि यतम ।
श्रीवासादि भक्त - गणेर हय प्राण - सम ॥117॥
cc-madhya-10.117.translation: Śrī Svarūpa Dāmodara was very dear to Advaita Ācārya and Nityānanda Prabhu, and he was the life and soul of all the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: सेइ दामोदर आ सि’ दण्डवत् हैला ।
चरणे पड़िया श्लोक पड़िते लागिला ॥118॥
cc-madhya-10.118.translation: It was Svarūpa Dāmodara who came to Jagannātha Purī and fell flat before the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, offering Him obeisances and reciting a verse.

lines: śrī-caitanya dayā-nidhe tava dayā bhūyād amandodayā
devanagari: हेलोद्धूनित - खेदया विशदया प्रोन्मीलदामोदया शाम्यच्छास्त्र - विवादया रस - दया चित्तार्पितोन्मादया ।
शश्वद्भक्ति - विनोदया स - मदया माधुर्य - मर्यादया श्री - चैतन्य दयानिधे तव दया भूयादमन्दोदया ॥119॥
cc-madhya-10.119.translation: "O ocean of mercy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! Let there be an awakening of Your auspicious mercy, which easily drives away all kinds of material lamentation. By Your mercy, everything is made pure and blissful. It awakens transcendental bliss and covers all gross material pleasures. By Your auspicious mercy, quarrels and disagreements arising among different scriptures are vanquished. Your auspicious mercy causes the heart to jubilate by pouring forth transcendental mellows. Your mercy always stimulates devotional service, which is full of joy. You are always glorifying the conjugal love of God. May transcendental bliss be awakened within my heart by Your causeless mercy."

devanagari: भवद्विधा भागवतास्तीर्थी - भूताः स्वयं विभो ।
तीर्थी - कुर्वन्ति तीर्थानि स्वान्तः - स्थेन गदा - भृता ॥12॥
cc-madhya-10.12.translation: “ 'Saints of your caliber are themselves places of pilgrimage. Because of their purity, they are constant companions of the Lord, and therefore they can purify even the places of pilgrimage.'

devanagari: उठाञा महाप्रभु कैल आलिङ्गन ।
दुइ - जने प्रेमावेशे हैल अचेतन ॥120॥
cc-madhya-10.120.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu raised Svarūpa Dāmodara to his feet and embraced him. They both became ecstatic in love and fell unconscious.

lines: kata-kṣaṇe dui jane sthira yabe hailā
devanagari: कत - क्षणे दुइ जने स्थिर यबे हैला ।
तबे महाप्रभु ताँरे कहिते लागिला ॥121॥
cc-madhya-10.121.translation: After they had regained their patience, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to speak.

lines: tumi ye āsibe, āji svapnete dekhila
bhāla haila, andha yena dui netra pāila
devanagari: तुमि ये आसिबे, आजि स्वप्नेते देखिल ।
भाल हैल, अन्ध येन दुइ नेत्र पाइल ॥122॥
cc-madhya-10.122.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "I saw in a dream that you were coming, and so this is very auspicious. I have been like a blind man, but your coming here restores My vision."

lines: tomā chāḍi' anyatra genu, karinu pramāda
devanagari: स्वरूप कहे , - प्रभु, मोर क्ष म’ अपराध ।
तोमा छा ड़ि’ अन्यत्र गेनु, करिनु प्रमाद ॥123॥
cc-madhya-10.123.translation: Svarūpa said, "My dear Lord, please excuse my offense. I gave up Your company to go elsewhere, and that was my great mistake.

lines: tomā chāḍi' pāpī muñi genu anya deśa
devanagari: तोमार चरणे मोर नाहि प्रेम - लेश ।
तोमा छा ड़ि’ पापी मुञि गेनु अन्य देश ॥124॥
cc-madhya-10.124.translation: "My dear Lord, I do not even possess a trace of love at Your lotus feet. If I did, how could I go to another country? I am therefore a most sinful man.

lines: muñi tomā chāḍila, tumi more nā chāḍilā
devanagari: मुञि तोमा छाड़िल, तुमि मोरे ना छाड़िला ।
कृपा - पाश गले बान्धि’ चरणे आनिला ॥125॥
cc-madhya-10.125.translation: "I gave up Your company, but You did not give me up. By Your merciful rope You have bound me by the neck and brought me back again to Your lotus feet."

lines: tabe svarūpa kaila nitāira caraṇa vandana
devanagari: तबे स्वरूप कैल निताइर चरण वन्दन ।
नित्यानन्द - प्रभु कैल प्रेम - आलिङ्गन ॥126॥
cc-madhya-10.126.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara then worshiped the lotus feet of Nityānanda Prabhu, and Nityānanda in turn embraced him in the ecstasy of love.

devanagari: जगदानन्द, मुकुन्द, शङ्कर, सार्वभौम ।
सबा - सङ्गे यथा - योग्य करिल मिलन ॥127॥
cc-madhya-10.127.translation: After worshiping Nityānanda Prabhu, Svarūpa Dāmodara met Jagadānanda, Mukunda, Śaṅkara and Sārvabhauma, as was befitting.

devanagari: परमानन्द पुरीर कैल चरण वन्दन ।
पुरी - गोसाञि ताँरे कैल प्रेम - आलिङ्गन ॥128॥
cc-madhya-10.128.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara also offered his worshipful prayers at the lotus feet of Paramānanda Purī, who, in return, embraced him in ecstatic love.

devanagari: महाप्रभु दिल ताँरे निभृते वासा - घर ।
जलादि - परिचर्या ला गि’ दिल एक किङ्कर ॥129॥
cc-madhya-10.129.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then gave Svarūpa Dāmodara residence in a solitary place and ordered one servant to serve him with a supply of water and other necessities.

lines: vaiṣṇavera ei haya eka svabhāva niścala
teṅho jīva nahena, hana svatantra īśvara
devanagari: वैष्णवेर एइ हय एक स्वभाव निश्चल ।
तेंहो जीव नहेन, हन स्वतन्त्र ईश्वर ॥13॥
cc-madhya-10.13.translation: "A Vaiṣṇava travels to places of pilgrimage to purify them and reclaim fallen conditioned souls. This is one of the duties of a Vaiṣṇava. Actually, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is not a living entity but the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself. Consequently, He is a fully independent controller, yet in His position as a devotee, He carries out the activities of a devotee."

devanagari: आर दिन सार्वभौम - आदि भक्त - सङ्गे ।
वसिया आछेन महाप्रभु कृष्ण - कथा - रङ्गे ॥130॥
cc-madhya-10.130.translation: The next day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat with all the devotees, headed by Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, and they discussed the pastimes of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: हेन - काले गोविन्देर हैल आगमन ।
दण्डवत्क रि’ कहे विनय - वचन ॥131॥
cc-madhya-10.131.translation: At that time Govinda appeared on the scene, offered his respectful obeisances and spoke submissively.

devanagari: ईश्वर - पुरीर भृत्य, - ‘गोविन्द’ मोर नाम ।
पुरी - गोसाञि र आज्ञाय आइनु तोमार स्थान ॥132॥
cc-madhya-10.132.translation: "I am the servant of Īśvara Purī. My name is Govinda, and following the orders of my spiritual master, I have come here.

devanagari: सिद्ध - प्राप्ति - काले गोसाञि आज्ञा कैल मोरे ।
कृष्ण - चैतन्य - निकटे रहि सेविह ताँहारे ॥133॥
cc-madhya-10.133.translation: "Just before his departure from this mortal world to attain the highest perfection, Īśvara Purī told me that I should go to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and render service unto Him.

devanagari: काशीश्वर आसिबेन सब तीर्थ देखिया ।
प्रभु - आज्ञाय मुञि आइनु तोमा - पदे धाञा ॥134॥
cc-madhya-10.134.translation: "Kāśīśvara will also come here after visiting all the holy places. However, following the orders of my spiritual master, I have hastily come to be present at Your lotus feet."

lines: kṛpā kari' mora ṭhāñi pāṭhāilā tomāre
devanagari: गोसाञि कहिल, ‘पुरीश्वर’ वात्सल्य करे मोरे ।
कृपा करि’ मोर ठाञि पाठाइला तोमारे ॥135॥
cc-madhya-10.135.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "My spiritual master, Īśvara Purī, always favors Me with paternal affection. Therefore, out of his causeless mercy, he has sent you here."

devanagari: एत शुनि’ सार्वभौम प्रभुरे पुछिल ।
पुरी - गोसाञि शूद्र - सेवक काँहे त’ राखिल ॥136॥
cc-madhya-10.136.translation: After hearing this, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya asked Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Why did Īśvara Purī keep a servant who comes from a śūdra family?"

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - ईश्वर हय परम स्वतन्त्र ।
ईश्वरेर कृपा नहे वेद - परतन्त्र ॥137॥
cc-madhya-10.137.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Both the Supreme Personality of Godhead and the spiritual master, Īśvara Purī, are completely independent. Therefore neither the mercy of the Supreme Personality of Godhead and Īśvara Purī is subject to any Vedic rules and regulations.

devanagari: ईश्वरेर कृपा जाति - कुलादि ना माने ।
विदुरेर घरे कृष्ण करिला भोजने ॥138॥
cc-madhya-10.138.translation: "The mercy of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is not restricted to the jurisdiction of caste and creed. Vidura was a śūdra, yet Kṛṣṇa accepted lunch at his home.

devanagari: स्नेह - लेशापेक्षा मात्र श्रीकृष्ण - कृपार ।
स्नेह - वश ह ञा करे स्वतन्त्र आचा र ॥139॥
cc-madhya-10.139.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa's mercy is dependent only on affection. Being obliged only by affection, Lord Kṛṣṇa acts very independently.

lines: rājā kahe,-tāṅre tumi yāite kene dile
pāya paḍi' yatna kari' kene nā rākhile
devanagari: राजा कहे , - ताँरे तुमि याइते केने दिले ।
पाय प ड़ि’ यत्न करि’ केने ना राखिले ॥14॥
cc-madhya-10.14.translation: Upon hearing this, the King replied, "Why did you allow Him to leave? Why didn't you fall at His lotus feet and keep Him here?"

devanagari: मर्यादा हैते कोटि सुख स्नेह - आचरणे ।
परमानन्द हय यार नाम - श्रवणे ॥140॥
cc-madhya-10.140.translation: "In conclusion, dealings in affection with the Supreme Personality of Godhead bring happiness many millions of times greater than dealings with Him in awe and veneration. Simply by hearing the holy name of the Lord, the devotee is merged in transcendental bliss."

devanagari: एत ब लि’ गोविन्देरे कैल आलिङ्गन ।
गोविन्द करिल प्रभुर चरण वन्दन ॥141॥
cc-madhya-10.141.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced Govinda, and Govinda in turn offered his respectful obeisances unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's lotus feet.

lines: gurura kiṅkara haya mānya se āmāra
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - भट्टाचार्य, करह विचार ।
गुरुर किङ्कर हय मान्य से आमार ॥142॥
cc-madhya-10.142.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then continued speaking to Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya: "Consider this point. The servant of the spiritual master is always respectable for Me.

lines: guru ājñā diyāchena, ki kari upāya
devanagari: ताँहारे आपन - सेवा कराइते ना युयाय ।
गुरु आज्ञा दियाछेन, कि करि उपाय ॥143॥
cc-madhya-10.143.translation: "As such, it is not befitting that the guru's servant should engage in My personal service. Yet My spiritual master has given this order. What shall I do?"

devanagari: भट्ट कहे , - गुरुर आज्ञा हय बलवान् ।
गुरु - आज्ञा ना लङ्गिये, शास्त्र - प्रमाण ॥144॥
cc-madhya-10.144.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya said, "The order of the spiritual master is very strong and cannot be disobeyed. That is the injunction of the śāstras, the revealed scriptures.

devanagari: स शुश्रुवान्मातरि भार्गवेण पितुर्नियोगात्प्रहृतं द्विषद्वत् ।
प्रत्यगृहीदग्रज - शासनं तद् आज्ञा गुरूणां ह्यविचारणीया ॥145॥
cc-madhya-10.145.translation: “ 'Being ordered by his father, Paraśurāma killed his mother, Reṇukā, just as if she were an enemy. Lakṣmaṇa, the younger brother of Lord Rāmacandra, immediately engaged Himself in the service of His elder brother and accepted His orders. The order of the spiritual master must be obeyed without consideration.'

devanagari: निर्विचारं गुरोराज्ञा मया कार्या महात्मनः ।
श्रेयो ह्येवं भवत्याश्च मम चैव विशेषतः ॥146॥
cc-madhya-10.146.translation: “ 'The order of a great personality like a father must be executed without consideration because there is good fortune in such an order for both of us. In particular, there is good fortune for Me.' "

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु ताँरे कैल अङ्गीकार ।
आपन - श्री - अङ्ग - सेवाय दिल अधिकार ॥147॥
cc-madhya-10.147.translation: After Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya said this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced Govinda and engaged him in the service of His personal body.

lines: prabhura priya bhṛtya kari' sabe kare māna
devanagari: प्रभुर प्रिय भृत्य करि’ सबे करे मान ।
सकल वैष्णवेर गोविन्द करे समाधान ॥148॥
cc-madhya-10.148.translation: Everyone respected Govinda as the dearest servant of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and Govinda served all the Vaiṣṇavas and saw to their needs.

devanagari: छोट - बड़ - कीर्तनीया - दुइ हरिदास ।
रामाइ, नन्दाइ रहे गोविन्देर पाश ॥149॥
cc-madhya-10.149.translation: Both Haridāsa senior and Haridāsa junior, who were musicians, as well as Rāmāi and Nandāi, used to stay with Govinda.

devanagari: भट्टाचार्य कहे , - तेंहो स्वयं ईश्वर स्वतन्त्र ।
साक्षात्श्रीकृष्ण, तेंहो नहे पर - तन्त्र ॥15॥
cc-madhya-10.15.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya replied, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself and is completely independent. Being Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself, He is not dependent on anyone.

devanagari: गोविन्देर सङ्गे करे प्रभुर सेवन ।
गोविन्देर भाग्य - सीमा ना याय वर्णन ॥150॥
cc-madhya-10.150.translation: They all remained with Govinda to serve Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; therefore no one could estimate the good fortune of Govinda.

lines: āra dine mukunda-datta kahe prabhura sthāne
devanagari: आर दिने मुकुन्द - दत्त कहे प्रभुर स्थाने ।
ब्रह्मानन्द - भारती आइला तोमार दरशने ॥151॥
cc-madhya-10.151.translation: The next day Mukunda Datta informed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Brahmānanda Bhāratī has come to see You."

lines: ājñā deha' yadi tāṅre āniye ethāi
prabhu kahe,-guru teṅha, yāba tāṅra ṭhāñi
devanagari: आज्ञा दे ह’ यदि ताँरे आनिये एथाइ ।
प्रभु कहे, - गुरु तेंह, याब ताँर ठाञि ॥152॥
cc-madhya-10.152.translation: Mukunda Datta then asked the Lord, "Shall I bring him here?"

devanagari: एत ब लि’ महाप्रभु भक्त - गण - सङ्गे ।
चलि’ आइला ब्रह्मानन्द - भारतीर आगे ॥153॥
cc-madhya-10.153.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees came before the presence of Brahmānanda Bhāratī.

lines: tāhā dekhi' prabhu duḥkha pāilā antara
devanagari: ब्रह्मानन्द परियाछे मृग - चर्माम्बर ।
ताहा दे खि’ प्रभु दुःख पाइला अन्तर ॥154॥
cc-madhya-10.154.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees approached him, they saw that he was covered with a deerskin. Seeing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became very unhappy.

lines: dekhiyā ta' chadma kaila yena dekhe nāñi
devanagari: देखिया त छद्म कैल येन देखे ना ञि ।
cc-madhya-10.155.translation: Seeing Brahmānanda Bhāratī thus attired, Caitanya Mahāprabhu pretended not to see him. Instead, He asked Mukunda Datta, "Where is Brahmānanda Bhāratī, My spiritual master?"

devanagari: मुकुन्द कहे, - एइ आगे देख विद्यमान ।
प्रभु कहे, - तेंह नहेन, तुमि अगेयान ॥156॥
cc-madhya-10.156.translation: Mukunda Datta replied, "Here is Brahmānanda Bhāratī, in Your presence."

lines: anyere anya kaha, nāhi tomāra jñāna
devanagari: अन्येरे अन्य कह, नाहि तोमार ज्ञान ।
भारती - गोसाञि केने परिबेन चाम ॥157॥
cc-madhya-10.157.translation: "You must be talking of someone else, for this is surely not Brahmānanda Bhāratī. You simply have no knowledge. Why should Brahmānanda Bhāratī wear a deerskin?"

lines: mora carmāmbara ei nā bhāya iṅhāre
devanagari: शुनि’ ब्रह्मानन्द करे हृदये विचारे ।
मोर चर्माम्बर एइ ना भाय इँहारे ॥158॥
cc-madhya-10.158.translation: When Brahmānanda Bhāratī heard this, he thought, "My deerskin is not approved by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

devanagari: भाल कहेन , - चर्माम्बर दम्भ ला गि’ परि ।
चर्माम्बर - परिधाने संसार ना तरि ॥159॥
cc-madhya-10.159.translation: Thus admitting his mistake, Brahmānanda Bhāratī thought, "He spoke well. I put on this deerskin only for prestige. I cannot cross over the ocean of nescience simply by wearing a deerskin.

lines: tathāpi rākhite tāṅre bahu yatna kailuṅ
devanagari: तथापि राखिते ताँरे बहु यत्न कैलुँ ।
ईश्वरेर स्वतन्त्र इच्छा, राखिते नारिलुँ ॥16॥
cc-madhya-10.16.translation: "Still, I endeavored very hard to keep Him here, but because He is the Supreme Personality of Godhead and completely independent, I was not successful."

lines: āji haite nā pariba ei carmāmbara
devanagari: आजि हैते ना परिब एइ चर्माम्बर ।
प्रभु बहिर्वास आनाइला जानिया अन्तर ॥160॥
cc-madhya-10.160.translation: "From today on I shall not wear this deerskin." As soon as Brahmānanda Bhāratī decided this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, understanding his mind, immediately sent for the robes of a sannyāsī.

lines: prabhu āsi' kaila tāṅra caraṇa vandana
devanagari: चर्माम्बर छा ड़ि’ ब्रह्मानन्द परिल वसन ।
प्रभु आसि’ कैल ताँर चरण वन्दन ॥161॥
cc-madhya-10.161.translation: As soon as Brahmānanda Bhāratī gave up his deerskin and covered himself with sannyāsī robes, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came and offered His respects at his lotus feet.

lines: punaḥ nā karibe nati, bhaya pāṅa citte
devanagari: भारती कहे , - तोमार आचार लोक शिखा इते ।
पुनः ना करिबे नति, भय पाङ चित्ते ॥162॥
cc-madhya-10.162.translation: Brahmānanda Bhāratī said, "You instruct the general populace by Your behavior. I will not do anything against Your wishes; otherwise You will not offer me respects but will neglect me. I am afraid of this.

devanagari: साम्प्रतिक ‘दुई ब्रह्म’ इहाँ ‘चलाचल’ ।
जगन्नाथ - अचल ब्रह्म, तुमि त’ सचल ॥163॥
cc-madhya-10.163.translation: "At the present moment I see two Brahmans. One Brahman is Lord Jagannātha, who does not move, and the other Brahman, who is moving, is You. Lord Jagannātha is arcā-vigraha, the worshipable Deity, and it is He who is the nonmoving Brahman. However, You are Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and You are moving here and there. Both of You are the same Brahman, master of material nature, but You are playing two parts-one moving and one not moving. In this way two Brahmans are now residing at Jagannātha Purī, Puruṣottama.

devanagari: तुमि - गौर - वर्ण, तेंह - श्यामल - वर्ण ।
दुइ ब्रह्मे कैल सब जगत्तारण ॥164॥
cc-madhya-10.164.translation: "Of the two Brahmans, You are fair-complexioned, and the other, Lord Jagannātha, is blackish. both of You are delivering the whole world."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - सत्य कहि, तोमार आगमने ।
दुइ ब्रह्म प्रकटिल श्री - पुरुषोत्तमे ॥165॥
cc-madhya-10.165.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Actually, to tell you the truth, due to your presence there are now two Brahmans at Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: ‘ब्रह्मानन्द’ नाम तुमि - गौर - ब्रह्म ‘चल’ ।
श्याम - वर्ण जगन्नाथ वसियाछेन ‘अचल’ ॥166॥
cc-madhya-10.166.translation: "Both Brahmānanda and Gaurahari are moving, whereas the blackish Lord Jagannātha is sitting tight and immobile."

lines: iṅhāra sane āmāra 'nyāya' bujha' mana diyā
devanagari: भारती कहे , - सार्वभौम, मध्यस्थ ह ञा ।
इँहार सने आमार ‘न्याय’ बुझ’ मन दिया ॥167॥
cc-madhya-10.167.translation: Brahmānanda Bhāratī said, "My dear Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, please become the mediator in this logical argument between Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and me."

devanagari: ‘व्याप्य’ ‘व्यापक’ - भावे ‘जीव’ - ‘ब्रह्म’ जानि ।
जीव - व्याप्य, ब्रह्म - व्यापक, शास्त्रेते वाखानि ॥168॥
cc-madhya-10.168.translation: Brahmānanda Bhāratī continued, "The living entity is localized, whereas the Supreme Brahman is all-pervading. That is the verdict of the revealed scriptures.

devanagari: चर्म घुचाञा कैल आमारे शोधन ।
दोंहार व्याप्य - व्यापकत्वे एइ त’ कारण ॥169॥
cc-madhya-10.169.translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu purified me by taking away my deerskin. This is proof that He is all-pervasive and all-powerful and that I am subordinate to Him.

lines: tumi tāṅre 'kṛṣṇa' kaha, tāte satya māni
devanagari: राजा कहे , - भट्ट तुमि विज्ञ - शिरोमणि ।
तुमि ताँरे ‘कृष्ण’ कह, ताते सत्य मानि ॥17॥
cc-madhya-10.17.translation: The King said, "Bhaṭṭācārya, you are the most learned and experienced person I know. Therefore when you address Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as Lord Kṛṣṇa, I accept this as the truth.

devanagari: सुवर्ण - वर्णो हेमाङ्गो वराङ्गश्चन्दनाङ्गदी ।
सन्न्यास - कृच्छमः शान्तो निष्ठा - शान्ति - परायणः ॥170॥
cc-madhya-10.170.translation: “ 'His bodily hue is golden, and His whole body is like molten gold. Every part of His body is very beautifully constructed and smeared with sandalwood pulp. Accepting the renounced order, the Lord is always equipoised. He is firmly fixed in His mission of chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra, and He is firmly situated in His dualistic conclusion and in His peace.'

lines: ei saba nāmera iṅha haya nijāspada
devanagari: एइ सब नामेर इँह हय निजास्पद ।
चन्दनाक्त प्रसाद - डोर - श्री - भुजे अङ्गद ॥171॥
cc-madhya-10.171.translation: "All the symptoms mentioned in the verse from the Viṣṇu-sahasra-nāma-stotra are visible in the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. His arms are decorated with sandalwood pulp and the thread received from the Śrī Jagannātha Deity, and these are His ornamental bangles."

lines: prabhu kahe,-yei kaha, sei satya haya
devanagari: भट्टाचार्य कहे , - भारती, देखि तोमार जय ।
प्रभु कहे, - येइ कह, सेइ सत्य हय ॥172॥
cc-madhya-10.172.translation: After hearing this, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya rendered his judgment, saying, "Brahmānanda Bhāratī, I see that you are victorious."

lines: bhāratī kahe,-eho nahe, anya hetu haya
devanagari: गुरु - शिष्य - न्याये सत्य शिष्येर पराजय ।
भारती कहे , - एहो नहे, अन्य हेतु हय ॥173॥
cc-madhya-10.173.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus posed Himself as a disciple and accepted Brahmānanda Bhāratī as His spiritual master. He then said, "The disciple is certainly defeated in an argument with the spiritual master."

lines: bhakta ṭhāñi hāra' tumi,-e tomāra svabhāva
āra eka śuna tumi āpana prabhāva
devanagari: भक्त ठाञि हार’ तुमि, - ए तोमार स्वभाव ।
आर एक शुन तुमि आपन प्रभाव ॥174॥
cc-madhya-10.174.translation: "It is Your natural characteristic to accept defeat at the hands of Your devotee. There is also another glory of Yours, which I ask You to hear attentively.

devanagari: आजन्म करिनु मुञि ‘निराका र’ - ध्यान ।
तोमा देखि’ ‘कृष्ण’ हैल मोर विद्यमान ॥175॥
cc-madhya-10.175.translation: "I have been meditating on the impersonal Brahman since my birth, but since I have seen You, I have fully experienced Kṛṣṇa."

lines: kṛṣṇa-nāma sphure mukhe, mane netre kṛṣṇa
devanagari: कृष्ण - नाम स्फुरे मुखे, मने नेत्रे कृष्ण ।
तोमाके तद्रूप देखि’ हृदय - सतृष्ण ॥176॥
cc-madhya-10.176.translation: Brahmānanda Bhāratī continued, "Since I have seen You, I have been feeling Lord Kṛṣṇa's presence in my mind and have been seeing Him before my eyes. I now want to chant the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Over and above this, within my heart I consider You to be Kṛṣṇa, and I am therefore very eager to serve You.

lines: ihāṅ dekhi' sei daśā ha-ila āmāra
devanagari: बिल्वमङ्गल कैल यैछे दशा आपनार ।
इहाँ दे खि’ सेइ दशा हद्दल आमार ॥177॥
cc-madhya-10.177.translation: "Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura abandoned his impersonal realization for the realization of the Personality of Godhead. I now see that my condition is similar to his, for it has already changed."

devanagari: अद्वैत - वीथी - पथिकैरुपास्याः स्वानन्द - सिंहासन - लब्ध - दीक्षाः ।
शठेन केनापि वयं हठेन दासी - कृता गोप - वधू - विटेन ॥178॥
cc-madhya-10.178.translation: Brahmānanda Bhāratī concluded, " 'Although I was worshiped by those on the path of monism and initiated into self-realization through the yoga system, I am nonetheless been forcibly turned into a maidservant by some cunning boy who is always joking with the gopīs.' "

lines: prabhu kahe,-kṛṣṇe tomāra gāḍha premā haya
yāhāṅ netra paḍe, tāhāṅ śrī-kṛṣṇa sphuraya
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - कृष्णे तोमार गाढ़ प्रेमा हय ।
याहाँ नेत्र पड़े, ताहाँ श्रीकृष्ण स्फुरय ॥179॥
cc-madhya-10.179.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "You have a deep ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa; therefore wherever your eyes turn, you simply heighten your Kṛṣṇa consciousness."

devanagari: पुनरपि इहाँ ताँर हैले आगमन ।
एक - बार देखि करि सफल नयन ॥18॥
cc-madhya-10.18.translation: "When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returns again, I wish to see Him just once in order to make my eyes perfect."

lines: āge yadi kṛṣṇa dena sākṣāt daraśana
devanagari: भट्टाचार्य कहे , - दोंहार सुसत्य वचन ।
आगे यदि कृष्ण देन साक्षात्दरशन ॥180॥
cc-madhya-10.180.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya said, "Both Your statements of both of you are correct. Kṛṣṇa gives direct audience through His own mercy.

lines: prema vinā kabhu nahe tāṅra sākṣātkāra
devanagari: प्रेम विना कभु नहे ताँर साक्षात्कार ।
इँहार कृपाते हय दरशन इँहार ॥181॥
cc-madhya-10.181.translation: "Without having ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa, one cannot see Him directly. Therefore through the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Brahmānanda Bhāratī has acquired direct vision of the Lord."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - ‘विष्णु’ ‘विष्णु’, कि कह सार्वभौम ।
‘अति - स्तुति’ हय एइ निन्दार लक्षण ॥182॥
cc-madhya-10.182.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, what are you saying? Lord Viṣṇu, save Me! Such glorification is simply another form of blasphemy."

lines: eta bali' bhāratīre lañā nija-vāsā āilā
devanagari: एत ब लि’ भारतीरे लञा निज - वासा आइला ।
भारती - गोसाञि प्रभुर निकटे रहिला ॥183॥
cc-madhya-10.183.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took Brahmānanda Bhāratī with Him to His residence. From that time on, Brahmānanda Bhāratī remained with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: prabhu-pade rahilā duṅhe chāḍi' sarva kārya
devanagari: रामभद्राचार्य, आर भगवानाचार्य ।
प्रभु - पदे रहिला दुँहे छाड़ि’ सर्व कार्य ॥184॥
cc-madhya-10.184.translation: Later, Rāmabhadra Ācārya and Bhagavān Ācārya also joined them and, giving up all other responsibilities, remained under Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's shelter.

lines: sammāna kariyā prabhu rākhilā nija sthāne
devanagari: काशीश्वर गोसाञि आइला आर दिने ।
सम्मान करिया प्रभु राखिला निज स्थाने ॥185॥
cc-madhya-10.185.translation: The next day, Kāśīśvara Gosāñi also came and remained with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who received him with great respect.

devanagari: प्रभुके लञा करा’न ईश्वर दरशन ।
आगे लोक - भिड़ सब क रि’ निवारण ॥186॥
cc-madhya-10.186.translation: Kāśīśvara used to usher Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu into the Jagannātha temple. He would precede the Lord into the crowd and keep the people from touching Him.

lines: yata nada nadī yaiche samudre milaya
aiche mahāprabhura bhakta yāhāṅ tāhāṅ haya
devanagari: यत नद नदी यैछे समुद्रे मिलय ।
ऐछे महाप्रभुर भक्त याहाँ ताहाँ हय ॥187॥
cc-madhya-10.187.translation: As all the rivers flow into the sea, all the devotees throughout the country finally came to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's shelter.

lines: prabhu kṛpā kari' sabāya rākhila nija sthāne
devanagari: सबे आ सि’ मिलिला प्रभुर श्री - चरणे ।
प्रभु कृपा करि’ सबाय राखिल निज स्थाने ॥188॥
cc-madhya-10.188.translation: Since all the devotees came to Him for shelter, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed them all mercy and kept them under His protection.

devanagari: एइ त’ कहिल प्रभुर वैष्णव - मिलन ।
इहा येइ शुने, पाय चैतन्य - चरण ॥189॥
cc-madhya-10.189.translation: Thus I have described the meeting of all the Vaiṣṇavas with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Whoever hears this description ultimately attains His shelter.

lines: rahite tāṅre eka sthāna cāhiye virale
devanagari: भट्टाचार्य कहे , - तेंहो आसिबे अल्प - काले ।
रहिते ताँरे एक स्थान चाहिये विरले ॥19॥
cc-madhya-10.19.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya replied, "His Holiness Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu will return very soon. I wish to have a nice place ready for Him, a place solitary and peaceful.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥190॥
cc-madhya-10.190.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-madhya-10.2.translation: All glories to Lord Caitanya All glories to Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya!

lines: e-mata nirṇaya kari' deha' eka sthāne
devanagari: ठाकुरेर निकट, आर हइबे निर्जने ।
ए - मत निर्णय क रि’ देह’ एक स्थाने ॥20॥
cc-madhya-10.20.translation: "Lord Caitanya's residence should be very secluded and also near the temple of Jagannātha. Please consider this proposal and give me a nice place for Him."

devanagari: राजा कहे , - ऐछे काशी - मिश्रेर भवन ।
ठाकुरेर निकट, हय परम निर्जन ॥21॥
cc-madhya-10.21.translation: The King replied, "Kāśī Miśra's house is exactly what you require. It is near the temple and is very secluded, calm and quiet."

lines: eta kahi' rājā rahe utkaṇṭhita hañā
devanagari: एत क हि’ राजा रहे उत्कण्ठित ह ञा ।
भट्टाचार्य काशी - मिश्रे कहिल आसिया ॥22॥
cc-madhya-10.22.translation: After saying this, the King became very anxious for the Lord to return. Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya then went to Kāśī Miśra to convey the King's desire.

devanagari: काशी - मिश्र कहे , - आमि बड़ भाग्यवान् ।
मोर गृहे ‘प्रभु - पादेर’ हबे अवस्थान ॥23॥
cc-madhya-10.23.translation: When Kāśī Miśra heard the proposal, he said, "I am very fortunate that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord of all prabhus, will stay at my home."

devanagari: एइ - मत पुरुषोत्तम - वासी यत जन ।
प्रभुके मिलिते सबार उत्कण्ठित मन ॥24॥
cc-madhya-10.24.translation: Thus all the residents of Jagannātha Purī, which is also known as Puruṣottama, were very anxious to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again.

devanagari: सर्व - लोकेर उत्कण्ठा यबे अत्यन्त बाड़िल ।
महाप्रभु दक्षिण हैते तबहि आइल ॥25॥
cc-madhya-10.25.translation: When all the residents of Jagannātha Purī were thus anxious, the Lord again, He returned from South India.

devanagari: शुनि’ आनन्दित हैल सबाकार मन ।
सबे आ सि’ सार्वभौमे कैल निवेदन ॥26॥
cc-madhya-10.26.translation: Hearing of the Lord's return, everyone became very happy, and they all went to Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and spoke to him as follows.

devanagari: प्रभुर सहित आमा - सबार कराह मिलन ।
तोमार प्रसादे पाइ प्रभुर चरण ॥27॥
cc-madhya-10.27.translation: "Please arrange our meeting with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. It is only by your mercy that we can attain the shelter of the lotus feet of the Lord."

devanagari: भट्टाचार्य कहे , - कालि काशी - मिश्रेर घरे ।
प्रभु याइबेन, ताहाँ मिलाब सबारे ॥28॥
cc-madhya-10.28.translation: The Bhaṭṭācārya replied to the people, "Tomorrow the Lord will be at the house of Kāśī Miśra. I shall arrange for you all to meet Him."

devanagari: आर दिन महाप्रभु भट्टाचा र्येर सङ्गे ।
जगन्नाथ दरशन कैल महा - रङ्गे ॥29॥
cc-madhya-10.29.translation: The next day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived and went with Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, with great enthusiasm, to see the temple of Lord Jagannātha.

devanagari: पूर्वे यबे महाप्रभु चलिला दक्षिणे ।
प्रतापरुद्र राजा तबे बोलाइल सार्वभौमे ॥3॥
cc-madhya-10.3.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu departed for South India, King Pratāparudra called Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya to his palace.

devanagari: महा - प्रसाद दिया ताहाँ मिलिला सेवक - गण ।
महाप्रभु सबाकारे कैल आलिङ्गन ॥30॥
cc-madhya-10.30.translation: All the servants of Lord Jagannātha delivered remnants of the Lord's food to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. In return, Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them all.

devanagari: दर्शन क रि’ महाप्रभु चलिला बाहिरे ।
भट्टाचार्य आनिल ताँरे काशी - मिश्र - घरे ॥31॥
cc-madhya-10.31.translation: After seeing Lord Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left the temple. Bhaṭṭācārya then took Him to the house of Kāśī Miśra.

devanagari: काशी - मिश्र आ सि’ पड़िल प्रभुर चरणे ।
गृह - सहित आत्मा ताँरे कैल निवेदने ॥32॥
cc-madhya-10.32.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at his house, Kāśī Miśra immediately fell down at His lotus feet and surrendered himself and all his possessions.

devanagari: प्रभु चतुर्भुज - मूर्ति ताँरे देखाइल ।
आत्मसात्क रि’ तारे आलिङ्गन कैल ॥33॥
cc-madhya-10.33.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then showed Kāśī Miśra His four-armed form. Then, accepting him for His service, the Lord embraced him.

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु ताहाँ वसिला आसने ।
चौदिके वसिला नित्यानन्दादि भक्त - गणे ॥34॥
cc-madhya-10.34.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu next sat down at the place prepared for Him, and all the devotees, headed by Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, surrounded Him.

lines: sukhī hailā dekhi' prabhu vāsāra saṁsthāna
devanagari: सुखी हैला देखि’ प्रभु वासार संस्थान ।
येइ वासाय हय प्रभुर सर्व - समाधान ॥35॥
cc-madhya-10.35.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very happy to see His residential quarters, in which all His necessities were taken care of.

devanagari: सार्वभौम कहे , - प्रभु, योग्य तोमार वासा ।
तुमि अङ्गीकार कर, - काशी - मिश्रेर आशा ॥36॥
cc-madhya-10.36.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya said, "This place is just befitting You. Please accept it. It is the hope of Kāśī Miśra that You do."

lines: yei tumi kaha, sei sammata āmāra
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - एइ देह तोमा - सबाकार ।
येइ तुमि कह, सेइ सम्मत आमार ॥37॥
cc-madhya-10.37.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "My body belongs to all of you. Therefore I agree to whatever you say."

devanagari: तबे सार्वभौम प्रभुर दक्षिण - पार्श्वे वसि’ ।
मिलाइते लागिला सब पुरुषोत्तम - वासी ॥38॥
cc-madhya-10.38.translation: After this, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, sitting at the right hand of the Lord, began to introduce all the inhabitants of Puruṣottama, Jagannātha Purī.

lines: ei saba loka, prabhu, vaise nīlācale
devanagari: एइ सब लोक, प्रभु, वैसे नीलाचले ।
उत्कण्ठित हाञाछे सबे तोमा मिलिबारे ॥39॥
cc-madhya-10.39.translation: The Bhaṭṭācārya said, "My dear Lord, all these people who are residents of Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī, have been very anxious to meet You.

devanagari: वसिते आसन दिल क रि’ नमस्कारे ।
महाप्रभुर वार्ता तबे पुछिल ताँहारे ॥4॥
cc-madhya-10.4.translation: When Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya met with the King, the King offered him a seat with all respects and inquired about news of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: तृषित चातक यैछे करे हाहाकार ।
तैछे एइ सब , - सबे कर अङ्गीकार ॥40॥
cc-madhya-10.40.translation: "In Your absence all these people have been exactly like thirsty cātaka birds crying in disappointment. Kindly accept them."

devanagari: जगन्नाथ - सेवक एइ, नाम - जनार्दन ।
अनवसरे करे प्रभुर श्री - अङ्ग - सेवन ॥41॥
cc-madhya-10.41.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya first introduced Janārdana, saying, "Here is Janārdana, servant of Lord Jagannātha. He renders service to the Lord when it is time to renovate His transcendental body."

devanagari: कृष्णदास - नाम एइ सुवर्ण - वेत्र - धारी ।
शिखि माहाति - नाम एइ लिखना धिकारी ॥42॥
cc-madhya-10.42.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya continued, "This is Kṛṣṇadāsa, who carries a golden cane, and here is Śikhi Māhiti, who is in charge of writing.

devanagari: प्रद्युम्न - मिश्र इँह वैष्णव प्रधान ।
जगन्नाथेर महा - सोयार इँह ‘दास’ नाम ॥43॥
cc-madhya-10.43.translation: "This is Pradyumna Miśra, who is chief of all Vaiṣṇavas. He is a great servitor of Jagannātha, and his name is Dāsa.

lines: tomāra caraṇa vinu āra gati nāi
