cc-madhya-13.111.translation: After performing His devastating dance for some time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mind entered into a mood of ecstatic love.

devanagari: ताण्डव - नृत्य छाड़ि’ स्वरूपेरे आज्ञा दिल ।
हृदय जानिया स्वरूप गाइते लागिल ॥112॥
cc-madhya-13.112.translation: After abandoning the dancing, the Lord ordered Svarūpa Dāmodara to sing. Understanding His mind, Svarūpa Dāmodara began to sing as follows.

devanagari: “सेइ त पराण - नाथ पाइनु ।
याहा लागि’ मदन - दहने झुरि’ गेनु” ॥113॥
cc-madhya-13.113.translation: "Now I have gained the Lord of My life, in the absence of whom I was being burned by Cupid and was withering away."

devanagari: एइ धुया उच्चैः - स्वरे गाय दामोदर ।
आनन्दे मधुर नृत्य करेन ईश्वर ॥114॥
cc-madhya-13.114.translation: When this refrain was loudly sung by Svarūpa Dāmodara, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again began rhythmically dancing in transcendental bliss.

lines: āge nṛtya kari' calena śacīra nandana
devanagari: धीरे धीरे जगन्नाथ करेन गमन ।
आगे नृत्य करि’ चलेन शचीर नन्दन ॥115॥
cc-madhya-13.115.translation: The car of Lord Jagannātha began to move slowly while the son of mother Śacī went ahead and danced in front.

lines: jagannāthe netra diyā sabe nāce, gāya
kīrtanīyā saha prabhu pāche pāche yāya
devanagari: जगन्नाथे नेत्र दिया सबे नाचे, गाय ।
कीर्तनीया सह प्रभु पाछे पाछे याय ॥116॥
cc-madhya-13.116.translation: While dancing and singing, all the devotees in front of Lord Jagannātha kept their eyes on Him. Caitanya Mahāprabhu then went to the end of the procession with the saṅkīrtana performers.

devanagari: जगन्नाथे मग्न प्रभुर नयन - हृदय ।
श्री - हस्त - युगे करे गीतेर अभिनय ॥117॥
cc-madhya-13.117.translation: His eyes and mind fully absorbed in Lord Jagannātha, Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to play the drama of the song with His two arms.

lines: gaura yadi pāche cale, śyāma haya sthire
gaura āge cale, śyāma cale dhīre-dhīre
devanagari: गौर यदि पाछे चले, श्याम हय स्थिरे ।
गौर आगे चले, श्याम चले धीरे - धीरे ॥118॥
cc-madhya-13.118.translation: When Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dramatically enacting the song, He would sometimes fall behind in the procession. At such times, Lord Jagannātha would come to a standstill. When Caitanya Mahāprabhu again went forward, Lord Jagannātha's car would slowly start again.

devanagari: एइ - मत गौर - श्यामे, दोंहे ठेलाठेलि ।
स्वरथे श्यामेरे राखे गौर महा - बली ॥119॥
cc-madhya-13.119.translation: Thus there was a sort of competition between Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Jagannātha in seeing who would lead, but Caitanya Mahāprabhu was so strong that He made Lord Jagannātha wait in His car.

lines: tulā saba uḍi' yāya, śabda haya pracaṇḍa
devanagari: प्रभु - पदाघाते तुली हय खण्ड खण्ड ।
तुला सब उड़ि’ याय, शब्द हय प्रचण्ड ॥12॥
cc-madhya-13.12.translation: While the dayitās carried the heavy Jagannātha Deity from one pad to the next, some of the pads broke, and the cotton contents floated into the air. When they broke, they made a heavy, cracking sound.

lines: hasta tuli' śloka paḍe kari' uccaiḥ-svara
devanagari: नाचिते नाचिते प्रभुर हैला भावान्तर ।
हस्त तुलि’ श्लोक पड़े करि’ उच्चैः - स्वर ॥120॥
cc-madhya-13.120.translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing, His ecstasy changed. Raising His two arms, He began to recite the following verse in a loud voice.

lines: yaḥ kaumāra-haraḥ sa eva hi varas tā eva caitra-kṣapās
devanagari: यः कौमार - हरः स एव हि वरस्ता एव चैत्र - क्षपास् ते चोन्मीलित - मालती - सुरभयः प्रौढ़ाः कदम्बानिलाः ।
सा चैवास्मि तथापि तत्र सुरत - व्यापार - लीला - विधौ रेवा - रोधसि वेतसी - तरु - तले चे तः समुत्कण्ठते ॥121॥
cc-madhya-13.121.translation: "That very personality who stole away my heart during my youth is now again my master. These are the same moonlit nights of the month of Caitra. The same fragrance of mālatī flowers is there, and the same sweet breezes are blowing from the kadamba forest. In our intimate relationship, I am also the same lover, yet still my mind is not happy here. I am eager to go back to that place on the bank of the Revā under the Vetasī tree. That is my desire."

lines: ei śloka mahāprabhu paḍe bāra bāra
svarūpa vinā artha keha nā jāne ihāra
devanagari: एइ श्लोक महाप्रभु पड़े बार बार ।
स्वरूप विना अर्थ केह ना जाने इहार ॥122॥
cc-madhya-13.122.translation: This verse was recited by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again and again. But for Svarūpa Dāmodara, no one could understand its meaning.

devanagari: एइ श्लोकार्थ पूर्वे करियाछि व्याख्यान ।
श्लोकेर भावार्थ करि सङ्क्षेपे आख्यान ॥123॥
cc-madhya-13.123.translation: I have already explained this verse. Now I shall simply describe it in brief.

devanagari: पूर्वे यैछे कुरुक्षेत्रे सब गोपी - गण ।
कृष्णेर दर्शन पाञा आनन्दित मन ॥124॥
cc-madhya-13.124.translation: Formerly, all the gopīs of Vṛndāvana were very pleased when they met with Kṛṣṇa in the holy place Kurukṣetra.

lines: jagannātha dekhi' prabhura se bhāva uṭhila
devanagari: जगन्नाथ देखि’ प्रभुर से भाव उठिल ।
सेइ भावाविष्ट ह ञा धुया गाओयाइल ॥125॥
cc-madhya-13.125.translation: Similarly, after seeing Lord Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu awoke with the ecstasy of the gopīs. Being absorbed in this ecstasy, He asked Svarūpa Dāmodara to sing the refrain.

lines: sei tumi, sei āmi, sei nava saṅgama
devanagari: अवशेषे राधा कृष्णे करे निवेदन ।
सेइ तुमि, सेइ आमि, सेइ नव सङ्गम ॥126॥
cc-madhya-13.126.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke thus to Lord Jagannātha: "You are the same Kṛṣṇa, and I am the same Rādhārāṇī. We are meeting again in the same way that We met in the beginning of Our lives.

devanagari: तथापि आमार मन हरे वृन्दावन ।
वृन्दावने उदय कराओ आपन - चरण ॥127॥
cc-madhya-13.127.translation: "Although We are both the same, My mind is still attracted to Vṛndāvana-dhāma. I wish that You will please again appear with Your lotus feet in Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: इहाँ लोकारण्य, हाती, घोड़ा, रथ - ध्वनि ।
ताहाँ पुष्पारण्य, भृङ्ग - पिक - नाद शुनि ॥128॥
cc-madhya-13.128.translation: "Kurukṣetra is crowded with people, their elephants and horses, and the rattling of chariots. In Vṛndāvana, however, there are flower gardens, and the humming of the bees and chirping of the birds can be heard.

devanagari: इहाँ राज - वेश, सङ्गे सब क्षत्रिय - गण ।
ताहाँ गोप - वेश, सङ्गे मुरली - वादन ॥129॥
cc-madhya-13.129.translation: "Here at Kurukṣetra You are dressed like a royal prince, accompanied by great warriors, but in Vṛndāvana You appeared just like an ordinary cowherd boy, accompanied only by Your beautiful flute.

devanagari: विश्वम्भर जगन्नाथे के चालाइते पारे ? ।
आपन इच्छाय चले करिते विहारे ॥13॥
cc-madhya-13.13.translation: Lord Jagannātha is the maintainer of the whole universe. Who can carry Him from one place to another? However, the Lord moves by His personal will just to perform His pastimes.

lines: sei sukha-samudrera ihāṅ nāhi eka kaṇa
devanagari: व्रजे तोमार सङ्गे येइ सुख - आस्वादन ।
सेइ सुख - समुद्रेर इहाँ नाहि एक कण ॥130॥
cc-madhya-13.130.translation: "Here there is not even a drop of the ocean of transcendental happiness that I enjoyed with You in Vṛndāvana.

lines: āmā lañā punaḥ līlā karaha vṛndāvane
tabe āmāra mano-vāñchā haya ta' pūraṇe
devanagari: आमा लञा पुनः लीला करह वृन्दावने ।
तबे आमार मनो - वाञ्छा हय त’ पूरणे ॥131॥
cc-madhya-13.131.translation: "I therefore request You to come to Vṛndāvana and enjoy pastimes with Me. If You do so, My ambition will be fulfilled."

devanagari: भागवते आछे यैछे राधिका - वचन ।
पूर्वे ताहा सूत्र - मध्ये करियाछि वर्णन ॥132॥
cc-madhya-13.132.translation: I have already described in brief Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's statement from Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

lines: sei bhāvāveśe prabhu paḍe āra śloka
sei saba ślokera artha nāhi bujhe loka
devanagari: सेइ भावावेशे प्रभु पड़े आर श्लोक ।
सेइ सब श्लोकेर अर्थ नाहि बुझे लोक ॥133॥
cc-madhya-13.133.translation: In that ecstatic mood, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited many other verses, but people in general cannot understand their meaning.

lines: svarūpa-gosāñi jāne, nā kahe artha tāra
devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि जाने, ना कहे अर्थ तार ।
श्री - रूप - गोसाञि कैल से अर्थ प्रचार ॥134॥
cc-madhya-13.134.translation: The meaning of those verses was known to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, but he did not reveal it. However, Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī has broadcast the meaning.

lines: svarūpa saṅge yāra artha kare āsvādana
devanagari: स्वरूप सङ्गे यार अर्थ करे आस्वादन ।
नृत्य - मध्ये सेइ श्लोक करेन पठन ॥135॥
cc-madhya-13.135.translation: While dancing, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again began to recite that verse, which He tasted in the association of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.

lines: gehaṁ juṣām api manasy udiyāt sadā naḥ
devanagari: आहुश्च ते नलिन - नाभ पदारविन्दं योगेश्व रैर्हदि विचिन्त्यमगाध - बोधैः ।
संसार - कूप - पतितोत्तरणावलम्ब गेहं जुषामपि मनस्युदियात्सदा नः ॥136॥
cc-madhya-13.136.translation: "The gopīs spoke thus: 'Dear Lord, whose navel is just like a lotus flower, Your lotus feet are the only shelter for those who have fallen into the deep well of material existence. Your feet are worshiped and meditated upon by great mystic yogīs and highly learned philosophers. We wish that these lotus feet may also be awakened within our hearts, although we are only ordinary persons engaged in household affairs.' "

lines: tāhāṅ tomāra pada-dvaya, karāha yadi udaya,
devanagari: अन्येर हृदय - मन, मोर मन - वृन्दावन
‘मने ‘वने’ एक करि’ जानि ।
ताहाँ तोमार पद - द्वय, कराह यदि उदय
तबे तोमार पूर्ण कृपा मानि ॥137॥
cc-madhya-13.137.translation: Speaking in the mood of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, " 'For most people, the mind and heart are one, but because My mind is never separated from Vṛndāvana, I consider My mind and Vṛndāvana to be one. My mind is already Vṛndāvana, and since You like Vṛndāvana, will You please place Your lotus feet there? I would deem that Your full mercy.

devanagari: प्राण - नाथ, शुन मोर सत्य निवेदन
व्रज - आमार सदन, ताहाँ तोमार सङ्गम, ।
ना पाइले ना रहे जीवन ॥138॥
cc-madhya-13.138.translation: “ 'My dear Lord, kindly hear My true submission. My home is Vṛndāvana, and I wish Your association there. But if I do not get it, then it will be very difficult for Me to keep My life.

devanagari: पूर्वे उद्धव - द्वारे, एबे साक्षातामारे ,
योग - ज्ञाने कहिला उपाय ।
तुमि - विदग्ध, कृपामय, जानह आमार हृदय ,
मोरे ऐछे कहिते ना युयाय ॥139॥
cc-madhya-13.139.translation: “ 'My dear Kṛṣṇa, formerly, when You were staying in Mathurā, You sent Uddhava to teach Me speculative knowledge and mystic yoga. Now You Yourself are speaking the same thing, but My mind doesn't accept it. There is no place in My mind for jñāna-yoga or dhyāna-yoga. Although You know Me very well, You are still instructing Me in jñāna-yoga and dhyāna-yoga. It is not right for You to do so.' "

devanagari: महाप्रभु ‘मणिमा’ ‘मणिमा’ करे ध्वनि ।
नाना - वाद्य - कोलाहले किछुइ ना शुनि ॥14॥
cc-madhya-13.14.translation: While the Lord was transported from the throne to the car, tumultuous sounds were made on various musical instruments. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was chanting "Maṇimā Maṇimā," but He could not be heard.

lines: citta kāḍhi' tomā haite, viṣaye cāhi lāgāite,
tāre dhyāna śikṣā karāha, loka hāsāñā māra,
devanagari: चित्त काढ़ि’ तोमा हैते, विषये चाहि लागाइते ,
यत्न करि, नारि काढ़िबारे ।
तारे ध्यान शिक्षा कराह, लोक हासाञा मार,
स्थानास्थान ना कर विचारे ॥140॥
cc-madhya-13.140.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued: " 'I would like to withdraw My consciousness from You and engage it in material activities, but even though I try, I cannot do so. I am naturally inclined to You only. Your instructions for Me to meditate on You are therefore simply ludicrous. In this way, You are killing Me. It is not very good for You to think of Me as a candidate for Your instructions.

devanagari: नहे गोपी योगेश्वर, पद - कमल तोमार
ध्यान करि’ पाइबे सन्तोष ।
तोमार वाक्य - परिपाटी, तार मध्ये कुटिनाटी
शुनि’ गोपीर आरो बाढ़े रोष ॥141॥
cc-madhya-13.141.translation: “ 'The gopīs are not like the mystic yogīs. They will never be satisfied simply by meditating on Your lotus feet and imitating the so-called yogīs. Teaching the gopīs about meditation is another kind of duplicity. When they are instructed to undergo mystic yoga practice, they are not at all satisfied. On the contrary, they become more angry with You.' "

lines: deha-smṛti nāhi yāra, saṁsāra-kūpa kāhāṅ tāra,
devanagari: देह - स्मृति नाहि यार, संसार - कूप काहाँ तार
ताहा हैते ना चाहे उद्धार ।
विरह - समुद्र - जले, काम - तिमिङ्गिले गिले
गोपी - गणे ने ह’ तार पार ॥142॥
cc-madhya-13.142.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued: " 'The gopīs are fallen in the great ocean of separation, and they are being devoured by the timiṅgila fish, which represent their ambition to serve You. The gopīs are to be delivered from the mouths of these timiṅgila fish, for they are pure devotees. Since they have no material conception of life, why should they aspire for liberation? The gopīs do not want that liberation desired by yogīs and jñānīs, for they are already liberated from the ocean of material existence.

lines: sei vrajera vraja-jana, mātā, pitā, bandhu-gaṇa,
devanagari: वृन्दावन, गोवर्धन, यमुना - पुलिन, वन,
सेइ कुञ्जे रासादिक लीला ।
सेइ व्रजेर व्रज - जन, माता, पिता, बन्धु - गण,
बड़ चित्र, केमने पासरिला ॥143॥
cc-madhya-13.143.translation: “ 'It is amazing that You have forgotten the land of Vṛndāvana. And how is it that You have forgotten Your father, mother and friends? How have You forgotten Govardhana Hill, the bank of the Yamunā, and the forest where You enjoyed the rāsa-līlā dance?

lines: vidagdha, mṛdu, sad-guṇa, suśīla, snigdha, karuṇa,
tabe ye tomāra mana, nāhi smare vraja-jana,
devanagari: विदग्ध, मृदु, सद्गुण, सुशील, स्निग्ध, करुण ,
तुमि, तोमार नाहि दोषाभास ।
तबे ये तोमार मन, नाहि स्मरे व्रज - जन,
से - आमार दुर्दैव - विलास ॥144॥
cc-madhya-13.144.translation: “ 'Kṛṣṇa, You are certainly a refined gentleman with all good qualities. You are well-behaved, softhearted and merciful. I know that there is not even a tinge of fault to be found in You, yet Your mind does not even remember the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana. This is only My misfortune, and nothing else.

lines: kibā māra' vraja-vāsī, kibā jīyāo vraje āsi',
devanagari: ना गणि आपन - दुःख, देखि’ व्रजेश्वरी - मुख
व्रज - जनेर हृदय विदरे ।
किबा मा र’ व्रज - वासी, किबा जीयाओ व्रजे आसि’
केन जीयाओ दुःख सहाइबारे? ॥145॥
cc-madhya-13.145.translation: “ 'I do not care for My personal unhappiness, but when I see the morose face of Your mother Yaśodā and the hearts of all the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana breaking because of You, I wonder whether You want to kill them all. Is it that You want to enliven them by coming there? Why is it You are simply keeping them alive in a state of suffering?

lines: tomāra ye anya veśa, anya saṅga, anya deśa,
vraja-bhūmi chāḍite nāre, tomā nā dekhile mare,
devanagari: तोमार ये अन्य वेश, अन्य सङ्ग, अन्य देश ,
व्रज - जने कभु नाहि भाय ।
व्रज - भूमि छाड़िते नारे, तोमा ना देखिले मरे ,
व्रज - जनेर कि हबे उपाय ॥146॥
cc-madhya-13.146.translation: “ 'The inhabitants of Vṛndāvana do not want You dressed like a prince, nor do they want You to associate with great warriors in a different country. They cannot leave the land of Vṛndāvana, and without Your presence, they are all dying. What is their condition to be?

lines: kṛpārdra tomāra mana, āsi' jīyāo vraja-jana,
devanagari: तुमि - व्रजेर जीवन, व्रज - राजेर प्राण - धन
तुमि व्रजेर सकल सम्पद् ।
कृपार्द्र तोमार मन, आसि’ जीयाओ व्रज - जन
व्रजे उदय कराओ निज - पद ॥147॥
cc-madhya-13.147.translation: “ 'My dear Kṛṣṇa, You are the life and soul of Vṛndāvana-dhāma. You are especially the life of Nanda Mahārāja. You are the only opulence in the land of Vṛndāvana, and You are very merciful. Please come and let them all live. Kindly keep Your lotus feet again in Vṛndāvana.'

devanagari: शुनिया राधिका - वाणी, व्रज - प्रेम मने आनि
भावे व्याकुलित देह - मन ।
व्रज - लोकेर प्रेम शुनि’, आपनाके ‘ऋणी’ मानि’
करे कृष्ण ताँरे आश्वासन ॥148॥
cc-madhya-13.148.translation: "After hearing Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's statements, Lord Kṛṣṇa's love for the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana was evoked, and His body and mind became very perturbed. After hearing of their love for Him, He immediately thought Himself to be always indebted to the residents of Vṛndāvana. Then Kṛṣṇa began to pacify Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī as follows.

lines: mora duḥkha nā jāne kona jana
devanagari: प्राण - प्रिये, शुन, मोर ए - सत्य - वचन
तोमा - सबार स्मरणे, झुरों मुञि रात्रि - दिने, ।
मोर दुःख ना जाने कोन जन ॥149॥
cc-madhya-13.149.translation: “ 'My dearest Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, please hear Me. I am speaking the truth. I cry day and night simply upon remembering all you inhabitants of Vṛndāvana. No one knows how unhappy this makes Me.'

devanagari: तबे प्रतापरुद्र करे आपने सेवन ।
सुवर्ण - मार्जनी लञा करे पथ सम्मार्जन ॥15॥
cc-madhya-13.15.translation: While the Lord was being carried from the throne to the car, King Pratāparudra personally engaged in the Lord's service by cleansing the road with a broom that had a golden handle.

lines: vraja-vāsī yata jana, mātā, pitā, sakhā-gaṇa,
tāṅra madhye gopī-gaṇa, sākṣāt mora jīvana,
devanagari: व्रज - वासी यत जन, माता, पिता, सखा - गण,
सबे हय मोर प्राण - सम ।
ताँर मध्ये गोपी - गण, साक्षात्मोर जीवन ,
तुमि मोर जीवनेर जीवन ॥150॥
cc-madhya-13.150.translation: "Śrī Kṛṣṇa continued: 'All the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana-dhāma-My mother, father, cowherd boy friends and everything else-are like My life and soul. And among all the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana, the gopīs are My very life and soul. Among the gopīs, You, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, are the chief. Therefore You are the very life of My life.

devanagari: तोमा - सबार प्रेम - रसे, आमाके करिल वशे
आमि तोमार अधीन केवल ।
तोमा - सबा छाड़ा ञा, आमा दूर - देशे लञा
राखियाछे दुर्दैव प्रबल ॥151॥
cc-madhya-13.151.translation: “ 'My dear Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, I am always subservient to the loving affairs of all of you. I am under your control only. My separation from you and residence in distant places have occurred due to My strong misfortune.

lines: mora daśā śone yabe, tāṅra ei daśā habe,
devanagari: प्रिया प्रिय - सङ्ग - हीना, प्रिय प्रिया - सङ्ग विना,
नाहि जीये , - ए सत्य प्रमाण ।
मोर दशा शोने यबे, ताँर एइ दशा हबे ,
एइ भये दुँहे राखे प्राण ॥152॥
cc-madhya-13.152.translation: “ 'When a woman is separated from the man she loves or a man is separated from his beloved woman, neither of them can live. It is a fact that they live only for one another, for if one dies and the other hears of it, he or she will die also.

lines: sei satī premavatī, premavān sei pati,
devanagari: सेइ सती प्रेमवती, प्रेमवान्सेइ पति
वियोगे ये वाञ्छे प्रिय - हिते ।
ना गणे आपन - दुःख, वाञ्छे प्रियजन - सुख
सेइ दुइ मिले अचिराते ॥153॥
cc-madhya-13.153.translation: “ 'A loving, chaste wife and a loving husband who desire all welfare for each other in separation and do not care for personal happiness, desire only one another's well-being. Such a pair certainly meet again without delay.

lines: rākhite tomāra jīvana, sevi āmi nārāyaṇa,
tomā-sane krīḍā kari', niti yāi yadu-purī,
devanagari: राखिते तोमार जीवन, सेवि आमि नारायण
ताँर शक्त्ये आसि निति - निति ।
तोमा - सने क्रीड़ा करि’, निति याइ यदु - पुरी
ताहा तुमि मानह मोर स्फूर्ति ॥154॥
cc-madhya-13.154.translation: “ 'You are My most dear, and I know that in My absence You cannot live for a moment. Just to keep You living, I worship Lord Nārāyaṇa. By His merciful potency, I come to Vṛndāvana every day to enjoy pastimes with You. I then return to Dvārakā-dhāma. Thus You can always feel My presence here in Vṛndāvana.

lines: mora bhāgya mo-viṣaye, tomāra ye prema haye,
lukāñā āmā āne, saṅga karāya tomā-sane,
devanagari: मोर भाग्य मो - विषये, तोमार ने प्रेम हये
सेइ प्रेम - परम प्रबल ।
लुकाञा आमा आने, सङ्ग कराय तोमा - सने
प्रकटेह आनिबे सत्वर ॥155॥
cc-madhya-13.155.translation: “ 'Our love affair is more powerful because of My good fortune in receiving Nārāyaṇa's grace. This allows Me to come here unseen by others. I hope that very soon I will be visible to everyone.

lines: āche dui-cāri jana, tāhā māri' vṛndāvana,
devanagari: यादवेर विपक्ष, यत दुष्ट कंस - पक्ष,
ताहा आमि कैलुँ सब क्षय ।
आछे दुइ - चारि जन, ताहा मारि’ वृन्दावन,
आइलाम आमि, जानिह निश्चय ॥156॥
cc-madhya-13.156.translation: “ 'I have already killed all the mischievous demons who are enemies of the Yadu dynasty, and I have also killed Kaṁsa and his allies. However, there are two or four demons still living. I want to kill them, and after doing so I shall very soon return to Vṛndāvana. Please know this for certain.

devanagari: सेइ शत्रु - गण हैते, व्रज - जन राखिते
रहि राज्ये उदासीन हजा ।
येबा स्त्री - पुत्र - धने, करि राज्य आवरणे
यदु - गणेर सन्तोष लागिया ॥157॥
cc-madhya-13.157.translation: “ 'I wish to protect the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana from the attacks of My enemies. That is why I remain in My kingdom; otherwise I am indifferent to My royal position. Whatever wives, sons and wealth I maintain in the kingdom are only for the satisfaction of the Yadus.

lines: tomāra ye prema-guṇa, kare āmā ākarṣaṇa,
devanagari: तोमार ये प्रेम - गुण, करे आमा आकर्षण
आनिबे आमा दिन दश बिशे ।
पुनः आसि’ वृन्दावने, व्रज - वधू तोमा - सने
विलसिब रजनी - दिवसे ॥158॥
cc-madhya-13.158.translation: “ 'Your loving qualities always attract Me to Vṛndāvana. Indeed, they will bring Me back within ten or twenty days, and when I return I shall enjoy both day and night with You and all the damsels of Vrajabhūmi.'

lines: eta tāṅre kahi kṛṣṇa, vraje yāite satṛṣṇa,
sei śloka śuni' rādhā, khāṇḍila sakala bādhā,
devanagari: एत ताँरे कहि कृष्ण, व्रजे याइते सतृष्ण
एक श्लोक पड़ि’ शुनाइल ।
सेइ श्लोक शुनि’ राधा, खाण्डिल सकल बाधा
कृष्ण - प्राप्त्ये प्रतीति हइल ॥159॥
cc-madhya-13.159.translation: "While speaking to Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, Kṛṣṇa became very anxious to return to Vṛndāvana. He made Her listen to a verse which banished all Her difficulties and which assured Her that She would again attain Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: चन्दन - जलेते करे पथ निषेचने ।
तुच्छ सेवा करे वसि’ राज - सिंहासने ॥16॥
cc-madhya-13.16.translation: The King sprinkled the road with sandalwood-scented water. Although he was the owner of the royal throne, he engaged in menial service for the sake of Lord Jagannātha.

devanagari: मयि भक्तिर्हि भूतानाममृतत्वाय कल्पते ।
दिष्ट्या यदासीन्मत्स्नेहो भवतीनां मदापनः ॥160॥
cc-madhya-13.160.translation: "Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: 'Devotional service unto Me is the only way to attain Me. My dear gopīs, whatever love and affection you have attained for Me by good fortune is the only reason for My returning to you.' "

lines: ei saba artha prabhu svarūpera sane
devanagari: एइ सब अर्थ प्रभु स्वरूपेर सने ।
रात्रि - दिने घरे वसि’ करे आस्वादने ॥161॥
cc-madhya-13.161.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would sit in His room with Svarūpa Dāmodara and taste the topics of these verses day and night.

devanagari: नृत्य - काले सेइ भावे आविष्ट ह ञा ।
श्लोक पड़ि’ नाचे जगन्नाथ - मुख चाञा ॥162॥
cc-madhya-13.162.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced completely absorbed in ecstatic emotion. While looking at the face of Lord Jagannātha, He danced and recited these verses.

lines: prabhute āviṣṭa yāṅra kāya, vākya, mana
devanagari: स्वरूप - गोसाञि र भाग्य ना याय वर्णन ।
प्रभुते आविष्ट याँर काय, वाक्य, मन ॥163॥
cc-madhya-13.163.translation: No one can describe the good fortune of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, for he is always absorbed in the service of the Lord with his body, mind and words.

devanagari: स्वरूपेर इन्द्रिये प्रभुर निजेन्द्रिय - गण ।
आविष्ट ह ञा करे गान - आस्वादन ॥164॥
cc-madhya-13.164.translation: The senses of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were identical with the senses of Svarūpa. Therefore Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to become fully absorbed in tasting the singing of Svarūpa Dāmodara.

devanagari: भावेर आवेशे कभु भूमिते वसिया ।
तर्जनीते भूमे लिखे अधोमुख हञा ॥165॥
cc-madhya-13.165.translation: In emotional ecstasy, Caitanya Mahāprabhu would sometimes sit on the ground and, looking down, would write on the ground with His finger.

devanagari: अङ्गुलिते क्षत हबे जानि’ दामोदर ।
भये निज - करे निवारये प्रभु - कर ॥166॥
cc-madhya-13.166.translation: Feeling that the Lord would injure His finger by writing in this way, Svarūpa Dāmodara checked Him with his own hand.

lines: yabe yei rasa tāhā kare mūrtimān
devanagari: प्रभुर भावानुरूप स्वरूपेर गान ।
यबे येइ रस ताहा करे मूर्तिमान् ॥167॥
cc-madhya-13.167.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara used to sing exactly according to the ecstatic emotion of the Lord. Whenever a particular mellow was being tasted by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Svarūpa Dāmodara would personify it by singing.

devanagari: श्री - जगन्नाथेर देखे श्री - मुख - कमल ।
ताहार उपर सुन्दर नयन - युगल ॥168॥
cc-madhya-13.168.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu looked upon the beautiful lotuslike face and eyes of Lord Jagannātha.

devanagari: सूर्येर किरणे मुख करे झलमल ।
माल्य, वस्त्र, दिव्य अलङ्कार, परिमल ॥169॥
cc-madhya-13.169.translation: Lord Jagannātha was garlanded, dressed with nice garments and adorned with beautiful ornaments. His face was glittering from the rays of sunshine, and the entire atmosphere was fragrant.

lines: uttama hañā rājā kare tuccha sevana
devanagari: उत्तम ह ञा राजा करे तुच्छ सेवन ।
अतएव जगन्नाथेर कृपार भाजन ॥17॥
cc-madhya-13.17.translation: Although the King was the most exalted respectable person, still he accepted menial service for the Lord; he, therefore, became a suitable candidate for receiving the Lord's mercy.

devanagari: प्रभुर हृदये आनन्द - सिन्धु उथलिल ।
उन्माद, झञ्झा - वात तत्क्षणे उठिल ॥170॥
cc-madhya-13.170.translation: An ocean of transcendental bliss expanded in the heart of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and symptoms of madness immediately intensified like a hurricane.

devanagari: आनन्दोन्मादे उठाय भावेर तरङ्ग ।
नाना - भाव - सैन्ये उपजिल युद्ध - रङ्ग ॥171॥
cc-madhya-13.171.translation: The madness of transcendental bliss created waves of various emotions. The emotions appeared like opposing soldiers staging a fight.

devanagari: भावोदय, भाव - शान्ति, सन्धि, शाबल्य ।
सञ्चारी, सात्त्विक, स्थायी स्वभाव - प्राबल्य ॥172॥
cc-madhya-13.172.translation: There was an increase in all the natural emotional symptoms. Thus there were awakening emotions, peacefulness, joined, mixed, transcendental and prevalent emotions, and impetuses for emotion.

devanagari: प्रभुर शरीर येन शुद्ध - हेमाचल ।
भाव - पुष्प - द्रुम ताहे पुष्पित सकल ॥173॥
cc-madhya-13.173.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's body appeared like a transcendental Himalayan mountain bearing ecstatic emotional flower trees, all of them blooming.

devanagari: देखिते आकर्षये सबार चित्त - मन ।
प्रेमामृत - वृष्ट्ये प्रभु सिञ्चे सबार मन ॥174॥
cc-madhya-13.174.translation: Upon seeing all these symptoms, everyone's mind and consciousness were attracted. Indeed, the Lord sprinkled everyone's mind with the nectar of transcendental love of Godhead.

devanagari: जगन्नाथ - सेवक यत राज - पात्र - गण ।
यात्रिक लोक, नीलाचल - वासी यत जन ॥175॥
cc-madhya-13.175.translation: He sprinkled the minds of the servants of Lord Jagannātha, the government officers, the pilgrim visitors, the general populace and all the residents of Jagannātha Purī.

lines: prabhura nṛtya prema dekhi' haya camatkāra
devanagari: प्रभुर नृत्य प्रेम देखि’ हय चमत्कार ।
कृष्ण - प्रेम उछलिल हृदये सबार ॥176॥
cc-madhya-13.176.translation: After seeing the dancing and ecstatic love of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, everyone became astonished. In their hearts they became infatuated with love of Kṛṣṇa.

lines: preme nāce, gāya, loka, kare kolāhala
prabhura nṛtya dekhi' sabe ānande vihvala
devanagari: प्रेमे नाचे, गाय, लोक, करे कोलाहल ।
प्रभुर नृत्य देखि’ सबै आनन्दे विह्वल ॥177॥
cc-madhya-13.177.translation: Everyone danced and chanted in ecstatic love, and a great noise resounded. Everyone was overwhelmed with transcendental bliss just to see the dancing of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: prabhura nṛtya dekhi' sukhe calilā manthara
devanagari: अन्येर कि काय, जगन्नाथ - हलधर ।
प्रभुर नृत्य देखि’ सुखे चलिला मन्थर ॥178॥
cc-madhya-13.178.translation: Apart from the others, even Lord Jagannātha and Lord Balarāma, with great happiness, began to move very slowly upon seeing the dancing of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: kabhu sukhe nṛtya-raṅga dekhe ratha rākhi'
se kautuka ye dekhila, sei tāra sākṣī
devanagari: कभु सुखे नृत्य - रङ्ग देखे रथ राखि’ ।
से कौतुक ये देखिल, सेइ तार साक्षी ॥179॥
cc-madhya-13.179.translation: Lord Jagannātha and Lord Balarāma sometimes stopped the car and happily observed Lord Caitanya's dancing. Anyone who was able to see Them stop and watch the dancing bore witness to Their pastimes.

devanagari: महाप्रभु सुख पाइल से सेवा देखिते ।
महाप्रभुर कृपा हैल से - सेवा हइते ॥18॥
cc-madhya-13.18.translation: Upon seeing the King engaged in such menial service, Caitanya Mahāprabhu became very happy. Simply by rendering this service, the King received the mercy of the Lord.

devanagari: एइ - मत प्रभु नृत्य करिते भ्रमिते ।
प्रतापरुद्रेर आगे लागिला पड़िते ॥180॥
cc-madhya-13.180.translation: When Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing and wandering in this way, He fell down in front of Mahārāja Pratāparudra.

devanagari: सम्भ्रमे प्रतापरुद्र प्रभुके धरिल ।
ताँहाके देखिते प्रभुर बाह्य - ज्ञान हइल ॥181॥
cc-madhya-13.181.translation: Mahārāja Pratāparudra picked the Lord up with great respect, but upon seeing the King, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu came to His external senses.

lines: chi, chi, viṣayīra sparśa ha-ila āmāra
devanagari: राजा देखि’ महाप्रभु करेन धिक्कार ।
छि, छि, विषयीर स्पर्श हइल आमार ॥182॥
cc-madhya-13.182.translation: After seeing the King, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu condemned Himself, saying, "Oh, how pitiful it is that I have touched a person who is interested in mundane affairs."

devanagari: आवेशेते नित्यानन्द ना हैला सावधाने ।
काशीश्वर - गोविन्द आछिला अन्य - स्थाने ॥183॥
cc-madhya-13.183.translation: Not even Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, Kāśīśvara or Govinda took care of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu when He fell down. Nityānanda was in great ecstasy, and Kāśīśvara and Govinda were elsewhere.

devanagari: यद्यपि राजा र देखि’ हाड़िर सेवन ।
प्रसन्न हञाछे ताँरे मिलिबारे मन ॥184॥
cc-madhya-13.184.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had already been satisfied by the King's behavior, for the King had accepted the service of a sweeper for Lord Jagannātha. Therefore Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu actually desired to see the King.

devanagari: तथापि आपन - गणे करिते सावधान ।
बाह्ये किछु रोषाभास कैला भगवान् ॥185॥
cc-madhya-13.185.translation: However, just to warn His personal associates, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, externally expressed feelings of anger.

lines: prabhura vacane rājāra mane haila bhaya
devanagari: प्रभुर वचने राजार मने हैल भय ।
सार्वभौम कहे , - तुमि ना कर संशय ॥186॥
cc-madhya-13.186.translation: King Pratāparudra became frightened when Lord Caitanya showed external anger, but Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya told the King, "Don't worry."

lines: tomā lakṣya kari' śikhāyena nija gaṇa
devanagari: तोमार उपरे प्रभुर सुप्रसन्न मन ।
तोमा लक्ष्य करि’ शिखायेन निज गण ॥187॥
cc-madhya-13.187.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya informed the King, "The Lord is very satisfied with you. By pointing you out, He was teaching His personal associates how to behave with mundane people."

devanagari: अवसर जानि’ आमि करिब निवेदन ।
सेइ - काले याइ’ करिह प्रभुर मिलन ॥188॥
cc-madhya-13.188.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya continued, "I shall submit your petition when there is an opportune moment. It will then be easy for you to come and meet the Lord."

lines: ratha-pāche yāi' ṭhele rathe māthā diyā
devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु रथ प्रदक्षिण करिया ।
रथ - पाछे याइ’ ठेले रथे माथा दिया ॥189॥
cc-madhya-13.189.translation: After circumambulating Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went behind the car and began pushing it with His head.

devanagari: रथेर साजनि देखि’ लोके चमत्कार ।
नव हेममय रथ - सुमेरु - आकार ॥19॥
cc-madhya-13.19.translation: Everyone was astonished to see the decorations on the Ratha car. The car appeared to be newly made of gold, and it was as high as Mount Sumeru.

devanagari: ठेलितेइ चलिल रथ ‘हड़’ ‘हड़’ करि’ ।
चतुर्दिके लोक सब बले ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ॥190॥
cc-madhya-13.190.translation: As soon as He pushed, the car immediately started to move, making a rattling noise. The people all around began to chant the holy name of the Lord, "Hari! Hari!"

devanagari: तबे प्रभु निज - भक्त - गण लञा सङ्गे ।
बलदेव - सुभद्राग्रे नृत्य करे रङ्गे ॥191॥
cc-madhya-13.191.translation: As the car began to move, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took His personal associates in front of the cars occupied by Lord Balarāma and Subhadrā, the goddess of fortune. Greatly inspired, He then began to dance in front of Them.

lines: tāhāṅ nṛtya kari' jagannātha āge āilā
devanagari: ताहाँ नृत्य करि’ जगन्नाथ आगे आइला ।
जगन्नाथ देखि’ नृत्य करिते लागिला ॥192॥
cc-madhya-13.192.translation: After finishing the dance before Lord Baladeva and Subhadrā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came before Lord Jagannātha's car. Upon seeing Lord Jagannātha, He began to dance again.

lines: jagannātha ratha rākhi' dekhe ḍāhine vāme
devanagari: चलिया आइल रथ ‘बलगण्डि’ - स्थाने ।
जगन्नाथ रथ राखि’ देखे डाहिने वामे ॥193॥
cc-madhya-13.193.translation: When they reached the place called Balagaṇḍi, Lord Jagannātha stopped His car and began to look left and right.

devanagari: वामे - ‘विप्र - शासन’ नारिकेल - वन ।
डाहिने त’ पुष्पोद्यान येन वृन्दावन ॥194॥
cc-madhya-13.194.translation: On the left side, Lord Jagannātha saw the neighborhood of brāhmaṇas known as vipra-śāsana and the coconut tree grove. On the right side, He saw nice flower gardens resembling those in the holy place Vṛndāvana.

lines: āge nṛtya kare gaura lañā bhakta-gaṇa
devanagari: आगे नृत्य करे गौर लञा भक्त - गण ।
रथ राखि’ जगन्नाथ करेन दरशन ॥195॥
cc-madhya-13.195.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees were dancing in front of the car, and, having stopped the car, Lord Jagannātha watched the dancing.

devanagari: सेइ स्थले भोग लागे , - आछये नियम ।
कोटि भोग जगन्नाथ करे आस्वादन ॥196॥
cc-madhya-13.196.translation: It was customary that food be offered to the Lord at vipra-śāsana. Indeed, innumerable dishes of food were offered, and Lord Jagannātha tasted each one of them.

devanagari: जगन्नाथेर छोट - बड़ यत भक्त - गण ।
निज निज उत्तम - भोग करे समर्पण ॥197॥
cc-madhya-13.197.translation: All kinds of devotees of Lord Jagannātha-from neophytes to the most advanced-offered their best cooked food to the Lord.

devanagari: राजा, राज - महिषी - वृन्द, पात्र, मित्र - गण ।
नीलाचल - वासी यत छोट - बड़ जन ॥198॥
cc-madhya-13.198.translation: This included the King, his queens, his ministers and friends and all other big and small residents of Jagannātha Purī.

devanagari: नाना - देशेर देशी यत यात्रिक जन ।
निज - निज - भोग ताहाँ करे समर्पण ॥199॥
cc-madhya-13.199.translation: All the visitors who had come from different countries to Jagannātha Purī, as well as the local devotees, offered their personally cooked food to the Lord.

devanagari: जय जय श्री कृष्ण - चैतन्य नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-madhya-13.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya and Prabhu Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

devanagari: शत शत सु - चामर - दर्पणे उज्ज्वल ।
उपरे पताका शोभे चाँदोया निर्मल ॥20॥
cc-madhya-13.20.translation: The decorations included bright mirrors and hundreds and hundreds of cāmaras [white whisks made of yak tails]. On top of the car were a neat and clean canopy and very beautiful flag.

devanagari: आगे पाछे, दुइ पार्श्वे पुष्पोद्यान - वने ।
येइ याहा पाय, लागाय , - नाहिक नियमे ॥200॥
cc-madhya-13.200.translation: The devotees offered their foods everywhere, in front and behind the car, on the two sides and within the flower garden. Wherever possible, they made their offering to the Lord, for there were no hard-and-fast rules.

lines: bhogera samaya lokera mahā bhiḍa haila
devanagari: भोगेर समय लोकेर महा भिड़ हैल ।
नृत्य छाड़ि’ महाप्रभु उपवने गेल ॥201॥
cc-madhya-13.201.translation: While the food was being offered, a large crowd of people gathered. At that time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped His dancing and went to a nearby garden.

devanagari: प्रेमावेशे महाप्रभु उपवन पाञा ।
पुष्पोद्याने गृह - पिण्डाय रहिला पड़िया ॥202॥
cc-madhya-13.202.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the garden. Immersed in a great ecstatic emotion, He fell flat on a raised platform there.

devanagari: नृत्य - परिश्रमे प्रभुर देहे घन घर्म ।
सुगन्धि शीतल - वायु करेन सेवन ॥203॥
cc-madhya-13.203.translation: The Lord was very fatigued from the hard labor of dancing, and there was perspiration all over His body. He therefore enjoyed the fragrant, cool breeze of the garden.

devanagari: यत भक्त कीर्तनीया आसिया आरामे ।
प्रति - वृक्ष - तले सबै करेन विश्रामे ॥204॥
cc-madhya-13.204.translation: All the devotees who were performing saṅkīrtana came there and took rest under each and every tree.

devanagari: एइ त’ कहिल प्रभुर महा - सङ्कीर्तन ।
जगन्नाथेर आगे यैछे करिल नर्तन ॥205॥
cc-madhya-13.205.translation: Thus I have described the great performance of congregational chanting by Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as He danced in front of Lord Jagannātha.

devanagari: रथाग्रेते प्रभु यैछे करिला नर्तन ।
चैतन्याष्टके रूप - गोसाञि कर्याछे वर्णन ॥206॥
cc-madhya-13.206.translation: In his prayer known as the Caitanyāṣṭaka, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī has given a vivid description of the Lord's dancing before the car of Jagannātha.

lines: sa caitanyaḥ kiṁ me punar api dṛśor yāsyati padam
devanagari: रथारूढ़स्यारादधिपदवि नीलाचल - पतेर् अदभ्र - प्रेमोर्मि - स्फुरित - नटनोल्लास - विवशः ।
स - हर्ष गायद्भिः परिवृत - तनुर्वैष्णव - जनैः स चैतन्यः किं में पुनरपि दृशोर्यास्यति पदम् ॥207॥
cc-madhya-13.207.translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced down the main road in great ecstasy before Lord Jagannātha, the master of Nīlācala, who was sitting on His car. Overwhelmed by the transcendental bliss of dancing and surrounded by Vaiṣṇavas who sang the holy names, He manifested waves of ecstatic love of Godhead. When will Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again be visible to my vision?"

lines: ihā yei śune sei śrī-caitanya pāya
devanagari: इहा येइ शुने सेइ श्री - चैतन्य पाय ।
सुदृढ़ विश्वास - सह प्रेम - भक्ति हय ॥208॥
cc-madhya-13.208.translation: Anyone who hears this description of the car festival will attain Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He will also attain the elevated state by which he will have firm conviction in devotional service and love of Godhead.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥209॥
cc-madhya-13.209.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: घाघर, किङ्किणी बाजे, घण्टार क्वणित ।
नाना चित्र - पट्ट - वस्त्रे रथ विभूषित ॥21॥
cc-madhya-13.21.translation: The car was also decorated with silken cloth and various pictures. Many brass bells, gongs and ankle bells rang.

lines: āra dui rathe caḍe subhadrā, haladhara
devanagari: लीलाय चड़िल ईश्वर रथेर उपर ।
आर दुइ रथे चड़े सुभद्रा, हलधर ॥22॥
cc-madhya-13.22.translation: For the pastimes of the Ratha-yātrā ceremony, Lord Jagannātha got aboard one car, and His sister, Subhadrā, and elder brother, Balarāma, got aboard two other cars.

lines: tāṅra saṅge krīḍā kaila nibhṛte vasiyā
devanagari: पञ्च - दश दिन ईश्वर महा - लक्ष्मी लञा ।
ताँर सङ्गे क्रीड़ा कैल निभृते वसिया ॥23॥
cc-madhya-13.23.translation: For fifteen days the Lord had remained in a secluded place with the supreme goddess of fortune and had performed His pastimes with her.

lines: tāṅhāra sammati lañā bhakte sukha dite
rathe caḍi' bāhira haila vihāra karite
devanagari: ताँहार सम्मति लञा भक्ते सुख दिते ।
रथे चड़ि’ बाहिर हैल विहार करिते ॥24॥
cc-madhya-13.24.translation: Having taken permission from the goddess of fortune, the Lord came out to ride on the Ratha car and perform His pastimes for the pleasure of the devotees.

devanagari: सूक्ष्म श्वेत - बालु पथे पुलिनेर सम ।
दुइ दिके टोटा, सब - येन वृन्दावन ॥25॥
cc-madhya-13.25.translation: The fine, white sand spread all over the path resembled the bank of the Yamunā, and the small gardens on both sides looked just like those in Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: रथे चड़ि’ जगन्नाथ करिला गमन ।
दुइ - पार्श्वे देखि’ चले आनन्दित - मन ॥26॥
cc-madhya-13.26.translation: As Lord Jagannātha rode in His car and saw the beauty on both sides, His mind was filled with pleasure.

lines: kṣaṇe śīghra cale ratha, kṣaṇe cale manda
devanagari: ‘गौड़’ सब रथ टाने करिया आनन्द ।
क्षणे शीघ्र चले रथ, क्षणे चले मन्द ॥27॥
cc-madhya-13.27.translation: The pullers of the car were known as gauḍas, and they pulled with great pleasure. However, the car sometimes went very fast and sometimes very slow.

lines: kṣaṇe sthira hañā rahe, ṭānileha nā cale
īśvara-icchāya cale, nā cale kāro bale
devanagari: क्षणे स्थिर ह ञा रहे, टानिलेह ना चले ।
ईश्वर - इच्छाय चले, ना चले कारो बले ॥28॥
cc-madhya-13.28.translation: Sometimes the car would stand still and not move, even though it was pulled very vigorously. The chariot therefore moved by the will of the Lord, not by the strength of any ordinary person.

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु सब लञा भक्त - गण ।
स्वहस्ते पराइल सबे माल्य - चन्दन ॥29॥
cc-madhya-13.29.translation: As the car stood still, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gathered all His devotees and, with His own hand, decorated them with flower garlands and sandalwood pulp.

lines: jaya śrotā-gaṇa, śuna, kari' eka mana
devanagari: जय श्रोता - गण, शुन, करि’ एक मन ।
रथ - यात्राय नृत्य प्रभुर परम मोहन ॥3॥
cc-madhya-13.3.translation: All glories to the listeners of Caitanya-caritāmṛta. Please hear the description of the dancing of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu at the Ratha-yātrā festival. His dancing is very enchanting. Please hear of it with great attention.

devanagari: परमानन्द पुरी, आर भारती ब्रह्मानन्द ।
श्री - हस्ते चन्दन पाञा बाड़िल आनन्द ॥30॥
cc-madhya-13.30.translation: Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī were both personally given garlands and sandalwood pulp from the very hands of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. This increased their transcendental pleasure.

devanagari: अद्वैत - आचार्य, आर प्रभु - नित्यानन्द ।
श्री - हस्त - स्पर्शे दुँहार हइल आनन्द ॥31॥
cc-madhya-13.31.translation: Similarly, when Advaita Ācārya and Nityānanda Prabhu felt the touch of the transcendental hand of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, They were both very pleased.

devanagari: कीर्तनीया - गणे दिल माल्य - चन्दन ।
स्वरूप, श्रीवास , - याहाँ मुख्य दुइ - जन ॥32॥
cc-madhya-13.32.translation: The Lord also gave garlands and sandalwood pulp to the performers of saṅkīrtana. The chief two performers were Svarūpa Dāmodara and Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura.

lines: dui dui mārdaṅgika haila aṣṭa jana
devanagari: चारि सम्प्रदाये हैल चब्बिश गायन ।
दुइ दुइ मार्दङ्गिक हैल अष्ट जन ॥33॥
cc-madhya-13.33.translation: There were altogether four parties of kīrtana performers, comprising twenty-four chanters. In each party there were also two mṛdaṅga players, making an additional eight persons.

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभ मने विचार करिया ।
चारि सम्प्रदाय दिल गायन बाँटिया ॥34॥
cc-madhya-13.34.translation: When the four parties were formed, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, after some consideration, divided the chanters.

lines: cāri jane ājñā dila nṛtya karibāre
devanagari: नित्यानन्द, अद्वैत, हरिदास, वक्रेश्वरे ।
चारि जने आज्ञा दिल नृत्य करिबारे ॥35॥
cc-madhya-13.35.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Nityānanda Prabhu, Advaita Ācārya, Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Vakreśvara Paṇḍita to dance in each of the four respective parties.

devanagari: प्रथम सम्प्रदाये कैल स्वरूप - प्रधान ।
आर पञ्च - जन दिल ताँर पालिगान ॥36॥
cc-madhya-13.36.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara was chosen as the leader of the first party and was given five assistants to respond to his chanting.

devanagari: दामोदर, नारायण, दत्त गोविन्द ।
राघव पण्डित, आर श्री - गोविन्दानन्द ॥37॥
cc-madhya-13.37.translation: The five who responded to the singing of Svarūpa Dāmodara were Dāmodara Paṇḍita, Nārāyaṇa, Govinda Datta, Rāghava Paṇḍita and Śrī Govindānanda.

devanagari: अद्वैतेरे नृत्य करिबारे आज्ञा दिल ।
श्रीवास - प्रधान आर सम्प्रदाय कैल ॥38॥
cc-madhya-13.38.translation: Advaita Ācārya Prabhu was ordered to dance in the first group. The Lord then formed another group with Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura as the chief man.

devanagari: गङ्गादास, हरिदास, श्रीमान्, शुभानन्द ।
श्री - राम पण्डित, ताहाँ नाचे नित्यानन्द ॥39॥
cc-madhya-13.39.translation: The five singers who responded to the singing of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura were Gaṅgādāsa, Haridāsa, Śrīmān, Śubhānanda and Śrī Rāma Paṇḍita. Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu was appointed as a dancer.

devanagari: आर दिन महाप्रभु हञा सावधान ।
रात्रे उठि’ गण - सङ्गे कैल प्रातः - स्नान ॥4॥
cc-madhya-13.4.translation: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His personal associates got up in the dark and attentively took their early morning baths.

devanagari: वासुदेव, गोपीनाथ, मुरारि याहाँ गाय ।
मुकुन्द - प्रधान कैल आर सम्प्रदाय ॥40॥
cc-madhya-13.40.translation: Another group was formed consisting of Vāsudeva, Gopīnātha, and Murāri. All these were responsive singers, and Mukunda was the chief singer.

devanagari: श्रीकान्त, वल्लभ - सेन आर दुइ जन ।
हरिदास - ठाकुर ताहाँ करेन नर्तन ॥41॥
cc-madhya-13.41.translation: Another two persons, Śrīkānta and Vallabha Sena, joined as responsive singers. In this group, Haridāsa Ṭhākura [the senior] was the dancer.

devanagari: गोविन्द - घोष - प्रधान कैल आर सम्प्रदाय ।
हरिदास, विष्णुदास, राघव, याहाँ गाय ॥42॥
cc-madhya-13.42.translation: The Lord formed another group, appointing Govinda Ghosh as leader. In this group the younger Haridāsa, Viṣṇudāsa and Rāghava were the responding singers.

devanagari: माधव, वासुदेव - घोष, दुइ सहोदर ।
नृत्य करेन ताहाँ पण्डित - वक्रेश्वर ॥43॥
cc-madhya-13.43.translation: Two brothers named Mādhava Ghosh and Vāsudeva Ghosh also joined this group as responsive singers. Vakreśvara Paṇḍita was the dancer.

devanagari: कुलीन - ग्रामेर एक कीर्तनीया - समाज ।
ताहाँ नृत्य करेन रामानन्द, सत्यराज ॥44॥
cc-madhya-13.44.translation: There was a saṅkīrtana party from the village known as Kulīna-grāma, and Rāmānanda and Satyarāja were appointed the dancers in this group.

lines: acyutānanda nāce tathā, āra saba gāya
devanagari: शान्तिपुरेर आचार्येर एक सम्प्रदाय ।
अच्युतानन्द नाचे तथा, आर सब गाय ॥45॥
cc-madhya-13.45.translation: There was another party that came from Śāntipura and was formed by Advaita Ācārya. Acyutānanda was the dancer, and the rest of the men were singers.

devanagari: खण्डेर सम्प्रदाय करे अन्यत्र कीर्तन ।
नरहरि नाचे ताहाँ श्री - रघुनन्दन ॥46॥
cc-madhya-13.46.translation: Another party was formed by the people of Khaṇḍa. These people were singing in a different place. In that group, Narahari Prabhu and Raghunandana were dancing.

lines: dui pāśe dui, pāche eka sampradāya
devanagari: जगन्ना थेर आगे चारि सम्प्रदाय गाय ।
दुइ पाशे दुइ, पाछे एक सम्प्रदाय ॥47॥
cc-madhya-13.47.translation: Four parties chanted and danced in front of Lord Jagannātha, and on both sides were two other parties. Another was at the rear.

lines: yāra dhvani śuni' vaiṣṇava haila pāgala
devanagari: सात सम्प्रदाये बाजे चौद्द मादल ।
यार ध्वनि शुनि’ वैष्णव हैल पागल ॥48॥
cc-madhya-13.48.translation: There were altogether seven parties of saṅkīrtana, and in each party two men were beating drums. Thus fourteen drums were being played at once. The sound was tumultuous, and all the devotees bacame mad.

devanagari: वैष्णवेर मेघ - घटाय हइल बादल ।
कीर्तनानन्दे सब वर्षे नेत्र - जल ॥49॥
cc-madhya-13.49.translation: All the Vaiṣṇavas came together like an assembly of clouds. As the devotees chanted the holy names, tears fell in great ecstasy like rainfall from their eyes.

devanagari: पाण्डु - विजय देखिबारे करिल गमन ।
जगन्नाथ यात्रा कैल छाड़ि’ सिंहासन ॥5॥
cc-madhya-13.5.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His personal associates then went to see the ceremony of Pāṇḍu-vijaya. During this ceremony, Lord Jagannātha leaves His throne and gets up onto the car.

lines: anya vādyādira dhvani kichui nā śuni
devanagari: त्रि - भुवन भरि’ उठे कीर्तनेर ध्वनि ।
अन्य वाद्यादिर ध्वनि किछुइ ना शुनि ॥50॥
cc-madhya-13.50.translation: When the saṅkīrtana resounded, it filled the three worlds. Indeed, no one could hear mundane sounds or musical instruments other than the saṅkīrtana.

devanagari: सात ठाञि बुले प्रभु ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ बलि’ ।
‘जय जगन्नाथ’, बलेन हस्त - युग तुलि’ ॥51॥
cc-madhya-13.51.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu wandered through all seven groups chanting the holy name, "Hari, Hari!" Raising His arms, He shouted, "All glories to Lord Jagannātha!"

lines: āra eka śakti prabhu karila prakāśa
devanagari: आर एक शक्ति प्रभु करिल प्रकाश ।
एक - काले सात ठाञि करिल विलास ॥52॥
cc-madhya-13.52.translation: Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu then exhibited another mystic power by performing pastimes simultaneously in all seven groups.

lines: anya ṭhāñi nāhi yā'na āmāre dayāya
devanagari: सबे कहे , - प्रभु आछेन मोर सम्प्रदाय ।
अन्य ठाञि नाहि या’न आमारे दयाय ॥53॥
cc-madhya-13.53.translation: Everyone said, "Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu is present in my group. Indeed, He does not go anywhere else. He is bestowing His mercy upon us."

devanagari: केह लखिते नारे प्रभुर अचिन्त्य - शक्ति ।
अन्तरङ्ग - भक्त जाने, याँर शुद्ध - भक्ति ॥54॥
cc-madhya-13.54.translation: Actually, no one could see the inconceivable potency of the Lord. Only the most confidential devotees, those in pure, unalloyed devotional service, could understand.

devanagari: कीर्तन देखिया जगन्नाथ हरषित।
सङ्कीर्तन देखे रथ करिया स्थगित ॥55॥
cc-madhya-13.55.translation: Lord Jagannātha was very pleased by the saṅkīrtana, and He brought His car to a standstill just to see the performance.

devanagari: प्रताप रुद्रेर हैल परम विस्मय ।
देखिते विवश राजा हैल प्रेममय ॥56॥
cc-madhya-13.56.translation: King Pratāparudra also was astonished to see the saṅkīrtana. He became inactive and was converted to ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: काशी - मिश्रे कहे राजा प्रभुर महिमा ।
काशी - मिश्र कहे , - तोमार भाग्येर नाहि सीमा ॥57॥
cc-madhya-13.57.translation: When the King informed Kāśī Miśra of the glories of the Lord, Kāśī Miśra replied, "O King, your fortune has no limit!"

lines: āra keha nāhi jāne caitanyera curi
devanagari: सार्वभौम - सङ्गे राजा करे ठाराठारि ।
आर केह नाहि जाने चैतन्येर चुरि ॥58॥
cc-madhya-13.58.translation: The King and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya were both aware of the Lord's activities, but no one else could see the tricks of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: yāre tāṅra kṛpā, sei jānibāre pāre
devanagari: यारे ताँर कृपा, सेइ जानिबारे पारे ।
कृपा विना ब्रह्मादिक जानिबारे नारे ॥59॥
cc-madhya-13.59.translation: Only a person who has received the mercy of the Lord can understand. Without the Lord's mercy, even the demigods, headed by Lord Brahmā, cannot understand.

devanagari: आपनि प्रतापरुद्र ल ञा पात्र - गण ।
महाप्रभुर गणे कराय विजय - दर्शन ॥6॥
cc-madhya-13.6.translation: King Pratāparudra in person, as well as his entourage, allowed the Pāṇḍu-vijaya ceremony to be seen by all the associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: rājāra tuccha sevā dekhi' prabhura tuṣṭa mana
devanagari: राजार तुच्छ सेवा देखि’ प्रभुर तुष्ट मन ।
सेइ त’ प्रसादे पाइल ‘रहस्य - दर्शन’ ॥60॥
cc-madhya-13.60.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very satisfied to see the King accept the menial task of sweeping the street, and for this humility, the King received the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He could therefore observe the mystery of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities.

lines: sākṣāte nā deya dekhā, parokṣe ta' dayā
devanagari: साक्षाते ना देय देखा, परोक्षे त’ दया ।
के बुझिते पारे चैतन्य - चन्द्रेर माया ॥61॥
cc-madhya-13.61.translation: Although the King was refused an interview, he was indirectly bestowed causeless mercy. Who can understand the internal potency of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?

devanagari: सार्वभौम, काशी - मिश्र, - दुइ महाशय ।
राजारे प्रसाद देखि’ हइला विस्मय ॥62॥
cc-madhya-13.62.translation: When the two great personalities Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Kāśī Miśra saw Caitanya Mahāprabhu's causeless mercy upon the King, they were astonished.

devanagari: एइ - मत लीला प्रभु कैल कत - क्षण ।
आपने गायेन, नाचा’न निज - भक्त - गण ॥63॥
cc-madhya-13.63.translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed His pastimes for some time in this way. He personally sang and induced His personal associates to dance.

lines: kabhu eka mūrti, kabhu hana bahu-mūrti
devanagari: कभु एक मूर्ति, कभु हन बहु - मूर्ति ।
कार्य - अनुरूप प्रभु प्रकाशये शक्ति ॥64॥
cc-madhya-13.64.translation: According to His need, the Lord sometimes exhibited one form and sometimes many. This was being executed by His internal potency.

devanagari: लीलावेशे प्रभुर नाहि निजानुसन्धान ।
इच्छा जानि ‘लीला शक्ति’ करे समाधान ॥65॥
cc-madhya-13.65.translation: Indeed, the Personality of Godhead forgot Himself in the course of His transcendental pastimes, but His internal potency [līlā-śakti], knowing the intentions of the Lord, made all arrangements.

lines: pūrve yaiche rāsādi līlā kaila vṛndāvane
alaukika līlā gaura kaila kṣaṇe kṣaṇe
devanagari: पूर्वे यैछे रासादि लीला कैल वृन्दावने ।
अलौकिक लीला गौर कैल क्षणे क्षणे ॥66॥
cc-madhya-13.66.translation: Just as Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa formerly performed the rāsa-līlā dance and other pastimes at Vṛndāvana, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed uncommon pastimes moment after moment.

devanagari: भक्त - गण अनुभवे, नाहि जाने आन ।
श्री - भागवत - शास्त्र ताहाते प्रमाण ॥67॥
cc-madhya-13.67.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's dancing before the Ratha-yātrā car could be perceived only by pure devotees. Others could not understand. Descriptions of Lord Kṛṣṇa's uncommon dancing can be found in the revealed scripture Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभु करे नृत्य - रङ्गे ।
भासाइल सब लोक प्रेमेर तरङ्गे ॥68॥
cc-madhya-13.68.translation: In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced in great jubilation and inundated all the people with waves of ecstatic love.

devanagari: एइ - मत हैल कृष्णेर रथे आरोहण ।
तार आगे प्रभु नाचाइल भक्त - गण ॥69॥
cc-madhya-13.69.translation: Thus Lord Jagannātha mounted His car, and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inspired all His devotees to dance in front of it.

devanagari: अद्वैत, निताइ आदि सङ्गे भक्तगण ।
सुखे महाप्रभु देखे ईश्वर - गमन ॥7॥
cc-madhya-13.7.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His prominent devotees-Advaita Ācārya, Nityānanda Prabhu and others-were very happy to observe how Lord Jagannātha began the Ratha-yātrā.

lines: tāra āge prabhu yaiche karilā nartana
devanagari: आगे शुन जगन्नाथेर गुण्डिचा - गमन ।
तार आगे प्रभु यैछे करिला नर्तन ॥70॥
cc-madhya-13.70.translation: Now please hear about Lord Jagannātha's going to the Guṇḍicā temple while Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced before the Ratha car.

devanagari: एइ - मत कीर्तन प्रभु करिल कत - क्षण ।
आपन - उद्योगे नाचाइल भक्त - गण ॥71॥
cc-madhya-13.71.translation: The Lord performed kīrtana for some time and, through His own endeavor, inspired all the devotees to dance.

lines: āpani nācite yabe prabhura mana haila
devanagari: आपनि नाचि ते यबे प्रभुर मन हैल ।
सात सम्प्रदाय तबे एकत्र करिल ॥72॥
cc-madhya-13.72.translation: When the Lord Himself wanted to dance, all seven groups combined together.

devanagari: श्रीवास, रामाइ, रघु, गोविन्द, मुकुन्द ।
हरिदास, गोविन्दानन्द, माधव, गोविन्द ॥73॥
cc-madhya-13.73.translation: The Lord's devotees-including Śrīvāsa, Rāmāi, Raghu, Govinda, Mukunda, Haridāsa, Govindānanda, Mādhava and Govinda-all combined together.

lines: svarūpera saṅge dila ei nava jana
devanagari: उद्दण्ड - नृत्ये प्रभुर यबे हैल मन ।
स्वरूपेर सङ्गे दिल एई नव जन ॥74॥
cc-madhya-13.74.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu desired to jump high while dancing, He placed these nine people in the charge of Svarūpa Dāmodara.

lines: ei daśa jana prabhura saṅge gāya, dhāya
āra saba sampradāya cāri dike gāya
devanagari: एइ दश जन प्रभुर सङ्गे गाय, धाय ।
आर सब सम्प्रदाय चारि दिके गाय ॥75॥
cc-madhya-13.75.translation: These devotees [Svarūpa Dāmodara and the devotees in his charge] sang along with the Lord, and they also ran beside Him. All the other groups of men also sang.

lines: daṇḍavat kari, prabhu yuḍi' dui hāta
devanagari: दण्डवत्करि, प्रभु गुड़ि’ दुइ हात ।
ऊर्ध्व - मुखे स्तुति करे देखि’ जगन्नाथ ॥76॥
cc-madhya-13.76.translation: Offering obeisances to the Lord with folded hands, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu raised His face toward Jagannātha and prayed as follows.

devanagari: नमो ब्रह्म ण्य - देवाय गो - ब्राह्मण - हिताय च ।
जगद्धिताय कृष्णाय गोविन्दाय नमो नमः ॥77॥
cc-madhya-13.77.translation: “ 'Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto Lord Kṛṣṇa, who is the worshipable Deity for all brahminical men, who is the well-wisher of cows and brāhmaṇas, and who is always benefiting the whole world. I offer my repeated obeisances to the Personality of Godhead, known as Kṛṣṇa and Govinda.'

devanagari: जयति जयति देवो देवकी - नन्दनोऽसौ जयति जयति कृष्णो वृष्णि - वंश - प्रदीपः ।
जयति जयति मेघ - श्यामलः कोमलाङ्गो जयति जयति पृथ्वी - भार - नाशो मुकुन्दः ॥78॥
cc-madhya-13.78.translation: “ 'All glories unto the Supreme Personality of Godhead who is known as the son of Devakī. All glories to the Supreme Personality of Godhead who is known as the light of the dynasty of Vṛṣṇi. All glories to the Supreme Personality of Godhead whose bodily luster is like that of a new cloud and whose body is as soft as a lotus flower. All glories to the Supreme Personality of Godhead who appeared on this planet to deliver the world from the burden of demons and who can offer liberation to everyone.'

devanagari: जयति जन - निवासो देवकी - जन्म - वादो यदु - वर - परिषत्स्वैर्दो र्भिरस्यन्नधर्मम् ।
स्थिर - चर - वृजिन - घ्नः सुस्मित - श्री - मुखेन व्रज - पुर - वनितानां वर्धयन्काम - देवम् ॥79॥
cc-madhya-13.79.translation: “ 'Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa is He who is known as jana-nivāsa, the ultimate resort of all living entities, and who is also known as Devakī-nandana or Yaśodā-nandana, the son of Devakī and Yaśodā. He is the guide of the Yadu dynasty, and with His mighty arms He kills everything inauspicious as well as every man who is impious. By His presence He destroys all things inauspicious for all living entities, moving and inert. His blissful smiling face always increases the lusty desires of the gopīs of Vṛndāvana. May He be all glorious and happy!'

devanagari: बलिष्ठ दयिता’ गण - येन मत्त हाती ।
जगन्नाथ विजय कराय करि’ हाताहाति ॥8॥
cc-madhya-13.8.translation: The very strongly built dayitās [carriers of the Jagannātha Deity] were as powerful as drunken elephants. They manually carried Lord Jagannātha from the throne to the car.

lines: nāhaṁ vipro na ca nara-patir nāpi vaiśyo na śūdro
nāhaṁ varṇī na ca gṛha-patir no vanastho yatir vā
devanagari: नाहं विप्रो न च नर - पतिर्नापि वैश्यो न शुद्रो नाहं वर्णी न च गृह - पतिर्नो वनस्थो यतिर्वा ।
किन्तु प्रोद्यन्निखिल - परमानन्द - पूर्नामृताब्धेर् गोपी - भर्तुः पद - कमलयोर्दास - दासानुदासः ॥80॥
cc-madhya-13.80.translation: “ 'I am not a brāhmaṇa, I am not a kṣatriya, I am not a vaiśya or a śūdra. Nor am I a brahmacārī, a householder, a vānaprastha or a sannyāsī. I identify Myself only as the servant of the servant of the servant of the lotus feet of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the maintainer of the gopīs. He is like an ocean of nectar, and He is the cause of universal transcendental bliss. He is always existing with brilliance.' "

devanagari: एत पड़ि’ पुनरपि करिल प्रणाम
योड़ - हाते भक्त - गण वन्दे भगवान् ॥81॥
cc-madhya-13.81.translation: Having recited all these verses from scripture, the Lord again offered His obeisances, and all the devotees, with folded hands, also offered prayers to the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

devanagari: उद्दण्ड नृत्य प्रभु करिया हुङ्कार ।
चक्र - भ्रमि भ्रमे यैछे अलात - आकार ॥82॥
cc-madhya-13.82.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced and jumped high, roaring like thunder and moving in a circle like a wheel, He appeared like a circling firebrand.

lines: nṛtye prabhura yāhāṅ yāṅhā paḍe pada-tala
devanagari: नृत्ये प्रभुर याहाँ याँहा पड़े पद - तल ।
ससागर - शैल मही करे टलमल ॥83॥
cc-madhya-13.83.translation: Wherever Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stepped while dancing, the whole earth, with its hills and seas, appeared to tilt.

lines: stambha, sveda, pulaka, aśru, kampa, vaivarṇya
devanagari: स्तम्भ, स्वेद, पुलक, अश्रु, कम्प, वैवर्ण्य ।
नाना - भावे विवशता, गर्व, हर्ष, दैन्य ॥84॥
cc-madhya-13.84.translation: When Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced, He displayed various blissful transcendental changes in His body. Sometimes He appeared as though stunned. Sometimes the hairs of His body stood on end. Sometimes He perspired, cried, trembled and changed color, and sometimes He exhibited symptoms of helplessness, pride, exuberance and humility.

lines: āchāḍa khāñā paḍe bhūme gaḍi' yāya
devanagari: आछाड़ खा ञा पड़े भूमे गड़ि’ याय ।
सुवर्ण - पर्वत यैछे भूमेते लोटाय ॥85॥
cc-madhya-13.85.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell down with a crash while dancing, He would roll on the ground. At such times it appeared that a golden mountain was rolling on the ground.

devanagari: नित्या नन्द - प्रभु दुइ हात प्रसारिया ।
प्रभुरे धरिते चाहे आश - पाश धा ञा ॥86॥
cc-madhya-13.86.translation: Nityānanda Prabhu would stretch out His two hands and try to catch the Lord when He was running here and there.

devanagari: प्रभु - पाछे बुले आचार्य करिया हुङ्कार ।
‘हरि - बोल’ ‘हरि - बोल’ बले बार बार ॥87॥
cc-madhya-13.87.translation: Advaita Ācārya would walk behind the Lord and loudly chant "Hari bol! Hari bol!" again and again.

devanagari: लोक निवारिते हैल तिन मण्डल ।
प्रथम - मण्डले नित्यानन्द महा - बल ॥88॥
cc-madhya-13.88.translation: Just to check the crowds from coming too near the Lord, they formed three circles. The first circle was guided by Nityānanda Prabhu, who is Balarāma Himself, the possessor of great strength.

devanagari: काशीश्वर गोविन्दादि यत भक्त - गण ।
हाताहाति करि’ हैल द्वितीय आवरण ॥89॥
cc-madhya-13.89.translation: All the devotees headed by Kāśīśvara and Govinda linked hands and formed a second circle around the Lord.

devanagari: कतक दयिता करे स्कन्ध आलम्बन ।
कतक दयिता धरे श्री - पद्म - चरण ॥9॥
cc-madhya-13.9.translation: While carrying the Deity of Lord Jagannātha, some of the dayitās took hold of the shoulders of the Lord, and some caught His lotus feet.

devanagari: बाहिरे प्रतापरुद्र लञा पात्र - गण ।
मण्डल ह ञा करे लोक निवारण ॥90॥
cc-madhya-13.90.translation: Mahārāja Pratāparudra and his personal assistants formed a third circle around the two inner circles just to check the crowd from coming too near.

lines: prabhura nṛtya dekhe rājā āviṣṭa hañā
devanagari: हरिचन्दनेर स्कन्धे हस्त आलम्बिया ।
प्रभुर नृत्य देखे राजा आविष्ट हञा ॥91॥
cc-madhya-13.91.translation: With his hands on the shoulders of Haricandana, King Pratāparudra could see Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu dancing, and the King felt great ecstasy.

lines: rājāra āge rahi' dekhe prabhura nartana
devanagari: हेन - काले श्रीनिवास प्रेमाविष्ट - मन ।
राजार आगे रहि’ देखे प्रभुर नर्तन ॥92॥
cc-madhya-13.92.translation: While the King beheld the dancing, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, standing in front of him, became ecstatic as he saw the dancing of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: राजार आगे हरिचन्दन देखे श्रीनिवास ।
हस्ते ताँरे स्पर्शि’ कहे, - हओ एक - पाश ॥93॥
cc-madhya-13.93.translation: Seeing Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura standing before the King, Haricandana touched Śrīvāsa with his hand and requested him to step aside.

lines: bāra bāra ṭhele, teṅho krodha haila mane
devanagari: नृत्यावेशे श्रीनिवास किछुइ ना जाने ।
बार बार ठेले, तेंहो क्रोध हैल मने ॥94॥
cc-madhya-13.94.translation: Absorbed in watching Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dance, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura could not understand why he was being touched and pushed. After he was pushed again and again, he became angry.

devanagari: चापड़ मारिया तारे कैल निवारण ।
चापड़ खाञा क्रुद्ध हैला हरिचन्दन ॥95॥
cc-madhya-13.95.translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura slapped Haricandana to stop him from pushing him. In turn, this made Haricandana angry.

lines: kruddha hañā tāṅre kichu cāhe balibāre
devanagari: क्रुद्ध हञा ताँरे किछु चाहे बलिबारे ।
आपनि प्रतापरुद्र निवारिल तारे ॥96॥
cc-madhya-13.96.translation: As the angered Haricandana was about to speak to Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, Pratāparudra Mahārāja personally stopped him.

lines: āmāra bhāgye nāhi, tumi kṛtārtha hailā
devanagari: भाग्यवान्तुमि - इँहार हस्त - स्पर्श पाइला ।
आमार भाग्ये नाहि, तुमि कृतार्थ हैला ॥97॥
cc-madhya-13.97.translation: King Pratāparudra said, "You are very fortunate, for you have been graced by the touch of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura. I am not so fortunate. You should feel obliged to him."

lines: prabhura nṛtya dekhi' loke haila camatkāra
devanagari: प्रभुर नृत्य देखि’ लोके हैल चमत्कार ।
अन्य आछुक्, जगन्नाथेर आनन्द अपार ॥98॥
cc-madhya-13.98.translation: Everyone was astonished by the dancing of Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and even Lord Jagannātha became extremely happy to see Him.

lines: ratha sthira kaila, āge nā kare gamana
devanagari: रथ स्थिर कैल, आगे ना करे गमन ।
अनिमिष - नेत्रे करे नृत्य दरशन ॥99॥
cc-madhya-13.99.translation: The car came to a complete standstill and remained immobile while Lord Jagannātha, with unblinking eyes, watched the dancing of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: गौरः पश्यन्नात्म - वृन्दैः श्री - लक्ष्मी - विजयोत्सवम् ।
श्रुत्वा गोपी - रसोल्लासं हृष्टः प्रेम्णा ननर्त सः ॥1॥
cc-madhya-14.1.translation: Accompanied by His personal devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the festival known as Lakṣmī-vijayotsava. There He discussed the superexcellent love of the gopīs. Just by hearing about them, He became very pleased and danced in great ecstatic love for the Lord.

devanagari: “तव कथा मृतं” श्लोक राजा ये पड़िल ।
उठि’ प्रेमावेशे प्रभु आलिङ्गन कैल ॥10॥
cc-madhya-14.10.translation: As soon as the King recited the verse beginning with the words "tava kathāmṛtam," the Lord immediately arose in ecstatic love and embraced him.

devanagari: तबे वक्रेश्वरे प्रभु कहिला नाचिते ।
वक्रेश्वर नाचे, प्रभु लागिला गाइते ॥100॥
cc-madhya-14.100.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then ordered Vakreśvara Paṇḍita to dance, and as he began to dance, the Lord began to sing.

devanagari: प्रभु - सड़े स्वरूपादि कीर्तनीया गाय ।
दिक्वि दिक्नाहि ज्ञान प्रेमेर वन्याय ॥101॥
cc-madhya-14.101.translation: Then devotees like Svarūpa Dāmodara and other kīrtana performers began to sing along with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Being inundated with ecstatic love, they lost all consideration of time and circumstance.

devanagari: एइ मत कत - क्षण करि’ वन - लीला ।
नरेन्द्र - सरोवरे गेला करिते जल - खेला ॥102॥
cc-madhya-14.102.translation: After thus performing pastimes in the garden for some time, they all went to a lake called Narendra-sarovara and there enjoyed sporting in the water.

devanagari: जल - क्रीड़ा करि’ पुनः आइला उद्याने ।
भोजन - लीला कैला प्रभु लञा भक्त - गणे ॥103॥
cc-madhya-14.103.translation: After sporting in the water, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to the garden and accepted prasāda with the devotees.

devanagari: नव दिन गुण्डिचाते रहे जगन्नाथ ।
महाप्रभु ऐछे लीला करे भक्त - साथ ॥104॥
cc-madhya-14.104.translation: For nine continuous days His Lordship Śrī Jagannātha-deva stayed at the Guṇḍicā temple. During this time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also stayed there and performed the pastimes with His devotees that have already been described.

lines: nava dina karena prabhu tathāi viśrāma
devanagari: ‘जगन्नाथ - वल्लभ’ नाम बड़ पुष्पाराम ।
नव दिन करेन प्रभु तथाइ विश्राम ॥105॥
cc-madhya-14.105.translation: The garden of His pastimes was very large and was named Jagannātha vallabha. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took his rest there for nine days.

devanagari: ‘हेरा - पञ्चमी’र दिन आइल जानिया ।
काशी - मिश्रे कहे राजा सयन करिया ॥106॥
cc-madhya-14.106.translation: Knowing that the Herā-pañcamī festival was drawing near, King Pratāparudra attentively talked with Kāśī Miśra.

lines: aiche utsava kara yena kabhu nāhi haya
devanagari: कल्य ‘हेरा - पञ्चमी’ हबे लक्ष्मीर विजय ।
ऐछे उत्सव कर येन कभु नाहि हय ॥107॥
cc-madhya-14.107.translation: "Tomorrow will be the function of Herā-pañcamī or Lakṣmī-vijaya. Hold this festival in a way that it has never been held before."

devanagari: महोत्सव कर तैछे विशेष सम्भार ।
देखि’ महाप्रभुर यैछे हय चमत्कार ॥108॥
cc-madhya-14.108.translation: King Pratāparudra said, "Hold this festival in such a gorgeous way that upon seeing it, Caitanya Mahāprabhu will be completely pleased and astonished.

devanagari: ठाकुरेर भाण्डारे आर आमार भाण्डारे ।
चित्र - वस्त्र - किङ्किणी, आर छत्र - चामरे ॥109॥
cc-madhya-14.109.translation: "Take as many printed cloths, small bells, umbrellas and cāmaras as there are in my storehouse and in the Deity's storehouse.

lines: tumi more dile bahu amūlya ratana
mora kichu dite nāhi, diluṅ āliṅgana
devanagari: तुमि मोरे दिले बहु अमूल्य रतन ।
मोर किछु दिते नाहि, दिलुँ आलिङ्गन ॥11॥
cc-madhya-14.11.translation: Upon hearing the verses recited by the King, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "You have given Me invaluable gems, but I have nothing to give you in return. Therefore I am simply embracing you."

devanagari: ध्वजावृन्द - पताका - घण्टाय करह मण्डन ।
नाना - वाद्य - नृत्य - दोलाय करह साजन ॥110॥
cc-madhya-14.110.translation: "Collect all kinds of small and large flags and ringing bells. Then decorate the carrier and have various musical and dancing parties accompany it. In this way decorate the carrier attractively.

devanagari: द्विगुण करिया कर सब उपहार ।
रथ - यात्रा हैते यैछे हय चमत्कार ॥111॥
cc-madhya-14.111.translation: "You should also double the quantity of prasāda. Make so much that it will even surpass the Ratha-yātrā festival.

devanagari: सेइत’ करिह , - प्रभु लञा भक्त - गण ।
स्वच्छन्दे आसिया यैछे करेन दरशन ॥112॥
cc-madhya-14.112.translation: "Arrange the festival in such a way that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu may freely go with His devotees to visit the Deity without difficulty."

devanagari: प्रातःकाले महाप्रभु निज - गण लञा ।
जगन्नाथ दर्शन कैल सुन्दराचले याञा ॥113॥
cc-madhya-14.113.translation: In the morning, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took His personal associates with Him to see Lord Jagannātha at Sundarācala.

devanagari: नीलाचले आइला पुनः भक्त - गण - सङ्गे ।
देखिते उत्कण्ठा हेरा - पञ्चमीर रङ्गे ॥114॥
cc-madhya-14.114.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His personal devotees returned to Nīlācala with great eagerness to see the Herā-pañcamī festival.

devanagari: काशी - मिश्र प्रभुरे बहु आदर करिया ।
स्वगण - सह भाल - स्थाने वसाइल लञा ॥115॥
cc-madhya-14.115.translation: Kāśī Miśra received Caitanya Mahāprabhu with great respect, and taking the Lord and His associates to a very nice place, he had them seated.

devanagari: रस - विशेष प्रभुर शुनिते मन हैल ।
ईषत् हासिया प्रभु स्वरूपे पुछिल ॥116॥
cc-madhya-14.116.translation: After taking His seat, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to hear about a particular mellow of devotional service; therefore, mildly smiling, He began to question Svarūpa Dāmodara.

devanagari: यद्यपि जगन्नाथ करेन द्वारकाय विहार ।
सहज प्रकट करे परम उदार ॥117॥
cc-madhya-14.117-118.translation: "Although Lord Jagannātha enjoys His pastimes at Dvārakā-dhāma and naturally manifests sublime liberality there, still, once a year, He becomes unlimitedly eager to see Vṛndāvana."

devanagari: वृन्दावन - सम एइ उपवन - गण ।
ताहा देखिबारे उत्कण्ठित हय मन ॥119॥
cc-madhya-14.119.translation: Pointing out the neighboring gardens, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "All these gardens exactly resemble Vṛndāvana; therefore Lord Jagannātha is very eager to see them again.

lines: eta bali' sei śloka paḍe bāra bāra
devanagari: एत बलि’ सेइ श्लोक पड़े बार बार ।
दुइ - जनार अड़े कम्प, नेत्रे जल - धार ॥12॥
cc-madhya-14.12.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to recite the same verse again and again. Both the King and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were trembling, and tears were flowing from their eyes.

devanagari: बाहिर हइते करे रथ - यात्रा - छल ।
सुन्दराचले याय प्रभु छाड़ि’ नीलाचल ॥120॥
cc-madhya-14.120.translation: "Externally He gives the excuse that He wants to participate in the Ratha-yātrā festival, but actually He wants to leave Jagannātha Purī to go to Sundarācala, Guṇḍicā temple, the replica of Vṛndāvana.

lines: lakṣmīdevīre saṅge nāhi laya ki kāraṇe?
devanagari: नाना - पुष्पोद्याने तथा खेले रात्रि - दिने ।
लक्ष्मीदेवीरे सङ्गे नाहि लय कि कारणे? ॥121॥
cc-madhya-14.121.translation: "The Lord enjoys His pastimes day and night in various flower gardens there. But why did He not take Lakṣmīdevī, the goddess of fortune, with Him?"

devanagari: स्वरूप कहे , - शुन, प्रभु, कारण इहार ।
वृन्दावन - क्रीड़ाते लक्ष्मीर नाहि अधिकार ॥122॥
cc-madhya-14.122.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "My dear Lord, please hear the reason for this. Lakṣmīdevī, the goddess of fortune, cannot be admitted to the pastimes of Vṛndāvana.

lines: gopī-gaṇa vinā kṛṣṇera harite nāre mana
devanagari: वृन्दावन - लीलाय कृष्णेर सहाय गोपी - गण ।
गोपी - गण विना कृष्णेर हरिते नारे मन ॥123॥
cc-madhya-14.123.translation: "In the pastimes of Vṛndāvana, the only assistants are the gopīs. But for the gopīs, no one can attract the mind of Kṛṣṇa."

lines: subhadrā āra baladeva, saṅge dui jana
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - यात्रा - छले कृष्णेर गमन ।
सुभद्रा आर बलदेव, सङ्गे दुइ जन ॥124॥
cc-madhya-14.124.translation: The Lord said, "Using the car festival as an excuse, Kṛṣṇa goes there with Subhadrā and Baladeva.

lines: nigūḍha kṛṣṇera bhāva keha nāhi jāne
devanagari: गोपी - सङ्गे यत लीला हय उपवने ।
निगूढ़ कृष्णेर भाव केह नाहि जाने ॥125॥
cc-madhya-14.125.translation: "All the pastimes with the gopīs that take place in those gardens are very confidential ecstasies of Lord Kṛṣṇa. No one knows them.

lines: ataeva kṛṣṇera prākaṭye nāhi kichu doṣa
tabe kene lakṣmīdevī kare eta roṣa?
devanagari: अतएव कृष्णेर प्राकट्ये नाहि किछु दोष ।
तबे केने लक्ष्मीदेवी करे एत रोष ? ॥126॥
cc-madhya-14.126.translation: "Since there is no fault at all in Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, why does the goddess of fortune become angry?"

devanagari: स्वरूप कहे , - प्रेमवतीर एइ त’ स्वभाव ।
कान्तेर औदास्य - लेशे हय क्रोध - भाव ॥127॥
cc-madhya-14.127.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "It is the nature of a girl afflicted by love to become immediately angry upon finding neglect on the part of her lover."

devanagari: हेन - काले, खचित याहे विविध रतन ।
सुवर्णेर चौदोला करि’ आरोहण ॥128॥
cc-madhya-14.128.translation: While Svarūpa Dāmodara and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were talking, the procession of the goddess of fortune came by. She was riding upon a golden palanquin carried by four men and bedecked with a variety of jewels.

devanagari: छत्र - चामर - ध्वजा पताकार गण ।
नाना - वाद्य - आगे नाचे देव - दासी - गण ॥129॥
cc-madhya-14.129.translation: The palanquin was also surrounded by people carrying umbrellas, cāmara whisks and flags, and it was preceded by musicians and dancing girls.

devanagari: तव कथामृतं तप्त - जीवनं कविभिरीड़ितं कल्मषापहम् ।
श्रवण - मङ्गलं श्रीमदाततं भुवि गृणन्ति ये भूरिदा जनाः ॥13॥
cc-madhya-14.13.translation: "My Lord, the nectar of Your words and the descriptions of Your activities are the life and soul of those who are always aggrieved in this material world. These narrations are transmitted by exalted personalities, and they eradicate all sinful reactions. Whoever hears these narrations attains all good fortune. These narrations are broadcast all over the world and are filled with spiritual power. Those who spread the message of Godhead are certainly the most munificent welfare workers."

lines: sāthe dāsī śata, hāra divya bhūṣāmbara
devanagari: ताम्बूल - सम्पुट, झारि, व्यजन, चामर ।
साथे दासी शत, हार दिव्य भूषाम्बर ॥130॥
cc-madhya-14.130.translation: The maidservants were carrying water pitchers, cāmara whisks and boxes for betel nuts. There were hundreds of maidservants, all attractively dressed with valuable necklaces.

devanagari: अलौकिक ऐश्वर्य सङ्गे बहु - परिवार ।
क्रुद्ध हञा लक्ष्मीदेवी आइला सिंह - द्वार ॥131॥
cc-madhya-14.131.translation: In an angry mood, the goddess of fortune arrived at the main gate of the temple accompanied by many members of her family, all of whom exhibited uncommon opulence.

devanagari: जगन्नाथेर मुख्य मुख्य यत भृत्य - गणे ।
लक्ष्मीदेवीर दासी - गण करेन बन्धने ॥132॥
cc-madhya-14.132.translation: When the procession arrived, the maidservants of the goddess of fortune began to arrest all the principal servants of Lord Jagannātha.

lines: core yena daṇḍa kari' laya nānā-dhane
devanagari: बान्धिया आनिया पाड़े लक्ष्मीर चरणे ।
चोरे येन दण्ड करि’ लय नाना - धने ॥133॥
cc-madhya-14.133.translation: The maidservants bound the servants of Jagannātha, handcuffed them, and made them fall down at the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune. Indeed, they were arrested just like thieves who have all their riches taken away.

devanagari: अचेतनवत्तारे करेन ताड़ने ।
नाना - मत गालि देन भण्ड - वचने ॥134॥
cc-madhya-14.134.translation: When the servants fall down before the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune, they almost fall unconscious. They are chastised and made the butt of jokes and loose language.

lines: hāse mahāprabhura gaṇa mukhe hasta diyā
devanagari: लक्ष्मी - सङ्गे दासी - गणेर प्रागल्भ्य देखियो ।
हासे महाप्रभुर गण मुखे हस्त दिया ॥135॥
cc-madhya-14.135.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's associates saw such impudence exhibited by the maidservants of the goddess of fortune, they covered their faces with their hands and began to smile.

lines: trijagate kāhāṅ nāhi dekhi śuni āra
devanagari: दामोदर कहे , - ऐछे मानेर प्रकार ।
त्रिजगते काहाँ नाहि देखि शुनि आर ॥136॥
cc-madhya-14.136.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "There is no egoistic pride like this within the three worlds. At least I have neither seen nor heard of it.

devanagari: मानिनी निरुत्साहे छाड़े विभूषण ।
भूमे वसि’ नखे लेखे, मलिन - वदन ॥137॥
cc-madhya-14.137.translation: "When a woman is neglected and disappointed, out of egoistic pride she gives up her ornaments and morosely sits down on the floor, marking lines on it with her nails.

devanagari: पूर्वे सत्यभामार शुनि एवं - विध मान ।
व्रजे गोपी - गणेर मान - रसेर निधान ॥138॥
cc-madhya-14.138.translation: "I have heard of this kind of pride in Satyabhāmā, Kṛṣṇa's proudest Queen, and I have also heard of it in the gopīs of Vṛndāvana, who are the reservoirs of all transcendental mellows.

devanagari: इँहो निज - सम्पत्ति सब प्रकट करिया ।
प्रियेर उपर याय सैन्य साजा ञा ॥139॥
cc-madhya-14.139.translation: "But in the case of the goddess of fortune, I see a different kind of pride. She manifests her own opulences and even goes with her soldiers to attack her husband."

lines: iṅho nāhi jāne,-ihoṅ haya kon jana
devanagari: ‘भूरिदा’ ‘भूरिदा’ बलि’ करे आलिङ्गन ।
इँहो नाहि जाने , - इहों हय कोन्जन ॥14॥
cc-madhya-14.14.translation: After hearing the recitation of this verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately embraced the reciter, King Pratāparudra, and cried, "You are the most munificent! You are the most munificent!" At this point Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not even know who the King was.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - कह व्रजेर मानेर प्रकार ।
स्वरूप कहे , - गोपी - मान - नदी शत - धार ॥140॥
cc-madhya-14.140.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Please tell me of the varieties of egoistic pride manifest in Vṛndāvana." Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "The pride of the gopīs is like a river flowing with hundreds of tributaries.

devanagari: नायिकार स्वभाव, प्रेम - वृत्ते बहु भेद ।
सेइ भेदे नाना - प्रकार मानेर उद्भेद ॥141॥
cc-madhya-14.141.translation: "The characteristics and modes of love are different in different women. Their jealous anger also takes on different varieties and qualities.

lines: samyak gopikāra māna nā yāya kathana
devanagari: सम्यक्गोपिकार मान ना याय कथन ।
एक - दुइ - भेदे करि दिग्दरशन ॥142॥
cc-madhya-14.142.translation: "It is not possible to give a complete statement about the different types of jealous anger manifest by the gopīs, but a few principles may serve as an indication.

devanagari: माने केह हय ‘धीरा’, केह त’ ‘अधीरा’ ।
एइ तिन - भेदे, केह हय ‘धीराधीरा’ ॥143॥
cc-madhya-14.143.translation: "There are three types of women experiencing jealous anger: sober women, restless women and women both restless and sober.

devanagari: ‘धीरा’ कान्ते दूरे देखि’ करे प्रत्युत्थान ।
निकटे आसिले, करे आसन प्रदान ॥144॥
cc-madhya-14.144.translation: "When a sober heroine sees her hero approaching from a distance, she immediately stands up to recieve him. When he comes near, she immediately offers him a place to sit.

lines: hṛdaye kopa, mukhe kahe madhura vacana
devanagari: हृदये कोप, मुखे कहे मधुर वचन ।
प्रिय आलिङ्गिते, तारे करे आलिङ्गन ॥145॥
