cc-madhya-14.145.translation: "The sober heroine conceals her anger within her heart and externally speaks sweet words. When her lover embraces her, she also returns his embrace.

devanagari: सरल व्यवहार, करे मानेर पोषण ।
किम्वा सोल्लुण्ठ - वाक्ये करे प्रिय - निरसन ॥146॥
cc-madhya-14.146.translation: "The sober heroine is very simple in her behavior. She keeps her jealous anger within her heart, but with mild words and smiles she refutes the advances of her lover.

devanagari: ‘अधीरा’ निष्ठर - वाक्ये करये भर्त्सन ।
कर्णोत्पले ताड़े, करे मालाय बन्धन ॥147॥
cc-madhya-14.147.translation: "The restless heroine, however, sometimes chastises her lover with cruel words, sometimes pulls his ear and sometimes binds him with a flower garland.

lines: kabhu stuti, kabhu nindā, kabhu vā udāsa
devanagari: ‘धीराधीरा’ वक्र - वाक्ये करे उपहास ।
कभु स्तुति, कभु निन्दा, कभु वा उदास ॥148॥
cc-madhya-14.148.translation: "The heroine who is a combination of sobriety and restlessness always jokes with equivocal words. She sometimes praises her lover, sometimes blasphemes him and sometimes remains indifferent.

devanagari: ‘मुग्धा’, ‘मध्या’, ‘प्रगल्भा’, - तिन नायिकार भेद ।
‘मुग्धा’ नाहि जाने मानेर वैदग्ध्य - विभेद ॥149॥
cc-madhya-14.149.translation: "Heroines may also be classified as captivated, intermediate and impudent. The captivated heroine does not know very much about the cunning intricacies of jealous anger.

devanagari: पूर्व - सेवा देखि’ ताँरे कृपा उपजिल ।
अनुसन्धान विना कृपा - प्रसाद करिल ॥15॥
cc-madhya-14.15.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mercy was aroused because of the King's previous service. Therefore without even asking who he was, the Lord immediately bestowed His mercy upon him.

devanagari: मुख आच्छादिया करे केवल रोदन ।
कान्तेर प्रिय - वाक्य शुनि’ हय पर सन्न ॥150॥
cc-madhya-14.150.translation: "The captivated heroine simply covers her face and goes on crying. When she hears sweet words from her lover, she is very satisfied.

lines: tāra madhye sabāra svabhāve tina bheda
devanagari: ‘मध्या’ ‘प्रगल्भा’ धरे धीरादि - विभेद ।
तार मध्ये सबार स्वभावे तिन भेद ॥151॥
cc-madhya-14.151.translation: "Both the intermediate and impudent heroines can be classified as sober, restless and both sober and restless. All their characteristics can be further classified in three divisions.

devanagari: केह ‘प्रखरा’, केह ‘मृदु’, केह हय ‘समा’ ।
स्व - स्वभावे कृष्णेर बाड़ाय प्रेम - सीमा ॥152॥
cc-madhya-14.152.translation: "Some of them are very talkative, some are mild, and some are equipoised. Each heroine, according to her own character, increases Śrī Kṛṣṇa's loving ecstasy.

lines: sei sei svabhāve kṛṣṇe karāya santoṣa
devanagari: प्राखर्य, मार्दव, साम्य स्वभाव निर्दोष ।
सेइ सेइ स्वभावे कृष्णे कराय सन्तोष ॥153॥
cc-madhya-14.153.translation: "Although some of the gopīs are talkative, some mild and some equipoised, all of them are transcendental and faultless. They please Kṛṣṇa by their unique characteristics."

devanagari: ए - कथा शुनिया प्रभुर आनन्द अपार ।
‘कह, कह, दामोद र’, - बले बार बार ॥154॥
cc-madhya-14.154.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt unlimited happiness upon hearing these descriptions, and He again and again requested Svarūpa Dāmodara to continue speaking.

devanagari: दामोदर कहे , - कृष्ण रसिक - शेखर ।
रस - आस्वादक, रसमय - कलेवर ॥155॥
cc-madhya-14.155.translation: Dāmodara Gosvāmī said, "Kṛṣṇa is the master of all transcendental mellows. He is the taster of transcendental mellows, and His body is composed of transcendental bliss.

devanagari: प्रेममय - वपु कृष्ण भक्त - प्रेमाधीन ।
शुद्ध - प्रेमे, रस - गुणे, गोपिका - प्रवीण ॥156॥
cc-madhya-14.156.translation: "Kṛṣṇa is full of ecstatic love and always subordinate to the love of his devotees. The gopīs are very experienced in pure love and in the dealings of transcendental mellows.

devanagari: गोपिकार प्रेमे नाहि रसाभास - दोष ।
अतएव कृष्णेर करे परम सन्तोष ॥157॥
cc-madhya-14.157.translation: "There is no flaw or adulteration in the love of the gopīs; therefore they give Kṛṣṇa the highest pleasure.

devanagari: सिषेव आत्मन्यवरुद्ध - सौरतः ।
सर्वाः शरत्काव्य - कथा - रसाश्रयाः ॥158॥
cc-madhya-14.158.translation: “ 'Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, who is the Absolute Truth, enjoyed His rāsa dance every night during the autumn season. He performed this dance in the moonlight and with full transcendental mellows. He used poetic words and surrounded Himself with women who were very much attracted to Him.'

devanagari: ‘वामा’ एक गोपी - गण, ‘दक्षिणा’ एक गण ।
नाना - भावे कराय कृष्णे रस आस्वादन ॥159॥
cc-madhya-14.159.translation: "The gopīs can be divided into a left wing and a right wing. Both wings induce Kṛṣṇa to taste transcendental mellows by various manifestations of ecstatic love.

devanagari: एइ देख , - चैतन्येर कृपा - महाबल ।
तार अनुसन्धान विना कराय सफल ॥16॥
cc-madhya-14.16.translation: How powerful is the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! Without even inquiring about the King, the Lord made everything successful.

devanagari: गोपी - गण - मध्ये श्रेष्ठा राधा - ठाकुराणी ।
निर्मल - उज्वल - रस - प्रेम - रत्न - खनि ॥160॥
cc-madhya-14.160.translation: "Of all the gopīs, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is the chief. She is a jewel mine of ecstatic love and the source of all purified transcendental conjugal mellows.

devanagari: वयसे ‘मध्यमा’ तेंहो स्वभावेते ‘समा’ ।
गाढ़ प्रेम - भावे तेंहो निरन्तर ‘वामा’ ॥161॥
cc-madhya-14.161.translation: "Rādhārāṇī is grown up, and Her character is equipoised. She is always deeply absorbed in ecstatic love and always feeling in the mood of a left-wing gopī.

devanagari: वाम्य - स्वभावे मान उठे निरन्तर ।
तार मध्ये उठे कृष्णेर आनन्द - सागर ॥162॥
cc-madhya-14.162.translation: "Because She is a left-wing gopī, Her womanly anger is always awakening, but Kṛṣṇa derives transcendental bliss from Her activities.

devanagari: अहेरिव गतिः प्रेम्णः स्वभाव - कुटिला भवेत् ।
अतो हेतोरहेतोश्च यूनोर्मान उदञ्चति ॥163॥
cc-madhya-14.163.translation: “ 'The progress of loving affairs between young couples is by nature crooked, like the movement of a snake. Because of this, two types of anger arise between young couples-anger with a cause and anger without a cause.' "

devanagari: एत शुनि’ बाड़े प्रभुर आनन्द - सागर ।
‘कह, कह’ कहे प्रभु, बले दामोदर ॥164॥
cc-madhya-14.164.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these talks, His ocean of transcendental bliss increased. He therefore told Svarūpa Dāmodara, "Go on speaking, go on speaking." And thus Svarūpa Dāmodara continued.

devanagari: ‘अधिरूढ़ महाभा व’ - राधिकार प्रेम ।
विशुद्ध, निर्मल, यैछे दश - वाण हेम ॥165॥
cc-madhya-14.165.translation: "Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's love is a highly advanced ecstasy. All Her dealings are completely pure and devoid of material tinge. Indeed, Her dealings are ten times purer than gold.

devanagari: कृष्णेर दर्शन यदि पाय आचम्बिते ।
नाना - भाव - विभूषणे हय विभूषिते ॥166॥
cc-madhya-14.166.translation: "As soon as Rādhārāṇī gets a chance to see Kṛṣṇa, Her body is suddenly decorated with various ecstatic ornaments.

devanagari: अष्ट ‘सात्त्विक’, हर्षादि व्यभिचारी’ याँर ।
‘सहज प्रे म’, विंशति ‘भाव’ - अलङ्कार ॥167॥
cc-madhya-14.167.translation: "The transcendental ornaments of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's body include the eight sāttvikas, or transcendental symptoms, the thirty-three vyabhicārībhāvas, beginning with harṣa, or jubilation in natural love, and the twenty bhāvas, or ecstatic emotional ornaments.

devanagari: ‘किल - किञ्चि त’, ‘कुट्टमित’, ‘विलास’, ‘ललित’ ।
‘विव्वोक’, ‘मोट्टायि त’, आर ‘मौग्ध्य’, ‘चकित’ ॥168॥
cc-madhya-14.168.translation: "Some of the symptoms critically explained in the following verses are kilakiñcita, kuṭṭamita, vilāsa, lalita, vivvoka, moṭṭāyita, maugdhya and cakita.

devanagari: एत भाव - भूषाय भूषित श्री - राधार अङ्ग ।
देखिते उथले कृष्ण - सुखाब्धि - तरङ्ग ॥169॥
cc-madhya-14.169.translation: "When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's body manifests the ornaments of many ecstatic symptoms, the ocean of Kṛṣṇa's happiness immediately displays transcendental waves.

lines: prabhu bale,-ke tumi, karilā mora hita?
devanagari: प्रभु बले, - के तुमि, करिला मोर हित? ।
आचम्बिते आसि’ पियाओ कृष्ण - लीलामृत? ॥17॥
cc-madhya-14.17.translation: Finally Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Who are you? You have done so much for Me. All of a sudden you have come here and made Me drink the nectar of the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: किल - किञ्चितादि - भावेर शुन विवरण ।
ये भाव - भूषाय राधा हरे कृष्ण - मन ॥170॥
cc-madhya-14.170.translation: "Now hear a description of different ecstasies, beginning with kila-kiñcita. With these ecstatic ornaments, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī enchants the mind of Kṛṣṇa.

lines: rādhā dekhi' kṛṣṇa yadi chuṅite kare mana
devanagari: राधा देखि’ कृष्ण यदि छुडिते करे मन ।
दान - घाटि - पथे यबे वर्जेन गमन ॥171॥
cc-madhya-14.171.translation: "When Śrī Kṛṣṇa sees Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and wants to touch Her body, He prohibits Her from going to the spot where one can cross the River Yamunā.

lines: yabe āsi' mānā kare puṣpa uṭhāite
sakhī-āge cāhe yadi gāye hāta dite
devanagari: यबे आसि’ माना करे पुष्प उठाइते ।
सखी - आगे चाहे यदि गाये हात दिते ॥172॥
cc-madhya-14.172.translation: "Approaching Her, Kṛṣṇa prohibits Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī from picking flowers. He may also touch Her in front of Her friends.

devanagari: एइ - सब स्थाने ‘किल - किञ्चि त’ उद्गम ।
प्रथमे ‘हर्ष’ सञ्चारी - मूल कारण ॥173॥
cc-madhya-14.173.translation: "At such times, the ecstatic symptoms of kila-kiñcita are awakened. First there is jubilation in ecstatic love, which is the root cause of these symptoms.

devanagari: गर्वाभिलाष - रुदित - स्मितासूया - भय - क्रुधाम् ।
सङ्करी - करणं हर्षादुच्यते किल - किञ्चितम् ॥174॥
cc-madhya-14.174.translation: “ 'Pride, ambition, weeping, smiling, envy, fear and anger are the seven ecstatic loving symptoms manifest by a jubilant shrinking away, and these symptoms are called kila-kiñcita-bhāva.'

lines: āra sāta bhāva āsi' sahaje milaya
devanagari: आर सात भाव आसि’ सहजे मिलय ।
अष्ट - भाव - सम्मिलने ‘महा - भाव’ हय ॥175॥
cc-madhya-14.175.translation: "There are seven other transcendental ecstatic symptoms, and when they combine on the platform of jubilation, the combination is called mahābhāva.

devanagari: गर्व, अभिलाष, भय, शुष्क - रुदित ।
क्रोध, असूया हय, आर मन्द - स्मित ॥176॥
cc-madhya-14.176.translation: "The seven combined ingredients of mahābhāva are pride, ambition, fear, dry artificial crying, anger, envy and mild smiling.

devanagari: नाना - स्वादु अष्ट - भाव एकत्र मिलन ।
याहार आस्वादे तृप्त हय कृष्ण - मन ॥177॥
cc-madhya-14.177.translation: "There are eight symptoms of ecstatic love on the platform of transcendental jubilation, and when they are combined and tasted by Kṛṣṇa, the Lord's mind is completely satisfied.

lines: dadhi, khaṇḍa, ghṛta, madhu, marīca, karpūra
devanagari: दधि, खण्ड, घृत, मधु, मरीच, कर्पूर ।
एलाचि - मिलने यैछे रसाला मधुर ॥178॥
cc-madhya-14.178.translation: "Indeed, they are compared to a combination of yogurt, candy, ghee, honey, black pepper, camphor and cardamom, which, when mixed together, are very tasty and sweet.

devanagari: एइ भाव - मुक्त देखि’ राधास्य - नयन ।
सङ्गम हइते सुख पाय कोटि - गुण ॥179॥
cc-madhya-14.179.translation: "Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa is thousands upon thousands of times more satisfied when He sees Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's face light up from this combination of ecstatic love than He is by direct union with Her.

devanagari: राजा कहे , - आमि तोमार दासेर अनुदास ।
भृत्येर भृत्य कर, - एइ मोर आश ॥18॥
cc-madhya-14.18.translation: The King replied, "My Lord, I am the most obedient servant of Your servants. It is my ambition that You will accept me as the servant of Your servants."

lines: rādhāyāḥ kila-kiñcita-stavakinī dṛṣṭiḥ śriyaṁ vaḥ kriyāt
devanagari: अन्तः स्मेरतयोज्वला जल - कण - व्याकीर्ण - पक्ष्माङ्करा किञ्चित्पाटलिताञ्चला रसिकतोत्सित्ता पुरः कुञ्चती ।
रुद्धायाः पथि माधवेन मधुर - व्याभुग्न - तोरोत्तरा राधायाः किल - किञ्चित - स्तवकिनी दृष्टिः श्रियं वः क्रियात् ॥180॥
cc-madhya-14.180.translation: “ 'May the sight of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's kila-kiñcita ecstasy, which is like a bouquet, bring good fortune to all. When Śrī Kṛṣṇa blocked Rādhārāṇī's way to the dāna-ghāṭi, there was laughter within Her heart. Her eyes grew bright, and fresh tears flowed from Her eyes, reddening them. Due to Her sweet relationship with Kṛṣṇa, Her eyes were enthusiastic, and when Her crying subsided, She appeared even more beautiful.'

lines: ānandaṁ tam avāpa koṭi-guṇitaṁ yo 'bhūn na gīr-gocaraḥ
devanagari: बाष्प - व्याकुलतारुणाञ्चल - चलन्नेत्रं रसोल्लासितं हेलोल्लास - चलाधरं कुटिलित - भू - युग्ममुद्यस्मितम् ।
राधायाः किल - किञ्चिताञ्चितमसौ वीक्ष्याननं सङ्गमाद् आनन्दं तमवाप कोटि - गुणितं योऽभून्न गीर्गोचरः ॥181॥
cc-madhya-14.181.translation: “ 'Agitated by tears, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's eyes were tinged with red, just like the eastern horizon at sunrise. Her lips began to move with jubilation and lusty desire. Her eyebrows curved, and Her lotus-like face smiled mildly. Seeing Rādhārāṇī's face exhibit such emotion, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa felt a million times happier than when He embraced Her. Indeed, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa's happiness is not at all mundane.' "

lines: eta śuni' prabhu hailā ānandita mana
devanagari: एत शुनि’ प्रभु हैला आनन्दित मन ।
सुखाविष्ट हञा स्वरूपे कैला आलिङ्गन ॥182॥
cc-madhya-14.182.translation: Upon hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became very happy, and, being absorbed in this happiness, He embraced Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.

lines: yei bhāve rādhā hare govindera mana?
devanagari: ‘विलासादि’ - भाव - भूषार कह त’ लक्षण ।
येइ भावे राधा हरे गोविन्देर मन ? ॥183॥
cc-madhya-14.183.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then asked Svarūpa Dāmodara, "Please speak of the ecstatic ornaments decorating the body of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, by which She enchants the mind of Śrī Govinda."

devanagari: तबे त’ स्वरूप - गोसाञि कहिते लागिला ।
शुनि’ प्रभुर भक्त - गण महा - सुख पाइला ॥184॥
cc-madhya-14.184.translation: Being thus requested, Svarūpa Dāmodara began to speak. All the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were very happy to hear him.

lines: rādhā vasi' āche, kibā vṛndāvane yāya
devanagari: राधा वसि’ आछे, किबा वृन्दावने याय ।
ताहाँ यदि आचम्बिते कृष्ण - दरशन पाय ॥185॥
cc-madhya-14.185.translation: "Sometimes when Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is sitting or when She is going to Vṛndāvana, She sometimes sees Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: देखिते नाना - भाव हय विलक्षण ।
से वैलक्षण्येर नाम ‘विलास’ - भूषण ॥186॥
cc-madhya-14.186.translation: "The symptoms of various ecstasies that become manifest at that time are called vilāsa.

devanagari: गति - स्थानासनादीनां मुख - नेत्रादि - कर्मणाम् ।
तात्कालिकं तु वैशिष्ट्यं विलासः प्रिय - सङ्ग - जम् ॥187॥
cc-madhya-14.187.translation: “ 'The various symptoms manifested in a woman's face, eyes, and the other parts of her body and the way she moves, stands or sits when she meets her beloved are called vilāsa.' "

lines: lajjā, harṣa, abhilāṣa, sambhrama, vāmya, bhaya
eta bhāva mili' rādhāya cañcala karaya
devanagari: लज्जा, हर्ष, अभिलाष, सम्भ्रम, वाम्य, भय ।
एत भाव मि लि’ राधाय चञ्चल करय ॥188॥
cc-madhya-14.188.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "Timidity, jubilation, ambition, respect, fear and the characteristics of the left-wing gopīs were all ecstatic symptoms combined to agitate Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

lines: calat-tāraṁ sphāraṁ nayana-yugam ābhugnam iti sā
devanagari: पुरः कृष्णालोकात्स्थगित - कुटिलास्या गतिरभूत् तिरश्चीनं कृष्णाम्बर - दर - वृतं श्री - मुखमपि ।
चलत्तारं स्फारं नयन - युगमाभुग्नमिति सा विलासाख्य - स्वालङ्करण - वलितासीप्रिय - मुदे ॥189॥
cc-madhya-14.189.translation: “ 'When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī saw Lord Kṛṣṇa just before Her, Her progress stopped, and She assumed an attitude of opposition. Although Her face was slightly covered by a blue garment, Her two starry eyes were agitated, being wide and curved. Thus She was decorated with the ornaments of vilāsa, and Her beauty increased to give pleasure to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead.'

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु ताँरे ऐश्वर्य देखाइल ।
‘कारेह ना कहिबे’ एइ निषेध करिल ॥19॥
cc-madhya-14.19.translation: At that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu displayed some of His divine opulences to the King, and He forbade him to disclose this to anyone.

devanagari: कृष्ण - आगे राधा यदि रहे दाण्डा ञा ।
तिन - अङ्ग - भङ्गे रहे भू नाचाञा ॥190॥
cc-madhya-14.190.translation: "When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī stands before Kṛṣṇa, She stands bent in three places-Her neck, waist and legs-and Her eyebrows dance.

devanagari: मुखे - नेत्रे हय नाना - भावेर उद्गार ।
एइ कान्ता - भावेर नाम ‘ललि त’ - अलङ्कार ॥191॥
cc-madhya-14.191.translation: "When there is an awakening of various ecstatic features on Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's face and in Her eyes, the lalita ornaments are manifest.

devanagari: विन्यास - भङ्गिङ्गानां भू - विलास - मनोहरा ।
सुकुमारा भवेद् यत्र ललितं तदुदाहृतम् ॥192॥
cc-madhya-14.192.translation: “ 'When the bodily features are delicate and expertly curved, and when the eyebrows are very beautifully agitated, the ornament of charm, called lalita alaṅkāra, is manifest.'

devanagari: ललित - भूषित राधा देखे यदि कृष्ण ।
दुँहे दुँहा मिलिबारे हयेन सतृष्ण ॥193॥
cc-madhya-14.193.translation: "When Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa happens to see Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī decorated with these lalita ornaments, They both anxiously want to meet one another.

devanagari: ह्रिया तिर्यग्ग्रीवा - चरण - कटि - भङ्गी - सुमधुरा चलच्चिल्ली - वल्ली - दलित - रतिनाथोर्जित - धनुः ।
प्रिय - प्रेमोल्लासोल्लसित - ललितालालित - तनुः प्रिय - प्रीत्यै सासीदुदित - ललिताल ङ्कृति - ग्रुता ॥194॥
cc-madhya-14.194.translation: “ 'When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was decorated with the ornament of lalita-alaṅkāra, just to increase Śrī Kṛṣṇa's love, an attractive curve was manifest by Her neck, knees and waist. This was brought about by Her timidity and apparent desire to avoid Kṛṣṇa. The flickering movements of Her eyebrows could conquer the powerful bow of Cupid. To increase the joy of Her beloved's love, Her body was decorated with the ornaments of lalita-alaṅkāra.'

devanagari: लोभे आसि’ कृष्ण करे कञ्चुकाकर्षण ।
अन्तरे उल्लास, राधा करे निवारण ॥195॥
cc-madhya-14.195.translation: "When Kṛṣṇa comes forward and greedily snatches at the border of Rādhārāṇī's sari, She is actually very pleased within, but overtly She tries to stop Him.

devanagari: बाहिरे वामता - क्रोध, भितरे सुख मने ।
‘कुट्टमित’ - नाम एइ भाव - विभूषणे ॥196॥
cc-madhya-14.196.translation: "This ecstatic dress of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's is called kuṭṭamita. When it is manifest, She externally tries to avoid Kṛṣṇa, and She apparently becomes angry, although She is very happy within.

devanagari: स्तनाधरादि - ग्रहणे हृत्प्रीतावपि सम्भ्रमात् ।
बहिः क्रोधो व्यथित - वत्प्रोक्तं कुट्टमितं बुधैः ॥197॥
cc-madhya-14.197.translation: “ 'When the border of Her sari and the cloth veiling Her face are caught, She externally appears offended and angry, but within Her heart She is very happy. Learned scholars call this attitude kuṭṭamita.'

devanagari: कृष्ण - वाञ्छा पूर्ण हय, करे पाणि - रोध ।
अन्तरे आनन्द राधा, बाहिरे वाम्य - क्रोध ॥198॥
cc-madhya-14.198.translation: "Although Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was checking Her sari with Her hand, internally She was thinking, 'Let Kṛṣṇa satisfy His desires.' In this way She was very pleased within, although She externally displayed opposition and anger.

lines: vyathā pāñā' kare yena śuṣka rodana
devanagari: व्यथा पाञा’ करे येन शुष्क रोदन ।
ईषत् हासिया कृष्णे करेन भर्त्सन ॥199॥
cc-madhya-14.199.translation: "Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī externally displays a kind of dry crying, as if She is offended. Then She mildly smiles and admonishes Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: जय जय गौरचन्द्र श्री - कृष्ण - चैतन्य ।
जय जय नित्यानन्द जयाद्वैत धन्य ॥2॥
cc-madhya-14.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, known as Gauracandra! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is so exalted!

devanagari: ‘राजा’ - हेन ज्ञान कभु ना कैल प्रकाश ।
अन्तरे सकल जानेन, बाहिरे उदास ॥20॥
cc-madhya-14.20.translation: Although within His heart Caitanya Mahāprabhu knew everything that was happening, externally He did not disclose it. Nor did He disclose that He knew He was talking with King Pratāparudra.

devanagari: पाणि - रोधमविरोधित - वाञ्छं भर्त्सनाश्च मधुर - स्मित - गर्भाः ।
माधवस्य कुरुते करभोरुर् हारि शुष्क - रुदितं च मुखेऽपि ॥200॥
cc-madhya-14.200.translation: “ 'Actually She has no desire to stop Kṛṣṇa's endeavor to touch Her body with His hands, yet Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, whose thighs are like the trunk of a baby elephant, protests His advances and, sweetly smiling, admonishes Him. At such times She cries without tears on Her charming face.'

lines: yāhāte bhūṣita rādhā hare kṛṣṇa mana
devanagari: एइ - मत आर सब भाव - विभूषण ।
याहाते भूषित राधा हरे कृष्ण मन ॥201॥
cc-madhya-14.201.translation: "In this way, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is ornamented and decorated with various ecstatic symptoms, which attract the mind of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

lines: ananta kṛṣṇera līlā nā yāya varṇana
devanagari: अनन्त कृष्णेर लीला ना याय वर्णन ।
आपने वर्णेन यदि ‘सहस्त्र - वदन’ ॥202॥
cc-madhya-14.202.translation: "It is not at all possible to describe the unlimited pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, even though He Himself describes them in His incarnation of Sahasra-vadana, the thousand-mouthed Śeṣa Nāga."

devanagari: श्रीवास हासिया कहे , - शुन, दामोदर ।
आमार लक्ष्मीर देख सम्पत्ति विस्तर ॥203॥
cc-madhya-14.203.translation: This time, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura smiled and told Dāmodara Paṇḍita, "My dear sir, please hear! Just see how opulent my goddess of fortune is!

devanagari: वृन्दावनेर सम्पदेख, - पुष्प - किसलय ।
गिरिधातु - शिखिपिच्छ - गुञ्जाफल - मय ॥204॥
cc-madhya-14.204.translation: "As far as Vṛndāvana's opulence is concerned, it consists of a few flowers and twigs, some minerals from the hills, a few peacock feathers and the plant known as guñjā.

devanagari: वृन्दावन देखिबारे गेला जगन्नाथ ।
शुनि’ लक्ष्मी देवीर मने हैल आसोयाथ ॥205॥
cc-madhya-14.205.translation: "When Jagannātha decided to see Vṛndāvana, He went there, and upon hearing this, the goddess of fortune experienced restlessness and jealousy.

lines: eta sampatti chāḍi' kene gelā vṛndāvana
tāṅre hāsya karite lakṣmī karilā sājana
devanagari: एत सम्पत्ति छाड़ि’ केने गेला वृन्दावन ।
ताँरे हास्य करिते लक्ष्मी करिला साजन ॥206॥
cc-madhya-14.206.translation: "She wondered, 'Why did Lord Jagannātha give up so much opulence and go to Vṛndāvana?' To make Him a laughingstock, the goddess of fortune made arrangements for much decoration.

devanagari: “तोमार ठाकुर, देख एत सम्पत्ति छाड़ि’ ।
पत्र - फल - फुल - लोभे गेला पुष्प - बाड़ी ॥207॥
cc-madhya-14.207.translation: "Then the maidservants of the goddess of fortune said to the servants of Lord Jagannātha, 'Why did your Lord Jagannātha abandon the great opulence of the goddess of fortune and, for the sake of a few leaves, fruits and flowers, go see the flower garden of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī?

lines: lakṣmīra agrete nija prabhure deha' āni' "
devanagari: एइ कर्म करे काहाँ विदग्ध - शिरोमणि ?।
लक्ष्मीर अग्रेते निज प्रभुरे देह’ आनि” ॥208॥
cc-madhya-14.208.translation: “ 'Your master is so expert at everything, but why does He do such things? Please bring your master before the goddess of fortune.'

devanagari: एत बलि’ महा - लक्ष्मीर सब दासी - गणे ।
कटि - वस्त्रे बान्धि’ आने प्रभुर निज - गणे ॥209॥
cc-madhya-14.209.translation: "In this way all the maidservants of the goddess of fortune arrested the servants of Jagannātha, bound them around the waist and brought them before the goddess of fortune.

devanagari: प्रतापरुद्रेर भाग्य देखि’ भक्त - गणे ।
राजारे प्रशंसे सबे आनन्दित - मने ॥21॥
cc-madhya-14.21.translation: Seeing the Lord's special mercy upon King Pratāparudra, the devotees praised the King's fortune, and their minds became open and blissful.

devanagari: लक्ष्मीर चरणे आनि’ कराय प्रणति ।
धन - दण्ड लय, आर कराय मिनति ॥210॥
cc-madhya-14.210.translation: "When all the maidservants brought Lord Jagannātha's servants before the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune, the Lord's servants were fined and forced to submit.

devanagari: रथेर उपरे करे दण्डेर ताड़न ।
चोर - प्राय करे जगन्नाथेर सेवक - गण ॥211॥
cc-madhya-14.211.translation: "All the maidservants began to beat the Ratha car with sticks, and they treated the servants of Lord Jagannātha almost like thieves.

devanagari: सब भृत्य - गण कहे , - योड़ करि’ हात ।
‘कालि आनि दिब तोमार आगे जगन्नाथ’ ॥212॥
cc-madhya-14.212.translation: "Finally all of Lord Jagannātha's servants submitted to the goddess of fortune with folded hands, assuring her that they would bring Lord Jagannātha before her the very next day.

lines: tabe śānta hañā lakṣmī yāya nija ghara
devanagari: तबे शान्त ह ञा लक्ष्मी याय निज घर ।
आमार लक्ष्मीर सम्प द् द्वाक्य - अगोचर ॥213॥
cc-madhya-14.213.translation: "Being thus pacified, the goddess of fortune returned to her apartment. Just see! My goddess of fortune is opulent beyond all description."

lines: dugdha āuṭi' dadhi mathe tomāra gopī-gaṇe
devanagari: दुग्ध आउटि’ दधि मथे तोमार गोपी - गणे ।
आमार ठाकुराणी वैसे रत्न - सिंहासने ॥214॥
cc-madhya-14.214.translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura continued to address Svarūpa Dāmodara: "Your gopīs are engaged in boiling milk and churning it to turn it into yogurt, but my mistress, the goddess of fortune, sits on a throne made of jewels and gems."

devanagari: नारद - प्रकृति श्रीवास करे परिहास ।
शुनि’ हासे महाप्रभुर यत निज - दास ॥215॥
cc-madhya-14.215.translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, who was enjoying the mood of Nārada Muni, thus made jokes. Hearing him, all the personal servants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to smile.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - श्रीवास, तोमाते नारद - स्वभाव ।
ऐश्वर्य - भावे तोमाते, ईश्वर - प्रभाव ॥216॥
cc-madhya-14.216.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then told Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, "My dear Śrīvāsa, your nature is exactly like that of Nārada Muni. The Supreme Personality of Godhead's opulence is having a direct influence upon you.

lines: aiśvarya nā jāne iṅho śuddha-preme bhāsi'
devanagari: इँहो दामोदर - स्वरूप - शुद्ध - व्रजवासी ।
ऐश्वर्य ना जाने इँहो शुद्ध - प्रेमे भा सि’ ॥217॥
cc-madhya-14.217.translation: "Svarūpa Dāmodara is a pure devotee of Vṛndāvana. He does not even know what opulence is, for he is simply absorbed in pure devotional service."

devanagari: स्वरूप कहे , - श्रीवास, शुन सावधाने ।
वृन्दावन - सम्पद्तोमार नाहि पड़े मने? ॥218॥
cc-madhya-14.218.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara then retorted, "My dear Śrīvāsa, please hear me with attention. You have forgotten the transcendental opulence of Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: वृन्दावने साहजिक ग्रे सम्पत्सिन्धु ।
द्वारका - वैकुण्ठ - सम्पत् - तार एक बिन्दु ॥219॥
cc-madhya-14.219.translation: "The natural opulence of Vṛndāvana is just like an ocean. The opulence of Dvārakā and Vaikuṇṭha is not even to be compared to a drop.

lines: yoḍa hasta kari' saba bhaktere vandilā
devanagari: दण्डवत्क रि’ राजा बाहिरे चलिला ।
योड़ हस्त करि’ सब भक्तेरे वन्दिला ॥22॥
cc-madhya-14.22.translation: Submissively offering prayers to the devotees with folded hands and offering obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the King went outside.

devanagari: परम पुरुषोत्तम स्वयं भगवान् ।
कृष्ण याहाँ धनी ताहाँ वृन्दावन - धाम ॥220॥
cc-madhya-14.220.translation: "Śrī Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead full of all opulences, and His complete opulences are exhibited only in Vṛndāvana-dhāma.

devanagari: चिन्तामणि - मय भूमि रत्नेर भवन ।
चिन्तामणि - गण दासी - चरण - भूषण ॥221॥
cc-madhya-14.221.translation: "Vṛndāvana-dhāma is made of transcendental touchstone. Its entire surface is the source of all valuable jewels, and the cintāmaṇi stone is used to decorate the lotus feet of the maidservants of Vṛndāvana.

lines: puṣpa-phala vinā keha nā māge anya dhana
devanagari: कल्पवृक्ष - लतार - याहाँ साहजिक - वन ।
पुष्प - फल विना केह ना मागे अन्य धन ॥222॥
cc-madhya-14.222.translation: "Vṛndāvana is a natural forest of desire trees and creepers, and the inhabitants do not want anything but the fruits and flowers of those desire trees.

lines: ananta kāma-dhenu tāhāṅ phire vane vane
dugdha-mātra dena, keha nā māge anya dhane
devanagari: अनन्त काम - धेनु ताहाँ फिरे वने वने ।
दुग्ध - मात्र दे न, केह ना मागे अन्य धने ॥223॥
cc-madhya-14.223.translation: "In Vṛndāvana there are cows that fulfill all desires [kāma-dhenus], and their number is unlimited. They graze from forest to forest and deliver only milk. The people want nothing else.

devanagari: सहज लोकेर कथा - याहाँ दिव्य - गीत ।
सहज गमन करे , - यैछे नृत्य - प्रतीत ॥224॥
cc-madhya-14.224.translation: "In Vṛndāvana, the natural speech of the people sounds like music, and their natural motion resembles a dance.

devanagari: सर्वत्र जल - याहाँ अमृत - समान ।
चिदानन्द ज्योतिः स्वाद्य - याहाँ मूर्तिमान् ॥225॥
cc-madhya-14.225.translation: "The water in Vṛndāvana is nectar, and the brahmajyoti effulgence, which is full of transcendental bliss, is directly perceived there in its form.

lines: lakṣmī jini' guṇa yāhāṅ lakṣmīra samāja
devanagari: लक्ष्मी जिनि’ गुण याहाँ लक्ष्मीर समाज ।
कृष्ण - वंशी करे याहाँ प्रिय - सखी - काय ॥226॥
cc-madhya-14.226.translation: "The gopīs there are also goddesses of fortune, and they surpass the goddess of fortune who abides in Vaikuṇṭha. In Vṛndāvana, Lord Kṛṣṇa is always playing His transcendental flute, which is His dear companion.

lines: kathā gānaṁ nāṭyaṁ gamanam api vaṁśī priya-sakhī
cid-ānandaṁ jyotiḥ param api tad āsvādyam api ca
devanagari: श्रियः कान्ताः कान्तः परम - पुरुषः कल्प - तरवो द्रुमा भूमिश्चिन्तामणि - गण - मयी तोयममृतम् ।
कथा गा नं नाट्यं गमनमपि वंशी प्रिय - सखी चिदानन्दं ज्योतिः परमपि तदास्वाद्यमपि च ॥227॥
cc-madhya-14.227.translation: “ 'The damsels of Vṛndāvana, the gopīs, are super goddesses of fortune. The enjoyer in Vṛndāvana is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa. The trees there are all wish-fulfilling trees, and the land is made of transcendental touchstone. The water is all nectar, the talking is singing, the walking is dancing, and the constant companion of Kṛṣṇa is His flute. The effulgence of transcendental bliss is experienced everywhere. Therefore Vṛndāvana-dhāma is the only relishable abode.'

devanagari: चिन्तामणिश्चरण - भूषणमङ्गनानां शृङ्गार - पुष्प - तरवस्तरवः सुराणाम् ।
वृन्दावने व्रज - धनं ननु काम - धेनु - वृन्दानि चेति सुख - सिन्धुरहो विभूतिः ॥228॥
cc-madhya-14.228.translation: “ 'The anklets on the damsels of Vraja-bhūmi are made of cintāmaṇi stone. The trees are wish-fulfilling trees, and they produce flowers with which the gopīs decorate themselves. There are also wish-fulfilling cows [kāma dhenus], which deliver unlimited quantities of milk. These cows constitute the wealth of Vṛndāvana. Thus Vṛndāvana's opulence is blissfully exhibited.' "

devanagari: शुनि’ प्रेमावेशे नृत्य करे श्रीनिवास ।
कक्ष - तालि बाजाय, करे अट्ट - अट्ट हास ॥229॥
cc-madhya-14.229.translation: Śrīvāsa then began to dance in ecstatic love. He vibrated sounds by slapping his armpits with the palms of his hands, and he laughed very loudly.

devanagari: मध्याह्न करिला प्रभु लञा भक्त - गण ।
वाणीनाथ प्रसाद लञा कैल आगमन ॥23॥
cc-madhya-14.23.translation: After this, Vāṇīnātha Rāya brought all kinds of prasāda, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted lunch with the devotees.

devanagari: राधार शुद्ध - रस प्रभु आवेशे शुनिल ।
सेइ रसावेशे प्रभु नृत्य आरम्भिल ॥230॥
cc-madhya-14.230.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these discussions about the pure transcendental mellow of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. Absorbed in transcendental ecstasy, the Lord began to dance.

devanagari: रसावेशे प्रभुर नृत्य, स्वरूपेर गान ।
‘बल’ ‘बल’ बलि’ प्रभु पाते निज - काण ॥231॥
cc-madhya-14.231.translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing in ecstatic love and Svarūpa Dāmodara was singing, the Lord said, "Go on singing! Go on singing!" The Lord then extended His own ears.

devanagari: व्रज - रस - गीत शुनि’ प्रेम उथलिल ।
पुरुषोत्तम - ग्राम प्रभु प्रेमे भासाइल ॥232॥
cc-madhya-14.232.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic love was awakened by hearing the songs of Vṛndāvana. In this way He inundated Puruṣottama, Jagannātha Purī, with love of Godhead.

lines: prabhu nṛtya kare, haila tṛtīya prahara
devanagari: लक्ष्मी देवी यथा - काले गेला निज - घर ।
प्रभु नृत्य करे, हैल तृतीय प्रहर ॥233॥
cc-madhya-14.233.translation: Finally the goddess of fortune returned to her apartment. In due course of time, as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing, afternoon arrived.

lines: cāri sampradāya gāna kari' bahu śrānta haila
devanagari: चारि सम्प्रदाय गान करि’ बहु श्रान्त हैल ।
महाप्रभुर प्रेमावेश द्विगुण बाड़िल ॥234॥
cc-madhya-14.234.translation: After much singing, all four saṅkīrtana parties grew fatigued, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic love increased twofold.

devanagari: राधा - प्रेमावेशे प्रभु हैला सेइ मूर्ति ।
नित्यानन्द दूरे देखि’ करिलेन स्तुति ॥235॥
cc-madhya-14.235.translation: While dancing absorbed in Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's ecstatic love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu appeared in Her very form. Seeing this from a distant place, Nityānanda Prabhu offered prayers.

lines: nikaṭe nā āise, rahe kichu dūra-deśa
devanagari: नित्यानन्द देखिया प्रभुर भावावेश ।
निकटे ना आइसे, रहे किछु दूर - देश ॥236॥
cc-madhya-14.236.translation: Seeing the ecstatic love of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Nityānanda Prabhu did not approach but remained a little distance away.

lines: nityānanda vinā prabhuke dhare kon jana
prabhura āveśa nā yāya, nā rahe kīrtana
devanagari: नित्या नन्द विना प्रभुके धरे कोन्जन ।
प्रभुर आवेश ना झाय, ना रहे कीर्तन ॥237॥
cc-madhya-14.237.translation: Only Nityānanda Prabhu could catch Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but the ecstatic mood of the Lord would not stop. At the same time, kīrtana could not be continued.

lines: bhaṅgi kari' svarūpa sabāra śrama jānāila
bhakta-gaṇera śrama dekhi' prabhura bāhya haila
devanagari: भङ्गि करि’ स्वरूप सबार श्रम जानाइल ।
भक्त - गणेर श्रम देखि’ प्रभुर बाह्य हैल ॥238॥
cc-madhya-14.238.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara then informed the Lord that all the devotees were fatigued. Seeing this situation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came to His external senses.

lines: saba bhakta lañā prabhu gelā puṣpodyāne
devanagari: सब भक्त लञा प्रभु गेला पुष्पोद्याने ।
विश्राम करिया कैला माध्याह्निक स्नाने ॥239॥
cc-madhya-14.239.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then entered the flower garden with all His devotees. After resting there for some time, He finished His afternoon bath.

devanagari: सार्वभौम - रामानन्द - वाणीनाथे दिया ।
प्रसाद पाठा’ल राजा बहुत करिया ॥24॥
cc-madhya-14.24.translation: The King also sent a large quantity of prasāda through Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Rāmānanda Rāya and Vāṇīnātha Rāya.

devanagari: जगन्नाथेर प्र साद आइल बहु उपहार ।
लक्ष्मीर प्रसाद आइल विविध प्रकार ॥240॥
cc-madhya-14.240.translation: Then there arrived in large quantities a variety of food that had been offered to Śrī Jagannātha and a variety that had been offered to the goddess of fortune.

lines: sandhyā snāna kari' kaila jagannātha daraśana
devanagari: सबा लञा नाना - रङ्गे करिला भोजन ।
सन्ध्या स्नान करि’ कैल जगन्नाथ दरशन ॥241॥
cc-madhya-14.241.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu finished His afternoon lunch, and after His evening bath, He went to see Lord Jagannātha.

devanagari: जगन्नाथ देखि’ करेन नर्तन - कीर्तन ।
नरेन्द्रे जल - क्रीड़ा करे लञा भक्त - गण ॥242॥
cc-madhya-14.242.translation: As soon as He saw Lord Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to chant and dance. Afterward, accompanied by His devotees, the Lord enjoyed sporting in the lake called Narendra-sarovara.

devanagari: उद्याने आसिया कैल वन - भोजन ।
एइ - मत क्रीड़ा कैल प्रभु अष्ट - दिन ॥243॥
cc-madhya-14.243.translation: Then, entering the flower garden, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took His meal. In this way He continuously performed all kinds of pastimes for eight days.

devanagari: आर दिने जगन्नाथेर भितर - विजय ।
रथे चड़ि’ जगन्नाथ चले निजालय ॥244॥
cc-madhya-14.244.translation: The next day Lord Jagannātha came out from the temple and, riding on the car, returned to His own abode.

devanagari: पूर्ववत्कैल प्रभु लञा भक्त - गण ।
परम आनन्दे करेन नर्तन - कीर्तन ॥245॥
cc-madhya-14.245.translation: As previously, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees again chanted and danced with great pleasure.

lines: eka guṭi paṭṭa-ḍorī tāṅhā ṭuṭi' gela
devanagari: जगन्नाथेर पुनः पाण्डु - विजय हइल ।
एक गुटि पट्ट - डोरी ताँहा टुटि’ गेल ॥246॥
cc-madhya-14.246.translation: During the Pāṇḍu-vijaya, Lord Jagannātha was carried, and while He was being carried, a bunch of silken ropes broke.

devanagari: पाण्डु - विजयेर तुलि फाटि - फुटि याय ।
जगन्नाथेर भरे तुला उड़िया पलाय ॥247॥
cc-madhya-14.247.translation: When the Jagannātha Deity is carried, at intervals He is placed on cotton pads. When the ropes broke, the cotton pads also broke due to the weight of Lord Jagannātha, and the cotton floated in the air.

lines: tāṅre ājñā dila prabhu kariyā sammāna
devanagari: कुलीन - ग्रामी रामानन्द, सत्यराज खाँन ।
ताँरे आज्ञा दिल प्रभु करिया सम्मान ॥248॥
cc-madhya-14.248.translation: Rāmānanda and Satyarāja Khān were present from Kulīna-grāma, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, with great respect, gave them the following orders.

devanagari: एइ पट्ट - डोरीर तुमि हओ यजमान ।
प्रति - वत्सर आनिबे ‘डोरी’ करिया निर्माण ॥249॥
cc-madhya-14.249.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Rāmānanda and Satyarāja Khān to become the worshipers of these ropes and every year bring silken ropes from their village.

devanagari: ‘बलगण्डि भोगेर प्रसाद - उत्तम, अनन्त ।
‘नि - सकड़ि’ प्रसाद आइल, यार नाहि अन्त ॥25॥
cc-madhya-14.25.translation: The prasāda sent by the King had been offered at the Balagaṇḍi festival and included uncooked milk products and fruits. It was all of the finest quality, and there was no end to the variety.

lines: eta bali' dila tāṅre chiṇḍā paṭṭa-ḍorī
ihā dekhi' karibe ḍorī ati dṛḍha kari'
devanagari: एत बलि’ दिल ताँरे छिण्डा पट्ट - डोरी ।
इहा देखि’ करिबे डोरी अति दृढ़ करि’ ॥250॥
cc-madhya-14.250.translation: After telling them this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed them the broken silken ropes, saying, "Just look at this sample. You must make ropes that are much stronger."

devanagari: एइ पट्ट - डोरीते हय ‘शेष’ - अधिष्ठान ।
दश - मूर्ति हञा येंहो सेवे भगवान् ॥251॥
cc-madhya-14.251.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then informed Rāmānanda and Satyarāja Khān that this rope was the abode of Lord Śeṣa, who expands Himself into ten forms and serves the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

devanagari: भाग्यवान्सत्यराज वसु रामानन्द ।
सेवा - आज्ञा पा ञा हैल परम - आनन्द ॥252॥
cc-madhya-14.252.translation: After receiving orders from the Lord for the rendering of service, the fortunate Satyarāja and Rāmānanda Vasu were highly pleased.

lines: paṭṭa-ḍorī lañā āise ati baḍa raṅge
devanagari: प्रति वत्सर गुण्डिचाते भक्त - गण - सङ्गे ।
पट्ट - डोरी लञा आइसे अति बड़ रङ्गे ॥253॥
cc-madhya-14.253.translation: Every year thereafter, when the Guṇḍicā temple was being cleansed, Satyarāja and Rāmānanda Vasu would come with other devotees and with great pleasure bring silken rope.

devanagari: तबे जगन्नाथ याइ’ वसिला सिंहासने ।
महाप्रभु घरे आइला लञा भक्त - गणे ॥254॥
cc-madhya-14.254.translation: Thus Lord Jagannātha returned to His temple and sat on His throne while Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence with His devotees.

devanagari: एइ - मत भक्त - गणे यात्रा देखाइल ।
भक्त - गण लञा वृन्दावन - केलि कैल ॥255॥
cc-madhya-14.255.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed the Ratha-yātrā ceremony to His devotees and performed the Vṛndāvana pastimes with them.

devanagari: चैतन्य गोसाञि र लीला - अनन्त, अपार ।
‘सहस्त्र - वदन’ यार नाहि पाय पार ॥256॥
cc-madhya-14.256.translation: The pastimes of Lord Caitanya are unlimited and endless. Even Sahasravadana, Lord Śeṣa, cannot reach the limits of His pastimes.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥257॥
cc-madhya-14.257.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: chānā, pānā, paiḍa, āmra, nārikela, kāṅṭhāla
devanagari: छाना, पाना, पैड़, आम्र, नारिकेल, काँठाल ।
नाना - विध कदलक, आर बीज - ताल ॥26॥
cc-madhya-14.26.translation: There was curd, fruit juice, coconut, mango, dried coconut, jackfruit, various kinds of bananas and palm fruit seeds.

devanagari: नारङ्ग, छोलङ्ग, टाबा, कमला, बीज - पूर।
बादाम, छोहारा, द्राक्षा, पिण्ड - खर्जुर ॥27॥
cc-madhya-14.27.translation: There were also oranges, grapefruit, tangerines, almonds, dried fruit, raisins and dates.

devanagari: मनोहरा - लाड़ आदि शतेक प्रकार ।
अमृत - गुटिका - आदि, क्षीरसा अपार ॥28॥
cc-madhya-14.28.translation: There were hundreds of different types of sweetmeats like manoharā-lāḍu, sweets like amṛta-guṭikā and various types of condensed milk.

devanagari: अमृत - मण्डा, सरवती, आर कुम्ड़ा - कुरी ।
सरामृत, सरभाजा, आर सरपुरी ॥29॥
cc-madhya-14.29.translation: There were also papayas and saravatī, a type of orange, and also crushed squash. There was also regular cream, fried cream and a type of purī made with cream.

devanagari: जय जय श्रीवासादि गौर - भक्त - गण ।
जय श्रोता - गण, - याँर गौर प्राण - धन ॥3॥
cc-madhya-14.3.translation: All glories to all the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura! All glories to the readers who have taken Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as their life and soul.

devanagari: हरि - वल्लभ, सेडोति, कर्पूर, मालती ।
डालिमा मरिच - लाडू, नवात, अमृति ॥30॥
cc-madhya-14.30.translation: There were also sweets like hari-vallabha and sweets made of seṅoti flowers, karpūra flowers and mālatī flowers. There were pomegranates, sweets made with black pepper, sweets made with fused sugar, and amṛti-jilipi.

devanagari: पद्मचिनि, चन्द्रका न्ति, खाजा, खण्डसार ।
वियरि, कह्मा, तिलाखाजार प्रकार ॥31॥
cc-madhya-14.31.translation: There was lotus flower sugar, a kind of bread made from urad dahl, crispy sweetmeats, sugar candy, fried rice sweets, sesame seed sweets and cookies made from sesame seeds.

devanagari: नारङ्ग - छोलङ्ग - आम्र - वृक्षेर आकार ।
फुल - फल - पत्र - युक्त खण्डेर विकार ॥32॥
cc-madhya-14.32.translation: There were sweetmeats made from sugarcane candy in the form of oranges, lemons and mangoes along with fruits, flowers and leaves.

lines: dadhi, dugdha, nanī, takra, rasālā, śikhariṇī
devanagari: दधि, दुग्ध, ननी, तक्र, रसाला, शिखरिणी ।
स - लवण मुद्गाङ्कर, आदा खानि खानि ॥33॥
cc-madhya-14.33.translation: There was yogurt, milk, butter, buttermilk, fruit juice, a preparation made of fried yogurt and sugar candy, and salty mung dahl sprouts with shredded ginger.

lines: likhite nā pāri prasāda kateka prakāra
devanagari: लेम्बु - कुल - आदि नाना - प्रकार आचार ।
लिखिते ना पारि प्रसाद कतेक प्रकार ॥34॥
cc-madhya-14.34.translation: There were also various types of pickles-lemon pickle, berry pickle and so on. Indeed, I am not able to describe the variety of food offered to Lord Jagannātha.

devanagari: प्रसादे पूरित हइल अर्ध उपवन ।
देखिया सन्तोष हैल महाप्रभुर मन ॥35॥
cc-madhya-14.35.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw half the garden filled with a variety of prasāda, He was very satisfied.

devanagari: एइ - मत जगन्नाथ करेन भोजन ।
एइ सुखे महाप्रभुर जुड़ाय नयन ॥36॥
cc-madhya-14.36.translation: Indeed, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was fully satisfied just to see how Lord Jagannātha accepted all the food.

lines: eka eka jane daśa donā dila,-eta pāta
devanagari: केया - पत्र - द्रोणी आइल बोझा पाँच - सात ।
एक एक जने दश दोना दिल , - एत पात ॥37॥
cc-madhya-14.37.translation: There then arrived five or seven loads of plates made of the leaves of the ketakī tree. Each man was supplied ten of these plates, and in this way the dishes were served.

devanagari: कीर्तनीयार परिश्रम जानि’ गौरराय ।
ताँ - सबारे खाओयाइते प्रभुर मन धाय ॥38॥
cc-madhya-14.38.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu understood the labor of all the kīrtana chanters; therefore He was very eager to feed them sumptuously.

devanagari: पाँति पाँति करि’ भक्त - गणे वसाइला ।
परिवेशन करिबारे आपने लागिला ॥39॥
cc-madhya-14.39.translation: All the devotees sat down in lines, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally began to distribute the prasāda.

devanagari: एइ - मत प्रभु आछेन प्रेमेर आवेशे ।
हेन - काले प्रतापरुद्र करिल प्रवेशे ॥4॥
cc-madhya-14.4.translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was resting in ecstatic love, Mahārāja Pratāparudra entered the garden.

lines: prabhu nā khāile, keha nā kare bhojana
devanagari: प्रभु ना खाइले, केह ना करे भोजन ।
स्वरूप - गोसाञि तबे कैल निवेदन ॥40॥
cc-madhya-14.40.translation: However, the devotees could not accept the prasāda until Caitanya Mahāprabhu took it. It was Svarūpa Gosvāmī who informed the Lord of this.

lines: tumi nā khāile, keha nā pāre khāite
devanagari: आपने वैस, प्रभु, भोजन करते ।
तुमि ना खाइले, केह ना पारे खाइते ॥41॥
cc-madhya-14.41.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "My Lord, would You please sit down. No one will eat until You do."

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु वैसे निज - गण ल ञा ।
भोजन कराइल सबाके आकण्ठ पूरिया ॥42॥
cc-madhya-14.42.translation: At that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat down with His personal associates and fed everyone of them very sumptuously until they were filled to the necks.

lines: bhojana kari' vasilā prabhu kari' ācamana
devanagari: भोजन करि’ वसिला प्रभु करि’ आचमन ।
प्रसाद उबरिल, खाय सहस्त्रेक जन ॥43॥
cc-madhya-14.43.translation: After finishing, the Lord washed His mouth and sat down. There was so much extra prasāda that it was distributed to thousands.

devanagari: प्रभुर आज्ञाय गोविन्द दीन - हीन जने ।
दुःखी काङ्गाल आनि’ कराय भोजने ॥44॥
cc-madhya-14.44.translation: Following the orders of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Govinda, His personal servant, called for all the poor beggars, who were unhappy due to their poverty, and fed them sumptuously.

devanagari: काङ्गालेर भोजन - रङ्ग देखे गौरहरि ।
‘हरि - बोल’ बलि’ तारे उपदेश करि ॥45॥
cc-madhya-14.45.translation: Observing the beggars eating prasāda, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chanted, "Hari bol!" and instructed them to chant the holy name.

devanagari: ‘हरि - बोल’ बलि’ काङ्गाल प्रेमे भासि’ याय ।
ऐछन अद्भुत लीला करे गौरराय ॥46॥
cc-madhya-14.46.translation: As soon as the beggars chanted the holy name, "Hari bol," they were immediately absorbed in ecstatic love of Godhead. In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed wonderful pastimes.

lines: gauḍa saba ratha ṭāne, āge nāhi yāya
devanagari: इहाँ जगन्नाथेर रथ - चलन - समय ।
गौड सब रथ टाने, आगे नाहि याय ॥47॥
cc-madhya-14.47.translation: Outside the garden, when it was time to pull Jagannātha's car, all the workers called gauḍas tried to pull it, but it would not move forward.

lines: ṭānite nā pāre gauḍa, ratha chāḍi' dila
pātra-mitra lañā rājā vyagra hañā āila
devanagari: टानिते ना पारे गौड़, रथ छाड़ि’ दिल ।
पात्र - मित्र लञा राजा व्यग्र ह ञा आइल ॥48॥
cc-madhya-14.48.translation: When the gauḍas saw that they could not budge the car, they abandoned the attempt. Then the King arrived in great anxiety, and he was accompanied by his officers and friends.

lines: āpane lāgilā ratha, nā pāre ṭānite
devanagari: महा - मल्ल - गणे दिल रथ चालाइते ।
आपने लागिला रथ, ना पारे टानिते ॥49॥
cc-madhya-14.49.translation: The King then arranged for big wrestlers to try to pull the car, and even the King himself joined in, but the car could not be moved.

devanagari: सार्वभौम - उपदेशे छाड़ि’ राज - वेश ।
एकला वैष्णव - वेशे करिल प्रवेश ॥5॥
cc-madhya-14.5.translation: Following Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya's instructions, the King had given up his royal dress. He now entered the garden in the dress of a Vaiṣṇava.

devanagari: व्यग्र ह ञा आने राजा मत्त - हाती - गण ।
रथ चालाइते रथे करिल योजन ॥50॥
cc-madhya-14.50.translation: Becoming even more eager to move the car, the King had very strong elephants brought forth and harnessed to it.

lines: eka pada nā cale ratha, ha-ila acala
devanagari: मत्त - हस्ति - गण टाने यार व्रत बल ।
एक पद ना चले रथ, हइल अचल ॥51॥
cc-madhya-14.51.translation: The strong elephants pulled with all their strength, but still the car remained at a standstill, not budging an inch.

devanagari: शुनि’ महाप्रभु आइला निज - गण लञा ।
मत्त - हस्ती रथ टाने , - देखे दाण्डा ञा ॥52॥
cc-madhya-14.52.translation: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this news, He went there with all His personal associates. They then stood there and watched the elephants try to pull the car.

lines: ratha nāhi cale, loke kare hāhākāra
devanagari: अङ्कुशेर घाय हस्ती करये चित्कार ।
रथ नाहि चले, लोके करे हाहाकार ॥53॥
cc-madhya-14.53.translation: The elephants, being beaten by the elephant-goad, were crying, but still the car would not move. The assembled people cried out, "Alas!"

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु सब हस्ती घुचाइल ।
निज - गणे रथ - काछि टानिबारे दिल ॥54॥
cc-madhya-14.54.translation: At that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu let all the elephants go free and placed the car's ropes in the hands of His own men.

lines: āpane rathera pāche ṭhele māthā diyā
haḍ haḍ kari, ratha calila dhāiyā
devanagari: आपने रथेर पाछे ठेले माथा दिया ।
हड् हड् करि, रथ चलिल धाइया ॥55॥
cc-madhya-14.55.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then went to the back of the car and began to push with His head. It was then that the car began to move and ramble along, making a rattling sound.

lines: bhakta-gaṇa kāchi hāte kari' mātra dhāya
āpane calila ratha, ṭānite nā pāya
devanagari: भक्त - गण काछि हाते करि’ मात्र धाय ।
आपने चलिल रथ, टानिते ना पाय ॥56॥
cc-madhya-14.56.translation: Indeed, the car began to move automatically, and the devotees simply carried the rope in their hands. Since it was moving effortlessly, they did not need to pull it.

devanagari: आनन्दे करये लोक ‘जय’ ‘जय’ - ध्वनि ।
‘जय जगन्नाथ’ बइ आर नाहि शुनि ॥57॥
cc-madhya-14.57.translation: When the car moved forward, everyone began to chant with great pleasure, "All glories! All glories!" and "All glories to Lord Jagannātha!" No one could hear anything else.

lines: nimeṣe ta' gela ratha guṇḍicāra dvāra
devanagari: निमेषे त’ गेल रथ गुण्डिचार द्वार।
चैतन्य - प्रताप देखि’ लोके चमत्कार ॥58॥
cc-madhya-14.58.translation: In a moment the car reached the door of the Guṇḍicā temple. Upon seeing the uncommon strength of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the people were struck with wonder.

devanagari: ‘जय गौरचन्द्र’, ‘जय श्री कृष्ण - चैतन्य’ ।
एइ - मत कोलाहल लोके धन्य धन्य ॥59॥
cc-madhya-14.59.translation: The crowd made a tumultuous vibration, chanting, "Jaya Gauracandra! Jaya Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya!" Then the people began to chant, "Wonderful! Wonderful!"

devanagari: सब - भक्तेर आज्ञा निल योड़ - हात ह ञा ।
प्रभु - पद धरि’ पड़े साहस करिया ॥6॥
cc-madhya-14.6.translation: Mahārāja Pratāparudra was so humble that with folded hands he first took permission from all the devotees. Then, with great courage, he fell down and touched the lotus feet of the Lord.

lines: prabhura mahimā dekhi' preme phule aṅge
devanagari: देखिया प्रतापरुद्र पात्र - मित्र - सङ्गे ।
प्रभुर महिमा देखि’ प्रेमे फुले अङ्गे ॥60॥
cc-madhya-14.60.translation: Seeing the greatness of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Pratāparudra Mahārāja and his ministers and friends were so moved by ecstatic love that their hair stood on end.

devanagari: पाण्डु - विजय तबे करे सेवक - गणे ।
जगन्नाथ वसिला गिया निज - सिंहासने ॥61॥
cc-madhya-14.61.translation: All the servants of Lord Jagannātha then took Him down from the car, and the Lord went to sit on His throne.

devanagari: सुभद्रा - बलराम निज - सिंहासने आइला ।
जगन्नाथेर स्नान - भोग हइते लागिला ॥62॥
cc-madhya-14.62.translation: Subhadrā and Balarāma also sat on their respective thrones. There followed the bathing of Lord Jagannātha and finally the offering of food.

devanagari: आङ्गिनाते महाप्रभु लञा भक्त - गण ।
आनन्दे आरम्भ कैल नर्तन - कीर्तन ॥63॥
cc-madhya-14.63.translation: While Lord Jagannātha, Lord Balarāma and Subhadrā sat on their respective thrones, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees began to perform saṅkīrtana with great pleasure, chanting and dancing in the yard of the temple.

devanagari: आनन्दे महाप्र भुर प्रेम उथलिल ।
देखि’ सब लोक प्रेम - सागरे भासिल ॥64॥
cc-madhya-14.64.translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was chanting and dancing, He was overwhelmed with ecstatic love, and all the people who saw Him were also flooded in the ocean of love of Godhead.

devanagari: नृत्य करि’ सन्ध्या - काले आरति देखिल ।
आइटोटा आसि’ प्रभु विश्राम करिल ॥65॥
cc-madhya-14.65.translation: In the evening, after finishing His dancing in the yard of the Guṇḍicā temple, the Lord observed the ārati ceremony. Thereafter He went to a place called Āiṭoṭā and took rest for the night.

lines: mukhya mukhya nava jana nava dina pāila
devanagari: अद्वैतादि भक्त - गण निमन्त्रण कैल ।
मुख्य मुख्य नव जन नव दिन पाइल ॥66॥
cc-madhya-14.66.translation: For nine days, nine chief devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, got an opportunity to invite the Lord to their homes.

lines: eka eka dina kari' karila baṇṭana
devanagari: आर भक्त - गण चातुर्मास्ये यत दिन ।
एक एक दिन करि’ करिल वण्टन ॥67॥
cc-madhya-14.67.translation: During the four months of the rainy season, the remaining devotees extended invitations to the Lord for one day each. In this way they shared invitations.

lines: cāri māsera dina mukhya-bhakta bāṅṭi' nila
devanagari: चारि मासेर दिन मुख्य - भक्त बाँ टि’ निल ।
आर भक्त - गण अवसर ना पाइल ॥68॥
cc-madhya-14.68.translation: For the four-month period, all the daily invitations were shared among the important devotees. The rest of the devotees did not get an opportunity to extend an invitation to the Lord.

lines: eka dina nimantraṇa kare dui-tine mili'
devanagari: एक दिन निमन्त्रण करे दुइ - तिने मि लि’ ।
एइ - मत महाप्रभुर निमन्त्रण - केलि ॥69॥
cc-madhya-14.69.translation: Since they could not get one day each, two or three devotees combined to extend an invitation. These are the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's acceptance of invitations.

lines: āṅkhi mudi' prabhu preme bhūmite śayāna
devanagari: आङ्खि मुदि’ प्रभु प्रेमे भूमिते शयान ।
नृपति नैपुण्ये करे पाद - संवाहन ॥7॥
cc-madhya-14.7.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was lying on the ground with His eyes closed in ecstatic love and emotion, and the King very expertly began to massage His legs.

devanagari: प्रातः - काले स्नान करि’ देखि’ जगन्नाथ ।
सङ्कीर्तने नृत्य करे भक्त - गण साथ ॥70॥
cc-madhya-14.70.translation: After taking His bath early in the morning, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go see Lord Jagannātha in the temple. Then He would perform saṅkīrtana with His devotees.

devanagari: कभु अद्वैते नाचाय, कभु नित्यानन्दे ।
कभु हरिदासे नाचाय, कभु अच्युतानन्दे ॥71॥
cc-madhya-14.71.translation: By chanting and dancing, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu induced Advaita Ācārya to dance. Sometimes He induced Nityānanda, Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Acyutānanda to dance.

devanagari: कभु वक्रेश्वरे, कभु आर भक्त - गणे ।
त्रिसन्ध्या कीर्तन करे गुण्डिचा - प्राङ्गणे ॥72॥
cc-madhya-14.72.translation: Sometimes Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu engaged Vakreśvara and other devotees in chanting and dancing. Three times daily-morning, noon and evening-He would perform saṅkīrtana in the yard of the Guṇḍicā temple.

devanagari: वृन्दावने आइला कृष्ण - एइ प्रभुर ज्ञान ।
कृष्णेर विरह - स्फूर्ति हैल अवसान ॥73॥
cc-madhya-14.73.translation: At this time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt that Lord Kṛṣṇa had returned to Vṛndāvana. Thinking this, His feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa subsided.

lines: ei rase magna prabhu ha-ilā āpane
devanagari: राधा - सङ्गे कृष्ण - लीला - एइ हैल ज्ञाने ।
एइ रसे मग्न प्रभु हइला आपने ॥74॥
cc-madhya-14.74.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was always thinking of the pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, and He remained personally merged in this consciousness.

devanagari: नानोद्याने भक्त - सङ्गे वृन्दावन - लीला ।
‘इन्द्रद्युम्न’ - सरोवरे करे जल - खेला ॥75॥
cc-madhya-14.75.translation: There were many gardens near the Guṇḍicā temple, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees used to perform the pastimes of Vṛndāvana in each of them. In the lake named Indradyumna, He sported in the water.

lines: āpane sakala bhakte siñce jala diyā
devanagari: आपने सकल भक्ते सिञ्चे जल दिया ।
सब भक्त - गण सिञ्चे चौदिके बेड़िया ॥76॥
cc-madhya-14.76.translation: The Lord personally splashed all the devotees with water, and the devotees, surrounding Him on all sides, also splashed the Lord.

lines: kabhu eka maṇḍala, kabhu aneka maṇḍala
devanagari: कभु एक मण्डल, कभु अनेक मण्डल ।
जल - मण्डूक - वाद्ये सबे बाजाय करताल ॥77॥
cc-madhya-14.77.translation: While in the water they sometimes formed a circle and sometimes many circles, and while in the water they used to play cymbals and imitate the croaking of frogs.

lines: keha hāre, keha jine-prabhu kare daraśana
devanagari: दुई - दुई जने मेलि’ करे जल - रण ।
केह हारे, केह जिने - प्रभु करे दरशन ॥78॥
cc-madhya-14.78.translation: Sometimes two would pair off to fight in the water. One would emerge victorious and the other defeated, and the Lord would watch all this fun.

devanagari: अद्वैत - नित्यानन्दे जल - फेलाफेलि ।
आचार्य हारिया पाछे करे गालागालि ॥79॥
cc-madhya-14.79.translation: The first sporting took place between Advaita Ācārya and Nityānanda Prabhu, who threw water upon one another. Advaita Ācārya was defeated, and He later began to rebuke Nityānanda Prabhu, calling Him bad names.

devanagari: रास - लीलार श्लोक पड़ि’ करेन स्तवन ।
“जयति तेऽधिकं” अध्याय करेन पठन ॥8॥
cc-madhya-14.8.translation: The King began to recite verses about the rāsa-līlā from Śrīmad Bhāgavatam. He recited the chapter beginning with the words "jayati te 'dhikam."

devanagari: विद्यानिधिर जल - केलि स्वरूपेर सने ।
गुप्त - दत्ते जल - केलि करे दुइ जने ॥80॥
cc-madhya-14.80.translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara and Vidyānidhi also threw water upon one another, and Murāri Gupta and Vāsudeva Datta also sported in that way.

devanagari: श्रीवास - सहित जल खेले गदाधर ।
राघव - पण्डित सने खेले वक्रेश्वर ॥81॥
cc-madhya-14.81.translation: Another duel took place between Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and Gadādhara Paṇḍita, and yet another between Rāghava Paṇḍita and Vakreśvara Paṇḍita. Thus they all engaged in throwing water.

devanagari: सार्वभौम - सङ्गे खेले रामानन्द - राय ।
गाम्भीर्य गेल दोंहार, हैल शिशु - प्राय ॥82॥
cc-madhya-14.82.translation: Indeed, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya engaged in water sports with Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya, and they both lost their gravity and became like children.

devanagari: महाप्रभु ताँ दोंहार चाञ्चल्य देखिया ।
गोपीनाथाचार्ये किछु कहेन हासिया ॥83॥
cc-madhya-14.83.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the exuberance of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Rāmānanda Rāya, He smiled and spoke to Gopīnātha Ācārya.

devanagari: पण्डित, गम्भीर, दुँहे - प्रामाणिक जन ।
बाल - चाञ्चल्य करे, कराह वर्जन ॥84॥
cc-madhya-14.84.translation: "Tell Bhaṭṭācārya and Rāmānanda Rāya to stop their childish play because they are both learned scholars and very grave and great personalities."

lines: uchalita kare yabe tāra eka bindu
devanagari: गोपीनाथ कहे , - तोमार कृपा - महासिन्धु ।
उछलित करे यबे तार एक बिन्दु ॥85॥
cc-madhya-14.85.translation: Gopīnātha Ācārya replied, "I believe that one drop of the ocean of Your great mercy has swelled up upon them.

devanagari: मेरु - मन्दर - पर्वत डुबाय यथा तथा ।
एइ दुइ - गण्ड - शैल, इहार का कथा ॥86॥
cc-madhya-14.86.translation: "A drop from the ocean of Your mercy can drown great mountains like Sumeru and Mandara. Since these two gentlemen are little hills by comparison, there is no wonder that they are being drowned in the ocean of Your mercy.

devanagari: शुष्क - तकर् - खलि खाइते जन्म गेल याँर ।
ताँरे लीलामृत पियाओ, - ए कृपा तोमार ॥87॥
cc-madhya-14.87.translation: "Logic is like a dry oil cake from which all the oil has been extracted. Bhaṭṭācārya passed his life in eating such dry cakes, but now You have made him drink the nectar of transcendental pastimes. It is certainly Your great mercy upon him."

devanagari: हासि’ महाप्रभु तबे अद्वैते आनिल ।
जलेर उपरे ताँरे शेष - शय्या कैल ॥88॥
cc-madhya-14.88.translation: After Gopīnātha Ācārya finished talking, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu smiled and, calling for Advaita Ācārya, made Him act like the Śeṣa Nāga bed.

devanagari: आपने ताँहार उपर करिल शयन ।
‘शेष - शायी - लीला’ प्रभु कैल प्रकटन ॥89॥
cc-madhya-14.89.translation: Lying down on Advaita Prabhu, who was floating on the water, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu demonstrated the pastime of Śeṣaśāyī Viṣṇu.

lines: 'bala, bala' bali' prabhu bale bāra bāra
devanagari: शुनिते शुनिते प्रभुर सन्तोष अपार ।
‘बल, बल’ बलि’ प्रभु बले बार बार ॥9॥
cc-madhya-14.9.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these verses, He was pleased beyond limits, and He said again and again, "Go on reciting, go on reciting."

devanagari: अद्वैत निज - शक्ति प्रकट करिया ।
महाप्रभु लञा बुले जलेते भासिया ॥90॥
cc-madhya-14.90.translation: Manifesting His personal potency, Advaita Ācārya floated about on the water, carrying Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: एइ - मत जल - क्रीड़ा करि’ कत - क्षण ।
आइटोटा आइला प्रभु लञा भक्त - गण ॥91॥
cc-madhya-14.91.translation: After sporting in the water for some time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His place at Āiṭoṭā, accompanied by His devotees.

lines: purī, bhāratī ādi yata mukhya bhakta-gaṇa
devanagari: पुरी, भारती आदि ग्रत मुख्य भक्त - गण ।
आचार निमन्त्रणे करिला भोजन ॥92॥
cc-madhya-14.92.translation: Paramānanda Purī, Brahmānanda Bhāratī and all the other chief devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took lunch at the invitation of Advaita Ācārya.

devanagari: वाणीनाथ आर यत प्रसाद आनिल ।
महाप्रभुर गणे सेइ प्रसाद खाइल ॥93॥
cc-madhya-14.93.translation: Whatever extra prasāda was brought by Vāṇīnātha Rāya was taken by the other associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: अपराह्ने आसि’ कैल दर्शन, नर्तन ।
निशाते उद्याने आसि’ करिला शयन ॥94॥
cc-madhya-14.94.translation: In the afternoon, the Lord went to the Guṇḍicā temple to visit the Lord and dance. At night He went to the garden to take rest.

lines: āra dina āsi' kaila īśvara daraśana
devanagari: आर दिन आसि’ कैल ईश्वर दरशन ।
प्राङ्गणे नृत्य - गीत कैल कत - क्षण ॥95॥
cc-madhya-14.95.translation: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also went to the temple of Guṇḍicā and saw the Lord. He then chanted and danced in the yard for some time.

devanagari: भक्त - गण - सङ्गे प्रभु उद्याने आसिया ।
वृन्दावन - विहार करे भक्त - गण लञा ॥96॥
cc-madhya-14.96.translation: Accompanied by His devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then went into the garden and enjoyed the pastimes of Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: वृक्ष - वल्ली प्रफुल्लित प्रभुर दरशने ।
भृङ्ग - पिक गाय, वहे शीतल पवने ॥97॥
cc-madhya-14.97.translation: There were multifarious trees and creepers in the garden, and they were all jubilant to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Indeed, the birds were chirping, the bees were buzzing, and a cool breeze was blowing.

devanagari: प्रति - वृक्ष - तले प्रभु करेन नर्तन ।
वासुदेव - दत्त मात्र करेन गायन ॥98॥
cc-madhya-14.98.translation: As Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced beneath each and every tree, Vāsudeva Datta sang alone.

lines: eka eka vṛkṣa-tale eka eka gāna gāya
devanagari: एक एक वृक्ष - तले एक एक गान गाय ।
परम - आवेशे एका नाचे गौरराय ॥99॥
cc-madhya-14.99.translation: As Vāsudeva Datta sang a different song beneath each and every tree, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced there alone in great ecstasy.

devanagari: सार्वभौम - गृहे भुञ्जन्स्व - निन्दकममोघकम् ।
अङ्गी - कुर्वन्स्फुटां चक्रे गौरः स्वां भक्त - वश्यताम् ॥1॥
cc-madhya-15.1.translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was accepting prasāda at the house of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Amogha criticized Him. At that time the Lord also showed how much He was obliged to His devotees.

lines: sei saba lañā prabhu ācārye pūjila
devanagari: पूजा - पात्रे पुष्प - तुलसी शेष ये आछिल ।
सेइ सब लञा प्रभु आचार्ये पूजिल ॥10॥
cc-madhya-15.10.translation: After being worshiped by Advaita Ācārya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would take the dish containing flowers and tulasī and, with whatever paraphernalia remained, would also worship Advaita Ācārya.

lines: ei vākye vikāinu tāṅra vaṁśera hāta
devanagari: “नन्दनन्दन कृष्ण - मोर प्राण - नाथ” ।
एइ वाक्ये विकाइनु ताँर वंशेर हात ॥100॥
cc-madhya-15.100.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, " 'Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja, is my life and soul.' By this statement I am sold into the hands of the descendants of Guṇarāja Khān.

lines: tomāra ki kathā, tomāra grāmera kukkura
sei mora priya, anya-jana rahu dūra
devanagari: तोमार कि कथा, तोमार ग्रामेर कुकुर ।
सेइ मोर प्रिय, अन्य - जन रहु दूर ॥101॥
cc-madhya-15.101.translation: "To say nothing of you, even a dog living in your village is very dear to Me. What, then, to speak of others?"

devanagari: तबे रामानन्द, आर सत्यराज खाँन ।
प्रभुर चरणे किछु कैल निवेदन ॥102॥
cc-madhya-15.102.translation: After this, Rāmānanda Vasu and Satyarāja Khān both submitted questions at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

lines: gṛhastha viṣayī āmi, ki mora sādhane
devanagari: गृहस्थ विषयी आमि, कि मोर साधने ।
श्री - मुखे आज्ञा कर प्रभु - निवेदि चरणे ॥103॥
cc-madhya-15.103.translation: Satyarāja Khān said, "My dear Lord, being a householder and a materialistic man, I do not know the process of advancing in spiritual life. I therefore submit myself unto Your lotus feet and request You to give me orders."

devanagari: प्रभु कहेन, - ’कृष्ण - सेवा’, ‘वैष्णव - सेवन’ ।
‘निरन्तर कर कृष्ण - नाम - सङ्कीर्तन’ ॥104॥
cc-madhya-15.104.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Without cessation continue chanting the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Whenever possible, serve Him and His devotees, the Vaiṣṇavas."

lines: ke vaiṣṇava, kaha tāṅra sāmānya lakṣaṇe
devanagari: सत्यराज बले , - वैष्णव चिनिब केमने ? ।
के वैष्णव, कह ताँर सामान्य लक्षणे ॥105॥
cc-madhya-15.105.translation: Upon hearing this, Satyarāja said, "How can I recognize a Vaiṣṇava? Please let me know what a Vaiṣṇava is. What are his common symptoms?"

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “याँर मुखे शुनि एक - बार ।
कृष्ण - नाम, सेइ पूज्य, - श्रेष्ठ सबाका र” ॥106॥
cc-madhya-15.106.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Whoever chants the holy name of Kṛṣṇa just once is worshipable and is the topmost human being.

lines: nava-vidhā bhakti pūrṇa nāma haite haya
devanagari: “एक कृष्ण - नामे करे सर्व - पाप क्षय ।
नव - विधा भक्ति पूर्ण नाम हैते हय ॥107॥
cc-madhya-15.107.translation: "Simply by chanting the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, one is relieved from all the reactions of a sinful life. One can complete the nine processes of devotional service simply by chanting the holy name.

devanagari: दीक्षा - पुरश्चर्या - विधि अपेक्षा ना करे ।
जिह्वा - स्पर्शे आ - चण्डाल सबारे उद्धारे ॥108॥
cc-madhya-15.108.translation: "One does not have to undergo initiation or execute the activities required before initiation. One simply has to vibrate the holy name with his lips. Thus even a man in the lowest class [caṇḍāla] can be delivered.

devanagari: अनुषङ्ग - फले करे संसारेर क्षय ।
चित्त आकर्षिया कराय कृष्ण प्रेमोदय ॥109॥
cc-madhya-15.109.translation: "By chanting the holy name of the Lord, one dissolves his entanglement in material activities. After this, one becomes very attracted to Kṛṣṇa, and thus dormant love for Kṛṣṇa is awakened.

lines: "yo 'si so 'si namo 'stu te" ei mantra paḍe
devanagari: “योऽसि सोऽसि नमोऽस्तु ते” एइ मन्त्र पड़े।
मुख - वाद्य करि’ प्रभु हासाय आचार्येरे ॥11॥
cc-madhya-15.11.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would worship Advaita Ācārya by chanting the mantra, "Whatever You are, You are—but I offer My respects unto You." In addition, the Lord would make some sounds within His mouth that would make Advaita Ācārya laugh.

lines: no dīkṣāṁ na ca sat-kriyāṁ na ca puraścaryāṁ manāg īkṣate
devanagari: आकृष्टिः कृत - चेतसां सु - मनसामुच्चाटनं चांहसाम् आचण्डालममूक - लोक - सुलभो वश्यश्च मुक्ति - श्रियः ।
नो दीक्षां न च सक्रियां न च पुरश्चर्यां मनागीक्षते मन्त्रोऽयं रसना - स्पृगेव फलति श्री - कृष्ण - नामात्मकः ॥110॥
cc-madhya-15.110.translation: “ 'The holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa is an attractive feature for many saintly, liberal people. It is the annihilator of all sinful reactions and is so powerful that save for the dumb who cannot chant it, it is readily available to everyone, including the lowest type of man, the caṇḍāla. The holy name of Kṛṣṇa is the controller of the opulence of liberation, and it is identical with Kṛṣṇa. Simply by touching the holy name with one's tongue, immediate effects are produced. Chanting the holy name does not depend on initiation, pious activities or the puraścaryā regulative principles generally observed before initiation. The holy name does not wait for all these activities. It is self-sufficient.' "

lines: sei ta' vaiṣṇava, kariha tāṅhāra sammāna"
devanagari: “अतएव याँर मुखे एक कृष्ण - नाम ।
सेइ त’ वैष्णव, करिह ताँहार सम्मान” ॥111॥
cc-madhya-15.111.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then finally advised, "One who is chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra is understood to be a Vaiṣṇava; therefore you should offer all respects to him."

devanagari: खण्डेर मुकुन्द दास, श्री - रघुनन्दन ।
श्री - नरहरि , - एइ मुख्य तिन जन ॥112॥
cc-madhya-15.112.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then turned His attention to three persons-Mukunda dāsa, Raghunandana and Śrī Narahari-inhabitants of the place called Khaṇḍa.

devanagari: मुकुन्द दासेरे पुछे शचीर नन्दन ।
‘तुमि - पिता, पुत्र तोमार - श्री - रघुनन्दन? ॥113॥
cc-madhya-15.113.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of mother Śacī, next asked Mukunda dāsa, "You are the father, and your son is Raghunandana. Is that so?

devanagari: किबा रघुनन्दन - पिता, तुमि - तार तनय ?।
निश्चय करिया कह, याउक संशय’ ॥114॥
cc-madhya-15.114.translation: "Or is Śrīla Raghunandana your father whereas you are his son? Please let Me know the facts so that My doubts will go away."

devanagari: मुकुन्द कहे, - रघुनन्दन मोर ‘पिता’ हय ।
आमि तार ‘पुत्र’, - एइ आमार निश्चय ॥115॥
cc-madhya-15.115.translation: Mukunda replied, "Raghunandana is my father, and I am his son. This is my decision.

devanagari: आमा सबार कृष्ण - भक्ति रघुनन्दन हैते ।
अतएव पिता - रघुनन्दन आमार निश्चिते ॥116॥
cc-madhya-15.116.translation: "All of us have attained devotion to Kṛṣṇa due to Raghunandana. Therefore in my mind he is my father."

lines: yāṅhā haite kṛṣṇa-bhakti sei guru haya"
devanagari: शुनि’ हर्षे कहे प्रभु - “कहिले निश्चय ।
याँहा हैते कृष्ण - भक्ति सेइ गुरु हय” ॥117॥
cc-madhya-15.117.translation: Hearing Mukunda dāsa give this proper decision, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu confirmed it, saying, "Yes, it is correct. One who awakens devotion to Kṛṣṇa is certainly a spiritual master."

lines: bhaktera mahimā prabhu kahite pāya sukha
devanagari: भक्तेर महिमा प्रभु कहिते पाय सुख ।
भक्तेर महिमा कहिते हय पञ्च - मुख ॥118॥
cc-madhya-15.118.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became very happy just to speak of the glories of His devotees. Indeed, when He spoke of their glories, it was as if He had five faces.

lines: nigūḍha nirmala prema, yena dagdha hema
devanagari: भक्त - गणे कहे , - शुन मुकुन्देर प्रेम ।
निगूढ़ निर्मल प्रेम, येन दग्ध हेम ॥119॥
cc-madhya-15.119.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then informed all His devotees, "Please hear about Mukunda's love of Godhead. It is a very deep and pure love and can only be compared with purified gold.

lines: prabhure nimantraṇa kare ācārya bāra bāra
devanagari: एइ - मत अन्योन्ये करेन नमस्कार ।
प्रभुरे निमन्त्रण करे आचार्य बार बार ॥12॥
cc-madhya-15.12.translation: In this way both Advaita Ācārya and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would offer Their respectful obeisances unto one another. Then Advaita Ācārya would extend invitations to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again and again.

devanagari: बाह्ये राज - वैद्य इँहो करे राज - सेवा ।
अन्तरे कृष्ण - प्रेम इँहार जानिबेक केबा ॥120॥
cc-madhya-15.120.translation: "Mukunda dāsa externally appears to be a royal physician engaged in governmental service, but internally he has a deep love for Kṛṣṇa. Who can understand his love?

devanagari: एक दिन म्लेच्छ - राजार उच्च - टुङ्गिते ।
चिकित्सार बा त्कहे ताँहार अग्रेते ॥121॥
cc-madhya-15.121.translation: "One day Mukunda dāsa, the royal physician, was seated with the Mohammedan King on a high platform and was telling the King about medical treatment.

devanagari: हेन - काले एक मयूर - पुच्छेर आड़ानी ।
राज - शिरोपरि धरे एक सेवक आनि’ ॥122॥
cc-madhya-15.122.translation: "While the King and Mukunda dāsa were conversing, a servant brought a fan made of peacock feathers to shade the head of the King from the sun. Consequently he held the fan above the King's head.

devanagari: शिखि - पिच्छ देखि’ मुकुन्द प्रेमाविष्ट हैला ।
अति - उच्च टुङ्गि हैते भूमिते पड़िला ॥123॥
cc-madhya-15.123.translation: "Just by seeing the peacock-feathered fan, Mukunda dāsa became absorbed in ecstatic love of Godhead and fell from the high platform onto the ground.

devanagari: राजार ज्ञान , - राज - वैद्येर हइल मरण ।
आपने नामिया तबे कराइल चेतन ॥124॥
cc-madhya-15.124.translation: "The King, fearing that the royal physician was killed, personally descended and brought him to his consciousness.

lines: rājā bale—vyathā tumi pāile kona ṭhāñi?
devanagari: राजा बले - व्यथा तुमि पाइले कोन ठाञि ? ।
मुकुन्द कहे, - अति - बड़ व्यथा पाइ नाइ ॥125॥
cc-madhya-15.125.translation: "When the King asked Mukunda, 'Where is it paining you?' Mukunda replied, 'I am not very much pained.'

lines: rājā kahe,—mukunda, tumi paḍilā ki lāgi'?
mukunda kahe, rājā, mora vyādhi āche mṛgī
devanagari: राजा कहे , - मुकुन्द, तुमि पड़िला कि लागि’? ।
मुकुन्द कहे, राजा, मोर व्याधि आछे मृगी ॥126॥
cc-madhya-15.126.translation: "The King then inquired, 'Mukunda, why did you fall down?' Mukunda replied, 'My dear King, I have a disease that is like epilepsy.'

devanagari: महा - विदग्ध राजा, सेइ सब जाने ।
मुकुन्देरे हैल ताँर ‘महा - सिद्ध’ - ज्ञाने ॥127॥
cc-madhya-15.127.translation: "Being extraordinarily intelligent, the King could understand the whole affair. In his estimation, Mukunda was a most uncommon, exalted, liberated personality.

devanagari: रघुनन्दन सेवा करे कृष्णेर मन्दिरे ।
द्वारे पुष्करिणी, तार घाटेर उपरे ॥128॥
cc-madhya-15.128-129.translation: "Raghunandana is constantly engaged in serving the temple of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Beside the entrance of the temple is a lake, and on its banks is a kadamba tree, which daily delivers two flowers to be used for Kṛṣṇa's service."

devanagari: आचार्येर निमन्त्रण - आश्चर्य - कथन ।
विस्ता रि’ वणियाछेन दास - वृन्दावन ॥13॥
cc-madhya-15.13.translation: Indeed, Śrī Advaita Ācārya's invitation is another wonderful story. It has been very vividly described by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura.

devanagari: मुकुन्देरे कहे पुनः मधुर वचन ।
‘तोमार कार्य - धर्मे धन - उपार्जन ॥130॥
cc-madhya-15.130.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again spoke to Mukunda with sweet words: "Your duty is to earn both material and spiritual wealth.

lines: kṛṣṇa-sevā vinā iṅhāra anya nāhi mana
devanagari: रघुनन्दनेर कार्य - कृष्णेर सेवन ।
कृष्ण - सेवा विना इँहार अन्य नाहि मन ॥131॥
cc-madhya-15.131.translation: "Furthermore it is the duty of Raghunandana to always engage in Lord Kṛṣṇa's service. He has no other intention but the service of Lord Kṛṣṇa."

lines: ei tina kārya sadā karaha tina jane,
devanagari: नरहरि रहु आमार भक्त - गण - सने, ।
एइ तिन कार्य सदा करह तिन जने’ ॥132॥
cc-madhya-15.132.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then ordered Narahari: "I wish you to remain here with My devotees. In this way the three of you should always execute these three duties for the service of the Lord."

devanagari: सार्वभौम, विद्या - वाचस्पति, - दुइ भाइ ।
दुइ - जने कृपा करि’ कहेन गोसाञि ॥133॥
cc-madhya-15.133.translation: Out of His causeless mercy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave the following directions to the brothers Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Vidyā-vācaspati.

devanagari: ‘दारु’ - जल’ - रूपे कृष्ण प्रकट सम्प्रति ।
‘दरशन’ - ‘स्नाने’ करे जीवेर मुकति ॥134॥
cc-madhya-15.134.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "In this Age of Kali, Kṛṣṇa is manifest in two forms-wood and water. Thus He helps conditioned souls to become liberated by seeing the wood and bathing in the water.

devanagari: ‘दारु - ब्रह्म’ - रूपे - साक्षात्श्री - पुरुषोत्तम ।
भागीरथी हन साक्षात् ‘जल - ब्रह्म’ - सम ॥135॥
cc-madhya-15.135.translation: "Lord Jagannātha is the Supreme Lord Himself in the form of wood, and the River Ganges is the Supreme Lord Himself in the form of water.

devanagari: सार्वभौम, कर ‘दारु - ब्रह्म’ - आराधन ।
वाचस्पति, कर जल - ब्रह्मेर सेवन ॥136॥
cc-madhya-15.136.translation: "Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, you should engage in the worship of Lord Jagannātha Puruṣottama, and Vācaspati should worship mother Ganges."

devanagari: मुरारि - गुप्तेरे प्रभु करि’ आलिङ्गन ।
ताँर भक्ति - निष्ठा कहेन, शुने भक्त - गण ॥137॥
cc-madhya-15.137.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then embraced Murāri Gupta and began to speak about his firm faith in devotional service. This was heard by all the devotees.

lines: pūrve āmi iṅhāre lobhāila bāra bāra
devanagari: पूर्वे आमि इँहारे लोभाइल बार बार ।
परम मधुर, गुप्त, व्रजेन्द्र कुमार ॥138॥
cc-madhya-15.138.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Previously I induced Murāri Gupta again and again to be allured by Lord Kṛṣṇa. I said to him, 'My dear Gupta, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa, Vrajendra-kumāra, is the supreme sweetness.

devanagari: स्वयं भगवान्कृष्ण - सर्वांशी, सर्वाश्रय ।
विशुद्ध - निर्मल - प्रेम, सर्व - रसमय ॥139॥
cc-madhya-15.139.translation: “ 'Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the origin of all incarnations and the source of everything. He is pure transcendental love itself, and He is the reservoir of all pleasure.

lines: punarukti haya, tāhā nā kailuṅ varṇana
devanagari: पुनरुक्ति हय, ताहा ना कैलुँ वर्णन ।
आर भक्त - गण करे प्रभुरे निमन्त्रण ॥14॥
cc-madhya-15.14.translation: Since Advaita Ācārya's invitation has been described by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, I shall not repeat the story. However, I shall say that other devotees also extended invitations to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: सकल - सद्गुण - वृन्द - रत्न - रत्नाकर ।
विदग्ध, चतुर, धीर, रसिक - शेखर ॥140॥
cc-madhya-15.140.translation: “ 'Kṛṣṇa is the reservoir of all transcendental qualities. He is like a mine of gems. He is expert at everything, very intelligent and sober, and He is the summit of all humors.

devanagari: मधुर - चरित्र कृष्णेर मधुर - विलास ।
चातुर्य - वैदग्ध्य करे याँर लीला - रस ॥141॥
cc-madhya-15.141.translation: “ 'His character is very sweet, and His pastimes are melodious. He is expert in intelligence, and thus He enjoys all His pastimes and mellows.'

lines: sei kṛṣṇa bhaja tumi, hao kṛṣṇāśraya
kṛṣṇa vinā anya-upāsanā mane nāhi laya
devanagari: सेइ कृष्ण भज तुमि, हओ कृष्णाश्रय ।
कृष्ण विना अन्य - उपासना मने नाहि लय ॥142॥
cc-madhya-15.142.translation: "I then requested Murāri Gupta, 'Worship Kṛṣṇa and take shelter of Him. But for His service, nothing appeals to the mind.'

lines: āmāra gaurave kichu phiri' gela mana
devanagari: एइ - मत बार बार शुनिया वचन ।
आमार गौरवे किछु फिरि’ गेल मन ॥143॥
cc-madhya-15.143.translation: "In this way, he heard from Me again and again. By My influence, his mind was a little converted.

devanagari: आमारे कहेन , - आमि तोमार किङ्कर ।
तोमार आज्ञाकारी आमि नाहि स्वतन्तर ॥144॥
cc-madhya-15.144.translation: "Murāri Gupta then replied, 'I am Your servant and Your order carrier. I have no independent existence.'

lines: eta bali' ghare gela, cinti' rātri-kāle
devanagari: एत बलि’ घरे गेल, चिन्ति’ रात्रि - काले ।
रघुनाथ - त्याग - चिन्ताय हइल विकले ॥145॥
cc-madhya-15.145.translation: "After this, Murāri Gupta went home and spent the whole night thinking how he would be able to give up the association of Raghunātha, Lord Rāmacandra. Thus he was overwhelmed.

lines: āji rātrye prabhu mora karāha maraṇa
devanagari: केमने छाड़िब रघुनाथेर चरण ।
आजि रात्र्ये प्रभु मोर कराह मरण ॥146॥
cc-madhya-15.146.translation: "Murāri Gupta then began to pray at the lotus feet of Lord Rāmacandra. He prayed that death would come that night because it was not possible for him to give up the service of the lotus feet of Raghunātha.

lines: mane soyāsti nāhi, rātri kaila jāgaraṇa
devanagari: एइ मत सर्व - रात्रि करेन क्रन्दन ।
मने सोयास्ति नाहि, रात्रि कैल जागरण ॥147॥
cc-madhya-15.147.translation: "Thus Murāri Gupta cried the entire night. There was no rest for his mind; therefore he could not sleep but stayed awake the entire night.

devanagari: प्रातः - काले आसि’ मोर धरिल चरण ।
कान्दिते कान्दिते किछु करे निवेदन ॥148॥
cc-madhya-15.148.translation: "In the morning Murāri Gupta came to see Me. Catching hold of My feet and crying, he submitted an appeal.

lines: kāḍhite nā pāri māthā, mane pāi vyathā
devanagari: रघुनाथेर पाय मुञि वेचियाछों माथा ।
काढ़िते ना पारि माथा, मने पाइ व्यथा ॥149॥
cc-madhya-15.149.translation: "Murāri Gupta said, 'I have sold my head to the lotus feet of Raghunātha. I cannot withdraw my head, for that would give me too much pain.

lines: eka eka dina eka eka bhakta-gṛhe mahotsava
