prabhu-saṅge tāhāṅ bhojana kare bhakta saba
devanagari: एक ए क दिन एक एक भक्त - गृहे महोत्सव ।
प्रभु - सङ्गे ताहाँ भोजन करे भक्त सब ॥15॥
cc-madhya-15.15.translation: Every day one devotee after another would invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the other devotees to lunch and would also hold a festival.

lines: tava ājñā-bhaṅga haya, ki karoṅ upāya
devanagari: श्री - रघुनाथ - चरण छाड़ान ना याय ।
तव आज्ञा - भङ्ग हय, कि करों उपाय ॥150॥
cc-madhya-15.150.translation: “ 'It is not possible for me to give up the service of Raghunātha's lotus feet. At the same time, if I do not do so I shall break your order. What can I do?'

lines: tāte more ei kṛpā kara, dayāmaya
tomāra āge mṛtyu ha-uka, yāuka saṁśaya
devanagari: ताते मोरे एइ कृपा कर, दयामय ।
तोमार आगे मृत्यु हउक, याउक संशय ॥151॥
cc-madhya-15.151.translation: "In this way Murāri Gupta appealed to Me, saying, 'Kindly grant me this mercy because You are all-merciful. Let me die before You so that all my doubts will be finished.'

lines: eta śuni' āmi baḍa mane sukha pāiluṅ
devanagari: एत शुनि’ आमि बड़ मने सुख पाइलुँ ।
इँहारे उठा ञा तबे आलिङ्गन कैलुँ ॥152॥
cc-madhya-15.152.translation: "Hearing this, I became very happy. I then raised Murāri Gupta and embraced him.

lines: sādhu sādhu, gupta, tomāra sudṛḍha bhajana
āmāra vacaneha tomāra nā ṭalila mana
devanagari: साधु साधु, गुप्त, तोमार सुदृढ़ भजन ।
आमार वचनेह तोमार ना टलिल मन ॥153॥
cc-madhya-15.153.translation: "I said to him, 'All glories to you, Murāri Gupta! Your method of worship is very firmly fixed-so much so that even upon My request your mind did not turn.

lines: prabhu chāḍāileha, pada chāḍāna nā yāya
devanagari: एइ - मत सेवकेर प्रीति चाहि प्रभु - पाय ।
प्रभु छाड़ाइलेह, पद छाड़ान ना याय ॥154॥
cc-madhya-15.154.translation: “ 'The servitor must have love and affection for the lotus feet of the Lord exactly like this. Even if the Lord wants separation, a devotee cannot abandon the shelter of His lotus feet.

lines: tomāre āgraha āmi kailuṅ bāre bāre
devanagari: एइ - मत तोमार निष्ठा जानिबार तरे ।
तोमारे आग्रह आमि कैलुँ बारे बारे ॥155॥
cc-madhya-15.155.translation: “ 'Just to test your firm faith in your Lord, I requested you again and again to change your worship from Lord Rāmacandra to Kṛṣṇa.'

devanagari: साक्षात् हनुमान्तुमि श्री - राम - किङ्कर ।
तुमि केने छाड़िबे ताँर चरण - कमल ॥156॥
cc-madhya-15.156.translation: "In this way, I congratulated Murāri Gupta, saying, 'Indeed, you are the incarnation of Hanumān. Consequently you are the eternal servant of Lord Rāmacandra. Why should you give up the worship of Lord Rāmacandra and His lotus feet?' "

lines: iṅhāra dainya śuni' mora phāṭaye jīvana
devanagari: सेइ मुरारि - गुप्त एई - मोर प्राण सम ।
इँहार दैन्य शुनि’ मोर फाटये जीवन ॥157॥
cc-madhya-15.157.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "I accept this Murāri Gupta as My life and soul. When I hear of his humility, it perturbs My very life."

devanagari: तबे वासुदेवे प्रभु करि’ आलिङ्गन ।
ताँर गुण कहे हञा सहस्र - वदन ॥158॥
cc-madhya-15.158.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then embraced Vāsudeva Datta and began to speak of his glories as if He had a thousand mouths.

lines: nija-guṇa śuni' datta mane lajjā pāñā
devanagari: निज - गुण शुनि’ दत्त मने लज्जा पाञा ।
निवेदन करे प्रभुर चरणे धरिया ॥159॥
cc-madhya-15.159.translation: When Caitanya Mahāprabhu glorified him, Vāsudeva Datta immediately became very embarrassed and shy. He then submitted himself, touching the Lord's lotus feet.

devanagari: चारि - मास रहिला सबे महाप्रभु - सङ्गे ।
जगन्नाथेर नाना यात्रा देखे महा - रङ्गे ॥16॥
cc-madhya-15.16.translation: All the devotees remained at Jagannātha Purī for four continuous months, and they observed all Lord Jagannātha's festivals with great pleasure.

devanagari: जगत्तारिते प्रभु तोमार अवतार ।
मोर निवेदन एक करह अङ्गीकार ॥160॥
cc-madhya-15.160.translation: Vāsudeva Datta told Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "My dear Lord, You incarnate just to deliver all conditioned souls. I have now one petition, which I wish You would accept.

lines: tumi mana kara, tabe anāyāse haya
devanagari: करिते समर्थ तुमि हओ, दयामय ।
तुमि मन कर, तबे अनायासे हय ॥161॥
cc-madhya-15.161.translation: "My Lord, You are certainly capable of doing whatever You like, and You are indeed merciful. If You so desire, You can very easily do whatever You want.

lines: jīvera duḥkha dekhi' mora hṛdaya bidare
sarva-jīvera pāpa prabhu deha' mora śire
devanagari: जीवेर दुःख देखि’ मोर हृदय विदरे ।
सर्व - जीवेर पाप प्रभु देह’ मोर शिरे ॥162॥
cc-madhya-15.162.translation: "My Lord, my heart breaks to see the sufferings of all conditioned souls; therefore I request You to transfer the karma of their sinful lives upon my head.

lines: jīvera pāpa lañā muñi karoṅ naraka bhoga
devanagari: जीवेर पाप लञा मुञि करों नरक भोग ।
सकल जीवेर, प्रभु, घुचाह भव - रोग ॥163॥
cc-madhya-15.163.translation: "My dear Lord, let me suffer perpetually in a hellish condition, accepting all the sinful reactions of all living entities. Please finish their diseased material life."

devanagari: एत शुनि’ महाप्रभुर चित्त द्रविला ।
अश्रु - कम्प - स्वरभङ्गे कहिते लागिला ॥164॥
cc-madhya-15.164.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard Vāsudeva Datta's statement, His heart became very soft. Tears flowed from His eyes, and He began to tremble. In a faltering voice He spoke as follows.

devanagari: “तोमार विचित्र नहे, तुमि - साक्षात्प्रह्लाद ।
तोमार उपरे कृष्णेर सम्पूर्ण प्रसाद ॥165॥
cc-madhya-15.165.translation: Accepting Vāsudeva Datta as a great devotee, the Lord said, "Such a statement is not at all astonishing because you are the incarnation of Prahlāda Mahārāja. It appears that Lord Kṛṣṇa has bestowed complete mercy upon you. There is no doubt about it.

lines: kṛṣṇa sei satya kare, yei māge bhṛtya
devanagari: कृष्ण सेइ सत्य करे, येइ मागे भृत्य ।
भृत्य - वाञ्छा - पूर्ति विनु नाहि अन्य कृत्य ॥166॥
cc-madhya-15.166.translation: "Whatever a pure devotee wants from his master, Lord Kṛṣṇa doubtlessly grants because He has no duty other than to fulfill the desire of His devotee.

devanagari: ब्रह्माण्ड जीवेर तुमि वाञ्छिले निस्तार ।
विना पाप - भोगे हबे सबार उद्धार ॥167॥
cc-madhya-15.167.translation: "If you desire the deliverance of all living entities within the universe, then all of them can be delivered even without your undergoing the tribulations of sinful activity.

lines: asamartha nahe kṛṣṇa, dhare sarva bala
devanagari: असमर्थ नहे कृष्ण, धरे सर्व बल ।
तोमाके वा केने भुञ्जाइबे पाप - फल? ॥168॥
cc-madhya-15.168.translation: "Kṛṣṇa is not incapable, for He has all potencies. Why would He induce you to suffer the sinful reactions of other living entities?

lines: tumi yāṅra hita vāñcha', se haila 'vaiṣṇava'
vaiṣṇavera pāpa kṛṣṇa dūra kare saba
devanagari: तुमि याँर हित वाञ्छ’, से हैल ‘वैष्णव’ ।
वैष्णवेर पाप कृष्ण दूर करे सब ॥169॥
cc-madhya-15.169.translation: "Whosever welfare you desire immediately becomes a Vaiṣṇava, and Kṛṣṇa delivers all Vaiṣṇavas from the reactions of their past sinful activities.

lines: gopa-veśa hailā prabhu lañā bhakta saba
devanagari: कृष्ण - जन्म - यात्रा - दिने नन्द - महोत्सव ।
गोप - वेश हैला प्रभु लञा भक्त सब ॥17॥
cc-madhya-15.17.translation: The devotees also celebrated the festival of Janmāṣṭamī, Kṛṣṇa's birthday, which is also called Nanda-mahotsava, the festival of Nanda Mahārāja. At that time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees dressed themselves as cowherd boys.

lines: yas tv indra-gopam athavendram aho sva-karma-
devanagari: यस्त्विन्द्र - गोपमथ वेन्द्रमहो स्व - कर्म - बन्धानुरूप - फल - भाजनमातनोति ।
कर्माणि निर्दहति किन्तु च भक्ति - भाजां गोविन्दमादि - पुरुषं तमहं भजामि ॥170॥
cc-madhya-15.170.translation: “ 'Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto the original Personality of Godhead, Govinda, who regulates the sufferings and enjoyments of fruitive activity for everyone-from the heavenly King Indra down to the smallest insect [indra-gopa]. That very Personality of Godhead destroys the fruitive karma of one engaged in devotional service.'

lines: sarva mukta karite kṛṣṇera nāhi kichu śrama
devanagari: तोमार इच्छा - मात्रे हबे ब्रह्माण्ड - मोचन ।
सर्व मुक्त करिते कृष्णेर नाहि किछु श्रम ॥171॥
cc-madhya-15.171.translation: "Because of your honest desire, all living entities within the universe will be delivered, for Kṛṣṇa does not have to do anything to deliver all the living entities of the universe.

lines: koṭi ye brahmāṇḍa bhāse virajāra jale
devanagari: एक उडुम्बर वृक्षे लागे कोटि - फले ।
कोटि ये ब्रह्माण्ड भासे विरजार जले ॥172॥
cc-madhya-15.172.translation: "Just as there are millions of fruits on the uḍumbara tree, millions of universes float on the waters of the river Virajā.

lines: tāra eka phala paḍi' yadi naṣṭa haya
devanagari: तार एक फल पड़ि’ यदि नष्ट हय ।
तथापि वृक्ष नाहि जाने निज - अपचय ॥173॥
cc-madhya-15.173.translation: "The uḍumbara tree is filled with millions of fruits, and if one falls down and is destroyed, the tree does not even consider the loss.

lines: taiche eka brahmāṇḍa yadi mukta haya
tabu alpa-hāni kṛṣṇera mane nāhi laya
devanagari: तैछे एक ब्रह्माण्ड यदि मुक्त हय ।
तबु अल्प - हानि कृष्णेर मने नाहि लय ॥174॥
cc-madhya-15.174.translation: "In the same way, if one universe is vacated due to the living entities' having been liberated, that is a very little thing for Kṛṣṇa. He does not take it very seriously.

devanagari: अनन्त ऐश्वर्य कृष्णेर वैकुण्ठादि - धाम ।
तार गड़ - खाइ - कारणाब्धि यार नाम ॥175॥
cc-madhya-15.175.translation: "The entire spiritual world constitutes the unlimited opulence of Kṛṣṇa, and there are innumerable Vaikuṇṭha planets there. The Causal Ocean is considered the surrounding waters of Vaikuṇṭhaloka.

lines: tāte bhāse māyā lañā ananta brahmāṇḍa
devanagari: ताते भासे माया लञा अनन्त ब्रह्माण्ड ।
गड़ - खाइते भासे येन राइ - पूर्ण भाण्ड ॥176॥
cc-madhya-15.176.translation: "Māyā and her unlimited material universes are situated in that Causal Ocean. Indeed, māyā appears to be floating like a pot filled with mustard seeds.

lines: tāra eka rāi-nāśe hāni nāhi māni
aiche eka aṇḍa-nāśe kṛṣṇera nāhi hāni
devanagari: तार ए क राइ - नाशे हानि नाहि मानि ।
ऐछे ए क अण्ड - नाशे कृष्णेर नाहि हानि ॥177॥
cc-madhya-15.177.translation: "Of the millions of mustard seeds floating in that pot, if one seed is lost, the loss is not at all significant. Similarly, if one universe is lost, it is not significant to Lord Kṛṣṇa.

lines: saba brahmāṇḍa saha yadi 'māyā'ra haya kṣaya
tathāpi nā māne kṛṣṇa kichu apacaya
devanagari: सब ब्रह्माण्ड सह यदि ‘माया’र हय क्षय ।
तथापि ना माने कृष्ण किछु अपचय ॥178॥
cc-madhya-15.178.translation: "To say nothing of one universal mustard seed, even if all the universes and the material energy [māyā] are destroyed, Kṛṣṇa does not even consider the loss.

devanagari: कोटि - कामधेनु - पतिर छागी यैछे मरे ।
षडू - ऐश्वर्य - पति कृष्णेर माया किबा करे? ॥179॥
cc-madhya-15.179.translation: "If a person possessing millions of wish-fulfilling cows loses one she-goat, he does not consider the loss. Kṛṣṇa owns all six opulences in full. If the entire material energy is destroyed, what does He lose?"

devanagari: दधि - दुग्ध - भार सबे निज - स्कन्धे करि’ ।
महोत्सव - स्थाने आइला बलि ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ॥18॥
cc-madhya-15.18.translation: Having dressed up like cowherd boys, all the devotees carried pots of milk and yogurt balanced on rods over their shoulders. Thus they all arrived at the festival grounds chanting the holy name of Hari.

lines: jaya jaya jahy ajām ajita doṣa-gṛbhīta-guṇāṁ
devanagari: जय जय जह्यजामजित दोष - गृभीत - गुणां त्वमसि यदात्मना समवरुद्ध - समस्त - भगः ।
अग - जगदोकसामखिल - शक्त्यवबोधक ते क्वचिदजयात्मना च चरतोऽनुचरेन्निगमः” ॥180॥
cc-madhya-15.180.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, " 'O my Lord, O unconquerable one, O master of all potencies, please exhibit Your internal potency to conquer the nescience of all moving and inert living entities. Due to nescience, they accept all kinds of faulty things, thus provoking a fearful situation. O Lord, please show Your glories! You can do this very easily, for Your internal potency is beyond the external potency, and You are the reservoir of all opulence. You are also the demonstrator of the material potency. You are also always engaged in Your pastimes in the spiritual world. You exhibit Your reserved internal potency and sometimes exhibit the external potency by glancing over it. Thus You manifest Your pastimes. The Vedas confirm Your two potencies and accept both types of pastimes due to them.' "

lines: ei mata sarva-bhaktera kahi' saba guṇa
devanagari: एइ मत सर्व - भक्तेर कहि’ सब गुण ।
सबारे विदाय दिल करि’ आलिङ्गन ॥181॥
cc-madhya-15.181.translation: In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu described the good qualities of His devotees one after the other. He then embraced them and bade them farewell.

lines: bhaktera vicchede prabhura viṣaṇṇa haila mana
devanagari: प्रभुर विच्छेदे भक्त करेन रोदन ।
भक्तेर विच्छेदे प्रभुर विषण्ण हैल मन ॥182॥
cc-madhya-15.182.translation: Due to the impending separation from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the devotees began to cry. The Lord was also morose due to separation from the devotees.

devanagari: गदाधर - पण्डित रहिला प्रभुर पाशे ।
यमेश्वरे प्रभु याँरे कराइला आवासे ॥183॥
cc-madhya-15.183.translation: Gadādhara Paṇḍita remained with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and he was given a place to live at Yameśvara.

devanagari: पुरी - गोसाञि, जगदानन्द, स्वरूप - दामोदर ।
दामोदर - पण्डित, आर गोविन्द, काशीश्वर ॥184॥
cc-madhya-15.184-185.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained at Jagannātha Purī, Nīlācala, with Paramānanda Purī, Jagadānanda, Svarūpa Dāmodara, Dāmodara Paṇḍita, Govinda and Kāśīśvara. It was Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's daily business to see Lord Jagannātha in the morning.

devanagari: प्रभु - पाश आसि’ सार्वभौम एक दिन ।
योड़ - हात करि’ किछु कैल निवेदन ॥186॥
cc-madhya-15.186.translation: One day Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya came before Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with folded hands and submitted a request.

lines: ebe saba vaiṣṇava gauḍa-deśe cali' gela
devanagari: एबे सब वैष्णव गौड़ - देशे चलि’ गेल ।
एबे प्रभुर निमन्त्रणे अवसर हैल ॥187॥
cc-madhya-15.187.translation: Since all the Vaiṣṇavas had returned to Bengal, there was a good chance that the Lord would accept an invitation.

lines: ebe mora ghare bhikṣā karaha 'māsa' bhari'
prabhu kahe,—dharma nahe, karite nā pāri
devanagari: एबे मोर घरे भिक्षा करह ‘मास’ भरि’ ।
प्रभु कहे, - धर्म नहे, करिते ना पारि ॥188॥
cc-madhya-15.188.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya said, "Please accept my invitation for lunch for one month." The Lord replied, "That is not possible because it is against the religious principles of a sannyāsī."

devanagari: सार्वभौम कहे , - भिक्षा करह बिश दिन ।
प्रभु कहे, - एह नहे यति - धर्म - चिह्न ॥189॥
cc-madhya-15.189.translation: Sārvabhauma then said, "Please accept the invitation for twenty days," but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "It is not a religious principle of the renounced order."

devanagari: काना ञि - खुटिया आछेन ‘नन्द’ - वेश धरि’ ।
जगन्नाथ - माहाति हञाछे न ‘व्रजेश्वरी’ ॥19॥
cc-madhya-15.19.translation: Kānāñi Khuṭiyā dressed himself like Nanda Mahārāja, and Jagannātha Māhāti dressed himself as mother Yaśodā.

devanagari: सार्वभौम कहे पुनः, - दिन ‘पञ्च - दश’ ।
प्रभु कहे, - तोमार भिक्षा ‘एक’ दिवस ॥190॥
cc-madhya-15.190.translation: When Sārvabhauma requested Caitanya Mahāprabhu to accept lunch for fifteen days, the Lord said, "I shall accept lunch at your place for one day only."

devanagari: तबे सार्वभौम प्रभुर चरणे धरिया ।
‘दश - दिन भिक्षा क र’ कहे विनति करिया ॥191॥
cc-madhya-15.191.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya then caught hold of the Lord's lotus feet and submissively begged, "Please accept lunch for at least ten days."

devanagari: प्रभु क्रमे क्रमे पाँच - दिन घाटाइल ।
पाँच दिन ताँर भिक्षा नियम करिल ॥192॥
cc-madhya-15.192.translation: In this way, by and by, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu reduced the duration to five days. Thus for five days He regularly accepted the invitation to lunch.

devanagari: तबे सार्वभौम करे आर निवेदन ।
तोमार सङ्गे सन्यासी आछे दश - जन ॥193॥
cc-madhya-15.193.translation: After this, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya said, "My Lord, there are ten sannyāsīs with You."

devanagari: पुरी - गोसाञि र भिक्षा पाँच - दिन मोर घरे ।
पूर्वे आमि कहियाछों तोमार गोचरे ॥194॥
cc-madhya-15.194.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya then submitted that Paramānanda Purī Gosvāmī should accept a five-day invitation at his place. This was settled before the Lord.

lines: kabhu tomāra saṅge yābe, kabhu ekeśvara
devanagari: दामोदर - स्वरूप , - एइ बान्धव आमार ।
कभु तोमार सङ्गे याबे, कभु एकेश्वर ॥195॥
cc-madhya-15.195.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya said, "Dāmodara Svarūpa is my intimate friend. He will come sometimes with You and sometimes alone.

lines: āra aṣṭa sannyāsīra bhikṣā dui dui divase
eka eka-dina, eka eka jane pūrṇa ha-ila māse
devanagari: आर अष्ट स न्यासीर भिक्षा दुइ दुइ दिवसे ।
एक एक - दिन, एक एक जने पूर्ण हइल मासे ॥196॥
cc-madhya-15.196.translation: "The other eight sannyāsīs will accept invitations for two days each. In this way there will be engagements for each and every day during the entire month.

lines: bahuta sannyāsī yadi āise eka ṭhāñi
devanagari: बहुत सन्यासी यदि आइसे एक ठाञि ।
सम्मान करिते नारि, अपराध पाई ॥197॥
cc-madhya-15.197.translation: "If all the sannyāsīs come together, it would not be possible for me to pay them proper respects. Therefore I would be an offender.

devanagari: तुमिह निज - छाये आसिबे मोर घर ।
कभु सङ्गे आसिबेन स्वरूप - दामोदर ॥198॥
cc-madhya-15.198.translation: "Sometimes You will come alone to my place, and sometimes You will be accompanied by Svarūpa Dāmodara."

devanagari: प्रभुर इङ्गित पाञा आनन्दित मन ।
सेइ दिन महाप्रभुर कैल निमन्त्रण ॥199॥
cc-madhya-15.199.translation: Having this arrangement confirmed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Bhaṭṭācārya became very glad and immediately invited the Lord to his house on that very day.

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-madhya-15.2.translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya!

devanagari: आपने प्रतापरुद्र, आर मिश्र - काशी ।
सार्वभौम, आर पड़िछा - पात्र तुलसी ॥20॥
cc-madhya-15.20.translation: At that time, King Pratāparudra was also personally present with Kāśī Miśra, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Tulasī Paḍichāpātra.

devanagari: ‘षाठीर माता’ नाम, भट्टाचा र्येर गृहिणी ।
प्रभुर महा - भक्त तेंहो, स्नेहेते जननी ॥200॥
cc-madhya-15.200.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya's wife was known as the mother of Ṣāṭhī. She was a great devotee of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and she was affectionate like a mother.

lines: ghare āsi' bhaṭṭācārya tāṅre ājñā dila
devanagari: घरे आसि’ भट्टाचार्य ताँरे आज्ञा दिल ।
आनन्दे षाठीर माता पाक चड़ाइल ॥201॥
cc-madhya-15.201.translation: After returning to his home, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya gave orders to his wife, and his wife, known as Ṣāṭhīra Mātā, the mother of Ṣāṭhī, began cooking with great pleasure.

lines: bhaṭṭācāryera gṛhe saba dravya āche bhari'
devanagari: भट्टाचार गृहे सब द्रव्य आछे भरि’ ।
येबा शाक - फलादिक, आनाइल आ हरि’ ॥202॥
cc-madhya-15.202.translation: At Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya's house, there was always a full stock of food. Whatever spinach, vegetables, fruit and so on were required, he collected and brought back home.

lines: āpani bhaṭṭācārya kare pākera saba karma
devanagari: आपनि भट्टाचार्य करे पाकेर सब कर्म ।
षाठीर माता - विचक्षणा, जाने पाक - मर्म ॥203॥
cc-madhya-15.203.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya personally began to help his wife cook. His wife, the mother of Ṣāṭhī, was very experienced, and she knew how to cook nicely.

devanagari: पाक - शालार दक्षिणे - दुइ भोगालय ।
एक - घरे शालग्रामेर भोग - सेवा हय ॥204॥
cc-madhya-15.204.translation: On the southern side of the kitchen were two rooms for offering food, and in one of them the food was offered to Śālagrāma Nārāyaṇa.

devanagari: आर घर महाप्रभुर भिक्षार लागिया ।
निभृते करियाछे भट्ट नूतन करिया ॥205॥
cc-madhya-15.205.translation: The other room was for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's lunch. The Lord's lunch room was very secluded, and it was newly constructed by Bhaṭṭācārya.

lines: bāhye eka dvāra tāra, prabhu praveśite
devanagari: बाह्ये एक द्वार तार, प्रभु प्रवेशिते ।
पाक - शालार एक द्वार अन्न परिवेशिते ॥206॥
cc-madhya-15.206.translation: The room was so constructed that there was only one door as an entrance from the outside for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. There was another door attached to the kitchen, and it was through this door that the food was brought.

devanagari: बत्तिशा - आठिया कलार आङ्गटिया पाते ।
तिन - मान तण्डुलेर उभारिल भाते ॥207॥
cc-madhya-15.207.translation: First, three mānas of cooked rice-almost six pounds-was poured on a big banana leaf.

devanagari: पीत - सुगन्धि - घृते अन्न सिक्त कैल ।
चारि - दिके पाते घृत वहिया चलिल ॥208॥
cc-madhya-15.208.translation: Then, the whole stack of rice was mixed with so much yellowish and fragrant clarified butter that it began to overflow the leaf.

devanagari: केयापत्र - कलाखोला - डोङ्गा सारि सारि ।
चारि - दिके धरियाछे नाना व्यञ्जन भरि’ ॥209॥
cc-madhya-15.209.translation: There were a number of pots made of the bark of banana trees and the leaves of the keyā plant. These pots were filled with various cooked vegetables and placed on all sides of the leaf.

devanagari: इँहा - सबा लञा प्रभु करे नृत्य - रङ्ग ।
दधि - दुग्ध हरिद्रा - जले भरे सबार अङ्ग ॥21॥
cc-madhya-15.21.translation: As usual, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced jubilantly. Everyone was covered with milk, yogurt and yellow turmeric water.

devanagari: दश - प्रकार शाक, निम्ब - तिक्त - सुख्त - झोल ।
मरिचेर झाल, छाना - बड़ा, बड़ि घोल ॥210॥
cc-madhya-15.210.translation: There were about ten kinds of spinach, a soup called sukhta, which was made with bitter nimba leaves, a pungent preparation made with black pepper, a mild cake made of fried curd, and buttermilk mixed with small fried pieces of dhal.

devanagari: दुग्ध - तुम्बी, दुग्ध - कुष्माण्ड, वेसर, लाफ्रा ।
मोचा - घण्ट, मोचा - भाजा, विविध शाक्रा ॥211॥
cc-madhya-15.211.translation: There were preparations of dugdha-tumbī, dugdha-kuṣmāṇḍa, vesara, lāphrā, mocā-ghaṇṭa, mocā-bhājā and other vegetables.

devanagari: वृद्ध - कुष्माण्ड - बड़ीर व्यञ्जन अपार ।
फुलबड़ी - फल - मूल विविध प्रकार ॥212॥
cc-madhya-15.212.translation: There were unlimited quantities of vṛddha-kuṣmāṇḍa-baḍī, phula-baḍī, fruits and various roots.

devanagari: नव - निम्बपत्र - सह भृष्ट - वार्ताकी ।
फुल - बड़ी पटोल - भाजा, कुष्माण्ड - मान - चाकी ॥213॥
cc-madhya-15.213.translation: Other preparations included eggplant mixed with newly grown nimba leaves fried together, light baḍī, fried paṭola, and fried rounds of squash and pumpkin.

devanagari: भृष्ट - माष - मुद्ग - सूप अमृत निन्दय ।
मधुराम्ल, बड़ाम्लादि अम्ल पाँच छय ॥214॥
cc-madhya-15.214.translation: There was a soup made with fried urad dahl and mung dahl, defeating nectar. There were also sweet chutney and five or six kinds of sour preparations, beginning with baḍāmla.

devanagari: मुद्ग - बड़ा, माष - बड़ा, कला - बड़ा मिष्ट ।
क्षीर - पुलि, नारिकेल - पुलि आर यत पिष्ट ॥215॥
cc-madhya-15.215.translation: There were bharats made of mung dahl, of urd dahl and of sweet bananas, and there was sweet rice cake, coconut cake and various other cakes.

lines: āra yata piṭhā kaila, kahite nā śaki
devanagari: काँजि - बड़ा, दुग्ध - चिड़ा, दुग्ध - लक्लकी ।
आर यत पिठा कैल, कहिते ना शकि ॥216॥
cc-madhya-15.216.translation: There was kāṅji-baḍā, dugdha-ciḍā, dugdha-laklakī and various cakes, which I am unable to describe.

devanagari: घृत - सिक्त परमान्न, मृत्कुण्डिका भरि’ ।
चाँपाकला - घनदुग्ध - आम्र ताहा धरि ॥217॥
cc-madhya-15.217.translation: Sweet rice mixed with ghee was poured into an earthen pot and mixed with cāṅpā-kalā, condensed milk and mango.

devanagari: रसाला - मथित दधि, सन्देश अपार ।
गौड़े उत्कले यत भक्ष्येर प्रकार ॥218॥
cc-madhya-15.218.translation: Other preparations included a very delicious churned curd and a variety of sandeśa sweetmeats. Indeed, all the various eatables available in Bengal and Orissa were prepared.

devanagari: श्रद्धा करि’ भट्टाचार्य सब कराइल ।
शुभ्र - पीठोपरि सूक्ष्म वसन पातिल ॥219॥
cc-madhya-15.219.translation: Thus Bhaṭṭācārya prepared a great variety of food and spread a fine cloth over a white wooden platform.

lines: advaita kahe,—satya kahi, nā kariha kopa
laguḍa phirāite pāra, tabe jāni gopa
devanagari: अद्वैत कहे , - सत्य कहि, ना करिह कोप ।
लगुड़ फिराइते पार, तबे जानि गोप ॥22॥
cc-madhya-15.22.translation: It was at this time that Śrīla Advaita Ācārya said, "Please do not be angry. I speak the truth. I shall know whether You are a cowherd boy only if You can wheel this rod about."

devanagari: दुइ पाशे सुगन्धि शीतल जल - झारी ।
अन्न - व्यञ्जनोपरि दिल तुलसी - मञ्जरी ॥220॥
cc-madhya-15.220.translation: On two sides of the stack of food were pitchers filled with scented cold water. The flowers of the tulasī tree were placed above the mound of rice.

devanagari: अमृत - गुटिका, पिठा - पाना आनाइल ।
जगन्नाथ - प्रसाद सब पृथक्धरिल ॥221॥
cc-madhya-15.221.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya also included several types of food that had been offered to Lord Jagannātha. This included sweetballs known as amṛta-guṭikā, sweet rice and cakes. All these were kept separately.

devanagari: हेन - काले महाप्रभु मध्याह्न करिया ।
एकले आइल ताँर हृदय जानिया ॥222॥
cc-madhya-15.222.translation: When everything was ready, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came there alone after finishing His midday duties. He knew the heart of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya.

devanagari: भट्टाचार्य कैल तबे पाद प्रक्षालन ।
घरेर भितरे गेला करिते भोजन ॥223॥
cc-madhya-15.223.translation: After Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya washed the Lord's feet, the Lord entered the room to take His lunch.

devanagari: अन्नादि देखिया प्रभु विस्मित हञा ।
भट्टाचार्ये कहे किछु भङ्गि करिया ॥224॥
cc-madhya-15.224.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was a little astonished to see the gorgeous arrangement, and, gesturing, He spoke to Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya.

lines: dui prahara bhitare kaiche ha-ila randhana?
devanagari: अलौकिक एइ सब अन्न - व्यञ्जन ।
दुइ प्रहर भितरे कैछे हइल रन्धन? ॥225॥
cc-madhya-15.225.translation: "This is most uncommon! How was this arrangement of rice and vegetables finished within six hours?

lines: śata culāya śata jana pāka yadi kare
tabu śīghra eta dravya rāndhite nā pāre
devanagari: शत चुलाय शत जन पाक यदि करे ।
तबु शीघ्र एत द्रव्य रान्धिते ना पारे ॥226॥
cc-madhya-15.226.translation: "Even a hundred men cooking on a hundred ovens could not possibly finish all these preparations within so short a time.

devanagari: कृष्णेर भोग लागाञाछ, - अनुमान करि ।
उपरे देखिये याते तुलसी - मञ्जरी ॥227॥
cc-madhya-15.227.translation: "I hope the food has already been offered to Kṛṣṇa, since I see there are tulasī flowers over the plates.

devanagari: भाग्यवान्तुमि, सफल तोमार उद्योग ।
राधा - कृष्णे लागाञाछ एतादृश भोग ॥228॥
cc-madhya-15.228.translation: "You are most fortunate, and your endeavor is successful, for you have offered such wonderful food to Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: अन्नेर सौरभ्य, वर्ण - अति मनोरम ।
राधा - कृष्ण साक्षातिहाँ करियाछेन भोजन ॥229॥
cc-madhya-15.229.translation: "The color of the rice is so attractive and its aroma so good that it appears Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa have directly taken it.

lines: tabe laguḍa lañā prabhu phirāite lāgilā
bāra bāra ākāśe pheli' luphiyā dharilā
devanagari: तबे लगुड़ लञा प्रभु फिराइते लागिला ।
बार बार आकाशे फेलि’ लुफिया धरिला ॥23॥
cc-madhya-15.23.translation: Accepting Advaita Ācārya's challenge, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took a big rod and began to wheel it around and around. Again and again He threw the rod into the sky and caught it when it fell.

devanagari: तोमार बहुत भाग्य कत प्रशंसिब ।
आमि - भाग्यवान्, इहार अवशेष पाबे ॥230॥
cc-madhya-15.230.translation: "My dear Bhaṭṭācārya, your fortune is very great. How much shall I praise you? I also am very fortunate to be able to take the remnants of this food.

lines: more prasāda deha' bhinna pātrete kariyā
devanagari: कृष्णेर आसन - पीठ राखह उठा ञा ।
मोरे प्रसाद देह’ भिन्न पात्रेते करिया ॥231॥
cc-madhya-15.231.translation: "Take away Kṛṣṇa's sitting place and put it aside. Then give me prasāda on a different plate."

lines: yei khābe, tāṅhāra śaktye bhoga siddha haya
devanagari: भट्टाचार्य बले - प्रभु ना करह विस्मय ।
येइ खाबे, ताँहार शक्त्ये भोग सिद्ध हय ॥232॥
cc-madhya-15.232.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya said, "It is not so wonderful, my Lord. Everything has been made possible by the energy and mercy of He who will eat the food.

lines: udyoga nā chila mora gṛhiṇīra randhane
yāṅra śaktye bhoga siddha, sei tāhā jāne
devanagari: उद्योग ना छिल मोर गृहिणीर रन्धने ।
याँर शक्त्ये भोग सिद्ध, सेइ ताहा जाने ॥233॥
cc-madhya-15.233.translation: "My wife and I did not especially exert ourselves in the cooking. He by whose power the food has been prepared knows everything.

devanagari: एइत आसने वसि’ करह भोजन ।
प्रभु कहे, - पूज्य एई कृष्णेर आसन ॥234॥
cc-madhya-15.234.translation: "Now please sit in this place and take Your lunch." Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "This place is worshipable because it was used by Kṛṣṇa."

lines: anna khābe, pīṭhe vasite kāhāṅ aparādha?
devanagari: भट्ट कहे , - अन्न, पीठ, - समान प्रसाद ।
अन्न खाबे, पीठे वसिते काहाँ अपराध ? ॥235॥
cc-madhya-15.235.translation: Bhaṭṭācārya said, "Both the food and the sitting place are the Lord's mercy. If You can eat the remnants of the food, what is the offense in Your sitting in this place?"

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - भाल कैले, शास्त्र - आज्ञा हय ।
कृष्णेर सकल शेष भृत्य आस्वादय ॥236॥
cc-madhya-15.236.translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "Yes, you have spoken correctly. The śāstras enjoin that the devotee can partake of everything left by Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: त्वयोपयुक्त - स्त्रग्गन्ध - वासोऽलङ्कार - चर्चिताः ।
उच्छिष्ट - भोजिनो दासास्तव मायां जयेम हि ॥237॥
cc-madhya-15.237.translation: “ 'My dear Lord, the garlands, scented substances, garments, ornaments and other such things that have been offered to You may later be used by Your servants. By partaking of these things and eating the remnants of food You have left, we will be able to conquer the illusory energy.' "

lines: tathāpi eteka anna khāona nā yāya
devanagari: तथापि एतेक अन्न खाओन ना याय ।
भट्ट कहे , - जानि, खाओ यतेक युयाय ॥238॥
cc-madhya-15.238.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "There is so much food here that it is impossible to eat." Bhaṭṭācārya replied, "I know how much You can eat.

lines: nīlācale bhojana tumi kara bāyānna bāra
eka eka bhogera anna śata śata bhāra
devanagari: नीलाचले भोजन तुमि कर बायान्न बार ।
एक एक भोगेर अन्न शत शत भार ॥239॥
cc-madhya-15.239.translation: "After all, at Jagannātha Purī You eat fifty-two times a day, and each time You eat hundreds of buckets filled with prasāda.

devanagari: शिरेर उपरे, पृष्ठे, सम्मुखे, दुइ - पाशे ।
पाद - मध्ये फिराय लगुड़, देखि’ लोक हासे ॥24॥
cc-madhya-15.24.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wheeled and threw the rod, sometimes over His head, sometimes behind His back, sometimes in front of Him, sometimes to His side and sometimes between His legs. Indeed, all the people laughed to see this.

devanagari: द्वारकाते षोल - सहस्र महिषी - मन्दिरे ।
अष्टादश माता, आर यादवेर घरे ॥240॥
cc-madhya-15.240.translation: "At Dvārakā, You keep sixteen thousand queens in sixteen thousand palaces. Also, there are eighteen mothers and numerous friends and relatives of the Yadu dynasty.

lines: vraje jyeṭhā, khuḍā, māmā, pisādi gopa-gaṇa
devanagari: व्रजे ज्येठा, खुड़ा, मामा, पिसादि गोप - गण ।
सखा - वृन्द सबार घरे द्विसन्ध्या - भोजन ॥241॥
cc-madhya-15.241.translation: "In Vṛndāvana You also have Your father's elder brothers, Your father's younger brothers, maternal uncles, husbands of Your father's sisters and many cowherd men. There are also cowherd boy friends, and You eat twice a day, morning and evening, in the house of each and every one.

lines: tāra lekhāya ei anna nahe eka grāsī
devanagari: गोवर्धन - यज्ञे अन्न खाइला राशि राशि ।
तार लेखाय एइ अन्न नहे एक ग्रासी ॥242॥
cc-madhya-15.242.translation: "Indeed," Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya continued, "at the Govardhana-pūjā ceremony You ate stacks of rice. In comparison to that, this small quantity is not even a morsel for You.

lines: tumi ta' īśvara, muñi—kṣudra jīva chāra
devanagari: तुमि त’ ईश्वर, मुञि क्षुद्र जीव छार ।
एक - ग्रास माधुकरी करह अङ्गीकार ॥243॥
cc-madhya-15.243.translation: "You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead, whereas I am a most insignificant living being. Therefore You may accept a little quantity of food from my house."

lines: eta śuni' hāsi' prabhu vasilā bhojane
devanagari: एत शुनि’ हासि’ प्रभु वसिला भोजने ।
जगन्नाथेर प्रसाद भट्ट देन हर्ष - मने ॥244॥
cc-madhya-15.244.translation: Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu smiled and sat down to eat. Bhaṭṭācārya, with great pleasure, first offered Him the prasāda from the Jagannātha temple.

devanagari: हेन - काले ‘अमोघ,’ - भट्टाचार्येर जामाता ।
कुलीन, निन्दक तेंहो षाठी - कन्यार भर्ता ॥245॥
cc-madhya-15.245.translation: At this time Bhaṭṭācārya had a son-in-law named Amogha, who was the husband of his daughter named Ṣāṭhī. Although born in an aristocratic brāhmaṇa family, this Amogha was a great faultfinder and blasphemer.

lines: bhojana dekhite cāhe, āsite nā pāre
devanagari: भोजन देखिते चाहे, आसिते ना पारे ।
लाठि - हाते भट्टाचार्य आछेन दुयारे ॥246॥
cc-madhya-15.246.translation: Amogha wanted to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu eat, but he was not allowed to enter. Indeed, Bhaṭṭācārya guarded the threshold of his house with a stick in his hand.

lines: teṅho yadi prasāda dite hailā āna-mana
amogha āsi' anna dekhi' karaye nindana
devanagari: तेंहो यदि प्रसाद दिते हैला आन - मन ।
अमोघ आ सि’ अन्न देखि’ करये निन्दन ॥247॥
cc-madhya-15.247.translation: However, as soon as Bhaṭṭācārya began distributing prasāda and was a little inattentive, Amogha came in. Seeing the quantity of food, he began to blaspheme.

lines: ei anne tṛpta haya daśa bāra jana
devanagari: एइ अन्ने तृप्त हय दश बार जन ।
एकेला सन्यासी करे एतेक भक्षण! ॥248॥
cc-madhya-15.248.translation: "This much food is sufficient to satisfy ten or twelve men, but this sannyāsī alone is eating so much!"

devanagari: शुनितेइ भट्टाचार्य उलटि’ चाहिल ।
ताँर अवधान देखि’ अमोघ पलाइल ॥249॥
cc-madhya-15.249.translation: As soon as Amogha said this, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya turned his eyes upon him. Seeing Bhaṭṭācārya's attitude, Amogha immediately left.

devanagari: अलात - चक्रेर प्राय लगुड़ फिराय ।
देखि’ सर्व - लोक - चित्ते चमत्कार पाय ॥25॥
cc-madhya-15.25.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu whirled the rod in a circle like a firebrand, the heart of everyone who saw it was astonished.

lines: palāila amogha, tāra lāga nā pāila
devanagari: भट्टाचार्ये लाठि लञा मारिते धाइल ।
पलाइल अमोघ, तार लाग ना पाइल ॥250॥
cc-madhya-15.250.translation: Bhaṭṭācārya ran after him to strike him with a stick, but Amogha fled so fast that Bhaṭṭācārya could not catch him.

lines: tabe gāli, śāpa dite bhaṭṭācārya āilā
devanagari: तबे गालि, शाप दिते भट्टाचार्य आइला ।
निन्दा शुनि’ महाप्रभु हासिते लागिला ॥251॥
cc-madhya-15.251.translation: Bhaṭṭācārya then began to curse and call his son-in-law ill names. When Bhaṭṭācārya returned, he saw that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was laughing to hear him criticize Amogha.

lines: śuni' ṣāṭhīra mātā śire-buke ghāta māre
devanagari: शुनि’ षाठीर माता शिरे - बुके घात मारे ।
‘षाठी राण्डी हउक’ - इहा बले बारे बारे ॥252॥
cc-madhya-15.252.translation: When Ṣāṭhī's mother, Bhaṭṭācārya's wife, heard of this incident, she immediately began to strike her head and chest, saying again, "Let Ṣāṭhī become a widow!"

lines: duṅhāra duḥkha dekhi' prabhu duṅhā prabodhiyā
duṅhāra icchāte bhojana kaila tuṣṭa hañā
devanagari: दुँहार दुःख देखि’ प्रभु दुँहा प्रबोधिया ।
दुँहार इच्छाते भोजन कैल तुष्ट हञा ॥253॥
cc-madhya-15.253.translation: Seeing the lamentation of both husband and wife, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu tried to pacify them. According to their desire, He ate the prasāda and was very satisfied.

devanagari: आचमन करा ञा भट्ट दिल मुख - वास ।
तुलसी - मञ्जरी, लवङ्ग, एलाचि रस - वास ॥254॥
cc-madhya-15.254.translation: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu finished eating, Bhaṭṭācārya washed His mouth, hands and legs and offered Him flavored spices, tulasī-mañjarī, cloves, and cardamom.

devanagari: सर्वाङ्गे पराइल प्रभुर माल्य - चन्दन ।
दण्डवत् हञा बले सदैन्य वचन ॥255॥
cc-madhya-15.255.translation: The Bhaṭṭācārya then placed a flower garland over Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and smeared His body with sandalwood pulp. After offering obeisances, the Bhaṭṭācārya submitted the following humble statement.

lines: ei aparādha, prabhu, kṣamā kara more
devanagari: निन्दा कराइते तोमा आनिनु निज - घरे ।
एइ अपराध, प्रभु, क्षमा कर मोरे ॥256॥
cc-madhya-15.256.translation: "I brought You to my home just to have You blasphemed. This is a great offense. Please excuse me. I beg Your pardon."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - निन्दा नहे, ‘सहज’ कहिल ।
इहाते तोमार किबा अपराध हैल ? ॥257॥
cc-madhya-15.257.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "What Amogha has said is correct; therefore it is not blasphemy. What is your offense?"

lines: bhaṭṭācārya tāṅra ghare gelā tāṅra sane
devanagari: एत ब लि’ महाप्रभु चलिला भवने ।
भट्टाचार्य ताँर घरे गेला ताँर सने ॥258॥
cc-madhya-15.258.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left and returned to His residence. Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya also followed Him.

lines: tāṅre śānta kari' prabhu ghare pāṭhāila
devanagari: प्रभु - पदे प ड़ि’ बहु आत्म - निन्दा कैल ।
ताँरे शान्त क रि’ प्रभु घरे पाठाइल ॥259॥
cc-madhya-15.259.translation: Falling down at the Lord's feet, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya said many things in self-reproach. The Lord then pacified him and sent him back to his home.

lines: ke bujhibe tāṅhā duṅhāra gopa-bhāva gūḍha
devanagari: एइ - मत नित्यानन्द फिराय लगुड़।
के बुझिबे ताँहा बँहार गोप - भाव गूढ़ ॥26॥
cc-madhya-15.26.translation: Nityānanda Prabhu also played at whirling the rod. Who can understand how They were ecstatically immersed in the deep emotions of the cowherd boys?

devanagari: घरे आ सि’ भट्टाचार्य षाठीर माता - सने ।
आपना निन्दिया किछु बलेन वचने ॥260॥
cc-madhya-15.260.translation: After returning to his home, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya consulted with his wife, the mother of Ṣāṭhī. After personally condemning himself, he began to speak as follows.

devanagari: चैतन्य - गोसाञि र निन्दा शुनिल याहा हैते ।
तारे वध कैले हय पाप - प्रायश्चित्ते ॥261॥
cc-madhya-15.261.translation: "If the man who blasphemed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is killed, his sinful action may be atoned."

lines: dui yogya nahe, dui śarīra brāhmaṇa
devanagari: किम्वा निज - प्राण यदि करि विमोचन ।
दुइ योग्य नहे, दुइ शरीर ब्राह्मण ॥262॥
cc-madhya-15.262.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya continued, "Or, if I give up my own life, this sinful action may be atoned. However, neither of these ideas are befitting because both bodies belong to brāhmaṇas.

lines: punaḥ sei nindakera mukha nā dekhiba
parityāga kailuṅ, tāra nāma nā la-iba
devanagari: पुनः सेइ निन्दकेर मुख ना देखिब ।
परित्याग कैलुँ, तार नाम ना लइब ॥263॥
cc-madhya-15.263.translation: "Instead, I shall never see the face of that blasphemer. I reject him and give up his relationship. I shall never even speak his name.

devanagari: षाठीरे कह - तारे छाड़क, से हइल ‘पतित’ ।
‘पतित’ हइले भर्ता त्यजिते उचित ॥264॥
cc-madhya-15.264.translation: "Inform my daughter Ṣāṭhī to abandon her relationship with her husband because he has fallen down. When the husband falls down, it is the wife's duty to relinquish the relationship.

devanagari: पतिं च पतितं त्यजेत् ॥265॥
cc-madhya-15.265.translation: "When a husband is fallen, his relationship must be given up."

lines: sei rātre amogha kāhāṅ palāñā gela
devanagari: सेइ रात्रे अमोघ काहाँ पलाञा गेल ।
प्रातः - काले तार विसूचिका - व्याधि हैल ॥266॥
cc-madhya-15.266.translation: That night Amogha, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya's son-in-law, fled, and in the morning he immediately fell sick with cholera.

lines: sahāya ha-iyā daiva kaila mora kārya
devanagari: अमोघ मरेन - शुनि’ कहे भट्टाचार्य ।
सहाय हइया दैव कैल मोर कार्य ॥267॥
cc-madhya-15.267.translation: When Bhaṭṭācārya heard that Amogha was dying of cholera, he thought, "It is the favor of Providence that He is doing what I want to do.

lines: eta bali' paḍe dui śāstrera vacana
devanagari: ईश्वरे त’ अपराध फले तत - क्षण ।
एत ब लि’ पड़े दुइ शास्त्रेर वचन ॥268॥
cc-madhya-15.268.translation: "When one offends the Supreme Personality of Godhead, karma immediately takes effect." After saying this, he recited two verses from revealed scripture.

devanagari: महता हि प्रयत्नेन हस्त्यश्व - रथ - पत्तिभिः ।
अस्माभिर्यदनुष्ठेयं गन्धर्वैस्तदनुष्ठितम् ॥269॥
cc-madhya-15.269.translation: “ 'What we have had to arrange with great endeavor by collecting elephants, horses, chariots and infantry soldiers has already been accomplished by the Gandharvas.'

devanagari: प्रतापरुद्रेर आज्ञाय पड़िछा - तुलसी ।
जगन्नाथेर प्रसाद - वस्त्र एक लञा आसि ॥27॥
cc-madhya-15.27.translation: Following the orders of Mahārāja Pratāparudra, the temple superintendent named Tulasī brought one of Lord Jagannātha's used cloths.

devanagari: आयुः श्रियं यशो धर्मं लोकानाशिष एव च ।
हन्ति श्रेयांसि सर्वाणि पुंसो महदतिक्रमः ॥270॥
cc-madhya-15.270.translation: “ 'When a person mistreats great souls, his life span, opulence, reputation, religion, possessions and good fortune are all destroyed.'

devanagari: गोपीनाथाचार्य गेला प्रभु - दरशने ।
प्रभु ताँरे पुछिल भट्टाचार्य - विवरणे ॥271॥
cc-madhya-15.271.translation: At this time, Gopīnātha Ācārya went to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord asked him about the events taking place in Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya's house.

devanagari: आचार्य कहे , - उपवास कैल दुइ जन ।
विसूचिका - व्याधिते अमोघ छाड़िछे जीवन ॥272॥
cc-madhya-15.272.translation: Gopīnātha Ācārya informed the Lord that both the husband and wife were fasting and that their son-in-law Amogha was dying of cholera.

lines: amoghere kahe tāra buke hasta diyā
devanagari: शुनि’ कृपामय प्रभु आइला धाञा ।
अमोघेरे कहे तार बुके हस्त दिया ॥273॥
cc-madhya-15.273.translation: As soon as Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard that Amogha was going to die, He immediately ran to him in great haste. Placing His hand on Amogha's chest, He spoke as follows.

devanagari: सहजे निर्मल एइ ‘ब्राह्मण” - हृदय ।
कृष्णेर वसिते एइ योग्य - स्थान हय ॥274॥
cc-madhya-15.274.translation: "The heart of a brāhmaṇa is by nature very clean; therefore it is a proper place for Kṛṣṇa to sit.

devanagari: ‘मात्सर्य’ - चण्डाल केने इहाँ वसाइले ।
परम पवित्र स्थान अपवित्र कैले ॥275॥
cc-madhya-15.275.translation: "Why have you allowed jealousy to sit here also? Because of this, you have become like a caṇḍāla, the lowest of men, and you have also contaminated a most purified place-your heart.

devanagari: सार्वभौम - सङ्गे तोमार ‘कलुष’ हैल क्षय ।
‘कल्मष’ घुचिले जीव ‘कृष्ण - नाम’ लय ॥276॥
cc-madhya-15.276.translation: "However, due to the association of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, all your contamination is now vanquished. When a person's heart is cleansed of all contamination, he is able to chant the mahā-mantra, Hare Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: उठह, अमोघ, तुमि लओ कृष्ण - नाम ।
अचिरे तोमारे कृपा करिबे भगवान् ॥277॥
cc-madhya-15.277.translation: "Therefore, Amogha, get up and chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra! If you do so, Kṛṣṇa will unfailingly bestow mercy upon you."

devanagari: शुनि’ ‘कृष्ण’ ‘कृष्ण’ बलि’ अमोघ उठिला ।
प्रेमोन्मादे मत्त हञा नाचिते लागिला ॥278॥
cc-madhya-15.278.translation: After hearing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and being touched by Him, Amogha, who was on his deathbed, immediately stood up and began to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa. Thus he became mad with ecstatic love and began to dance emotionally.

lines: kampa, aśru, pulaka, stambha, sveda, svara-bhaṅga
prabhu hāse dekhi' tāra premera taraṅga
devanagari: कम्प, अश्रु, पुलक, स्तम्भ, स्वेद, स्वर - भङ्ग ।
प्रभु हासे देखि’ तार प्रेमेर तरङ्ग ॥279॥
cc-madhya-15.279.translation: While Amogha danced in ecstatic love, he manifested all the ecstatic symptoms-trembling, tears, jubilation, trance, perspiration and a faltering voice. Seeing these waves of ecstatic emotion, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to laugh.

devanagari: बहु - मूल्य वस्त्र प्रभु - मस्तके बान्धिल ।
आचार्यादि प्रभुर गणेरे पराइल ॥28॥
cc-madhya-15.28.translation: This valuable cloth was wrapped around the head of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The other devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, also had cloths wrapped about their heads.

devanagari: प्रभुर चरणे धरि’ करये विनय ।
अपराध क्षम मोरे, प्रभु, दयामय ॥280॥
cc-madhya-15.280.translation: Amogha then fell before the Lord's lotus feet and submissively said, "O merciful Lord, please excuse my offense."

lines: ei chāra mukhe tomāra karinu nindane
eta bali' āpana gāle caḍāya āpane
devanagari: एइ छार मुखे तोमार करिनु निन्दने ।
एत ब लि’ आपन गाले चड़ाय आपने ॥281॥
cc-madhya-15.281.translation: Not only did Amogha beg the Lord's pardon, but he also began slapping his own cheeks, saying, "By this mouth I have blasphemed You."

devanagari: चड़ाइते चड़ाइते गाल फुलाइल ।
हाते ध रि’ गोपीनाथाचार्य निषेधिल ॥282॥
cc-madhya-15.282.translation: Indeed, Amogha continued slapping his face over and over until his cheeks were swollen. Finally Gopīnātha Ācārya stopped him by catching hold of his hands.

lines: prabhu āśvāsana kare sparśi' tāra gātra
devanagari: प्रभु आश्वासन करे स्पर्शि’ तार गात्र ।
सार्वभौम - सम्बन्धे तुमि मोर स्नेह - पात्र ॥283॥
cc-madhya-15.283.translation: After this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu pacified Amogha by touching his body and saying, "You are the object of My affection because you are the son-in-law of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya.

lines: seha mora priya, anya jana rahu dūra
devanagari: सार्वभौम - गृहे दास - दासी, ये कुक्कुर ।
सेह मोर प्रिय, अन्य जन रहु दूर ॥284॥
cc-madhya-15.284.translation: "Everyone in Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya's house is very dear to Me, including his maids and servants and even his dog. And what to speak of his relatives?

devanagari: अपरा ध’ नाहि, सदा लओ कृष्ण - नाम ।
एत ब लि’ प्रभु आइला सार्वभौम - स्थान ॥285॥
cc-madhya-15.285.translation: "Amogha, always chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra and do not commit any further offenses." After giving Amogha this instruction, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Sārvabhauma's house."

devanagari: प्रभु देखि’ सार्वभौम धरिला चरणे ।
प्रभु ताँरे आलिङ्गिया वसिला आसने ॥286॥
cc-madhya-15.286.translation: Upon seeing the Lord, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya immediately caught hold of His lotus feet. The Lord also embraced him and sat down.

lines: prabhu kahe,—amogha śiśu, kibā tāra doṣa
kene upavāsa kara, kene kara roṣa
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - अमोघ शिशु, किबा तार दोष ।
केने उपवास कर, केने कर रोष ॥287॥
cc-madhya-15.287.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu pacified Sārvabhauma, saying, "After all, Amogha, your son-in-law, is a child. So what is his fault? Why are you fasting, and why are you angry?

lines: śīghra āsi, bhojana kara, tabe mora sukha
devanagari: उठ, स्नान कर, देख जगन्नाथ - मुख ।
शीघ्र आसि, भोजन कर, तबे मोर सुख ॥288॥
cc-madhya-15.288.translation: "Just get up and take your bath and go see the face of Lord Jagannātha. Then return here to eat your lunch. In this way I shall be happy.

lines: yāvat nā khāibe tumi prasāda āsiyā
devanagari: तावत्रहिब आमि एथाय वसिया ।
यावत्ना खाइबे तुमि प्रसाद आसिया ॥289॥
cc-madhya-15.289.translation: "I shall stay here until you return to take Lord Jagannātha's remnants for your lunch."

lines: āveśe bilāila ghare chila yata dhana
devanagari: कानाजि - खुटिया, जगन्नाथ, दुइ - जन ।
आवेशे विलाइल घरे छिल यत धन ॥29॥
cc-madhya-15.29.translation: In ecstasy, Kānāñi Khuṭiyā, who was dressed as Nanda Mahārāja, and Jagannātha Māhāti, who was dressed as mother Yaśodā, distributed all the riches they had stocked at home.

devanagari: प्रभु - पद ध रि’ भट्ट कहिते लागिला ।
मरित’ अमोघ, तारे केने जीयाइला ॥290॥
cc-madhya-15.290.translation: Catching hold of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's lotus feet, Bhaṭṭācārya said, "Why did You bring Amogha back to life? It would have been better had he died."

lines: bālaka-doṣa nā laya pitā, tāhāte pālaka
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - अमोघ शिशु, तोमार बालक ।
बालक - दोष ना लय पिता, ताहाते पालक ॥291॥
cc-madhya-15.291.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Amogha is a child and your son. The father does not take the faults of his son seriously, especially when he is maintaining him.

devanagari: एबे ‘वैष्णव’ हैल, तार गेल ‘अपराध’ ।
ताहार उपरे एबे करह प्रसाद ॥292॥
cc-madhya-15.292.translation: "Now that he has become a Vaiṣṇava, he is offenseless. You can bestow your mercy upon him without hesitation."

lines: snāna kari' tāṅhā muñi āsichoṅ ekhane
devanagari: भट्ट कहे , - चल, प्रभु, ईश्वर - दरशने ।
स्नान क रि’ ताँहा मुञि आसिछों एखने ॥293॥
cc-madhya-15.293.translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya said, " Please go, my Lord, to see Lord Jagannātha. After taking my bath, I shall go there and then return."

lines: iṅho prasāda pāile, vārtā āmāke kahibā
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - गोपीनाथ, इहाञि रहिबा ।
इँहो प्रसाद पाइले, वार्ता आमाके कहिबा ॥294॥
cc-madhya-15.294.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then told Gopīnātha, "Stay here and inform Me when Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya has taken his prasāda."

lines: bhaṭṭa snāna darśana kari' karilā bhojane
devanagari: एत ब लि’ प्रभु गेला ईश्वर - दरशने ।
भट्ट स्नान दर्शन क रि’ करिला भोजने ॥295॥
cc-madhya-15.295.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see Lord Jagannātha. Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya completed his bath, went to see Lord Jagannātha and then returned to his house to accept food.

devanagari: सेइ अमोघ हैल प्रभुर भक्त ‘एकान्त’ ।
प्रेमे नाचे, कृष्ण - नाम लय महा - शान्त ॥296॥
cc-madhya-15.296.translation: Thereafter, Amogha became an unalloyed devotee of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He danced in ecstasy and peacefully chanted the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

lines: yei dekhe, śune, tāṅra vismaya haya mana
devanagari: ऐछे चित्र - लीला करे शची र नन्द न ।
येइ देखे, शुने, ताँर विस्मय हय मन ॥297॥
cc-madhya-15.297.translation: In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed His various pastimes. Whoever sees them or hears of them becomes truly astonished.

devanagari: ऐछे भट्ट - गृहे करे भोजन - विलास ।
तार मध्ये नाना चित्र - चरित्र - प्रकाश ॥298॥
cc-madhya-15.298.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu enjoyed eating in Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya's house. Within that one pastime, many wonderful pastimes were manifest.

devanagari: सार्वभौम - घरे एइ भोजन - चरित ।
सार्वभौम - प्रेम याँहा हइला विदित ॥299॥
cc-madhya-15.299.translation: These are the peculiar characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes. Thus the Lord ate in Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya's house, and in this way Sārvabhauma's love for the Lord has become very well known.

devanagari: जय श्री - चैतन्य - चरितामृत - स्रोता - गण ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत - याँर प्राण - धन ॥3॥
cc-madhya-15.3.translation: All glories to the listeners of Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta who have accepted it as their life and soul.

devanagari: देखि’ महाप्रभु बड़ सन्तोष पाइला ।
माता - पिता - ज्ञाने दुँहे नमस्कार कैला ॥30॥
cc-madhya-15.30.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was greatly satisfied to see this. Accepting them both as His father and mother, He offered them obeisances.

lines: ṣāṭhīra mātāra prema, āra prabhura prasāda
devanagari: षाठीर मातार प्रेम, आर प्रभुर प्रसाद ।
भक्त - सम्बन्धे याहा क्षमिल अपराध ॥300॥
cc-madhya-15.300.translation: Thus I have related the ecstatic love of Sārvabhauma's wife, who is known as the mother of Ṣāṭhī. I have also related Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's great mercy, which He manifested by excusing Amogha's offense. He did so due to Amogha's relationship with a devotee.

lines: śraddhā kari' ei līlā śune yei jana
devanagari: श्रद्धा क रि’ एइ लीला शुने येइ जन ।
अचिरात्याय सेइ चैतन्य - चरण ॥301॥
cc-madhya-15.301.translation: Whoever hears these pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with faith and love will attain the shelter of the Lord's lotus feet very soon.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥302॥
cc-madhya-15.302.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: परम - आवेशे प्रभु आइला निज - घर ।
एइ - मत लीला क रे गौराङ्ग - सुन्दर ॥31॥
cc-madhya-15.31.translation: In great ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence. In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, known as Gaurāṅga-sundara, performed various pastimes.

devanagari: विजया - दशमी - लङ्का - विजयेर दिने ।
वानर - सैन्य कैला प्रभु लञा भक्त - गणे ॥32॥
cc-madhya-15.32.translation: On the victory day celebrating the conquest of Laṅkā-a day known as Vijayā-daśamī-Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dressed up all His devotees like monkey soldiers.

devanagari: हनुमानावेशे प्रभु वृक्ष - शाखा ल ञा ।
लङ्का - गड़े चड़ि’ फेले गड़ भाङ्गिया ॥33॥
cc-madhya-15.33.translation: Displaying the emotions of Hanumān, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took up a large tree branch, and, mounting the walls of the Laṅkā fort, began to dismantle it.

devanagari: ‘काहाँ रे राव्णा’ प्रभु कहे क्रोधावेशे ।
‘जगन्माता हरे पापी, मारिमु सवंशे ॥34॥
cc-madhya-15.34.translation: In the ecstasy of Hanumān, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu angrily said, "Where is the rascal Rāvaṇa? He has kidnapped the universal mother, Sītā. Now I shall kill him and all his family."

lines: sarva-loka jaya' jaya' bale bāra bāra
devanagari: गोसाञि र आवेश देखि’ लोके चमत्कार ।
सर्व - लोक ‘जय’ ‘जय’ बले बार बार ॥35॥
cc-madhya-15.35.translation: Everyone became very astonished to see the emotional ecstasy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and everyone began to chant, "All glories! All glories!" again and again.

devanagari: एइ - मत रास - यात्रा, आर दीपावली ।
उत्थान - द्वादशी यात्रा देखिला सकलि ॥36॥
cc-madhya-15.36.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees participated in all the festivals known as Rāsa-yātrā, Dīpāvalī and Utthāna-dvādaśī.

lines: dui bhāi yukti kaila nibhṛte vasiyā
devanagari: एक - दिन महाप्रभु नित्यानन्दे लञा ।
दुइ भाइ युक्ति कैल निभृते वसिया ॥37॥
cc-madhya-15.37.translation: One day the two brothers, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Nityānanda Prabhu, consulted one another, sitting together in a solitary place.

lines: kibā yukti kaila duṅhe, keha nāhi jāne
devanagari: किबा युक्ति कैल दुँहे, केह नाहि जाने ।
फले अनुमान पाछे कैल भक्त - गणे ॥38॥
cc-madhya-15.38.translation: No one could understand what the brothers discussed between Themselves, but later all the devotees could guess what the subject matter was.

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु सब भक्ते बोलाइल ।
गौड़ - देशे याह सबे विदाय करिल ॥39॥
cc-madhya-15.39.translation: Thereafter, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu called for all the devotees and asked them to return to Bengal. In this way, He bade farewell to them.

devanagari: एइ - मत महाप्रभु भक्त - गण - सङ्गे ।
नीलाचले रहि’ करे नृत्य - गीत - रङ्गे ॥4॥
cc-madhya-15.4.translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed at Jagannātha Purī, He constantly enjoyed chanting and dancing with His devotees.

devanagari: सबारे कहिल प्रभु - प्रत्यब्द आसिया ।
गुण्डिचा देखिया याबे आमारे मिलिया ॥40॥
cc-madhya-15.40.translation: Bidding farewell to all the devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested them to return to Jagannātha Purī every year to see Him and then see the cleansing of the Guṇḍicā temple.

devanagari: आचार्येरे आज्ञा दिल करिया सम्मान ।
‘आ - चण्डाल आदि कृष्ण - भक्ति दिओ दान’ ॥41॥
cc-madhya-15.41.translation: With great respect, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested Advaita Ācārya, "Give Kṛṣṇa consciousness, devotion to Kṛṣṇa, even to the lowest of men [caṇḍālas]."

devanagari: नित्यानन्दे आज्ञा दिल, - ‘याह गौड़ - देशे ।
अनर्गल प्रेम - भक्ति करिह प्रकाशे ॥42॥
cc-madhya-15.42.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Nityānanda Prabhu, "Go to Bengal and, without restriction, manifest devotional service to the Lord, Kṛṣṇa consciousness."

lines: tomāra sahāya lāgi' dilu tomāra sane
devanagari: राम - दास, गदाधर आदि कत जने ।
तोमार सहाय लागि’ दिलु तोमार सने ॥43॥
cc-madhya-15.43.translation: Nityānanda Prabhu was given assistants like Rāmadāsa, Gadādhara dāsa and several others. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "I give them to You to assist You.

lines: madhye madhye āmi tomāra nikaṭa yāiba
devanagari: मध्ये मध्ये आमि तोमार निकट याइब ।
अलक्षिते रहि’ तोमार नृत्य देखिब’ ॥44॥
cc-madhya-15.44.translation: "I shall also go to see You at intervals. Keeping Myself invisible, I shall watch You dance."

lines: kaṇṭhe dhari' kahe tāṅre madhura vacana
devanagari: श्रीवास - पण्डिते प्रभु करि’ आलिङ्गन ।
कण्ठे धरि’ कहे ताँरे मधुर वचन ॥45॥
cc-madhya-15.45.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then embraced Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita and, with His arm about his neck, began to speak to him in sweet words.

lines: tomāra ghare kīrtane āmi nitya nāciba
tumi dekhā pābe, āra keha nā dekhiba
devanagari: तोमार घरे कीर्तने आमि नित्य नाचिब ।
तुमि देखा पाबे, आर केह ना देखिब ॥46॥
cc-madhya-15.46.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, "Perform congregational chanting daily, and be assured that I shall also dance in your presence. You will be able to see this dancing, but not others.

lines: ei vastra mātāke diha', ei saba prasāda
devanagari: एइ वस्त्र माताके दि ह’, एइ सब प्रसाद ।
दण्डवत्क रि’ आमार क्षमाइह अपराध ॥47॥
cc-madhya-15.47.translation: "Take this prasāda of Lord Jagannātha's and this cloth and deliver them to My mother, Śacīdevī. After offering her obeisances, please request her to excuse My offenses.

lines: tāṅra sevā chāḍi' āmi kariyāchi sannyāsa
dharma nahe, kari āmi nija dharma-nāśa
devanagari: ताँर सेवा छाडि’ आमि करियाछि सन्यास ।
धर्म नहे, करि आमि निज धर्म - नाश ॥48॥
cc-madhya-15.48.translation: "I have given up the service of My mother and have accepted the sannyāsa order. Actually I should not have done this, for by so doing, I have destroyed My religious principles.

devanagari: ताँर प्रेम - वश आमि, ताँर सेवा - धर्म ।
ताहा छाड़ि’ करियाछि बातुलेर कर्म ॥49॥
cc-madhya-15.49.translation: "I am subordinate to the love of My mother, and it is My duty to serve her in return. Instead of doing so, I have accepted this renounced order. Certainly this is the act of a madman.

devanagari: प्रथमावसरे जगन्नाथ - दरशन ।
नृत्य - गीत करे दण्ड - परणाम, स्तवन ॥5॥
cc-madhya-15.5.translation: In the beginning, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the Deity of Lord Jagannātha in the temple. He offered Him obeisances and prayers and danced and sang before Him.

lines: vātula bālakera mātā nāhi laya doṣa
ei jāni' mātā more nā karaya roṣa
devanagari: बातुल बालकेर माता नाहि लय दोष ।
एइ जानि’ माता मोरे ना करय रोष ॥50॥
cc-madhya-15.50.translation: "A mother is not offended by her mad son, and, knowing this, My mother is not offended by Me.

lines: ki kāya sannyāse mora, prema nija-dhana
ye-kāle sannyāsa kailuṅ, channa haila mana
devanagari: कि काय सन्यासे मोर, प्रेम निज - धन ।
ये - काले सन्यास कैलुँ, छन्न हैल मन ॥51॥
cc-madhya-15.51.translation: "I had no business in accepting this renounced order and sacrificing My love for My mother, which is My real property. Actually I was in a crazy state of mind when I accepted sannyāsa.

lines: madhye madhye āsimu tāṅra caraṇa dekhite
devanagari: नीलाचले आछों मुञि ताँहार आज्ञाते ।
मध्ये मध्ये आसिमु ताँर चरण देखिते ॥52॥
cc-madhya-15.52.translation: "I am staying here at Jagannātha Purī, Nīlācala, to comply with her orders. However, at intervals I shall go see her lotus feet.

lines: nitya yāi' dekhi muñi tāṅhāra caraṇe
sphūrti-jñāne teṅho tāhā satya nāhi māne
devanagari: नित्य याइ’ देखि मुञि ताँहार चरणे ।
स्फूर्ति - ज्ञाने तेंहो ताहा सत्य नाहि माने ॥53॥
cc-madhya-15.53.translation: "Indeed, I go there daily to see her lotus feet. She is able to feel My presence, although she does not believe it to be true.

devanagari: एक - दिन शाल्यन्न, व्यञ्जन पाँच - सात ।
शाक, मोचा - घण्ट, भृष्ट - पटोल - निम्ब - पात ॥54॥
cc-madhya-15.54-55.translation: "One day My mother, Śacī, offered food to Śālagrāma Viṣṇu. She offered rice cooked from śāli paddies, various kinds of vegetables, spinach, curry made of banana flowers, fried paṭola with nimba leaves, pieces of ginger with lemon, and also yogurt, milk, sugar candy and many other foods.

devanagari: प्रसाद लञा कोले करेन क्रन्दन ।
निमाइर प्रिय मोर - ए - सब व्यञ्जन ॥56॥
cc-madhya-15.56.translation: "Taking the food upon her lap, Mother was crying to think that all that food was very dear to her Nimāi.

lines: nimāñi nāhika ethā, ke kare bhojana
devanagari: निमाञि नाहिक एथा, के करे भोजन ।
मोर ध्याने अश्रु - जले भरिल नयन ॥57॥
cc-madhya-15.57.translation: "My mother was thinking, 'Nimāi is not here. Who will accept all this food?' As she meditated upon Me in this way, her eyes filled with tears.

lines: śīghra yāi' muñi saba karinu bhakṣaṇa
devanagari: शीघ्र याइ’ मुञि सब करिनु भक्षण ।
शून्य - पात्र देखि’ अश्रु करिया मार्जन ॥58॥
cc-madhya-15.58.translation: "While she was thus thinking and crying, I immediately went there with great haste and ate everything. Seeing the dish empty, she wiped her tears away.

devanagari: ‘के अन्न - व्यञ्जन खाइल, शून्य केने पात?।
बालगोपाल किबा खाइल सब भात ? ॥59॥
cc-madhya-15.59.translation: "She then began to wonder who had eaten all that food. 'Why is the plate empty?' she wondered, doubting that Bāla-gopāla had eaten it all.

devanagari: ‘उपल - भोग’ लागिले करे बाहिरे विजय ।
हरिदास मि लि’ आइसे आपन निलय ॥6॥
cc-madhya-15.6.translation: After visiting the temple, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would remain outside during the upala-bhoga offering. He would then go meet Haridāsa Ṭhākura and return to His residence.

lines: kibā mora kathāya mane bhrama hañā gela!
kibā kona jantu āsi' sakala khāila?
devanagari: किबा मोर कथाय मने भ्रम ह ञा गेल! ।
किबा कोन जन्तु आसि’ सकल खाइल ? ॥60॥
cc-madhya-15.60.translation: "She began to wonder whether there was actually anything on the plate in the first place. Then again she thought that some animal might have come and eaten everything.

lines: kibā āmi anna-pātre bhrame nā bāḍila!'
devanagari: किबा आमि अन्न - पात्रे भ्रमे ना बाड़िल!’ ।
एत चिन्ति’ पाक - पात्र याञा देखिल ॥61॥
cc-madhya-15.61.translation: "She thought, 'Perhaps by mistake I did not put any food on the plate.' So thinking, she went into the kitchen and saw the pots.

lines: dekhiyā saṁśaya haila kichu camatkāra mane
devanagari: अन्न - व्यञ्जन - पूर्ण देखि’ सकल भाजने ।
देखिया संशय हैल किछु चमत्कार मने ॥62॥
cc-madhya-15.62.translation: "When she saw that all the pots were still filled with rice and vegetables, there was some doubt in her mind, and she was astonished.

devanagari: ईशाने बोलाञा पुनः स्थान लेपाइल ।
पुनरपि गोपालके अन्न समर्पिल ॥63॥
cc-madhya-15.63.translation: "Thus wondering, she called Īśāna, the servant, and had the place cleaned again. She then offered another plate to Gopāla.

devanagari: एइ - मत यबे करेन उत्तम रन्ध न ।
मोरे खाओयाइते करे उत्कण्ठाय रोदन ॥64॥
cc-madhya-15.64.translation: "Now whenever she prepares some good cooked food and wants to feed it to Me, she cries in great anxiety.

lines: tāṅra preme āni' āmāya karāya bhojane
antare mānaye sukha, bāhye nāhi māne
devanagari: ताँर प्रेमे आनि’ आमाय कराय भोजने ।
अन्तरे मानये सुख, बाह्ये नाहि माने ॥65॥
cc-madhya-15.65.translation: "Being obliged by her love, I am brought there to eat. Mother knows all these things internally and feels happiness, but externally she does not accept them.

devanagari: एइ विजया - दशमीते हैल एइ रीति ।
ताँहाके पुछिया ताँर कराइह प्रतीति ॥66॥
cc-madhya-15.66.translation: "Such an incident took place on the last Vijayā-daśamī day. You can ask her about this incident and thus make her believe that I actually go there."

lines: loka vidāya karite prabhu dhairya dharilā
devanagari: एतेक कहिते प्रभु विह्वल हइला ।
लोक विदाय करिते प्रभु धैर्य धरिला ॥67॥
cc-madhya-15.67.translation: While describing all this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was a little overwhelmed, but just to finish bidding farewell to the devotees, He remained patient.

lines: 'tomāra śuddha preme āmi ha-i' tomāra vaśa'
devanagari: राघव प ण्डिते कहेन वचन सरस ।
‘तोमार शुद्ध प्रेमे आमि हइ’ तोमार वश’ ॥68॥
cc-madhya-15.68.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu next spoke some relishable words to Rāghava Paṇḍita. He said, "I am obliged to you due to your pure love for Me."

devanagari: इँहार कृष्ण - सेवार कथा शुन, सर्व - जन ।
परम - पवित्र सेवा अति सर्वोत्तम ॥69॥
cc-madhya-15.69.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then informed everyone, "Just hear about the pure devotional service rendered to Kṛṣṇa by Rāghava Paṇḍita. Indeed, Rāghava Paṇḍita's service is supremely pure and highly accomplished.

lines: ghare vasi' kare prabhu nāma saṅkīrtana
devanagari: घरे वसि’ करे प्रभु नाम सङ्कीर्तन ।
अद्वैत आसिया करे प्रभुर पूजन ॥7॥
cc-madhya-15.7.translation: Sitting in His room, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would chant on His beads, and Advaita Prabhu would come there to worship the Lord.

lines: pāṅca gaṇḍā kari' nārikela vikāya tathā
devanagari: आर द्रव्य रहु - शुन नारिकेलेर कथा ।
पाँच गण्डा करि’ नारिकेल विकाय तथा ॥70॥
cc-madhya-15.70.translation: "Apart from other commodities, just hear about his coconut offering. A coconut is sold at the rate of five gaṇḍās each.

lines: vāṭite kata śata vṛkṣe lakṣa lakṣa phala
devanagari: वाटिते कत शत वृक्षे लक्ष लक्ष फल ।
तथापि शुनेन यथा मिष्ट नारिकेल ॥71॥
cc-madhya-15.71.translation: "Although he already has hundreds of trees and millions of fruits, he is still very eager to hear about the place where sweet coconut is available.

lines: eka eka phalera mūlya diyā cāri-cāri paṇa
devanagari: एक एक फलेर मूल्य दिया चारि - चारि पण ।
दश - क्रोश हैते आनाय करिया यतन ॥72॥
cc-madhya-15.72.translation: "He collects coconut with great endeavor from a place twenty miles away, and he gives four paṇas each for them.

devanagari: प्रति - दिन पाँच - सात फल छोला ञा ।
सुशीतल करिते राखे जले डुबाइञा ॥73॥
cc-madhya-15.73.translation: "Every day five to seven coconuts are clipped and put into water to keep cool.

lines: kṛṣṇe samarpaṇa kare mukha chidra kari'
devanagari: भोगेर समय पुनः छुलि’ संस्करि’ ।
कृष्णे समर्पण करे मुख छिद्र करि’ ॥74॥
cc-madhya-15.74.translation: "At the time of offering bhoga, the coconuts are again clipped and cleansed. After holes are made in them, they are offered to Lord Kṛṣṇa.

lines: kabhu śūnya phala rākhena, kabhu jala bhari'
devanagari: कृष्ण सेइ नारिकेल - जल पान करि’ ।
कभु शून्य फल राखेन, कभु जल भरि’ ॥75॥
cc-madhya-15.75.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa used to drink the juice from these coconuts, and sometimes the coconuts were left drained of juice. At other times the coconuts were filled with juice.

lines: phala bhāṅgi' śasye kare sat-pātra pūrita
devanagari: जल - शून्य फल देखि’ पण्डित - हरषित ।
फल भाङ्गि’ शस्ये करे सत्पात्र पूरित ॥76॥
cc-madhya-15.76.translation: "When Rāghava Paṇḍita saw that the juice had been drunk from the coconuts, he was very pleased. He would then break the coconut, take out the pulp and put it on another plate.

lines: śasya khāñā kṛṣṇa kare śūnya bhājana
devanagari: शस्य समर्पण क रि’ बाहिरे धेयान ।
शस्य खा ञा कृष्ण करे शून्य भाजन ॥77॥
cc-madhya-15.77.translation: "After offering the pulp, he would meditate outside the temple door. In the meantime, Lord Kṛṣṇa, having eaten the pulp, would leave the plate empty.

lines: kabhu śasya khāñā punaḥ pātra bhare śāṁse
devanagari: कभु शस्य खाञा पुनः पात्र भरे शांसे ।
श्रद्धा बाड़े पण्डितेर, प्रेम - सिन्धु भासे ॥78॥
cc-madhya-15.78.translation: "Sometimes, after eating the pulp, Kṛṣṇa would fill the plate again with new pulp. In this way, Rāghava Paṇḍita's faith increases, and he floats in an ocean of love.

lines: eka dina phala daśa saṁskāra kariyā
devanagari: एक दिन फल दश संस्कार करिया ।
भोग लागाइते सेवक आइल लञा ॥79॥
cc-madhya-15.79.translation: "One day it so happened that about ten coconuts were properly clipped and brought by a servant to offer to the Deity.

devanagari: सुगन्धि - सलिले देन पाद्य, आचमन ।
सर्वाङ्गे लेपये प्रभुर सुगन्धि चन्दन ॥8॥
cc-madhya-15.8.translation: While worshiping Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Advaita Ācārya would offer Him scented water to wash His mouth and feet. Then Advaita Ācārya would smear very fragrant sandalwood pulp all over His body.

devanagari: अवसर नाहि हय, विलम्ब हइल ।
फल - पात्र - हाते सेवक द्वारे त’ रहिल ॥80॥
cc-madhya-15.80.translation: "When the coconuts were brought, there was little time to offer them because it was already late. The servant, holding the container of coconuts, remained standing at the door.

lines: dvārera upara bhite teṅho hāta dila
sei hāte phala chuṅila, paṇḍita dekhila
devanagari: द्वारेर उपर भिते तेंहो हात दिल ।
सेइ हाते फल छुडिल, पण्डित देखिल ॥81॥
cc-madhya-15.81.translation: "Rāghava Paṇḍita then saw that the servant touched the ceiling above the door and then touched the coconuts with the same hand.

lines: tāra pada-dhūli uḍi' lāge upara bhite
devanagari: पण्डित कहे , - द्वारे लोक करे गतायाते ।
तार पद - धूलि उड़ि’ लागे उपर भिते ॥82॥
cc-madhya-15.82.translation: "Rāghava Paṇḍita then said, 'People are always coming and going through that door. The dust from their feet blows up and touches the ceiling.

lines: sei bhite hāta diyā phala paraśilā
devanagari: सेइ भिते हात दिया फल परशिला ।
कृष्ण - योग्य नहे, फल अपवित्र हैला ॥83॥
cc-madhya-15.83.translation: “ 'After touching the ceiling above the door, you have touched the coconuts. Now they are no longer fit to be offered to Kṛṣṇa because they are contaminated.'

lines: eta bali' phala phele prācīra laṅghiyā
devanagari: एत बलि’ फल फेले प्राचीर लङ्घिया ।
ऐछे पवित्र प्रेम - सेवा जगत्जिनिया ॥84॥
cc-madhya-15.84.translation: "Such was the service of Rāghava Paṇḍita. He did not accept the coconuts but threw them over the wall. His service is purely based on unalloyed love, and it conquers the whole world.

devanagari: तबे आर नारिकेल संस्कार कराइल ।
परम पवित्र करि’ भोग लागाइल ॥85॥
cc-madhya-15.85.translation: "Thereafter, Rāghava Paṇḍita had other coconuts gathered, cleansed and clipped, and with great attention he offered them to the Deity to eat.

devanagari: एइ - मत कला, आम्र, नारङ्ग, काँठाल ।
याहा याहा दूर - ग्रामे शुनियाछे भाल ॥86॥
cc-madhya-15.86.translation: "In this way he collected excellent bananas, mangoes, oranges, jackfruits and whatever first-class fruits from distant villages he had heard about.

devanagari: बहु - मूल्य दिया आनि’ करिया यतन ।
पवित्र संस्कार करि’ करे निवेदन ॥87॥
cc-madhya-15.87.translation: "All these fruits were collected from distant places and were bought at a high price. After trimming them with great care and purity, Rāghava Paṇḍita offered them to the Deity.

lines: ei mata vyañjanera śāka, mūla, phala
ei mata ciḍā, huḍuma, sandeśa sakala
devanagari: एइ मत व्यञ्जनेर शाक, मूल, फल ।
एइ मत चिड़ा, हुडुम, सन्देश सकल ॥88॥
cc-madhya-15.88.translation: "Thus with great care and attention Rāghava Paṇḍita would prepare spinach, other vegetables, radishes, fruits, chipped rice, powdered rice and sweetmeats.

devanagari: एइ - मत पिठा - पाना, क्षीर - ओदन ।
परम पवित्र, आर करे सर्वोत्तम ॥89॥
cc-madhya-15.89.translation: "He prepared cakes, sweet rice, concentrated milk and everything else with great attention, and the cooking conditions were purified so that the food was first class and tasteful.

devanagari: गले माला देन, माथाय तुलसी - मञ्जरी ।
योड़ - हाते स्तुति करे पदे नमस्क रि’ ॥9॥
cc-madhya-15.9.translation: Śrī Advaita Prabhu would also place a flower garland around the Lord's neck and tulasī flowers [mañjarīs] on His head. Then, with folded hands, Advaita Ācārya would offer obeisances and prayers unto the Lord.

devanagari: काशम्दि, आचार आदि अनेक प्रकार ।
गन्ध, वस्त्र, अलङ्कार, सर्व द्रव्य - सार ॥90॥
cc-madhya-15.90.translation: "Rāghava Paṇḍita would also offer all kinds of pickles, such as kāśamdi. He offered various scents, garments, ornaments and the best of everything.

devanagari: एइ - मत प्रेमेर सेवा करे अनुपम ।
याहा देखि’ सर्व - लोकेर जुड़ाय नयन ॥91॥
cc-madhya-15.91.translation: "Thus Rāghava Paṇḍita would serve the Lord in an incomparable way. Everyone was very satisfied just to see him."

devanagari: एत बलि’ राघवेरे कैल आलिङ्गने ।
एइ - मत सम्मानिल सर्व भक्त - गणे ॥92॥
cc-madhya-15.92.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then mercifully embraced Rāghava Paṇḍita. The Lord also offered all the other devotees a reception with similar respect.

devanagari: शिवानन्द सेने कहे करिया सम्मान ।
वासुदेव - दत्तेर तुमि करिह समाधान ॥93॥
cc-madhya-15.93.translation: The Lord also respectfully told Śivānanda Sena, "Take care of Vāsudeva Datta very nicely.

lines: parama udāra iṅho, ye dina ye āise
sei dine vyaya kare, nāhi rākhe śeṣe
devanagari: परम उदार इँहो, ये दिन ये आइसे ।
सेइ दिने व्यय करे, नाहि राखे शेषे ॥94॥
cc-madhya-15.94.translation: "Vāsudeva Datta is very liberal. Every day, whatever income he receives, he spends. He does not keep any balance.

lines: sañcaya nā kaile kuṭumba-bharaṇa nāhi haya
devanagari: ‘गृहस्थ’ हयेन इँहो, चाहिये सञ्चय ।
सञ्चय ना कैले कुटुम्ब - भरण नाहि हय ॥95॥
cc-madhya-15.95.translation: "Being a householder, Vāsudeva Datta needs to save some money. Because he is not doing so, it is very difficult for him to maintain his family.

devanagari: इहार घरेर आय - व्यय सब - तोमार स्थाने ।
‘सर खे ल’ हञा तुमि करिह समाधाने ॥96॥
cc-madhya-15.96.translation: "Please take care of Vāsudeva Datta's family affairs. Become his manager and make the proper adjustments.

devanagari: प्रति - वर्षे आमार सब भक्त - गण लञा ।
गुण्डिचाय आसिबे सबाय पालन करिया ॥97॥
cc-madhya-15.97.translation: "Come every year and bring all My devotees with you to the Guṇḍicā festival. I also request you to maintain all of them."

devanagari: कुलीन - ग्रामीरे कहे सम्मान करिया ।
प्रत्यब्द आसिबे यात्राय पट्ट - डोरी लञा ॥98॥
cc-madhya-15.98.translation: The Lord then with great respect extended an invitation to all the inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma, asking them to come every year and bring silken rope to carry Lord Jagannātha during the Ratha-yātrā festival.

devanagari: गुणराज - खाँन कैल श्री - कृष्ण - विजय ।
ताहाँ एक - वाक्य ताँर आछे प्रे ममय ॥99॥
cc-madhya-15.99.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "Guṇarāja Khān of Kulīna-grāma compiled a book named Śrī Kṛṣṇa-vijaya in which there is a sentence revealing the author's ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa."

devanagari: गौड़ोद्यानं गौर - मेघः सिञ्चन्स्वालोकनामृतैः ।
भवाग्नि - दग्ध - जनता - वीरुधः समजीवयत् ॥1॥
cc-madhya-16.1.translation: By the nectar of His personal glance, the cloud known as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu poured water upon the garden of Gauḍa-deśa and revived the people, who were like creepers and plants burning in the forest fire of material existence.

lines: yāite sammati nā deya vicchedera bhaya
devanagari: आजि - कालि क रि’ उठाय विविध उपाय ।
याइते सम्मति ना देय विच्छेदेर भय ॥10॥
cc-madhya-16.10.translation: In this way they both presented many impediments, indirectly not granting the Lord permission to go to Vṛndāvana. They did this because they were afraid of separation from Him.

devanagari: ‘कटके’ आसिया कैल ‘गोपाल’ दरशन ।
स्वप्नेश्वर - विप्र कैल प्रभुर निमन्त्रण ॥100॥
cc-madhya-16.100.translation: After reaching the city of Kaṭaka, He saw the temple of Gopāla, and a brāhmaṇa there named Svapneśvara invited the Lord to eat.

lines: bāhira udyāne āsi' prabhu vāsā kaila
devanagari: रामानन्द - राय सब - गणे निमन्त्रिल ।
बाहिर उद्याने आ सि’ प्रभु वासा कैल ॥101॥
cc-madhya-16.101.translation: Rāmānanda Rāya invited all the others for their meals, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu made His resting place in a garden outside the temple.

devanagari: भिक्षा क रि’ बकुल - तले करिला विश्राम ।
प्रतापरुद्र - ठाञि राय करिल पयान ॥102॥
cc-madhya-16.102.translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was taking rest beneath a bakula tree, Rāmānanda Rāya immediately went to Mahārāja Pratāparudra.

devanagari: शुनि’ आनन्दित राजा अति - शीघ्र आइला ।
प्रभु देखि’ दण्डवत्भूमेते पड़िला ॥103॥
cc-madhya-16.103.translation: The King was very happy to hear the news, and he hastily went there. Upon seeing the Lord, he fell flat to offer Him obeisances.

devanagari: पुनः उठे, पुनः पड़े प्रणय - विह्वल ।
स्तुति करे, पुलकाङ, पड़े अश्रु - जल ॥104॥
cc-madhya-16.104.translation: Being overwhelmed with love, the King again and again got up and fell down. When he offered prayers, his whole body shivered, and tears fell from his eyes.

lines: tāṅra bhakti dekhi' prabhura tuṣṭa haila mana
devanagari: ताँर भक्ति देखि’ प्रभुर तुष्ट हैल मन ।
उथि’ महाप्रभु ताँरे कैला आलिङ्गन ॥105॥
cc-madhya-16.105.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very pleased to see the King's devotion, and He therefore stood up and embraced him.

lines: punaḥ stuti kari' rājā karaye praṇāma
devanagari: पुनः स्तुति करि’ राजा करये प्रणाम ।
प्रभु - कृपा - अश्रुते ताँर देह हैल स्नान ॥106॥
cc-madhya-16.106.translation: When the Lord embraced the King, the King again and again offered prayers and obeisances. In this way, the Lord's mercy brought tears from the King, and the Lord's body was bathed with these tears.

devanagari: सुस्थ करि, रामानन्द राजारे वसाइला ।
काय - मनो - वाक्ये प्रभु ताँरे कृपा कैला ॥107॥
cc-madhya-16.107.translation: Finally Rāmānanda Rāya pacified the King and made him sit down. The Lord also bestowed mercy upon him through His body, mind and words.

devanagari: ऐछे ताँहारे कृपा कैल गौरराय ।
“प्रतापरुद्र - सन्त्रा ता” नाम हैल याय ॥108॥
cc-madhya-16.108.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed such mercy to the King that from that day on the Lord became known as Pratāparudra-santrātā, the deliverer of Mahārāja Pratāparudra.

devanagari: राज - पात्र - गण कैल प्रभुर वन्दन ।
राजारे विदाय दिला शचीर नन्दन ॥109॥
cc-madhya-16.109.translation: All the governmental officers also paid their respects to the Lord, and finally the King and his men were bade farewell by the son of mother Śacī.

lines: bhakta-icchā vinā prabhu nā kare gamana
devanagari: यद्यपि स्वतन्त्र प्रभु नहे निवारण ।
भक्त - इच्छा विना प्रभु ना करे गमन ॥11॥
cc-madhya-16.11.translation: Although the Lord is completely independent and incapable of being checked by anyone, He still did not go without the permission of His devotees.

devanagari: बाहिरे आ सि’ राजा आज्ञा - पत्र लेखाइल ।
निज - राज्ये यत ‘विषयी’, ताहारे पाठाइल ॥110॥
cc-madhya-16.110.translation: The King then went outside and had orders written down and sent to the government servants within his kingdom.

devanagari: ‘ग्रामे - ग्रामे’ नूतन आवास करिबा ।
पाँच - सात नव्य - गृहे सामग्रये भरिबा ॥111॥
cc-madhya-16.111.translation: His orders read: "In every village you should construct new residences, and in five or seven new houses, you should store all kinds of food.

devanagari: आपनि प्रभुके लञा ताहाँ उत्तरिबा ।
रात्रि - दिबा वेत्र - हस्ते सेवाय रहिबा ॥112॥
cc-madhya-16.112.translation: "You should personally take the Lord to these newly constructed houses. Day and night you should engage in His service with a stick in your hands."

lines: tāṅre ājñā dila rājā—'kariha sarva kāya
devanagari: दुइ महा - पात्र, - ‘हरिचन्दन’, ‘मर्दराज’ ।
ताँरे आज्ञा दिल राजा - ‘करिह सर्व काय ॥113॥
cc-madhya-16.113.translation: The King ordered two respectable officers named Haricandana and Mardarāja to do whatever was necessary to carry out these orders.

lines: yāhāṅ snāna kari' prabhu yā'na nadī-pāre
devanagari: एक नव्य - नौका आ नि’ राखह नदी - तीरे ।
याहाँ स्नान क रि’ प्रभु या’न नदी - पारे ॥114॥
cc-madhya-16.114-115.translation: The King also ordered them to maintain a new boat on the banks of the river, and wherever Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took His bath or crossed to the other side of the river, they should establish a memorial column and make that place a great place of pilgrimage. "Indeed," said the King, "I will take my bath there. And let me also die there."

devanagari: चतुर्द्वारे करह उत्तम नव्य वास ।
रामानन्द, याह तुमि महाप्रभु - पाश ॥116॥
cc-madhya-16.116.translation: The King continued, "At Caturdvāra, please construct new residential quarters. Now, Rāmānanda, you can return to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

devanagari: सन्ध्याते चलिबे प्रभु, - नृपति शुनिल ।
हस्ती - उपर ताम्बु - गृहे स्त्री - गणे चड़ाइल ॥117॥
cc-madhya-16.117.translation: When the King heard that the Lord was leaving that evening, he immediately made arrangements for some elephants with small tents on their backs to be brought there. Then all the ladies of the palace got on the elephants.

lines: prabhura calibāra pathe rahe sāri hañā
devanagari: प्रभुर चलिबार पथे रहे सारि हञा ।
सन्ध्याते चलिला प्रभु निज - गण लञा ॥118॥
cc-madhya-16.118.translation: All these ladies went to the road the Lord was taking and remained there in a line. That evening, the Lord departed with His devotees.
