cc-madhya-19.159.translation: "Some unnecessary creepers growing with the bhakti creeper are the creepers of behavior unacceptable for those trying to attain perfection, diplomatic behavior, animal killing, mundane profiteering, mundane adoration and mundane importance. All these are unwanted creepers.

devanagari: लोभी कायस्थ - गण राज - कार्य करे ।
आपने स्वगृहे करे शास्त्रेर विचारे ॥16॥
cc-madhya-19.16.translation: The greedy masters of his clerical and secretarial staff performed the government duties while Sanātana personally remained home and discussed revealed scriptures.

lines: stabdha hañā mūla-śākhā bāḍite nā pāya
devanagari: सेक - जल पा ञा उपशाखा बा ड़ि’ याय ।
स्तब्ध ह ञा मूल - शाखा बाड़िते ना पाय ॥160॥
cc-madhya-19.160.translation: "If one does not distinguish between the bhakti-latā creeper and the other creepers, the sprinkling of water is misused because the other creepers are nourished while the bhakti-latā creeper is curtailed.

devanagari: प्रथमेइ उपशाखार करये छेदन ।
तबे मूल - शाखा बा ड़ि’ याय वृन्दावन ॥161॥
cc-madhya-19.161.translation: "As soon as an intelligent devotee sees an unwanted creeper growing beside the original creeper, he must cut it down instantly. Then the real creeper of bhakti-latā-bīja grows nicely, returns home, back to Godhead, and seeks shelter under the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: ‘प्रेम - फल’ पाकि’ पड़े, माली आस्वादय ।
लता अवलम्बि’ माली ‘कल्प - वृक्ष’ पाय ॥162॥
cc-madhya-19.162.translation: "When the fruit of devotional service becomes ripe and falls down, the gardener tastes the fruit and thus takes advantage of the creeper and reaches the desire tree of the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa in Goloka Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: ताहाँ सेइ कल्प - वृक्षेर करये सेवन ।
सुखे प्रेम - फल - रस करे आस्वादन ॥163॥
cc-madhya-19.163.translation: "There the devotee serves the lotus feet of the Lord, which are compared to a wish-fulfilling tree. With great bliss he tastes the juice of the fruit of love and becomes eternally happy.

devanagari: एइत परम - फल ‘परम - पुरुषार्थ’ ।
याँर आगे तृण - तुल्य चारि पुरुषार्थ ॥164॥
cc-madhya-19.164.translation: "To taste the fruit of devotional service at Goloka Vṛndāvana is the highest perfection of life, and in the presence of such perfection, the four material perfections-religion, economic development, sense gratification and liberation-are very insignificant achievements.

lines: brahmānando gurur api camatkārayaty eva tāvat
devanagari: ऋद्धा सिद्धि - व्रज - विजयिता सत्य - धर्मा समाधि र् ब्रह्मानन्दो गुरुरपि चमत्कारयत्येव तावत् ।
यावत्प्रेम्णां मधु - रिपु - वशी - कार - सिद्धौषधीनां गन्धोऽप्यन्तः - करण - सरणी - पान्थतां न प्रयाति ॥165॥
cc-madhya-19.165.translation: "As long as there is not the slightest fragrance of pure love of Kṛṣṇa, which is the perfected medicinal herb for controlling Lord Kṛṣṇa within the heart, the opulences of material perfection-known as the siddhis, the brahminical perfections [satya, śama, titikṣā and so on], the trance of the yogīs and the monistic bliss of Brahman-all seem wonderful for men.

devanagari: ‘शुद्ध - भक्ति’ हैते हय ‘प्रेमा’ उत्पन्न ।
अतएव शुद्ध - भक्तिर कहिये ‘लक्षण’ ॥166॥
cc-madhya-19.166.translation: "When one is situated in pure devotional service, he develops love of Godhead; therefore let me describe some of the symptoms of pure devotional service.

devanagari: अन्याभिलाषिता - शून्यं ज्ञान - कर्माद्यनावृतम् ।
आनुकूल्येन कृष्णानु - शीलनं भक्तिरुत्तमा ॥167॥
cc-madhya-19.167.translation: "When first-class devotional service develops, one must be devoid of all material desires, knowledge obtained by monistic philosophy, and fruitive action. The devotee must constantly serve Kṛṣṇa favorably, as Kṛṣṇa desires.

devanagari: अन्य - वाञ्छा, अन्य - पूजा छाड़ि’ ‘ज्ञान’, ‘कर्म’ ।
आनुकूल्ये सर्वेन्द्रिये कृष्णानुशीलन ॥168॥
cc-madhya-19.168.translation: "A pure devotee must not cherish any other desire than to serve Kṛṣṇa. He should not offer worship to the demigods or to mundane personalities. He should not cultivate artificial knowledge, which is devoid of Kṛṣṇa consciousness, and he should not engage himself in anything other than Kṛṣṇa conscious activities. One must engage all one's purified senses in the service of the Lord. This is the favorable execution of Kṛṣṇa conscious activities.

devanagari: एइ ‘शुद्ध - भक्ति’ - इहा हैते ‘प्रेमा’ हय ।
पञ्चरात्रे, भागवते एइ लक्षण कय ॥169॥
cc-madhya-19.169.translation: "These activities are called śuddha-bhakti, pure devotional service. If one renders such pure devotional service, he develops his original love for Kṛṣṇa in due course of time. In Vedic literatures like the Pañcarātras and Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, these symptoms are described.

devanagari: भट्टाचार्य पण्डित बिश त्रिश लञा ।
भागवत विचार करेन सभाते वसिया ॥17॥
cc-madhya-19.17.translation: Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī used to discuss Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam in an assembly of twenty or thirty learned brāhmaṇa scholars.

devanagari: सर्वोपाधि - विनिर्मुक्तं तत्परत्वेन निर्मलम् ।
हृषीकेण हृषीकेश - सेवनं भक्तिरुच्यते ॥170॥
cc-madhya-19.170.translation: “ 'Bhakti, or devotional service, means engaging all our senses in the service of the Lord, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the master of all the senses. When the spirit soul renders service unto the Supreme, there are two side effects. One is freed from all material designations, and, simply by being employed in the service of the Lord, one's senses are purified.'

devanagari: मद्गुण - श्रुति - मात्रेण मयि सर्व - गुहाशये ।
मनो - गतिरविच्छिन्ना यथा गङ्गाम्भसोऽम्बुधौ ॥171॥
cc-madhya-19.171.translation: “ 'Just as the celestial waters of the Ganges flow unobstructed into the ocean, so when My devotees simply hear of Me, their minds come to Me. I reside in the hearts of all.

devanagari: लक्षणं भक्ति - योगस्य निर्गुणस्य ह्युदाहृतम् ।
अहैतुक्यव्यवहिता या भक्तिः पुरुषोत्तमे ॥172॥
cc-madhya-19.172.translation: “ 'These are the characteristics of transcendental loving service to Puruṣottama, the Supreme Personality of Godhead: it is causeless, and it cannot be obstructed in any way.

devanagari: सालोक्य - सार्ष्टि - सामीप्य - सारूप्यैकत्वमप्युत ।
दीयमानं न गृह्णन्ति विना मत्सेवनं जनाः ॥173॥
cc-madhya-19.173.translation: “ 'My devotees do not accept sālokya, sārṣṭi, sārūpya, sāmīpya or oneness with Me-even if I offer these liberations-in preference to serving Me.

devanagari: स एव भक्ति - योगाख्य आत्यन्तिक उदाहृतः ।
येनातिव्रज्य त्रि - गुणं मद्भावायोपपद्यते ॥174॥
cc-madhya-19.174.translation: “ 'Bhakti-yoga, as described above, is the ultimate goal of life. By rendering devotional service to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, one transcends the modes of material nature and attains the spiritual position on the platform of direct devotional service'

lines: sādhana karile prema utpanna nā haya
devanagari: भुक्ति - मुक्ति आदि - वाञ्छा यदि मने हय ।
साधन करिले प्रेम उत्पन्न ना हय ॥175॥
cc-madhya-19.175.translation: "If one is infected with the desire for material enjoyment or material liberation, he cannot rise to the platform of pure loving service unto the Lord, even though he may superficially render devotional service according to the routine regulative principles.

devanagari: भुक्ति - मुक्ति - स्पृहा यावत्पिशाची हृदि वर्तते ।
तावद्भक्ति - सुखस्यात्र कथमभ्युदयो भवेत् ॥176॥
cc-madhya-19.176.translation: "The material desire to enjoy the material world and the desire to become liberated from material bondage are considered to be two witches, and they haunt one like ghosts. As long as these witches remain within the heart, how can one feel transcendental bliss? As long as these two witches remain in the heart, there is no possibility of enjoying the transcendental bliss of devotional service.

lines: rati gāḍha haile tāra 'prema' nāma kaya
devanagari: साधन - भक्ति हैते हय ‘रति’र उदय ।
रति गाढ़ हैले तार ‘प्रेम’ नाम कय ॥177॥
cc-madhya-19.177.translation: "By regularly rendering devotional service, one gradually becomes attached to the Supreme Personality of Godhead. When that attachment is intensified, it becomes love of Godhead.

devanagari: प्रेम वृद्धि - क्रमे नाम - स्नेह, मान, प्रणय ।
राग, अनुराग, भाव, महाभाव हये ॥178॥
cc-madhya-19.178.translation: "The basic aspects of prema, when gradually increasing to different states, are affection, abhorrence, love, attachment, further attachment, ecstasy and great ecstasy.

lines: yaiche bīja, ikṣu, rasa, guḍa, khaṇḍa-sāra
devanagari: यैछे बीज, इक्ष, रस, गुड़, खण्ड - सार ।
शकर् रा, सिता, मिछरि, उत्तम - मिछरि आर ॥179॥
cc-madhya-19.179.translation: "The gradual development of love may be compared to different states of sugar. First there is the seed of the sugarcane, then sugarcane and then the juice extracted from the cane. When this juice is boiled, it forms a liquid molasses, then a solid molasses, then sugar, candy, rock candy and finally lozenges.

devanagari: आर दिन गौड़ेश्वर, सङ्गे एक - जन ।
आचम्बिते गोसाञि - सभाते कैल आगमन ॥18॥
cc-madhya-19.18.translation: While Sanātana Gosvāmī was studying Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam in the assembly of learned brāhmaṇas, one day the Nawab of Bengal and another person suddenly appeared.

devanagari: एइ सब कृष्ण - भक्ति - रसेर स्थायिभाव ।
स्थायिभावे मिले यदि विभाव, अनुभाव ॥180॥
cc-madhya-19.180.translation: "All these stages combined are called sthāyibhāva, or continuous love of Godhead in devotional service. In addition to these stages, there are vibhāva and anubhāva.

devanagari: सात्त्विक - व्यभिचारि - भावेर मिलने ।
कृष्ण - भक्ति - रस हय अमृत आस्वादने ॥181॥
cc-madhya-19.181.translation: "When the higher standard of ecstatic love is mixed with the symptoms of sāttvika and vyabhicārī, the devotee relishes the transcendental bliss of loving Kṛṣṇa in a variety of nectarean tastes.

lines: yaiche dadhi, sitā, ghṛta, marīca, karpūra
devanagari: यैछे दधि, सिता, घृत, मरीच, कर्पूर ।
मिलने, ‘रसाला’ हय अमृत मधुर ॥182॥
cc-madhya-19.182.translation: "These tastes are like a combination of yogurt, sugar candy, ghee [clarified butter], black pepper and camphor and are as palatable as sweet nectar.

devanagari: भक्त - भेदे रति - भेद पञ्च परकार ।
शान्त - रति, दास्य - रति, सख्य - रति आर ॥183॥
cc-madhya-19.183-184.translation: "According to the devotee, attachment falls within the five categories of śānta-rati, dāsya-rati, sakhya-rati, vātsalya-rati and madhura-rati. These five categories arise from the devotees' different attachments to the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The transcendental mellows derived from devotional service are also of five varieties.

lines: śānta, dāsya, sakhya, vātsalya, madhura-rasa nāma
devanagari: शान्त, दास्य, सख्य, वात्सल्य, मधुर - रस नाम ।
कृष्ण - भक्ति - रस - मध्ये ए पञ्च प्रधान ॥185॥
cc-madhya-19.185.translation: "The chief transcendental mellows experienced with the Supreme Personality of Godhead are five-śānta, dāsya, sakhya, vātsalya and madhura.

devanagari: हास्योऽद्भुतस्तथा वीरः करुणो रौद्र इत्यपि ।
भयानकः स - बीभत्स इति गौणश्च सप्तधा ॥186॥
cc-madhya-19.186.translation: "Besides the five direct mellows, there are seven indirect mellows, known as laughter, wonder, chivalry, compassion, anger, disaster and fear.

lines: hāsya, adbhuta, vīra, karuṇa, raudra, bībhatsa, bhaya
devanagari: हास्य, अद्भुत, वीर, करुण, रौद्र, बीभत्स, भय ।
पञ्च - विध - भक्ते गौण सप्त - रस हय ॥187॥
cc-madhya-19.187.translation: "In addition to the five direct mellows, there are seven indirect mellows, known as laughter, wonder, chivalry, compassion, anger, disaster and fear.

devanagari: पञ्च - रस ‘स्थायी’ व्यापी रहे भक्त - मने ।
सप्त गौण ‘आगन्तुक’ पाइये कारणे ॥188॥
cc-madhya-19.188.translation: "The five direct transcendental mellows of devotional service are permanently situated in the heart of the devotee, whereas the seven indirect emotions appear suddenly under certain conditions and appear more powerful.

devanagari: शान्त - भक्त - नव - योगेन्द्र, सनकादि आर ।
दास्य - भाव - भक्त - सर्वत्र सेवक अपार ॥189॥
cc-madhya-19.189.translation: "Examples of śānta-bhaktas are the nine Yogendras and the four Kumāras. Examples of devotees in dāsya-bhakti are innumerable, for such devotees exist everywhere.

devanagari: पात्साह देखिया सबे सम्भ्रमे उठिला ।
सम्भ्रमे आसन दिया राजारे वसाइला ॥19॥
cc-madhya-19.19.translation: As soon as all the brāhmaṇas and Sanātana Gosvāmī saw the Nawab appear, they all stood up and respectfully gave him a sitting place to honor him.

devanagari: सख्य - भक्त - श्रीदामादि, पुरे भीमार्जुन ।
वात्सल्य - भक्त माता पिता, यत गुरु - जन ॥190॥
cc-madhya-19.190.translation: "In Vṛndāvana, examples of devotees in fraternity are Śrīdāmā and Sudāmā; in Dvārakā the Lord's friends are Bhīma and Arjuna; in Vṛndāvana the devotees in parental love are mother Yaśodā and father Nanda Mahārāja, and in Dvārakā the Lord's parents are Vasudeva and Devakī. There are also other superior persons who are devotees in parental love.

devanagari: मधुर - रसे भक्त - मुख्य - व्रजे गोपी - गण ।
महिषी - गण, लक्ष्मी - गण, असङ्ख्य गणन ॥191॥
cc-madhya-19.191.translation: "The chief devotees in conjugal love are the gopīs in Vṛndāvana, the queens in Dvārakā and the goddesses of fortune in Vaikuṇṭha. These devotees are innumerable.

devanagari: पुनः कृष्ण - रति हय दुइत प्रकार ।
ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञान - मिश्रा, केवला - भेद आर ॥192॥
cc-madhya-19.192.translation: "Attachment for Kṛṣṇa is divided into two categories. One is attachment with awe and reverence, and the other is pure attachment without reverence.

devanagari: गोकुले ‘केवला’ रति - ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञान - हीन ।
पुरी - द्वये, वैकुण्ठाद्ये - ऐश्वर्य - प्रवीण ॥193॥
cc-madhya-19.193.translation: "Pure attachment without reverence is found in Goloka Vṛndāvana. Attachment in which awe and reverence are prominent is found in the two cities Mathurā and Dvārakā and in Vaikuṇṭha.

devanagari: ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञान - प्राधान्ये सङ्कचित प्रीति ।
देखिया ना माने ऐश्वर्य - केवलार रीति ॥194॥
cc-madhya-19.194.translation: "When opulence is very prominent, love of Godhead is somewhat crippled. According to kevalā devotion, however, even though the devotee sees the unlimited potency of Kṛṣṇa, he considers himself equal with Him.

devanagari: शान्त - दास्य - रसे ऐश्वर्य काहाँ उद्दीपन ।
वात्सल्य - सख्य - मधुरे त’ करे सङ्कोचन ॥195॥
cc-madhya-19.195.translation: "On the transcendental platform of neutrality and service, sometimes the opulence of the Lord is prominent. However, in the transcendental mellows of fraternal, paternal and conjugal love, the opulence is minimized.

devanagari: वसुदेव - देवकीर कृष्ण चरण वन्दिल ।
ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञाने दुँहार मने भय हैल ॥196॥
cc-madhya-19.196.translation: "When Kṛṣṇa offered prayers at the lotus feet of His mother and father, Vasudeva and Devakī, they both felt awe, reverence and fear due to knowledge of His opulences.

devanagari: देवकी वसुदेवश्च विज्ञाय जगदीश्वरौ ।
कृत - संवन्दनौ पुत्रौ सस्वजाते न शङ्कितौ ॥197॥
cc-madhya-19.197.translation: “ 'When Devakī and Vasudeva understood that their two sons Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma, who had paid obeisances to them, were the Supreme Personality of Godhead, they became fearful and did not embrace Them.'

lines: kṛṣṇera viśva-rūpa dekhi' arjunera haila bhaya
devanagari: कृष्णेर विश्व - रूप दे खि’ अर्जुनेर हैल भय ।
सख्य - भावे धायै धाष्टर्य क्षमापय करिया विनय ॥198॥
cc-madhya-19.198.translation: "When Kṛṣṇa manifested His universal form, Arjuna became reverent and fearful, and he begged forgiveness for his past impudence toward Kṛṣṇa as a friend.

lines: he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakheti
devanagari: सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति ।
अजानता महिमानं तवेदं मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि ॥199॥
cc-madhya-19.199-200.translation: “ 'I have in the past addressed You as "O Kṛṣṇa," "O Yādava," "O my friend" without knowing Your glories. Please forgive whatever I have done in madness or in love. I have dishonored You many times while we were relaxing, lying on the same bed or eating together, sometimes alone and sometimes in front of many friends. Please excuse me for all my offenses.'

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्या नन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-madhya-19.2.translation: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to all the devotees of the Lord!

lines: vaidya kahe,—vyādhi nāhi, sustha ye dekhiluṅ
devanagari: राजा कहे , - तोमार स्थाने वैद्य पाठाइ लुँ ।
वैद्य कहे , - व्याधि नाहि, सुस्थ ये देखिलुँ ॥20॥
cc-madhya-19.20.translation: The Nawab said, "I sent my physician to you, and he has reported that you are not diseased. As far as he could see, you are completely healthy.

devanagari: कृष्ण यदि रुक्मिणीरे कैला परिहास ।
‘कृष्ण छाड़िबे न’ - जानि’ रुक्मिणीर हैल त्रास ॥201॥
cc-madhya-19.201.translation: "Although Kṛṣṇa was joking with Queen Rukmiṇī, she was thinking that He was going to give up her company, and she was therefore shocked.

devanagari: तस्याः सु - दुःख - भय - शोक - विनष्ट - बुद्धेर् हस्ताच्छ्ल थद्वलयतो व्यजनं पपात ।
देहश्च विक्लव - धियः सहसैव मुह्यन् रम्भेव वात - विहता प्रविकीर्य केशान् ॥202॥
cc-madhya-19.202.translation: “ 'While Kṛṣṇa was joking with Rukmiṇī in Dvārakā, she was full of distress, fear and lamentation. She had also lost her intelligence. She dropped her hand bangles and the fan she was using to fan the Lord. Her hair became disarrayed, and she fainted and fell suddenly, appearing like a banana tree knocked down by high winds.'

devanagari: ‘केवला’र शुद्ध - प्रेम ‘ऐश्वर्य’ ना जाने ।
ऐश्वर्य देखिलेओ नि ज - सम्बन्ध से माने ॥203॥
cc-madhya-19.203.translation: "In the stage of kevalā [unalloyed devotion] a devotee does not consider the unlimited opulence of Kṛṣṇa, even though he experiences it. He takes seriously only his own relationship with Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: त्रय्या चोपनिषद्भिश्च साङ्ख्य - योगैश्च सात्वतैः ।
उपगीयमान - माहात्म्यं हरिं साऽमन्यतात्मजम् ॥204॥
cc-madhya-19.204.translation: “ 'When mother Yaśodā saw all the universes within Kṛṣṇa's mouth, she was astonished for the time being. The Lord is worshiped like Indra and other demigods by the followers of the three Vedas, who offer Him sacrifices. He is worshiped as impersonal Brahman by saintly persons who understand His greatness through studying the Upaniṣads, as the puruṣa by great philosophers who analytically study the universe, as the all-pervading Supersoul by great yogīs, and as the Supreme Personality of Godhead by devotees. Nevertheless, mother Yaśodā considered the Lord her own son.'

devanagari: तं मत्वात्मजमव्यक्तं मर्त्य - लिङ्गमधोक्षजम् ।
गोपिकोलूखले दाम्ना बबन्ध प्राकृतं यथा ॥205॥
cc-madhya-19.205.translation: “ 'Although Kṛṣṇa is beyond sense perception and is unmanifest to human beings, he takes up the guise of a human being with a material body. Thus mother Yaśodā thought Him to be her son, and she bound Lord Kṛṣṇa with rope to a wooden mortar, as if He were an ordinary child.'

devanagari: उवाह कृष्णो भगवान् श्रीदामानं पराजितः ।
वृषभं भद्रसेनस्तु प्रलम्बो रोहिणी - सुतम् ॥206॥
cc-madhya-19.206.translation: “ 'When Kṛṣṇa was defeated by Śrīdāmā, He had to carry him on His shoulders. Similarly, Bhadrasena carried Vṛṣabha, and Pralamba carried Balarāma, the son of Rohiṇī.'

devanagari: सा च मेने तदात्मानं वरिष्ठां सर्व - योषिताम् ।
हित्वा गोपीः काम - याना मामसौ भजते प्रियः ॥207॥
cc-madhya-19.207-209.translation: “ ' "My dearmost Kṛṣṇa, You are worshiping Me and giving up the company of all the other gopīs who wanted to enjoy themselves with You." Thinking like this, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī considered Herself Kṛṣṇa's most beloved gopī. She had become proud and had left the rāsa-līlā with Kṛṣṇa. In the deep forest She said, "My dear Kṛṣṇa, I cannot walk any more. You can take Me wherever You like." When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī petitioned Kṛṣṇa in this way, Kṛṣṇa said, "Just get up upon My shoulders." As soon as Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī began to do so, He disappeared. Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī then began to grieve over Her request and Kṛṣṇa's disappearance.'

lines: āmāra ye kichu kārya, saba tomā lañā
kārya chāḍi' rahilā tumi gharete vasiyā
devanagari: आमार ये किछु कार्य, सब तोमा लञा ।
कार्य छा ड़ि’ रहिला तुमि घरेते वसिया ॥21॥
cc-madhya-19.21.translation: "I am depending on you to carry out so many of my activities, but you have given up your governmental duties to sit here at home.

devanagari: पति - सुतान्वय - भ्रातृ - बान्धवान् अतिविल ङ्घ्य तेऽन्त्यच्युतागताः ।
गति - विदस्तवोद्गीत - मोहिताः कितव योषितः कस्त्यजेन्निशि ॥210॥
cc-madhya-19.210.translation: “ 'Dear Kṛṣṇa, neglecting the order of our husbands and sons, family, brothers and friends and leaving their company, we gopīs have come to You. You know everything about our desires. We have only come because we are attracted by Your supremely musical flute. However, You are a great cheater. Who else would give up the company of young girls like us in the dead of night?'

devanagari: शान्त - रसे - ‘स्वरूप - बुद्ध्ये कृष्णैक - निष्ठता’ ।
“शमो मन्निष्ठता बुद्धेः” इति श्री - मुख - गाथा ॥211॥
cc-madhya-19.211.translation: "When one is fully attached to Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet, one attains the śamatā stage. The word śamatā is derived from the word śama; therefore śānta-rasa, the position of neutrality, means being fully attached to the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. This is the verdict from the mouth of the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself. This state is called self-realization.

devanagari: शमो मन्निष्ठ ता बुद्धेरिति श्री - भगवद्वचः ।
तन्निष्ठा दुर्घटा बुद्धेरेतां शान्त - रतिं विना ॥212॥
cc-madhya-19.212.translation: "These are the words of the Supreme Personality of Godhead: 'When one's intelligence is fully attached to My lotus feet but one does not render practical service, one has attained the stage called śānta-rati, or śama. Without śānta-rati, attachment to Kṛṣṇa is very difficult to achieve.'

devanagari: शमो मन्निष्ठता बुद्धेर्दम इन्द्रिय - संयमः ।
तितिक्षा दुःख - सम्मर्षों जिह्वोपस्थ - जयो धृतिः ॥213॥
cc-madhya-19.213.translation: “ 'The word śama or śānta-rasa indicates that one is attached to the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. Dama means controlling the senses and not being deviated from the Lord's service. Endurance of unhappiness is titikṣā, and dhṛti means controlling the tongue and the genitals.'

devanagari: कृष्ण विना तृष्णा - त्याग - तार कार्य मानि ।
अतएव ‘शान्त’ कृष्ण - भक्त एक जानि ॥214॥
cc-madhya-19.214.translation: "Giving up all desires not connected with Kṛṣṇa is the business of one who is in the śānta-rasa. Only a devotee of Kṛṣṇa can be situated on that platform. He is thus called a śānta-rasa-bhakta.

devanagari: स्वर्ग, मोक्ष कृष्ण - भक्त ‘नरक’ करि’ माने ।
कृष्ण - निष्ठा, तृष्णा - त्याग - शान्तेर दुइ’ गुणे ॥215॥
cc-madhya-19.215.translation: "When a devotee is situated on the platform of śānta-rasa, he desires neither elevation to the heavenly planets nor liberation. These are the results of karma and jñāna, and the devotee considers them no better than hell. A person situated on the śānta-rasa platform manifests the two transcendental qualities of detachment from all material desire and full attachment to Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: नारायण - पराः सर्वे न कुतश्चन बिभ्यति ।
स्वर्गापवर्ग - नरकेष्वपि तुल्यार्थ - दर्शिनः ॥216॥
cc-madhya-19.216.translation: “ 'A person who is devoted to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Nārāyaṇa, is not afraid of anything. Elevation to the heavenly kingdom, condemnation to hell and liberation from material bondage all appear the same to a devotee.'

lines: ei dui guṇa vyāpe saba bhakta-jane
devanagari: एइ दुइ गुण व्यापे सब भक्त - जने ।
आकाशेर ‘शब्द’ - गुण येन भूत - गणे ॥217॥
cc-madhya-19.217.translation: "These two qualities of the śānta stage spread through the lives of all devotees. They are like the quality of sound in the sky. Sound vibration is found in all material elements.

devanagari: शान्तेर स्वभाव - कृष्णे ममता - गन्ध - हीन ।
‘परं - ब्रह्म’ - ’परमात्मा’ - ज्ञान प्रवीण ॥218॥
cc-madhya-19.218.translation: "It is the nature of śānta-rasa that not even the smallest intimacy exists. Rather, knowledge of impersonal Brahman and localized Paramātmā is prominent.

devanagari: केवल ‘स्वरूप - ज्ञान’ हय शान्त - रसे ।
‘पूर्णेश्वर्य - प्रभु - ज्ञान’ अधिक हय दास्ये ॥219॥
cc-madhya-19.219.translation: "On the platform of śānta-rasa, one only realizes his constitutional position. However, when one is raised to the platform of dāsya-rasa, he better understands the full opulence of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

lines: mora yata kārya-kāma, saba kailā nāśa
ki tomāra hṛdaye āche, kaha mora pāśa
devanagari: मोर यत कार्य - काम, सब कैला नाश ।
कि तोमार हृदये आछे, कह मोर पाश ॥22॥
cc-madhya-19.22.translation: "You have spoiled all my activities. What is your intention? Please tell me frankly."

devanagari: ईश्वर - ज्ञान, सम्भ्रम - गौरव प्रचुर ।
‘सेवा’ करि’ कृष्णे सुख देन निरन्तर ॥220॥
cc-madhya-19.220.translation: "On the dāsya-rasa platform, knowledge of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is revealed with awe and veneration. By rendering service unto Lord Kṛṣṇa, the devotee in dāsya-rasa gives constant happiness to the Lord.

devanagari: शान्तेर गुण दास्ये आछे, अधिक - ‘सेवन’ ।
अतएव दास्य - रसेर एइ ‘दुइ’ गुण ॥221॥
cc-madhya-19.221.translation: "The qualities of śānta-rasa are also present in dāsya-rasa, but service is added. Thus the dāsya-rasa platform contains the qualities of both śānta-rasa and dāsya-rasa.

lines: śāntera guṇa, dāsyera sevana—sakhye dui haya
devanagari: शान्तेर गुण, दास्येर सेवन - सख्ये दुइ हय ।
दास्येर ‘सम्भ्रम - गौरव’ - सेवा, सख्ये ‘विश्वास’ - मय ॥222॥
cc-madhya-19.222.translation: "The qualities of śānta-rasa and the service of dāsya-rasa are both present on the platform of sakhya-rasa. On the platform of fraternity, the qualities of dāsya-rasa are mixed with the confidence of fraternity instead of awe and veneration.

lines: kāndhe caḍe, kāndhe caḍāya, kare krīḍā-raṇa
devanagari: कान्धे चड़े, कान्धे चड़ाय, करे क्रीड़ा - रण ।
कृष्णे सेवे, कृष्णे कराय आपन - सेवन! ॥223॥
cc-madhya-19.223.translation: "On the sakhya-rasa platform, the devotee sometimes offers the Lord service and sometimes makes Kṛṣṇa serve him in exchange. In their mock fighting, the cowherd boys would sometimes climb on Kṛṣṇa's shoulders, and sometimes they would make Kṛṣṇa climb on their shoulders.

devanagari: विश्रम्भ - प्रधान सख्य - गौरव - सम्भ्रम - हीन ।
अतएव सख्य - रसेर ‘तिन’ गुण - चिह्न ॥224॥
cc-madhya-19.224.translation: "Since the platform of fraternity is predominated by confidential service, awe and veneration are absent. Therefore sakhya-rasa is characterized by three qualities.

devanagari: ‘ममता’ अधिक, कृष्णे आत्म - सम ज्ञान ।
अतएव सख्य - रसेर वश भगवान् ॥225॥
cc-madhya-19.225.translation: "On the platform of sakhya-rasa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead is obliged to the devotees who are intimate with Kṛṣṇa and think themselves equal to Him.

devanagari: वात्सल्ये शान्तेर गुण, दास्येर सेवन ।
सेइ सेइ सेवनेर इहाँ नाम - ‘पालन’ ॥226॥
cc-madhya-19.226.translation: "On the platform of parental love, the qualities of śānta-rasa, dāsya-rasa and sakhya-rasa are transformed into a form of service called maintenance.

devanagari: सख्येर गुण - ‘असङ्कोच’, ‘अगौरव’ सार ।
ममताधिक्ये ताड़न - भर्सन - व्यवहार ॥227॥
cc-madhya-19.227.translation: "The essence of fraternal love is intimacy devoid of the formality and veneration found in the dāsya-rasa. Due to a greater sense of intimacy, the devotee functioning in paternal love chastises and rebukes the Lord in an ordinary way.

devanagari: आपनारे ‘पालक’ ज्ञान, कृष्णे ‘पाल्य’ - ज्ञान ।
‘चारि’ गुणे वात्सल्य रस - अमृत - समान ॥228॥
cc-madhya-19.228.translation: "On the platform of paternal love, the devotee considers himself the Lord's maintainer. Thus the Lord is the object of maintenance, like a son, and therefore this mellow is full of the four qualities of śānta-rasa, dāsya-rasa, fraternity and parental love. This is more transcendental nectar.

lines: se amṛtānande bhakta saha ḍubena āpane
devanagari: से अमृतानन्दे भक्त सह डुबेन आपने ।
‘कृष्ण - भक्त - वश’ गुण कहे ऐश्वर्य - ज्ञानि - गणे ॥229॥
cc-madhya-19.229.translation: "The exchange of spiritual happiness between Kṛṣṇa and His devotee, in which Kṛṣṇa is controlled by His devotee, is compared to an ocean of nectar into which the devotee and Kṛṣṇa plunge. This is the verdict of learned scholars who appreciate Kṛṣṇa's opulence.

devanagari: सनातन कहे , - नहे आमा हैते काम ।
आर एक - जन दिया कर समाधान ॥23॥
cc-madhya-19.23.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "You can no longer expect any service from me. Please arrange for someone else to tend to the management."

devanagari: इतीदृक्स्व - लीलाभिरानन्द - कुण्डे स्वघोषं निमज्जन्तमाख्यापयन्तम् ।
तदीयेशितज्ञेषु भक्तैर्जितत्वं पुनः प्रेमतस्तं शतावृत्ति वन्दे ॥230॥
cc-madhya-19.230.translation: “ 'Again let me offer my respectful obeisances unto the Supreme Personality of Godhead. O my Lord, I offer my obeisances hundreds and thousands of times with all affection because by Your personal pastimes You plunge the gopīs into an ocean of nectar. Appreciating Your opulence, devotees generally declare that You are always subjugated by their feelings.'

devanagari: मधुर - रसे - कृष्ण - निष्ठा, सेवा अतिशय ।
सख्येर असङ्कोच, लालन - ममताधिक्य हय ॥231॥
cc-madhya-19.231.translation: "On the platform of conjugal love, attachment for Kṛṣṇa, rendering service unto Him, the relaxed feelings of fraternity and the feelings of maintenance all increase in intimacy.

devanagari: कान्त - भावे निजाङ्ग दिया करेन सेवन ।
अतएव मधुर - रसेर हय ‘पञ्च’ गुण ॥232॥
cc-madhya-19.232.translation: "On the platform of conjugal love, the devotee offers his body in the service of the Lord. Thus on this platform all five transcendental qualities are present.

lines: ākāśādi guṇa yena para para bhūte
devanagari: आकाशादि गुण येन पर पर भूते ।
एक - दुइ - तिन - चारि क्रमे पञ्च पृथिवीते ॥233॥
cc-madhya-19.233.translation: "All the material qualities evolve one after another in the material elements, beginning from ether. By gradual evolution, first one quality develops, then two qualities develop, then three and four, until all five qualities are found in earth.

devanagari: एइ - मत मधुरे सब भाव - समाहार ।
अतएव आस्वादाधिक्ये करे चमत्कार ॥234॥
cc-madhya-19.234.translation: "Similarly, on the platform of conjugal love, all the feelings of the devotees are amalgamated. The intensified taste is certainly wonderful."

devanagari: एइ भक्ति - रसेर करिलाङ दिग्दरशन ।
इहार विस्तार मने करिह भावन ॥235॥
cc-madhya-19.235.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then concluded: "I have simply given a general survey describing the mellows of devotional service. You can consider how to adjust and expand this.

devanagari: भाविते भाविते कृष्ण स्फुरये अन्तरे ।
कृष्ण - कृपाय अज्ञ पाय रस - सिन्धु - पारे ॥236॥
cc-madhya-19.236.translation: "When one thinks of Kṛṣṇa constantly, love for Him is manifest within the heart. Even though one may be ignorant, one can reach the shore of the ocean of transcendental love by Lord Kṛṣṇa's mercy."

lines: eta bali' prabhu tāṅre kailā āliṅgana
devanagari: एत ब लि’ प्रभु ताँरे कैला आलिङ्गन ।
वाराणसी चलिबारे प्रभुर हैल मन ॥237॥
cc-madhya-19.237.translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. The Lord then decided to go to the city of Benares.

lines: tabe tāṅra pade rūpa kare nivedana
devanagari: प्रभाते उठिया यबे करिला गमन ।
तबे ताँर पदे रूप करे निवेदन ॥238॥
cc-madhya-19.238.translation: The next morning, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arose and prepared to leave for Vārāṇasī [Benares], Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī made the following statement at the Lord's lotus feet.

devanagari: ‘आज्ञा हय, आसि मुञि श्री - चरण - सङ्गे ।
सहिते ना पारि मुञि विरह - तरङ्गे’ ॥239॥
cc-madhya-19.239.translation: "If You give me permission, I shall go with Your Lordship. It is not possible for me to tolerate the waves of separation."

lines: tabe kruddha hañā rājā kahe āra-bāra
devanagari: तबे क्रुद्ध हञा राजा कहे आर - बार ।
तोमार ‘बड़ भाइ’ करे दस्यु - व्यवहार ॥24॥
cc-madhya-19.24.translation: Becoming angry with Sanātana Gosvāmī, the Nawab said, "Your elder brother is acting just like a plunderer.

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - तोमार कर्तव्य, आमार वचन ।
निकटे आसियाछ तुमि, याह वृन्दावन ॥240॥
cc-madhya-19.240.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Your duty is to carry out My order. You have come near Vṛndāvana. Now you should go there.

devanagari: वृन्दावन हैते तुमि गौड़ - देश दिया ।
आमारे मिलिबा नीलाचलेते आसिया ॥241॥
cc-madhya-19.241.translation: "Later, you can go from Vṛndāvana to Jagannātha Purī through Bengal [Gauḍa-deśa]. There you will meet Me again."

devanagari: ताँरे आलिङ्गिया प्रभु नौकाते चड़िला ।
मूर्च्छित हञा तेंहो ताहा ञि पड़िला ॥242॥
cc-madhya-19.242.translation: After embracing Rūpa Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got into a boat. Rūpa Gosvāmī fainted and fell down on the spot.

devanagari: दाक्षिणात्य - विप्र ताँरे घरे ला ञा गेला ।
तबे दुइ भाइ वृन्दावनेरे चलिला ॥243॥
cc-madhya-19.243.translation: The brāhmaṇa from Deccan took Rūpa Gosvāmī to his home, and thereafter the two brothers departed for Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: महाप्रभु चलि’ चलि’ आइला वाराणसी ।
चन्द्रशेखर मिलिला ग्रामेर बाहिरे आसि’ ॥244॥
cc-madhya-19.244.translation: After walking and walking, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu finally arrived at Vārāṇasī, where He met Candraśekhara, who was coming out of the city.

lines: rātre teṅho svapna dekhe,—prabhu āilā ghare
devanagari: रात्रे तेंहो स्वप्न देखे , - प्रभु आइला घरे ।
प्रातःकाले आसि’ रहे ग्रामेर बाहिरे ॥245॥
cc-madhya-19.245.translation: In a dream Candraśekhara had seen that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had come to his home; therefore in the morning Candraśekhara went outside the city to receive the Lord.

devanagari: आचम्बिते प्रभु देखि’ चरणे पड़िला ।
आनन्दित ह ञा निज - गृहे लञा गेला ॥246॥
cc-madhya-19.246.translation: While Candraśekhara was waiting outside the city, he suddenly saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrive, and he fell down at the Lord's feet. Being very happy, he took the Lord to his home.

devanagari: तपन - मिश्र शुनि’ आसि’ प्रभुरे मिलिला ।
इष्ट - गोष्ठी करि’ प्रभुर निमन्त्रण कैला ॥247॥
cc-madhya-19.247.translation: Tapana Miśra also heard news of the Lord's arrival in Vārāṇasī, and he went to Candraśekhara's house to meet Him. After talking, he invited the Lord to take lunch at his place.

lines: nija ghare lañā prabhure bhikṣā karāila
devanagari: निज घरे लञा प्रभुरे भिक्षा कराइल ।
भट्टाचार्ये चन्द्रशेखर निमन्त्रण कैल ॥248॥
cc-madhya-19.248.translation: Tapana Miśra took Caitanya Mahāprabhu to his own house and gave Him lunch. Candraśekhara invited Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya to take lunch at his home.

lines: bhikṣā karāñā miśra kahe prabhu-pāya dhari'
eka bhikṣā māgi, more deha' kṛpā kari'
devanagari: भिक्षा करा ञा मिश्र कहे प्रभु - पाय ध रि’ ।
एक भिक्षा मागि, मोरे दे ह’ कृपा करि’ ॥249॥
cc-madhya-19.249.translation: After offering lunch to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Tapana Miśra begged a favor from the Lord and requested Him to reward him mercy.

lines: jīva-bahu māri' kaila cāklā saba nāśa
ethā tumi kailā mora sarva kārya nāśa
devanagari: जीव - बहु मारि’ कैल चाक्ला सब नाश ।
एथा तुमि कैला मोर सर्व कार्य नाश ॥25॥
cc-madhya-19.25.translation: "By killing many living entities, your elder brother has destroyed all Bengal. Now here you are destroying all my plans."

lines: mora ghara vinā bhikṣā nā karibā kati
devanagari: यावत्तोमार हय काशी - पुरे स्थिति ।
मोर घर विना भिक्षा ना करिबा कति ॥250॥
cc-madhya-19.250.translation: Tapana Miśra said, "As long as Your Lordship stays in Vārāṇasī, please do not accept an invitation from anyone but me."

lines: sannyāsīra saṅge bhikṣā kāhāṅ nā kariba
devanagari: प्रभु जानेन - दिन पाँच - सात से रहिब ।
सन्न्यासी र सङ्गे भिक्षा काहाँ ना करिब ॥251॥
cc-madhya-19.251.translation: It was known to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that He would remain there only five or seven days. He would not accept any invitation that involved Māyāvādī sannyāsīs.

lines: eta jāni' tāṅra bhikṣā kailā aṅgīkāra
devanagari: एत जा नि’ ताँर भिक्षा कैला अङ्गीकार ।
वासा - निष्ठा कैला चन्द्रशेखरेर घर ॥252॥
cc-madhya-19.252.translation: With this understanding, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu agreed to accept lunch at the place of Tapana Miśra. The Lord made His residence at the home of Candraśekhara.

lines: prabhu tāṅre sneha kari' kṛpā prakāśilā
devanagari: महाराष्ट्रीय विप्र आसि’ ताँहारे मिलिला ।
प्रभु ताँरे स्नेह करि’ कृपा प्रकाशिला ॥253॥
cc-madhya-19.253.translation: The Mahārāṣṭrīya brāhmaṇa came, and the Lord met him. Out of affection, the Lord bestowed His mercy upon him.

lines: mahāprabhu āilā śuni' śiṣṭa śiṣṭa jana
devanagari: महाप्रभु आइला शुनि’ शिष्ट शिष्ट जन ।
ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय आसि’ करेन दरशन ॥254॥
cc-madhya-19.254.translation: Hearing that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had come, all the respectable members of the brāhmaṇa and kṣatriya communities came to see Him.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - उपरे प्रभुर यत कृपा हैल ।
अत्यन्त विस्तार - कथा सङ्क्षेपे कहिल ॥255॥
cc-madhya-19.255.translation: Much mercy was thus bestowed upon Śrī Rupa Gosvāmī, and I have briefly described all those topics.

lines: śraddhā kari' ei kathā śune ye jane
devanagari: श्रद्धा करि’ एइ कथा शुने येइ जने ।
प्रेम - भक्ति पाय सेइ चैतन्य - चरणे ॥256॥
cc-madhya-19.256.translation: Whoever hears this narration with faith and love certainly develops love of God at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥257॥
cc-madhya-19.257.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

lines: ye yei doṣa kare, deha' tāra phala
devanagari: सनातन कहे , - तुमि स्वतन्त्र गौड़ेश्वर ।
ये येइ दोष करे, देह’ तार फल ॥26॥
cc-madhya-19.26.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī said, "You are the supreme ruler of Bengal and are completely independent. Whenever someone commits a fault, you punish him accordingly."

lines: eta śuni' gauḍeśvara uṭhi' ghare gelā
devanagari: एत शुनि’ गौड़ेश्वर उ ठि’ घरे गेला ।
पलाइब ब लि’ सनातनेरे बान्धिला ॥27॥
cc-madhya-19.27.translation: Hearing this, the Nawab of Bengal stood up and returned to his home. He ordered the arrest of Sanātana Gosvāmī so that he would not be able to leave.

devanagari: हेन - काले गेल राजा उड़िया मारिते ।
सनातने कहे , - तुमि चल मोर साथे ॥28॥
cc-madhya-19.28.translation: At this time, the Nawab was going to attack the province of Orissa, and he told Sanātana Gosvāmī, "Come along with me."

lines: teṅho kahe,—yābe tumi devatāya duḥkha dite
mora śakti nāhi, tomāra saṅge yāite
devanagari: तेंहो कहे, - याबे तुमि देवताय दुःख दिते ।
मोर शक्ति नाहि, तोमार सङ्गे याइते ॥29॥
cc-madhya-19.29.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "You are going to Orissa to give pain to the Supreme Personality of Godhead. For this reason I am powerless to go with you."

devanagari: श्री - रूप - सनातन रहे रामकेलि - ग्रामे ।
प्रभुरे मिलिया गेला आपन - भवने ॥3॥
cc-madhya-19.3.translation: After meeting Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in the village of Rāmakeli, the brothers Rūpa and Sanātana returned to their homes.

lines: tabe tāṅre bāndhi' rākhi' karilā gamana
ethā nīlācala haite prabhu calilā vṛndāvana
devanagari: तबे ताँरे बान्धि’ राखि’ करिला गमन ।
एथा नीलाचल हैते प्रभु चलिला वृन्दावन ॥30॥
cc-madhya-19.30.translation: The Nawab again arrested Sanātana Gosvāmī and kept him in prison. At this time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu departed for Vṛndāvana from Jagannātha Purī.

lines: tabe sei dui cara rūpa-ṭhāñi āila
devanagari: तबे सेइ दुइ चर रूप - ठाञि आइल ।
‘वृन्दावन चलिला प्रभु’ - आसिया कहिल ॥31॥
cc-madhya-19.31.translation: The two persons who went to Jagannātha Purī to inquire about the Lord's departure returned and informed Rūpa Gosvāmī that the Lord had already departed for Vṛndāvana.

devanagari: शुनिया श्री - रूप लिखिल सनातन - ठाञि ।
‘वृन्दावन चलिला श्री - चैतन्य - गोसाञि ॥32॥
cc-madhya-19.32.translation: Upon receiving this message from his two messengers, Rūpa Gosvāmī immediately wrote a letter to Sanātana Gosvāmī saying that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had departed for Vṛndāvana.

lines: tumi yaiche taiche chuṭi' āisa tāhāṅ haite
devanagari: आमि - दुइ - भाइ चलिलाङताँहारे मिलिते ।
तुमि यैछे तैछे छुटि’ आइस ताहाँ हैते ॥33॥
cc-madhya-19.33.translation: In his letter to Sanātana Gosvāmī, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī wrote, "We two brothers are starting out to go see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. You must also somehow or other get released and come meet us."

devanagari: दश - सहस्र मुद्रा तथा आछे मुदि - स्थाने ।
ताहा दिया कर शीघ्र आत्म - विमोचने ॥34॥
cc-madhya-19.34.translation: Rūpa Gosvāmī further informed Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī: "I have left a deposit of ten thousand coins with the grocer. Use that money to get out of prison.

lines: yaiche taiche chuṭi' tumi āisa vṛndāvana'
devanagari: यैछे तैछे छुटि’ तुमि आइस वृन्दावन’ ।
एत लि खि’ दुइ - भाइ करिला गमन ॥35॥
cc-madhya-19.35.translation: "Somehow or other get yourself released and come to Vṛndāvana." After writing this, the two brothers [Rūpa Gosvāmī and Anupama] went to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: अनुपम मल्लिक, ताँर नाम - ‘श्री - वल्ल भ’ ।
रूप - गोसाञि र छोट - भाइ - परम - वैष्णव ॥36॥
cc-madhya-19.36.translation: Rūpa Gosvāmī's younger brother was a great devotee whose actual name was Śrī Vallabha, but he was given the name Anupama Mallika.

devanagari: ताँहा लञा रूप - गोसाञि प्रयागे आइला ।
महाप्रभु ताहाँ शुनि’ आनन्दित हैला ॥37॥
cc-madhya-19.37.translation: Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī and Anupama Mallika went to Prayāga, and they were very pleased to hear news that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was there.

lines: lakṣa lakṣa loka āise prabhura milane
devanagari: प्रभु चलियाछेन बिन्दु - माधव - दरशने ।
लक्ष लक्ष लोक आइसे प्रभुर मिलने ॥38॥
cc-madhya-19.38.translation: At Prayāga, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see the temple of Bindu Mādhava, and many hundreds of thousands of people followed Him just to meet Him.

lines: keha kānde, keha hāse, keha nāce, gāya
devanagari: केह कान्दे, केह हासे, केह नाचे, गाय ।
‘कृष्ण’ ‘कृष्ण’ बलि’ केह गड़ागड़ि याय ॥39॥
cc-madhya-19.39.translation: Some of the people following the Lord were crying. Some were laughing, some dancing and some chanting. Indeed, some of them were rolling on the ground, exclaiming, "Kṛṣṇa! Kṛṣṇa!"

devanagari: दुइ - भाइ विषय - त्यागेर उपाय सृजिल ।
बहु - धन दिया दुइ ब्राह्मणे वरिल ॥4॥
cc-madhya-19.4.translation: The two brothers devised a means whereby they could give up their material activities. For this purpose, they appointed two brāhmaṇas and paid them a large amount of money.

devanagari: गङ्गा - यमुना प्रयाग नारिल डुबाइते ।
प्रभु डुबाइल कृष्ण - प्रेमेर वन्याते ॥40॥
cc-madhya-19.40.translation: Prayāga is located at the confluence of two rivers—the Ganges and the Yamunā. Although these rivers were not able to flood Prayāga with water, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inundated the whole area with waves of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

lines: bhiḍa dekhi' dui bhāi rahilā nirjane
devanagari: भिड़ दे खि’ दुइ भाइ रहिला निर्जने ।
प्रभुर आवेश हैल माधव - दरशने ॥41॥
cc-madhya-19.41.translation: Seeing the great crowd, the two brothers remained standing in a secluded place. They could see that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was ecstatic to see Lord Bindu Mādhava.

devanagari: प्रेमावेशे नाचे प्रभु हरि - ध्वनि करि’ ।
ऊर्ध्व - बाहु करि’ बले - बल ‘हरि’ ‘हरि’ ॥42॥
cc-madhya-19.42.translation: The Lord was loudly chanting the holy name of Hari. Dancing in ecstatic love and raising His arms, He asked everyone to chant "Hari! Hari!"

devanagari: प्रभुर महिमा देखि’ लोके चमत्कार ।
प्रयागे प्रभुर लीला नारि वर्णिबार ॥43॥
cc-madhya-19.43.translation: Everyone was astounded to see the greatness of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Indeed, I cannot properly describe the pastimes of the Lord at Prayāga.

devanagari: दाक्षिणात्य - विप्र - सने आछे परिचय ।
सेइ विप्र निमन्त्रिया निल निजालय ॥44॥
cc-madhya-19.44.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had made an acquaintance with a brāhmaṇa from Deccan [in South India], and that brāhmaṇa invited Him for meals and took Him to his place.

devanagari: विप्र - गृहे आसि’ प्रभु निभृते वसिला ।
श्री - रूप - वल्लभ दुँहे आसिया मिलिला ॥45॥
cc-madhya-19.45.translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was sitting in a solitary place in the home of that Deccan brāhmaṇa, Rūpa Gosvāmī and Śrī Vallabha [Anupama Mallika] came to meet Him.

lines: prabhu dekhi' dūre paḍe daṇḍavat hañā
devanagari: दुइ - गुच्छ तृण दुँहे दशने धरिया ।
प्रभु देखि’ दूरे पड़े दण्डवत् हञा ॥46॥
cc-madhya-19.46.translation: Seeing the Lord from a distance, the two brothers put two clumps of straw between their teeth and immediately fell down on the ground like rods, offering Him obeisances.

lines: nānā śloka paḍi' uṭhe, paḍe bāra bāra
devanagari: नाना श्लोक प ड़ि’ उठे, पड़े बार बार ।
प्रभु देखि’ प्रेमावेश हइल दुँहार ॥47॥
cc-madhya-19.47.translation: Both brothers were overwhelmed with ecstatic emotion, and reciting various Sanskrit verses, they stood up and fell down again and again.

lines: śrī-rūpe dekhiyā prabhura prasanna haila mana
devanagari: श्री - रूपे देखिया प्रभुर प्रसन्न हैल मन ।
‘उठ, उठ, रूप, आइस’, बलिला वचन ॥48॥
cc-madhya-19.48.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very pleased to see Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, and He told him, "Stand up! Stand up! My dear Rūpa, come here."

lines: kṛṣṇera karuṇā kichu nā yāya varṇane
devanagari: कृष्णेर करुणा किछु ना याय वर्णने ।
विषय - कूप हैते काड़िल तोमा दुइजने ॥49॥
cc-madhya-19.49.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "It is not possible to describe Kṛṣṇa's mercy, for He has delivered you both from the well of material enjoyment.

devanagari: कृष्ण - मन्त्रे कराइल दुइ पुरश्चरण ।
अचिरात्पाइबारे चैत न्य - चरण ॥5॥
cc-madhya-19.5.translation: The brāhmaṇas performed religious ceremonies and chanted the holy name of Kṛṣṇa so that the two brothers might attain shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu very soon.

lines: sa ca pūjyo yathā hy aham
devanagari: न मेऽभक्तश्चतुर्वेदी मद्भक्तः श्व - पचः प्रियः ।
तस्मै देयं ततो ग्राह्यं स च पूज्यो यथा ह्यहम् ॥50॥
cc-madhya-19.50.translation: “ 'Even though a person is a very learned scholar of the Sanskrit Vedic literatures, he is not accepted as My devotee unless he is pure in devotional service. Even though a person is born in a family of dog-eaters, he is very dear to Me if he is a pure devotee who has no motive to enjoy fruitive activities or mental speculation. Indeed, all respects should be given to him, and whatever he offers should be accepted. Such devotees are as worshipable as I am.' "

lines: ei śloka paḍi' duṅhāre kailā āliṅgana
devanagari: एइ श्लोक प ड़ि’ दुँहारे कैला आलिङ्गन ।
कृपाते दुँहार माथाय धरिला चरण ॥51॥
cc-madhya-19.51.translation: After reciting this verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced both brothers, and out of His causeless mercy He placed His feet on their heads.

lines: prabhu-kṛpā pāñā duṅhe dui hāta yuḍi'
dīna hañā stuti kare vinaya ācari'
devanagari: प्रभु - कृपा पाञा दुँहे दुइ हात युड़ि’ ।
दीन हञा स्तुति करे विनय आचरि’ ॥52॥
cc-madhya-19.52.translation: After receiving the Lord's causeless mercy, the brothers folded their hands and in great humility offered the following prayers unto the Lord.

devanagari: नमो महा - वदान्याय कृष्ण - प्रेम - प्रदाय ते ।
कृष्णाय कृष्ण - चैतन्य - नाम्ने गौर - त्विषे नमः ॥53॥
cc-madhya-19.53.translation: "O most munificent incarnation! You are Kṛṣṇa Himself appearing as Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu. You have assumed the golden color of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, and You are widely distributing pure love of Kṛṣṇa. We offer our respectful obeisances unto You.

devanagari: योऽज्ञान - मत्तं भुवनं दयालुर् उल्लाघयन्न प्यकरोत्प्रमत्तम् ।
स्व - प्रेम - सम्पत्सुधयाद्भुतेहं श्री कृष्ण - चैतन्यममुं प्रपद्ये ॥54॥
cc-madhya-19.54.translation: "We offer our respectful obeisances unto that merciful Supreme Personality of Godhead who has converted all three worlds, which were maddened by ignorance, and saved them from their diseased condition by making them mad with the nectar from the treasure-house of love of God. Let us take full shelter of that Personality of Godhead, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, whose activities are wonderful."

devanagari: तबे महाप्रभु ताँरे निकटे वसाइला ।
‘सनातनेर वार्ता क ह’ - ताँहारे पुछिला ॥55॥
cc-madhya-19.55.translation: After this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat them down by His side and asked them, "What news do you have of Sanātana?"

lines: tumi yadi uddhāra', tabe ha-ibe uddhāre
devanagari: रूप कहेन , - तेंहो बन्दी हय राज - घरे ।
तुमि यदि उद्धार’, तबे हइबे उद्धारे ॥56॥
cc-madhya-19.56.translation: Rūpa Gosvāmī replied, "Sanātana has now been arrested by the government of Hussain Shah. If You kindly save him, he can be liberated from that entanglement."

devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - सनात नेर हा ञाछे मोचन ।
अचिरात् आमा - सह हइबे मिलन ॥57॥
cc-madhya-19.57.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately replied, "Sanātana has already been released from his confinement, and he will very soon meet with Me."

devanagari: मध्याह्न करिते विप्र प्रभुरे कहिला ।
रूप - गोसाञि से - दिवस तथा ञि रहिला ॥58॥
cc-madhya-19.58.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was then requested by the brāhmaṇa to accept His lunch. Rūpa Gosvāmī also remained there that day.

devanagari: भट्टाचार्य दुइ भाइये निमन्त्रण कैल ।
प्रभुर शेष प्रसाद - पात्र दुइ - भाइ पाइल ॥59॥
cc-madhya-19.59.translation: Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya invited the two brothers to take lunch also. The remnants of food from the plate of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were offered to them.

lines: śrī-rūpa-gosāñi āpanāra ghare āilā bahu-dhana lañā
devanagari: श्री - रूप - गोसाञि तबे नौकाते भरिया ।
आपनार घरे आइला बहु - धन लञा ॥6॥
cc-madhya-19.6.translation: At this time, Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī returned home, taking with him large quantities of riches loaded in boats.

devanagari: त्रिवेणी - उपर प्रभुर वासा - घर स्थान ।
दुइ भाइ वासा कैल प्रभु - सन्निधान ॥60॥
cc-madhya-19.60.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu selected His residence beside the confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā at a place called Triveṇī. The two brothers-Rūpa Gosvāmī and Śrī Vallabha-selected their residence near the Lord's.

lines: mahāprabhu āilā śuni' āila tāṅra sthāne
devanagari: से - काले वल्लभ - भट्ट रहे आड़ाइल - ग्रामे ।
महाप्रभु आइला शुनि’ आइल ताँर स्थाने ॥61॥
cc-madhya-19.61.translation: At that time, Śrī Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was staying at Āḍāila-grāma, and when he heard that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had arrived, he went to His place to see Him.

lines: teṅho daṇḍavat kaila, prabhu kailā āliṅgana
devanagari: तेंहो दण्डवत्कैल, प्रभु कैला आलि ङ्गन ।
दुइ जने कृष्ण - कथा हैल कत - क्षण ॥62॥
cc-madhya-19.62.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya offered Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu his obeisances, and the Lord embraced him. After that, they discussed topics about Kṛṣṇa for some time.

devanagari: कृष्ण - कथाय प्रभुर महा - प्रेम उथलिल ।
भट्टेर सङ्कोचे प्रभु सम्वरण कैल ॥63॥
cc-madhya-19.63.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt great ecstatic love when they began discussing Kṛṣṇa, but the Lord checked His feelings because He felt shy before Vallabha Bhaṭṭa.

devanagari: अन्तरे गर - गर प्रेम, नहे सम्वरण ।
देखि’ चमत्कार हैल वल्लभ - भट्टेर मन ॥64॥
cc-madhya-19.64.translation: Although the Lord restrained Himself externally, ecstatic love raged within. There was no checking that. Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was astonished to detect this.

devanagari: तबे भट्ट महाप्रभुरे निमन्त्रण कैला ।
महाप्रभु दुइ - भाइ ताँहारे मिलाइला ॥65॥
cc-madhya-19.65.translation: Thereafter, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for lunch, and the Lord introduced the brothers Rūpa and Vallabha to him.

lines: bhaṭṭe daṇḍavat kailā ati dīna hañā
devanagari: दुइ - भाइ दूर हैते भूमिते पड़िया ।
भट्टे दण्डवत्केला अति दीन ह ञा ॥66॥
cc-madhya-19.66.translation: From a distance, the brothers Rūpa Gosvāmī and Śrī Vallabha fell on the ground and offered obeisances to Vallabha Bhaṭṭa with great humility.

lines: bhaṭṭa milibāre yāya, duṅhe palāya dūre
devanagari: भट्ट मिलिबारे याय, दुँहे पलाय दूरे ।
‘अस्पृश्य पामर मुञि, ना छुँइह मो रे’ ॥67॥
cc-madhya-19.67.translation: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya walked toward them, they ran away to a more distant place. Rūpa Gosvāmī said, "I am untouchable and most sinful. Please do not touch me."

lines: bhaṭṭera vismaya haila, prabhura harṣa mana
devanagari: भट्टेर विस्मय हैल, प्रभुर हर्ष मन ।
भट्टेरे कहिला प्रभु ताँर विवरण ॥68॥
cc-madhya-19.68.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya was very surprised at this. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, however, was very pleased, and He therefore spoke to him this description of Rūpa Gosvāmī.

devanagari: ‘इँहो ना स्पर्शह, इँहो जाति अति - हीन! ।
वैदिक, याज्ञिक तुमि कुलीन प्रवीण!’ ॥69॥
cc-madhya-19.69.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Don't touch him, for he belongs to a very low caste. You are a follower of Vedic principles and are a well experienced performer of many sacrifices. You also belong to the aristocracy."

devanagari: ब्राह्मण - वैष्णवे दिला तार अर्ध - धने ।
एक चौठि धन दिला कुटुम्ब - भरणे ॥7॥
cc-madhya-19.7.translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī divided the wealth that he brought back home. He gave fifty percent in charity to brāhmaṇas and Vaiṣṇavas and twenty-five percent to his relatives.

lines: bhaṭṭa kahe, prabhura kichu iṅgita-bhaṅgī jāni'
devanagari: दुँहार मुखे निरन्तर कृष्ण - नाम शुनि’ ।
भट्ट कहे, प्रभुर किछु इङ्गित - भङ्गी जानि’ ॥70॥
cc-madhya-19.70.translation: Hearing the holy name constantly vibrated by the two brothers, Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya could understand the hints of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

devanagari: ‘दुँहार मुखे कृष्ण - नाम करिछे नर्तन ।
एइ - दुइ ‘अधम’ नहे, हय ‘सर्वोत्तम’ ॥71॥
cc-madhya-19.71.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya admitted, "Since these two are constantly chanting the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, how can they be untouchable? On the contrary, they are most exalted."

lines: tepus tapas te juhuvuḥ sasnur āryā
devanagari: अहो बत श्व - पचोऽतो गरीयान् यजिह्वा ये वर्तते नाम तुभ्यम् ।
तेपुस्तपस्ते जुहुवुः सस्नुरा ब्रह्मानूचुर्नाम गृणन्ति ये ते ॥72॥
cc-madhya-19.72.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya then recited the following verse: " 'My dear Lord, one who always keeps Your holy name on his tongue becomes greater than an initiated brāhmaṇa. Although he may be born in a family of dog-eaters and may therefore, by material calculation, be the lowest among men, he is still glorious. This is the wonderful effect of chanting the holy name of the Lord. It is therefore concluded that one who chants the holy name of the Lord should be understood to have performed all kinds of austerities and great sacrifices mentioned in the Vedas. He has already taken his bath in all the holy places of pilgrimage. He has studied all the Vedas, and he is actually an Āryan.' "

devanagari: शुनि’ महाप्रभु ताँरे बहु प्रशंसिला ।
प्रेमाविष्ट ह ञा श्लोक पड़िते लागिला ॥73॥
cc-madhya-19.73.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very pleased to hear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa quoting from śāstra about the position of a devotee. The Lord praised him personally, and, feeling ecstatic love of Godhead, began to quote many verses from śāstra.

devanagari: शुचिः सद्भक्ति - दीप्ताग्नि - दग्ध - दुर्जाति - कल्मषः ।
श्व - पाकोऽपि बुधैः श्लाघ्यो न वेद - ज्ञोऽपि नास्तिकः ॥74॥
cc-madhya-19.74.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, " 'A person who has the pure characteristics of a brāhmaṇa due to devotional service, which is like a blazing fire burning to ashes all the sinful reactions of past lives, is certainly saved from the consequences of sinful acts, such as taking birth in a lower family. Even though he may be born in a family of dog-eaters, he is recognized by learned scholars. However, although a person may be a learned scholar in Vedic knowledge, he is not recognized if he is an atheist.

devanagari: भगवद्भक्ति - हीनस्य जातिः शास्त्रं जपस्तपः ।
अप्राणस्येव देहस्य मण्डनं लोक - रञ्जनम् ॥75॥
cc-madhya-19.75.translation: “ 'For a person devoid of devotional service, birth in a great family or nation, knowledge of revealed scripture, performance of austerities and penance, and chanting of Vedic mantras are all like ornaments on a dead body. Such ornaments simply serve the concocted pleasures of the general populace.' "

devanagari: प्रभुर प्रेमावेश, आर प्रभाव भक्ति - सार ।
सौन्दर्यादि दे खि’ भट्टेर हैल चमत्कार ॥76॥
cc-madhya-19.76.translation: When he saw the Lord's ecstatic love, Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya was certainly very astonished. He was also astonished by the Lord's knowledge of the essence of devotional service, as well as by His personal beauty and influence.

devanagari: सगणे प्रभुरे भट्ट नौकाते चड़ाञा ।
भिक्षा दिते निज - घरे चलिला लञा ॥77॥
cc-madhya-19.77.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya then put Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His associates aboard a boat and took them to his own place to offer them lunch.

devanagari: यमुनार जल देखि’ चिक्कण श्यामल ।
प्रेमावेशे महाप्रभु हइला विह्वल ॥78॥
cc-madhya-19.78.translation: While crossing the River Yamunā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the glossy black water and was immediately bewildered with ecstatic love.

lines: huṅkāra kari' yamunāra jale dilā jhāṅpa
prabhu dekhi' sabāra mane haila bhaya-kāṅpa
devanagari: हुङ्कार करि’ यमुनार जले दिला झाँप ।
प्रभु देखि’ सबार मने हैल भय - काँप ॥79॥
cc-madhya-19.79.translation: Indeed, as soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the River Yamunā, He immediately made a great sound and jumped into the water. Everyone was filled with fear and trembling to see this.

devanagari: दण्ड - बन्ध ला गि’ चौठि सञ्चय करिला ।
भाल - भाल विप्र - स्थाने स्थाप्य राखिला ॥8॥
cc-madhya-19.8.translation: He kept one-fourth of his wealth with a respectable brāhmaṇa. He kept this for his personal safety because he was expecting some legal complications.

devanagari: आस्ते - व्यस्ते सबे ध रि’ प्रभुरे उठाइल ।
नौकार उपरे प्रभु नाचिते लागिल ॥80॥
cc-madhya-19.80.translation: They all hastily grabbed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and pulled Him out of the water. Once on the boat's platform, the Lord began to dance.

lines: ḍubite lāgila naukā, jhalake bhare jala
devanagari: महाप्रभुर भरे नौका करे टलमल ।
डुबिते लागिल नौका, झलके भरे जल ॥81॥
cc-madhya-19.81.translation: Due to the Lord's heavy weight, the boat began to tilt. It began filling up with water and was on the verge of sinking.

lines: yadyapi bhaṭṭera āge prabhura dhairya haila mana
devanagari: यद्यपि भट्टेर आगे प्रभुर धैर्य हैल मन ।
दुर्वार उद्भट प्रेम नहे सम्वरण ॥82॥
cc-madhya-19.82.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu tried to restrain Himself as far as possible before Vallabhācārya, but although He tried to keep calm, His ecstatic love could not be checked.

devanagari: देश - पात्र दे खि’ महाप्रभु धैर्य हइल ।
आड़ाइलेर घाटे नौका आसि’ उत्तरिल ॥83॥
cc-madhya-19.83.translation: Seeing the circumstances, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu finally became calm so that the boat was able to reach the shore of Āḍāila and land there.

lines: bhaye bhaṭṭa saṅge rahe, madhyāhna karāñā
devanagari: भये भट्ट सङ्गे रहे, मध्याह्न कराञा ।
निज - गृहे आनिला प्रभुरे सङ्गेते लञा ॥84॥
cc-madhya-19.84.translation: Fearing for the Lord's welfare, Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya stayed in His association. After arranging for the Lord's bath, he took Him to his own house.

devanagari: आनन्दित हञा भट्ट दिल दिव्यासन ।
आपने करिल प्रभुर पाद - प्रक्षालन ॥85॥
cc-madhya-19.85.translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at his home, Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya, being greatly pleased, offered the Lord a nice sitting place and personally washed His feet.

devanagari: सवंशे सेइ जल मस्तके धरिल ।
नूतन कौपीन - बहिर्वास पराइल ॥86॥
cc-madhya-19.86.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya and his whole family then sprinkled that water over their heads. They then offered the Lord new underwear and outer garments.

devanagari: गन्ध - पुष्प - धूप - दीपे महा - पूजा कैल ।
भट्टाचार्ये मान्य करि’ पाक कराइल ॥87॥
cc-madhya-19.87.translation: Vallabhācārya worshiped the Lord with great pomp, offering scents, incense, flowers and lamps, and with great respect he induced Balabhadra Bhaṭṭa [the Lord's cook] to cook.

devanagari: भिक्षा कराइल प्रभुरे सस्नेह यतने ।
रूप - गोसाञि दुइ - भाइये कराइल भोजने ॥88॥
cc-madhya-19.88.translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was offered lunch with great care and affection. The brothers Rūpa Gosvāmī and Śrī Vallabha were also offered food.

lines: tabe sei prasāda kṛṣṇadāsa pāila śeṣa
devanagari: भट्टाचार्य श्री - रूपे देओयाइल ‘अवशे ष’ ।
तबे सेइ प्रसाद कृष्णदास पाइल शेष ॥89॥
cc-madhya-19.89.translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya first offered the remnants of the Lord's food to Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and then to Kṛṣṇadāsa.

devanagari: गौड़े राखिल मुद्रा दश - हाजारे ।
सनातन व्यय करे, राखे मुदि - घरे ॥9॥
cc-madhya-19.9.translation: He deposited ten thousand coins, which were later spent by Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī, in the custody of a local Bengali grocer.

devanagari: मुख - वास दिया प्रभुरे कराइल शयन ।
आपने भट्ट करेन प्रभुर पाद - सम्वाहन ॥90॥
cc-madhya-19.90.translation: The Lord was then given spices to purify His mouth. Afterwards He was made to rest, and Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya personally massaged His legs.

lines: bhojana kari' āilā teṅho prabhura caraṇe
devanagari: प्रभु पाठाइल ताँरे करिते भोजने ।
भोजन करि’ आइला तेंहो प्रभुर चरणे ॥91॥
cc-madhya-19.91.translation: While Vallabha Bhaṭṭācārya was massaging Him, the Lord asked him to go take prasāda. After taking prasāda, he returned to the lotus feet of the Lord.

devanagari: हेन - काले आइला रघुपति उपाध्याय ।
तिरुहिता पण्डित, बड़ वैष्णव, महाशय ॥92॥
cc-madhya-19.92.translation: At that time there arrived Raghupati Upādhyāya, who belonged to the Tiruhitā district. He was a very learned scholar, a great devotee and a respectable gentleman.

lines: āsi' teṅho kaila prabhura caraṇa vandana
devanagari: आसि’ तेंहो कैल प्रभुर चरण वन्दन ।
‘कृष्ण मति रहु’ बलि’ प्रभुर वचन ॥93॥
cc-madhya-19.93.translation: Raghupati Upādhyāya first offered his respects to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord gave him His blessings, saying, "Always stay in Kṛṣṇa consciousness."

devanagari: शुनि’ आनन्दित हैल उपाध्यायेर मन ।
प्रभु ताँरे कहिल , - ‘कह कृष्णेर वर्णन’ ॥94॥
cc-madhya-19.94.translation: Raghupati Upādhyāya was very pleased to hear the Lord's blessings. The Lord then asked him to describe Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: निज - कृत कृष्ण - लीला - श्लोक पड़िल ।
शुनि’ महाप्रभुर महा प्रेमावेश हैल ॥95॥
cc-madhya-19.95.translation: When Raghupati Upādhyāya was requested to describe Kṛṣṇa, he began to recite some verses he had personally composed about Kṛṣṇa's pastimes. Hearing those verses, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was overwhelmed with ecstatic love.

devanagari: श्रुतिमपरे स्मृतिमितरे भारतमन्ये भजन्तु भव - भीताः ।
अहमिह नन्दं वन्दे यस्यालिन्दे परं ब्रह्म ॥96॥
cc-madhya-19.96.translation: Raghupati Upādhyāya recited: "Those who are afraid of material existence worship Vedic literature. Some worship smṛti, the corollaries to Vedic literature, and others worship the Mahābhārata. As far as I am concerned, I worship Mahārāja Nanda, the father of Kṛṣṇa, in whose courtyard the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the Absolute Truth, is playing."

devanagari: ‘आगे कह’ - प्रभु - वाक्ये उपाध्याय कहिल ।
रघुपति उपाध्याय नमस्कार कैल ॥97॥
cc-madhya-19.97.translation: When Raghupati Upādhyāya was requested by the Lord to recite more, he immediately offered his respects to the Lord and granted His request.

devanagari: कं प्रति कथयितुमीशे सम्प्रति को वा प्रतीतिमायातु ।
गो - पति - तनया - कुञ्ज गोप - वधूटी - विटं ब्रह्म ॥98॥
cc-madhya-19.98.translation: "To whom can I speak who will believe me when I say that Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is hunting the gopīs in the bushes by the banks of the River Yamunā? In this way the Lord demonstrates His pastimes."

devanagari: प्रभु कहेन, - कह, तेंहो पड़े कृष्ण - लीला ।
प्रेमावेशे प्रभुर देह - मन आयुयाइला ॥99॥
cc-madhya-19.99.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested Raghupati Upādhyāya to continue speaking about the pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. Thus the Lord was absorbed in ecstatic love, and His mind and body slackened.

devanagari: वन्देऽनन्ताद्भुतैश्वर्यं श्री - चैतन्य महाप्रभुम् ।
नीचोऽपि यत्प्रसादात्स्याद्भक्ति - शास्त्र - प्रवर्तकः ॥1॥
cc-madhya-20.1.translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who has unlimited, wonderful opulences. By His mercy, even a person born as the lowest of men can spread the science of devotional service.

devanagari: सनातन कहे, - “तुमि ना कर राज - भय ।
दक्षिण गियाछे यदि लेउटि’ आओयय ॥10॥
cc-madhya-20.10-11.translation: Sanātana replied, "There is no danger. The Nawab has gone to the south. If he returns, tell him that Sanātana went to pass stool near the bank of the Ganges and that as soon as he saw the Ganges, he jumped in.

devanagari: आपनार हिताहित किछुइ ना जानि! ।
ग्राम्य - व्यवहारे पण्डित, ताइ सत्य मानि ॥100॥
cc-madhya-20.100.translation: "I do not know what is beneficial for me and what is detrimental. Nonetheless, in ordinary dealings people consider me a learned scholar, and I am also thinking of myself as such.

lines: kṛpā kari' yadi more kariyācha uddhāra
devanagari: कृपा करि’ यदि मोरे करियाछ उद्धार ।
आपन - कृपाते कह कर्तव्य’ आमार ॥101॥
cc-madhya-20.101.translation: "Out of Your causeless mercy, You have delivered me from the materialistic path. Now, by the same causeless mercy, please tell me what my duty is.

devanagari: ‘के आमि’, ‘केने आमाय जारे ताप - त्रय’ ।
इहा नाहि जानि - ‘केमने हित ह य’ ॥102॥
cc-madhya-20.102.translation: "Who am I? Why do the threefold miseries always give me trouble? If I do not know this, how can I be benefited?

lines: kṛpā kari' saba tattva kaha ta' āpani"
devanagari: ‘साध्य’ - ‘साधन’ - तत्त्व पुछिते ना जानि ।
कृपा करि’ सब तत्त्व कह त’ आपनि” ॥103॥
cc-madhya-20.103.translation: "Actually I do not know how to inquire about the goal of life and the process for obtaining it. Being merciful upon me, please explain all these truths."

lines: saba tattva jāna, tomāra nāhi tāpa-traya
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “कृष्ण - कृपा तोमाते पूर्ण हय ।
सब तत्त्व जान, तोमार नाहि ताप - त्रय ॥104॥
cc-madhya-20.104.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Lord Kṛṣṇa has bestowed His full mercy upon you so that all these things are known to you. For you, the threefold miseries certainly do not exist.

devanagari: कृष्ण - शक्ति धर तुमि, जान तत्त्व - भाव ।
जानि’ दाढर््य लागि’ पुछे, - साधुर स्वभाव ॥105॥
cc-madhya-20.105.translation: "Since you possess Lord Kṛṣṇa's potency, you certainly know these things. However, it is the nature of a sādhu to inquire. Although he knows these things, the sādhu inquires for the sake of strictness.

devanagari: अचिरादेव स र्वार्थः सिध्यत्येषामभीप्सितः ।
सद्धर्मस्यावबोधाय येषां निर्बन्धिनी मतिः ॥106॥
cc-madhya-20.106.translation: “ 'Those who are anxious to awaken their spiritual consciousness, who have unflinching intelligence and who are not deviated, certainly attain the desired goal.'

lines: krame saba tattva śuna, kahiye tomāte
devanagari: स्रोग्य - पात्र हओ तुमि भक्ति प्रवर्ताइते ।
क्रमे सब तत्त्व शुन, कहिये तोमाते ॥107॥
cc-madhya-20.107.translation: "You are fit to propagate the cult of devotional service. Therefore gradually hear all the truths about it from Me. I shall tell you about them.

devanagari: जीवेर ‘स्वरूप’ हय - कृष्णेर ‘नित्य - दास’ ।
कृष्णेर ‘तटस्था - शक्ति’ ‘भेदाभेद - प्रकाश’ ॥108॥
cc-madhya-20.108-109.translation: "It is the living entity's constitutional position to be an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa because he is the marginal energy of Kṛṣṇa and a manifestation simultaneously one and different from the Lord, like a molecular particle of sunshine or fire. Kṛṣṇa has three varieties of energy.

devanagari: एक - देश - स्थितस्याग्ने र्ज्योत्स्ना विस्तारिणी यथा ।
परस्य ब्रह्मणः शक्तिस्तथेदमखिलं जगत् ॥110॥
cc-madhya-20.110.translation: “ 'Just as the illumination of a fire, which is situated in one place, is spread all over, the energies of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Parabrahman, are spread all over this universe.'

devanagari: कृष्णेर स्वाभाविक तिन - शक्ति - परिणति ।
चिच्छक्ति, जीव - शक्ति, आर माया - शक्ति ॥111॥
cc-madhya-20.111.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa naturally has three energetic transformations, and these are known as the spiritual potency, the living entity potency and the illusory potency.

devanagari: विष्णु - शक्तिः परा प्रो क्ता क्षेत्रज्ञाख्या तथा परा ।
अविद्या - कर्म - संज्ञान्या तृतीया शक्तिरिष्यते ॥112॥
cc-madhya-20.112.translation: “ 'Originally, Kṛṣṇa's energy is spiritual, and the energy known as the living entity is also spiritual. However, there is another energy, called illusion, which consists of fruitive activity. That is the Lord's third potency.'

devanagari: शक्तयः सर्व - भावानाम
चिन्त्य - ज्ञान - गोचराः
यतोऽतो ब्रह्मणस्तास्तु
सर्गाद्या भाव - शक्तयः ।
भवन्ति तपतां श्रेष्ठ
पावकस्य यथोष्णता ॥113॥
cc-madhya-20.113.translation: “ 'All the creative energies, which are inconceivable to a common man, exist in the Supreme Absolute Truth. These inconceivable energies act in the process of creation, maintenance and annihilation. O chief of the ascetics, just as there are two energies possessed by fire-namely heat and light—these inconceivable creative energies are the natural characteristics of the Absolute Truth.'

devanagari: यया क्षेत्र - ज्ञ - शक्तिः सा वेष्टिता नृप सर्व - गा ।
संसार - तापानखिलानवाप्नोत्यत्र सन्ततान् ॥114॥
cc-madhya-20.114.translation: “ 'O King, the kṣetra-jña-śakti is the living entity. Although he has the facility to live in either the material or spiritual world, he suffers the threefold miseries of material existence because he is influenced by the avidyā [nescience] potency, which covers his constitutional position.

devanagari: तया तिरोहितत्वाच्च शक्तिः क्षेत्र - ज्ञ - संज्ञिता ।
सर्व - भूतेषु भू - पाल तारतम्येन वर्तते ॥115॥
cc-madhya-20.115.translation: “ 'This living entity, covered by the influence of nescience, exists in different forms in the material condition. O King, he is thus proportionately freed from the influence of material energy, to greater or lesser degrees.'

devanagari: अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि में पराम् ।
जीव - भूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत् ॥116॥
cc-madhya-20.116.translation: “ 'Besides this inferior nature, O mighty-armed Arjuna, there is a superior energy of Mine, which consists of all living entities who are struggling with material nature and are sustaining the universe.'

devanagari: कृष्ण भुलि’ सेइ जीव अनादि - बहिर्मुख ।
अतएव माया तारे देय संसार - दुःख ॥117॥
cc-madhya-20.117.translation: "Forgetting Kṛṣṇa, the living entity has been attracted by the external feature from time immemorial. Therefore the illusory energy [māyā] gives him all kinds of misery in his material existence.

lines: kabhu svarge uṭhāya, kabhu narake ḍubāya
devanagari: कभु स्वर्गे उठाय, कभु नरके डुबाय ।
दण्ड्य - जने राजा येन नदीते चुबाय ॥118॥
cc-madhya-20.118.translation: "In the material condition, the living entity is sometimes raised to higher planetary systems and material prosperity and sometimes drowned in a hellish situation. His state is exactly like that of a criminal whom a king punishes by submerging him in water and then raising him again from the water.

devanagari: ईशादपेतस्य विपर्ययोऽस्मृतिः ।
तन्माययातो बुध आभजेत्तं भक्त्यैकयेशं गुरु - देवतात्मा ॥119॥
cc-madhya-20.119.translation: “ 'When the living entity is attracted by the material energy, which is separate from Kṛṣṇa, he is overpowered by fear. Because he is separated from the Supreme Personality of Godhead by the material energy, his conception of life is reversed. In other words, instead of being the eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa, he becomes Kṛṣṇa's competitor. This is called viparyayo 'smṛtiḥ. To nullify this mistake, one who is actually learned and advanced worships the Supreme Personality of Godhead as his spiritual master, worshipful Deity and source of life. He thus worships the Lord by the process of unalloyed devotional service.'

lines: aneka dekhila, tāra lāg nā pāila
devanagari: अनेक देखिल, तार ला ग् ना पाइल ।
दाडुका - सहित डुबि काहाँ वहि’ गेल ॥12॥
cc-madhya-20.12.translation: "Tell him,'I looked for him a long time, but I could not find any trace of him. He jumped in with his shackles, and therefore he was drowned and washed away by the waves.'

lines: sei jīva nistare, māyā tāhāre chāḍaya
devanagari: साधु - शास्त्र - कृपाय यदि कृष्णोन्मुख हय ।
सेइ जीव निस्तरे, माया ताहारे छा ड़य ॥120॥
cc-madhya-20.120.translation: "If the conditioned soul becomes Kṛṣṇa conscious by the mercy of saintly persons who voluntarily preach scriptural injunctions and help him to become Kṛṣṇa conscious, the conditioned soul is liberated from the clutches of māyā, who gives him up.

devanagari: दैवी ह्ये षा गुण - मयी मम माया दुरत्यया ।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते ॥121॥
cc-madhya-20.121.translation: “ 'This divine energy of Mine, consisting of the three modes of material nature, is difficult to overcome. But those who have surrendered unto Me can easily cross beyond it.'

devanagari: माया - मुग्ध जीवेर नाहि स्वतः कृष्ण - ज्ञान ।
जीवेरे कृपाय कैला कृष्ण वेद - पुराण ॥122॥
cc-madhya-20.122.translation: "The conditioned soul cannot revive his Kṛṣṇa consciousness by his own effort. But out of causeless mercy, Lord Kṛṣṇa compiled the Vedic literature and its supplements, the Purāṇas.

devanagari: ‘शास्त्र - गुरु - आत्म’ - रूपे आपनारे जानान ।
‘कृष्ण मोर प्रभु, त्राता’ - जीवेर हय ज्ञान ॥123॥
cc-madhya-20.123.translation: "The forgetful conditioned soul is educated by Kṛṣṇa through the Vedic literatures, the realized spiritual master and the Supersoul. Through these, he can understand the Supreme Personality of Godhead as He is, and he can understand that Lord Kṛṣṇa is his eternal master and deliverer from the clutches of māyā. In this way one can acquire real knowledge of his conditioned life and can come to understand how to attain liberation.

devanagari: वेद - शास्त्र कहे - ‘सम्बन्ध’, ‘अभिधेय’, ‘प्रयोजन’ ।
‘कृष्ण’ - प्राप्य सम्बन्ध, ‘भक्ति’ - प्राप्त्येर साधन ॥124॥
cc-madhya-20.124.translation: "The Vedic literatures give information about the living entity's eternal relationship with Kṛṣṇa, which is called sambandha. The living entity's understanding of this relationship and acting accordingly is called abhidheya. Returning home, back to Godhead, is the ultimate goal of life and is called prayojana.

devanagari: अभिधे य - नाम’ भक्ति’, ‘प्रेम’ - प्रयोजन ।
पुरुषार्थ - शिरोमणि प्रेम महा - धन ॥125॥
cc-madhya-20.125.translation: "Devotional service, or sense activity for the satisfaction of the Lord, is called abhidheya because it can develop one's original love of Godhead, which is the goal of life. This goal is the living entity's topmost interest and greatest wealth. Thus one attains the platform of transcendental loving service unto the Lord.

devanagari: कृष्ण - माधुर्य - सेवानन्द - प्राप्तिर कारण ।
कृष्ण - सेवा करे, आर कृष्ण - रस - आस्वादन ॥126॥
cc-madhya-20.126.translation: "When one attains the transcendental bliss of an intimate relationship with Kṛṣṇa, he renders service to Him and tastes the mellows of Kṛṣṇa consciousness.

devanagari: इहाते दृष्टान्त - यैछे दरिद्रेर घरे ।
‘सर्वज्ञ’ आसि’ दुःख देखि’ पुछये ताहारे ॥127॥
cc-madhya-20.127.translation: "The following example may be given. Once a learned astrologer came to the house of a poor man and, seeing his distressed condition, questioned him.

lines: tomāre nā kahila, anyatra chāḍila jīvana"
devanagari: ‘तुमि केने दुःखी, तोमार आछे पितृ - धन ।
तोमारे ना कहिल, अन्यत्र छाड़िल जीव न” ॥128॥
cc-madhya-20.128.translation: "The astrologer asked, 'Why are you unhappy? Your father was very wealthy, but he did not disclose his wealth to you because he died elsewhere?'

devanagari: सर्वज्ञेर वाक्ये करे धनेर उद्देशे ।
ऐछे वेद - पुराण जीवे ‘कृष्ण’ उपदेशे ॥129॥
cc-madhya-20.129.translation: "Just as the words of the astrologer Sarvajña gave news of the poor man's treasure, Vedic literatures advise one about Kṛṣṇa consciousness when one is inquisitive to know why he is in a distressed material condition.

lines: kichu bhaya nāhi, āmi e-deśe nā raba
devanagari: किछु भय नाहि, आमि ए - देशे ना रब ।
दरवेश ह ञा आमि मक्काके याइब” ॥13॥
cc-madhya-20.13.translation: "There is no reason for you to be afraid, for I shall not remain in this country. I shall become a mendicant and go to the holy city of Mecca."

devanagari: सर्वज्ञेर वाक्ये मूल - धन अनुबन्ध ।
सर्व - शास्त्रे उपदेशे, ‘श्री - कृष्ण’ - सम्बन्ध ॥130॥
cc-madhya-20.130.translation: "By the words of the astrologer, the poor man's connection with the treasure was established. Similarly, Vedic literature advises us that our real connection is with Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

lines: tabe sarvajña kahe tāre prāptira upāya
devanagari: ‘बापेर धन आछे’ - ज्ञाने धन नाहि पाय ।
तबे सर्वज्ञ कहे तारे प्राप्तिर उपाय ॥131॥
cc-madhya-20.131.translation: "Although being assured of his father's treasure, the poor man cannot acquire this treasure by such knowledge alone. Therefore the astrologer had to inform him of the means whereby he could actually find the treasure.

devanagari: ‘एइ स्थाने आछे ध न’ - यदि दक्षिणे खुदिबे ।
‘भीमरुल - बरुली’ उठिबे, धन ना पाइबे ॥132॥
cc-madhya-20.132.translation: "The astrologer said, 'The treasure is in this place, but if you dig toward the southern side, the wasps and drones will rise, and you will not get your treasure.

lines: se vighna karibe,—dhane hāta nā paḍaya
devanagari: ‘पश्चिमे’ खुदिबे, ताहा ‘यक्ष’ एक हय ।
से विघ्न करिबे , - धने हात ना पड़य ॥133॥
cc-madhya-20.133.translation: “ 'If you dig on the western side, there is a ghost who will create such a disturbance that your hands will not even touch the treasure.

lines: dhana nāhi pābe, khudite gilibe sabāre
devanagari: ‘उत्तरे’ खुदिले आछे कृष्ण ‘अजगरे’ ।
धन नाहि पाबे, खुदिते गिलिबे सबारे ॥134॥
cc-madhya-20.134.translation: “ 'If you dig on the northern side, there is a big black snake that will devour you if you attempt to dig up the treasure.

devanagari: पूर्व - दिके ताते माटी अल्प खुदिते ।
धनेर झारि पड़िबेक तोमार हातेते ॥135॥
cc-madhya-20.135.translation: “ 'However, if you dig up a small quantity of dirt on the eastern side, your hands will immediately touch the pot of treasure.'

lines: aiche śāstra kahe,—karma, jñāna, yoga tyaji'
'bhaktye' kṛṣṇa vaśa haya, bhaktye tāṅre bhaji
devanagari: ऐछ शास्त्र कहे - कर्म, ज्ञान, योग त्यजी’।
‘भक्त्ये’ कृष्ण वश हय, भक्त्ये ताँरे भजि ॥136॥
cc-madhya-20.136.translation: "Revealed scriptures conclude that one should give up fruitive activity, speculative knowledge and the mystic yoga system and instead take to devotional service, by which Kṛṣṇa can be fully satisfied.

devanagari: न साधयति मां योगो न साङ्ख्यं धर्म उद्धव ।
न स्वाध्यायस्तपस्त्यागो यथा भक्तिर्ममोर्जिता ॥137॥
cc-madhya-20.137.translation: [The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, said:] " 'My dear Uddhava, neither through aṣṭāṅga-yoga [the mystic yoga system to control the senses], nor through impersonal monism or an analytical study of the Absolute Truth, nor through study of the Vedas, nor through practice of austerities, nor through charity, nor through acceptance of sannyāsa can one satisfy Me as much as one can by developing unalloyed devotional service unto Me.'

devanagari: भक्त्याहमेकया ग्राह्यः श्रद्धयात्मा प्रियः सताम् ।
भक्तिः पुनाति मन्निष्ठा श्व - पाकानपि सम्भवात् ॥138॥
cc-madhya-20.138.translation: “ 'Being very dear to the devotees and sādhus, I am attained through unflinching faith and devotional service. This bhakti-yoga system, which gradually increases attachment for Me, purifies even a human being born among dog-eaters. That is to say, everyone can be elevated to the spiritual platform by the process of bhakti-yoga.'

devanagari: अतएव ‘भक्ति’ - कृष्ण - प्राप्त्येर उपाय ।
‘अभिधेय’ बलि’ तारे सर्व - शास्त्रे गाय ॥139॥
cc-madhya-20.139.translation: "The conclusion is that devotional service is the only means to approach the Supreme Personality of Godhead. This system is therefore called abhidheya. This is the verdict of all revealed scriptures.

lines: sāta-hājāra mudrā tāra āge rāśi kailā
devanagari: तथापि यवन - मन प्रसन्न ना देखिला ।
सात - हाजार मुद्रा तार आगे राशि कैला ॥14॥
cc-madhya-20.14.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī could see that the mind of the meat-eater was still not satisfied. He then stacked Seven thousand gold coins before him.

lines: dhana pāile yaiche sukha-bhoga phala pāya
devanagari: धन पाइले यैछे सुख - भोग फल पाय ।
सुख - भोग हैते दुःख आपनि पलाय ॥140॥
cc-madhya-20.140.translation: "When one actually becomes rich, he naturally enjoys all kinds of happiness. When one is actually in a happy mood, all distressful conditions go away by themselves. No extraneous endeavor is needed.

lines: preme kṛṣṇāsvāda haile bhava nāśa pāya
devanagari: तैछे भक्ति - फले कृष्णे प्रेम उपजय ।
प्रेमे कृष्णास्वाद हैले भव नाश पाय ॥141॥
