cc-madhya-24.166.translation: “ 'Those who follow the path of great, saintly mystic yogīs take to the yogic gymnastic process and begin worshiping from the abdomen, where it is said that Brahman is located. Such people are called śārkarākṣa, which means that they are situated in the gross bodily conception. There are also followers of the ṛṣi known as Āruṇa. Following that path, they observe the activities of the arteries. Thus they gradually rise to the heart, where subtle Brahman, Paramātmā, is situated. They then worship Him. O unlimited Ananta! Better than these persons are the mystic yogīs who worship You from the top of their heads. Beginning with the abdomen and proceeding through the heart, they reach the top of the head and pass through the brahma-randhra, the hole at the top of the skull. Thus yogīs attain the perfectional platform and do not enter the cycle of birth and death again.'

devanagari: एहो कृष्ण - गुणाकृष्ट महा - मुनि हञा ।
अहैतुकी भक्ति करे निर्ग्रन्थ हञा ॥167॥
cc-madhya-24.167.translation: "Being attracted by the transcendental qualities of Kṛṣṇa, yogīs become great saints. At that time, not being hampered by the yogic process, they engage in unalloyed devotional service.

devanagari: ‘आत्मा’ - शब्दे ‘यत्न’ कहे - यत्न करिया ।
“मुनयोऽपि” कृष्ण भजे गुणाकृष्ट हञा ॥168॥
cc-madhya-24.168.translation: "Ātmā also means 'endeavor.' Being attracted by Kṛṣṇa's transcendental qualities, some saints make a great endeavor to come to the point of rendering service to Him.

lines: na labhyate yad bhramatām upary adhaḥ
devanagari: तस्यैव हेतोः प्रयतेत कोविदो न लभ्यते यद्भ्रमतामुपर्यधः ।
तल्लभ्यते दुःख - वदन्यतः सुखं कालेन सर्वत्र गभीर - रंहसा ॥169॥
cc-madhya-24.169.translation: “ 'The transcendental position cannot be attained by wandering up and down from Brahmaloka and Satyaloka to Pātālaloka. If one is actually intelligent and learned, he should endeavor for that rare transcendental position. Whatever material happiness is available within the fourteen worlds is attained by the force of time, just as one attains distress in due course of time. Since these are not attained by spiritual consciousness, one should not try for them.'

devanagari: मूर्ख, नीच, म्लेच्छ आदि शास्त्र - रिक्त - गण ।
धन - सञ्चयी - निर्ग्रन्थ, आर ये निर्धन ॥17॥
cc-madhya-24.17.translation: "Nirgrantha also refers to one who is illiterate, lowborn, misbehaved, unregulated and devoid of respect for Vedic literature. The word also refers to one who is a capitalist and to one who has no riches.

devanagari: सद्धर्मस्यावबोधाय येषां निर्बन्धिनी मतिः ।
अचिरादेव सर्वार्थः सिध्यत्येषामभीप्सितः ॥170॥
cc-madhya-24.170.translation: “ 'Those who are anxious to awaken their spiritual consciousness, who have unflinching intelligence and who are not deviated, certainly attain the desired goal of life.'

lines: yatnāgraha vinā bhakti nā janmāya preme
devanagari: च - शब्द अपि - अर्थे, ‘अपि’ - अवधारणे ।
यत्नाग्रह विना भक्ति ना जन्माय प्रेमे ॥171॥
cc-madhya-24.171.translation: "The word ca may be used in place of api, which gives emphasis to something. Thus it means that without sincere endeavor in devotional service, one cannot attain love of Godhead.

devanagari: साधनौधैरनासङ्गैरलभ्या सु - चिरादपि ।
हरिणा चाश्वदेयेति द्विधा सा स्यात्सु - दुर्लभा ॥172॥
cc-madhya-24.172.translation: “ 'Devotional perfection is very difficult to attain for two reasons. First, unless one is attached to Kṛṣṇa, he cannot attain devotional perfection even if he renders devotional service for a long time. Second, Kṛṣṇa does not easily deliver perfection in devotional service.'

devanagari: तेषां सतत - युक्तानां भजतां प्रीति - पूर्वकम् ।
ददामि बुद्धि - योगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते ॥173॥
cc-madhya-24.173.translation: “ 'To those who are constantly devoted and worship Me with love, I give the understanding by which they can come to Me.'

devanagari: ‘आत्मा’ - शब्दे ‘धृति’ कहे, - धैर्ये येइ रमे ।
धैर्यवन्त एव ह ञा करय भजने ॥174॥
cc-madhya-24.174.translation: "Another meaning of ātmā is dhṛti, or endurance. A person who endeavors with endurance is ātmārāma. With endurance, such a person engages in devotional service.

devanagari: ‘मुनि’ - शब्दे - पक्षी, भृङ्गः ‘निर्ग्रन्थे’ - मूर्ख - जन ।
कृष्ण - कृपाय साधु - कृपाय दोंहार भजन ॥175॥
cc-madhya-24.175.translation: "The word muni also means 'bird,' and 'bumblebee.' The word nirgrantha refers to foolish people. By the mercy of Kṛṣṇa, such creatures contact a sādhu [spiritual master] and thus engage in devotional service.

devanagari: प्रायो बताम्ब मुनयो विहगा वनेऽस्मिन कृष्णेक्षितं तदुदितं कल - वेणु - गीतम् ।
आरुह्य ये द्रुम - भुजान् रुचिर - प्रवालान् शृण्वन्ति मीलित - दृशो विगतान्य - वाचः ॥176॥
cc-madhya-24.176.translation: “ 'My dear mother, in this forest, all the birds, after rising on the beautiful branches of the trees, are closing their eyes and, not being attracted by any other sound, are simply listening to the vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute. Such birds and bees must be on the same level as great saints.'

devanagari: एतेऽलिनस्तव यशोऽखिल - लोक - तीर्थं गायन्त आदि - पुरुषानुपथं भजन्ते ।
प्रायो अमी मुनि - गणा भवदीय - मुख्या गूढ़म् वनेऽपि न जहत्यनघात्म - दैवम् ॥177॥
cc-madhya-24.177.translation: “ 'O good fortune personified! O original Personality of Godhead, all these bees are chanting about Your transcendental fame, which will purify the entire universe. Indeed, they are following Your path in the forest and are worshiping You. Actually they are all saintly persons, but now they have taken the form of bees. Although You are playing like a human being, they could not forget that You are their worshipable Deity.'

devanagari: सरसि सारस - हंस - विहङ्गाश् चारु - गीत - हृत - चेतस एत्य ।
हरिमुपासत ते यत - चित्ता हन्त मीलित - दृशो धृत - मौनाः ॥178॥
cc-madhya-24.178.translation: “ 'All the cranes and swans in the water are being enchanted by the melodious song of Kṛṣṇa's flute. They have approached and are worshiping the Supreme Personality of Godhead with full attention. Alas, they are closing their eyes and are becoming completely silent.'

devanagari: किरात - हूनान्न्र - पुलिन्द - पुक्कशा आभीर - शुम्भा यवनाः खशादयः ।
येऽन्ये च पापा यदपाश्रयाश्रयाः शुध्यन्ति तस्मै प्रभविष्णवे नमः ॥179॥
cc-madhya-24.179.translation: “ 'Kirāta, Hūna, Āndhra, Pulinda, Pulkaśa, Ābhīra, Śumbha, Yavana and the Khaśa races and even others who are addicted to sinful acts can be purified by taking shelter of the devotees of the Lord due to His being the supreme power. I beg to offer my respectful obeisances unto Him.'

devanagari: निर्निश्चये निष्क्रमार्थे निर्निर्माण - निषेधयोः ।
ग्रन्थो धनेऽथ सन्दर्भे वर्ण - सङ्ग्रथनेऽपि च ॥18॥
cc-madhya-24.18.translation: “ 'The prefix niḥ may be used for a sense of ascertainment, gradation, construction or forbidding. The word grantha means riches, thesis and composition.'

devanagari: किंवा ‘धृति’ - शब्दे निज - पूर्णतादि - ज्ञान कय ।
दुःखाभावे उत्तम - प्राप्त्ये महा - पूर्ण हय ॥180॥
cc-madhya-24.180.translation: "The word dhṛti is also used when one is fully perfect in knowledge. When due to having obtained the lotus feet of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, he has no material miseries, he attains mahā-pūrṇa, the highest level of perfection.

devanagari: धृतिः स्यात्पूर्णता - ज्ञान - दुःखाभावोत्तमाप्तिभिः ।
अप्राप्तातीत - नष्टार्था - नभिसंशोचनादि - कृत् ॥181॥
cc-madhya-24.181.translation: “ 'Dhṛti is the fullness felt by the absence of misery and brought about by receiving knowledge of the Supreme Lord and by obtaining pure love for Him. The lamentation that accrues from not obtaining a goal or by loss of something already attained does not affect this completeness.'

devanagari: कृष्ण - भक्त - दुःख - हीन, वाञ्छान्तर - हीन ।
कृष्ण - प्रेम - सेवा - पूर्णानन्द - प्रवीण ॥182॥
cc-madhya-24.182.translation: "A devotee of Kṛṣṇa is never in a miserable condition, nor does he have any desire other than to serve Kṛṣṇa. He is experienced and advanced. He feels the transcendental bliss of love of Kṛṣṇa and always engages in His service fully protected.

devanagari: मत्सेवया प्रतीतं ते सालोक्यादि - चतुष्टयम् ।
नेच्छन्ति सेवया पूर्णाः कुतोऽन्यत्काल - विप्लुतम् ॥183॥
cc-madhya-24.183.translation: “ 'My devotees, having fulfilled their desires by serving Me, do not accept the four kinds of salvation that are easily earned by such service. Why then should they accept any pleasures that are lost in the course of time?'

devanagari: हृषीकेशे हृषीकाणि यस्य स्थैर्य - गतानि हि ।
स एव धैर्यमाप्नोति संसारे जीव - चञ्चले ॥184॥
cc-madhya-24.184.translation: "In this material world, all living entities are disturbed due to their flickering position. A devotee, however, is fixed in the service of the lotus feet of the Lord, the master of the senses. Such a person is to be considered situated in endurance and patience.

devanagari: ‘च’ - अवधारणे, इहा ‘अपि’ - समुच्चये ।
धृतिमन्त हञा भजे पक्षि - मूर्ख - चये ॥185॥
cc-madhya-24.185.translation: "The word ca is for emphasis, and the word api is used as an aggregate. It is to be understood that even dull creatures [birds and illiterates] can also be situated in endurance and engage in Kṛṣṇa's devotional service.

devanagari: ‘आत्मा’ - शब्दे ‘बुद्धि’ कहे बुद्धि - विशेष ।
सामान्य - बुद्धि - युक्त यत जीव अवशेष ॥186॥
cc-madhya-24.186.translation: "The word ātmā is also used for a particular type of intelligence. Since all living entities generally have some intelligence, more or less, they are included.

devanagari: बुद्ध्ये रमे आत्माराम - दुइ त’ प्रकार ।
‘पण्डित’ मुनि - गण, निर्ग्रन्थ ‘मूर्ख’ आर ॥187॥
cc-madhya-24.187.translation: "Everyone has some kind of intelligence, and one who utilizes his intelligence is called ātmārāma. There are two types of ātmārāma. One is a learned scholar and a philosopher, and the other is an uneducated, illiterate and foolish person.

devanagari: कृष्ण - कृपाय साधु - सङ्गे रति - बुद्धि पाय ।
सब छा ड़ि’ शुद्ध - भक्ति करे कृष्ण - पाय ॥188॥
cc-madhya-24.188.translation: "By the mercy of Kṛṣṇa and by the association of devotees, one increases his attraction to and intelligence for pure devotional service; therefore one gives up everything and engages himself at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa and His pure devotees.

devanagari: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते ।
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भाव - समन्विताः ॥189॥
cc-madhya-24.189.translation: “ 'I [Kṛṣṇa] am the original source of everything. Everything emanates from Me. The wise who perfectly know this engage in My service with love and devotion.'

devanagari: ‘उरुक्रम’ - शब्दे कहे, बड़ याँर क्रम ।
‘क्रम’ - शब्दे कहे एइ पाद - विक्षेपण ॥19॥
cc-madhya-24.19.translation: "The word urukrama refers to one whose krama [step] is great. The word krama means 'throwing the foot forward,' that is, 'step.'

lines: te vai vidanty atitaranti ca deva-māyāṁ
devanagari: ते वै विदन्त्यतितरन्ति च देव - मायां स्त्री - शूद्र - हुण - शबरा अपि पाप - जीवाः ।
यद्यद्भुत - क्रम - परायण - शील - शिक्षास् तिर्यग्जना अपि किमु श्रुत - धारणा ये ॥190॥
cc-madhya-24.190.translation: “ 'Women, fourth-class men, uncivilized hill tribes, hunters and many others born of low families, as well as birds and beasts, can engage in the service of the Supreme Personality of Godhead-who acts very wonderfully-and follow the path of the devotees and take lessons from them. Although the ocean of nescience is vast, they can still cross over it. What, then, is the difficulty for those who are advanced in Vedic knowledge?'

lines: sei buddhi dena tāṅre, yāte kṛṣṇa pāya
devanagari: विचार करिया यबे भजे कृष्ण - पाय ।
सेइ बुद्धि देन ताँरे, याते कृष्ण पाय ॥191॥
cc-madhya-24.191.translation: "Considering all these points, when one engages in the service of Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet, Kṛṣṇa gives one the intelligence by which he can gradually progress toward perfection in service to the Lord.

devanagari: तेषां सतत - युक्तानां भजतां प्रीति - पूर्वकम् ।
ददामि बुद्धि - योगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते ॥192॥
cc-madhya-24.192.translation: “ 'To those who are constantly devoted and worship Me with love, I give the understanding by which they can come to Me.'

devanagari: सत्सङ्ग, कृष्ण - सेवा, भागवत, नाम ।
व्रजे वास , - एइ पञ्च साधन प्रधान ॥193॥
cc-madhya-24.193.translation: "To be elevated to the platform of devotional service, the following five items should be observed: association with devotees, engagement in the service of Lord Kṛṣṇa, the reading of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, the chanting of the holy names and residence at Vṛndāvana or Mathurā.

devanagari: एइ - पञ्च - मध्ये एक ‘स्वल्प’ यदि हय ।
सुबुद्धि जनेर हय कृष्ण - प्रेमोदय ॥194॥
cc-madhya-24.194.translation: "One's dormant love for Kṛṣṇa gradually awakens if one is a little advanced in one of these five items and is intelligent.

devanagari: दुरूहाद्भुत - वीर्येऽस्मिन्श्रद्धा दूरेऽस्तु पञ्चके ।
यत्र स्वल्पोऽपि सम्बन्धः सद्धियां भाव - जन्मने ॥195॥
cc-madhya-24.195.translation: “ 'The power of these five principles is very wonderful and difficult to reconcile. Even without faith in them, a person who is offenseless can experience dormant love of Kṛṣṇa simply by being a little connected with them.'

lines: nānā kāme bhaje, tabu pāya bhakti-siddhi
devanagari: उदार महती याँर सर्वोत्तमा बुद्धि ।
नाना कामे भजे, तबु पाय भक्ति - सिद्धि ॥196॥
cc-madhya-24.196.translation: "If a person is actually liberal and intelligent, he can advance and become perfect in devotional service even if he has material desires and serves the Lord with some motive.

devanagari: अकामः सर्व - कामो वा मोक्ष - काम उदार - धीः ।
तीव्रण भक्ति - योगेन यजेत पुरुषं परम् ॥197॥
cc-madhya-24.197.translation: “ 'Whether one desires everything or nothing, or whether he desires to merge into the existence of the Lord, he is intelligent only if he worships Lord Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, by rendering transcendental loving service.'

devanagari: भक्ति - प्रभाव , - सेइ काम छाड़ाञा ।
कृष्ण - पदे भक्ति कराय गुणे आकर्षिया ॥198॥
cc-madhya-24.198.translation: "Devotional service is so strong that when one engages in it, he gradually gives up all material desires and becomes fully attracted to the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. All this is brought about by attraction for the transcendental qualities of the Lord.

devanagari: सत्यं दिशत्यर्थितमर्थितो नृणां नैवार्थ - दो यत्पुनरर्थिता यतः ।
स्वयं विधत्ते भजतामनिच्छताम् इच्छा - पिधानं निज - पाद - पल्लवम् ॥199॥
cc-madhya-24.199.translation: “ 'Whenever Kṛṣṇa is requested to fulfill one's desire, He undoubtedly does so, but He does not award anything which, after being enjoyed, will cause someone to petition Him again and again to fulfill further desires. When one has other desires but engages in the Lord's service, Kṛṣṇa forcibly gives one shelter at His lotus feet, where one will forget all other desires.'

devanagari: जय जय श्री - चैतन्य जय नित्यानन्द ।
जयाद्वैत - चन्द्र जय गौर - भक्त - वृन्द ॥2॥
cc-madhya-24.2.translation: All glories to Lord Caitanya! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya!

lines: śakti, kampa, paripāṭī, yukti, śaktye ākramaṇa
devanagari: शक्ति, कम्प, परिपाटी, युक्ति, शक्त्ये आक्रमण ।
चरण - चालने काँपाइल त्रिभुवन ॥20॥
cc-madhya-24.20.translation: "Krama also means power, trembling, a systematic method, argument, and a forcible attack by stepping forward. Thus Vāmana caused the three worlds to tremble.

devanagari: ‘आत्मा’ - शब्दे ‘स्वभाव’ कहे, ताते येइ रमे ।
आत्माराम जीव यत स्थावर - जङ्गमे ॥200॥
cc-madhya-24.200.translation: "Another meaning of the word ātmā is 'one's characteristic nature.' Whoever enjoys his particular type of nature is called ātmārāma. Therefore, all living entities-be they moving or nonmoving-are also called ātmārāma.

devanagari: जीवेर स्वभाव - कृष्ण - ‘दास’ - अभिमान ।
देहे आत्म - ज्ञाने आच्छादित सेइ ‘ज्ञान’ ॥201॥
cc-madhya-24.201.translation: "The original nature of every living entity is to consider himself the eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa. However, under the influence of māyā, he thinks himself to be the body, and thus his original consciousness is covered.

devanagari: च - शब्दे ‘एव’, ‘अपि’ - शब्द समुच्चये ।
‘आत्मारामा ए व’ हञा श्री - कृष्ण भजये ॥202॥
cc-madhya-24.202.translation: "In that case, by the word ca, the word eva is meant. The word api can be taken in the sense of aggregation. Thus the verse would read ātmārāmā eva; that is, 'even all kinds of living beings worship Kṛṣṇa.'

devanagari: एइ जीव - सनकादि सब मुनि - जन ।
‘निर्ग्रन्थ’ - मूर्ख, नीच, स्थावर - पशु - गण ॥203॥
cc-madhya-24.203.translation: "Living entities include great personalities like the four Kumāras, low-class foolish people, trees, plants, birds and beasts.

devanagari: व्यास - शुक - सनकादिर प्रसिद्ध भजन ।
‘निर्ग्रन्थ’ स्थावरादिर शुन विवरण ॥204॥
cc-madhya-24.204.translation: "The devotional service of Vyāsa, Śuka and the four Kumāras has already been well celebrated. Now let Me explain how immovable living entities like trees and plants engage in the Lord's devotional service.

devanagari: कृष्ण - कृपादि - हेतु हैते सबार उदय ।
कृष्ण - गुणाकृष्ट हञा ताँहारे भजय ॥205॥
cc-madhya-24.205.translation: "Everyone is eligible to receive Kṛṣṇa's mercy-including Vyāsadeva, the four Kumāras, Śukadeva Gosvāmī, lowborn creatures, trees, plants and beasts. By Kṛṣṇa's mercy they are elevated and engaged in His service.

devanagari: धन्येयमद्य धरणी तृण - वीरुधस्त्वत् पाद - स्पृशो द्रुम - लताः करजाभिमृष्टाः ।
नद्योऽद्रयः खग - मृगाः सदयावलोकैर् गोप्योऽन्तरेण भुजयोरपि यत्स्पृहा श्रीः ॥206॥
cc-madhya-24.206.translation: “ 'This land Vṛndāvana [Vrajabhūmi] is glorified today. Your lotus feet have touched the earth and grass. Your fingers have touched the trees and creepers, and Your merciful eyes have glanced upon rivers, hills, birds and beasts. The gopīs have been embraced by Your arms, and even the goddess of fortune desires this. Now all of these are glorified.'

devanagari: गा गोपकैरनु - वनं नयतोरुदार - वेणु - स्वनैः कल - पदैस्तनु - भृत्सु सख्यः ।
अस्पन्दनं गतिमतां पुलकस्तरूणां निर्योग - पाश - कृत - लक्षणयोर्विचित्रम् ॥207॥
cc-madhya-24.207.translation: “ 'My dear friend, both Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma are passing through the forest leading Their cows with Their cowherd boy friends. They both carry ropes with which, at the time of milking, They bind the rear legs of the cows. When They play on Their flutes, all moving living entities are stunned, and nonmoving living entities experience ecstatic jubilation by Their sweet music. All these things are certainly very wonderful.'

devanagari: प्रणत - भार - विटपा मधु - धाराः।
प्रेम - हृष्ट - तनवो ववृषुः स्म ॥208॥
cc-madhya-24.208.translation: “ 'The plants, creepers and trees were full of fruits and flowers due to ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa. Indeed, being so full, they were bowing down. They were inspired by such deep love for Kṛṣṇa that they were constantly pouring showers of honey. In this way the gopīs saw all the forest of Vṛndāvana.'

devanagari: किरात - हूणान्न्र - पुलिन्द - पुल्कशा आभीर - शुम्भा यवनाः खसादयः ।
येऽन्ये च पापा यदपाश्रयाश्रयाः शुध्यन्ति तस्मै प्रभविष्णवे नमः ॥209॥
cc-madhya-24.209.translation: “ 'Kirāta, Hūna, Āndhra, Pulinda, Pulkaśa, Ābhīra, Śumbha, Yavana and the Khaśa races and even others who are addicted to sinful acts can be purified by taking shelter of the devotees of the Lord due to His being the supreme power. I beg to offer my respectful obeisances unto Him.'

lines: yaḥ pārthivāny api kavir vimame rajāṁsi
devanagari: विष्णोर्नु वीर्य - गणनां कतमोऽर्हतीह यः पार्थिवान्यपि कविर्विममे रजांसि ।
चस्कम्भ यः स्व - रंहसास्खलता त्रि - पृष्ठं यस्मात्त्रि - साम्य - सदनादुरु कम्पयानम् ॥21॥
cc-madhya-24.21.translation: “ 'Even if a learned man is able to count all the minute atoms in this material world, he still cannot count the potencies of Lord Viṣṇu. In the form of the Vāmana incarnation, Lord Viṣṇu, without hindrance, captured all the planets, beginning from the root of the material world up to Satyaloka. Indeed, He caused every planetary system to tremble by the force of His steps.'

lines: ūnaviṁśati artha ha-ila mili' ei dui
devanagari: आगे ‘तेर’ अर्थ करि लुँ, आर ‘छय’ एइ ।
ऊनविंशति अर्थ हइल मिलि’ एइ दुइ ॥210॥
cc-madhya-24.210.translation: "I have already spoken about the thirteen kinds of meaning. Now there are six more. Combined, these make nineteen.

lines: ei ūniśa artha karilu, āge śuna āra
devanagari: एइ ऊनिश अर्थ करिलु, आगे शुन आर ।
‘आत्म’ - शब्दे ‘देह’ कहे, - चारि अर्थ तार ॥211॥
cc-madhya-24.211.translation: "I have already explained nineteen different meanings. Now please hear further meanings. The word ātma also refers to the body, and this can be taken in four ways.

devanagari: देहारामी देहे भजे ‘देहोपाधि ब्रह्म’ ।
सत्सङ्गे सेह करे कृष्णेर भजन ॥212॥
cc-madhya-24.212.translation: "One in the bodily conception worships his own body as Brahman, but when he comes in contact with the devotee, he gives up this mistaken idea and engages himself in the devotional service of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

lines: tata udagād ananta tava dhāma śiraḥ paramaṁ
punar iha yat sametya na patanti kṛtānta-mukhe
devanagari: उदरमुपासते य ऋषि - वर्मसु कूर्प - दृशः परिसर - पद्धतिं हृदयमारुणयो दहरम् ।
तत उदगादनन्त तव धाम शिरः परमं पुनरिह यत्समेत्य न पतन्ति कृतान्त - मुखे ॥213॥
cc-madhya-24.213.translation: “ 'Those who follow the path of great, saintly mystic yogīs take to the yogic gymnastic process and begin worshiping from the abdomen, where it is said that Brahman is located. Such people are called śārk, which means that they are situated in the gross bodily conception. There are also followers of the ṛṣi known as Āruṇa. Following that path, they observe the activities of the arteries. Thus they gradually rise to the heart, where subtle Brahman, Paramātmā, is situated. They then worship Him. O, unlimited Ananta! Better than these persons are the mystic yogīs who worship You from the top of their heads. Beginning with the abdomen and proceeding through the heart, they reach the top of the head and pass through the brahma-randra, the hole at the top of the skull. Thus yogīs attain the perfectional platform and do not enter the cycle of birth and death again.'

devanagari: देहारामी कर्म - निष्ठ - याज्ञिकादि जन ।
सत्सङ्गे ‘कर्म’ त्यजि’ करय भजन ॥214॥
cc-madhya-24.214.translation: "Those who are in the bodily conception mainly engage in fruitive activity. Those who perform yajñas and ritualistic ceremonies are also considered in the same category. However, when they are all in contact with the pure devotee, they give up their fruitive activity and fully engage in the service of the Lord.

devanagari: कर्मण्यस्मिन्ननाश्वासे धूम - धूम्रात्मनां भवान् ।
आपाययति गोविन्द - पाद - पद्मासवं मधु ॥215॥
cc-madhya-24.215.translation: “ 'We have just begun performing this fruitive activity, a sacrificial fire, but due to the many imperfections in our action, we are not certain of its result. Our bodies have become black from the smoke, but we are factually pleased by the nectar of the lotus feet of the Personality of Godhead, Govinda, which you are distributing.'

devanagari: ‘तपस्वी’ प्रभृति यत देहारामी हय ।
साधु - सङ्गे तप छाड़ि’ श्री कृष्ण भजय ॥216॥
cc-madhya-24.216.translation: "The tapasvīs, those who undergo severe austerities and penances to elevate themselves to the higher planetary systems, are also in the same category. When such persons come in contact with a devotee, they give up all those practices and engage in Lord Kṛṣṇa's service.

devanagari: यत्पाद - सेवाभिरुचिस्तपस्विनाम् अशेष - जन्मोपचितं मलं धियः ।
सद्यः क्षिणोत्यन्वहमेधती सती यथा पदाङ्गुष्ठ - विनिःसृता सरित् ॥217॥
cc-madhya-24.217.translation: “ 'The taste for loving service is like the water of the River Ganges, which flows from the feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Every day that taste diminishes the results of sinful activities acquired over a period of many births by those who perform austerities.'

lines: kṛṣṇa-kṛpāya kṛṣṇa bhaje chāḍi' saba kāma
devanagari: देहारामी, सर्व - काम - सब आत्माराम ।
कृष्ण - कृपाय कृष्ण भजे छाड़ि’ सब काम ॥218॥
cc-madhya-24.218.translation: "As long as one labors under the bodily conception, he must fulfill volumes and volumes of material desires. Thus a person is called ātmārāma. When such an ātmārāma is favored by the mercy of Kṛṣṇa, he gives up his so-called self-satisfaction and engages in the transcendental loving service of the Lord.

devanagari: स्थानाभिलाषी तपसि स्थितोऽहं त्वां प्राप्तवान्देव - मुनीन्द्र - गुह्यम् ।
काचं विचिन्वन्नपि दिव्य - रत्नं स्वामिन्कृतार्थोऽस्मि वरं न याचे ॥219॥
cc-madhya-24.219.translation: [When he was being benedicted by the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Dhruva Mahārāja said], " 'O my Lord, because I was seeking an opulent material position, I was performing severe types of penance and austerity. Now I have gotten You, who are very difficult for the great demigods, saintly persons and kings to attain. I was searching after a piece of glass, but instead I have found a most valuable jewel. Therefore I am so satisfied that I do not wish to ask any benediction from You.'

devanagari: विभु - रूपे व्यापे, शक्त्ये धारण - पोषण ।
माधुर्य - शक्त्ये गोलोक, ऐश्वर्ये परव्योम ॥22॥
cc-madhya-24.22.translation: "Through His all-pervasive feature, the Supreme Personality of Godhead expanded the entire creation. He is holding and maintaining this creation by His extraordinary potency. By His conjugal potency, He maintains the planetary system known as Goloka Vṛndāvana. Through His six opulences, He maintains many Vaikuṇṭha planets.

lines: ei cāri artha saha ha-ila 'teiśa' artha
āra tina artha śuna parama samartha
devanagari: एइ चारि अर्थ सह हइल ‘तेइश’ अर्थ ।
आर तिन अर्थ शुन परम समर्थ ॥220॥
cc-madhya-24.220.translation: "In addition to the nineteen other meanings, this ātmārāma meaning [including those laboring under the bodily conception] makes four meanings altogether and brings the total to twenty-three meanings. Now hear of another three meanings, which are very suitable.

devanagari: च - शब्दे ‘समुच्चये’, आर अर्थ कय ।
‘आत्मारामाश्च मुनयश्च’ कृष्णेरे भजय ॥221॥
cc-madhya-24.221.translation: "As mentioned above, the word ca has been used to mean 'aggregate.' According to this meaning, all the ātmārāmas and the munis engage in Kṛṣṇa's service. Besides 'aggregate,' there is another meaning of the word ca.

lines: 'rāmaś ca kṛṣṇaś ca' yathā viharaye vane
devanagari: ‘निर्ग्रन्थाः’ हञा इहाँ ‘अपि’ - निर्धारणे ।
‘रामश्च कृष्णश्च’ यथा विहरये वने ॥222॥
cc-madhya-24.222.translation: "The word nirgranthāḥ is used as an adjective, and api is used in the sense of certainty. For instance, rāmaś ca kṛṣṇaś ca means that both Rāma and Kṛṣṇa enjoy walking in the forest.

lines: 'baṭo, bhikṣām aṭa, gāṁ cānaya' yaiche prakāra
devanagari: च - शब्दे ‘अन्वाचये’ अर्थ कहे आर ।
‘बटो, भिक्षामट, गां चानय’ यैछे प्रकार ॥223॥
cc-madhya-24.223.translation: "The word ca also means anvācaye, which means to present a secondary thing to be done at the same time. This is the way of understanding the word anvācaye. An example is: 'O brahmacārī, go out to collect alms and at the same time bring in the cows.'

devanagari: कृष्ण - मनने मुनि कृष्णे सर्वदा भजय ।
‘आत्मारामा अ पि’ भजे, - गौण अर्थ कय ॥224॥
cc-madhya-24.224.translation: "Saintly persons who are always meditating upon Kṛṣṇa are engaged in the devotional service of the Lord. The ātmārāmas are also engaged in the Lord's service. That is the indirect import.

devanagari: ‘च’ एवार्थे - ‘मुनयः एव’ कृष्णेरे भजय ।
“आत्मारामा अपि” - ‘अपि’ ‘गर्हा’ - अर्थ कय ॥225॥
cc-madhya-24.225.translation: "The word ca is also used to indicate the certainty that only saintly persons are engaged in rendering devotional service to Kṛṣṇa. In the combination ātmārāmā api, api is used in the sense of censure.

lines: āra artha śuna, yaiche sādhura saṅgama
devanagari: ‘निर्ग्रन्थ ह ञा’ - एइ दुँहार ‘विशेषण’ ।
आर अर्थ शुन, यैछे साधुर सङ्गम ॥226॥
cc-madhya-24.226.translation: "The word nirgrantha is taken as an adjective modifying muni and ātmārāma. There is another meaning, which you may hear from Me, indicating association with a devotee. Now I shall explain how it is that through the association of devotees, even a nirgrantha can become a devotee.

devanagari: निर्ग्रन्थ - शब्दे कहे तबे ‘व्याध’, ‘निर्धन’ ।
साधु - सङ्गे सेह करे श्री - कृष्ण - भजन ॥227॥
cc-madhya-24.227.translation: "The word nirgrantha-when combined with api, used in the sense of certainty-indicates a person who is a hunter by profession or who is very poor. Nonetheless, when such a person associates with a great saint like Nārada, he engages in Lord Kṛṣṇa's devotional service.

devanagari: ‘कृष्णारामा श्च’ एव हय - कृष्ण - मनन ।
व्याध ह ञा हय पूज्य भागवतोत्तम ॥228॥
cc-madhya-24.228.translation: "The words kṛṣṇārāmaś ca refer to one who takes pleasure in thinking of Kṛṣṇa. Even though such a person may be a hunter, he is still worshipable and is the best of devotees.

devanagari: एक भक्त - व्याधेर कथा शुन सावधाने ।
याहा हैते हय सत्सङ्ग - महिमार ज्ञाने ॥229॥
cc-madhya-24.229.translation: "I shall now narrate the story of how the hunter became a great devotee by the association of such an exalted personality as Nārada Muni. From this story, one can understand the greatness of association with pure devotees.

devanagari: माया - शक्त्ये ब्रह्माण्डादि - परिपाटी - सृजन ।
‘उरुक्रम’ - शब्देर एइ अर्थ निरूपण ॥23॥
cc-madhya-24.23.translation: "The word urukrama indicates the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who, by His external potency, has perfectly created innumerable universes.

devanagari: एक दिन श्री - नारद दे खि’ नारायण ।
त्रिवेणी - स्नाने प्रयाग करिला गमन ॥230॥
cc-madhya-24.230.translation: "Once upon a time the great saint Nārada, after visiting Lord Nārāyaṇa in the Vaikuṇṭhas, went to Prayāga to bathe at the confluence of three rivers—the Ganges, Yamunā and Sarasvatī.

lines: vana-pathe dekhe mṛga āche bhūme paḍi'
devanagari: वन - पथे देखे मृग आछे भूमे पड़ि’ ।
बाण - विद्ध भग्न - पाद करे ध ड् - फड़ि ॥231॥
cc-madhya-24.231.translation: "Nārada Muni saw that a deer was lying on the path through the forest and that it was pierced by an arrow. It had broken legs and was twisting due to much pain.

devanagari: आर कत - दूरे एक देखेन शूकर ।
तैछे विद्ध भग्न - पाद करे धड् - फड़ ॥232॥
cc-madhya-24.232.translation: "Farther ahead, Nārada Muni saw a boar pierced by an arrow. Its legs were also broken, and it was twisting in pain.

lines: aiche eka śaśaka dekhe āra kata-dūre
devanagari: ऐछे एक शशक देखे आर कत - दूरे ।
जीवेर दुःख देखि’ नारद व्याकुल - अन्तरे ॥233॥
cc-madhya-24.233.translation: "When he went farther, he saw a rabbit that was also suffering. Nārada Muni was greatly pained at heart to see living entities suffer so.

lines: kata-dūre dekhe vyādha vṛkṣe oṅta hañā
devanagari: कत - दूरे देखे व्याध वृक्षे ओंत हञा ।
मृग मारिबारे आछे बाण युड़िया ॥234॥
cc-madhya-24.234.translation: "When Nārada Muni advanced farther, he saw a hunter behind a tree. This hunter was holding arrows, and he was ready to kill more animals.

devanagari: श्याम - वर्ण रक्त - नेत्र महा - भयङ्कर ।
धनुर्बाण हस्ते, - येन यम दण्ड - धर ॥235॥
cc-madhya-24.235.translation: "The hunter's body was blackish. He had reddish eyes, and he appeared fierce. It was as if the superintendent of death, Yamarāja, was standing there with bows and arrows in his hands.

lines: patha chāḍi' nārada tāra nikaṭe calila
nārade dekhi' mṛga saba palāñā gela
devanagari: पथ छा डि’ नारद तार निकटे चलिल ।
नारदे दे खि’ मृग सब पलाञा गेल ॥236॥
cc-madhya-24.236.translation: "When Nārada Muni left the forest path and went to the hunter, all the animals immediately saw him and fled.

lines: kruddha hañā vyādha tāṅre gāli dite cāya
devanagari: क्रुद्ध हञा व्याध ताँरे गालि दिते चाय ।
नारद - प्रभावे मुखे गालि नाहि आय ॥237॥
cc-madhya-24.237.translation: "When all the animals fled, the hunter wanted to chastise Nārada with abusive language, but due to Nārada's presence, he could not utter anything abusive.

lines: tomā dekhi' mora lakṣya mṛga palāilā"
devanagari: “गोसाञि, प्रयाण - पथ छा ड़ि’ केने आइला ।
तोमा दे खि’ मोर लक्ष्य मृग पलाइला” ॥238॥
cc-madhya-24.238.translation: "The hunter addressed Nārada Muni: 'O gosvāmī! O great saintly person! Why have you left the general path through the forest to come to me? Simply by seeing you, all the animals I was hunting have now fled.'

lines: mane eka saṁśaya haya, tāhā khaṇḍāite
devanagari: नारद कहे , - “पथ भुलि’ आइलाङ पुछिते ।
मने एक संशय हय, ताहा खण्डाइ ते” ॥239॥
cc-madhya-24.239.translation: "Nārada Muni replied, 'Leaving the path, I have come to you to settle a doubt that is in my mind.

devanagari: “क्रमः शक्तौ परिपाट्यां क्रमश्चालन - कम्पयोः” ॥24॥
cc-madhya-24.24.translation: “ 'These are the different meanings of the word krama. It is used in the sense of potency, systematic arrangement, step, moving or trembling.'

lines: pathe ye śūkara-mṛga, jāni tomāra haya"
vyādha kahe,—"yei kaha, sei ta' niścaya"
devanagari: “पथे ये शूकर - मृग, जानि तोमार हय” ।
व्याध कहे , - “येइ कह, सेइ त’ निश्चय” ॥240॥
cc-madhya-24.240.translation: “ 'I was wondering whether all the boars and other animals that are half-killed belong to you.' The hunter replied, 'Yes, what you are saying is so.'

lines: nārada kahe,—"yadi jīve māra' tumi bāṇa
ardha-mārā kara kene, nā lao parāṇa?"
devanagari: नारद कहे , - “यदि जीवे मा र’ तुमि बाण ।
अर्ध - मारा कर केने, ना लओ पराण ?” ॥241॥
cc-madhya-24.241.translation: "Nārada Muni then inquired, 'Why did you not kill the animals completely? Why did you half-kill them by piercing their bodies with arrows?'

lines: pitāra śikṣāte āmi kari aiche kāma
devanagari: व्याध कहे , - “शुन, गोसाञि, ‘मृगारि’ मोर नाम ।
पितार शिक्षाते आमि करि ऐछे काम” ॥242॥
cc-madhya-24.242.translation: "The hunter replied, 'My dear saintly person, my name is Mṛgāri, enemy of animals. My father taught me to kill them in that way.

lines: tabe ta' ānanda mora bāḍaye antare"
devanagari: अर्ध - मारा जीव यदि धड् - फड़ करे ।
तबे त’ आनन्द मोर बाड़ये अन्तरे ॥243॥
cc-madhya-24.243.translation: “ 'When I see half-killed animals suffer, I feel great pleasure.'

lines: vyādha kahe,—"mṛgādi laha, yei tomāra mane
devanagari: नारद कहे , - ‘एक - वस्तु मागि तोमार स्थाने’ ।
व्याध कहे , - “मृगादि लह, येइ तोमार मने” ॥244॥
cc-madhya-24.244.translation: "Nārada Muni then told the hunter, 'I have one thing to beg of you.' The hunter replied, 'You may take whatever animals or anything else you would like.

lines: mṛga-chāla cāha yadi, āisa mora ghare
devanagari: मृग - छाल चाह यदि, आइस मोर घरे ।
येइ चाह ताहा दिब मृग - व्याघ्राम्ब रे ॥245॥
cc-madhya-24.245.translation: “ 'I have many skins if you would like them. I shall give you either a deerskin or a tiger skin.'

lines: nārada kahe,—"ihā āmi kichu nāhi cāhi
devanagari: नारद कहे , - “इहा आमि किछु नाहि चाहि ।
आर एक - दान आमि मागि तोमा - ठाञि” ॥246॥
cc-madhya-24.246.translation: "Nārada Muni said, 'I do not want any of the skins. I am only asking one thing from you in charity.

lines: kāli haite tumi yei mṛgādi māribā
devanagari: कालि हैते तुमि येइ मृगादि मारिबा ।
प्रथमेइ मारिबा, अर्ध - मारा ना करिबा ॥247॥
cc-madhya-24.247.translation: “ 'I beg you that from this day on you will kill animals completely and not leave them half-dead.'

lines: ardha mārile kibā haya, tāhā kaha more"
devanagari: व्याध कहे , - “किबा दान मागिला आमारे ।
अर्ध मारिले किबा हय, ताहा कह मो रे” ॥248॥
cc-madhya-24.248.translation: "The hunter replied, 'My dear sir, what are you asking of me? What is wrong with the animals' lying there half-killed? Will you please explain this to me?'

lines: nārada kahe,—"ardha mārile jīva pāya vyathā
jīve duḥkha ditecha, tomāra ha-ibe aiche avasthā
devanagari: नारद कहे, “अर्ध मारिले जीव पाय व्यथा ।
जीवे दुःख दितेछ, तोमार हइबे ऐछे अवस्था” ॥249॥
cc-madhya-24.249.translation: "Nārada Muni replied, 'If you leave the animals half-dead, you are purposefully giving them pain. Therefore you will have to suffer in retaliation.'

devanagari: ‘कुर्वन्ति’ - पद एइ परस्मैपद हय ।
कृष्ण - सुख - निमित्त भजने तात्पर्य कहय ॥25॥
cc-madhya-24.25.translation: "The word kurvanti, which means 'they do something for others,' is a form of the verb 'things done for others.' It is used in connection with devotional service, which must be executed for the satisfaction of Kṛṣṇa. That is the purport of the word kurvanti.

lines: vyādha tumi, jīva māra—'alpa' aparādha tomāra
devanagari: व्याध तुमि, जीव मार - ‘अल्प’ अपराध तोमार ।
कदर्थना दिया मा र’ - ए पाप ‘अपार’ ॥250॥
cc-madhya-24.250.translation: "Nārada Muni continued, 'My dear hunter, your business is killing animals. That is a slight offense on your part, but when you consciously give them unnecessary pain by leaving them half-dead, you incur very great sins.'

devanagari: कदर्थिया तुमि यत मारिला जीवेरे ।
तारा तैछे तोमा मारिबे जन्म - जन्मान्त रे ॥251॥
cc-madhya-24.251.translation: "Nārada Muni continued, 'All the animals that you have killed and given unnecessary pain will kill you one after the other in your next life and in life after life.'

lines: tāṅra vākya śuni' mane bhaya upajila
devanagari: नारद - सड़े व्याधेर मन परसन्न हइल ।
ताँर वाक्य शुनि’ मने भय उपजिल ॥252॥
cc-madhya-24.252.translation: "In this way, through the association of the great sage Nārada Muni, the hunter was a little convinced of his sinful activity. He therefore became somewhat afraid due to his offenses.

lines: vyādha kahe,—"bālya haite ei āmāra karma
devanagari: व्याध कहे , - “बाल्य हैते एइ आमार कर्म ।
केमने तरिमु मुञि पामर अधम ?” ॥253॥
cc-madhya-24.253.translation: "The hunter then admitted that he was convinced of his sinful activity, and he said, 'I have been taught this business from my very childhood. Now I am wondering how I can become freed from these unlimited volumes of sinful activity.'

lines: ei pāpa yāya mora, kemana upāye?
nistāra karaha more, paḍoṅ tomāra pāye"
devanagari: एइ पाप याय मोर, केमन उपाये ? ।
निस्तार करह मोरे, पड़ों तोमार पाये ॥254॥
cc-madhya-24.254.translation: "The hunter continued, 'My dear sir, please tell me how I can be relieved from the reactions of my sinful life. Now I fully surrender unto you and fall down at your lotus feet. Please deliver me from sinful reactions.'

lines: tabe se karite pāri tomāra mocana'
devanagari: नारद कहे , - ’यदि धरे आमार वचन ।
तबे से करिते पारि तोमार मोच न’ ॥255॥
cc-madhya-24.255.translation: "Nārada Muni assured the hunter, 'If you listen to my instructions, I shall find the way you can be liberated.'

lines: vyādha kahe,—'yei kaha, sei ta' kariba'
nārada kahe,—'dhanuka bhāṅga, tabe se kahiba'
devanagari: व्याध कहे , - ‘येइ कह, सेइ त’ करिब’ ।
नारद कहे , - ‘धनुक भाङ्ग, तबे से कहि ब’ ॥256॥
cc-madhya-24.256.translation: "The hunter then said, 'My dear sir, whatever you say I shall do.' Nārada immediately ordered him, 'First of all, break your bow. Then I shall tell you what is to be done.'

devanagari: व्याध कहे, - ‘धनुक भाङ्गिले वर्तिब केमने?’ ।
नारद कहे , - ‘आमि अन्न दिब प्रति - दिने’ ॥257॥
cc-madhya-24.257.translation: "The hunter replied, 'If I break my bow, how shall I maintain myself?' Nārada Muni replied, 'Do not worry. I shall supply all your food every day.'

lines: dhanuka bhāṅgi' vyādha tāṅra caraṇe paḍila
devanagari: धनुक भाङ्गि’ व्याध ताँर चरणे पड़िल ।
तारे उठा ञा नारद उपदेश कैल ॥258॥
cc-madhya-24.258.translation: "Being thus assured by the great sage Nārada Muni, the hunter broke his bow, immediately fell down at the saint's lotus feet and fully surrendered. After this, Nārada Muni raised him with his hand and gave him instructions for spiritual advancement.

lines: "ghare giyā brāhmaṇe deha' yata āche dhana
eka eka vastra pari' bāhira hao dui-jana
devanagari: घरे गिया ब्राह्मणे देह’ यत आछे धन ।
एक एक वस्त्र परि’ बाहिर हओ दुइ - जन ॥259॥
cc-madhya-24.259.translation: "Nārada Muni then advised the hunter, 'Return home and distribute whatever riches you have to the pure brāhmaṇas who know the Absolute Truth. After distributing all your riches to the brāhmaṇas, both you and your wife should leave home, taking only one cloth to wear.'

devanagari: “स्वरित - ञितः कर्त्रभिप्राये क्रिया - फले” ॥26॥
cc-madhya-24.26.translation: “ 'The terminations of the ātmanepada are employed when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent of verbs having an indicatory ñ or a svarita accent.'

devanagari: नदी - तीरे एक - खानि कुटीर करिया ।
तार आगे एक - पिण्डि तुलसी रोपिया ॥260॥
cc-madhya-24.260.translation: "Nārada Muni continued, 'Leave your home and go to the river. There you should construct a small cottage, and in front of the cottage you should grow a tulasī plant on a raised platform.

devanagari: तुलसी - परिक्रमा कर, तुलसी - सेवन ।
निरन्तर कृष्ण - नाम करिह कीर्तन ॥261॥
cc-madhya-24.261.translation: “ 'After planting the tulasī tree before your house, you should daily circumambulate that tulasī plant, serve her by giving her water and other things, and continuously chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra.'

lines: āmi tomāya bahu anna pāṭhāimu dine
sei anna labe, yata khāo dui-jane"
devanagari: आमि तोमाय बहु अन्न पाठाइमु दिने ।
सेइ अन्न लबे, यत खाओ दुइ - जने ॥262॥
cc-madhya-24.262.translation: "Nārada Muni continued, 'I shall send sufficient food to you both every day. You can take as much food as you want.'

lines: tabe sei mṛgādi tine nārada sustha kaila
sustha hañā mṛgādi tine dhāñā palāila
devanagari: तबे सेइ मृगादि तिने नारद सुस्थ कैल ।
सुस्थ हञा मृगादि तिने धाञा पलाइल ॥263॥
cc-madhya-24.263.translation: "The three animals that were half-killed were then brought to their consciousness by the sage Nārada. Indeed, the animals got up and swiftly fled.

lines: ghare gela vyādha, guruke kari' namaskāra
devanagari: देखिया व्याधेर मने हैल चमत्कार ।
घरे गेल व्याध, गुरुके करि’ नमस्कार ॥264॥
cc-madhya-24.264.translation: "When the hunter saw the half-killed animals flee, he was certainly struck with wonder. He then offered his respectful obeisances to the sage Nārada and returned home.

lines: yathā-sthāne nārada gelā, vyādha ghare āila
devanagari: यथा - स्थाने नारद गेला, व्याध घरे आइल ।
नारदेर उपदेशे सकल करिल ॥265॥
cc-madhya-24.265.translation: "After all this, Nārada Muni went to his destination. After the hunter returned home, he exactly followed the instructions of his spiritual master, Nārada.

lines: grāmera loka saba anna ānite lāgila
devanagari: ग्रामे ध्वनि हैल , - व्याध वैष्ण व’ हइल ।
ग्रामेर लोक सब अन्न आनिते लागिल ॥266॥
cc-madhya-24.266.translation: "The news that the hunter had become a Vaiṣṇava spread all over the village. Indeed, all the villagers broughts alms and presented them to the Vaiṣṇava who was formerly a hunter.

lines: dine tata laya, yata khāya dui jane
devanagari: एक - दिन अन्न आने दश - बिश ज ने ।
दिने तत लय, यत खाय दुइ जने ॥267॥
cc-madhya-24.267.translation: "In one day enough food was brought for ten or twenty people, but the hunter and his wife would accept only as much as they could eat.

lines: āmāra eka śiṣya āche, calaha dekhite"
devanagari: एक - दिन नारद कहे , - “शुनह, पर्वते ।
आमार एक शिष्य आछे, चलह देखि ते” ॥268॥
cc-madhya-24.268.translation: "One day, while speaking to his friend Parvata Muni, Nārada Muni requested him to go with him to see his disciple the hunter.

lines: tabe dui ṛṣi āilā sei vyādha-sthāne
dūra haite vyādha pāila gurura daraśane
devanagari: तबे दुइ ऋषि आइला सेइ व्याध - स्थाने ।
दूर हैते व्याध पाइल गुरुर दरशने ॥269॥
cc-madhya-24.269.translation: "When the saintly sages came to the hunter's place, the hunter could see them coming from a distance.

lines: bhukti, siddhi, mukti—mukhya ei tina prakāre
devanagari: ‘हेतु’ - शब्दे कहे - भुक्ति - आदि वाञ्छान्तरे ।
भुक्ति, सिद्धि, मुक्ति - मुख्य एइ तिन प्रकारे ॥27॥
cc-madhya-24.27.translation: "The word hetu [cause] means that a thing is done for some motive. There can be three motives. One may act to enjoy the result personally, to achieve some material perfection, or to act in such a way that one may be liberated.

lines: āste-vyaste dhāñā āse, patha nāhi pāya
devanagari: आस्ते - व्यस्ते धा ञा आसे, पथ नाहि पाय ।
पथेर पिपीलिका इति - उति धरे पाय ॥270॥
cc-madhya-24.270.translation: "With great alacrity the hunter began to run toward his spiritual master, but he could not fall down and offer obeisances because ants were running hither and thither around his feet.

lines: vastre sthāna jhāḍi' paḍe daṇḍavat hañā
devanagari: दण्डवत्स्थाने पिपीलिकारे देखिया ।
वस्त्रे स्थान झा ड़ि’ पड़े दण्डवत् हञा ॥271॥
cc-madhya-24.271.translation: "Seeing the ants, the hunter whisked them away with a piece of cloth. After thus clearing the ants from the ground, he fell down flat to offer his obeisances.

lines: nārada kahe,—"vyādha, ei nā haya āścarya
devanagari: नारद कहे , - “व्याध, एइ ना हय आश्चर्य ।
हरि - भक्त्ये हिंसा शून्य हय साधु - वर्य ॥272॥
cc-madhya-24.272.translation: "Nārada Muni said, 'My dear hunter, such behavior is not at all astonishing. A man in devotional service is automatically nonviolent. He is the best of gentlemen.

devanagari: एते न ह्यद्ध ता व्याध तवाहिंसादयो गुणाः ।
हरि - भक्तौ प्रवृत्ता ये न ते स्युः पर - तापिनः ॥273॥
cc-madhya-24.273.translation: “ 'O hunter, good qualities like nonviolence, which you have developed, are not very astonishing, for those engaged in the Lord's devotional service are never inclined to give pain to others because of envy.'

lines: tabe sei vyādha doṅhāre aṅgane ānila
devanagari: तबे सेइ व्याध दोंहारे अङ्गने आनिल ।
कुशासन आनि’ दोंहारे भक्त्ये वसाइल ॥274॥
cc-madhya-24.274.translation: "The hunter then received both the great sages in the courtyard of his house. He spread out a straw mat for them to sit upon, and with great devotion he begged them to sit down.

lines: jala āni' bhaktye doṅhāra pāda prakṣālila
sei jala strī-puruṣe piyā śire la-ila
devanagari: जल आ नि’ भक्त्ये दोंहार पाद प्रक्षालिल ।
सेइ जल स्त्री - पुरुषे पिया शिरे लइल ॥275॥
cc-madhya-24.275.translation: "He then fetched water and washed the sages' feet with great devotion. Then both husband and wife drank that water and sprinkled it on their heads.

lines: ūrdhva bāhu nṛtya kare vastra uḍāñā
devanagari: कम्प - पुलकाश्रु हैल कृष्ण - नाम गाञा ।
ऊर्ध्व बा हु नृत्य करे वस्त्र उड़ाञा ॥276॥
cc-madhya-24.276.translation: "When the hunter chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra before his spiritual master, his body trembled, and tears welled in his eyes. Filled with ecstatic love, he raised his hands and began to dance, waving his garments up and down.

devanagari: देखिया व्याधेर प्रेम पर्वत - महामुनि ।
नारदेरे कहे , - तुमि हओ स्पर्श - मणि ॥277॥
cc-madhya-24.277.translation: "When Parvata Muni saw the ecstatic loving symptoms of the hunter, he told Nārada, 'Certainly you are a touchstone.'

devanagari: “अहो धन्योऽसि देवर्षे कृपया यस्य तत्क्षणात् ।
नीचोऽप्युत्पुलको लेभे लुब्धको रतिमच्युते” ॥278॥
cc-madhya-24.278.translation: "Parvata Muni continued, 'My dear friend Nārada Muni, you are glorified as the sage among the demigods. By your mercy, even a lowborn person like this hunter can immediately become attached to Lord Kṛṣṇa.'

lines: nārada kahe,—'vaiṣṇava, tomāra anna kichu āya?'
vyādha kahe, "yāre pāṭhāo, sei diyā yāya
devanagari: नारद कहे , - ‘वैष्णव, तोमार अन्न किछु आय?’ ।
व्याध कहे, “यारे पाठाओ, सेइ दिया याय” ॥279॥
cc-madhya-24.279.translation: "Nārada Muni then asked the hunter, 'My dear Vaiṣṇava, do you have some income for your maintenance?' The hunter replied, 'My dear spiritual master, whoever you send gives me something when he comes to see me.'

devanagari: एक भुक्ति कहे, भोग - अनन्त - प्रकार ।
सिद्धि - अष्टादश, मुक्ति - पञ्च - विधाकार ॥28॥
cc-madhya-24.28.translation: "First we take the word bhukti [material enjoyment], which is of unlimited variety. We may also take the word siddhi [perfection], which has eighteen varieties. Similarly, the word mukti has five varieties.

lines: eta anna nā pāṭhāo, kichu kārya nāi
devanagari: एत अन्न ना पाठाओ, किछु कार्य नाइ ।
सबे दुइ - जनार योग्य भक्ष्य - मात्र चाइ ॥280॥
cc-madhya-24.280.translation: "The former hunter said, 'Please do not send so many grains. Only send what is sufficient for two people, no more.'

devanagari: नारद कहे , - ‘ऐछे रह, तुमि भाग्यवान्’ ।
एत ब लि’ दुइ - जन हइला अन्तर्धान ॥281॥
cc-madhya-24.281.translation: "Nārada Muni approved his not wanting more than a daily supply of food, and he blessed him, saying, 'You are fortunate.' Nārada Muni and Parvata Muni then disappeared from that place.

lines: ei ta' kahiluṅ tomāya vyādhera ākhyāna
devanagari: एइ त कहिलुँ तोमाय व्याधेर आख्यान ।
या शुनिले हय साधु - सङ्ग - प्रभाव - ज्ञान ॥282॥
cc-madhya-24.282.translation: "So far I have narrated the incident of the hunter. By hearing this narration, one can understand the influence derived by associating with devotees.

lines: ei āra tina artha gaṇanāte pāila
ei dui artha mili' 'chābbiśa' artha haila
devanagari: एइ आर तिन अर्थ गणनाते पाइल ।
एइ दुइ अर्थ मिलि’ ‘छाब्बि श’ अर्थ हैल ॥283॥
cc-madhya-24.283.translation: "In this way we have found three more meanings. Combine these with the other meanings, and the total number of meanings add up to twenty-six in all.

devanagari: आर अर्थ शुन, याहा - अर्थेर भाण्डार ।
स्थूले ‘दुइ’ अर्थ, सूक्ष्मे ‘बत्रिश’ प्रकार ॥284॥
cc-madhya-24.284.translation: "There is yet another meaning, which is full of a variety of imports. Actually there are two gross meanings and thirty-two subtle meanings.

devanagari: ‘आत्मा’ - शब्दे कहे - सर्व - विध भगवान् ।
एक ‘स्वयं भगवान्’, आर ‘भगवान्’ - आख्यान ॥285॥
cc-madhya-24.285.translation: "The word ātmā refers to all the different expansions of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. One of them is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself, Kṛṣṇa, and the others are different incarnations or expansions of Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: ताँते रमे येइ, सेइ सब - ‘आत्मारा म’ ।
‘विधि - भक्त’, ‘राग - भक्त’, - दुइ - विध नाम ॥286॥
cc-madhya-24.286.translation: "One who always engages in the service of the Supreme Personality of Godhead is called ātmārāma. There are two types of ātmārāma. One is an ātmārāma engaged in regulative devotional service, and the other is an ātmārāma engaged in spontaneous devotional service.

lines: dui-vidha bhakta haya cāri cāri prakāra
devanagari: दुइ - विध भक्त हय चारि चारि प्रकार ।
पारिषद, साधन - सिद्ध, साधक - गण आर ॥287॥
cc-madhya-24.287.translation: "The ātmārāmas engaged in regulative and spontaneous devotional service are further categorized into four groups. There are the eternal associates, the associates who have become perfect by devotional service, and those who are engaged in devotional service and are called sādhaka.

devanagari: जात - अजात - रति - भेदे साधक दुइ भेद ।
विधि - राग - मार्गे चारि चारि - अष्ट भेद ॥288॥
cc-madhya-24.288.translation: "Those who are practicing devotional service are either mature or immature. Therefore the sādhakas are of two types. Since the devotees execute either regulative devotional service or spontaneous devotional service and there are four groups within these two divisions, altogether there are eight varieties.

devanagari: विधि - भक्त्ये नित्य - सिद्ध पारिषद - ‘दास’ ।
cc-madhya-24.289.translation: "By executing regulative devotional service, one is elevated to the platform of an eternally perfect associate-such as a servant, friend, superior or beloved woman. These are of four varieties.

lines: yāhā haite vaśa haya śrī-kṛṣṇa kautukī
devanagari: एइ याँहा नाहि, ताहा भक्ति - ‘अहैतुकी’ ।
याहा हैते वश हय श्री कृष्ण कौतुकी ॥29॥
cc-madhya-24.29.translation: "Causeless devotional service is unmotivated by sense enjoyment, perfection or liberation. When one is freed from all these contaminations, he can bring Lord Kṛṣṇa, who is very funny, under control.

devanagari: साधन - सिद्ध - दास, सखा, गुरु, कान्ता - गण ।
जात - रति साधक - भक्त - चारि - विध जन ॥290॥
cc-madhya-24.290.translation: "Among those who have perfected themselves by devotional service, there are servants, friends, superiors and beloved damsels. Similarly, there are four types of mature devotees.

devanagari: अजात - रति साधक - भक्त, - ए चार प्रकार ।
विधि - मार्गे भक्ते षोड़श भेद प्रचार ॥291॥
cc-madhya-24.291.translation: "Within the category of regulative devotional service, there are also immature devotees. These are also of four varieties. Thus in regulative devotional service there are altogether sixteen varieties.

devanagari: राग - आर्गे ऐछे भक्ते षोड़श विभेद ।
दुइ मार्गे आत्मारामेर बत्रिश विभेद ॥292॥
cc-madhya-24.292.translation: "On the path of spontaneous devotional service, there are also sixteen categories of devotees. Thus there are thirty-two types of ātmārāmas enjoying the Supreme Lord on these two paths.

lines: yāhāṅ yei lāge, tāhā kariye samartha
devanagari: ‘मुनि’, ‘निर्ग्रन्थ’, ‘च’ ‘अपि’, - चारि शब्देर अर्थ ।
याहाँ येइ लागे, ताहा करिये समर्थ ॥293॥
cc-madhya-24.293.translation: "When these thirty-two types of devotees are qualified with the words muni nirgrantha ca api, they can be increased in different ways and very soundly elaborated upon.

lines: āra eka bheda śuna arthera prakāśa
devanagari: बत्रिशे छाब्बिशे मिलि, अष्ट - पञ्चाश ।
आर एक भेद शुन अर्थेर प्रकाश ॥294॥
cc-madhya-24.294.translation: "When we add the twenty-six types of devotees to these thirty-two, they altogether number fifty-eight. You may now hear from Me of manifestations with different meanings.

devanagari: इतरेतर ‘च’ दिया समास करिये ।
‘आटान्न’ - बार आत्माराम नाम लइये ॥295॥
cc-madhya-24.295.translation: "In this way, as I add the word ca to one word after another, I make a compound. Thus the different names of ātmārāmas can be taken fifty-eight times.

lines: śeṣe saba lopa kari' rākhi eka-bāra
devanagari: ‘आत्मारामाश्च आत्मारामा श्च’ आटान्न - बार ।
शेषे सब लोप क रि’ राखि एक - बार ॥296॥
cc-madhya-24.296.translation: "In this way, one can repeat the word ātmārāmāḥ with ca for each of the fifty-eight meanings. By following the rule previously stated and rejecting all but the last, we retain that which represents all the meanings.

devanagari: सरूपाणामेक - शेष एक - विभक्तौ ,
उक्तार्थानामप्रयोग इति ॥297॥
cc-madhya-24.297.translation: “ 'Of words having the same form and case termination, the last one is the only one retained.'

devanagari: आटान्न च - कारेर सब लोप हय ।
एक आत्माराम - शब्दे आटान्न अर्थ कय ॥298॥
cc-madhya-24.298.translation: "When all the ca-kāra, or additions to the word ca, are taken away, fifty-eight different meanings can still be understood by the one word ātmārāma.

lines: aśvattha-vṛkṣāś ca baṭa-vṛkṣāś ca kapittha-vṛkṣāś ca āmra-vṛkṣāś ca vṛkṣāḥ
devanagari: अश्वत्थ - वृक्षाश्च बट - वृक्षाश्च कपित्थ -
वृक्षाश्च आम्र - वृक्षाश्च वृक्षाः ॥299॥
cc-madhya-24.299.translation: “ 'By the plural word vṛkṣāḥ [trees], all trees, such as banyan trees, fig trees, kapittha trees and mango trees, are indicated.'

devanagari: तबे सनातन प्रभुर चरणे धरिया ।
पुनरपि कहे किछु विनय करिया ॥3॥
cc-madhya-24.3.translation: Thereafter, Sanātana Gosvāmī clasped the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and humbly submitted the following petition.

devanagari: ‘भक्ति’ - शब्देर अर्थ हय दश - विधाकार ।
एक - ‘साधन’, ‘प्रेम - भक्ति’ - नव प्रकार ॥30॥
cc-madhya-24.30.translation: "There are ten meanings to the word bhakti, devotional service. One is execution of devotional service according to the regulative principles, and the other, called prema-bhakti [ecstatic love] has nine varieties.

lines: taiche saba ātmārāma kṛṣṇe bhakti karaya
devanagari: “अस्मिन्वने वृक्षाः फलन्ति” यैछे हय ।
तैछे सब आत्माराम कृष्णे भक्ति करय ॥300॥
cc-madhya-24.300.translation: "This ātmārāma verse is like the sentence, 'In this forest many different trees bear fruit.' All ātmārāmas render devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: ‘आत्मारामा श्च’ समुच्चये कहिये च - कार ।
‘मुनयश्च’ भक्ति करे , - एइ अर्थ तार ॥301॥
cc-madhya-24.301.translation: "After fifty-eight times uttering the word ātmārāmāḥ and taking ca in a sense of aggregation, one may add the word munayaḥ. That will mean that they also render devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa. In this way there are fifty-nine meanings.

devanagari: ‘निर्ग्रन्था ए व’ हञा, ‘अपि’ - निर्धारणे ।
एइ ‘ऊनषष्टि’ प्रकार अर्थ करि लुँ व्याख्याने ॥302॥
cc-madhya-24.302.translation: "Then taking the word nirgranthā and considering api in the sense of sustenance, I have tried to explain fifty-nine meanings of the word.

lines: 'ātmārāmāś ca munayaś ca nirgranthāś ca' bhajaya
devanagari: सर्व - समुच्चये आर एक अर्थ हय ।
‘आत्मारामाश्च मुनयश्च निर्ग्रन्थाश्च’ भजय ॥303॥
cc-madhya-24.303.translation: "Taking all the words together, there is another meaning. Whether one is an ātmārāma, a great sage, or nirgrantha, everyone must engage in the service of the Lord.

devanagari: ‘अपि’ - शब्द - अवधारणे, सेह चार बार ।
चारि - शब्द - सड़े एवेर करिबे उच्चार ॥304॥
cc-madhya-24.304.translation: "The word api is then used in the sense of ascertainment, and then four times with four words the word eva can be uttered.

lines: "urukrame eva bhaktim eva ahaitukīm eva kurvanty eva"
devanagari: “उरुक्रमे एव भ क्तिमेव अहैतुकीमेव कुर्वन्त्येव” ॥305॥
cc-madhya-24.305.translation: "The words urukrama, bhakti, ahaitukī and kurvanti are added to the word eva again and again. Thus another meaning is explained.

lines: ei ta' kahiluṅ ślokera 'ṣaṣṭi' saṅkhyaka artha
āra eka artha śuna pramāṇe samartha
devanagari: एइ त कहिलुँ श्लोकेर ‘षष्टि’ सङ्ख्यक अर्थ ।
आर एक अर्थ शुन प्रमाणे समर्थ ॥306॥
cc-madhya-24.306.translation: "Now I have given sixty different meanings to the verse, and yet there is another meaning which is also very strongly evident.

devanagari: ‘आत्मा’ - शब्दे कहे ‘क्षेत्रज्ञ जी व’ - लक्षण ।
ब्रह्मादि कीट - पर्यन्त - ताँर शक्तिते गणन ॥307॥
cc-madhya-24.307.translation: "The word ātmā also refers to the living entity who knows about his body. That is another symptom. From Lord Brahmā down to the insignificant ant, everyone is counted as the marginal potency of the Lord.

devanagari: विष्णु - शक्तिः परा प्रोक्ता क्षेत्रज्ञाख्या तथा परा ।
अविद्या - कर्म - संज्ञान्या तृतीया शक्तिरिष्यते ॥308॥
cc-madhya-24.308.translation: “ 'The potency of Lord Viṣṇu is summarized in three categories-namely the spiritual potency, the living entities and ignorance. The spiritual potency is full of knowledge; the living entities, although belonging to the spiritual potency, are subject to bewilderment; and the third energy, which is full of ignorance, is always visible in fruitive activities.'

devanagari: “क्षेत्रज्ञ आत्मा पुरुषः
प्रधानं प्रकृतिः स्त्रियाम्” ॥309॥
cc-madhya-24.309.translation: “ 'The word kṣetrajña refers to the living entity, the enjoyer, the chief and material nature.'

devanagari: ‘रति’ - लक्षणा, ‘प्रेम’ - लक्षणा, इत्यादि प्रचार ।
भाव - रूपा, महाभाव - लक्षण - रूपा आर ॥31॥
cc-madhya-24.31.translation: "Next are explained the symptoms of love of Godhead, which can be divided into nine varieties, beginning with attraction up to ecstatic love and finally up to the topmost ecstatic love [mahābhāva].

lines: saba tyaji' tabe tiṅho kṛṣṇere bhajaya
devanagari: भ्रमिते भ्रमिते यदि साधु - सङ्ग पाय ।
सब त्य जि’ तबे सिंहो कृष्णेरे भजय ॥310॥
cc-madhya-24.310.translation: "The living entities are wandering in different species of life on different planets, but if by chance they get the association of a pure devotee [sādhu] they give up all other engagements and engage in the service of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

lines: sei artha haya ei saba udāharaṇe
devanagari: षाटि अर्थ कहिलुँ, सब - कृष्णेर भजने ।
सेइ अर्थ हय एइ सब उदाहरणे ॥311॥
cc-madhya-24.311.translation: "I have thus explained sixty different meanings, and all of them aim at the service of Lord Kṛṣṇa. After giving so many examples, that is the only meaning.

devanagari: ‘एक - षष्टि’ अर्थ एबे स्फुरिल तोमा - सङ्गे ।
तोमार भक्ति - वशे उठे अर्थेर तरङ्गे ॥312॥
cc-madhya-24.312.translation: "Now, due to your association, another meaning has awakened. It is due to your devotional service that these waves of meaning are arising.

devanagari: अहं वेद्मि शुको वेत्ति व्यासो वेत्ति न वेत्ति वा ।
भक्त्या भागवतं ग्राह्यं न बुद्ध्या न च टीकया ॥313॥
cc-madhya-24.313.translation: "[Lord Śiva said,] 'I may know; Śukadeva Gosvāmī, the son of Vyāsadeva, may know; and Vyāsadeva may know or may not know the Śrīmad Bhāgavatam. On the whole, Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, the spotless Purāṇa, can be learned only through devotional service, not by material intelligence, speculative methods or imaginary commentaries.' "

devanagari: अर्थ शुनि’ सनातन विस्मित ह ञा ।
स्तुति करे महाप्रभुर चरणे धरिया ॥314॥
cc-madhya-24.314.translation: After hearing all the explanations of all the different meanings of the ātmārāma verse, Sanātana Gosvāmī was struck with wonder. He fell down at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and began to offer prayers.

devanagari: साक्षात् ईश्वर तुमि व्रजेन्द्र - नन्दन ।
तोमार निश्वासे सर्व - वेद - प्रवर्तन ॥315॥
cc-madhya-24.315.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī said, "My dear Lord, You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda. All the Vedic literatures are vibrated through Your breathing.

lines: tomā vinā anya jānite nāhika samartha"
devanagari: तुमि - वक्ता भागवतेर, तुमि जान अर्थ ।
तोमा विना अन्य जानिते नाहिक समर्थ ॥316॥
cc-madhya-24.316.translation: "My dear Lord, You are the original speaker of the Bhāgavatam. You therefore know its real import. But for You, no one can understand the confidential meaning of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam."

lines: bhāgavatera svarūpa kene nā kara vicāraṇa?
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “केने कर आमार स्तवन ।
भागवतेर स्वरूप केने ना कर विचारण ?” ॥317॥
cc-madhya-24.317.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Why are you glorifying Me personally? You should understand the transcendental position of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam. Why don't you consider this important point?

devanagari: कृष्ण - तुल्य भागवत - विभु, सर्वाश्रय ।
प्रति - श्लोके प्रति - अक्षरे नाना अर्थ कय ॥318॥
cc-madhya-24.318.translation: "Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam is as great as Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Lord and shelter of everything. In each and every verse of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and in each and every syllable, there are various meanings.

devanagari: प्रश्नोत्तरे भागवते करियाले निर्धार ।
याँहार श्रवणे लोके लागे चमत्कार ॥319॥
cc-madhya-24.319.translation: "The form of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam is given in questions and answers. Thus the conclusion is established. By hearing these questions and answers, one is highly astonished.

devanagari: शान्त - भक्तेर रति बाड़े ‘प्रेम’ - पर्यन्त ।
दास्य - भक्तेर रति हय ‘राग’ - दशा - अन्त ॥32॥
cc-madhya-24.32.translation: "The attraction to Kṛṣṇa of devotees on the platform of neutrality increases up to love of Godhead [prema], and the attraction of devotees on the platform of servitorship increases to spontaneous attachment [rāga].

devanagari: ब्रूहि योगेश्वरे कृष्णे ब्रह्मण्ये धर्म - वर्मणि ।
स्वां काष्ठामधुनोपेते धर्मः कं शरणं गतः ॥320॥
cc-madhya-24.320.translation: “ 'Now that Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Absolute Truth, the master of all mystic powers, has departed for His own abode, please tell us by whom religious principles are presently protected.'

devanagari: कृष्णे स्व - धामोपगते धर्म - ज्ञानादिभिः सह ।
कलौ नष्ट - दृशामेष पुराणार्कोऽधुनोदितः ॥321॥
cc-madhya-24.321.translation: “ 'After Lord Kṛṣṇa departed for His abode along with religious principles and transcendental knowledge, this Purāṇa, Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, has arisen like the sun in this Age of Kali to enlighten those who have no spiritual vision.'

lines: ei mata kahiluṅ eka ślokera vyākhyāna
vātulera pralāpa kari' ke kare pramāṇa?
devanagari: एइ मत कहिलुँ एक श्लोकेर व्याख्यान ।
बातुलेर प्रलाप करि’ के करे प्रमाण ? ॥322॥
cc-madhya-24.322.translation: "In this way, like a madman, I have explained the meaning of just one verse. I do not know who will take this as evidence.

devanagari: आमा - हेन येबा केह ‘बातुल’ हय ।
एइ - दृष्टे भागवतेर अर्थ जानय ॥323॥
cc-madhya-24.323.translation: "If one becomes a madman like Me, he may also understand the meaning of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam by this process."

lines: punaḥ sanātana kahe yuḍi' dui kare
devanagari: पुनः सनातन कहे युड़ि’ दुइ करे ।
प्रभु आज्ञा दिला ‘वैष्णव - स्मृति’ करिबारे ॥324॥
cc-madhya-24.324.translation: Folding his hands, Sanātana Gosvāmī said, "My Lord, You ordered me to write a directory about the activities of Vaiṣṇavas.

devanagari: मुञि - नीच - जाति, किछु ना जानों आचार ।
मो - हैते कैछे हय स्मृति - परचार ॥325॥
cc-madhya-24.325.translation: "I am a most lowborn person. I have no knowledge of good behavior. How is it possible for me to write authorized directions about Vaiṣṇava activities?"

lines: sūtra kari' diśā yadi karaha upadeśa
devanagari: सूत्र करि’ दिशा यदि करह उपदेश ।
आपने करह यदि हृदये प्रवेश ॥326॥
cc-madhya-24.326.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī then requested the Lord, "Please personally tell me how I can write this difficult book about Vaiṣṇava behavior. Please manifest Yourself in my heart.

lines: tabe tāra diśā sphure mo-nīcera hṛdaya
īśvara tumi,—ye karāha, sei siddha haya"
devanagari: तबे तार दिशा स्फुरे मो - नीचेर हृदय ।
ईश्वर तुमि, - ये कराह, सेइ सिद्ध हय ॥327॥
cc-madhya-24.327.translation: "If You would please manifest Yourself within my heart and personally direct me in writing this book, then, although I am lowborn, I may hope to be able to write it. You can do this because You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead Yourself, and whatever You direct is perfect."

lines: prabhu kahe,—"ye karite karibā tumi mana
kṛṣṇa sei sei tomā karābe sphuraṇa
devanagari: प्रभु कहे, - “ये करिते करिबा तुमि मन ।
कृष्ण सेइ सेइ तोमा कराबे स्फुरण” ॥328॥
cc-madhya-24.328.translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Whatever you want to do you will be able to do correctly by Lord Kṛṣṇa's favor. He will manifest the real purport.

devanagari: तथापि एइ सूत्रेर शुन दिग्दरशन ।
सकारण लिखि आदौ गुरु - आश्रयण ॥329॥
cc-madhya-24.329.translation: "Because you asked me for a synopsis, please hear these few indications. In the beginning one must take shelter of a bona fide spiritual master.

devanagari: सखा - गणेर रति हय ‘अनुराग’ पर्यन्त ।
पितृ - मातृ - स्नेह आदि ‘अनुराग’ - अन्त ॥33॥
cc-madhya-24.33.translation: "Devotees in Vṛndāvana who are friends of the Lord can increase their ecstatic love to the point of anurāga. Paternal affectionate lovers, Kṛṣṇa's father and mother, can increase their love of Godhead up to the anurāga point also.

devanagari: गुरु - लक्षण, शिष्य - लक्षण, दोंहार परीक्षण ।
सेव्य - भगवान्, सर्व - मन्त्र - विचारण ॥330॥
cc-madhya-24.330.translation: "In your book there should be the characteristics of the bona fide guru and the bona fide disciple. Then, before accepting a spiritual master, one can be assured of the spiritual master's position. Similarly, the spiritual master can also be assured of the disciple's position. The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, should be described as the worshipable object, and you should consider the bīja-mantra for the worship of Kṛṣṇa, Rāma or any other expansion of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

devanagari: मन्त्र - अधिकारी, मन्त्र - सिद्ध्यादि - शोधन ।
दीक्षा, प्रातः - स्मृति - कृत्य, शौच, आचमन ॥331॥
cc-madhya-24.331.translation: "You should discuss the qualifications necessary for receiving a mantra, the perfection of the mantra, the purification of the mantra, initiation, morning duties, remembrance of the Supreme Lord, cleanliness, and washing the mouth and other parts of the body.

devanagari: दन्त - धावन, स्नान, सन्ध्यादि वन्दन ।
गुरु - सेवा, ऊर्ध्व - पुण्ड् - चक्रादि - धारण ॥332॥
cc-madhya-24.332.translation: "In the morning, one should regularly brush his teeth, take his bath, offer prayers to the Lord and offer obeisances to the spiritual master. One should render service to the spiritual master and paint one's body in twelve places with ūrdhva-puṇḍra [tilaka]. One should stamp the holy names of the Lord on his body, or one should stamp the symbols of the Lord, such as the disc and club.

devanagari: गोपीचन्दन - माल्य - धृति, तुलसी - आहरण ।
वस्त्र - पीठ - गृह - संस्कार, कृष्ण - प्रबोधन ॥333॥
cc-madhya-24.333.translation: "After this, you should describe how one should decorate his body with gopīcandana, wear neck beads, collect tulasī leaves from the tulasī tree, cleanse his cloth and the altar, cleanse one's own house or apartment and go to the temple and ring the bell just to draw the attention of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

devanagari: पञ्च, षोड़श, पञ्चाशत् उपचारे अर्चन ।
पञ्च - काल पूजा आरति, कृष्णेर भोजन - शयन ॥334॥
cc-madhya-24.334.translation: "Also describe Deity worship, wherein one should offer food to Kṛṣṇa at least five times daily. One should in due time place Kṛṣṇa on a bed. You should also describe the process for offering ārati and the worship of the Lord according to the list of five, sixteen or fifty ingredients.

devanagari: श्री - मूर्ति - लक्षण, आर शालग्राम - लक्षण ।
कृष्ण - क्षेत्र - यात्रा, कृष्ण - मूर्ति - दरशन ॥335॥
cc-madhya-24.335.translation: "The characteristics of the Deities should be discussed as well as the characteristics of the śālagrāma-śilā. One should also discuss visiting the Deities in the temple and touring holy places like Vṛndāvana, Mathurā and Dvārakā.

devanagari: नाम - महिमा, नामापराध दूरे वर्जन ।
वैष्णव - लक्षण, सेवापराध - खण्डन ॥336॥
cc-madhya-24.336.translation: "You should glorify the holy name and carefully give up offenses when chanting the holy name. One should know the symptoms of a Vaiṣṇava. One must give up or nullify all kinds of sevā-aparādha, offenses in Deity worship.

devanagari: शङ्ख - जल - गन्ध - पुष्प - धूपादि - लक्षण ।
जप, स्तुति, परिक्रमा, दण्डवत् वन्दन ॥337॥
cc-madhya-24.337.translation: "The items of worship, such as water, conchshell, flowers, incense and lamp, should be described. You should also mention chanting softly, offering prayers, circumambulating, and offering obeisances. All these should be carefully studied.

devanagari: पुरश्चरण - विधि, कृष्णप्रसाद - भोजन ।
अनिवेदित - त्याग, वैष्णव - निन्दादि - वर्जन ॥338॥
cc-madhya-24.338.translation: "Other items to be considered are the method of performing puraścaraṇa, taking kṛṣṇa-prasāda, giving up unoffered food and not blaspheming the Lord's devotees.

devanagari: साधु - लक्षण, साधु - सङ्ग साधु - सेवन ।
असत्सङ्ग - त्याग, श्री - भागवत - श्रवण ॥339॥
cc-madhya-24.339.translation: "One should know the symptoms of a devotee and how to associate with devotees. One should know how to satisfy the devotee by rendering service, and one should know how to give up the association of nondevotees. One should also regularly hear the recitation of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

devanagari: कान्ता - गणेर रति पाय ‘महाभाव’ - सीमा ।
‘भक्ति’ - शब्देर एइ सब अ र्थेर महिमा ॥34॥
cc-madhya-24.34.translation: "The gopīs of Vṛndāvana who are attached to Kṛṣṇa in conjugal love can increase their ecstatic love up to the point of mahābhāva [the greatest ecstatic love]. These are some of the glorious meanings of the word bhakti, devotional service.

devanagari: दिन - कृत्य, पक्ष - कृत्य, एकादश्यादि - विवरण ।
मास - कृत्य, जन्माष्टम्यादि - विधि - विचारण ॥340॥
cc-madhya-24.340.translation: "You should describe the ritualistic duties of every day, and you should describe the fortnightly duties-especially observing Ekādaśī fast, which comes every fortnight. You should also describe the duties of every month, especially the observance of ceremonies like Janmāṣṭamī, Rāma-navamī and Nṛsiṁha-caturdaśī.

devanagari: एकादशी, जन्माष्टमी, वामन - द्वादशी ।
श्री - राम - नवमी, आर नृसिंह - चतुर्दशी ॥341॥
cc-madhya-24.341.translation: "Ekādaśī, Janmāṣṭamī, Vāmana-dvādaśī, Rāma-navamī and Nṛsiṁha-caturdaśī should all be observed.

devanagari: एइ सबे विद्धा - त्याग, अविद्धा - करण ।
अकरणे दोष, कैले भक्तिर लम्भन ॥342॥
cc-madhya-24.342.translation: "You should recommend the avoidance of mixed Ekādaśī and the performance of pure Ekādaśī. You should also describe the fault in not observing this. One should be very careful as far as these items are concerned. If one is not careful, one will be negligent in executing devotional service.

devanagari: सर्वत्र प्रमाण दिबे पुराण - वचन ।
श्री - मूर्ति - विष्णु - मन्दिर - करण - लक्षण ॥343॥
cc-madhya-24.343.translation: "Whatever you say about Vaiṣṇava behavior, the establishment of Vaiṣṇava temples and Deities and everything else should be supported by evidence from the Purāṇas.

devanagari: ‘सामान्य’ सदाचार, आर ‘वैष्णव’ - आचार ।
कर्तव्याकर्तव्य सब ‘स्मार्त’ व्यवहार ॥344॥
cc-madhya-24.344.translation: "You should give general and specific descriptions of the behavior and activities of a Vaiṣṇava. You should outline things that are to be done and things that are not to be done. All this should be described as regulations and etiquette.

lines: yabe tumi likhibā, kṛṣṇa karābe sphuraṇa
devanagari: एइ सङ्क्षेपे सूत्र कहिलुँ दिग्दरशन ।
यबे तुमि लिखिबा, कृष्ण कराबे स्फुरण ॥345॥
cc-madhya-24.345.translation: "I have thus given a synopsis of the Vaiṣṇava regulative principles. I have given this in brief just to give you a little direction. When you write on this subject, Kṛṣṇa will help you by spiritually awakening you."

lines: ei ta' kahilu prabhura sanātane prasāda
devanagari: एइ त’ कहिलु प्रभुर सनातने प्रसाद ।
याहार श्रवणे चित्तेर खण्डे अवसाद ॥346॥
cc-madhya-24.346.translation: Thus I have narrated Lord Caitanya's mercy upon Sanātana Gosvāmī. When one hears these topics, one's heart will be cleansed of all contamination.

devanagari: निज - ग्रन्थे कर्णपूर विस्तार करिया ।
सनातने प्रभुर प्रसाद राखियाछे लिखिया ॥347॥
cc-madhya-24.347.translation: The authorized poet Kavi-karṇapūra has written a book named Caitanya-candrodaya-nāṭaka. This book tells how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu blessed Sanātana Gosvāmī with His specific mercy.

lines: gauḍendrasya sabhā-vibhūṣaṇa-maṇis tyaktvā ya ṛddhāṁ śriyaṁ
rūpasyāgraja eṣa eva taruṇīṁ vairāgya-lakṣmīṁ dadhe
śaivālaiḥ pihitaṁ mahā-sara iva prīti-pradas tad-vidām
devanagari: गौड़ेन्द्रस्य सभा - विभूषण - मणिस्त्यक्त्वा य ऋद्धां श्रियं रूपस्याग्रज एष एव तरुणीं वैराग्य - लक्ष्मीं दधे ।
अन्तर्भक्ति - रसेन पूर्ण - हृदयो बाह्येऽवधूताकृतिः शैवालैः पिहितं महा - सर इव प्रीति - प्रदस्तद्विदाम् ॥348॥
cc-madhya-24.348.translation: "Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, the elder brother of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, was a most important minister in the government of Hussain Shah, the ruler of Bengal, and he was considered a most brilliant gem in that assembly. He possessed all the opulences of a royal position, but he gave up everything just to accept the youthful goddess of renunciation. Although he externally appeared to be a mendicant who had renounced everything, he was filled with the pleasure of devotional service within his heart. Thus he can be compared to a deep lake covered with moss. He was the object of pleasure for all the devotees who knew the science of devotional service.

devanagari: तं सनातनमुपागतमक्ष्णोर् दृष्ट - मात्रमतिमात्र - दयार्द्रः ।
आलिलिङ्ग परिघायत - दोभ्य सानुकम्पमथ चम्पक - गौरः ॥349॥
cc-madhya-24.349.translation: "As soon as Sanātana Gosvāmī arrived in front of Lord Caitanya, the Lord, seeing him, became merciful to him. The Lord, who has the complexion of a golden campaka flower, opened His arms and embraced him while expressing great affection."

devanagari: ‘इत्थम्भूत - गुणः’ - शब्देर शुनह व्याख्यान ।
‘इत्थं’ - शब्देर भिन्न अर्थ, ‘गुण’ - शब्देर आन ॥35॥
cc-madhya-24.35.translation: "Please hear the meaning of the word ittham-bhūta-guṇa, which is found in the ātmārāma verse. Ittham-bhūta has different meanings, and guṇa has other meanings.

devanagari: कालेन वृन्दावन - केलि - वार्ता लुप्तेति तां ख्यापयितुं विशिष्य ।
कृपामृतेनाभिषिषेच देवस् तत्रैव रूपं च सनातनं च ॥350॥
cc-madhya-24.350.translation: "In the course of time, the transcendental news of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes in Vṛndāvana was almost lost. To enunciate explicitly those transcendental pastimes, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, at Prayāga, empowered Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī with the nectar of His mercy to carry out this work in Vṛndāvana."

lines: ei ta' kahiluṅ sanātane prabhura prasāda
devanagari: एइ त’ कहिलुँ सनातने प्रभुर प्रसाद ।
याहार श्रवणे चित्तेर खण्डे अवसाद ॥351॥
cc-madhya-24.351.translation: I have thus explained the mercy bestowed on Sanātana Gosvāmī by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. If one hears this, all moroseness in the heart will diminish.

devanagari: कृष्णेर स्वरूप - गणेर सकल हय ‘ज्ञान’ ।
विधि - राग - मार्गे ‘साधन - भक्ति’र विधान ॥352॥
cc-madhya-24.352.translation: By reading these instructions to Sanātana Gosvāmī, one will become fully aware of Lord Kṛṣṇa's various expansions and the process of devotional service according to the regulative principles and spontaneous love. Thus everything can be fully known.

lines: ihāra śravaṇe bhakta jānena saba anta
devanagari: ‘कृष्ण - प्रेम’, ‘भक्ति - रस’, ‘भक्तिर सिद्धा न्त’ ।
इहार श्रवणे भक्त जानेन सब अन्त ॥353॥
cc-madhya-24.353.translation: By reading this chapter, a pure devotee can understand love of Kṛṣṇa, the mellows of devotional service and the conclusion of devotional service. Everyone can understand all these things to their ultimate end by studying this chapter.

lines: yāṅra prāṇa-dhana, sei pāya ei dhana
devanagari: श्री - चैतन्य - नित्यानन्द - अद्वैत - चरण ।
याँर प्रा ण - धन, सेइ पाय एइ धन ॥354॥
cc-madhya-24.354.translation: The conclusion of this chapter can be known to one whose life and soul are the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Nityānanda Prabhu and Advaita Prabhu.

devanagari: श्री - रूप - रघुनाथ - पदे यार आश ।
चैतन्य - चरितामृत कहे कृष्णदास ॥355॥
cc-madhya-24.355.translation: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

devanagari: ‘इत्थम्भूत’ - शब्देर अर्थ - पूर्णानन्दमय ।
याँर आगे ब्रह्मानन्द तृण - प्राय हय ॥36॥
cc-madhya-24.36.translation: "The word ittham-bhūta is transcendentally exalted because it means 'full of transcendental bliss.' Before this transcendental bliss, the bliss derived from merging into the existence of the Absolute [brahmānanda] becomes like a piece of straw in comparison.

devanagari: त्वत्साक्षात्करणाह्लाद - विशुद्धाब्धि - स्थितस्य मे ।
सुखानि गोष्पदायन्ते ब्राह्माण्यपि जगद्गुरो ॥37॥
cc-madhya-24.37.translation: “ 'My dear Lord, O master of the universe, since I have directly seen You, my transcendental bliss has taken the shape of a great ocean. Being situated in that ocean, I now realize all other so-called happiness to be like the water contained in the hoofprint of a calf.'

devanagari: सर्वाकर्षक, सर्वाह्लादक, महा - रसायन ।
आपनार बले करे सर्व - विस्मारण ॥38॥
cc-madhya-24.38.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa is so exalted that He is more attractive than anything else and more pleasing than anything else. He is the most sublime abode of bliss. By His own strength, He causes one to forget all other ecstasies.

devanagari: भुक्ति - मुक्ति - सिद्धि - सुख छाड़य यार गन्धे ।
अलौकिक शक्ति - गुणे कृष्ण - कृपाय बान्धे ॥39॥
cc-madhya-24.39.translation: "Pure devotional service is so sublime that one can very easily forget the happiness derived from material happiness, material liberation and mystic or yogic perfection. Thus the devotee is bound by Kṛṣṇa's mercy and His uncommon power and qualifications.

lines: eka śloke āṭhāra artha kairācha vyākhyāne
devanagari: ‘पूर्वे शुनियाछों, तुमि सार्वभौम - स्थाने ।
एक श्लोके आठार अर्थ कैराछ व्याख्याने’ ॥4॥
cc-madhya-24.4.translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī said, "My Lord, I have heard that previously, at the home of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, You explained the ātmārāma verse in eighteen different ways.

devanagari: शास्त्र - युक्ति नाहि इहाँ सिद्धान्त - विचार ।
एइ स्वभाव - गुणे, याते माधुर्येर सार ॥40॥
cc-madhya-24.40.translation: "When one is attracted to Kṛṣṇa on the transcendental platform, there is no longer any logical argument on the basis of revealed scripture, nor are there considerations of such conclusions. This is His transcendental quality that is the essence of all transcendental sweetness.

devanagari: ‘गुण’ शब्देर अर्थ - कृष्णेर गुण अनन्त ।
सच्चिद् - रूप - गुण सर्व पूर्णानन्द ॥41॥
cc-madhya-24.41.translation: "The word guṇa means 'quality.' The qualities of Kṛṣṇa are transcendentally situated and are unlimited in quantity. All of the spiritual qualities are full of transcendental bliss.

devanagari: ऐश्वर्य - माधुर्य - कारुण्ये स्वरूप - पूर्णता ।
भक्त - वात्सल्य, आत्म - पर्यन्त वदान्यता ॥42॥
cc-madhya-24.42.translation: "Kṛṣṇa's transcendental qualities such as opulence, sweetness and mercy are perfect and full. As far as Kṛṣṇa's affectionate leaning toward His devotees is concerned, He is so magnanimous that He can give Himself to His devotees.

lines: kāro mana kona guṇe kare ākarṣaṇa
devanagari: अलौकिक रूप, रस, सौरभादि गुण ।
कारो मन कोन गुणे करे आकर्षण ॥43॥
